To quantify the significance of firms' plant‐level networks for the propagation and amplification of local productivity shocks, we estimate a quantitative spatial model in which plants of multi‐region firms are linked through shared knowledge. Counterfactual exercises show that while large industrial plant openings have a greater local impact in less developed regions, the aggregate gains are greatest when the plants locate in well‐developed regions, which are connected to other regions through firms' plant‐level (knowledge‐sharing) networks.
records.abstract_cn: 集聚经济的收益被认为具有高度地方性。利用保密的普查工厂层面数据，我们表明大型工业工厂的开设不仅提高了当地工厂的生产率，还提高了数百英里之外遥远工厂的生产率，这些遥远工厂属于大型多工厂、多区域企业，通过其一家工厂接触到地方生产率溢出效应。这种“全球性”生产率溢出效应不随距离衰减，并且当工厂处于相互共享知识的行业时更为强烈。为了量化企业工厂层面网络对地方生产率冲击的传播和放大的重要性，我们估计了一个定量空间模型，在该模型中，多区域企业的工厂通过共享知识相互联系。反事实实验表明，虽然大型工业工厂的开设在欠发达地区具有更大的地方影响，但当工厂位于发达地区时，总体收益最大，因为这些地区通过企业的工厂层面（知识共享）网络与其他地区相连。

records.title_en: Endogenous Production Networks Under Supply Chain Uncertainty
records.title_cn: 供应链不确定性下的内生生产网络
records.abstract_en: Supply chain disturbances can lead to substantial increases in production costs. To mitigate these risks, firms may take steps to reduce their reliance on volatile suppliers. We construct a model of endogenous network formation to investigate how these decisions affect the structure of the production network and the level and volatility of macroeconomic aggregates. When uncertainty increases in the model, producers prefer to purchase from more stable suppliers, even though they might sell at higher prices. The resulting reorganization of the network tends to reduce macroeconomic volatility, but at the cost of a decline in aggregate output. The model also predicts that more productive and stable firms have higher Domar weights—a measure of their importance as suppliers—in the equilibrium network. We provide a basic calibration of the model using U.S. data to evaluate the importance of these mechanisms.
records.abstract_cn: 供应链扰动可能导致生产成本大幅增加。为减轻这些风险，企业可能采取措施减少对不稳定供应商的依赖。我们构建了一个内生网络形成模型，以研究这些决策如何影响生产网络的结构以及宏观经济总量的水平和波动性。当模型中的不确定性增加时，生产者更倾向于从更稳定的供应商处采购，即使这些供应商可能以更高的价格出售。由此产生的网络重组倾向于降低宏观经济波动性，但代价是总产出下降。该模型还预测，在生产率和稳定性方面更具优势的企业在均衡网络中具有更高的多马尔权重——这是衡量其作为供应商重要性的指标。我们使用美国数据对模型进行了基本校准，以评估这些机制的重要性。

records.title_en: Spatial Unit Roots and Spurious Regression
records.title_cn: 空间单位根与伪回归
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a model for, and investigates the consequences of, strong spatial dependence in economic variables. Our findings echo those of the corresponding “unit root” time series literature: Spatial unit root processes induce spuriously significant regression results, even with clustered standard errors or spatial HAC corrections. We develop large‐sample valid unit root and stationarity tests that can detect such strong spatial dependence. Finally, we use simulations to study strategies for valid inference in regressions with persistent spatial data, such as spatial analogues of first‐differencing transformations. Regressions from Chetty, Hendren, Kline, and Saez (2014) are used to illustrate the issues and methods.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个模型，并研究了经济变量中强空间依赖性的后果。我们的发现与相应的“单位根”时间序列文献相呼应：空间单位根过程会导致伪显著的回归结果，即使使用聚类标准误或空间HAC修正也是如此。我们开发了大样本有效的单位根和平稳性检验，能够检测这种强空间依赖性。最后，我们使用模拟来研究在具有持久性空间数据的回归中进行有效推断的策略，例如空间一阶差分变换的类似物。Chetty、Hendren、Kline和Saez（2014）的回归被用来说明这些问题和方法。

records.title_en: Lifestyle Behaviors and Wealth‐Health Gaps in Germany
records.title_cn: 德国生活方式行为与财富-健康差距
records.abstract_en: We document significant gaps in wealth across health status over the life cycle in Germany—a country with a universal healthcare system and negligible out‐of‐pocket medical expenses. To investigate the underlying sources of these wealth‐health gaps, we build a heterogeneous‐agent life‐cycle model in which health and wealth evolve endogenously. In the model, agents exert efforts to lead a healthy lifestyle, which helps maintain good health status in the future. Effort choices, or lifestyle behaviors, are subject to adjustment costs to capture their habitual nature in the data. We find that our estimated model generates the great majority of the empirical wealth gaps by health and quantify the role of earnings and savings channels through which health affects these gaps. We show that variations in individual health efforts account for around a quarter of the model‐generated wealth gaps by health, illustrating their role as an amplification mechanism behind the gaps.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了德国生命周期中按健康状况划分的显著财富差距——德国是一个拥有全民医疗保健体系和可忽略不计的自付医疗费用的国家。为了调查这些财富-健康差距的根本来源，我们构建了一个异质性主体生命周期模型，其中健康和财富内生演化。在模型中，主体付出努力以过上健康的生活方式，这有助于在未来维持良好的健康状况。努力选择，或生活方式行为，受到调整成本的约束，以捕捉其在数据中的习惯性特征。我们发现，我们估计的模型产生了按健康划分的经验财富差距的绝大部分，并量化了健康通过这些差距影响的收入和储蓄渠道的作用。我们表明，个体健康努力的差异约占模型生成的按健康划分的财富差距的四分之一，说明它们作为差距背后的放大机制的作用。

records.title_en: Contractual Chains
records.title_cn: 合同链
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a model of private bilateral contracting, in which an exogenous network determines the pairs of players who can communicate and contract with each other. After contracting, the players interact in an underlying game with globally verifiable productive actions and externally enforced transfers. The paper investigates whether such decentralized contracting can internalize externalities that arise due to parties being unable to contract directly with others whose productive actions affect their payoffs. The contract‐formation protocol, called the “contracting institution,” is treated as a design element. The main result is positive: There is a contracting institution that supports efficient equilibria for any underlying game and connected network. A critical property is that the institution allows for sequential contract formation or revision. The equilibrium construction features assurance contracts and cancellation penalties.
records.abstract_cn: 本文发展了一个私人双边合同模型，其中外生网络决定了哪些玩家之间可以沟通和签订合同。在签订合同后，玩家在一个基础博弈中互动，该博弈具有全局可验证的生产行动和外部执行的转移支付。本文研究了这种分散化合同能否内化由于各方无法直接与那些其生产行动影响其收益的其他人签订合同而产生的外部性。合同形成协议，称为“合同制度”，被视为设计元素。主要结果是积极的：存在一种合同制度，能够为任何基础博弈和连通网络支持有效均衡。一个关键特性是该制度允许顺序合同形成或修订。均衡构建具有保证合同和取消罚金的特点。

records.title_en: Nonrepresentativeness in Population Health Research: Evidence from a COVID-19 Antibody Study
records.title_cn: 人群健康研究中的非代表性：来自一项COVID-19抗体研究的证据
records.abstract_en: We analyze representativeness in a COVID-19 serological study with randomized participation incentives. We find large participation gaps by race and income when incentives are lower. High incentives increase participation rates for all groups but increase them more among under-represented groups. High incentives restore representativeness on race and income and also on health variables likely to be correlated with seropositivity, such as the uninsured rate, hospitalization rates, and an aggregate COVID-19 risk index. (JEL C83, I11, I14, J15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一项具有随机参与激励的COVID-19血清学研究中的代表性。我们发现，当激励较低时，种族和收入方面的参与差距较大。高激励提高了所有群体的参与率，但在代表性不足的群体中提高得更多。高激励恢复了种族和收入方面的代表性，也恢复了可能与血清阳性相关的健康变量的代表性，如未保险率、住院率和综合COVID-19风险指数。（JEL C83, I11, I14, J15）

records.title_en: Zooming to Class? Experimental Evidence on College Students’ Online Learning during COVID-19
records.title_cn: Zoom上课？COVID-19期间大学生在线学习的实验证据
records.abstract_en: One persistent question in higher education is the efficacy of online education. In the fall of 2020, we randomized 551 West Point students in a required introductory economics course across 12 instructors to either an online or in-person class as a response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Final grades for online students dropped by 0.215 standard deviations, a result apparent in both assignments and exams and largest for academically at-risk students. A postcourse survey finds that online students struggled to concentrate in class and felt less connected to their instructors and peers. Our results show detrimental effects for online learning. (JEL A22, I12, I23, I26)
records.abstract_cn: 高等教育中一个长期存在的问题是在线教育的有效性。2020年秋季，我们将西点军校551名选修一门必修经济学入门课程的学生随机分配到12名教师下的在线或面授课堂，以应对COVID-19疫情。在线学生的期末成绩下降了0.215个标准差，这一结果在作业和考试中均显而易见，且对学业上有风险的学生影响最大。课程后调查发现，在线学生在课堂上难以集中注意力，并感到与教师和同伴的联系减少。我们的结果表明在线学习存在不利影响。（JEL A22, I12, I23, I26）

records.title_en: The Labor Market Impacts of Reducing Felony Convictions
records.title_cn: 减少重罪定罪对劳动力市场的影响
records.abstract_en: We study the labor market impacts of retroactively reducing felonies to misdemeanors in San Joaquin County, California, where criminal justice agencies implemented Proposition 47 reductions in a quasi-random order, without requiring input or action from affected individuals. Linking records of reductions to administrative tax data, we find employment benefits for individuals who (likely) requested their reduction, consistent with selection, but no benefits among the larger subset of individuals whose records were reduced proactively. A field experiment notifying a subset of individuals about their proactive reduction also shows null results, implying that lack of awareness is unlikely to explain our findings. (JEL C93, H76, J22, K14, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了加利福尼亚州圣华金县追溯性地将重罪减少为轻罪对劳动力市场的影响，该县的刑事司法机构以准随机顺序实施了提案 47 减少罪名，而不需要受影响个人的意见或行动。将减少记录与行政税收数据联系起来，我们发现（可能）要求减少的个人有就业福利，这与选择一致，但主动减少记录的较大子集的个人没有受益。一项向一部分人通报其主动减少排放的现场实验也显示出无效结果，这意味着缺乏意识不太可能解释我们的发现。 （JEL C93、H76、J22、K14、K42）

records.title_en: Regulating Transformative Technologies
records.title_cn: 监管变革性技术
records.abstract_en: Transformative technologies like generative AI promise to accelerate productivity growth across many sectors, but they also present new risks from potential misuse. We develop a multisector technology adoption model to study the optimal regulation of transformative technologies when society can learn about these risks over time. Socially optimal adoption is gradual and typically convex. If social damages are large and proportional to the new technology’s productivity, a higher growth rate paradoxically leads to slower optimal adoption. Equilibrium adoption is inefficient when firms do not internalize all social damages, and sector-independent regulation is helpful but generally not sufficient to restore optimality. (JEL D21, H21, H25, O31, O33)
records.abstract_cn: 生成式人工智能等变革性技术有望加速许多行业的生产率增长，但也带来了因潜在滥用而产生的新风险。我们构建了一个多部门技术采用模型，研究当社会可以随时间了解这些风险时，对变革性技术的最优监管。社会最优采用是渐进的，且通常是凸性的。如果社会损害较大且与新技术的生产率成比例，那么更高的增长率反而会导致更慢的最优采用。当企业不内化所有社会损害时，均衡采用是无效率的，而部门无关的监管是有帮助的，但通常不足以恢复最优性。（JEL D21, H21, H25, O31, O33）

records.title_en: Central Bank Credibility and Fiscal Responsibility
records.title_cn: 中央银行可信度与财政责任
records.abstract_en: We consider a New Keynesian model with strategic monetary and fiscal interactions. The fiscal authority maximizes social welfare. Monetary policy is delegated to a central bank with an anti-inflation bias that suffers from a lack of commitment. The impact of central bank hawkishness on debt issuance is nonmonotonic because increased hawkishness reduces the benefit from fiscal stimulus while simultaneously increasing real debt capacity. Starting from high levels of hawkishness (dovishness), a marginal increase in the central bank’s anti-inflation bias decreases (increases) debt issuance. (JEL E12, E31, E52, E58, E62, H63)
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个具有战略货币和财政互动的新凯恩斯主义模型。财政当局最大化社会福利。货币政策被委托给一个具有反通胀倾向但缺乏承诺能力的中央银行。中央银行鹰派立场对债务发行的非单调影响，是因为更强的鹰派立场降低了财政刺激的收益，同时增加了实际债务能力。从高水平的鹰派（鸽派）立场出发，中央银行反通胀倾向的边际增加会减少（增加）债务发行。（JEL E12, E31, E52, E58, E62, H63）

records.title_en: The Socioeconomic Distribution of Choice Quality: Evidence from Health Insurance in the Netherlands
records.title_cn: 选择质量的社会经济分布：来自荷兰健康保险的证据
records.abstract_en: We study how choice quality relates to socioeconomic factors, using population-wide data on health insurance choices and utilization in the Netherlands. We document a striking choice quality gradient with respect to socioeconomic status, finding that those with higher income, higher education, and training in quantitative fields make meaningfully better choices. Household income for the top 5 percent of decision-makers, in terms of surplus captured, is almost three times higher than for the bottom 5 percent. When jointly including all factors, education degree and field of study are more important predictors of choice quality than income and other financial variables. (JEL D31, G22, G52, I13, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用荷兰健康保险选择和利用的全人口数据，研究选择质量如何与社会经济因素相关。我们记录了选择质量与社会经济地位之间显著的梯度关系，发现收入较高、教育程度较高以及接受过定量领域培训的人做出的选择明显更好。就获得的剩余而言，排名前5%的决策者的家庭收入几乎是排名后5%的决策者的三倍。当将所有因素共同纳入时，教育程度和学习领域比收入和其他财务变量更能预测选择质量。（JEL D31, G22, G52, I13, L15）

records.title_en: Repression and Repertoires
records.title_cn: 镇压与行动剧目
records.abstract_en: We formalize Tilly’s concept of repertoires of collective action and analyze how state repression affects the variety of observed contentious actions. When repression accelerates with higher levels of antiregime actions (convex repression structure), opposition leaders tend to call for many different forms of contentious actions, thereby generating a wider repertoire. In contrast, when repression decelerates with higher contentious actions (concave repression structure, including indiscriminate repression), opposition leaders tend to call for just one form of contentious action, thereby generating a narrower repertoire. Methodologically, we deliver an analysis for settings in which coordination and delegation are intertwined. (JEL D71, D72, D74, D82)
records.abstract_cn: 我们形式化了蒂利关于集体行动剧目的概念，并分析国家镇压如何影响所观察到的抗争行动的多样性。当镇压随着反政权行动水平的升高而加速（凸性镇压结构）时，反对派领导人倾向于号召多种不同形式的抗争行动，从而产生更广泛的剧目。相反，当镇压随着抗争行动的升高而减速（凹性镇压结构，包括不分青红皂白的镇压）时，反对派领导人倾向于只号召一种形式的抗争行动，从而产生更狭窄的剧目。在方法论上，我们提供了对协调与委托相互交织情境的分析。（JEL D71, D72, D74, D82）

records.title_en: Dynamic Spending Responses to Wealth Shocks: Evidence from Quasi Lotteries on the Stock Market
records.title_cn: 财富冲击的动态支出反应：来自股市准彩票的证据
records.abstract_en: How much and over what horizon do households adjust their consumption in response to stock market wealth shocks? We address these questions using granular data on spending and stock portfolios from a large bank and exploiting lottery-like variation in gains across investors with similar portfolio characteristics. Consistent with the permanent income hypothesis, spending responses to stock market gains are immediate and persistent. The monthly responses cumulate to marginal propensities to consume of 4.4 percent over one year and 16 percent over three years. The results suggest that inattention attenuates household responses to stock market cycles over horizons as long as one year. (JEL D12, E21, G11, G14, G51)
records.abstract_cn: 家庭如何以及在多长时间范围内调整其消费以应对股市财富冲击？我们利用一家大型银行的支出和股票投资组合的细粒度数据，并利用具有相似投资组合特征的投资者之间收益的彩票式变化来解决这些问题。与永久收入假说一致，对股市收益的支出反应是即时且持久的。月度反应累积为一年内边际消费倾向4.4%，三年内16%。结果表明，在长达一年的时间范围内，忽视会减弱家庭对股市周期的反应。（JEL D12, E21, G11, G14, G51）

records.title_en: Arbitraging Covered Interest Rate Parity Deviations and Bank Lending
records.title_cn: 套利抛补利率平价偏离与银行贷款
records.abstract_en: I propose and test a new channel through which covered interest rate parity (CIP) deviations can affect bank lending in emerging economies. I argue that when CIP deviations exist, banks attempt to arbitrage them. To do so, banks must borrow in a particular currency. When this currency is scarce, bank lending in the currency required to arbitrage decreases, while they use this currency in their arbitrage activities. I test this channel by exploiting differences in the abilities of Peruvian banks to arbitrage CIP deviations. I find evidence that supports the proposed channel.
records.abstract_cn: 我提出并检验了一个新渠道，通过该渠道，抛补利率平价（CIP）偏离可以影响新兴经济体的银行贷款。我认为，当CIP偏离存在时，银行试图对其进行套利。为此，银行必须以特定货币借款。当这种货币稀缺时，套利所需货币的银行贷款减少，而银行将这种货币用于其套利活动。我通过利用秘鲁银行套利CIP偏离能力的差异来检验这一渠道。我发现了支持所提出渠道的证据。

records.title_en: Revealing Choice Bracketing
records.title_cn: 揭示选择分框
records.abstract_en: Experiments suggest that people fail to take into account interdependencies between their choices—they do not broadly bracket. Researchers often instead assume people narrowly bracket, but existing designs do not test it. We design a novel experiment and revealed preference tests for how someone brackets their choices. In portfolio allocation under risk, social allocation, and induced-value shopping experiments, 40–43 percent of subjects are consistent with narrow bracketing, and 0–16 percent with broad bracketing. Adjusting for each model's predictive precision, 74 percent of subjects are best described by narrow bracketing, 13 percent by broad bracketing, and 6 percent by intermediate cases.
records.abstract_cn: 实验表明，人们未能考虑其选择之间的相互依赖性——他们不会进行广义分框。研究者通常反而假设人们进行狭义分框，但现有设计并未对此进行检验。我们设计了一项新颖的实验和显示性偏好检验，以考察人们如何对其选择进行分框。在风险下的投资组合配置、社会分配和诱导价值购物实验中，40-43%的受试者与狭义分框一致，0-16%与广义分框一致。根据每个模型的预测精度进行调整后，74%的受试者被最佳描述为狭义分框，13%为广义分框，6%为中间情形。

records.title_en: Valuing Long-Term Property Rights with Anticipated Political Regime Shifts
records.title_cn: 预期政治体制转变下的长期产权估值
records.abstract_en: We identify exposure to political risk by exploiting a unique variation around land lease extension protection after 2047 in Hong Kong's housing market due to historical arrangements. Relative to properties that have been promised an extension protection, those with unprotected leases granted by the current government are sold at a discount of 8 percent; those with colonial leases suffer an additional discount of 8 percent. Incorporating estimated structural parameters that suggest an additional 20 percent ground rent after 2047, our model matches empirical discounts well across lease horizons. Discounts increase over time, particularly in areas with greater pessimism about the city's future.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过利用香港住房市场中因历史安排而在2047年后土地租约续期保护方面的独特差异，来识别政治风险的暴露程度。相对于已承诺续期保护的物业，由现政府授予的无保护租约物业以8%的折扣出售；而殖民时期租约的物业则额外遭受8%的折扣。结合估计的结构参数（表明2047年后额外20%的地租），我们的模型在不同租约期限下很好地匹配了经验折扣。折扣随时间增加，尤其是在对城市未来更为悲观的地区。

records.title_en: Age Set versus Kin: Culture and Financial Ties in East Africa
records.title_cn: 年龄组与亲属关系：东非的文化与金融联系
records.abstract_en: We study how social organization shapes patterns of economic interaction and the effects of national policy, focusing on the distinction between age-based and kin-based groups in sub-Saharan Africa. Motivated by ethnographic accounts suggesting that this distinction affects redistribution, we analyze a cash transfer program in Kenya and find that in age-based societies there are consumption spillovers within the age cohort, but not the extended family, while in kin-based societies we find the opposite. Next, we document that social structure shapes the impact of policy by showing that Uganda's pension program had positive effects on child nutrition only in kin-based societies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究社会组织如何塑造经济互动模式和国家政策的影响，重点关注撒哈拉以南非洲地区基于年龄和基于亲属关系的群体之间的区别。受民族志记载的启发，这些记载表明这种区别影响再分配，我们分析了肯尼亚的一项现金转移计划，发现在基于年龄的社会中，消费溢出发生在同龄群体内部，而非大家庭内部，而在基于亲属关系的社会中，我们发现情况相反。接下来，我们通过展示乌干达的养老金计划仅在基于亲属关系的社会中对儿童营养产生积极影响，记录了社会结构如何塑造政策的影响。

records.title_en: Investing in the Next Generation: The Long-Run Impacts of a Liquidity Shock
records.title_cn: 投资下一代：流动性冲击的长期影响
records.abstract_en: Poor entrepreneurs must frequently choose between business investment and children's education. To examine this trade-off, we exploit experimental variation in short-run microenterprise growth among a sample of Indian households and track schooling and business out-comes over eleven years. Treated households, who experience higher initial microenterprise growth, are on average one-third more likely to send children to college. However, educational investment and schooling gains are concentrated among literate-parent households, whose enterprises eventually stagnate. In contrast, illiterate-parent households experience long-run business gains but declines in children's education. Our findings suggest that microenterprise growth has the potential to reduce relative intergenerational educational mobility.
records.abstract_cn: 贫困企业家常常不得不在商业投资与子女教育之间做出选择。为了考察这一权衡，我们利用印度家庭样本中短期微型企业增长的实验性变异，并追踪了十一年间的教育与企业成果。接受处理的家庭，其初始微型企业增长较高，平均而言，将子女送入大学的可能性高出三分之一。然而，教育投资和学业收益集中在有文化的父母家庭，这些家庭的企业最终停滞不前。相比之下，无文化的父母家庭经历了长期的企业收益，但子女教育却有所下降。我们的研究结果表明，微型企业增长有可能降低相对代际教育流动性。

records.title_en: Big Loans to Small Businesses: Predicting Winners and Losers in an Entrepreneurial Lending Experiment
records.title_cn: 向小企业发放大额贷款：预测创业贷款实验中的赢家与输家
records.abstract_en: We experimentally study the impact of relatively large enterprise loans in Egypt. Larger loans generate small average impacts, but machine learning using psychometric data reveals "top performers" (those with the highest predicted treatment effects) substantially increase profits, while profits drop for poor performers. The large differences imply that lender credit allocation decisions matter for aggregate income, yet we find existing practice leads to substantial misallocation. We argue that some entrepreneurs are overoptimistic and squander the opportunities presented by larger loans by taking on too much risk, and show the promise of allocations based on entrepreneurial type relative to firm characteristics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究了埃及相对大额的企业贷款的影响。较大贷款产生较小的平均影响，但使用心理测量数据的机器学习揭示了“表现最佳者”（那些预测处理效应最高的人）显著增加利润，而表现不佳者的利润则下降。巨大的差异意味着贷款机构的信贷分配决策对总收入至关重要，然而我们发现现有实践导致了显著的错配。我们认为一些企业家过度乐观，通过承担过多风险而浪费了较大贷款带来的机会，并展示了基于企业家类型相对于企业特征的分配前景。

records.title_en: In-Kind Transfers as Insurance
records.title_cn: 实物转移支付作为保险
records.abstract_en: Households in developing countries often face variation in the prices of consumption goods. We develop a model demonstrating that in-kind transfers will provide insurance benefits against price risk if the covariance between the marginal utility of income and price is positive. Using calorie shortfalls as a proxy for marginal utility, we find that this condition holds for low-income Indian households. Expansions in India's flagship in-kind food transfer program not only increase caloric intake but also reduce caloric sensitivity to prices. Our results contribute to ongoing debates about the optimal form of social protection programs.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的家庭经常面临消费品价格的变化。我们构建了一个模型，表明如果收入边际效用与价格之间的协方差为正，实物转移支付将对价格风险提供保险收益。使用卡路里短缺作为边际效用的代理指标，我们发现这一条件对印度低收入家庭成立。印度旗舰实物食品转移支付项目的扩展不仅增加了卡路里摄入量，还降低了卡路里对价格的敏感性。我们的研究结果为关于社会保护项目最优形式的持续辩论做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Spending and Job-Finding Impacts of Expanded Unemployment Benefits: Evidence from Administrative Micro Data
records.title_cn: 扩大失业救济金的支出与就业影响：来自行政微观数据的证据
records.abstract_en: We show that the largest increase in unemployment benefits in US history had large spending impacts and small job-finding impacts. This finding has three implications. First, increased benefits were important for explaining aggregate spending dynamics—but not employment dynamics—during the pandemic. Second, benefit expansions allow us to study the MPC of normally low-liquidity households in a high-liquidity state. These households still have high MPCs. This suggests a role for permanent behavioral characteristics, rather than just current liquidity, in driving spending behavior. Third, the mechanisms driving our results imply that temporary benefit supplements are a promising countercyclical tool.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，美国历史上最大规模的失业救济金增加产生了巨大的支出影响和较小的就业影响。这一发现具有三个含义。首先，增加的救济金对于解释疫情期间的总支出动态——而非就业动态——至关重要。其次，救济金的扩大使我们能够研究通常流动性较低的家庭在高流动性状态下的边际消费倾向。这些家庭仍然具有较高的边际消费倾向。这表明永久性行为特征，而不仅仅是当前流动性，在驱动支出行为中发挥作用。第三，驱动我们结果的机制意味着临时救济金补充是一种有前景的反周期工具。

records.title_en: Experimentation in Networks
records.title_cn: 网络中的实验
records.abstract_en: We propose a model of strategic experimentation on social networks in which forward-looking agents learn from their own and neighbors' successes. In equilibrium, private discovery is followed by social diffusion. Social learning crowds out own experimentation, so total information decreases with network density; we determine density thresholds below which agents' asymptotic learning is perfect. By contrast, agent welfare is single peaked in network density and achieves a second-best benchmark level at intermediate levels that strike a balance between discovery and diffusion.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个社交网络上的策略性实验模型，其中前瞻性主体从自身及邻居的成功中学习。在均衡中，私人发现之后是社会扩散。社会学习挤出了自身的实验，因此总信息随网络密度而减少；我们确定了密度阈值，低于该阈值时主体的渐近学习是完美的。相比之下，主体福利在网络密度上是单峰的，并在中间水平达到次优基准水平，该水平在发现与扩散之间取得了平衡。

records.title_en: Comparisons of Signals
records.title_cn: 信号的比较
records.abstract_en: A signal is a description of an information source that specifies both its correlation with the state and its correlation with other signals. Extending Blackwell (1953), we characterize when one signal is more valuable than another regardless of preferences and regardless of access to other signals. This comparison is equivalent to reveal-or-refine: every realization of the more valuable signal reveals the state or refines the realization of the less valuable signal. We also study other comparisons of signals, including sufficiency, martingale dominance, and Lehmann. Reveal-or-refine is also equivalent to making any of these comparisons robust to access to other signals.
records.abstract_cn: 信号是对信息源的描述，它既指定了信号与状态的相关性，也指定了信号与其他信号的相关性。我们扩展了Blackwell（1953）的研究，刻画了在何种条件下，无论偏好如何、无论能否获取其他信号，一个信号总是比另一个信号更有价值。这种比较等价于“揭示或细化”：更有价值的信号的每一个实现要么揭示状态，要么细化较不有价值信号的实现。我们还研究了信号的其他比较，包括充分性、鞅占优和Lehmann比较。“揭示或细化”也等价于使这些比较中的任何一种在获取其他信号时具有稳健性。

records.title_en: The Bright Side of Political Uncertainty: The Case of RD
records.title_cn: 政治不确定性的光明面：以研发为例
records.abstract_en: We use close gubernatorial elections as a quasi-natural experiment to document a positive effect of political uncertainty on firm-level R&D. This finding is in contrast to the existing literature documenting a negative impact of political uncertainty on capital investment. We examine potential mechanisms and find that our results are consistent with the growth option view of R&D investment. The effect is stronger for politically sensitive and high-tech industries.The results are robust to different proxies for political uncertainty shocks. As predicted by models of investment under uncertainty, the real effects of political uncertainty critically depend on the type of the investment. JEL G18, G38, O31, O32
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用州长选举的接近程度作为准自然实验，记录了政治不确定性对企业层面研发的积极影响。这一发现与现有文献中关于政治不确定性对资本投资产生负面影响的记录形成对比。我们考察了潜在机制，发现我们的结果与研发投资的增长期权观点一致。这种效应在政治敏感和高科技行业中更为显著。结果对于政治不确定性冲击的不同代理指标均保持稳健。正如不确定性下的投资模型所预测的，政治不确定性的实际影响关键取决于投资类型。JEL G18, G38, O31, O32

records.title_en: Tax Policy and Abnormal Investment Behavior
records.title_cn: 税收政策与异常投资行为
records.abstract_en: This paper studies tax-minimizing investment, whereby firms tilt capital purchases toward year-end to reduce taxes. We use this pattern to characterize how taxes affect investment behavior. We exploit variation in firm tax positions from administrative data to confirm that tax minimization causes spikes. Spikes increase when firms face financial constraints or higher option values of waiting. Cumulative investment does not completely reverse after spikes. We develop an investment model with tax asymmetries to rationalize these patterns. Both depreciation motives (later investments face lower effective tax rates) and option value motives (tax asymmetry implies time-varying opportunities to minimize taxes) are necessary to fit the data. (JEL G31, G38, H25)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了税收最小化投资，即企业将资本购买倾斜至年末以减少税收。我们利用这一模式来刻画税收如何影响投资行为。我们利用行政数据中企业税收头寸的变化来确认税收最小化导致投资尖峰。当企业面临财务约束或等待的期权价值更高时，尖峰增加。尖峰后累计投资并未完全逆转。我们构建了一个具有税收不对称性的投资模型来解释这些模式。折旧动机（后期投资面临较低的有效税率）和期权价值动机（税收不对称意味着最小化税收的机会随时间变化）对于拟合数据都是必要的。（JEL G31, G38, H25）

records.title_en: The Savings of Corporate Giants
records.title_cn: 企业巨头的储蓄
records.abstract_en: We construct a novel panel data set to provide new evidence on how the largest nonfinancial firms manage their financial assets. Our granular data show that, over the past decade, bond portfolios have grown to be at least as large as cash-like instruments, driven by the meteoric rise of corporate bond holdings. To shed light on the drivers of this growth, we conduct a pair of event studies around the 2017 tax reform and the 2020 liquidity crisis. We find that large holdings of marketable securities are primarily driven by cross-border tax incentives, while cash-like instruments are driven by liquidity motives. (JEL G32, G35, G11, E440)
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个新颖的面板数据集，以提供关于最大非金融企业如何管理其金融资产的新证据。我们的细粒度数据显示，在过去十年中，债券投资组合的增长至少与现金类工具相当，这得益于公司债券持有量的急剧上升。为了阐明这种增长的驱动因素，我们围绕2017年税制改革和2020年流动性危机进行了两项事件研究。我们发现，大量持有有价证券主要受跨境税收激励驱动，而现金类工具则受流动性动机驱动。(JEL G32, G35, G11, E440)

records.title_en: Firm Networks and Asset Returns
records.title_cn: 企业网络与资产回报
records.abstract_en: Changes in the propagation of shocks along firm networks are important to understanding aggregate and cross-sectional features of stock returns. When calibrated to match key characteristics of supplier–customer networks in the United States, a model in which firms are interlinked via enduring relationships generates long-run consumption risks, high and volatile risk premiums, and a small and stable risk-free rate. The model also matches cross-sectional patterns of portfolio returns sorted by firm centrality, a feature unaccounted for by standard asset pricing models. (JEL C67, E30, G12, L14)
records.abstract_cn: 冲击沿企业网络的传导变化对于理解股票回报的总体和横截面特征至关重要。当校准以匹配美国供应商-客户网络的关键特征时，一个企业通过持久关系相互关联的模型产生了长期消费风险、高且波动的风险溢价，以及小而稳定的无风险利率。该模型还匹配了按企业中心性排序的投资组合回报的横截面模式，这是标准资产定价模型未能解释的特征。(JEL C67, E30, G12, L14)

records.title_en: The Value of ETF Liquidity
records.title_cn: ETF流动性的价值
records.abstract_en: We analyze how ETFs compete. Drawing on a new model and empirical analysis, we show that ETF secondary market liquidity plays a key role in determining fees. More liquid ETFs for a given index charge higher fees and attract short-horizon investors who are more sensitive to liquidity than to fees. Higher turnover from these investors sustains the ETF’s high liquidity, allowing the ETF to extract a rent through its fee, and creating a first-mover advantage. Liquidity segmentation through clientele effects generates welfare losses. Our findings resolve the apparent paradox that higher-fee ETFs not only survive but also flourish in equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析ETF如何竞争。基于一个新模型和实证分析，我们表明ETF二级市场流动性在决定费用方面起着关键作用。对于给定指数，流动性更高的ETF收取更高的费用，并吸引那些对流动性比对费用更敏感的短期投资者。这些投资者的更高换手率维持了ETF的高流动性，使ETF能够通过其费用提取租金，并创造先发优势。通过客户群体效应进行的流动性分割会产生福利损失。我们的发现解决了高费用ETF不仅在均衡中生存而且蓬勃发展的明显悖论。

records.title_en: Price elasticity of demand and risk-bearing capacity in sovereign bond auctions
records.title_cn: 主权债券拍卖中的需求价格弹性与风险承受能力
records.abstract_en: The paper uses bids submitted by primary dealer banks at auctions of sovereign bonds to quantify the price elasticity of demand. The price elasticity of demand correlates strongly with the volatility of returns of the same bonds traded in the secondary market but only weakly with their bid-ask spread. It predicts same-bond post-auction returns in the secondary market, even after controlling for pre-auction volatility. The evidence suggests that the price elasticity of demand is associated with the magnitude of price pressure in the secondary market around auction days and proxies for primary dealer risk-bearing capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用一级交易商银行在主权债券拍卖中的投标来量化需求的价格弹性。需求的价格弹性与同一债券在二级市场交易的收益波动性密切相关，但与其买卖价差仅弱相关。即使在控制拍卖前波动性后，它也能预测同一债券在二级市场的拍卖后收益。证据表明，需求的价格弹性与拍卖日前后二级市场的价格压力大小相关，并可作为一级交易商风险承受能力的代理指标。

records.title_en: Holding Period Effects in Dividend Strip Returns
records.title_cn: 股息剥离收益中的持有期效应
records.abstract_en: We estimate short-term dividend strip prices from 27 years of S&P 500 index options data (1996-2022). We use option-implied interest rates when estimating strip prices and longer holding period returns to mitigate measurement error. We find that Sharpe ratios for short-term strips are similar to or higher than Sharpe ratios for the market. Short-term strips also have a low market beta and a positive alpha. Over the business cycle, realized term premiums (ie, the difference between market and strip returns) and the term structure of Sharpe ratios move countercyclically, whereas the term structure of alphas moves procyclically.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用27年的标普500指数期权数据（1996-2022）估计短期股息剥离价格。在估计剥离价格和较长持有期收益时，我们使用期权隐含利率以减轻测量误差。我们发现短期剥离的夏普比率与市场的夏普比率相似或更高。短期剥离还具有较低的市场贝塔和正阿尔法。在经济周期中，已实现期限溢价（即市场收益与剥离收益之差）和夏普比率的期限结构呈逆周期变动，而阿尔法的期限结构则呈顺周期变动。

records.title_en: Public wages, public employment, and business cycle volatility: Evidence from U.S. metro areas
records.title_cn: 公共工资、公共就业与商业周期波动：来自美国都市区的证据
records.abstract_en: We revisit the question about whether a larger public sector stabilizes or destabilizes the economy. Based on results from two causal identification approaches, we show that a higher rate of public-sector employment reduces volatility in, i.e. stabilizes, private-sector employment growth, with at most a slight crowding-out of private employment. Public wages, meanwhile, increase private wages but appear not to be destabilizing. The stabilizing effect of public employment with limited crowding out is at odds with standard search and matching models that contain a public sector, which predict 1:1 crowding out and strong destabilization. To improve the performance of such models, we follow Gomes (2015) and add a product market that can replicate what Gomes calls the Business Cycle Wealth Effect. We also point out that the government procures output directly from the private sector. When the model has these two features, then it can generate stabilizing effects of public employment on private employment, with reduced crowding out.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视了关于更大规模的公共部门是稳定还是破坏经济的问题。基于两种因果识别方法的结果，我们表明，公共部门就业率越高，会降低私营部门就业增长的波动性，即起到稳定作用，且对私营就业的挤出效应至多轻微。与此同时，公共工资提高了私营工资，但似乎并未造成不稳定。公共就业的稳定效应与有限的挤出效应，与包含公共部门的标准搜索和匹配模型的预测相悖，后者预测1:1的挤出效应和强烈的不稳定。为了改进此类模型的表现，我们遵循Gomes（2015）的做法，加入了一个能够复制Gomes所称“商业周期财富效应”的产品市场。我们还指出，政府直接从私营部门采购产出。当模型具备这两个特征时，它就能产生公共就业对私营就业的稳定效应，并减少挤出效应。

records.title_en: Real-time forward-looking skewness over the business cycle
records.title_cn: 商业周期中的实时前瞻偏度
records.abstract_en: This paper measures option-implied skewness for individual firms and the S&P 500 index between 1980 and 2021, giving real-time measures of conditional micro and macro skewness. There are three key results: 1. Micro skewness is significantly procyclical, while macro skewness is acyclical; 2. Micro skewness leads the business cycle and is strongly linked to credit spreads, suggesting one potential causal channel; 3. Micro skewness is significantly, and not mechanically, correlated with macro volatility, implying that there is a common shock driving them both, which is also linked to the business cycle.
records.abstract_cn: 本文衡量了1980年至2021年间个股和标普500指数的期权隐含偏度，提供了条件微观和宏观偏度的实时度量。有三个关键结果：1. 微观偏度显著顺周期，而宏观偏度非周期；2. 微观偏度领先商业周期，并与信用利差密切相关，暗示了一个潜在的因果渠道；3. 微观偏度与宏观波动率显著相关，且并非机械性相关，这意味着存在一个共同冲击驱动两者，该冲击也与商业周期相关。

records.title_en: Shocks to inflation expectations
records.title_cn: 通胀预期冲击
records.abstract_en: The consensus among central bankers is that higher inflation expectations can drive up actual inflation. We assess this by devising a novel method for identifying shocks to inflation expectations, estimating a semi-structural VAR where an expectation shock is identified as that which causes measured forecasts to diverge from the rational expectation. Surprisingly, using data for the United States we find that a positive inflation expectation shock is contractionary and deflationary: output, inflation, and interest rates all fall. These results are inconsistent with the standard New Keynesian model, which predicts inflation and interest rate hikes.
records.abstract_cn: 央行行长们的共识是，更高的通胀预期会推高实际通胀。我们通过设计一种识别通胀预期冲击的新方法，估计一个半结构VAR模型，其中预期冲击被识别为导致实际预测偏离理性预期的因素，来评估这一共识。令人惊讶的是，使用美国数据，我们发现正向通胀预期冲击是紧缩性和通缩性的：产出、通胀和利率均下降。这些结果与标准新凯恩斯模型不一致，该模型预测通胀和利率上升。

records.title_en: The macroeconomics of hedging income shares
records.title_cn: 对冲收入份额的宏观经济学
records.abstract_en: The debate about the falling labor share has brought attention to the income-shares trends, but less attention has been devoted to their variability. We analyze how their fluctuations can be insured between workers and capitalists, and the corresponding implications for financial markets. We study a neoclassical growth model with aggregate shocks that affect income shares and financial frictions that prevent firms from fully insuring idiosyncratic risk. We examine theoretically how aggregate risk sharing is shaped by the combination of idiosyncratic risk and moving shares. In this setting, accumulation of safe assets by capitalists and risky assets by workers emerges naturally as a tool to insure income shares' risk. Then, in a quantitative exploration we show that low interest rates, rising capital shares, and accumulation of safe assets by firms and risky assets by households can be rationalized by persistent shocks to the labor share.
records.abstract_cn: 关于劳动份额下降的争论引起了人们对收入份额趋势的关注，但对其波动性的关注较少。我们分析了工人和资本家之间如何为这些波动提供保险，以及相应的金融市场影响。我们研究了一个新古典增长模型，其中包含影响收入份额的总量冲击和阻止企业完全保险特质风险的金融摩擦。我们从理论上考察了特质风险和变动份额的组合如何塑造总量风险分担。在这种设定下，资本家积累安全资产和工人积累风险资产自然成为保险收入份额风险的工具。然后，在定量探索中，我们表明低利率、上升的资本份额以及企业和家庭分别积累安全资产和风险资产的现象，可以通过劳动份额的持续性冲击来合理化。

records.title_en: Coordinating in financial crises
records.title_cn: 金融危机中的协调
records.abstract_en: Why do some financial crises lead to macroeconomic disasters, while others barely affect the real economy? This paper proposes a model to study unusually deep financial crises. Deep crises arise from the interplay of demand-driven coordination failures on the productive sector and weak banks' balance sheets. There is a dynamic feedback between banks' balance sheets and coordination. Coordination failures happen when banks suffer large losses and substantially reduce asset prices and welfare, even if the economy is in good times and they rarely happen. Financial crises that start from similar initial shocks can feature very heterogeneous real effects.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么一些金融危机导致宏观经济灾难，而另一些则几乎不影响实体经济？本文提出了一个模型来研究异常深度的金融危机。深度危机源于生产部门需求驱动的协调失败与银行资产负债表疲软之间的相互作用。银行资产负债表与协调之间存在动态反馈。当银行遭受重大损失并大幅降低资产价格和福利时，即使经济处于良好时期且此类情况很少发生，协调失败也会发生。从类似初始冲击开始的金融危机可能表现出非常异质性的实际影响。

records.title_en: Filtering economic time series: On the cyclical properties of Hamilton's regression filter and the Hodrick-Prescott filter
records.title_cn: 经济时间序列滤波：Hamilton回归滤波器与Hodrick-Prescott滤波器的周期性质
records.abstract_en: The Hamilton (H) filter is proposed as an alternative to the Hodrick-Prescott (HP) filter. It is designed to meet all of the objectives desired by users of the HP filter while avoiding its drawbacks (spurious dynamics, ad hoc filter settings, end-of-sample bias). I document a trade-off that has been overlooked: Addressing the HP filter's drawbacks means that the H filter cannot fulfill all of the desired objectives. It modifies different frequencies captured in an estimated cyclical component by inducing phase shifts and by likely altering variances. Typically, these modifications vary across time series. Through both simulation and real data exercises, I illustrate each filter's cyclical properties.
records.abstract_cn: Hamilton（H）滤波器被提议作为Hodrick-Prescott（HP）滤波器的替代方案。它旨在满足HP滤波器用户期望的所有目标，同时避免其缺点（虚假动态、临时滤波器设置、样本末端偏差）。我记录了一个被忽视的权衡：解决HP滤波器的缺点意味着H滤波器无法实现所有期望的目标。它通过引入相位偏移和可能改变方差来修改估计周期分量中捕获的不同频率。通常，这些修改随时间序列而变化。通过模拟和实际数据练习，我说明了每个滤波器的周期性质。

records.title_en: Immigration, legal status and fiscal impact
records.title_cn: 移民、法律身份与财政影响
records.abstract_en: We develop a general equilibrium model with search frictions in the labor market, wage bargaining and a welfare state, to study the impact of immigrants on the fiscal balance and welfare of natives in the host country. We distinguish immigrants by legal status and account for both their direct fiscal effects, through their tax contributions and transfer receipts, and their indirect fiscal and welfare effects, through their labor-market impact. We calibrate the model to the U.S. economy and find that legal immigrants reduce the tax burden on natives and increase natives' welfare, mainly because their tax contributions greatly exceed the transfers they receive. On the other hand, illegal immigrants' positive welfare impact stems mainly from their positive effect on job creation, which increases income to natives and in turn consumption. A legalization program leads to a fiscal gain, increases natives' welfare and is more beneficial to natives than a purely restrictive immigration policy that reduces the illegal immigrant population.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含劳动力市场搜索摩擦、工资谈判和福利国家的一般均衡模型，以研究移民对东道国财政平衡和本地居民福利的影响。我们按法律身份区分移民，并考虑其直接财政效应（通过税收贡献和转移支付领取）以及间接财政和福利效应（通过劳动力市场影响）。我们将模型校准至美国经济，发现合法移民降低了本地居民的税收负担并提高了其福利，主要因为他们的税收贡献远超所获得的转移支付。另一方面，非法移民的正面福利影响主要源于其对就业创造的积极效应，这增加了本地居民的收入进而促进消费。合法化计划带来财政收益，提高本地居民福利，并且比纯粹限制性移民政策（减少非法移民人口）对本地居民更为有利。

records.title_en: A unified approach to determinacy conditions with regime switching
records.title_cn: 具有制度转换的确定性条件的统一方法
records.abstract_en: The conditions that ensure the existence of a unique stable equilibrium — determinacy conditions — for rational expectations models with Markov switching depend on the stability concept, contrasting with standard linear rational expectations models. In this paper, we offer a unified framework for the two commonly used stability concepts: boundedness and mean-square stability. We derive determinacy conditions for both concepts based on simple metrics. Qualitatively, we show that mean-square stable solutions are always at least as many as bounded solutions. We then apply and discuss our results in two monetary models.
records.abstract_cn: 确保存在唯一稳定均衡的条件——即确定性条件——对于具有马尔可夫转换的理性预期模型，取决于稳定性概念，这与标准线性理性预期模型形成对比。在本文中，我们为两种常用的稳定性概念提供了一个统一框架：有界性和均方稳定性。我们基于简单度量推导了这两种概念的确定性条件。从定性上讲，我们表明均方稳定解的数量总是至少与有界解一样多。然后，我们在两个货币模型中应用并讨论了我们的结果。

records.title_en: Spillover effects of specialized high schools
records.title_cn: 专业高中的溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Specialized high schools are an increasingly popular way to prepare young adults for postsecondary experiences and expand school choice. While much literature examines charter school spillover effects and the effects of specialized schools on the students who attend them, little is known about the spillover effects of specialized high schools on traditional public schools (TPS). Using an event study design, we show that one type of specialized high school, North Carolina’s Cooperative Innovative High Schools, initially attracted students who were higher achieving and more likely to be white than TPS students, but these specialized schools became more representative of the district population over time. On average, the opening of specialized schools had a mix of null and positive spillover effects on TPS student achievement. While there is some evidence of negative spillovers from the first schools that opened, the effects become more positive over time.
records.abstract_cn: 专业高中是为年轻人准备高等教育经历和扩大学校选择的一种日益流行的方式。虽然大量文献考察了特许学校的溢出效应以及专业学校对就读学生的影响，但关于专业高中对传统公立学校（TPS）的溢出效应知之甚少。使用事件研究设计，我们表明一种类型的专业高中，即北卡罗来纳州的合作创新高中，最初吸引的学生比TPS学生成绩更高且更可能是白人，但这些专业学校随着时间的推移变得更加代表地区人口。平均而言，专业学校的开设对TPS学生成绩产生了零效应和正溢出效应的混合。虽然有一些证据表明最早开设的学校产生了负面溢出效应，但随着时间的推移，这些效应变得更加积极。

records.title_en: The safety net and job loss: How much insurance do public programs provide?
records.title_cn: 安全网与失业：公共项目提供了多少保险？
records.abstract_en: We comprehensively evaluate the role of the U.S. safety net in replacing displaced workers’ lost income and health insurance using the 1996–2013 Survey of Income and Program Participation. Cash and near-cash programs replace 32% of lost income on average over the two years following job loss and reduce the likelihood of experiencing poverty by 18 percentage points. 97% of transfer benefits paid in these two years come from Unemployment Insurance. Two years after job loss, the replacement rate is 28%, but this is largely driven by UI benefit extensions unique to the Great Recession. Public health insurance makes up for 17% of the loss in private insurance, but, even two years later, rates of uninsurance are higher than pre-job loss. Looking at heterogeneous effects, in general, the safety net is progressive, though we uncover important gaps in benefits for some disadvantaged groups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用1996-2013年收入和项目参与调查，全面评估了美国安全网在替代失业工人收入损失和医疗保险方面的作用。现金和近现金项目在失业后两年内平均替代了32%的收入损失，并将经历贫困的可能性降低了18个百分点。在这两年中支付的转移支付中，97%来自失业保险。失业两年后，替代率为28%，但这主要归因于大衰退特有的失业保险福利延长。公共医疗保险弥补了私人保险损失的17%，但即使在两年后，无保险率仍高于失业前。考察异质性效应时，总体而言，安全网具有累进性，尽管我们发现一些弱势群体在福利方面存在重要缺口。

records.title_en: Coordinated selection of collective action: Wealthy-interest bias and inequality
records.title_cn: 集体行动的协调选择：富人利益偏差与不平等
records.abstract_en: We extend a collective action problem to study policy and project selection by heterogeneous groups who prefer to work together on a joint initiative but may disagree on which initiative is best. Our framework, adapted from a model of multiple threshold public goods, presents groups with several mutually exclusive projects, any of which require sufficient support from the group to succeed. Individuals strictly prefer to contribute where and how much they believe others expect of them to ensure joint project success. Groups tend to coordinate on the public good preferred by the wealthiest member, demonstrating a wealthy-interest bias even without corruption, politics, and information asymmetries. At the same time, groups divide costs in highly progressive ways, with the wealthy voluntarily funding a disproportionate share, helping offset the inherent inequality from endowment and selection differences. We discuss applications for policy selection, charitable giving, and taxes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们扩展了一个集体行动问题，以研究异质性群体在政策与项目选择上的行为，这些群体倾向于在联合倡议上合作，但可能对哪个倡议最佳存在分歧。我们的框架改编自一个多阈值公共品模型，向群体呈现多个互斥项目，其中任何一个项目都需要获得群体内足够的支持才能成功。个体严格偏好于在他们认为他人期望他们贡献的地方和数量上进行贡献，以确保联合项目的成功。群体倾向于协调于最富有成员偏好的公共品，即使在不存在腐败、政治和信息不对称的情况下，也表现出富人利益偏差。同时，群体以高度累进的方式分摊成本，富人自愿承担不成比例的份额，这有助于抵消禀赋和选择差异所固有的不平等。我们讨论了在政策选择、慈善捐赠和税收方面的应用。

records.title_en: The McMansion effect: Positional externalities in U.S. suburbs
records.title_cn: 麦克豪宅效应：美国郊区的地位外部性
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how the construction of very large homes — or “McMansions” — in U.S. suburbs affects homeowners’ satisfaction and housing behavior. Combining three decades of survey data with geolocated information on three million suburban houses, I find that homeowners exposed to newly constructed, large houses report lower satisfaction with their own homes, while their neighborhood satisfaction remains unaffected. This effect is contingent on the visual salience of McMansions, as indicated by their proximity to roads. Homeowners exposed to new-built McMansions are more likely to expand their own homes and take on more debt.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了美国郊区建造超大型住宅——即“麦克豪宅”——如何影响房主的满意度和住房行为。结合三十年的调查数据以及三百万套郊区住宅的地理定位信息，我发现，接触到新建大型住宅的房主对自己住房的满意度较低，而他们对社区的满意度则不受影响。这一效应取决于麦克豪宅的视觉显著性，如其与道路的邻近程度所示。接触到新建麦克豪宅的房主更有可能扩建自己的住房并承担更多债务。

records.title_en: The effects of physician vertical integration on referral patterns, patient welfare, and market dynamics
records.title_cn: 医生纵向整合对转诊模式、患者福利和市场动态的影响
records.abstract_en: The growth of physician vertical integration raises concerns about distorted referral patterns, higher spending, and market foreclosure. Using 100% Medicare data, we combine reduced-form analysis with a discrete choice model to estimate the effects of physician vertical integration on patients’ provider choices and welfare for two common “downstream” surgical procedures. Physician–hospital integration results in an approximately 10% increase in referrals to higher-priced facilities instead of lower-priced providers. Our counterfactual analysis implies that if all primary care physicians become integrated, total Medicare spending will increase by $315 million.
records.abstract_cn: 医生纵向整合的增长引发了对转诊模式扭曲、支出增加和市场封锁的担忧。利用100%的医疗保险数据，我们将简化形式分析与离散选择模型相结合，评估医生纵向整合对患者为两种常见“下游”外科手术选择医疗服务提供者及其福利的影响。医生与医院的整合导致转向高价医疗机构的转诊增加约10%%，而非转向低价提供者。我们的反事实分析表明，如果所有初级保健医生都实现整合，医疗保险总支出将增加$315百万。

records.title_en: School segregation in the presence of student sorting and cream-skimming: Evidence from a school voucher reform
records.title_cn: 存在学生分流和择优录取情况下的学校隔离：来自学校代金券改革的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper uses a reform to Chile’s school choice system to study student socioeconomic segregation with a focus on student demand and school selectivity. The reform increases the subsidies that schools receive for low socioeconomic status students. I exploit this shock to schools’ incentives to test for selection at admission based on students’ socioeconomic characteristics. Schools respond to the new voucher by decreasing the level of cream-skimming. I incorporate these admission restrictions in a demand model to estimate parents’ preferences for school and peer characteristics. I show that ignoring admission restrictions leads to underestimating poor parents’ preferences for school quality. Counterfactual simulations show that preferences of high-SES parents for high-SES peers are one of the main drivers behind segregation as opposed to schools’ selective behavior. This likely explains the unexpected increase in enrollment for schools that opted out of the reform and the ineffectiveness of the reform in reducing socioeconomic segregation across schools.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用智利学校选择体系的改革来研究学生社会经济隔离，重点关注学生需求和学校选择性。改革提高了学校招收社会经济地位较低学生所获得的补贴。我利用这一冲击学校激励的机会，检验入学时基于学生社会经济特征的选择性。学校通过降低择优录取水平来回应新的代金券。我将这些入学限制纳入需求模型，以估计家长对学校和同伴特征的偏好。我表明，忽略入学限制会导致低估贫困家长对学校质量的偏好。反事实模拟显示，高社会经济地位家长对高社会经济地位同伴的偏好是隔离的主要驱动因素之一，而非学校的选择性行为。这很可能解释了选择退出改革的学校入学人数的意外增加，以及改革在减少学校间社会经济隔离方面的无效性。

records.title_en: Do bishops matter for politics? Evidence From Italy
records.title_cn: 主教对政治有影响吗？来自意大利的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies whether and how religious leaders affect politics. Focusing on Italian dioceses in the period from 1948 to 1992, we find that the identity of the bishop in office explains a significant amount of the variation in the vote share for the Christian Democracy party (DC). This result is robust to several exercises that use different samples and time windows. Zooming into the mechanism, we find that two characteristics of bishops matter: (i) his political culture, and (ii) his interaction with the population—the latter being measured using text-analysis techniques.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究宗教领袖是否以及如何影响政治。以1948年至1992年期间的意大利教区为研究对象，我们发现任职主教的身份解释了基督教民主党（DC）选票份额变异的很大一部分。这一结果在采用不同样本和时间窗口的多次检验中均保持稳健。深入机制分析，我们发现主教的两个特征至关重要：（i）其政治文化，以及（ii）其与民众的互动——后者通过文本分析技术进行衡量。

records.title_en: The political economy of coastal development
records.title_cn: 沿海发展的政治经济学
records.abstract_en: Coastal development has advantages, such as job creation, and drawbacks, such as the loss of environmental amenities, for both residents and non-residents. Local governments may prioritize their constituents’ interests, resulting in suboptimal coastal development. We investigate how political alignment among neighboring mayors facilitates intergovernmental cooperation in the development of coastal areas. We leverage causal effects by applying a close-elections Regression Discontinuity Design to the universe of buildings in Spain. Municipalities with party-aligned mayors develop 46% less land than politically isolated ones, and politically homogeneous coastal areas develop less than fragmented ones. The effect is more salient for land closest to shore or previously occupied by forests, in municipalities with a large share of protected land, and for relevant environmental markers, such as air and bathing water pollution. These results underscore the importance of cooperative political endeavors in managing development spillovers, with environmental considerations assuming a central role.
records.abstract_cn: 沿海发展既有优势，如创造就业，也有弊端，如环境资源的丧失，对居民和非居民均是如此。地方政府可能优先考虑其选民的利益，导致沿海发展欠佳。我们研究了相邻市长之间的政治一致性如何促进沿海地区开发中的政府间合作。我们通过将接近选举的断点回归设计应用于西班牙的所有建筑，来利用因果效应。拥有党派一致市长的城市比政治孤立的城市少开发46%的土地，而政治同质的沿海地区比碎片化的地区开发更少。这一效应在离海岸最近或先前被森林覆盖的土地上、在保护区土地占比较大的城市中，以及对于空气和沐浴水污染等相关环境指标更为显著。这些结果强调了合作政治努力在管理开发溢出效应中的重要性，其中环境考量扮演着核心角色。

records.title_en: Organizational capacity and profit shifting
records.title_cn: 组织能力与利润转移
records.abstract_en: Good organizational capacity drives productivity and potential taxable profits, but may also enable multinationals (MNEs) to more efficiently re-allocate profits across tax jurisdictions, lowering actual taxable profits. We show that MNE subsidiaries with better organizational capacity report significantly lower profits in high-tax countries. This pattern is not present in low-tax countries. Further, responsiveness to corporate tax rate changes in terms of profit reporting is driven by firms with good organizational capacity. We show our results are consistent with profit-shifting behavior and rule out key alternative channels.
records.abstract_cn: 良好的组织能力能提升生产力和潜在应税利润，但也可能使跨国企业（MNEs）更有效地在税收管辖区之间重新分配利润，从而降低实际应税利润。我们表明，组织能力较强的跨国企业子公司在高税收国家报告的利润显著较低。这一模式在低税收国家并不存在。此外，就利润报告而言，对企业所得税税率变化的响应性由组织能力良好的企业驱动。我们证明我们的结果与利润转移行为一致，并排除了关键替代渠道。

records.title_en: Public pensions and retirement: Evidence from the Railroad Retirement Act
records.title_cn: 公共养老金与退休：来自《铁路退休法》的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates how public pensions affect retirement timing by examining the Railroad Retirement Act of 1937, which replaced private railroad pensions with a national program comparable in many ways to Social Security. Leveraging linked decennial census records between 1910–1940, the first part of the analysis compares male labor force nonparticipation in 1940 relative to 1930, between workers previously in railroad versus other industries with broad pension coverage, and by age. Higher benefits led to earlier retirement, largely driven by exit at age 65. The second part of my analysis also exploits the switch from flat to progressive benefits in average wages to estimate the elasticity of nonparticipation with respect to benefits for men aged 65-69. My central estimate of 0.55 indicates a large retirement response. Application of these estimates to Social Security expansions in the 1950s suggests rising benefits was the key driver of earlier retirement among the already-insured male population during this era.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过考察1937年《铁路退休法》（该法案用一项在许多方面与社会保障相当的国家计划取代了私人铁路养老金）来估计公共养老金如何影响退休时机。利用1910-1940年间的关联十年一次人口普查记录，分析的第一部分比较了1940年相对于1930年，先前在铁路行业与其他养老金覆盖广泛行业的男性劳动力不参与率，并按年龄分组。更高的福利导致更早退休，主要由65岁时的退出驱动。我分析的第二部分还利用从平均工资的固定福利转向累进福利的变化，来估计65-69岁男性不参与率对福利的弹性。我的中心估计值为0.55，表明退休反应显著。将这些估计应用于1950年代社会保障扩张，表明福利增加是该时期已参保男性人口更早退休的关键驱动因素。

records.title_en: Optional (non-)filing and effective taxation
records.title_cn: 可选（不）申报与有效税收
records.abstract_en: Many countries have automatic wage tax withholding systems with tax non-filing options for some taxpayers. We show that this has sizable and potentially unintended implications for effective taxation because taxes are often over-withheld. Low-income taxpayers pay more taxes than they have to because they frequently do not file. Using German administrative tax data, we document that the average non-filer overpays €119 in one year, equivalent to a 1.2 percentage point increase in the average tax rate. Non-filing acts as a form of “reverse evasion”: It weakens the effective tax progressivity by increasing tax rates at the bottom of the income distribution.
records.abstract_cn: 许多国家实行自动工资预扣税制度，部分纳税人可选择不进行税务申报。我们表明，这会对有效税收产生显著且可能非预期的后果，因为税款往往被多预扣。低收入纳税人由于经常不申报而缴纳了超过应缴的税款。利用德国行政税收数据，我们记录了平均不申报者一年内多缴€119，相当于平均税率提高1.2个百分点。不申报行为构成一种“反向逃税”：它通过提高收入分布底端的税率，削弱了有效税收的累进性。

records.title_en: Heard the news? Environmental policy and clean investments
records.title_cn: 听到消息了吗？环境政策与清洁投资
records.abstract_en: We build the first news-based index of US environmental and climate policy and examine how it relates to clean investments. Extracting text from ten leading US newspapers over the last four decades, we use text-mining techniques to develop a granular news index of US environmental and climate policy (EnvP) over the 1981–2019 period. Furthermore, we develop a set of additional measures, namely an index of sentiment on environmental policy, as well as various topic-specific indexes. We validate our index by showing that it correctly captures trends and peaks in the evolution of US environmental and climate policy and that it has a meaningful association with clean investments, in line with environmental regulations supporting growing opportunities for clean markets. In firm-level estimations, we find that our index is associated with a greater probability of receiving venture capital (VC) funding for cleantech startups and reduced stock returns for high-emissions firms most exposed to environmental regulations. At the aggregate level, we find in VAR models that a shock in our news-based index of renewable energy policy is associated with an increase in the number of clean energy VC deals and in the assets under management of a benchmark clean energy exchange-traded fund.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了首个基于新闻的美国环境和气候政策指数，并考察其与清洁投资的关系。通过提取过去四十年间美国十家主要报纸的文本，我们运用文本挖掘技术，开发了一个涵盖1981-2019年期间的美国环境和气候政策（EnvP）的细粒度新闻指数。此外，我们还制定了一套附加指标，即环境政策情绪指数，以及各种特定主题指数。我们通过展示该指数正确捕捉了美国环境和气候政策演变中的趋势和峰值，并证明其与清洁投资存在有意义的关联，这与环境法规支持清洁市场增长机会相一致，从而验证了我们的指数。在企业层面的估计中，我们发现该指数与清洁技术初创企业获得风险投资（VC）资金的可能性增加以及受环境法规影响最大的高排放企业股票回报率下降相关。在总体层面，我们在VAR模型中发现，基于新闻的可再生能源政策指数的冲击与清洁能源风险投资交易数量的增加以及基准清洁能源交易所交易基金管理资产的增加相关。

records.title_en: Norm-based feedback on household waste: Large-scale field experiments in two Swedish municipalities
records.title_cn: 基于规范的垃圾反馈：瑞典两个市镇的大规模实地实验
records.abstract_en: We conduct two large-scale randomized controlled trials to produce the first evidence that Home Energy Report-type norm feedback letters can be used to reduce household waste. We explore several feedback variants, including a novel short-run dynamic norm that emphasizes ongoing changes in waste behavior. Waste reductions are on the order of 7%–12% for all treatments, substantially larger than usually found in the energy or water domains. Effects are mostly driven by increased recycling of packaging and remain largely intact a year after the intervention ended. Feedback is highly cost-effective compared to alternative non-price waste policies. However, net social benefits depend on household preferences for receiving feedback, which we elicit in a valuation survey, and whether existing waste fees internalize the marginal social cost of waste.
records.abstract_cn: 我们进行了两项大规模随机对照试验，首次提供证据表明家庭能源报告类型的规范反馈信可用于减少家庭垃圾。我们探索了几种反馈变体，包括一种新颖的短期动态规范，强调垃圾行为的持续变化。所有处理组的垃圾减少量约为7%–12%，远大于通常在能源或水领域发现的减少量。效果主要由包装回收增加驱动，并在干预结束一年后基本保持。与替代的非价格垃圾政策相比，反馈具有很高的成本效益。然而，净社会效益取决于家庭对接收反馈的偏好（我们在估值调查中引出）以及现有垃圾费是否内化了垃圾的边际社会成本。

records.title_en: Later-life mortality and the repeal of federal prohibition
records.title_cn: 晚年死亡率与联邦禁酒令的废除
records.abstract_en: Despite a recent and dramatic re-evaluation of the health consequences of alcohol consumption, very little is known about the effects of in utero exposure to alcohol on long-run outcomes such as later-life mortality. Here, we investigate how state by year variation in alcohol control arising from the repeal of federal prohibition affects mortality for cohorts born in the 1930s. We find that individuals born in wet states experienced higher later-life mortality than individuals born in dry states, translating into a 3.3% increase in mortality rates between 1990 and 2004 for affected cohorts.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管近期对饮酒健康后果的评估发生了戏剧性的重新审视，但关于子宫内酒精暴露对长期结果（如晚年死亡率）的影响知之甚少。在此，我们研究了因废除联邦禁酒令而产生的州际逐年酒精控制变化如何影响1930年出生队列的死亡率。我们发现，出生在湿州的个体晚年死亡率高于出生在干州的个体，这转化为受影响队列在1990年至2004年间死亡率增加3.3%。

records.title_en: Spillovers in fields of study: Siblings, cousins, and neighbors
records.title_cn: 专业选择中的溢出效应：兄弟姐妹、堂表亲与邻居
records.abstract_en: We use admission lotteries for higher education studies in the Netherlands to investigate whether someone’s field of study influences the study choices of their younger peers. We find that younger siblings and cousins are strongly affected. Also younger neighbors are affected but to a smaller extent. These findings indicate that a substantial part of the correlations in study choices between family members can be attributed to spillover effects and are not due to shared environments. Our findings concur with those of recent studies based on admission thresholds, which find sibling spillovers on college or college-major choices. This indicates that the results from previous studies can be extrapolated to students away from admission thresholds, and from siblings to cousins and neighbors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用荷兰高等教育录取抽签来研究某人的专业选择是否会影响其较年幼同伴的学习选择。我们发现，较年幼的兄弟姐妹和堂表亲受到强烈影响。较年幼的邻居也受到影响，但程度较小。这些发现表明，家庭成员之间学习选择的相关性有很大一部分可归因于溢出效应，而非共同环境所致。我们的发现与近期基于录取分数线的研究结果一致，这些研究发现兄弟姐妹在学院或学院专业选择上存在溢出效应。这表明，先前研究的结果可以推广到远离录取分数线的学生，以及从兄弟姐妹推广到堂表亲和邻居。

records.title_en: Estimating intergenerational health transmission in Taiwan with administrative health records
records.title_cn: 利用行政健康记录估计台湾的代际健康传递
records.abstract_en: We use population-wide administrative health records from Taiwan to estimate intergenerational persistence in health, providing the first estimates for a middle-income country. We measure latent health by applying principal components analysis to a set of indicators for 13 broad ICD categories and quintiles of visits to a general practitioner. We find that the rank–rank slope in health between adult children and their parents is 0.22 which is broadly in line with results from other countries. Maternal transmission is stronger than paternal transmission and sons have higher persistence than daughters. Persistence is also higher at the upper tail of the parent health distribution. Persistence is lower when complete data on outpatient care is unavailable. Health transmission is almost entirely unrelated to household income levels in Taiwan. We also find that there are small geographic differences in absolute health mobility across townships and that these are modestly correlated with area-level income and doctor availability.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用台湾全人口行政健康记录来估计健康的代际持续性，提供了首个中等收入国家的估计。我们通过对13个宽泛的ICD类别和全科医生就诊次数的五分位数指标进行主成分分析来衡量潜在健康。我们发现成年子女与其父母之间的健康秩-秩斜率为0.22，与其他国家的结果大致一致。母系传递强于父系传递，儿子的持续性高于女儿。在父母健康分布的上尾，持续性也更高。当门诊护理的完整数据不可用时，持续性较低。在台湾，健康传递与家庭收入水平几乎完全无关。我们还发现，各乡镇之间的绝对健康流动性存在较小的地理差异，并且这些差异与地区收入和医生可用性适度相关。

records.title_en: Rounded Up: Using round numbers to identify tax evasion
records.title_cn: 凑整：利用整数来识别逃税行为
records.abstract_en: Australian taxpayers display a clear preference for round numbers for end-of-year tax refunds, bunching at positive and salient thresholds such as the tens, hundreds and thousands. Bunching appears to be driven by tax evasion. Data from audited returns shows that bunching is present in returns before audit, but does not persist post-audit. Tax preparers play an important role, being twice as likely to deliver positive round-number refunds as individuals who file their own tax returns. Preparers with greater propensity to bunch deliver larger refunds by lifting deductions and lowering reported income for return items where audits are costly. This highlights how bunching behaviors can help identify tax evasion, including tax preparers who facilitate it and the tax return items which are manipulated.
records.abstract_cn: 澳大利亚纳税人在年终退税时明显偏好整数，集中在正数且显著的阈值上，如十位、百位和千位。这种聚集现象似乎是由逃税驱动的。来自审计后申报表的数据显示，聚集现象在审计前的申报表中存在，但在审计后不再持续。税务代理人在其中扮演重要角色，他们提供正数整数退税的可能性是自行申报纳税人的两倍。那些更倾向于凑整的代理人通过提高扣除额和降低报告收入来提供更大的退税，尤其是在审计成本较高的申报项目上。这凸显了聚集行为如何有助于识别逃税行为，包括协助逃税的税务代理人以及被操纵的申报项目。

records.title_en: Sophistication about self-control
records.title_cn: 关于自我控制的复杂性
records.abstract_en: We use information on people’s ideal, predicted, and realized body weight to classify them as time-consistent versus naïve, and partially or fully sophisticated regarding their self-control limitations. Operationalizing this approach in population-representative data reveals that self-control problems are pervasive and that most people are at least partly aware of their limited self-control. Compared to naïfs, sophisticates have higher IQs, better educated parents, and are more likely to use potential commitment devices. Despite their self-control problems, sophisticated individuals make similar choices as time-consistent individuals when those choices involve immediate costs and later benefits. An increased awareness of one’s own self-control limitations may thus help in reducing their adverse consequences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用人们理想、预测和实际体重的信息，将他们分类为时间一致型与天真型，以及部分或完全了解自身自我控制限制的复杂型。在具有人口代表性的数据中实施这一方法揭示，自我控制问题普遍存在，且大多数人至少部分意识到自己的自我控制有限。与天真型相比，复杂型个体具有更高的智商、受过更好教育的父母，并且更可能使用潜在的承诺机制。尽管存在自我控制问题，复杂型个体在涉及即时成本和后期收益的选择中，会做出与时间一致型个体相似的选择。因此，增强对自身自我控制限制的认识可能有助于减少其不利后果。

records.title_en: Brains versus brawn: Ordinal rank effects in job training
records.title_cn: 智力与体力：职业培训中的序数排名效应
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes ordinal rank across cognitive and physical ability within an initial job training program. Using a rich administrative dataset and conditional random assignment of trainees to peer groups, we test whether rank effects vary across contemporaneous training and long-term career outcomes. We find cognitive ordinal rank, measured by an individual’s score on the Armed Forces Qualification Test (AFQT), has a meaningful impact on completing initial training into the U.S. Air Force (USAF). This ranking also affects occupational specialization for trainees that arrive without a preassigned occupation. We also show physical ordinal rank, measured by an individual’s initial fitness score, affects job training performance. Both sets of ranking effects impact behavioral misconduct outcomes and vary by gender. Finally, the interaction between cognitive and physical ordinal ranking has multiplicative effects on a limited set of outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了初始职业培训项目中认知和体能能力的序数排名。利用丰富的行政数据集和受训者随机分配到同伴组的条件随机分配，我们检验了排名效应是否在同期培训和长期职业结果中有所不同。我们发现，以个人在武装部队资格测验（AFQT）中的分数衡量的认知序数排名，对完成美国空军（USAF）初始培训有显著影响。这种排名也影响没有预先分配职业的受训者的职业专业化。我们还表明，以个人初始体能分数衡量的体能序数排名，影响职业培训表现。两组排名效应都影响行为不当结果，并因性别而异。最后，认知和体能序数排名之间的交互作用对有限的结果集具有乘数效应。

records.title_en: Softening the blow: Job retention schemes in the pandemic
records.title_cn: 缓解冲击：疫情中的职位保留计划
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the welfare effects of the temporary job retention schemes (JRS) implemented in response to the COVID-19 pandemic in a DSGE model with incomplete insurance and heterogeneous agents calibrated to the euro area. JRS have large favorable welfare effects and benefit all households when they are well targeted at potentially viable jobs at risk of being lost. These gains are particularly strong for liquid-asset-poor households, especially for those that are also unemployed or on furlough. The job protection component of JRS explains almost all the welfare gains they deliver, while their high level of generosity plays a minor role and has ambiguous net aggregate welfare effects. We also discuss the conditions that make JRS valuable and show that they can cause a decrease in welfare when they subsidize too many safe jobs; when they are targeted at non-viable jobs that will inevitably be lost once schemes end; and when implemented in economies where labor market frictions are low.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了为应对COVID-19大流行而实施的临时职位保留计划（JRS）在具有不完全保险和异质性主体的DSGE模型中的福利效应，该模型校准至欧元区。当JRS精准针对可能流失但具有潜在可行性的工作岗位时，它们具有显著的正面福利效应，并使所有家庭受益。这些收益对流动性资产匮乏的家庭尤为显著，特别是对那些同时失业或被强制休假（furlough）的家庭。JRS的职位保护成分几乎解释了其带来的全部福利收益，而其高水平的慷慨程度作用较小，且对总体福利具有模糊的净效应。我们还讨论了使JRS有价值的条件，并表明当JRS补贴过多安全岗位、针对那些在计划结束后必然流失的不可持续岗位，以及在劳动力市场摩擦较低的经济体中实施时，它们可能导致福利下降。

records.title_en: The division of parental leave: Empirical evidence and policy design
records.title_cn: 育儿假的分配：实证证据与政策设计
records.abstract_en: We study several key aspects of the design of parental leave systems. First, we estimate parents’ willingness to pay for parental leave using Danish administrative data on the division of leave from almost 190,000 births combined with sharp variation in economic incentives created by the parental leave benefit system. We find evidence of both strong behavioral responses with significant bunching at kink points and a willingness to pay for a gender-traditional allocation of leave, where fathers take little or no leave. Second, we provide a menu of counterfactual policy simulations showing substantial interaction effects between earmarked leave, replacement rates and the duration of leave benefits. Relevant for the implementation of a recent EU directive, a higher replacement rate significantly increases the behavioral response of fathers to earmarked leave. Finally, we discuss the welfare effects of different policies aimed at increasing the parental leave of fathers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了育儿假制度设计的几个关键方面。首先，我们利用丹麦行政数据，基于近190,000例出生中育儿假的分配情况，结合育儿假福利制度造成的经济激励的急剧变化，估计了父母对育儿假的支付意愿。我们发现了显著的行为反应证据，包括在拐点处的显著聚集现象，以及父母对性别传统分配育儿假（即父亲很少或完全不休假）的支付意愿。其次，我们提供了一系列反事实政策模拟，显示指定假期、替代率和假期福利持续时间之间存在显著的交互效应。与近期欧盟指令的实施相关，更高的替代率显著增加了父亲对指定假期的行为反应。最后，我们讨论了旨在增加父亲育儿假的不同政策的福利效应。

records.title_en: The intergenerational (Im)mobility of immigrants
records.title_cn: 移民的代际（不）流动性
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the influence of pre-migration social background on the long-term economic assimilation of immigrants. I use unique French survey data to trace family histories over three generations, before and after migration. While many immigrants experience an occupational downgrading at migration, their children benefit from various characteristics associated with the high socio-economic status their family had in the origin country. As a result, characteristics of immigrant grandparents are highly predictive of their grandchildren’s educational attainment.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了迁移前社会背景对移民长期经济同化的影响。我使用了独特的法国调查数据，追踪了三代人（迁移前后）的家庭历史。尽管许多移民在迁移时经历了职业降级，但他们的子女受益于与其家庭在原籍国所拥有的高社会经济地位相关的各种特征。因此，移民祖父母的特征对其孙辈的教育成就具有高度预测性。

records.title_en: How do parole boards respond to large, societal shocks? Evidence from the 9/11 terrorist attacks
records.title_cn: 假释委员会如何应对大规模社会冲击？来自9/11恐怖袭击的证据
records.abstract_en: We provide the first evidence of the impact of 9/11 on outcomes for Muslims in the US criminal justice system. We focus on parole outcomes of Black Muslim men in the state of Georgia, and find large post-9/11 declines in the likelihood of being granted parole and a subsequent 23% relative increase in prison time for Muslim inmates. These impacts persisted for several years after 9/11 and were larger for inmates with higher levels of recidivism risk. We argue that these effects reflect unwarranted disparities driven by the decision-making of parole board members post-9/11.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了9/11事件对美国刑事司法系统中穆斯林结果影响的首个证据。我们聚焦于佐治亚州黑人穆斯林男性的假释结果，发现9/11事件后获得假释的可能性大幅下降，随后穆斯林囚犯的监禁时间相对增加了23%。这些影响在9/11事件后持续了数年，并且对于再犯风险较高的囚犯影响更大。我们认为这些效应反映了9/11事件后假释委员会成员决策所导致的不合理差异。

records.title_en: Effects of the expanded Child Tax Credit on employment outcomes
records.title_cn: 扩大的儿童税收抵免对就业结果的影响
records.abstract_en: The temporary 2021 expansion of the Child Tax Credit (CTC) was intended to reduce child poverty during the COVID-19 pandemic. The expansion’s elimination of an existing phase-in with earnings, however, potentially disincentivized labor supply, raising concerns that it would reduce parent employment. We empirically test for employment effects using difference-in-differences analyses with Current Population Survey data. Across many specifications and multiple sub-groups, we find very small, inconsistently signed, statistically insignificant impacts of the 2021 CTC on parental labor force participation and employment.
records.abstract_cn: 临时性的2021年儿童税收抵免（CTC）扩大旨在减少COVID-19大流行期间的儿童贫困。然而，该扩大取消了现有的收入逐步引入机制，可能抑制劳动力供给，引发其可能减少父母就业的担忧。我们使用当前人口调查数据，通过双重差分分析对就业影响进行实证检验。在许多规格和多个子群体中，我们发现2021年CTC对父母劳动力参与和就业的影响非常小、符号不一致且统计上不显著。

records.title_en: No country for young people? The rise of anti-immigration politics in ageing societies
records.title_cn: 没有年轻人的国家？老龄化社会中的反移民政治兴起
records.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of population ageing on immigration policies using a citizen-candidate model of elections. In each period, young people work and pay taxes while old people receive social security payments. Immigrants are all young, meaning they contribute significantly to financing the cost of public services and social security. Among natives, the elderly and the poor benefit the most from public spending. However, since these two types of voters do not internalise the positive fiscal effects of immigration, they have a common interest in supporting candidates who seek to curb immigration and increase the tax burden on high-income individuals. Population ageing increases the size and, in turn, the political power of such sociodemographic groups, resulting in more restrictive immigration policies, a larger public sector, higher tax rates, and lower societal well-being. Calibrating the model to UK data suggests that the magnitude of these effects is large. The implications of this model are shown to be consistent with the patterns observed in UK attitudinal data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用公民候选人选举模型研究人口老龄化对移民政策的影响。在每个时期，年轻人工作并纳税，而老年人领取社会保障金。移民均为年轻人，这意味着他们对公共服务和社会保障的成本融资有显著贡献。在本地人中，老年人和穷人从公共支出中获益最多。然而，由于这两类选民没有内化移民的积极财政效应，他们共同倾向于支持那些试图限制移民并增加高收入人群税收负担的候选人。人口老龄化增加了此类社会人口群体的规模，进而增强了其政治力量，导致移民政策更加严格、公共部门规模扩大、税率提高以及社会福利水平下降。将模型校准至英国数据表明，这些效应的规模是巨大的。该模型的推论与英国态度数据中观察到的模式一致。

records.title_en: Technology Adoption and Productivity Growth: Evidence from Industrialization in France
records.title_cn: 技术采用与生产率增长：来自法国工业化的证据
records.abstract_en: New technologies tend to be adopted slowly and—even after being adopted—take time to be reflected in higher aggregate productivity. One prominent explanation is that major technological breakthroughs create the need to reorganize production. We study a unique setting that allows us to examine this mechanism: the adoption of mechanized cotton spinning during the first Industrial Revolution in France. Using a novel hand-collected, plant-level dataset from French archival sources, we show that a process of “trial and error” in reorganizing production led to initially low and widely dispersed productivity across firms operating the new technology. In the subsequent decades, we observe high productivity growth as knowledge diffused through the economy and new entrants adopted improved methods of organizing production.
records.abstract_cn: 新技术往往被缓慢采用，即使被采用后，也需要时间才能在总体生产率的提高中体现出来。一个突出的解释是，重大技术突破需要重组生产。我们研究了一个独特的环境，使我们能够检验这一机制：法国第一次工业革命期间机械化棉纺的采用。利用从法国档案来源手工收集的新颖工厂层面数据集，我们表明，重组生产过程中的“试错”过程导致运营新技术的企业最初生产率低下且分散。在随后的几十年里，我们观察到高生产率增长，因为知识通过经济扩散，新进入者采用了改进的生产组织方法。

records.title_en: Big G
records.title_cn: 大G
records.abstract_en: “Big G” typically refers to aggregate government spending on a homogeneous good. We confront this notion with five facts for the universe of federal purchases. First, they are volatile and account for the largest part of the short-run variation in total spending. Second, the origin of their variation is granular. Third, purchases are subject to procurement and bidding. Fourth, they are concentrated in long-term contracts. Fifth, their composition is biased toward sectors in which private sector prices are sticky. We develop a two-sector New Keynesian model consistent with these facts and find where the government spends is key for aggregate effects.
records.abstract_cn: “大G”通常指在一种同质商品上的总政府支出。我们用关于联邦采购总体的五个事实来面对这一概念。第一，它们波动性大，并且占总支出的短期变动的大部分。第二，它们变动的来源是颗粒状的。第三，采购受制于采购和投标。第四，它们集中于长期合同。第五，它们的构成偏向于私营部门价格具有粘性的部门。我们开发了一个与这些事实一致的两部门新凯恩斯模型，并发现政府支出的去向对总体效应至关重要。

records.title_en: Learning about the Long Run
records.title_cn: 学习长期趋势
records.abstract_en: Forecasts of professional forecasters are anomalous: they are biased, and forecast errors are autocorrelated and predictable by forecast revisions. We propose that these anomalies arise because professional forecasters do not know the model that generates the data. We show that Bayesian agents learning about hard-to-learn features of the world can generate all the prominent aggregate anomalies emphasized in the literature. We show this for professional forecasts of nominal interest rates and Congressional Budget Office forecasts of gross domestic product growth. Our learning model for interest rates can explain observed deviations from the expectations hypothesis of the term structure without relying on time variation in risk premia.
records.abstract_cn: 专业预测者的预测存在异常：它们有偏，预测误差自相关且可由预测修正预测。我们提出这些异常的产生是因为专业预测者不知道生成数据的模型。我们表明，贝叶斯主体学习世界中难以学习的特征可以产生文献中强调的所有显著的总体异常。我们针对名义利率的专业预测和国会预算办公室对国内生产总值增长的预测展示了这一点。我们的利率学习模型可以解释观察到的期限结构预期假设的偏离，而无需依赖风险溢价的时间变化。

records.title_en: Strategic Inattention, Inflation Dynamics, and the Nonneutrality of Money
records.title_cn: 策略性忽视、通货膨胀动态与货币非中性
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how competition affects firms’ expectations in a new dynamic general equilibrium model with rational inattention and oligopolistic competition where firms acquire information about their competitors’ beliefs. In the model, firms with fewer competitors are less attentive to aggregate variables—a novel prediction supported by survey evidence. A calibrated version of the model matches the relationship between firms’ numbers of competitors and their uncertainty about aggregate inflation as a nontargeted moment. A quantitative exercise reveals that firms’ strategic inattention to aggregates significantly amplifies monetary nonneutrality and shifts output response disproportionately toward less competitive oligopolies by distorting relative prices.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个具有理性忽视和寡头竞争的新动态一般均衡模型中研究竞争如何影响企业的预期，其中企业获取关于其竞争对手信念的信息。在该模型中，竞争对手较少的企业对总体变量的关注度较低——这一新颖的预测得到了调查证据的支持。模型的校准版本匹配了企业竞争对手数量与其对总体通货膨胀不确定性之间的关系，作为非目标矩。一项定量分析表明，企业对总体的策略性忽视显著放大了货币非中性，并通过扭曲相对价格，使产出反应不成比例地转向竞争较弱的寡头垄断企业。

records.title_en: Reputation Effects under Short Memories
records.title_cn: 短记忆下的声誉效应
records.abstract_en: I analyze a reputation game between a patient player and a sequence of short-run players. Each short-run player observes the number of times that the patient player took each of his actions in the past K periods. When players have monotone supermodular payoffs, the patient player can approximately secure his commitment payoff in all equilibria regardless of K. I also show that the short-run players can approximately attain their highest feasible payoff in all equilibria if and only if K is lower than some cutoff. This is because a larger K weakens the short-run players’ incentives to punish the patient player.
records.abstract_cn: 我分析了一个有耐心的参与人与一系列短视参与人之间的声誉博弈。每个短视参与人观察过去K期内有耐心的参与人采取每种行动的次数。当参与人具有单调超模支付时，无论K为何值，有耐心的参与人在所有均衡中都能近似获得其承诺支付。我还表明，当且仅当K低于某个临界值时，短视参与人在所有均衡中才能近似达到其最高可行支付。这是因为较大的K削弱了短视参与人惩罚有耐心参与人的激励。

records.title_en: Prices and Policies in Opioid Markets
records.title_cn: 阿片类药物市场的价格与政策
records.abstract_en: Opioid mortality increases have been linked to both lax and restrictive opioid prescription regulations. Modeling choice between prescription and illicitly manufactured opioid sources helps reconcile the apparently contradictory empirical findings. It also identifies groups responding opposite of the average and applies previous studies to new supply conditions. Organized around the two supply channels, a policy database is assembled that reveals distinct pricing phases during 1999–2021. Consistent with the model, during the later phases the relationship between the opioid fatality rate (measured from death certificates) and its composition changes sign, minors’ fatality rates trend opposite of adults’, and the black-white gap changes sign.
records.abstract_cn: 阿片类药物死亡率上升与处方阿片类药物监管的宽松和严格均有关联。对处方来源和非法制造来源之间选择进行建模，有助于调和看似矛盾的实证发现。该模型还识别出与平均水平反应相反的群体，并将先前研究应用于新的供应条件。围绕两个供应渠道组织，构建了一个政策数据库，揭示了1999-2021年期间不同的定价阶段。与模型一致，在后期阶段，阿片类药物致死率（根据死亡证明测量）与其构成之间的关系符号发生改变，未成年人的致死率趋势与成年人相反，黑人与白人之间的差距符号也发生改变。

records.title_en: Intergenerational Insurance
records.title_cn: 代际保险
records.abstract_en: How should successive generations insure each other when the young can default on previously promised transfers to the old? This paper studies intergenerational insurance that maximizes the expected discounted utility of all generations subject to participation constraints for each generation. If complete insurance is unattainable, the optimal intergenerational insurance is history dependent even when the environment is stationary.
