records.abstract_en: A signal is privacy‐preserving with respect to a collection of privacy sets if the posterior probability assigned to every privacy set remains unchanged conditional on any signal realization. We characterize the privacy‐preserving signals for arbitrary state space and arbitrary privacy sets. A signal is privacy‐preserving if and only if it is a garbling of a reordered quantile signal. Furthermore, distributions of posterior means induced by privacy‐preserving signals are exactly mean‐preserving contractions of that induced by the quantile signal. We discuss the economic implications of our characterization for statistical discrimination, the revelation of sensitive information in auctions and price discrimination.
records.abstract_cn: 如果对于任意信号实现，每个隐私集的后验概率保持不变，则该信号相对于一组隐私集是隐私保护的。我们刻画了任意状态空间和任意隐私集下的隐私保护信号。一个信号是隐私保护的当且仅当它是重排序分位数信号的扰动。此外，由隐私保护信号诱导的后验均值分布恰好是分位数信号诱导的后验均值分布的均值保持收缩。我们讨论了我们的刻画对统计歧视、拍卖中敏感信息揭示和价格歧视的经济学含义。

records.title_en: Stationary Social Learning in a Changing Environment
records.title_cn: 变化环境中的平稳社会学习
records.abstract_en: We consider social learning in a changing world. With changing states, societies can be responsive only if agents regularly act upon fresh information, which significantly limits the value of observational learning. When the state is close to persistent, a consensus whereby most agents choose the same action typically emerges. However, the consensus action is not perfectly correlated with the state, because societies exhibit inertia following state changes. When signals are precise enough, learning is incomplete, even if agents draw large samples of past actions, as actions then become too correlated within samples, thereby reducing informativeness and welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑变化世界中的社会学习。随着状态的变化，只有当个体定期依据新信息行动时，社会才能做出响应，这显著限制了观察学习的价值。当状态接近持久时，通常会出现一种共识，即大多数个体选择相同的行动。然而，共识行动与状态并非完全相关，因为社会在状态变化后表现出惯性。当信号足够精确时，即使个体抽取大量过去行动样本，学习也是不完整的，因为样本内的行动变得过于相关，从而降低了信息量和福利。

records.title_en: Ambiguous Contracts
records.title_cn: 模糊契约
records.abstract_en: We explore the deliberate infusion of ambiguity into the design of contracts. We show that when the agent is ambiguity‐averse and hence chooses an action that maximizes their minimum utility, the principal can strictly gain from using an ambiguous contract, and this gain can be arbitrarily high. We characterize the structure of optimal ambiguous contracts, showing that ambiguity drives optimal contracts toward simplicity. We also provide a characterization of ambiguity‐proof classes of contracts, where the principal cannot gain by infusing ambiguity. Finally, we show that when the agent can engage in mixed actions, the advantages of ambiguous contracts disappear.
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了在契约设计中刻意引入模糊性的问题。我们证明，当代理人具有模糊厌恶特征，因而选择能够最大化其最低效用的行动时，委托人可以通过使用模糊契约获得严格收益，且这种收益可以任意高。我们刻画了最优模糊契约的结构，表明模糊性促使最优契约趋于简单化。我们还提供了模糊免疫契约类别的特征描述，在这些类别中，委托人无法通过引入模糊性获得收益。最后，我们证明当代理人可以采取混合行动时，模糊契约的优势会消失。

records.title_en: Social Media and Collective Action in China
records.title_cn: 社交媒体与中国集体行动
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how social media affects the dynamics of protests and strikes in China during 2009–2017. Based on 13.2 billion microblog posts, we use tweets and retweets to measure social media communication across cities and exploit its rapid expansion for identification. We find that, despite strict government censorship, Chinese social media has a sizeable effect on the geographical spread of protests and strikes. Furthermore, social media communication considerably expands the scope of protests by spreading events across different causes (e.g., from anticorruption protests to environmental protests) and dramatically increases the probability of far‐reaching protest waves with simultaneous events occurring in many cities. These effects arise even though Chinese social media barely circulates content that explicitly helps organize protests.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了社交媒体如何影响2009-2017年间中国抗议和罢工的动态。基于13.2亿条微博帖子，我们利用推文和转发来衡量城市间的社交媒体交流，并利用其快速扩张进行识别。我们发现，尽管政府严格审查，中国社交媒体对抗议和罢工的地理传播具有显著影响。此外，社交媒体交流通过将事件传播到不同原因（例如，从反腐败抗议到环境抗议）大大扩展了抗议的范围，并显著增加了在许多城市同时发生事件的深远抗议浪潮的可能性。即使中国社交媒体几乎不传播明确帮助组织抗议的内容，这些效应也会出现。

records.title_en: Adaptive, Rate‐Optimal Hypothesis Testing in Nonparametric IV Models
records.title_cn: 非参数工具变量模型中的自适应、速率最优假设检验
records.abstract_en: We propose a new adaptive hypothesis test for inequality (e.g., monotonicity, convexity) and equality (e.g., parametric, semiparametric) restrictions on a structural function in a nonparametric instrumental variables (NPIV) model. Our test statistic is based on a modified leave‐one‐out sample analog of a quadratic distance between the restricted and unrestricted sieve two‐stage least squares estimators. We provide computationally simple, data‐driven choices of sieve tuning parameters and Bonferroni adjusted chi‐squared critical values. Our test adapts to the unknown smoothness of alternative functions in the presence of unknown degree of endogeneity and unknown strength of the instruments. It attains the adaptive minimax rate of testing in L2. That is, the sum of the supremum of type I error over the composite null and the supremum of type II error over nonparametric alternative models cannot be minimized by any other tests for NPIV models of unknown regularities. Confidence sets in L2 are obtained by inverting the adaptive test. Simulations confirm that, across different strength of instruments and sample sizes, our adaptive test controls size and its finite‐sample power greatly exceeds existing non‐adaptive tests for monotonicity and parametric restrictions in NPIV models. Empirical applications to test for shape restrictions of differentiated products demand and of Engel curves are presented.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新的自适应假设检验，用于非参数工具变量（NPIV）模型中结构函数的不等式（如单调性、凸性）和等式（如参数、半参数）约束。我们的检验统计量基于受限与非受限筛子两阶段最小二乘估计量之间二次距离的修正留一法样本模拟。我们提供了计算简单、数据驱动的筛子调参参数选择和邦费罗尼调整的卡方临界值。我们的检验适应于未知内生性程度和未知工具强度下备择函数的未知光滑性。它在L2中达到了自适应的极小极大检验速率。也就是说，在复合原假设下第一类错误的上确界与非参数备择模型下第二类错误的上确界之和，不能被任何其他针对未知正则性的NPIV模型的检验所最小化。通过反转自适应检验获得L2中的置信集。模拟证实，在不同的工具强度和样本量下，我们的自适应检验控制了规模，其有限样本功效大大超过了现有的针对NPIV模型中单调性和参数约束的非自适应检验。我们还提供了对差异化产品需求和恩格尔曲线形状约束检验的实证应用。

records.title_en: Caution and Reference Effects
records.title_cn: 谨慎与参照效应
records.abstract_en: We introduce Cautious Utility, a new model based on the idea that individuals are unsure of trade‐offs between goods and apply caution. The model yields an endowment effect, even when gains and losses are treated symmetrically. Moreover, it implies either loss aversion or loss neutrality for risk, but in a way unrelated to the endowment effect, and it captures the certainty effect, providing a novel unified explanation of all three phenomena. Cautious Utility can help organize empirical evidence, including some that directly contradicts leading alternatives.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了谨慎效用，这是一个基于个体对商品间权衡不确定并采取谨慎态度这一思想的新模型。该模型产生了禀赋效应，即使收益和损失被对称对待时也是如此。此外，它意味着风险方面的损失厌恶或损失中性，但这种方式与禀赋效应无关，并且它捕捉了确定性效应，为所有这三种现象提供了一种新颖的统一解释。谨慎效用有助于组织经验证据，包括一些直接与主要替代理论相矛盾的证据。

records.title_en: Polity Size and Local Government Performance: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 政体规模与地方政府绩效：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: Developing countries have increasingly decentralized power to local governments. This paper studies the implications of a central element of decentralization (polity size) using population-based discontinuities that determine local government boundaries for over 100,000 Indian villages. Over the short and long run, individuals allocated into local governments with smaller populations have better access to public goods. We provide suggestive evidence that these results are related to heightened civic engagement and stronger political incentives, but not to other mechanisms such as elite capture.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家越来越多地将权力下放给地方政府。本文利用基于人口的不连续性来研究分权的一个核心要素（政体规模）的影响，这些不连续性决定了超过100,000个印度村庄的地方政府边界。在短期和长期内，被分配到人口较少的地方政府的个人能更好地获得公共物品。我们提供的初步证据表明，这些结果与公民参与度提高和政治激励增强有关，但与其他机制如精英俘获无关。

records.title_en: Institution Building without Commitment
records.title_cn: 无承诺的制度建设
records.abstract_en: We propose a theory of gradualism in the implementation of good policies, suitable for environments featuring time consistency. We downplay the role of the initial period by allowing agents both to wait for future agents to start equilibrium play and to restart the equilibrium by ignoring past history. The allocation gradually transits toward one that weighs both short- and long-term concerns, stopping short of the Ramsey outcome but greatly improving upon Markovian equilibria. We use the theory to account for the slow emergence of both climate policies and the reduction of global tariff rates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个在良好政策实施中渐进主义的理论，适用于具有时间一致性的环境。我们通过允许代理人既等待未来代理人开始均衡博弈，又通过忽略过去历史来重新启动均衡，从而淡化了初始时期的作用。配置逐渐过渡到既考虑短期又考虑长期关切的均衡，虽未达到拉姆齐结果，但大大改善了马尔可夫均衡。我们运用该理论来解释气候政策和全球关税税率降低的缓慢出现。

records.title_en: Financial Technology Adoption: Network Externalities of Cashless Payments in Mexico
records.title_cn: 金融科技采纳：墨西哥无现金支付的网络外部性
records.abstract_en: Do coordination failures constrain financial technology adoption? Exploiting the Mexican government's rollout of 1 million debit cards to poor households from 2009 to 2012, I examine responses on both sides of the market and find important spillovers and distributional impacts. On the supply side, small retail firms adopted point-of-sale terminals to accept card payments. On the demand side, this led to a 21 percent increase in other consumers' card adoption. The supply-side technology adoption response had positive effects on both richer consumers and small retail firms: richer consumers shifted 13 percent of their supermarket consumption to small retailers, whose sales and profits increased.
records.abstract_cn: 协调失败是否会限制金融科技的采纳？利用墨西哥政府在1年至2009年间向贫困家庭发放的2012万张借记卡，我考察了市场双方的反应，并发现了重要的溢出效应和分配影响。在供给方面，小型零售企业采纳了销售点终端来接受卡支付。在需求方面，这导致其他消费者的卡采纳率增加了21%。供给方的技术采纳反应对较富裕消费者和小型零售企业都产生了积极影响：较富裕消费者将其超市消费的13%转移到了小型零售商，后者的销售额和利润均有所增加。

records.title_en: Sticky Spending, Sequestration, and Government Debt
records.title_cn: 粘性支出、自动减支与政府债务
records.abstract_en: Once established, government spending programs tend to continue. A commonly held view is that spending inertia leads to unsustainable debt, ultimately requiring fiscal adjustments such as "sequestration." We show that by insuring against political turnover, inertia may reduce politicians' incentives to accumulate debt. However, large preexisting commitments and the prospect of future stabilization can lead to overspending to dilute past administrations' commitments. Finally, we show that political polarization amplifies incentives to prioritize inertial programs, potentially explaining the increased share of mandatory spending in the US budget.
records.abstract_cn: 一旦建立，政府支出项目往往会持续下去。一种普遍的观点是，支出惯性会导致不可持续的债务，最终需要诸如“自动减支”之类的财政调整。我们表明，通过对政治更替提供保险，惯性可能会减少政治家积累债务的动机。然而，大量的既有承诺和未来稳定的前景可能导致过度支出，以稀释前任政府的承诺。最后，我们表明，政治极化放大了优先考虑惯性项目的激励，这可能解释了美国预算中强制性支出份额的增加。

records.title_en: Generalized Social Marginal Welfare Weights Imply Inconsistent Comparisons of Tax Policies
records.title_cn: 广义社会边际福利权重意味着税收政策的比较不一致
records.abstract_en: This paper concerns Saez and Stantcheva's (2016) generalized social marginal welfare weights, which aggregate losses and gains due to tax policies while incorporating nonutilitarian ethical considerations. The approach evaluates local tax changes without a global social objective. I show that local tax policy comparisons implicitly entail global comparisons. Moreover, whenever welfare weights do not have a utilitarian structure, these implied global comparisons are inconsistent. I argue that broader ethical values cannot in general be represented simply by modifying the weights placed on benefits to different people, and a more thoroughgoing modification of the utilitarian approach is required.
records.abstract_cn: 本文关注Saez和Stantcheva（2016）提出的广义社会边际福利权重，该权重在纳入非功利主义伦理考量的同时，汇总税收政策带来的损失与收益。该方法在不设定全局社会目标的情况下评估局部税收变化。我证明，局部税收政策比较隐含地涉及全局比较。此外，当福利权重不具有功利主义结构时，这些隐含的全局比较是不一致的。我认为，更广泛的伦理价值观通常不能简单地通过修改赋予不同人利益的权重来体现，而需要对功利主义方法进行更彻底的修改。

records.title_en: The Dynamic Consequences of State Building: Evidence from the French Revolution
records.title_cn: 国家建设的动态后果：来自法国大革命的证据
records.abstract_en: How do radical reforms shape economic development over time? In 1790, the French Constituent Assembly overhauled the kingdom's organization to establish new local capitals. In some departments, the choice of local capitals over rival candidate cities was plausibly exogenous. We study how changes in administrative presence affect state capacity and development in the ensuing decades. In the short run, administrative proximity increases taxation and investments in law enforcement. In the long run, capitals obtain more public goods and grow faster. Our results shed light on the dynamic impacts of state building following one of history's most ambitious administrative reforms.
records.abstract_cn: 激进改革如何长期塑造经济发展？在1790年，法国制宪议会彻底改革了王国的组织，以建立新的地方首府。在某些省份，地方首府的选择相对于竞争候选城市而言，似乎是外生的。我们研究行政存在的改变如何影响随后几十年的国家能力和发展。在短期内，行政邻近性增加了税收和执法投资。在长期内，首府获得更多公共物品并增长更快。我们的结果揭示了历史上最雄心勃勃的行政改革之一后国家建设的动态影响。

records.title_en: Merchants of Death: The Effect of Credit Supply Shocks on Hospital Outcomes
records.title_cn: 死亡商人：信贷供给冲击对医院结局的影响
records.abstract_en: This study examines the link between credit supply and hospital health outcomes. We use bank stress tests as exogenous shocks to credit access for hospitals that have lending relationships with tested banks. We find that affected hospitals shift their operations to increase resource utilization following a negative credit shock but reduce the quality of their care to patients across a variety of measures, including a significant increase in risk-adjusted readmission and mortality rates. The results indicate that access to credit can affect the quality of health care hospitals deliver, pointing to important spillover effects of credit market frictions on health outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了信贷供给与医院健康结局之间的联系。我们利用银行压力测试作为对与受测银行有贷款关系的医院信贷准入的外生冲击。我们发现，受影响的医院在负面信贷冲击后调整其运营以提高资源利用率，但降低了其对患者护理质量的多种衡量指标，包括风险调整后再入院率和死亡率的显著增加。结果表明，信贷准入可以影响医院提供的医疗服务质量，指出信贷市场摩擦对健康结局的重要溢出效应。

records.title_en: Micro Risks and (Robust) Pareto-Improving Policies
records.title_cn: 微观风险与（稳健的）帕累托改进政策
records.abstract_en: We provide conditions for the feasibility of robust Pareto-improving (RPI) policies when markets are incomplete and the interest rate is below the growth rate. We allow for arbitrary heterogeneity in preferences and income risk and a wedge between the return to capital and bonds. An RPI improves risk sharing and can induce a more efficient level of capital. Elasticities of aggregate savings to changes in interest rates are the crucial ingredients to the feasibility of RPIs. Government debt may complement rather than substitute for capital in an RPI. Our analysis emphasizes the welfare-improving qualities of government bonds versus explicit redistribution.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了在市场不完全且利率低于增长率时，稳健帕累托改进（RPI）政策可行性的条件。我们允许偏好和收入风险存在任意异质性，以及资本回报与债券之间存在楔子。RPI改善了风险分担，并能引致更有效的资本水平。总储蓄对利率变化的弹性是RPI可行性的关键因素。在RPI中，政府债务可能补充而非替代资本。我们的分析强调了政府债券相对于显性再分配的福利改进特性。

records.title_en: A Technology-Gap Model of 'Premature' Deindustrialization
records.title_cn: “过早”去工业化的技术差距模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a parsimonious mechanism for generating premature deindustrialization (PD). In the baseline model, the Baumol effect drives the hump-shaped path of the manufacturing share. Countries follow different paths due to the difference in the sector-specific adoption lags. The condition for PD under which countries differ only in technology gap implies that the cross-country productivity dispersion is the largest in agriculture. Moreover, when calibrated to match Rodrik's (2016) findings, it is the smallest in manufacturing. In three extensions, we add the Engel effect, international trade, and catching up by late industrializers, to demonstrate the robustness of the mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个生成过早去工业化（PD）的简约机制。在基准模型中，鲍莫尔效应驱动了制造业份额的驼峰形路径。由于部门特定采用滞后的差异，各国遵循不同的路径。PD的条件，即各国仅在技术差距上有所不同，意味着跨国生产率离散度在农业中最大。此外，当校准以匹配罗德里克（2016）的发现时，它在制造业中最小。在三个扩展中，我们加入了恩格尔效应、国际贸易和晚期工业化国家的追赶，以证明该机制的稳健性。

records.title_en: Quality Is in the Eye of the Beholder: Taste Projection in Markets with Observational Learning
records.title_cn: 质量在观察者眼中：具有观察学习的市场中的品味投射
records.abstract_en: We study how misperceptions of others' tastes influence beliefs, demand, and prices in markets with observational learning. Consumers infer a good's quality from the quantity demanded and price paid by others. When consumers exaggerate the similarity between their and others' tastes, such "taste projection" generates discrepant quality perceptions, which are decreasing in a projector's taste and increasing in the observed price. These biased inferences produce an excessively elastic market demand. We also analyze dynamic monopoly pricing with short-lived taste-projecting consumers. Optimal pricing follows a declining path: a high initial price inflates future buyers' perceptions, and lower subsequent prices induce overadoption.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究在具有观察学习的市场中，对他人口味的误解如何影响信念、需求和价格。消费者从他人购买的数量和支付的价格中推断商品的质量。当消费者夸大自己与他人口味的相似性时，这种“品味投射”会产生不一致的质量感知，这种感知随投射者的口味递减，随观察到的价格递增。这些有偏的推断导致市场需求过度弹性。我们还分析了具有短视品味投射消费者的动态垄断定价。最优定价遵循下降路径：高初始价格抬高未来购买者的感知，随后的较低价格诱导过度采用。

records.title_en: Information Frictions and Skill Signaling in the Youth Labor Market
records.title_cn: 青年劳动力市场中的信息摩擦与技能信号
records.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence that information frictions limit the labor market trajectories of US youth. We provide credible skill signals—recommendation letters based on supervisor feedback—to a random subset of 43,409 participants in New York’s summer jobs program. Letters increase employment the following year by 3 percentage points (4.5 percent). Earnings effects grow over four years to a cumulative $1,349 (4.9 percent). We find little evidence of increased job search or confidence; instead, signals may help employers better identify successful matches with high-productivity workers. Pulling youth into the labor market can, however, hamper on-time graduation, especially among low-achieving students. (JEL D82, H75, J13, J24, J31, J64)
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了信息摩擦限制美国青年劳动力市场轨迹的证据。我们向纽约暑期就业项目中随机抽取的43,409名参与者提供了可信的技能信号——基于主管反馈的推荐信。信件使次年就业率提高了3个百分点（4.5%）。收入效应在四年内累积增长至1,349美元（4.9%）。我们几乎没有发现求职活动或信心增强的证据；相反，信号可能帮助雇主更好地识别与高生产率工人的成功匹配。然而，将青年拉入劳动力市场可能会阻碍按时毕业，尤其是在低成就学生中。（JEL D82, H75, J13, J24, J31, J64）

records.title_en: High Schools Tailored to Adults Can Help Them Complete a Traditional Diploma and Excel in the Labor Market
records.title_cn: 为成人量身定制的高中可帮助他们完成传统文凭并在劳动力市场中表现出色
records.abstract_en: Over 18 million adults in the United States lack a high school credential. While some go on to attain the GED, diplomas are potentially more valuable. A network of high schools helps adults graduate by providing tailored curricula, nonacademic coaching, onsite child care, and transportation. After five years, earnings increase by 38 percent more for graduates than nonenrolling applicants. We address selection by conditioning on preapplication earnings and comparing to students who exit after positive shocks. Much of the wage gains can be accounted for by sectoral switching and evidence on credential completions is consistent with a human capital mechanism. (JEL I21, I26, J24, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 美国有超过18万成年人缺乏高中文凭。虽然有些人继续获得GED，但文凭可能更有价值。一个高中网络通过提供量身定制的课程、非学业辅导、现场儿童保育和交通服务，帮助成年人毕业。五年后，毕业生的收入比未入学的申请者高出38%。我们通过根据申请前收入进行条件调整，并与在正向冲击后退出的学生进行比较来解决选择性问题。大部分工资增长可以由部门转换来解释，而关于文凭完成的证据与人力资本机制一致。(JEL I21, I26, J24, J31)

records.title_en: Pricing Carbon: Evidence from Expert Recommendations
records.title_cn: 碳定价：来自专家建议的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the variation of carbon price recommendations and their determinants using survey evidence from more than 400 experts across almost 40 countries. We quantify the extent of disagreement and reveal that a majority of experts can agree on short- and medium-term global carbon price levels, and on unilateral carbon price levels in most countries. The majority of recommendations do not exhibit a “ free riding” pattern of lower unilateral than global carbon prices. Furthermore, border carbon adjustment facilitates higher unilateral price recommendations. We show how recommendations vary with additional survey responses, and with country and expert characteristics. (JEL H43, Q54, Q58)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用来自近40个国家400多位专家的调查证据，研究碳价格建议的差异及其决定因素。我们量化了分歧的程度，并揭示出大多数专家能够在短期和中期全球碳价格水平以及大多数国家的单边碳价格水平上达成一致。大多数建议并未表现出“搭便车”模式，即单边碳价格低于全球碳价格。此外，边境碳调整促进了更高的单边价格建议。我们展示了建议如何随额外的调查回应以及国家和专家特征而变化。(JEL H43, Q54, Q58)

records.title_en: Real-Time Pricing and the Cost of Clean Power
records.title_cn: 实时定价与清洁电力成本
records.abstract_en: Solar and wind power are now cheaper than fossil fuels but are intermittent. The extra supply-side variability implies growing benefits of using real-time retail pricing (RTP). We evaluate the potential gains of RTP using a model that jointly solves investment, supply, storage, and demand to obtain a chronologically detailed dynamic equilibrium for the island of Oahu, Hawai‘i. We find that, holding demand assumptions fixed, RTP reduces costs in high-renewable systems by roughly 6 to 12 times as much as in fossil systems, markedly lowering the cost of clean energy integration. (JEL G31, L94, L98, Q42, Q48)
records.abstract_cn: 太阳能和风能现在比化石燃料更便宜，但它们是间歇性的。额外的供应侧可变性意味着使用实时零售定价（RTP）的收益越来越大。我们使用一个联合求解投资、供应、存储和需求的模型来评估RTP的潜在收益，从而获得夏威夷瓦胡岛的时间详细动态均衡。我们发现，在保持需求假设不变的情况下，RTP在高可再生能源系统中降低的成本大约是化石燃料系统的6到12倍，显著降低了清洁能源整合的成本。（JEL G31, L94, L98, Q42, Q48）

records.title_en: Identity in Court Decision-Making
records.title_cn: 法院决策中的身份认同
records.abstract_en: We explore the role of identity along multiple dimensions in high-stakes decision-making. Our data contain information about demographic and socioeconomic indicators for defendants and randomly assigned jurors in a Swedish court. Our results show that defendants are 4 to 6 percent less likely to get a prison sentence if judged by one more juror belonging to the same identity-forming group. Moreover, they are given 10 percent shorter prison sentences. Socioeconomic background and demographic attributes are equally important for identity effects, and these effects stem from trials of longer duration and where the defendant is present in the courtroom. (JEL D91, J15, J16, K42, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了身份认同在高风险决策中沿多个维度所起的作用。我们的数据包含瑞典法院中被告和随机分配的陪审员的人口统计和社会经济指标信息。我们的结果表明，如果由多一位属于同一身份形成群体的陪审员审理，被告获得监禁判决的可能性会降低4至6%。此外，他们被判处更短的监禁刑期，缩短了10%。社会经济背景和人口统计特征对身份效应同样重要，且这些效应源于持续时间较长以及被告出庭的审判。(JEL D91, J15, J16, K42, Z13)

records.title_en: The School-to-Prison Pipeline: Long-Run Impacts of School Suspensions on Adult Crime
records.title_cn: 从学校到监狱的管道：学校停学对成年犯罪的长期影响
records.abstract_en: Schools must balance student behavior management with the potential negatives of strict discipline. These policies can deter misbehavior but may stigmatize students and expose them to the criminal justice system early. We assess the impact of attending a strict discipline school on achievement, educational attainment, and adult criminal activity. Using data from a boundary change and principal switches, we find that higher suspension rates have significant negative long-term effects. Students at such schools are 15–20 percent more likely to be arrested and incarcerated as adults. Negative impacts on educational attainment are particularly pronounced for males and students of color. (JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 学校必须在学生行为管理与严格纪律的潜在负面影响之间取得平衡。这些政策可以阻止不当行为，但可能使学生蒙受污名，并使其过早接触刑事司法系统。我们评估了就读于纪律严格的学校对学业成绩、教育程度和成年犯罪活动的影响。利用边界变化和校长更替的数据，我们发现较高的停学率具有显著的长期负面效应。此类学校的学生成年后被逮捕和监禁的可能性高出15-20%。对教育程度的负面影响在男性和有色人种学生中尤为明显。（JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, K42）

records.title_en: Downward Revision of Investment Decisions after Corporate Tax Hikes
records.title_cn: 企业税上调后投资决策的下调修正
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal effect of corporate tax hikes on firm investment based on more than 1,400 local tax changes. By observing planned and realized investment volumes in a representative sample of German manufacturing firms, we can study how tax hikes induce firms to revise their investment decisions. On average, the share of firms that invest less than previously planned increases by 3 percentage points after a tax hike. This effect is twice as large during recessions. (JEL D22, E32, G31, H25, H32, H71, L60)
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于超过1,400次地方税变化，估计了企业税上调对企业投资的因果效应。通过观察德国制造业企业代表性样本中的计划投资额和实际投资额，我们可以研究税收上调如何促使企业修正其投资决策。平均而言，在税收上调后，投资低于先前计划的企业比例增加了3个百分点。这一效应在经济衰退期间是两倍大。（JEL D22, E32, G31, H25, H32, H71, L60）

records.title_en: Managers’ Productivity and Recruitment in the Public Sector
records.title_cn: 公共部门管理者的生产率与招聘
records.abstract_en: Governments face many constraints in attracting talented managers to the public sector, which often lacks high-powered incentives. In this paper, we study how a civil service reform in Chile changed the effectiveness of a vital group of public sector managers: school principals. First, we estimate principal effectiveness by using an extension of the canonical teacher value-added model. Then we evaluate the effect of the reform on principal effectiveness using a difference-in-differences approach. We find that public schools appointed more effective managers and improved their students’ outcomes after increasing the competitiveness and transparency of their selection process. (JEL D73, H83, I21, J24, J45, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 政府在吸引有才能的管理者进入公共部门方面面临许多约束，而公共部门往往缺乏高能激励。在本文中，我们研究了智利的一项公务员制度改革如何改变了公共部门管理者中一个关键群体的有效性：学校校长。首先，我们通过扩展经典的教师增值模型来估计校长的有效性。然后，我们使用双重差分方法评估改革对校长有效性的影响。我们发现，在提高选拔过程的竞争性和透明度之后，公立学校任命了更有效的管理者，并改善了学生的成绩。（JEL D73, H83, I21, J24, J45, O15）

records.title_en: How Do You Say Your Name? Difficult-to-Pronounce Names and Labor Market Outcomes
records.title_cn: 你的名字怎么念？难发音的名字与劳动力市场结果
records.abstract_en: We test for labor market discrimination based on an understudied characteristic: name fluency. Analysis of recent economics PhD job candidates indicates that name difficulty is negatively related to the probability of landing an academic or tenure-track position and research productivity of initial institutional placement. Discrimination due to name fluency is also found using experimental data from prior audit studies. Within samples of African Americans (Bertrand and Mullainathan 2004) and ethnic immigrants (Oreopoulos 2011), job applicants with less fluent names experience lower callback rates, and name complexity explains roughly between 10 and 50 percent of ethnic name penalties. The results are primarily driven by candidates with weaker résumés, suggesting that cognitive biases may contribute to the penalty of having a difficult-to-pronounce name. (JEL A11, J15, J23, J44, J71)
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于一个研究不足的特征——名字流畅度——来检验劳动力市场歧视。对近期经济学博士求职者的分析表明，名字难度与获得学术或终身教职职位的概率以及初始机构安置的研究生产力呈负相关。使用先前审计研究的实验数据也发现了因名字流畅度而产生的歧视。在非裔美国人（Bertrand和Mullainathan 2004）和族裔移民（Oreopoulos 2011）的样本中，名字流畅度较低的求职者获得的回电率较低，而名字复杂度大约解释了族裔名字惩罚的10至50%%。结果主要由简历较弱的候选人驱动，这表明认知偏差可能助长了难发音名字的惩罚。（JEL A11, J15, J23, J44, J71）

records.title_en: Achieving Air Pollution Control Targets with Technology‑Aided Monitoring: Better Enforcement or Localized Efforts?
records.title_cn: 借助技术辅助监测实现空气污染控制目标：更好的执法还是局部努力？
records.abstract_en: Weak enforcement of environmental regulations remains a global issue due to inadequate monitoring and misaligned incentives. This paper examines the effects of automated monitoring on achieving air pollution control targets amidst China’s war on pollution. Utilizing the staggered rollout process and remote-sensing data, we find local governments respond to the advanced monitoring system by strategically targeting areas near monitors, resulting in a 3.2 percent decrease in pollution adjacent to automated monitors compared to areas farther away. Furthermore, we observe heterogeneity in response across cities with varying degrees of preexisting data manipulation and among officials facing different incentives and public pressure. (JEL O13, O18, P25, P28, Q53, Q55, R11)
records.abstract_cn: 由于监测不足和激励错位，环境法规执行不力仍是一个全球性问题。本文考察了自动化监测在中国治污攻坚战中实现空气污染控制目标的效果。利用分阶段推广过程和遥感数据，我们发现地方政府对先进监测系统的回应是战略性地瞄准监测点附近的区域，导致自动化监测点附近的污染比更远区域下降3.2%。此外，我们观察到在不同程度的事先数据操纵的城市以及面临不同激励和公众压力的官员之间存在异质性反应。(JEL O13, O18, P25, P28, Q53, Q55, R11)

records.title_en: Administrative Burden and Procedural Denials: Experimental Evidence from SNAP
records.title_cn: 行政负担与程序性拒绝：来自SNAP的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Many government program applications result in procedural denials due to administrative burdens associated with applying. We identify the intake interview as a key barrier to take-up of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and study the effect of an alternative application process designed to reduce burdens. Using a field experiment involving 65,000 Los Angeles applicants, we find that access to flexible interviews initiated by the applicant increases approvals by 6 percentage points, doubles early approvals, and increases long-term participation by over 2 percentage points. Our findings highlight the importance of incorporating flexibility when designing program integrity policies to minimize procedural denials. (JEL H75, I18, I38)
records.abstract_cn: 许多政府项目申请因申请过程中的行政负担而导致程序性拒绝。我们确定 intake 访谈是补充营养援助计划参与的一个关键障碍，并研究了一种旨在减少负担的替代申请流程的效果。通过一项涉及 65,000 名洛杉矶申请人的现场实验，我们发现，由申请人发起的灵活访谈可增加 6 个百分点的批准率，使早期批准翻倍，并将长期参与率提高超过 2 个百分点。我们的研究结果强调了在设计项目诚信政策时纳入灵活性以最小化程序性拒绝的重要性。(JEL H75, I18, I38)

records.title_en: Education and Geographical Mobility: The Role of the Job Surplus
records.title_cn: 教育与地理流动性：工作盈余的作用
records.abstract_en: Better educated workers accept many more long-distance job offers, and relocate quicker following local shocks. I attribute this to a fundamental feature of their labor market experience, unrelated to geography: large returns to job match quality. If a good offer happens to originate from far away, the match surplus is then more likely to justify the cost of moving. This “lubricates” labor markets spatially. Using wage transition data (and a jobs ladder model), I show this can explain the bulk of mobility differentials. These differentials can be closed by subsidizing long-distance matches, and I quantify the cost of doing so. (JEL I26, J24, J41, J61, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 受教育程度更高的工人会接受更多远距离工作机会，并在本地冲击后更快地搬迁。我将此归因于他们劳动力市场经验的一个基本特征，与地理无关：工作匹配质量的高回报。如果一个好的机会恰好来自远方，那么匹配盈余就更有可能证明搬迁成本的合理性。这在空间上“润滑”了劳动力市场。利用工资转换数据（以及工作阶梯模型），我表明这可以解释流动性差异的大部分。这些差异可以通过补贴远距离匹配来消除，我量化了这样做的成本。（JEL I26, J24, J41, J61, R23）

records.title_en: Algorithmic Risk Assessment in the Hands of Humans
records.title_cn: 人类手中的算法风险评估
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the impacts of adopting algorithmic risk assessments in sentencing. We find that judges changed sentencing practices in response to the risk assessment, but that discretion played a large role in mediating its impact. Judges deviated from the recommendations associated with the algorithm in systematic ways, suggestive of alternative objectives. As a result, risk assessment did not lead to detectable gains in terms of public safety or reduced incarceration rates. Using simulations, we show that strict adherence to the sentencing recommendations associated with the algorithm would have had benefits (less incarceration) but also some costs (increased sentences for youth). (JEL D81, D91, H76, K41, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了在量刑中采用算法风险评估的影响。我们发现，法官因应风险评估而改变了量刑实践，但自由裁量权在调节其影响方面发挥了重要作用。法官以系统性的方式偏离与算法相关的建议，这暗示了其他目标的存在。因此，风险评估并未在公共安全或降低监禁率方面带来可检测的收益。通过模拟，我们表明严格遵守与算法相关的量刑建议本可带来好处（减少监禁），但也带来一些成本（对青少年增加刑罚）。（JEL D81, D91, H76, K41, K42）

records.title_en: The Carrot and the Stick: Bank Bailouts and the Disciplining Role of Board Appointments
records.title_cn: 胡萝卜与大棒：银行救助与董事会任命的纪律作用
records.abstract_en: We empirically examine the Capital Purchase Program (CPP) used by the US government to bail out distressed banks and its implications for regulatory policy. We find strong evidence that a feature of the CPP—the government’s ability to appoint independent directors on the board of an assisted bank that missed six dividend payments to the Treasury—had a significant effect on bank behavior. Banks were averse to these appointments—the empirical distribution of missed payments exhibits a sharp discontinuity at five. Director appointments by the Treasury were associated with improved bank performance and lower CEO pay. (JEL G21, G28, G32, G34, G35, G38, H81)
records.abstract_cn: 我们实证研究了美国政府用于救助陷入困境银行的资本购买计划（CPP）及其对监管政策的影响。我们发现强有力的证据表明，CPP的一个特征——政府有能力在未向财政部支付六次股息的受助银行董事会中任命独立董事——对银行行为产生了显著影响。银行对这些任命持反感态度——未支付股息的实证分布在五次处出现明显的不连续性。财政部的董事任命与银行绩效改善和CEO薪酬降低相关。（JEL G21, G28, G32, G34, G35, G38, H81）

records.title_en: Price Sensitivity and Information Barriers to the Take-Up of Naloxone
records.title_cn: 纳洛酮使用中的价格敏感性与信息障碍
records.abstract_en: We conducted a field experiment that randomized advertisements, advertisement content, and prices across 2,204 counties in the United States to study the impacts on online purchases of naloxone, an opioid overdose reversal drug. Advertising increased web-site users but only impacted purchases when combined with a price reduction. Messages emphasizing the discreet nature of online sales had no additional impact on purchases. Comparing counties with advertisements featuring a highly discounted price to those featuring the full price, we estimate a price elasticity of demand for online naloxone of −1.3. Price is a significant barrier to online purchases of this lifesaving medication. (JEL C93, H75, I12, I18, L65, M37)
records.abstract_cn: 我们在美国2,204个县进行了一项实地实验，随机分配广告、广告内容和价格，以研究对纳洛酮（一种阿片类药物过量逆转药物）在线购买的影响。广告增加了网站用户，但只有在与降价相结合时才影响购买。强调在线销售隐蔽性的信息对购买没有额外影响。比较以大幅折扣价格为特色的广告县与以全价为特色的广告县，我们估计在线纳洛酮的需求价格弹性为−1.3。价格是这种救命药物在线购买的重要障碍。(JEL C93, H75, I12, I18, L65, M37)

records.title_en: Remote Instruction and Student Mental Health: Swedish Evidence from the Pandemic
records.title_cn: 远程教学与学生心理健康：来自瑞典大流行的证据
records.abstract_en: When COVID-19 reached Sweden, upper-secondary students (ages 17–19) transitioned to remote instruction, while lower-secondary schools (ages 14–16) remained open. We use this setting as a natural experiment to analyze how modes of instruction affect student mental health. We find a 4.4 percent decrease in mental health care use from remote instruction, primarily due to fewer diagnoses and prescriptions for depression and anxiety. The reduction persists throughout the study period; 21 months after the initial closure and 9 months after schools resumed usual operations. This suggests potential mental health benefits from remote instruction, at least in the medium term. (JEL I12, I18, I21, I28, I31)
records.abstract_cn: 当COVID-19到达瑞典时，高中学生（年龄17-19岁）转为远程教学，而初中（年龄14-16岁）仍保持开放。我们利用这一情境作为自然实验，分析教学模式如何影响学生心理健康。我们发现远程教学使心理健康护理使用减少了4.4%，主要归因于抑郁和焦虑的诊断和处方减少。这一减少在整个研究期间持续存在；在最初关闭后的21个月和学校恢复正常运营后的9个月。这表明远程教学可能对心理健康有益，至少在中期内如此。（JEL I12, I18, I21, I28, I31）

records.title_en: The Status Quo and Belief Polarization of Inattentive Agents: Theory and Experiment
records.title_cn: 不关注代理人的现状与信念极化：理论与实验
records.abstract_en: We show that rational but inattentive agents can become polarized ex ante. We present how optimal information acquisition and subsequent belief formation depend crucially on the agent-specific status quo valuation. Beliefs can systematically—in expectations over all possible signal realizations conditional on the state of the world—update away from the realized truth, and even agents with the same initial beliefs might become polarized. We design a laboratory experiment to test the model’s predictions. The results confirm our predictions about the mechanism (rational information acquisition) and its effect on beliefs (systematic polarization), and they provide general insights into demand for information. (JEL C92, D72, D83, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，理性但不关注的代理人可以在事前变得极化。我们展示了最优信息获取和随后的信念形成如何关键地取决于代理人特定的现状估值。信念可以系统地——在对所有可能信号实现的条件期望中，给定世界状态——偏离已实现的真相而更新，甚至具有相同初始信念的代理人也可能变得极化。我们设计了一个实验室实验来检验模型的预测。结果证实了我们关于机制（理性信息获取）及其对信念影响（系统性极化）的预测，并为信息需求提供了普遍见解。（JEL C92, D72, D83, D91）

records.title_en: Consistent Depth of Reasoning in Level-k Models
records.title_cn: Level-k模型中推理深度的一致性
records.abstract_en: Level-k models often assume that individuals employ a fixed depth of reasoning across different games. We study this assumption by having subjects make choices in five classes of games chosen to identify inconsistent depth of reasoning. We demonstrate that depth of reasoning is pervasively inconsistent, changing both within and between classes of games. We show that this cannot easily be explained by factors such as subject confusion, changing beliefs about others’ depth of reasoning, stochastic choice, model misspecification, changing incentives, or low cognitive ability. We develop a simple model incorporating ambiguity aversion that predicts inconsistent depth of reasoning. (JEL C57, C90, D81, D83, D91)
records.abstract_cn: Level-k模型通常假设个体在不同博弈中采用固定的推理深度。我们通过让受试者在五类博弈中做出选择来研究这一假设，这些博弈旨在识别不一致的推理深度。我们证明推理深度普遍不一致，在博弈类别内部和类别之间都会发生变化。我们表明，这不能轻易用受试者困惑、对他人推理深度的信念变化、随机选择、模型误设、激励变化或认知能力低下等因素来解释。我们开发了一个包含模糊厌恶的简单模型，该模型预测了不一致的推理深度。(JEL C57, C90, D81, D83, D91)

records.title_en: A New Era of Midnight Mergers: Antitrust Risk and Investor Disclosures
records.title_cn: 午夜合并的新时代：反垄断风险与投资者披露
records.abstract_en: Antitrust authorities search public documents to discover anticompetitive mergers. Thus, investor disclosures may alert them to deals that would otherwise go undetected, creating disincentives for managers to divulge certain transactions. We study this behavior in publicly traded US companies. First, we employ a regression discontinuity approach to estimate the effect of mandatory disclosures. We find that releasing information to investors poses antitrust risk. Second, we introduce a method for measuring undisclosed mergers that relies on financial accounting reporting requirements. We find that undisclosed mergers total $1.85 trillion between 2002 and 2016. (JEL D22, G32, G34, G38, K21, L41, M41)
records.abstract_cn: 反垄断机构通过搜索公开文件来发现反竞争的合并。因此，投资者披露可能会提醒他们注意那些原本不会被发现的交易，从而抑制管理者披露某些交易的动机。我们研究了美国上市公司中的这种行为。首先，我们采用断点回归方法来估计强制披露的影响。我们发现向投资者发布信息会带来反垄断风险。其次，我们引入了一种依赖于财务会计报告要求的衡量未披露合并的方法。我们发现，在2002年至2016年间，未披露的合并总额为1.85万亿美元。（JEL D22, G32, G34, G38, K21, L41, M41）

records.title_en: Noncompete Agreements and the Welfare of Consumers
records.title_cn: 竞业禁止协议与消费者福利
records.abstract_en: Employee spin-offs harm incumbent firms by increasing competition (benefiting consumers) and preventing firm owners from making beneficial investments in workers who may later spin off (harming consumers). We model noncompete agreements (NCAs) as solutions for the firm and analyze the resulting trade-off for consumers. We show that market structure and the nature of investment play large roles. Counterintuitively, increased investment benefits have the potential to harm consumers such that industries where firms value NCAs the most are those where harm is greater. Finally, we draw two analogies between NCAs and antitrust and show how those areas inform NCA policy. (JEL D42, D43, J41, K21, L26, M13, M53)
records.abstract_cn: 员工离职创业通过增加竞争（有利于消费者）和阻止企业主对可能随后离职创业的工人进行有益投资（损害消费者）来损害现有企业。我们将竞业禁止协议（NCAs）建模为企业的解决方案，并分析由此产生的消费者权衡。我们表明，市场结构和投资性质起着重要作用。与直觉相反，增加的投资收益有可能损害消费者，以至于企业最看重NCAs的行业正是损害更大的行业。最后，我们在NCAs和反垄断之间画了两个类比，并展示了这些领域如何为NCA政策提供信息。（JEL D42, D43, J41, K21, L26, M13, M53）

records.title_en: Dual Moral Hazard and the Tyranny of Success
records.title_cn: 双重道德风险与成功的暴政
records.abstract_en: I explain why current success can undermine an organization’s ability to innovate. I consider a standard bandit problem between a safe and a risky arm with two modifications. First, a principal allocates resources. Second, an agent must install the risky arm, which is not contractible. If the principal cannot commit to a resource policy, a dual moral hazard problem emerges: The agent’s pay must be tied to the risky arm’s success to encourage installation, inducing the principal to stop experimenting with the arm prematurely. This problem intensifies as the safe arm becomes more profitable, potentially leaving the organization worse off. (JEL D21, D82, D86, O31)
records.abstract_cn: 我解释了为什么当前的成功会削弱组织的创新能力。我考虑了一个标准的多臂老虎机问题，涉及一个安全臂和一个风险臂，并进行了两项修改。首先，委托人分配资源。其次，代理人必须安装风险臂，而这不可缔约。如果委托人无法承诺资源政策，就会出现双重道德风险问题：代理人的报酬必须与风险臂的成功挂钩以鼓励安装，这导致委托人过早停止对该臂的试验。随着安全臂变得更有利可图，这个问题会加剧，可能使组织状况恶化。（JEL D21, D82, D86, O31）

records.title_en: Recovering the Anchoring of Economic Valuations
records.title_cn: 恢复经济估值锚定的解释
records.abstract_en: We revisit the interpretation of the anchoring effect as evidence for nonexisting or arbitrary preferences. A theory of endogenous information acquisition (i.e., deliberation) is developed to rationalize the causal dependence of economic valuations on arbitrary anchor numbers. We identify theory-driven moderators to reconcile seemingly discrepant findings among original and follow-up anchoring experiments. We demonstrate in a meta-analysis that the anchoring effect may be systematically moderated by unintended experimental/individual differences. Moreover, apparent replication failure of the anchoring effect may be a false negative for self-countervailing treatment effects, because an anchoring treatment may cast opposite effects on different subjects within an experiment. (JEL C90, D11, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视锚定效应作为不存在或任意偏好证据的解释。我们发展了一个内生信息获取（即深思熟虑）理论，以合理化经济估值对任意锚定数字的因果依赖。我们识别出理论驱动的调节变量，以调和原始和后续锚定实验中看似不一致的发现。我们在元分析中证明，锚定效应可能受到非故意的实验/个体差异的系统性调节。此外，锚定效应的明显复制失败可能是自我抵消处理效应的假阴性，因为锚定处理可能在实验中对不同受试者产生相反效应。（JEL C90, D11, D83）

records.title_en: Bargaining in the Shadow of Uncertainty
records.title_cn: 不确定性阴影下的谈判
records.abstract_en: In bargaining environments with stochastic future surplus, failing to delay agreement can be inefficient when the expected future surplus is sufficiently high. Theoretically, such inefficiencies never arise under unanimity rule but can arise under majority rule. Using a laboratory experiment, we find support for these predictions, both when the unanimity rule is predicted to be more efficient and when there should be no difference between the two rules. We also find large point prediction deviations under the majority rule. We show these deviations can be explained by higher-than-predicted egalitarian sharing and a lower risk of being excluded from future agreements. (JEL C78, C92, D71, D81)
records.abstract_cn: 在具有随机未来剩余的谈判环境中，当预期未来剩余足够高时，未能延迟达成协议可能是低效的。理论上，这种低效在一致同意规则下永远不会出现，但在多数规则下可能出现。通过实验室实验，我们发现了支持这些预测的证据，无论是在预测一致同意规则更有效的情况下，还是在两种规则之间不应存在差异的情况下。我们还发现多数规则下存在较大的点预测偏差。我们表明，这些偏差可以通过高于预测的平等主义分享和较低的被排除在未来协议之外的风险来解释。（JEL C78, C92, D71, D81）

records.title_en: Fair Shares and Selective Attention
records.title_cn: 公平份额与选择性关注
records.abstract_en: Attitudes toward fairness and redistribution differ along socioeconomic lines. To understand their formation, we conduct a large-scale experiment on attention to merit and luck and the effect of attention on fairness decisions. Randomly advantaged subjects pay less attention to information about true merit and retain more economic surplus, and this effect persists in subsequent impartial decisions. Attention also has a causal role: encouraging subjects to look at merit reduces the effect of an advantaged position on allocations. This suggests that attention-based policy interventions may be effective in reducing polarized views on inequality. (JEL C91, D63, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 对公平和再分配的态度因社会经济地位而异。为了理解这些态度的形成，我们进行了一项大规模实验，研究对才能和运气的关注以及关注对公平决策的影响。随机获得优势的受试者对真实才能信息的关注较少，并保留了更多的经济剩余，这种效应在随后的公正决策中持续存在。关注也具有因果作用：鼓励受试者关注才能会减少优势地位对分配的影响。这表明基于关注的干预措施可能有效减少对不平等的极化观点。（JEL C91, D63, D83）

records.title_en: A Revealed Preference Test for Choquet and Max-Min Expected Utility with Ambiguity Aversion
records.title_cn: 具有模糊厌恶的Choquet和最大最小期望效用的显示偏好检验
records.abstract_en: We develop a revealed preference test for the Choquet expected utility model with ambiguity aversion, which does not rely on specific functional form assumptions on the utility index. It is computationally efficient if the number of states is not too large, even for a large number of observations. This is a nice feature compared to other existing revealed preference tests for decision models with ambiguity. We illustrate the usefulness of our results by implementing our test on two experimental datasets from the literature, and we compare the empirical fit of this model to the subjective expected utility model. (JEL C91, D81, D91, G41)
records.abstract_cn: 我们为具有模糊厌恶的Choquet期望效用模型开发了一种显示偏好检验，该检验不依赖于效用指数的特定函数形式假设。如果状态数量不是太大，即使观测数量很大，该检验在计算上也是高效的。与现有的针对具有模糊性的决策模型的其他显示偏好检验相比，这是一个很好的特点。我们通过在文献中的两个实验数据集上实施我们的检验来说明我们结果的有用性，并将该模型的实证拟合与主观期望效用模型进行比较。(JEL C91, D81, D91, G41)

records.title_en: The Inverse Product Differentiation Logit Model
records.title_cn: 逆产品差异化Logit模型
records.abstract_en: We introduce the inverse product differentiation logit (IPDL) model, a micro-founded inverse market share model for differentiated products that captures market segmentation according to one or more characteristics. The IPDL model generalizes the nested logit model to allow richer substitution patterns, including complementarity in demand, and can be estimated by linear instrumental variable regression with market-level data. Furthermore, we provide Monte Carlo experiments comparing the IPDL model to the workhorse empirical models of the literature. Lastly, we demonstrate the empirical performance of the IPDL model using a well-known dataset on the ready-to-eat cereal market. (JEL C25, D11, D12, L66, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了逆产品差异化Logit（IPDL）模型，这是一个基于微观基础的差异化产品逆市场份额模型，能够根据一个或多个特征捕捉市场细分。IPDL模型推广了嵌套Logit模型，允许更丰富的替代模式，包括需求中的互补性，并且可以通过市场层面数据的线性工具变量回归进行估计。此外，我们提供了蒙特卡洛实验，将IPDL模型与文献中的主流实证模型进行比较。最后，我们使用一个关于即食谷物市场的知名数据集展示了IPDL模型的实证表现。（JEL C25, D11, D12, L66, L81）

records.title_en: Secure Survey Design in Organizations: Theory and Experiments
records.title_cn: 组织中的安全调查设计：理论与实验
records.abstract_en: We study secure survey designs in organizational settings where fear of retaliation makes it hard to elicit truth. Theory predicts that (i) randomized-response techniques offer no improvement because they are strategically equivalent to direct elicitation, (ii) exogenously distorting survey responses (hard garbling) can improve information transmission, and (iii) the impact of survey design on reporting can be estimated in equilibrium. Laboratory experiments confirm that hard garbling outperforms direct elicitation but randomized response works better than expected. False accusations slightly but persistently bias treatment effect estimates. Additional experiments reveal that play converges to equilibrium if learning from others’ experience is possible. (JEL C83, C90, D83, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究组织环境中的安全调查设计，在这种环境中，害怕报复使得难以引出真实信息。理论预测：（i）随机应答技术没有改进，因为它们在策略上等同于直接引出；（ii）外生地扭曲调查回答（硬性扰动）可以改善信息传递；（iii）调查设计对报告的影响可以在均衡中估计。实验室实验证实，硬性扰动优于直接引出，但随机应答的效果比预期更好。虚假指控轻微但持续地偏倚处理效应估计。额外的实验表明，如果可以从他人的经验中学习，博弈会收敛到均衡。（JEL C83, C90, D83, D91）

records.title_en: Decentralized Matching with Transfers: Experimental and Noncooperative Analyses
records.title_cn: 带转移的分散匹配：实验与非合作分析
records.abstract_en: We experimentally examine the Becker-Shapley-Shubik two-sided matching model. In the experiment, the aggregate outcomes of matching and surplus are affected by whether equal split is in the core and whether efficient matching is assortative; the canonical cooperative theory predicts no effect. In markets with an equal number of participants on both sides, individual payoffs cannot be explained by existing refinements of the core, but are consistent with our noncooperative model’s predictions. In markets with unequal numbers of participants, noncompetitive outcomes, are not captured by the canonical cooperative model, but are included in the set of predictions in our noncooperative model. (JEL C71, C72, C78)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验检验了Becker-Shapley-Shubik双边匹配模型。在实验中，匹配和剩余的总体结果受到均等分割是否在核内以及有效匹配是否具有分类性的影响；经典合作理论预测没有影响。在双方参与者数量相等的市场中，个体收益无法用现有的核精炼来解释，但与我们的非合作模型的预测一致。在参与者数量不等的市场中，非竞争性结果未被经典合作模型捕捉，但包含在我们的非合作模型的预测集中。(JEL C71, C72, C78)

records.title_en: Corrupted Votes and Rule Compliance
records.title_cn: 腐败选票与规则遵从
records.abstract_en: Allegations of voter fraud accompany many real-world elections. How does electoral malpractice affect the acceptance of elected institutions? Using an online experiment in which participants distribute income according to majority-elected rules, we show that those who experience vote buying or voter disenfranchisement during the election are subsequently less likely to voluntarily comply with a rule. On average, the detrimental impact of electoral malpractice on compliance is of the same magnitude as removing the election altogether and imposing a rule exogenously. Our experiment shows how corrupting democratic processes impacts economic behavior and sheds light on factors that may underlie “rule legitimacy.” (JEL C90, D63, D72, D73, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 关于选民欺诈的指控伴随着许多现实世界的选举。选举舞弊如何影响当选机构的接受度？通过一项在线实验，参与者根据多数选举产生的规则分配收入，我们表明，那些在选举期间经历买票或选民剥夺选举权的人，随后自愿遵守规则的可能性较低。平均而言，选举舞弊对遵从的有害影响与完全取消选举并外生施加规则的影响程度相同。我们的实验展示了腐败的民主进程如何影响经济行为，并揭示了可能构成“规则合法性”基础的因素。（JEL C90, D63, D72, D73, D83）

records.title_en: On Optimal Scheduling
records.title_cn: 论最优调度
records.abstract_en: We consider a decision-maker sequentially choosing among alternatives when periodic payoffs depend on both chosen and unchosen alternatives in that period. We show that when flow payoffs are the sum or product of payoffs from chosen and unchosen alternatives, the optimal policy is an index policy. We characterize key properties of the optimal dynamics and present an algorithm for computing the indices explicitly. Furthermore, we use the results to generalize Weitzman’s (1979) classic “Pandora’s boxes” problem to allow for complementarities. We illustrate the framework’s usefulness through applications, including decision problems with disappearing alternatives, repeated bargaining, dynamic supervision, and dynamic occupational choice. (JEL C78, D82, M11)
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个决策者在一个时期内，当周期收益取决于该时期被选择和未被选择的备选方案时，依次进行选择的情形。我们证明，当流动收益是被选择与未被选择备选方案收益之和或乘积时，最优政策是指数政策。我们刻画了最优动态的关键性质，并提出了一种显式计算指数的算法。此外，我们利用这些结果将Weitzman（1979）经典的“潘多拉盒子”问题推广到允许互补性的情形。我们通过应用实例说明了该框架的实用性，包括具有消失备选方案的决策问题、重复谈判、动态监督和动态职业选择。（JEL C78, D82, M11）

records.title_en: Climate Change and Adaptation in Global Supply-Chain Networks
records.title_cn: 气候变化与全球供应链网络中的适应
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how physical climate exposure affects firm performance and global supply chains. We document that heat at supplier locations reduces the operating income of suppliers and their customers. Further, customers respond to perceived changes in suppliers’ exposure: when suppliers’ realized exposure exceeds ex ante expectations, customers are 7% more likely to terminate supplier relationships. Consistent with experience-based learning, this effect increases with signal strength and repetition and decreases with country-level climate adaptation. Subsequent replacement suppliers show a lower expected and realized but similar projected heat exposure. We find similar results for suppliers’ exposure to floods.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了物理气候暴露如何影响企业绩效和全球供应链。我们记录了供应商所在地的高温会降低供应商及其客户的营业收入。此外，客户会对供应商暴露的感知变化做出反应：当供应商的实际暴露超过事前预期时，客户终止供应商关系的可能性增加7%。与基于经验的学习一致，这种效应随着信号强度和重复次数的增加而增强，并随着国家层面的气候适应而减弱。后续的替代供应商显示出较低的预期和实际但相似的预计高温暴露。我们发现供应商对洪水的暴露也有类似的结果。

records.title_en: Corporate Climate Risk: Measurements and Responses
records.title_cn: 企业气候风险：度量与应对
records.abstract_en: This paper conducts a textual analysis of earnings call transcripts to quantify climate risk exposure at the firm level. We construct dictionaries that measure physical and transition climate risks separately and identify firms that proactively respond to climate risks. Our validation analysis shows that our measures capture firm-level variations in respective climate risk exposure. Firms facing high transition risk, especially those that do not proactively respond, have been valued at a discount in recent years as aggregate investor attention to climate-related issues has been increasing. We document differences in how firms respond through investment, green innovation, and employment when facing high climate risk exposure.
records.abstract_cn: 本文对财报电话会议记录进行文本分析，以量化企业层面的气候风险敞口。我们构建了分别度量物理气候风险和转型气候风险的词典，并识别出主动应对气候风险的企业。我们的验证分析表明，我们的度量捕捉了企业层面各自气候风险敞口的差异。近年来，随着投资者对气候相关问题的总体关注度不断上升，面临高转型风险的企业，尤其是那些未主动应对的企业，其估值一直存在折价。我们记录了企业在面临高气候风险敞口时，通过投资、绿色创新和就业等方面应对方式的差异。

records.title_en: Adverse Selection and Climate Risk: A Response to
records.title_cn: 逆向选择与气候风险：回应
records.abstract_en: We identify two issues in the work of Ouazad and Kahn (2022). Correcting either reverses the original result. The two changes are to use the correct FHFA conforming loan limits for each county and year and to compare the individual loan amount to that limit correctly. There is no evidence that lenders transfer climate risk by altering loan origination and securitization behavior. None of our results calls into question the value and importance of the O&K model as a test for adverse selection. The question addressed and the setup of the test are important and should be replicated over time.
records.abstract_cn: 我们指出了Ouazad和Kahn（2022）研究中的两个问题。纠正其中任何一个都会逆转原始结果。这两个修改是使用每个县和年份正确的FHFA合格贷款限额，并正确地将个人贷款金额与该限额进行比较。没有证据表明贷款机构通过改变贷款发放和证券化行为来转移气候风险。我们的结果均不质疑O&K模型作为逆向选择检验的价值和重要性。所研究的问题和检验的设置很重要，应随时间推移进行复制。

records.title_en: The Effect of Carbon Pricing on Firm Emissions: Evidence from the Swedish CO2 Tax
records.title_cn: 碳定价对企业排放的影响：来自瑞典二氧化碳税的证据
records.abstract_en: Sweden was one of the first countries to introduce a carbon tax back in 1991. We assemble a unique data set tracking CO2 emissions from Swedish manufacturing firms over 26 years to estimate the impact of carbon pricing on firm-level emission intensities. We estimate an emission-to-pricing elasticity of around two, with substantial heterogeneity across subsectors and firms, where higher abatement costs and tighter financial constraints are associated with lower elasticities. A simple calibration suggests that 2015 CO2 emissions from Swedish manufacturing would have been roughly 30% higher without carbon pricing.
records.abstract_cn: 瑞典是早在1991年就引入碳税的首批国家之一。我们汇编了一个独特的数据集，追踪瑞典制造业企业26年间的二氧化碳排放，以估算碳定价对企业层面排放强度的影响。我们估算的排放对价格弹性约为二，且各子行业和企业之间存在显著异质性，其中较高的减排成本和较紧的融资约束与较低的弹性相关。一个简单的校准表明，如果没有碳定价，2015年瑞典制造业的二氧化碳排放量将大约高出30%。

records.title_en: Equity Return Expectations and Portfolios: Evidence from Large Asset Managers
records.title_cn: 股票收益预期与投资组合：来自大型资产管理公司的证据
records.abstract_en: Collecting large asset managers’ capital market assumptions, we revisit the relationships between subjective equity premium expectations, equity valuations, and financial portfolios. In contrast to the well-documented extrapolative expectations of retail investors, asset managers’ equity premium expectations are countercyclical: they are high (low) when valuations are low (high). We find that asset managers’ portfolios reflect their heterogeneous expectations: allocation funds of asset managers with larger U.S. equity premium expectations invest significantly more in U.S. equities. The sensitivity of portfolios to expectations seems to be muted by investment mandates and is smaller than the one predicted by a standard portfolio choice model.
records.abstract_cn: 通过收集大型资产管理公司的资本市场假设，我们重新审视了主观股票溢价预期、股票估值和金融投资组合之间的关系。与零售投资者广为人知的外推性预期相反，资产管理公司的股票溢价预期是逆周期的：当估值低（高）时，预期高（低）。我们发现，资产管理公司的投资组合反映了其异质性预期：美国股票溢价预期较大的资产管理公司的配置基金在美国股票上的投资显著更多。投资组合对预期的敏感性似乎受到投资授权的抑制，并且小于标准投资组合选择模型所预测的敏感性。

records.title_en: Which Subjective Expectations Explain Asset Prices?
records.title_cn: 哪些主观预期解释了资产价格？
records.abstract_en: We present a method for determining whether errors in expectations explain asset pricing puzzles without imposing assumptions about the error mechanism. Using accounting identities and survey forecasts, we find that errors in expected long-term inflation explain price variation, return predictability, and the rejection of the expectations hypothesis for aggregate stock and bond markets. Errors in short-term (long-term) nominal earnings growth expectations explain (do not explain) stock price variation and return predictability. The relevant errors are consistent with mistakes about the persistence of forecasted variables and the response to surprises. A simple framework based on fundamental extrapolation successfully replicates these findings. (JEL G40, G12, G14, E71)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种方法，用于在不施加关于误差机制的假设的情况下，确定预期误差是否解释了资产定价之谜。利用会计恒等式和调查预测，我们发现，预期长期通胀的误差解释了总体股票和债券市场的价格变动、收益可预测性以及对预期假说的拒绝。短期（长期）名义盈利增长预期的误差解释了（不解释）股票价格变动和收益可预测性。相关误差与对预测变量持续性和对意外反应的错误一致。一个基于基本面外推的简单框架成功复制了这些发现。（JEL G40, G12, G14, E71）

records.title_en: Selective Default Expectations
records.title_cn: 选择性违约预期
records.abstract_en: This paper explores how selective default expectations affect the pricing of sovereign bonds in a historical laboratory: the German default of the 1930s. We analyze yield differentials between identical government bonds traded across various creditor countries before and after bond market segmentation. We show that, when secondary debt markets are segmented, a large selective default probability can be priced in bond yield spreads. Selective default risk accounted for one-third of the yield spread of German external bonds over the risk-free rate during the 1930s. Selective default expectations arose from differences in the creditor countries’ economic power over the debtor.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个历史实验室中探讨选择性违约预期如何影响主权债券定价：1930年德国的违约。我们分析了在债券市场分割前后，不同债权国交易的相同政府债券之间的收益率差异。我们表明，当二级债务市场分割时，较大的选择性违约概率可以被定价在债券收益率利差中。在1930年代，选择性违约风险占德国外债相对于无风险利率收益率利差的三分之一。选择性违约预期源于债权国对债务国经济实力的差异。

records.title_en: Resolving Failed Banks: Uncertainty, Multiple Bidding and Auction Design
records.title_cn: 解决破产银行：不确定性、多重投标与拍卖设计
records.abstract_en: The FDIC resolves insolvent banks with scoring auctions. Although the structure of the scoring rule is known to bidders, they are uncertain about how the FDIC trades off different bid components. Scoring-rule uncertainty motivates bidders to submit multiple bids for the same failed bank. To evaluate the effects of uncertainty and multiple bidding for FDIC costs, we develop a methodology for analysing multidimensional bidding when the auctioneer’s scoring weights are unknown to bidders. We estimate private valuations for failed-bank assets during the great financial crisis and compute counterfactuals in the absence of scoring uncertainty. Our findings imply a substantial reduction in FDIC resolution costs of between 29.8% ($8.2 billion) and 44.6% ($12.3 billion). These savings can reduce policy-driven banking-sector distortions, since FDIC resolution costs are covered either through special levies on banks or through loans from the US Treasury. Our analyses also shed new light on optimal bid portfolio choice in combinatorial auctions.
records.abstract_cn: 联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）通过评分拍卖解决资不抵债的银行。尽管评分规则的结构对投标人已知，但他们不确定FDIC如何权衡不同的投标组成部分。评分规则的不确定性促使投标人为同一家破产银行提交多个投标。为了评估不确定性和多重投标对FDIC成本的影响，我们开发了一种在拍卖人的评分权重对投标人未知的情况下分析多维投标的方法。我们估计了大金融危机期间破产银行资产的私人估值，并计算了在没有评分不确定性情况下的反事实结果。我们的研究结果表明，FDIC的解决成本大幅降低，介于29.8%（8.2十亿美元）和44.6%（12.3十亿美元）之间。这些节省可以减少政策驱动的银行业扭曲，因为FDIC的解决成本要么通过对银行的特别征税来覆盖，要么通过美国财政部的贷款来覆盖。我们的分析也为组合拍卖中的最优投标组合选择提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Deadly Debt Crises: COVID-19 in Emerging Markets
records.title_cn: 致命债务危机：新兴市场中的COVID-19
records.abstract_en: Emerging markets have experienced large human and economic costs from coronavirus disease 2019, and their tight fiscal space has limited the support extended to their citizens. We study the impact of an epidemic on economic and health outcomes by integrating epidemiological dynamics into a sovereign default model. The sovereign’s option to default tightens fiscal space and results in an epidemic with limited mitigation and depressed consumption. A quantitative analysis of our model accounts well for the dynamics of fatalities, social distancing, consumption, sovereign debt, and spreads in Latin America. We find that because of default risk, the welfare cost of the pandemic is about a third higher than it is in a version of the model with perfect financial markets. We study debt relief programs and find a compelling case for their implementation. These programs deliver large social gains, improving health and economic outcomes for the country at no cost to international lenders or financial institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 新兴市场因2019冠状病毒病遭受了巨大的人员和经济损失，而其紧张的财政空间限制了向公民提供的支持。我们通过将流行病学动态纳入主权违约模型，研究流行病对经济与健康结果的影响。主权国家的违约选择收紧了财政空间，导致疫情缓解措施有限且消费低迷。我们模型的定量分析很好地解释了拉丁美洲的死亡人数、社交距离、消费、主权债务和利差的动态变化。我们发现，由于违约风险，疫情造成的福利成本比金融市场完善版本模型中的高出约三分之一。我们研究了债务减免计划，并发现其实施具有令人信服的理由。这些计划带来巨大的社会收益，在不给国际贷款机构或金融机构带来成本的情况下，改善了该国的健康和经济结果。

records.title_en: Is the Social Safety Net a Long-Term Investment? Large-Scale Evidence From the Food Stamps Program
records.title_cn: 社会安全网是长期投资吗？来自食品券计划的大规模证据
records.abstract_en: We use novel, large-scale data on 17.5 million Americans to study how a policy-driven increase in economic resources affects children's long-term outcomes. Using the 2000 Census and 2001–13 American Community Survey linked to the Social Security Administration's NUMIDENT, we leverage the county-level rollout of the Food Stamps program between 1961 and 1975. We find that children with access to greater economic resources before age five have better outcomes as adults. The treatment-on-the-treated effects show a 6% of a standard deviation improvement in human capital, 3% of a standard deviation increase in economic self-sufficiency, 8% of a standard deviation increase in the quality of neighbourhood of residence, a 1.2-year increase in life expectancy, and a 0.5 percentage-point decrease in likelihood of being incarcerated. These estimates suggest that Food Stamps’ transfer of resources to families is a highly cost-effective investment in young children, yielding a marginal value of public funds of approximately sixty-two.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用新颖的大规模数据，涵盖17.5万美国人，研究政策驱动的经济资源增加如何影响儿童的长期结果。利用2000年人口普查和2001-13年美国社区调查，并与社会保障局的NUMIDENT数据相关联，我们利用了1961年至1975年间食品券计划在县级逐步推广的情况。我们发现，在五岁之前获得更多经济资源的儿童，成年后结果更好。处理组平均处理效应显示，人力资本提高6%个标准差，经济自给能力提高3%个标准差，居住社区质量提高8%个标准差，预期寿命增加1.2年，入狱可能性降低0.5个百分点。这些估计表明，食品券向家庭转移资源是对幼儿的一项高成本效益投资，公共资金的边际价值约为六十二。

records.title_en: Changes in Social Network Structure in Response to Exposure to Formal Credit Markets
records.title_cn: 社会网络结构对正规信贷市场暴露的响应变化
records.abstract_en: We show that the entry of formal financial institutions can have far-reaching and long-lasting impacts on informal lending and social networks more generally. We first study the introduction of microfinance in 75 villages in Karnataka, India, 43 of which were exposed to microfinance. Using difference-in-differences, we show that networks shrank more in exposed villages. Moreover, links between households that were both unlikely to borrow from microfinance were at least as likely to disappear as links involving likely borrowers. We replicate these surprising findings in the context of a randomised controlled trial (RCT) in Hyderabad, where a microfinance institution randomly selected 52 of 104 neighbourhoods to enter first. Four years after all neighbourhoods were treated, households in early-entry neighbourhoods had credit access longer and had larger loans. We again find fewer social relationships between households in these neighbourhoods, even among those ex-ante unlikely to borrow. Because the results suggest global spillovers, atypical in usual models of network formation, we develop a new dynamic model of network formation that emphasizes chance meetings, where efforts to socialize generate a global network-level externality. Finally, we analyse informal borrowing and the sensitivity of consumption to income fluctuations. Households unlikely to take up microcredit suffer the greatest loss of informal borrowing and risk sharing, underscoring the global nature of the externality.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，正规金融机构的进入可以对非正规借贷和社会网络产生深远且持久的影响。我们首先研究了印度卡纳塔克邦75个村庄中小额信贷的引入，其中43个村庄接触到了小额信贷。使用双重差分法，我们发现在接触小额信贷的村庄中，网络收缩得更多。此外，那些都不太可能从小额信贷借款的家庭之间的联系，与涉及可能借款人的联系相比，至少同样可能消失。我们在海得拉巴的一项随机对照试验（RCT）背景下复制了这些令人惊讶的发现，该试验中，一家小额信贷机构随机选择了104个社区中的52个首先进入。在所有社区都得到处理四年后，早期进入社区的家庭获得信贷的时间更长，贷款规模也更大。我们再次发现这些社区中家庭之间的社会关系较少，即使在那些事前不太可能借款的家庭中也是如此。由于结果表明存在全局溢出效应，这在通常的网络形成模型中并不典型，我们开发了一个新的动态网络形成模型，强调偶然相遇，其中社交努力产生全局网络层面的外部性。最后，我们分析了非正规借贷和消费对收入波动的敏感性。不太可能采用小额信贷的家庭在非正规借贷和风险分担方面遭受的损失最大，这突显了外部性的全局性质。

records.title_en: The Darwinian Returns to Scale
records.title_cn: 达尔文规模报酬
records.abstract_en: How does an increase in market size, say due to globalization, affect welfare? We study this question using a model with monopolistic competition, heterogeneous markups, and fixed costs. We characterize changes in welfare and decompose changes in allocative efficiency into three different effects: (1) reallocations across firms with heterogeneous price elasticities due to intensifying competition, (2) reallocations due to the exit of marginally profitable firms, and (3) reallocations due to changes in firms’ markups. Whereas the second and third effects have ambiguous implications for welfare, the first effect, which we call the Darwinian effect, always increases welfare regardless of the shape of demand curves. We nonparametrically calibrate demand curves with data from Belgian manufacturing firms and quantify our results. We find that mild increasing returns at the microlevel can catalyze large increasing returns at the macrolevel. Between 70 and 90% of increasing returns to scale come from improvements in how a larger market allocates resources. The lion’s share of these gains are due to the Darwinian effect, which increases the aggregate markup and concentrates sales and employment in high-markup firms. This has implications for policy: an entry subsidy, which harnesses Darwinian reallocations, can improve welfare even when there is more entry than in the first best.
records.abstract_cn: 市场规模扩大（例如由于全球化）如何影响福利？我们使用一个具有垄断竞争、异质性加成和固定成本的模型来研究这个问题。我们刻画了福利变化，并将配置效率的变化分解为三种不同的效应：（1）由于竞争加剧导致的具有异质性价格弹性的企业间的重新配置，（2）由于边际利润企业退出导致的重新配置，以及（3）由于企业加成变化导致的重新配置。第二种和第三种效应对福利的影响是模糊的，而第一种效应（我们称之为达尔文效应）无论需求曲线的形状如何，总是提高福利。我们使用比利时制造业企业的数据对需求曲线进行非参数校准，并量化我们的结果。我们发现，微观层面的温和规模报酬递增可以催化宏观层面的大规模规模报酬递增。在规模报酬递增中，有70到90%%来自于更大市场资源配置的改善。这些收益的绝大部分归因于达尔文效应，该效应提高了总加成，并将销售和就业集中在高加成企业。这对政策有启示：利用达尔文重新配置的进入补贴，即使进入量超过第一最优水平，也能改善福利。

records.title_en: Dynamic Opinion Aggregation: Long-Run Stability and Disagreement
records.title_cn: 动态意见聚合：长期稳定性与分歧
records.abstract_en: This article proposes a model of non-Bayesian social learning in networks that accounts for heuristics and biases in opinion aggregation. The updating rules are represented by non-linear opinion aggregators from which we extract two extreme networks capturing strong and weak links. We provide graph-theoretic conditions for these networks that characterize opinions’ convergence, consensus formation, and efficient or biased information aggregation. Under these updating rules, agents may ignore some of their neighbours’ opinions, reducing the number of effective connections and inducing long-run disagreement for finite populations. For the wisdom of the crowd in large populations, we highlight a trade-off between how connected the society is and the non-linearity of the opinion aggregator. Our framework bridges several models and phenomena in the non-Bayesian social learning literature, thereby providing a unifying approach to the field.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个网络中的非贝叶斯社会学习模型，该模型考虑了意见聚合中的启发式和偏差。更新规则由非线性意见聚合器表示，我们从中提取两个极端网络，分别捕捉强联系和弱联系。我们为这些网络提供了图论条件，这些条件刻画了意见的收敛、共识形成以及有效或有偏的信息聚合。在这些更新规则下，个体可能会忽略其部分邻居的意见，减少有效连接的数量，并在有限群体中引发长期分歧。对于大群体中的群体智慧，我们强调了社会连通性与意见聚合器非线性之间的权衡。我们的框架桥接了非贝叶斯社会学习文献中的多个模型和现象，从而为该领域提供了一种统一的方法。

records.title_en: Trust in Risk Sharing: A Double-Edged Sword
records.title_cn: 风险分担中的信任：一把双刃剑
records.abstract_en: We analyse efficient risk-sharing arrangements when the value from deviating is determined endogenously by another risk-sharing arrangement. Coalitions form to insure against idiosyncratic income risk. Self-enforcing contracts for both the original coalition and any coalition formed (joined) after deviations rely on a belief in future cooperation which we term “trust”. We treat the contracting conditions of original and deviation coalitions symmetrically and show that higher trust tightens incentive constraints since it facilitates the formation of deviating coalitions. As a consequence, although trust facilitates the initial formation of coalitions, the extent of risk sharing in successfully formed coalitions is declining in the extent of trust and efficient allocations might feature resource burning or utility burning: trust is indeed a double-edged sword.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了当偏离的价值由另一风险分担安排内生决定时的有效风险分担安排。联盟形成以抵御特质收入风险。原始联盟和偏离后形成（加入）的任何联盟的自执行契约都依赖于对未来合作的信念，我们称之为“信任”。我们对称地处理原始联盟和偏离联盟的契约条件，并表明更高的信任会收紧激励约束，因为它促进了偏离联盟的形成。因此，尽管信任促进了联盟的初始形成，但成功形成的联盟中风险分担的程度随信任程度的增加而下降，且有效配置可能具有资源消耗或效用消耗的特征：信任确实是一把双刃剑。

records.title_en: Selfish Corporations
records.title_cn: 自私的企业
records.abstract_en: We study how perceptions of corporate responsibility influence policy preferences and the effectiveness of corporate communication when agents have imperfect memory recall. Using a new large-scale survey of U.S. citizens on their support for corporate bailouts, we first establish that the public demands corporations to behave better within society, a sentiment we label “big business discontent.” Using random variation in the order of survey sections and in the exposure to animated videos, we then show that priming respondents to think about corporate responsibility lowers the support for bailouts. This finding suggests that big business discontent influences policy preferences. Furthermore, we find that messages which paint a positive picture of corporate responsibility can “backfire,” as doing so brings attention to an aspect on which the public has negative views. In contrast, reframing corporate bailouts in terms of economic tradeoffs increases support for the policy. We develop a memory-based model of decision-making and communication to rationalize these findings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当代理人记忆不完美时，对企业责任的认知如何影响政策偏好以及企业沟通的有效性。通过对美国公民对企业救助支持度的一项新的大规模调查，我们首先确立了公众要求企业在社会中表现得更好，我们将这种情绪称为“大企业不满”。利用调查部分顺序的随机变化和动画视频曝光的随机变化，我们随后表明，启动受访者思考企业责任会降低对救助的支持。这一发现表明，大企业不满影响政策偏好。此外，我们发现，描绘企业责任积极形象的讯息可能“适得其反”，因为这样做会引发公众对此持负面看法的方面的关注。相比之下，将企业救助重新定义为经济权衡会增加对该政策的支持。我们开发了一个基于记忆的决策和沟通模型来解释这些发现。

records.title_en: Bilateral Trade Imbalances
records.title_cn: 双边贸易失衡
records.abstract_en: If sectoral trade flows obey structural gravity, countries’ bilateral trade imbalances are the result of macro trade imbalances, “triangular trade”, or pairwise asymmetric trade barriers. Using data for 40 major economies and the Rest of the World, we show that large and pervasive asymmetries in trade barriers are required to account for most of the observed variation in bilateral imbalances. A dynamic quantitative trade model suggests that eliminating these asymmetries would significantly reduce bilateral (but not macro) imbalances and have sizeable impacts on welfare. We provide evidence that the asymmetries we measure are in part related to the policy environment: trade inside the European Single Market appears to be subject to more bilaterally symmetric frictions. Extending the same symmetry to all parts of the global economy would give a large boost to the real incomes of several non-E.U. countries.
records.abstract_cn: 如果部门贸易流动遵循结构性引力模型，那么各国的双边贸易失衡是宏观贸易失衡、“三角贸易”或成对不对称贸易壁垒的结果。利用40个主要经济体和世界其他地区的数据，我们表明，需要大规模且普遍存在的贸易壁垒不对称性来解释所观察到的双边失衡的大部分变化。一个动态定量贸易模型表明，消除这些不对称性将显著减少双边（但非宏观）失衡，并对福利产生可观影响。我们提供的证据表明，我们测量的不对称性部分与政策环境有关：欧洲单一市场内部的贸易似乎受到更多双边对称摩擦的影响。将同样的对称性扩展到全球经济的其他部分，将大幅提升多个非欧盟国家的实际收入。

records.title_en: The Effect of Wealth on Worker Productivity
records.title_cn: 财富对工人生产率的影响
records.abstract_en: We propose a theory that analyzes how a workers’ asset holdings affect their job productivity. In a labor market with uninsurable risk, workers choose to direct their job search trading off productivity and wages against unemployment risk. Workers with low asset holdings have a precautionary job search motive, they direct their search to low productivity jobs because those offer a low risk at the cost of low productivity and a low wage. Our main theoretical contribution shows that the presence of consumption smoothing can reconcile the directed search model with negative duration-dependence on wages, a robust empirical regularity that the canonical directed search model cannot rationalize. We calibrate the infinite horizon economy and find this mechanism to be quantitatively important. We evaluate a tax financed unemployment insurance (UI) scheme and analyze how it affects welfare. Aggregate welfare is inverted U-shaped in benefits: the insurance effect UI dominates the incentive effects for low levels of benefits and vice versa for high benefits. In addition, when UI increases, total production falls in the economy while worker productivity increases.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出一个理论，分析工人的资产持有如何影响其工作生产率。在存在不可保险风险的劳动力市场中，工人选择求职方向时，会在生产率与工资之间权衡失业风险。资产持有较低的工人具有预防性求职动机，他们将求职方向转向低生产率工作，因为这些工作以低生产率和低工资为代价提供低风险。我们的主要理论贡献表明，消费平滑的存在可以使定向搜索模型与工资的负持续时间依赖性相协调，这是典型定向搜索模型无法解释的一个稳健的经验规律。我们校准了无限期界经济，并发现这一机制在数量上很重要。我们评估了一项税收融资的失业保险（UI）计划，并分析其如何影响福利。总体福利在福利水平上呈倒U形：保险效应UI在低福利水平上主导激励效应，反之在高福利水平上激励效应主导。此外，当UI增加时，经济中的总产出下降，而工人生产率上升。

records.title_en: The Slaughter of the Bison and Reversal of Fortunes on the Great Plains
records.title_cn: 野牛大屠杀与大平原上命运的逆转
records.abstract_en: In the late nineteenth century, the North American bison was brought to the brink of extinction in less than two decades. We demonstrate that the loss of the bison had immediate, negative consequences for the Native Americans who relied on them and ultimately resulted in a persistent reversal of fortunes. Once amongst the tallest people in the world, the generations of bison-reliant people born after the slaughter lost their entire height advantage. By the early twentieth century, child mortality was 16 percentage points higher and the probability of reporting an occupation 19 percentage points lower in bison nations compared with nations that were never reliant on the bison. Throughout the latter half of the twentieth century and into the present, income per capita has remained 25% lower, on average, for bison nations. This persistent gap cannot be explained by differences in agricultural productivity, self-governance, or application of the Dawes Act. We provide evidence that this historical shock altered the dynamic path of development for formerly bison-reliant nations. We demonstrate that limited access to credit constrained the ability of bison nations to adjust through re-specialization and migration.
records.abstract_cn: 在十九世纪末，北美野牛在不到二十年的时间里濒临灭绝。我们证明，野牛的消失对依赖它们的原住民立即产生了负面影响，并最终导致了命运的持续逆转。曾经是世界上最高的人群之一，屠杀后出生的依赖野牛的几代人完全失去了他们的身高优势。到二十世纪初，与从未依赖野牛的部落相比，野牛部落的儿童死亡率高出16个百分点，报告职业的概率低19个百分点。在整个二十世纪下半叶及至今，野牛部落的人均收入平均仍低25%。这一持续差距无法用农业生产率、自治或道斯法案的实施差异来解释。我们提供的证据表明，这一历史冲击改变了原先依赖野牛部落的发展动态路径。我们证明，有限的信贷获取渠道限制了野牛部落通过重新专业化和迁移进行调整的能力。

records.title_en: How Responsive Are Wages to Firm-Specific Changes in Labour Demand? Evidence from Idiosyncratic Export Demand Shocks
records.title_cn: 工资对企业特定劳动力需求变化的反应有多灵敏？来自特质性出口需求冲击的证据
records.abstract_en: Do firms adjust wages in response to changes in their own demand level or to changes in competitive pressure from rival employers? We study how exporters adjust wages in response to unexpected product demand shocks during the 2008–9 Great Recession. Using rich data on Portuguese firms’ pre-recession export shipments, we measure firm-level shocks to export demand during the Recession. We show that shocks constructed at the firm level are not necessarily firm-specific and can be decomposed into a common component affecting all producers in a product market and an idiosyncratic component affecting individual firms within markets based on the locations of their pre-recession customers. We demonstrate that while both components impact firms’ output and their workers’ wages, the common component spills over from firms to their labour market rivals, whereas the idiosyncratic component does not. We find that 10–15% of firms’ idiosyncratic demand passes through to their employees’ wage growth with no effect on retention rates, implying significant dependence of wages on noncompetitive quasi-rents. Moreover, we find that wages respond primarily to shifts in internal labour demand when labour markets are thin, but they respond more to competition from other employers when labour markets are fluid. These results indicate that employers’ ability to set wages hinges on the underlying competitiveness of the labour market.
records.abstract_cn: 企业是否会根据自身需求水平的变化或竞争对手雇主竞争压力的变化来调整工资？我们研究了出口企业在2008-9年大衰退期间如何应对意外的产品需求冲击调整工资。利用葡萄牙企业在衰退前出口发货的丰富数据，我们衡量了衰退期间企业层面的出口需求冲击。我们表明，在企业层面构建的冲击不一定具有企业特定性，可以分解为一个影响产品市场中所有生产者的共同成分和一个基于衰退前客户位置影响市场内个别企业的特质性成分。我们证明，虽然这两种成分都会影响企业的产出及其工人的工资，但共同成分会从企业溢出到其劳动力市场竞争对手，而特质性成分则不会。我们发现，企业特质性需求的10-15%会传导至其员工的工资增长，且对留存率没有影响，这意味着工资在很大程度上依赖于非竞争性准租金。此外，我们发现，当劳动力市场薄弱时，工资主要对内部劳动力需求的变化做出反应，但当劳动力市场流动性强时，工资更多地受到其他雇主竞争的影响。这些结果表明，雇主设定工资的能力取决于劳动力市场的潜在竞争性。

records.title_en: Experimentation in Endogenous Organizations
records.title_cn: 内生组织中的实验
records.abstract_en: We study policy experimentation in organizations with endogenous membership. An organization decides when to stop a policy experiment based on its results. As information arrives, agents update their beliefs, and enter or leave the organization based on their expected flow payoffs. Unsuccessful experiments make all agents more pessimistic, but also drive out conservative members. We identify sufficient conditions under which the latter effect dominates, leading to excessive experimentation. In fact, the organization may experiment forever in the face of mounting negative evidence. Ex post heterogeneous payoffs exacerbate the problem, as optimists can join forces with guaranteed winners. Control by shareholders who own all future payoffs, however, can have a corrective effect. Our results contrast with models of collective experimentation with fixed membership, in which under-experimentation is the typical outcome.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有内生成员资格的组织中的政策实验。组织根据实验结果决定何时停止政策实验。随着信息的到来，代理人更新他们的信念，并根据他们的预期流动收益进入或离开组织。不成功的实验使所有代理人更加悲观，但也驱走了保守成员。我们确定了后一种效应占主导地位的充分条件，导致过度实验。事实上，面对越来越多的负面证据，组织可能会永远实验下去。事后异质性收益加剧了这一问题，因为乐观主义者可以与有保证的赢家联合。然而，由拥有所有未来收益的股东控制可以产生纠正效应。我们的结果与固定成员资格的集体实验模型形成对比，在那些模型中，实验不足是典型的结果。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous Paths of Industrialization
records.title_cn: 工业化的异质性路径
records.abstract_en: Industrialization experiences differ substantially across countries. We use a benchmark model of structural change to shed light on the sources of this heterogeneity and, in particular, the phenomenon of premature deindustrialization. Our analysis leads to three key findings. First, benchmark models of structural change robustly generate hump-shaped patterns for the evolution of the industrial sector. Second, heterogeneous patterns of catch-up in sectoral productivities across countries can generate variation in industrialization experiences similar to those found in the data, including premature deindustrialization. Third, differences in the rate of agricultural productivity growth across economies can account for the majority of the variation in peak industrial employment shares.
records.abstract_cn: 各国的工业化经验存在显著差异。我们使用一个结构变迁的基准模型来阐明这种异质性的来源，特别是过早去工业化现象。我们的分析得出三个关键发现。首先，结构变迁的基准模型稳健地生成工业部门演变的驼峰形模式。其次，各国部门生产率追赶的异质性模式可以产生与数据中发现的相似的工业化经验差异，包括过早去工业化。第三，各经济体农业生产率增长率的差异可以解释峰值工业就业份额变化的大部分。

records.title_en: Memory and Markets
records.title_cn: 记忆与市场
records.abstract_en: In many environments, including credit and online markets, records about participants are collected, published, and erased after some time. We study the effects of erasing past records in a dynamic market where the quality of sellers follows a Markov process, and buyers leave feedback about sellers to an information intermediary.
