This stresses the need of going from “one size fits all” policies to policies that better adapted to different investor characteristics. To meet the urgent need to accelerate the diffusion of RETs, our results show the impact of investor heterogeneity on policy responsiveness and provide avenues for the design of targeted policies.
records.abstract_cn: 在过去十年中，为增加太阳能光伏（PV）投资，设立了不同的经济激励措施。尽管研究表明可再生能源电力技术（RET）的投资者具有异质性，但政策在设计补贴计划时并未考虑这一点。本文旨在分析政策激励对不同投资者群体（包括家庭、公司、协会和公共组织）投资光伏系统意愿的影响。利用2009年至2021年间瑞典光伏资本补贴计划所有申请数据，我们分析了补贴水平对投资随时间的影响。我们的分析表明，补贴对家庭和私营公司作为投资者群体具有显著的正向影响。然而，我们也发现其他变量对不同投资者群体的投资意愿产生了显著的正向或负向影响。这强调了从“一刀切”政策转向更适应不同投资者特征的政策必要性。为满足加速RET扩散的迫切需求，我们的结果显示了投资者异质性对政策响应的影响，并为设计针对性政策提供了途径。

records.title_en: The pathway to curb greenwashing in sustainable growth: The role of artificial intelligence
records.title_cn: 遏制可持续增长中漂绿行为的路径：人工智能的作用
records.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) can improve production efficiency and general quality of life through assisting human labor, potentially leading to the conversion of employment types, enhancing industrialization, and upgrading energy structure. This paper enriches the role of AI in improving sustainable growth by curbing hypocritical sustainable and greenwashing behaviors. By accessing the panel data from Chinese listed-firms for the period 2014–2021, we have shown that AI can significantly mitigate the existence of greenwashing behaviors by raising the disclosure quality of ESG rating scores. Moreover, the role of AI in mitigating greenwashing behaviors performs significantly in SOEs, less pollution-intensive industries, high environmental regulation and less developed green finance regions. Furthermore, the potential mechanisms of AI in mitigating greenwashing behaviors are displayed, including alleviating financial constraints, easing management cost, improving green innovations.
records.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）可以通过协助人类劳动来提高生产效率和总体生活质量，可能导致就业类型的转换、工业化的增强以及能源结构的升级。本文通过遏制虚伪的可持续行为和漂绿行为，丰富了人工智能在改善可持续增长中的作用。通过获取2014-2021年期间中国上市公司的面板数据，我们表明，人工智能可以通过提高ESG评级分数的披露质量来显著减少漂绿行为的存在。此外，人工智能在减少漂绿行为中的作用在国有企业、污染密集型较低的行业、环境监管严格的地区和绿色金融发展较不发达的地区表现显著。进一步地，本文展示了人工智能减少漂绿行为的潜在机制，包括缓解融资约束、降低管理成本、改善绿色创新。

records.title_en: The macroeconomic costs of energy policies: Quasi-fiscal deficit in the Middle East and North Africa
records.title_cn: 能源政策的宏观经济成本：中东和北非的准财政赤字
records.abstract_en: The annual electricity investments needed in the Middle East and North Africa region to keep up with demand have been estimated at about 3% of the region's projected gross domestic product. However, in most economies of the region, the ability to make those investments is limited by fiscal and macroeconomic constraints. This paper demonstrates that by improving the management and performance of the region's utilities, more than enough resources could be freed up in most economies of the region to finance the investments needed. These resources represent what is known as the quasi-fiscal deficit (QFD) associated with the management of the electricity sector in policy discussions. The paper presents the first evaluation of its size and composition in 14 economies of the region. Based on 2013 data, the average QFD is estimated at 4.3% of gross domestic product (GDP). It is lower than 3% for only four economies. For most, its main driver is the underpricing of electricity, which costs on average 3.3% of GDP. Commercial inefficiency comes next, at an average cost of 0.6% of GDP. Technical and labor inefficiencies represent, respectively, 0.5 and 0.2% of GDP.
records.abstract_cn: 中东和北非地区为满足电力需求所需的年度电力投资估计约占该地区预计国内生产总值的3%。然而，在该地区大多数经济体中，进行这些投资的能力受到财政和宏观经济约束的限制。本文表明，通过改善该地区公用事业的管理和绩效，大多数经济体可以释放出足够的资源来资助所需的投资。这些资源代表了政策讨论中与电力部门管理相关的所谓准财政赤字（QFD）。本文首次评估了该地区14个经济体中准财政赤字的规模和构成。基于2013年的数据，平均准财政赤字估计为国内生产总值（GDP）的4.3%。只有四个经济体的准财政赤字低于3%。对于大多数经济体而言，其主要驱动因素是电力定价过低，平均占GDP的3.3%。商业低效次之，平均占GDP的0.6%。技术和劳动力低效分别占GDP的0.5和0.2%。

records.title_en: Energy imports and manufacturing exports with successive oligopolies and storage
records.title_cn: 能源进口与制造业出口：连续寡头垄断与存储视角
records.abstract_en: Many industrial countries run a “business model” that is based on oligopolistic export industries which strongly depend on energy imports. This paper uses an analytically tractable general equilibrium model of international trade with successive oligopolies and storage to analyze optimum trade and industrial policies for such countries. There can be over-investment in storage for strategic reasons. Despite double marginalization, there is a non-zero optimum level of market concentration for the domestic industry. The optimum import tariff is most likely positive. Subsidies to storage and reduced use of long term contracts usually raise domestic welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 许多工业国家运行着一种基于寡头垄断出口产业且严重依赖能源进口的“商业模式”。本文使用一个具有连续寡头垄断和存储的可解析处理的国际贸易一般均衡模型，来分析此类国家的最优贸易和产业政策。出于战略原因，存储可能存在过度投资。尽管存在双重边际化，国内产业仍存在非零的最优市场集中度。最优进口关税极有可能为正。对存储的补贴以及减少长期合同的使用通常会提高国内福利。

records.title_en: Assessing the impact of environmental regulation on enterprise high-quality development in China: A two-tier stochastic frontier model
records.title_cn: 评估环境规制对中国企业高质量发展的影响：两层随机前沿模型
records.abstract_en: With the heightened concern of environmental sustainability, the relationship between environmental regulations and enterprise high-quality development(HQD) has become increasingly intertwined. However, the specific impact of environmental regulation on enterprise HQD remains unclear. Based on the panel data of A-share listed manufacturing companies in China from 2010 to 2020, this study constructs a two-tier stochastic frontier model to measure the bilateral effects of environmental regulation on enterprise HQD. The empirical results indicate the following: 1. The positive effect of environmental regulation makes the HQD of enterprises 54.995% higher than the frontier level, while its negative effect results in HQD being 16.215% lower than the frontier level. 2. The net effect of environmental regulation on enterprise HQD is positive over time, and it overall displays a W-shaped fluctuating downward trend. 3. Heterogeneity analysis, categorized by various criteria, shows that enterprises that are in non-heavily polluting industries, audited by listed accounting firms, state-owned enterprises, with higher investor attention, and in regions with lower intensity of environmental regulation, experience a greater net positive effect from environmental regulation. Policy implications are discussed to enhance the effectiveness of environmental regulation and high-quality development of enterprise
records.abstract_cn: 随着人们对环境可持续发展的高度关注，环境法规与企业高质量发展（HQD）的关系日益紧密。但环境规制对企业总部的具体影响尚不清楚。本研究基于2010至2020我国A股制造业上市公司的面板数据，构建了两层随机前沿模型来衡量环境规制对企业总部发展的双边效应。实证结果表明：1。环境规制的正效应使企业的HQD54.54.995%高于前沿水平，而其负效应则导致企业的HQD16.16.215%低于前沿水平。 2。环境规制对企业总部质量的净效应随时间推移呈正向，总体呈W型波动下降趋势。 3。不同标准的异质性分析显示，上市会计师事务所审计的非重污染行业企业、投资者关注度较高的国有企业以及环境监管强度较低的地区，环境监管的净正效应更大。探讨增强环境监管有效性和企业高质量发展的政策含义

records.title_en: ESG investment and bank efficiency: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: ESG投资与银行效率：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Although environmental, social, and governance (ESG) investment is essential to achieving sustainable development, previous studies usually focused on the relation between ESG investment and non-financial firms but neglected its impact on bank efficiency. To fill this research gap, we use a stochastic frontier analysis (SFA) model to investigate the influence of ESG investment on banks' profit efficiency and to explore whether financial technology (fintech) can strengthen the relationship between them. Results show that increasing ESG investment is beneficial to bank efficiency. We also find structural differences in the influence of ESG investment on bank efficiency. Specifically, environmental (E) and governance (G) investments enhance bank efficiency, while social (S) variables reduce bank efficiency. In addition, fintech has a moderating effect. When the level of fintech is high, ESG investment rises, and the increase in bank efficiency is more significant. Finally, by conducting a time-varying analysis of bank efficiency, we find that banks with higher ESG investments are more efficient. Under the goal of sustainable development, strengthening ESG investment and focusing on the empowering role of fintech are essential ways for commercial banks to increase efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管环境、社会和治理（ESG）投资对于实现可持续发展至关重要，但以往研究通常关注ESG投资与非金融企业之间的关系，而忽视了其对银行效率的影响。为填补这一研究空白，我们使用随机前沿分析（SFA）模型来考察ESG投资对银行利润效率的影响，并探讨金融科技（fintech）能否强化二者之间的关系。结果表明，增加ESG投资有利于提升银行效率。我们还发现ESG投资对银行效率的影响存在结构性差异。具体而言，环境（E）和治理（G）投资提升了银行效率，而社会（S）变量则降低了银行效率。此外，金融科技具有调节作用。当金融科技水平较高时，ESG投资增加，银行效率的提升更为显著。最后，通过对银行效率进行时变分析，我们发现ESG投资较高的银行效率更高。在可持续发展目标下，加强ESG投资并重视金融科技的赋能作用，是商业银行提升效率的重要途径。

records.title_en: Social media sentiment of hydrogen fuel cell vehicles in China: Evidence from artificial intelligence algorithms
records.title_cn: 中国氢燃料电池汽车社交媒体情绪：来自人工智能算法的证据
records.abstract_en: Hydrogen energy is significant in the energy consumption, especially in Hydrogen Fuel Cell Vehicles(HFCVs) market. Social media data is critical for exploring public perceptions of HFCVs. To find hot topics and understand the public sentiment of HFCVs, we employ a computational model, which combines Kmeans algorithm, Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), and SnowNLP. The training data consists of 42,063 comments sourced from Bilibili-a popular Chinese social media platform. The analysis has identified 12 clusters, each with distinct topics and sentiments. The results reveal that the Chinese public generally holds a neutral stance on the hydrogen energy market, while some stakeholders maintain a positive on the technology and development of HFCVs, but some concerns about the transportation and safety of hydrogen fuel. Furthermore, this study offers suggestions for the technological, operational, and strategic advancement of HFCVs.
records.abstract_cn: 氢能在能源消费中具有重要意义，尤其是在氢燃料电池汽车（HFCVs）市场。社交媒体数据对于探索公众对HFCVs的看法至关重要。为了发现热门话题并了解公众对HFCVs的情绪，我们采用了一种计算模型，该模型结合了Kmeans算法、潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）和SnowNLP。训练数据包括来自Bilibili（一个受欢迎的中国社交媒体平台）的42,063条评论。分析识别出12个聚类，每个聚类具有不同的主题和情绪。结果表明，中国公众普遍对氢能源市场持中立态度，而一些利益相关者对HFCVs的技术和发展持积极态度，但对氢燃料的运输和安全性存在一些担忧。此外，本研究为HFCVs的技术、运营和战略发展提供了建议。

records.title_en: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Market Power and Wage Inequality
records.title_cn: Walras-Bowley讲座：市场势力与工资不平等
records.abstract_en: We propose a theory of how market power affects wage inequality. We ask how goods and labor market power jointly determine the level of wages, the skill premium, and wage inequality. We then use detailed microdata from the U.S. Census Bureau between 1997 and 2016 to estimate the parameters of labor supply, technology, and the market structure. We find that a less competitive market structure lowers the average wage of high‐skilled workers by 11.3%, and of low‐skilled workers by 12.2%, contributes 8.1% to the rise in the skill premium, and accounts for 54.8% of the increase in between‐establishment wage variance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出一个关于市场势力如何影响工资不平等的理论。我们探讨商品和劳动力市场势力如何共同决定工资水平、技能溢价和工资不平等。然后，我们使用美国人口普查局1997年至2016年间的详细微观数据来估计劳动力供给、技术和市场结构的参数。我们发现，竞争性较弱的市场结构使高技能工人的平均工资降低11.3%，低技能工人的平均工资降低12.2%，对技能溢价的上升贡献了8.1%，并解释了54.8%的机构间工资方差增加。

records.title_en: A Comment on: “Walras–Bowley Lecture: Market Power and Wage Inequality” by Shubhdeep Deb, Jan Eeckhout, Aseem Patel, and Lawrence Warren
records.title_cn: 对Shubhdeep Deb、Jan Eeckhout、Aseem Patel和Lawrence Warren所著《Walras–Bowley讲座：市场势力与工资不平等》的评论

records.title_en: A Comment on: “Walras–Bowley Lecture: Market Power and Wage Inequality” by Shubhdeep Deb, Jan Eeckhout, Aseem Patel, and Lawrence Warren
records.title_cn: 评论：《瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：市场势力与工资不平等》作者：舒布迪普·德布、扬·埃克豪特、阿西姆·帕特尔和劳伦斯·沃伦
records.abstract_en: A burgeoning literature in labor economics is focused on modeling employer labor market power, generally finding nontrivial estimates of monopsony power. A smaller literature also simultaneously incorporates product market power. Deb, Eeckhout, Patel, and Warren (2024) is an example of applying an oligopoly‐oligopsony model to the U.S. labor market, arguing for important effects on wage levels and inequality from rising market power. I support combining IO and labor as a fruitful way of studying wages and business dynamism, but argue for looking more broadly at (i) differential degrees of employer power in labor and product markets; (ii) investigating the dynamic sources of markups (e.g., through innovation), and (iii) considering wage bargaining models, not just wage posting models, which have some starkly different implications for wage setting.
records.abstract_cn: 劳动经济学中一个新兴的文献侧重于建模雇主劳动力市场势力，通常发现对垄断势力的非平凡估计。一个较小的文献也同时纳入了产品市场势力。德布、埃克豪特、帕特尔和沃伦（2024）是将寡头垄断-寡头垄断模型应用于美国劳动力市场的一个例子，认为市场势力的上升对工资水平和不平等产生了重要影响。我支持将产业组织与劳动相结合作为研究工资和企业活力的有效途径，但主张更广泛地审视（i）劳动力和产品市场中雇主势力的差异程度；（ii）研究加价的动态来源（例如，通过创新）；以及（iii）考虑工资谈判模型，而不仅仅是工资公告模型，后者对工资设定有一些截然不同的含义。

records.title_en: Reply to: Comments on “Walras–Bowley Lecture: Market Power and Wage Inequality”
records.title_cn: 回复：对“瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：市场势力与工资不平等”的评论
records.abstract_en: Census Bureau VIOLANTE (2023) AND VAN REENEN (2023) offer a comprehensive review of the lecture and point out the key aspects of the paper.We are grateful for their comments which have greatly improved this research.Our goals in this paper are twofold: (a) to provide a methodological framework that jointly incorporates goods market power (oligopoly) and labor market power (oligopsony) in a general equilibrium setting, and (b) to propose an empirical strategy for applying such a framework to microdata to estimate key structural parameters and a joint distribution of establishment-level productivity.Combined, these features allow us to quantify the relative importance of technological change and changes in market structure on the labor market, in particular on the evolution of wages, wage stagnation, and wage inequality.The main insight of our model is that market power and wage inequality are both endogenous objects, determined simultaneously in equilibrium by (1) the market structure (the number of competing firms); (2) the dispersion of establishment-level productivity; and (3) the substitutability parameters in the product and labor markets.We find that a change in the market structure (excluding changes in the dispersion of productivity and within-and between-market substitutability parameters) accounts for 8.1% of the rise in the skill premium, and 54.8% of the increase in between-establishment inequality.Our analysis also establishes that technology is indeed the main driver of wage inequality, whereas the decline in competition is behind the increasing gap between wages and productivity.Both commentators rightly point out that our assumption of perfectly overlapping boundaries between product and labor markets is strong.We agree, and nonetheless maintain this simplifying assumption for two reasons.The first is for computational tractability, as allowing for non-overlapping boundaries greatly increases the dimensionality of the system of equations needed to compute the economy's equilibrium. 1 Second, we es-
records.abstract_cn: 人口普查局维奥兰特（2023）和范里宁（2023）对讲座进行了全面回顾，并指出了论文的关键方面。我们感谢他们的评论，这些评论极大地改进了这项研究。本文的目标有两个：（a）提供一个方法论框架，在一般均衡设定中共同纳入商品市场势力（寡头垄断）和劳动力市场势力（寡头 monopsony）；（b）提出一种实证策略，将该框架应用于微观数据，以估计关键结构参数和企业层面生产率的联合分布。综合这些特征，我们能够量化技术变革和市场结构变化对劳动力市场的相对重要性，特别是对工资演变、工资停滞和工资不平等的影响。我们模型的主要见解是，市场势力和工资不平等都是内生对象，在均衡中由（1）市场结构（竞争企业数量）；（2）企业层面生产率的离散程度；以及（3）产品和劳动力市场中的替代参数同时决定。我们发现，市场结构的变化（不包括生产率离散程度以及市场内和市场间替代参数的变化）解释了技能溢价上升的8.1%，以及企业间不平等增加的54.8%。我们的分析还表明，技术确实是工资不平等的主要驱动因素，而竞争下降则是工资与生产率之间差距扩大的背后原因。两位评论者正确指出，我们关于产品和劳动力市场边界完全重叠的假设是强有力的。我们同意，但出于两个原因仍维持这一简化假设。第一个是为了计算的可处理性，因为允许非重叠边界会大大增加计算经济均衡所需方程组的维度。1 第二，我们……

records.title_en: Certification Design With Common Values
records.title_cn: 共同价值下的认证设计
records.abstract_en: This paper studies certification design and its implications for information disclosure. Our model features a profit‐maximizing certifier and the seller of a good of unknown quality. We allow for common values as the seller's opportunity cost may depend on the quality of the good. We compare certifier‐optimal with transparency‐maximizing certification design. Certifier‐optimal certification design implements the evidence structure of Dye (1985)—a fraction of sellers acquire information while the remaining sellers are uninformed—and results in partial disclosure to the market. A transparency‐maximizing regulator prefers a less precise signal, which conveys more information to the market through a higher rate of certification and unraveling (Grossman (1981), Milgrom (1981)) at the disclosure stage.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究认证设计及其对信息披露的影响。我们的模型以一个追求利润最大化的认证机构和一位销售质量未知商品的卖方为特征。我们允许共同价值的存在，因为卖方的机会成本可能取决于商品的质量。我们比较了认证机构最优与透明度最大化的认证设计。认证机构最优的认证设计实现了Dye（1985）的证据结构——一部分卖方获取信息，而其余卖方不获取信息——并导致市场部分披露。透明度最大化的监管者偏好一个不那么精确的信号，该信号通过更高的认证率和披露阶段的揭穿效应（Grossman（1981），Milgrom（1981））向市场传递更多信息。

records.title_en: Bias‐Aware Inference in Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity Designs
records.title_cn: 模糊回归不连续设计中的偏差感知推断
records.abstract_en: We propose new confidence sets (CSs) for the regression discontinuity parameter in fuzzy designs. Our CSs are based on local linear regression, and are bias‐aware, in the sense that they take possible bias explicitly into account. Their construction shares similarities with that of Anderson–Rubin CSs in exactly identified instrumental variable models, and thereby avoids issues with “delta method” approximations that underlie most commonly used existing inference methods for fuzzy regression discontinuity analysis. Our CSs are asymptotically equivalent to existing procedures in canonical settings with strong identification and a continuous running variable. However, they are also valid under a wide range of other empirically relevant conditions, such as setups with discrete running variables, donut designs, and weak identification.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为模糊设计中的回归不连续参数提出了新的置信集（CSs）。我们的置信集基于局部线性回归，并且是偏差感知的，即它们明确考虑了可能的偏差。它们的构造与恰好识别工具变量模型中的Anderson–Rubin置信集有相似之处，从而避免了模糊回归不连续分析中大多数常用现有推断方法所依赖的“德尔塔方法”近似的问题。在具有强识别和连续运行变量的典型设置中，我们的置信集与现有程序渐近等价。然而，它们在一系列其他经验相关条件下也有效，例如具有离散运行变量、甜甜圈设计和弱识别的设置。

records.title_en: A Demand Curve for Disaster Recovery Loans
records.title_cn: 灾难恢复贷款的需求曲线
records.abstract_en: We estimate and trace a credit demand curve for households that recently experienced damage to their homes from a natural disaster. Our administrative data include over one million applicants to a federal recovery loan program for households. We estimate extensive‐margin demand over a large range of interest rates. Our identification strategy exploits 24 natural experiments, leveraging exogenous, time‐based variation in the program's offered interest rate. Interest rates meaningfully affect consumer demand throughout the distribution of rates. On average, a 1 percentage point increase in the interest rate reduces loan take‐up by 26%. We find a large impact of applicants' credit quality on demand and evidence of monthly payment targeting. Using our estimated demand curve and information on program costs, we find that the program generates an average social surplus of $2900 per borrower.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计并描绘了近期遭受自然灾害房屋损坏的家庭的信贷需求曲线。我们的行政数据包括超过一百万个联邦恢复贷款计划的家庭申请者。我们在广泛的利率范围内估计了广延边际需求。我们的识别策略利用24个自然实验，利用该计划提供的利率的外生、基于时间的变化。利率在整个利率分布中显著影响消费者需求。平均而言，利率每增加1个百分点，贷款接受率降低26%。我们发现申请人的信用质量对需求有重大影响，并存在月度还款目标瞄准的证据。利用我们估计的需求曲线和项目成本信息，我们发现该计划平均每个借款人产生2900美元的社会盈余。

records.title_en: Identification and Estimation in Many‐to‐One Two‐Sided Matching Without Transfers
records.title_cn: 无转移多对一双边匹配中的识别与估计
records.abstract_en: In a setting of many‐to‐one two‐sided matching with nontransferable utilities, for example, college admissions, we study conditions under which preferences of both sides are identified with data on one single market. Regardless of whether the market is centralized or decentralized, assuming that the observed matching is stable, we show nonparametric identification of preferences of both sides under certain exclusion restrictions. To take our results to the data, we use Monte Carlo simulations to evaluate different estimators, including the ones that are directly constructed from the identification. We find that a parametric Bayesian approach with a Gibbs sampler works well in realistically sized problems. Finally, we illustrate our methodology in decentralized admissions to public and private schools in Chile and conduct a counterfactual analysis of an affirmative action policy.
records.abstract_cn: 在不可转移效用的多对一双边匹配环境中，例如大学招生，我们研究了在单一市场数据下双方偏好可被识别的条件。无论市场是集中还是分散，假设观察到的匹配是稳定的，我们在某些排除限制下证明了双方偏好的非参数识别。为了将我们的结果应用于数据，我们使用蒙特卡洛模拟来评估不同的估计量，包括直接从识别中构建的估计量。我们发现，带有吉布斯采样的参数贝叶斯方法在现实规模的问题中表现良好。最后，我们在智利公立和私立学校的分散招生中展示了我们的方法，并对一项平权政策进行了反事实分析。

records.title_en: Implementation via Information Design in Binary‐Action Supermodular Games
records.title_cn: 二元行动超模博弈中通过信息设计实施
records.abstract_en: What outcomes can be implemented by the choice of an information structure in binary‐action supermodular games? An outcome is partially implementable if it satisfies obedience (Bergemann and Morris (2016)). We characterize when an outcome is smallest equilibrium implementable (induced by the smallest equilibrium). Smallest equilibrium implementation requires a stronger sequential obedience condition: there is a stochastic ordering of players under which players are prepared to switch to the high action even if they think only those before them will switch. We then characterize the optimal outcome induced by an information designer who prefers the high action to be played, but anticipates that the worst (hence smallest) equilibrium will be played. In a potential game, under convexity assumptions on the potential and the designer's objective, it is optimal to choose an outcome where actions are perfectly coordinated (all players choose the same action), with the high action profile played on the largest event where that action profile maximizes the average potential.
records.abstract_cn: 在二元行动超模博弈中，通过选择信息结构可以实施哪些结果？如果一个结果满足服从性（Bergemann和Morris（2016）），则它是部分可实施的。我们刻画了何时一个结果是最小均衡可实施的（由最小均衡诱导）。最小均衡实施需要一个更强的序贯服从条件：存在一个玩家的随机排序，在该排序下，即使玩家认为只有排在他们前面的人会转向高行动，他们也准备转向高行动。然后，我们刻画了偏好高行动被采取但预期最坏（因此最小）均衡将被采取的信息设计者的最优结果。在一个势博弈中，在势函数和设计者目标的凸性假设下，最优选择是选择一个行动完全协调（所有玩家选择相同行动）的结果，其中高行动组合在最大化平均势的最大事件上被采取。

records.title_en: Setbacks, Shutdowns, and Overruns
records.title_cn: 挫折、停工与超支
records.abstract_en: We investigate optimal project management in a setting plagued by an indefinite number of setbacks that are discovered en route to project completion. The contractor can cover up delays in progress due to shirking either by making false claims of setbacks or by postponing the reports of real ones. The sponsor optimally induces work and honest reporting via a soft deadline and a reward for completion that specifies a bonus for early delivery. Late‐stage setbacks trigger randomization between minimally feasible project extension and (inefficient) cancellation. Because extensions may be granted repeatedly, arbitrarily large overruns in schedule and budget are possible after which the project may still be canceled.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在项目完成过程中发现无限数量挫折的环境下的最优项目管理。承包商可以通过虚假声称挫折或推迟报告真实挫折来掩盖因偷懒导致的进度延误。委托人通过软截止日期和规定提前交付奖金的完成奖励来最优地诱导工作和诚实报告。后期挫折会触发在最小可行项目延期和（低效）取消之间的随机化。由于延期可能被反复批准，进度和预算可能出现任意大的超支，之后项目仍可能被取消。

records.title_en: Equilibrium Grading Policies With Implications for Female Interest in STEM Courses
records.title_cn: 均衡评分政策及其对女性STEM课程兴趣的影响
records.abstract_en: We show that stricter grading policies in STEM courses reduce STEM enrollment, especially for women. We estimate a model of student demand for courses and optimal effort choices given professor grading policies. Grading policies are treated as equilibrium objects that in part depend on student demand for courses. Differences in demand for STEM and non‐STEM courses explain much of why STEM classes give lower grades. Restrictions on grading policies that equalize average grades across classes reduce the STEM gender gap and increase overall enrollment in STEM classes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，STEM课程中更严格的评分政策会降低STEM课程的注册率，尤其是对女性而言。我们估计了一个学生课程需求模型以及在给定教授评分政策下的最优努力选择模型。评分政策被视为均衡对象，部分取决于学生对课程的需求。对STEM和非STEM课程需求的差异在很大程度上解释了为什么STEM课程给出的分数较低。对评分政策的限制，使各课程的平均分数相等，缩小了STEM领域的性别差距，并增加了STEM课程的总体注册率。

records.title_en: Endogenous Information and Simplifying Insurance Choice
records.title_cn: 内生信息与简化保险选择
records.abstract_en: In markets with complicated products, individuals may choose how much time and effort to spend understanding and comparing alternatives. Focusing on insurance choice, we find evidence consistent with individuals acquiring more information when there are larger consequences from making an uninformed choice. Building on the rational inattention literature, we develop and estimate a parsimonious demand model in which individuals choose how much to research difficult‐to‐observe characteristics. We use our estimates to evaluate policies that simplify choice. Reducing the number of plans can raise welfare through improved choice as well as savings in information costs. Capping out‐of‐pocket costs generates larger welfare gains than standard models. The empirical model can be applied to other settings to examine the regulation of complex products.
records.abstract_cn: 在复杂产品的市场中，个体可能选择花费多少时间和精力来理解和比较替代品。聚焦于保险选择，我们发现证据与个体在未被告知选择后果更大时获取更多信息的行为一致。基于理性疏忽文献，我们开发并估计了一个简约的需求模型，其中个体选择研究难以观察特征的程度。我们利用估计结果评估简化选择的政策。减少计划数量可以通过改善选择以及节省信息成本来提高福利。设定自付费用上限比标准模型产生更大的福利收益。该实证模型可应用于其他情境，以检验复杂产品的监管。

records.title_en: A Comment on: “A Modern Gauss–Markov Theorem”
records.title_cn: 对《现代高斯-马尔可夫定理》的评论
records.abstract_en: We show that Theorem 4 in Hansen (2022) applies to exactly the same class of estimators as does the classical Aitken theorem. We furthermore point out that Theorems 5–7 in Hansen (2022) contain extra assumptions not present in the classical Gauss–Markov or Aitken theorem, and thus the former theorems do not contain the latter ones as special cases.
records.abstract_cn: 我们证明Hansen（2022）中的定理4适用于与经典艾特肯定理完全相同的估计量类别。我们进一步指出，Hansen（2022）中的定理5-7包含了经典高斯-马尔可夫或艾特肯定理中不存在的额外假设，因此前者定理并不包含后者作为特例。

records.title_en: Reply to: Comment on “A Modern Gauss–Markov Theorem”
records.title_cn: 回复：关于“现代高斯-马尔可夫定理”的评论
records.abstract_en: This note makes a brief response to Portnoy (2022) and Pötscher and Preinerstorfer (2024), and discusses what instructors should teach about best unbiased estimation.
records.abstract_cn: 本注释对Portnoy（2022）和Pötscher与Preinerstorfer（2024）作出简要回应，并讨论教师在最佳无偏估计方面应教授的内容。

records.title_en: Structural identification of weather impacts on crop yields: Disentangling agronomic from adaptation effects
records.title_cn: 天气对作物产量影响的结构性识别：区分农艺效应与适应效应
records.abstract_en: A large literature has assessed the impacts of climate change on agricultural production by estimating reduced‐form models of crop yields conditionally on weather and individual fixed effects. The estimates obtained are usually interpreted as the weather impacts on yields once farmers have adapted . Yet, few attempts have documented that farmers do adapt to weather, and none have verified that these adjustments actually impact crop yields. Our objective here is to unpack how weather affects agricultural production by developing a structural model that explicitly accounts for both the plants' biophysical and farmers' behavioral responses to weather. Considering adaptation during the growing season through fertilizer and pesticide applications, our approach allows us to distinguish the “direct” weather effects (i.e., the agronomic impacts of weather changes on plant growth per se) from the “indirect” weather effects via farmers' input choices (i.e., the adaptation impacts). We estimate the underlying structural model using farm‐level data from the Meuse French department, which provides details of fertilizer and pesticide uses by crop. We show that the reduced‐form and structural estimates indicate similar weather impacts on crop yields, for a large range of sensitivity analyses. Our structural estimates indicate that the adaptation effects are sizable and that farmers' adjustments reduce projected damage from climate change. In our illustrative case, farmers' adaptation offsets between one‐quarter to two‐thirds of the negative agronomic impacts of future warming on crop yields. Our analyses exhibit that commonly used reduced‐form models of crop yields inherently capture these within‐season behavioral responses to weather.
records.abstract_cn: 大量文献通过估计作物产量对天气和个体固定效应的简化形式模型，评估了气候变化对农业生产的影响。所获得的估计通常被解释为农民适应后天气对产量的影响。然而，很少有研究记录农民确实适应天气，也没有研究验证这些调整是否真正影响作物产量。我们的目标是通过开发一个明确考虑植物生物物理和农民行为对天气响应的结构模型，来揭示天气如何影响农业生产。考虑到生长季节通过施肥和施用农药的适应，我们的方法使我们能够区分“直接”天气效应（即天气变化对植物生长本身的农艺影响）与通过农民投入选择产生的“间接”天气效应（即适应影响）。我们使用法国默兹省农场层面的数据估计潜在的结构模型，该数据提供了按作物划分的肥料和农药使用详情。我们表明，对于大范围的敏感性分析，简化形式和结构估计表明天气对作物产量的影响相似。我们的结构估计表明，适应效应相当可观，农民的调整减少了对气候变化预测的损害。在我们的示例案例中，农民的适应抵消了未来变暖对作物产量负面农艺影响的四分之一到三分之二。我们的分析表明，常用的作物产量简化形式模型固有地捕捉了这些季节内对天气的行为响应。

records.title_en: Agricultural shocks, coping policies and deforestation: Evidence from the coffee leaf rust epidemic in Mexico
records.title_cn: 农业冲击、应对政策与森林砍伐：来自墨西哥咖啡叶锈病疫情的证据
records.abstract_en: Deforestation in the tropics is a critical issue that interacts with global environmental changes, and the mediating role of negative agricultural shocks is ambiguous. We investigate the impact of the massive epidemic of coffee leaf rust (CLR) that affected Mexico from 2012 on deforestation. CLR is a fungal disease that negatively affects coffee production. We exploit the gradual spread of the epidemic across coffee‐growing municipalities and estimate a difference‐in‐differences model. We find that deforestation increased by 32% in CLR‐affected municipalities, but we find no increase in agricultural land. We find evidence of deforestation in cropland area, and our effects are driven by states where rustic coffee systems were predominant. These results suggest that deforestation occurred within coffee cultivation areas and point out the concurrent role of government subsidies and incentives through the PROCAFE program, launched in 2014, that promoted the replacement of traditional coffee trees by CLR‐resistant hybrids. We study the dynamic effects of CLR and exploit the delayed launch of PROCAFE to try to disentangle the impact of the epidemic from that of the policy response. Our results emphasize the vulnerability of agroforestry systems to exogenous shocks and suggest that PROCAFE, as a short‐term response to CLR, contributed to increasing deforestation and accelerating the transition of Mexican traditional coffee landscapes to monoculture.
records.abstract_cn: 热带地区的森林砍伐是一个与全球环境变化相互作用的关键问题，而负面农业冲击的中介作用尚不明确。我们研究了自2012年起影响墨西哥的大规模咖啡叶锈病（CLR）疫情对森林砍伐的影响。CLR是一种对咖啡生产产生负面影响的真菌病害。我们利用该流行病在咖啡种植市镇间的逐步蔓延，并估计了一个双重差分模型。我们发现，在受CLR影响的市镇，森林砍伐增加了32%，但农业用地并未增加。我们发现了耕地面积上的森林砍伐证据，且我们的效应主要由以粗放式咖啡系统为主的州驱动。这些结果表明，森林砍伐发生在咖啡种植区域内，并指出了通过PROCAFE计划（于2014年启动）提供的政府补贴和激励措施的并行作用，该计划促进了传统咖啡树被抗CLR杂交品种所替代。我们研究了CLR的动态效应，并利用PROCAFE的延迟启动来尝试区分疫情与政策应对的影响。我们的结果强调了农林复合系统对外生冲击的脆弱性，并表明PROCAFE作为对CLR的短期应对措施，促进了森林砍伐的增加，加速了墨西哥传统咖啡景观向单一栽培的转变。

records.title_en: Do obese and nonobese consumers respond differently to price changes? Implications of preference heterogeneity for obesity‐oriented food taxes and subsidies
records.title_cn: 肥胖与非肥胖消费者对价格变化的反应是否不同？偏好异质性对针对肥胖的食品税和补贴的影响
records.abstract_en: Preference heterogeneity in food demand has important health and equity implications for targeted and broad‐based taxes and subsidies intended to enhance diet quality and reduce obesity. We study the role of obesity in the purchases of food at home and food away from home using data from the nationally representative National Household Food Acquisition and Purchase Survey. We develop a method for incorporating the complex survey design and retail scanner data into the estimation of a 21‐good Exact Affine Stone Index demand system with endogenous prices and truncated purchases. We find significant preference heterogeneity associated with the obesity status of household members. Counterfactual simulations find that (1) a sweetened beverage tax is effective in increasing the healthfulness of purchases by lower income obese consumers; (2) the nutritional benefits of a fruit and vegetable subsidy are concentrated on nonobese consumers with little improvement in obese consumers' Healthy Eating Index and an increase in their total calories purchased; and (3) a fiscally neutral healthy food subsidy fully funded by an unhealthy food tax benefits nonobese consumers both financially and nutritionally more than it does obese consumers. These findings show that lowering healthy food prices without raising the cost of unhealthy foods is unlikely to reduce obesity. Policymakers in favor of a systems approach of simultaneously taxing unhealthy foods and subsidizing healthy foods should be mindful of the distributional effects of this policy on obese consumers and the lower income population.
records.abstract_cn: 食品需求中的偏好异质性对于旨在提高饮食质量和减少肥胖的定向及广泛税收和补贴具有重要的健康和公平意义。我们利用具有全国代表性的国家家庭食品获取与购买调查数据，研究了肥胖在家庭内食品和外带食品购买中的作用。我们开发了一种方法，将复杂的调查设计和零售扫描数据纳入包含内生价格和截断购买的21种商品精确仿射斯通指数需求系统的估计中。我们发现与家庭成员肥胖状态相关的显著偏好异质性。反事实模拟发现，(1)含糖饮料税能有效提高低收入肥胖消费者购买食品的健康程度；(2)水果和蔬菜补贴的营养益处集中在非肥胖消费者身上，肥胖消费者的健康饮食指数改善甚微，且其总购买热量增加；(3)由不健康食品税全额资助的财政中性健康食品补贴，在财务和营养方面对非肥胖消费者的益处大于肥胖消费者。这些发现表明，在不提高不健康食品成本的情况下降低健康食品价格不太可能减少肥胖。支持同时征收不健康食品税和补贴健康食品的系统方法的政策制定者应注意该政策对肥胖消费者和低收入人群的分配效应。

records.title_en: Increasing production diversity and diet quality: Evidence from Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 增加生产多样性与饮食质量：来自孟加拉国的证据
records.abstract_en: In the context of rural Bangladesh, we assess whether agriculture training alone, nutrition behavior communication change (BCC) alone, combined agriculture training and nutrition BCC, or agriculture training and nutrition BCC combined with gender sensitization improve: (a) production diversity, either on household fields or through crop, livestock, or aquaculture activities carried out near the family homestead; and (b) diet diversity and the quality of household diets. All treatment arms were implemented by government employees. Implementation quality was high. No treatment increased production diversification of crops grown on fields. Treatment arms with agricultural training did increase the number of different crops grown in homestead gardens and the likelihood of any egg, dairy, or fish production but the magnitudes of these effect sizes were small. All agricultural treatment arms had, in percentage terms, large effects on measures of levels of homestead production. However, because baseline levels of production were low, the magnitude of these changes in absolute terms was modest. Nearly all treatment arms improved measures of food consumption and diet with the largest effects found when nutrition and agriculture training were combined. Relative to treatments combining agriculture and nutrition training, we find no significant impact of adding the gender sensitization on our measures of production diversity or diet quality. Interventions that combine agricultural training and nutrition BCC can improve both production diversity and diet quality, but they are not a panacea. They can, however, contribute toward better diets of rural households.
records.abstract_cn: 在孟加拉国农村的背景下，我们评估了仅农业培训、仅营养行为沟通改变（BCC）、农业培训与营养BCC相结合，或农业培训与营养BCC结合性别敏感化是否改善：（a）生产多样性，无论是在家庭田地还是通过家庭宅基地附近进行的作物、牲畜或水产养殖活动；（b）饮食多样性和家庭饮食质量。所有治疗组均由政府雇员实施。实施质量很高。没有治疗组增加田间种植作物的生产多样化。包含农业培训的治疗组确实增加了家庭菜园中种植的不同作物数量以及任何蛋、奶或鱼生产的可能性，但这些效应的大小很小。所有农业治疗组在百分比上对宅基地生产水平指标有较大影响。然而，由于基线生产水平较低，这些变化的绝对幅度适中。几乎所有治疗组都改善了食品消费和饮食指标，当营养和农业培训相结合时效果最大。相对于结合农业和营养培训的治疗，我们发现增加性别敏感化对我们的生产多样性或饮食质量指标没有显著影响。结合农业培训和营养BCC的干预措施可以改善生产多样性和饮食质量，但它们不是万能药。然而，它们可以有助于改善农村家庭的饮食。

records.title_en: The end of an era: Who paid the price when the livestock futures pits closed?
records.title_cn: 一个时代的终结：牲畜期货交易池关闭时谁付出了代价？
records.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the impact of the Chicago Mercantile Exchange's (CME) decision to close the livestock futures pits on the execution quality of customer orders. Our findings suggest that, prior to its closure, the livestock futures pit offers high immediacy execution and attracts large orders. Because such high immediacy orders generally execute faster and cost more, their migration to the electronic market after the pit closure explains why the execution of electronic orders becomes on average speedier and more expensive for customers who used to be active pit users. However, our results also indicate that these pit‐user customers face a lower overall execution cost following the pit closure when we account for all their orders, pit and electronic.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了芝加哥商品交易所（CME）关闭牲畜期货交易池对客户订单执行质量的影响。我们的研究结果表明，在关闭之前，牲畜期货交易池提供了高即时性执行并吸引了大量订单。由于这类高即时性订单通常执行更快且成本更高，它们在交易池关闭后向电子市场的迁移解释了为何电子订单的执行对曾经活跃的交易池用户而言平均变得更快且更昂贵。然而，我们的结果也表明，当我们将这些交易池用户的所有订单（包括交易池和电子订单）考虑在内时，他们在交易池关闭后面临的总执行成本更低。

records.title_en: Social networks and technology adoption: Evidence from church mergers in the U.S. Midwest
records.title_cn: 社交网络与技术采用：来自美国中西部教会合并的证据
records.abstract_en: How do social networks impact technology adoption? Exploiting a natural experiment in the mid‐20th century U.S. Upper Midwest, we find that social network expansions, in the form of mergers between congregations of the American Lutheran Church, led to increased rates of agricultural technology adoption among farmers. In counties that experienced a merger, the number of farms using chemical fertilizer increased by over 5%, and the total fertilized acreage increased by over 10% relative to counties without a merger. These effects are consistent with increased information sharing between farmers due to congregational mergers.
records.abstract_cn: 社交网络如何影响技术采用？利用20世纪中叶美国上中西部地区的一项自然实验，我们发现，社交网络的扩展，以美国路德教会会众合并的形式，导致农民中农业技术采用率的提高。在经历合并的县，使用化肥的农场数量相对于未经历合并的县增加了超过5%，总施肥面积增加了超过10%。这些效应与教会合并导致农民之间信息共享增加相一致。

records.title_en: Striving to revive pulses in India with extension, input subsidies, and output price supports †
records.title_cn: 通过推广、投入补贴和产出价格支持努力振兴印度豆类生产†
records.abstract_en: Pulse production in India has stagnated relative to staple grains and cash crops, raising concerns about rural protein consumption. We experimentally evaluate an effort to increase local pulse production in Bihar. This intervention consisted of 2 years of input subsidies and extension to facilitate learning, followed by the creation of marketing organizations and a year of output price support to raise profitability. Farmers respond to price signals by expanding inputs when subsidized and increasing pulse sales under price supports. However, we see no evidence that the program shifted equilibrium production portfolios as pulses return to pre‐intervention levels after the support ends. Results indicate that short‐term learning by doing cannot overcome long‐run barriers to local pulse production, even when farmers have a viable outlet to sell their surplus output.
records.abstract_cn: 印度豆类生产相对于主粮和经济作物一直停滞不前，引发了对农村蛋白质消费的担忧。我们通过实验评估了一项旨在提高比哈尔邦当地豆类产量的干预措施。该干预措施包括2年的投入补贴和推广以促进学习，随后建立营销组织并提供一年的产出价格支持以提高盈利能力。农民对价格信号作出反应，在补贴期间扩大投入，在价格支持下增加豆类销售。然而，我们没有发现该项目改变了均衡生产组合的证据，因为支持结束后豆类产量恢复到干预前水平。结果表明，即使农民有可行的销售剩余产品的渠道，短期边做边学也无法克服当地豆类生产的长期障碍。

records.title_en: Estimating habit‐forming and variety‐seeking behavior: Valuation of recreational birdwatching
records.title_cn: 估计习惯形成与寻求多样性行为：休闲观鸟的价值评估
records.abstract_en: Past experiences influence choices, and people's preferences for more similar (habit‐forming) or different (variety‐seeking) experiences are reflected in these choices. We develop a structural estimation framework to capture whether people are habit forming or variety seeking and apply it to the choice of recreation site. This research contributes to the revealed preference literature by demonstrating how to account for habit or variety‐seeking behavior in recreation site choice models in a two‐stage framework. Using this framework, we estimate similarity weights that reflect the birders habit formation and variety seeking preferences. Predicted probabilities from the first stage model are then incorporated into the second stage, a mixed logit recreation site choice model of bird watching trips from eBird, by their members. We find that including the dynamic elements of choice, specifically variety‐seeking behavior, can double the estimated willingness to pay (WTP) for individual sites relative to the static model. Although our sample of bird watching trips taken by eBird members is a sample of convenience, these results suggest that static models of recreation site choice are a lower bound on our recreation demand WTP estimates. We find variety‐seeking preferences are related to land cover and the site's fixed attributes, whereas habit formation appears for seasonality in the bird watching context.
records.abstract_cn: 过去的经历影响选择，人们对于更相似（习惯形成）或不同（寻求多样性）经历的偏好反映在这些选择中。我们开发了一个结构估计框架来捕捉人们是习惯形成还是寻求多样性，并将其应用于休闲地点的选择。这项研究通过展示如何在两阶段框架中考虑休闲地点选择模型中的习惯或寻求多样性行为，为显示性偏好文献做出了贡献。使用这个框架，我们估计了反映观鸟者习惯形成和寻求多样性偏好的相似性权重。然后，将第一阶段模型的预测概率纳入第二阶段，即由eBird成员进行的观鸟旅行的混合logit休闲地点选择模型。我们发现，包含选择的动态元素，特别是寻求多样性行为，可以使个体地点的估计支付意愿（WTP）相对于静态模型翻倍。尽管我们的eBird成员观鸟旅行样本是一个便利样本，但这些结果表明，休闲地点选择的静态模型是我们休闲需求WTP估计的下限。我们发现寻求多样性偏好与土地覆盖和地点的固定属性相关，而习惯形成则出现在观鸟情境中的季节性方面。

records.title_en: Land use impacts of the Conservation Reserve Program: An analysis of rejected offers
records.title_cn: 保护储备计划的土地利用影响：对拒绝报价的分析
records.abstract_en: The Conservation Reserve Program is the largest agricultural land retirement program in the United States, with more enrolled acreage entering the program through a competitive auction called the General Signup than any other component. In this study, we assess the land use impacts of the Conservation Reserve Program by observing the land use decisions of parcels following the 2016 General Signup. We estimate land use impacts using a regression discontinuity design based on the Environmental Benefits Index, the program's selection and ranking mechanism. Our estimates largely rely on the auction design of the General Signup, such that we observe the land use decisions of rejected offers. We also use information on the rental rates of these offers to understand what the program pays to retire land in different uses. We estimate that a marginal acre of land enrolled in the Conservation Reserve Program replaces 0.30 acres in cropland, 0.25 acres in mixed forage, 0.32 acres in grassland, 0.12 acres in idle or fallow land, and 0.01 acres in timberland. We also find that enrollments from newly offered fields are more likely to displace cropland and less likely to displace grassland than returning fields. Consequently, we estimate that new enrollments lead to 47% greater reductions in water‐driven erosion and 12% greater reductions in wind‐driven erosion, compared to fields with prior enrollment.
records.abstract_cn: 保护储备计划是美国最大的农业土地休耕计划，通过称为一般注册的竞争性拍卖进入该计划的注册面积比任何其他组成部分都多。在本研究中，我们通过观察2016年一般注册后地块的土地利用决策来评估保护储备计划的土地利用影响。我们使用基于环境效益指数（该计划的选择和排名机制）的断点回归设计来估计土地利用影响。我们的估计主要依赖于一般注册的拍卖设计，因此我们观察到了被拒绝报价的土地利用决策。我们还利用这些报价的租金率信息来了解该计划为不同用途的土地休耕所支付的费用。我们估计，保护储备计划中每增加一英亩土地，将替代0.30英亩的耕地、0.25英亩的混合饲草地、0.32英亩的草地、0.12英亩的闲置或休耕地以及0.01英亩的林地。我们还发现，新提供的地块的注册比返回的地块更可能替代耕地，而不太可能替代草地。因此，我们估计，与先前注册的地块相比，新注册导致水蚀减少47%，风蚀减少12%。

records.title_en: Farm‐level responses to weather trends: A structural model
records.title_cn: 农场对天气趋势的响应：一个结构模型
records.abstract_en: Assessing the effects of weather and climate on agricultural production is crucial for designing policies related to climate change adaptation and mitigation. A large body of literature has identified the detrimental effects of climate change on crop yields worldwide, and farm‐level adaptation has been shown to mitigate the adverse effects on agricultural production. In this study, we employ a structural model to examine farm production responses to ongoing weather trends. We investigate how farmers adjust output and input decisions by estimating a system of output supply and input demand functions, controlling for nonrandom crop selection. Using panel data with 14,796 observations reflecting 1638 German crop farms (1996–2019), we find that both the expected and realized weather determine farmers' production decisions. In the event of a drought, the supply of most considered crops and the demand for fertilizer decrease. The drought shock has also lasting effects on farmers' production decisions, with a reduced supply of protein crops and an increased level of root crops production in subsequent years. These findings highlight the need to account for farm‐level production responses when assessing weather and climate impacts.
records.abstract_cn: 评估天气和气候对农业生产的影响对于设计气候变化适应和减缓政策至关重要。大量文献已识别出气候变化对全球作物产量的不利影响，并且农场层面的适应已被证明能减轻对农业生产的不利影响。在本研究中，我们采用结构模型来考察农场生产对持续天气趋势的响应。通过估计产出供给和投入需求函数系统，并控制非随机作物选择，我们研究了农民如何调整产出和投入决策。利用包含14,796个观测值、反映1,638个德国作物农场（1996-2019年）的面板数据，我们发现预期和实际天气都决定农民的生产决策。在干旱事件中，大多数考虑作物的供给和化肥需求减少。干旱冲击还对农民的生产决策产生持久影响，表现为随后几年蛋白质作物供给减少和块根作物产量增加。这些发现强调了在评估天气和气候影响时需要考虑农场层面的生产响应。

records.title_en: Market power in California's water market
records.title_cn: 加州水市场中的市场势力
records.abstract_en: We estimate market power in California's surface water market. Market power may distort the potential welfare gains from water marketing. We use a Nash‐Cournot model and derive a closed‐form solution for the extent of market power in a water market setting. We then use this solution to estimate market power in a newly assembled dataset on California's water economy. We show that, under the assumptions of the Nash‐Cournot model, market power in this thin market is limited.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估算了加州地表水市场中的市场势力。市场势力可能会扭曲水市场潜在的福利收益。我们使用纳什-古诺模型，并推导出水市场环境中市场势力程度的闭式解。然后，我们利用这一解来估算一个新汇编的加州水经济数据集中的市场势力。我们表明，在纳什-古诺模型的假设下，这个薄市场中的市场势力是有限的。

records.title_en: Land competition and welfare effects from Mexico's proposal to ban genetically engineered corn
records.title_cn: 土地竞争与墨西哥禁止转基因玉米提案的福利效应
records.abstract_en: Since joining the North American Free Trade Agreement, Mexico has increased its meat production and exports and become more dependent on imported feedstuffs such as genetically engineered (GE) corn. Mexico recently banned the use of GE corn in corn‐based foods and called for a gradual substitution away from the use of GE corn for other uses (e.g., feed). This paper considers how a complete ban on GE corn might affect Mexican households using a computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to simulate the impact over the medium run (5 years). Results indicate that Mexico decreases corn imports by 76.9% and increases corn production by 65.6%—an increase that would require 3.3 million hectares more land for corn. The policy leads to a 24.8% increase in Mexico's corn price and up to a 6% increase in the prices of other agricultural products. But Mexico might have difficulty shifting land to corn; as such, we consider an alternative scenario that restricts land movements. We find that impacts are further exacerbated in this scenario—for example, corn prices triple. Our final contribution is to pair these results with a compensating variation calculation based on the almost ideal demand system. We find that Mexican households would need to spend, on average, between 6.7 and 13.9% more on food, depending on the scenario, to compensate for the resulting price escalations. Ultimately, our results show that a move toward greater food sovereignty in Mexico is ultimately borne by consumers via higher food prices.
records.abstract_cn: 自加入北美自由贸易协定以来，墨西哥增加了肉类生产和出口，并更加依赖进口饲料，如转基因玉米。墨西哥最近禁止在玉米类食品中使用转基因玉米，并呼吁逐步替代其他用途（如饲料）中的转基因玉米。本文使用可计算一般均衡模型模拟中期（5年）影响，考虑全面禁止转基因玉米可能对墨西哥家庭产生的影响。结果表明，墨西哥玉米进口减少76.9%，玉米产量增加65.6%——这一增长需要额外3.3万公顷土地用于玉米种植。该政策导致墨西哥玉米价格上涨24.8%，其他农产品价格最多上涨6%。但墨西哥可能难以将土地转向玉米种植；因此，我们考虑了一个限制土地流动的替代情景。我们发现，在此情景下影响进一步加剧——例如，玉米价格翻三倍。我们的最终贡献是将这些结果与基于几乎理想需求系统的补偿变差计算相结合。我们发现，墨西哥家庭平均需要多支出6.7至13.9%的食品费用，具体取决于情景，以补偿由此产生的价格上涨。最终，我们的结果表明，墨西哥走向更高粮食主权的举措最终由消费者通过更高的食品价格承担。

records.title_en: Shocks, Frictions, and Inequality in US Business Cycles
records.title_cn: 冲击、摩擦与美国商业周期中的不平等
records.abstract_en: We show how a heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) model with incomplete markets and portfolio choice can be estimated in state space using a Bayesian approach. To render estimation feasible, the structure of the economy can be exploited and the dimensionality of the model automatically reduced based on the Bayesian priors. We apply this approach to analyze how much inequality matters for the business cycle and vice versa. Even when the model is estimated on aggregate data alone and with a set of shocks and frictions designed to match aggregate data, it broadly reproduces observed US inequality dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们展示了如何利用贝叶斯方法在状态空间中估计一个具有不完全市场和投资组合选择的异质代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）模型。为了使估计可行，可以利用经济结构，并基于贝叶斯先验自动降低模型的维度。我们应用这种方法来分析不平等对商业周期的影响程度，反之亦然。即使模型仅基于总量数据估计，并设计了一组冲击和摩擦以匹配总量数据，它也能大致再现观察到的美国不平等动态。

records.title_en: Household Labor Supply and the Value of Social Security Survivors Benefits
records.title_cn: 家庭劳动力供给与社会保障遗属抚恤金的价值
records.abstract_en: We combine quasi-experimental variation in spousal death and age eligibility for survivors benefits using US tax records to study the effects on American households' labor supply and the design of social security's survivors insurance. Benefit eligibility at the exact age of 60 induces sharp reductions in the labor supply of newly widowed households, highlighting the value of survivors benefits and the liquidity they provide following the shock. Among eligible widows, the spousal death event induces no increases in labor supply, suggesting little residual need to self-insure. Using theory, we underscore the program's protective insurance role and its high valuation among survivors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国税收记录中配偶死亡和遗属抚恤金年龄资格的半实验性变化，研究其对美国家庭劳动力供给的影响以及社会保障遗属保险的设计。在恰好年满60岁时获得资格，导致新丧偶家庭的劳动力供给急剧减少，凸显了遗属抚恤金的价值及其在冲击后提供的流动性。在符合条件的寡妇中，配偶死亡事件并未导致劳动力供给增加，表明几乎没有剩余的自我保险需求。通过理论分析，我们强调了该计划的保护性保险作用及其在遗属中的高估值。

records.title_en: Creating Moves to Opportunity: Experimental Evidence on Barriers to Neighborhood Choice
records.title_cn: 创造流动机会：邻里选择障碍的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Low-income families often live in low-upward-mobility neighborhoods. We study why by using a randomized trial with housing voucher recipients that provided information, financial support, and customized search assistance to move to high-opportunity neighborhoods. The treatment increased the fraction moving to high-upward-mobility areas from 15 to 53 percent. A second trial reveals this treatment effect is driven primarily by customized search assistance. Qualitative interviews show that the intervention relaxed bandwidth constraints and addressed family-specific needs. Our findings imply many low-income families do not have strong preferences to stay in low-opportunity areas and that barriers in housing search significantly increase residential segregation by income.
records.abstract_cn: 低收入家庭往往居住在上行流动性低的社区。我们通过一项针对住房券受助者的随机试验来研究其原因，该试验提供了信息、财政支持和定制化搜索援助，以帮助其迁往高机会社区。该干预措施将迁往高上行流动性地区的比例从15提高到53%。第二项试验表明，这一处理效应主要由定制化搜索援助驱动。定性访谈显示，干预措施缓解了带宽限制，并解决了家庭特定需求。我们的研究结果表明，许多低收入家庭并没有强烈偏好留在低机会地区，住房搜索中的障碍显著加剧了按收入划分的居住隔离。

records.title_en: From Fog to Smog: The Value of Pollution Information
records.title_cn: 从雾到霾：污染信息的价值
records.abstract_en: In 2013, China launched a landmark program to monitor air quality and disclose real-time data, significantly increasing the public's access to and awareness of pollution information. The program triggered cascading behavioral changes such as stronger avoidance of outdoor pollution exposure and increased spending on protective products. These behavioral responses mitigated the mortality impact of air pollution. Conservative estimates indicate that the program's health benefits outweigh the costs by an order of magnitude. The findings highlight the benefits of improving public access to pollution information in developing countries which often experience severe air pollution but lack pollution data collection and dissemination.
records.abstract_cn: 2013年，中国启动了一项具有里程碑意义的空气质量监测和实时数据公开项目，显著提高了公众获取和了解污染信息的程度。该项目引发了连锁行为变化，如更强烈地避免户外污染暴露和增加防护产品的支出。这些行为反应减轻了空气污染对死亡率的影响。保守估计表明，该项目的健康效益比成本高出一个数量级。研究结果强调了在经常遭受严重空气污染但缺乏污染数据收集和传播的发展中国家，改善公众获取污染信息的益处。

records.title_en: Urban Public Works in Spatial Equilibrium: Experimental Evidence from Ethiopia
records.title_cn: 空间均衡中的城市公共工程：来自埃塞俄比亚的实验证据
records.abstract_en: This paper evaluates a large urban public works program randomly rolled out across neighborhoods of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We find the program increased public employment and reduced private labor supply among beneficiaries and improved local amenities in treated locations. We then combine a spatial equilibrium model and unique commuting data to estimate the spillover effects of the program on private sector wages across neighborhoods: under full program rollout, wages increased by 18.6 percent. Using our model, we show that welfare gains to the poor are six times larger when we include the indirect effects on private wages and local amenities.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了一项在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴各街区随机推出的大型城市公共工程计划。我们发现该计划增加了公共就业，减少了受益者的私人劳动力供给，并改善了受处理地区的本地设施。然后，我们结合空间均衡模型和独特的通勤数据来估计该计划对跨街区私营部门工资的溢出效应：在全面实施该计划的情况下，工资上涨了18.6%。利用我们的模型，我们表明，当我们将对私人工资和本地设施的间接影响包括在内时，穷人的福利收益要大六倍。

records.title_en: Resisting Social Pressure in the Household Using Mobile Money: Experimental Evidence on Microenterprise Investment in Uganda
records.title_cn: 使用移动货币抵制家庭内部社会压力：乌干达微型企业投资的实验证据
records.abstract_en: I examine whether changing the form of disbursement of a microfinance loan enables female microfinance borrowers to overcome intra-household sharing pressure and grow their businesses. Using a field experiment with 3,000 borrowers in Uganda, I compare the disbursement of a loan as cash to disbursement onto a digital account. After 8 months, women who received their microfinance loan on the digital account had 11 percent higher (US$70) business capital and 15 percent higher (US$18) profits compared to those who received their loan as cash. Impacts were greatest for women who experienced pressure to share money with others in the household at baseline.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了改变小额信贷贷款的发放形式是否能使女性小额信贷借款人克服家庭内部的分享压力并发展她们的企业。通过在乌干达对3,000名借款人进行的实地实验，我将贷款以现金发放与发放到数字账户进行了比较。8个月后，与以现金形式获得小额信贷贷款的女性相比，通过数字账户获得贷款的女性的商业资本高出11%%（US$70），利润高出15%%（US$18）。对于在基线时感受到家庭内部与他人分享金钱压力的女性，影响最大。

records.title_en: A Framework for Economic Growth with Capital-Embodied Technical Change
records.title_cn: 资本体现型技术变革的经济增长框架
records.abstract_en: Technological advance is often embodied in capital inputs, like computers, airplanes, and robots. This paper builds a framework where capital inputs advance through (i) increased automation and (ii) increased productivity. The interplay of these two innovation dimensions can produce balanced growth, satisfying the Uzawa Growth Theorem even though technological progress is capital-embodied. The framework can further address structural transformation, general-purpose technologies, the limited macroeconomic impact of computing, and declining productivity growth and labor shares. Overall, this tractable framework can help resolve puzzling tensions between micro-level observations of innovation and balanced growth while providing new perspectives on numerous macroeconomic phenomena.
records.abstract_cn: 技术进步往往体现在资本投入中，如计算机、飞机和机器人。本文构建了一个框架，其中资本投入通过（i）自动化程度的提高和（ii）生产率的提高而进步。这两个创新维度的相互作用可以产生平衡增长，满足Uzawa增长定理，即使技术进步是资本体现型的。该框架还可以进一步解决结构转型、通用目的技术、计算对宏观经济影响的有限性以及生产率增长和劳动份额下降等问题。总体而言，这个易于处理的框架有助于解决微观层面的创新观察与平衡增长之间令人困惑的紧张关系，同时为众多宏观经济现象提供新的视角。

records.title_en: On Binscatter
records.title_cn: 关于分箱散点图
records.abstract_en: Binscatter is a popular method for visualizing bivariate relationships and conducting informal specification testing. We study the properties of this method formally and develop enhanced visualization and econometric binscatter tools. These include estimating conditional means with optimal binning and quantifying uncertainty. We also highlight a methodological problem related to covariate adjustment that can yield incorrect conclusions. We revisit two applications using our methodology and find substantially different results relative to those obtained using prior informal binscatter methods. General purpose software in Python, R, and Stata is provided. Our technical work is of independent interest for the nonparametric partition-based estimation literature.
records.abstract_cn: 分箱散点图是一种用于可视化双变量关系并进行非正式设定检验的流行方法。我们正式研究了该方法的性质，并开发了增强的可视化和计量经济学分箱散点图工具。这些工具包括通过最优分箱估计条件均值以及量化不确定性。我们还强调了与协变量调整相关的一个方法论问题，该问题可能导致错误的结论。我们使用我们的方法重新审视了两个应用，并发现与使用先前非正式分箱散点图方法所得结果相比，结果存在显著差异。我们提供了Python、R和Stata中的通用软件。我们的技术工作对于非参数分区估计文献具有独立的意义。

records.title_en: Racial and Ethnic Representation in Local Government
records.title_cn: 地方政府中的种族与民族代表性
records.abstract_en: Does the presence of underrepresented racial/ethnic groups in a legislative body differentially impact outcomes for members of those groups? We study close elections between White and non-White candidates for California city council and the corresponding impact on housing values, a summary statistic for neighborhood investment. We find electing non-White rather than White candidates generates differential home value gains in majority non-White neighborhoods. This result, which is not explained by correlations between candidate race and political affiliation or neighborhood racial composition and income, suggests that increased representation can reduce racial disparities. Our results strengthen with increased city-level segregation and council member pivotality. (JEL D72, J15, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 立法机构中代表性不足的种族/民族群体的存在是否会对这些群体成员的结果产生不同影响？我们研究了加州城市议会白人与非白人候选人之间的势均力敌的选举，以及其对住房价值（社区投资的汇总统计量）的相应影响。我们发现，选举非白人而非白人候选人会在多数非白人社区产生不同的房屋价值收益。这一结果无法用候选人种族与政治派别或社区种族构成与收入之间的相关性来解释，表明增加代表性可以减少种族差异。我们的结果随着城市层面的隔离程度和议会成员的关键性增强而更加显著。（JEL D72, J15, R23）

records.title_en: The Returns to STEM Programs for Less-Prepared Students
records.title_cn: STEM项目对准备不足学生的回报
records.abstract_en: The returns to selective STEM programs depend on whether students complete these programs, earnings conditional on completion, and counterfactual schooling choices. Much research has focused on only one of these margins, potentially leading to an incomplete picture of the returns to STEM education for students with less academic preparation. Using data from a Colombian university and two empirical strategies, we find less-prepared students have higher earnings returns to selective STEM programs than more-prepared students, even though they are less likely to complete these programs. A key mechanism is that less-prepared students have lower-paying counterfactual schooling options. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J31, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 选择性STEM项目的回报取决于学生是否完成这些项目、完成条件下的收入以及反事实的 schooling 选择。许多研究仅关注这些边际中的一个，可能导致对学术准备不足学生STEM教育回报的不完整认识。利用哥伦比亚一所大学的数据和两种实证策略，我们发现准备不足的学生从选择性STEM项目中获得的收入回报高于准备更充分的学生，尽管他们完成这些项目的可能性较低。一个关键机制是，准备不足的学生拥有收入更低的反事实 schooling 选择。(JEL I23, I26, J24, J31, O15)

records.title_en: The Returns to Public Library Investment
records.title_cn: 公共图书馆投资的回报
records.abstract_en: Local governments spend over $12 billion annually funding the operation of 15,427 public libraries in the United States, yet we know little about their effects. We use data describing the near universe of public libraries to show that public library capital investment increases library visits, children’s attendance at library events, and children’s circulation by an average of 5–15 percent in the years following investment. Increases in library use translate into improved test scores in nearby school districts: a $200 or greater per student capital investment in local public libraries increases reading test scores by 0. 01–0.04 standard deviations in subsequent years. (JEL G31, H75, I21, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 地方政府每年花费超过12十亿美元资助美国15,427公共图书馆的运营，但我们对其影响知之甚少。我们使用描述公共图书馆近期情况的数据表明，公共图书馆资本投资在投资后的几年内使图书馆访问量、儿童参加图书馆活动和儿童流通量平均增加 5-15%。图书馆使用率的增加转化为附近学区考试成绩的提高：对当地公共图书馆的每位学生资本投资 200 美元或更多，阅读考试成绩将提高 0。随后几年的01-0.04标准差。 (JEL G31、H75、I21、L86)

records.title_en: Do Family Policies Reduce Gender Inequality? Evidence from 60 Years of Policy Experimentation
records.title_cn: 家庭政策能否减少性别不平等？来自60年政策实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Do family policies reduce gender inequality in the labor market? We contribute to this debate by investigating the joint impact of parental leave and childcare, using administrative data covering Austrian workers over more than half a century. We start by quasi-experimentally identifying the causal effects of all family policy reforms since the 1950s on the full dynamics of male and female earnings. We then map these causal estimates into a decomposition framework to compute counterfactual gender inequality series. Our results show that the enormous expansions of parental leave and childcare have had virtually no impact on gender convergence. (JEL D63, J13, J16, J31, J32)
records.abstract_cn: 家庭政策能否减少劳动力市场中的性别不平等？我们通过研究育儿假和儿童照护的联合影响来为这一争论做出贡献，使用的是覆盖半个多世纪奥地利工人的行政数据。我们首先通过准实验方法识别自1950年以来所有家庭政策改革对男性和女性收入完整动态的因果效应。然后，我们将这些因果估计映射到一个分解框架中，以计算反事实的性别不平等序列。我们的结果表明，育儿假和儿童照护的大幅扩展对性别趋同几乎没有影响。（JEL D63, J13, J16, J31, J32）

records.title_en: Hospital Queues, Patient Health, and Labor Supply
records.title_cn: 医院排队、患者健康与劳动力供给
records.abstract_en: Long waits for health care raise concerns about the consequences of delayed treatment. We use variation in queue congestion to estimate effects of wait time for orthopedic surgery. We do not find that longer wait times lead to increased health care utilization. However, we do find persistent reductions in labor supply: long waits increase medium to long-term work absences and permanent disability receipt. Effects are driven by individuals who are on sick leave at referral. Our results are consistent with patterns of state dependence, where extended periods of temporary disability while awaiting treatment create persistent barriers to returning to work. (JEL I11, I12, I18, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 医疗保健的长时间等待引发了对延迟治疗后果的担忧。我们利用排队拥堵的变化来估计骨科手术等待时间的影响。我们没有发现更长的等待时间会导致医疗保健利用增加。然而，我们确实观察到劳动力供给的持续减少：长时间等待增加了中长期工作缺勤和永久性残疾津贴的领取。这些影响由转诊时正在休病假的个体驱动。我们的结果与状态依赖的模式一致，即等待治疗期间长期处于临时残疾状态，造成了重返工作的持续障碍。（JEL I11, I12, I18, J22）

records.title_en: The Gender Application Gap: Do Men and Women Apply for the Same Jobs?
records.title_cn: 性别申请差距：男性和女性会申请相同的工作吗？
records.abstract_en: Men and women tend to hold different jobs. Are these differences present already in the types of jobs men and women apply for? Using administrative data on job applications made by the universe of Danish unemployment insurance recipients, we provide evidence on gender differences in applied-for jobs for the broader labor market. Across a range of job characteristics, we find large gender gaps in the share of applications going to different job types even among observationally similar men and women. In a standard decomposition, gender differences in applications can explain more than 70 percent of the residual gender wage gap. (JEL J16, J31, J64, J65, J71)
records.abstract_cn: 男性和女性往往从事不同的工作。这些差异是否已经存在于男性和女性申请的工作类型中？利用丹麦失业保险金领取者全体的求职申请行政数据，我们提供了更广泛劳动力市场中申请工作性别差异的证据。在一系列工作特征中，我们发现即使在可观测特征相似的男性和女性之间，申请不同类型工作的比例也存在巨大的性别差距。在标准分解中，申请中的性别差异可以解释剩余性别工资差距的70%以上。（JEL J16, J31, J64, J65, J71）

records.title_en: Killing Prescriptions Softly: Low Emission Zones and Child Health from Birth to School
records.title_cn: 温和地扼杀处方：低排放区与从出生到入学的儿童健康
records.abstract_en: We examine the persistence of the impact of early-life exposure to air pollution on children’s health from birth to school enrollment using administrative public health insurance records covering one-third of all children in Germany. For identification, we exploit air quality improvements caused by Low Emission Zones, a policy imposing driving restrictions on emission-intensive vehicles. Our results indicate that children exposed to cleaner air in utero and their first year of life require less medication for at least five years. The initially latent health response materializes only gradually, leaving important but subtle health benefits undetected in common measures of infant health. (JEL I12, I13, J13, Q51, Q53, R48)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用覆盖德国所有儿童三分之一的行政公共健康保险记录，考察了生命早期暴露于空气污染对儿童从出生到入学健康影响的持续性。为识别因果效应，我们利用了低排放区（一项对高排放车辆实施驾驶限制的政策）带来的空气质量改善。我们的结果表明，在子宫内和出生后第一年暴露于更清洁空气的儿童，至少五年内需要更少的药物。最初潜在的健康反应仅逐渐显现，留下了重要但细微的健康益处，而这些在常见的婴儿健康指标中未被检测到。(JEL I12, I13, J13, Q51, Q53, R48)

records.title_en: Opposing Firm-Level Responses to the China Shock: Output Competition versus Input Supply
records.title_cn: 企业层面应对中国冲击的对立反应：产出竞争与投入供给
records.abstract_en: We decompose the “China shock” into two components that induce different adjustments for firms exposed to Chinese exports: an output shock affecting firms selling goods that compete with similar imported Chinese goods, and an input supply shock affecting firms using inputs similar to the imported Chinese goods. Combining French accounting, customs, and patent information at the firm level, we show that the output shock is detrimental to firms’ sales, employment, and innovation. Moreover, this negative impact is concentrated in low-productivity firms. On the other hand, the impact of the input supply shock is reversed. (JEL D22, D24, F14, J23, L25, O31, O34)
records.abstract_cn: 我们将“中国冲击”分解为两个组成部分，它们对面临中国出口的企业引发不同的调整：一个产出冲击影响销售与进口中国相似商品竞争的企业，以及一个投入供给冲击影响使用与进口中国商品相似投入的企业。结合企业层面的法国会计、海关和专利信息，我们表明产出冲击对企业的销售、就业和创新不利。此外，这种负面影响集中在低生产率企业中。另一方面，投入供给冲击的影响则是相反的。（JEL D22, D24, F14, J23, L25, O31, O34）

records.title_en: Time Aggregation in Health Insurance Deductibles
records.title_cn: 健康保险免赔额中的时间聚合
records.abstract_en: Health insurance plans increasingly pay for expenses only beyond a large annual deductible. This paper explores the implications of deductibles that reset over shorter timespans. We develop a model of insurance demand between two actuarially equivalent deductible policies in which one deductible is larger and resets annually and the other deductible is smaller and resets biannually. Our model incorporates borrowing constraints, moral hazard, midyear contract switching, and delayable care. Calibrations using claims data show that the liquidity benefits of resetting deductibles can generate welfare gains of 3–10 percent of premium costs, particularly for individuals with borrowing constraints. (JEL D15, D82, G22, G51, G52, I13)
records.abstract_cn: 健康保险计划越来越多地仅支付超出大额年度免赔额的费用。本文探讨了在较短时间跨度内重置的免赔额的影响。我们建立了一个保险需求模型，比较两种精算等价的免赔额政策：一种免赔额较大且每年重置，另一种免赔额较小且每半年重置。我们的模型包含了借贷约束、道德风险、年中合同转换和可延迟护理。使用索赔数据的校准表明，重置免赔额的流动性收益可以产生相当于保费成本3-10%的福利收益，特别是对于有借贷约束的个人。(JEL D15, D82, G22, G51, G52, I13)

records.title_en: Efficiency and Incidence of Taxation with Free Entry and Love-of-Variety Preferences
records.title_cn: 自由进入与品种偏好下的税收效率与归宿
records.abstract_en: We develop a theory of commodity taxation featuring imperfect competition along with love-of-variety preferences and endogenous firm entry and exit. We derive new formulas for the efficiency and pass-through of specific and ad valorem taxes. These formulas unify existing canonical ones and feature a new term capturing the effect of variety on consumer surplus. As a proof of concept, we use theoretical formulas to identify love-of-variety preferences in an empirical application. Our welfare analysis shows that the marginal excess burden is sensitive to the estimated love of variety, which overturns classical results on the desirability of ad valorem versus specific taxation. (JEL D11, D21, D91, H25)
records.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个商品税理论，该理论包含不完全竞争、品种偏好以及内生企业进入与退出。我们推导了从量税和从价税的效率与转嫁的新公式。这些公式统一了现有的经典公式，并引入了一个捕捉品种对消费者剩余影响的新项。作为概念验证，我们使用理论公式在一个实证应用中识别品种偏好。我们的福利分析表明，边际超额负担对估计的品种偏好程度敏感，这推翻了关于从价税与从量税可取性的经典结论。(JEL D11, D21, D91, H25)

records.title_en: Migrants at Sea: Unintended Consequences of Search and Rescue Operations
records.title_cn: 海上的移民：搜救行动的意外后果
records.abstract_en: Many countries are facing and resisting strong migratory pressure, fueling irregular migration. In response to mounting deaths in the Central Mediterranean, European nations intensified rescue operations in 2013. We develop a model of irregular migration to identify the effects of these operations. We find that smugglers responded by sending boats in adverse weather and utilizing flimsy rafts, thus inducing more crossings in dangerous conditions and ultimately offsetting intended safety benefits due to moral hazard. Despite the increased risk, these operations likely increased aggregate migrant welfare; nevertheless, a more successful policy should instead restrict supply of rafts and expand legal alternatives. (JEL D82, J15, J18, K37, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 许多国家正面临并抵制强大的移民压力，这助长了非正规移民。为应对中地中海死亡人数的上升，欧洲国家在2013年加强了救援行动。我们建立了一个非正规移民模型，以识别这些行动的影响。我们发现，走私者通过让船只在不适宜的天气条件下出发并使用简陋的筏子来应对，从而在危险条件下引发了更多的越境，最终因道德风险抵消了预期的安全效益。尽管风险增加，这些行动可能提高了移民的整体福利；然而，更成功的政策应转而限制筏子的供应并扩大合法替代方案。(JEL D82, J15, J18, K37, K42)

records.title_en: Public Pensions and Private Savings
records.title_cn: 公共养老金与私人储蓄
records.abstract_en: How does the provision of public pension benefits impact private savings? We answer this question in the context of a Danish reform that increased social security eligibility ages. Using administrative data and a regression discontinuity design, we identify the causal effects of the policy on savings throughout the financial portfolio. We find increases in contributions to personal and employer-sponsored retirement accounts when delayed benefit eligibility induces extended employment. We argue that inertia—the continuation of previous savings behaviors—is a key mechanism, and we highlight how firm default contribution rate policies can mediate savings responses to social security reform. (JEL G51, H55, J22, J26, J32)
records.abstract_cn: 公共养老金福利的提供如何影响私人储蓄？我们在丹麦一项提高社会保障资格年龄的改革背景下回答这一问题。利用行政数据和断点回归设计，我们识别了该政策对整个金融投资组合中储蓄的因果效应。我们发现，当延迟福利资格导致就业延长时，个人和雇主资助的退休账户缴款会增加。我们认为惯性——即先前储蓄行为的延续——是一个关键机制，并强调公司默认缴款率政策如何能够调节储蓄对社会保障改革的反应。（JEL G51, H55, J22, J26, J32）

records.title_en: Refugee Benefit Cuts
records.title_cn: 难民福利削减
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the effects of Denmark’s Start Aid welfare reform that targets refugees. Implemented in 2002, it enables us to study not only the reform’s immediate effects but also its longer-term consequences and its repeal a decade later. The reform-induced large transfer cuts led to an increase in employment rates, but only in the short run. Overall, the reform increased poverty rates and led to a rise in subsistence crime. Moreover, local demand conditions generate substantial heterogeneity in the reform’s effects on immediate and longer-term employment. (JEL I32, I38, J15, J22, J64, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了丹麦针对难民的“启动援助”福利改革的影响。该改革于2002年实施，使我们不仅能够研究改革的即时效应，还能研究其长期后果以及十年后的废除情况。改革引起的大幅转移支付削减导致就业率上升，但仅在短期内如此。总体而言，改革提高了贫困率，并导致生存型犯罪增加。此外，地方需求条件在改革对即时和长期就业的影响中产生了显著的异质性。（JEL I32, I38, J15, J22, J64, K42）

records.title_en: Saving Lives with Indexed Disaster Funds: Evidence from Mexico
records.title_cn: 利用指数化灾害基金拯救生命：来自墨西哥的证据
records.abstract_en: Developing economies are not disproportionately exposed to natural disasters, but they experience significantly more deaths. Exploiting a discontinuity in the eligibility rules for Mexico’s indexed disaster fund (Fonden), I show that the accelerated reconstruction of public infrastructure can significantly mitigate the mortality impacts of disasters. Fonden’s impact is concentrated in areas with medical infrastructure and among conditions responsive to basic and freely available medical care. These findings suggest that Fonden operates by restoring access to health services. I also show that Fonden is cost-effective relative to other interventions and that its benefit–cost ratio is at least 3.2. (JEL D61, H12, H54, H84, I18, O13, Q54)
records.abstract_cn: 发展中经济体并非不成比例地暴露于自然灾害，但它们经历的死亡人数显著更多。利用墨西哥指数化灾害基金（Fonden）资格规则中的不连续性，我表明公共基础设施的加速重建可以显著减轻灾害的死亡率影响。Fonden的影响集中在拥有医疗基础设施的地区，以及对基本且免费可得的医疗服务有反应的病症中。这些发现表明，Fonden通过恢复医疗服务的获取来发挥作用。我还表明，相对于其他干预措施，Fonden具有成本效益，其效益-成本比至少为3.2。（JEL D61, H12, H54, H84, I18, O13, Q54）

records.title_en: Understanding the Link between Temperature and Crime
records.title_cn: 理解温度与犯罪之间的联系
records.abstract_en: The correlation between hot weather and crime is well documented but not fully understood. We combine millions of administrative records, victimization surveys on unreported crime, and daily weather information to analyze the effect of temperatures on crime in Mexico. We find that sample selection cannot explain the observed positive correlation between temperature and crime. Moreover, we find that shifts in alcohol consumption and time use on weekends are responsible for 28 percent of temperature-induced crimes. We also observe changes in the hour and location of crimes, providing new evidence on the importance of time use as a determinant of crime. (JEL D91, K42, O13, O17, Q54)
records.abstract_cn: 炎热天气与犯罪之间的相关性已有充分记录，但尚未完全理解。我们结合了数百万条行政记录、关于未报告犯罪的受害者调查以及每日天气信息，来分析温度对墨西哥犯罪的影响。我们发现样本选择无法解释观察到的温度与犯罪之间的正相关关系。此外，我们发现周末饮酒消费和时间使用的变化导致了28%的温度诱发犯罪。我们还观察到犯罪发生时间和地点的变化，为时间使用作为犯罪决定因素的重要性提供了新证据。(JEL D91, K42, O13, O17, Q54)

records.title_en: The Indirect Fiscal Benefits of Low-Skilled Immigration
records.title_cn: 低技能移民的间接财政收益
records.abstract_en: Low-skilled immigrants indirectly affect public finances through their effect on resident wages and labor supply. We operationalize this indirect fiscal effect in a model of immigration and the labor market. We derive closed-form expressions for this effect in terms of estimable statistics. An empirical quantification for the United States reveals an indirect fiscal benefit for one average low-skilled immigrant of roughly $750 annually. The indirect fiscal benefit may outweigh the negative direct fiscal effect that has previously been documented. This challenges the perception of low-skilled immigration as a fiscal burden. (JEL H24, H75, J15, J24, J61, J82)
records.abstract_cn: 低技能移民通过影响居民工资和劳动力供给，间接影响公共财政。我们在一个移民与劳动力市场模型中操作化了这一间接财政效应。我们推导出了该效应以可估计统计量表示的闭式表达式。对美国的实证量化显示，平均每位低技能移民每年的间接财政收益约为750美元。间接财政收益可能超过先前记录的负面直接财政效应。这对低技能移民作为财政负担的看法提出了挑战。（JEL H24, H75, J15, J24, J61, J82）

records.title_en: The Fake News Effect: Experimentally Identifying Motivated Reasoning Using Trust in News
records.title_cn: 假新闻效应：利用对新闻的信任实验识别动机性推理
records.abstract_en: Motivated reasoning posits that people distort how they process information in the direction of beliefs they find attractive. This paper creates a novel experimental design to identify motivated reasoning from Bayesian updating when people have preconceived beliefs. It analyzes how subjects assess the veracity of information sources that tell them the median of their belief distribution is too high or too low. Bayesians infer nothing about the source veracity, but motivated beliefs are evoked. Evidence supports politically motivated reasoning about immigration, income mobility, crime, racial discrimination, gender, climate change, and gun laws. Motivated reasoning helps explain belief biases, polarization, and overconfidence. (JEL C91, D12, D72, D83, D91, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 动机性推理假定人们会以自己认为有吸引力的信念为方向，扭曲其信息处理方式。本文设计了一种新颖的实验设计，以在人们持有先入为主的信念时，从贝叶斯更新中识别动机性推理。它分析了受试者如何评估那些告诉他们其信念分布中位数过高或过低的信息来源的可信度。贝叶斯主义者无法推断出关于来源可信度的任何信息，但动机性信念会被唤起。证据支持关于移民、收入流动性、犯罪、种族歧视、性别、气候变化和枪支法律的动机性政治推理。动机性推理有助于解释信念偏差、两极分化和过度自信。（JEL C91, D12, D72, D83, D91, L82）

records.title_en: Multigame Contact: A Double-Edged Sword for Cooperation
records.title_cn: 多博弈接触：合作的双刃剑
records.abstract_en: We study experimentally the effect of multigame contact on cooperation, with each subject playing a pair of indefinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemmas. Multigame contact is present if a subject plays both games with a single partner, and it is absent if each of the two games is played with a different partner. In contrast to the theoretical prediction, multigame contact does not increase overall cooperation rates. Nonetheless, multigame contact systematically affects behavior and outcomes, acting like a double-edged sword, in the sense that subjects link decisions across games and, consequently, mutual cooperation and mutual defection in both games become more likely. (JEL C72, C73, C92, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究了多博弈接触对合作的影响，每个受试者参与一对无限重复的囚徒困境博弈。如果受试者与同一个伙伴进行两个博弈，则存在多博弈接触；如果两个博弈分别与不同的伙伴进行，则不存在多博弈接触。与理论预测相反，多博弈接触并未提高总体合作率。尽管如此，多博弈接触系统地影响了行为和结果，如同双刃剑，即受试者会跨博弈关联决策，因此两个博弈中的相互合作和相互背叛都变得更可能发生。（JEL C72, C73, C92, D91）

records.title_en: Media Competition and News Diets
records.title_cn: 媒体竞争与新闻食谱
records.abstract_en: Technological innovations like broadcast television and the internet challenge local newspapers’ business model of bundling their local content with third-party content, such as wire national news. We examine how the entry of television affected newspapers and news diets in the United States. We construct a dataset of newspapers’ economic performance and content choices from 1944 to 1964 and exploit quasi-random variation in the rollout of television to show its negative impact in the readership and advertising markets. Newspapers responded by reducing content, particularly local news. We tie this change to increased party vote share congruence between congressional and presidential elections. (JEL D72, L25, L82, M37, N42, N72)
records.abstract_cn: 广播电视和互联网等技术革新挑战了地方报纸将本地内容与第三方内容（如通讯社全国新闻）捆绑的商业模式。我们研究了电视的进入如何影响美国的报纸和新闻食谱。我们构建了一个从1944年到1964年报纸经济表现和内容选择的数据集，并利用电视推广中的准随机变化来展示其对读者和广告市场的负面影响。报纸通过减少内容，特别是本地新闻来应对。我们将这一变化与国会和总统选举之间政党选票份额一致性的增加联系起来。（JEL D72, L25, L82, M37, N42, N72）

records.title_en: Technology Transfer in Global Value Chains
records.title_cn: 全球价值链中的技术转移
records.abstract_en: Global value chains create opportunities for North-South technology diffusion. This paper studies technology transfer in value chains when contracts are incomplete and input production technologies are imperfectly excludable. It introduces a new taxonomy of value chains based on whether the headquarters firm benefits from imitation of its supplier’s technology. In inclusive value chains, where imitation is beneficial, the headquarters firm promotes technology diffusion. But in exclusive value chains headquarters seek to limit supplier imitation. The paper analyzes how this distinction affects the returns to offshoring, the welfare effects of technical change, and the social efficiency of knowledge sharing. (JEL F16, J23, J24, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 全球价值链为南北技术扩散创造了机会。本文研究了当合同不完全且投入品生产技术不完全可排他时，价值链中的技术转移。它引入了一种新的价值链分类法，基于总部公司是否从模仿其供应商的技术中获益。在包容性价值链中，模仿是有益的，总部公司促进技术扩散。但在排他性价值链中，总部寻求限制供应商模仿。本文分析了这一区别如何影响离岸外包的回报、技术变革的福利效应以及知识共享的社会效率。（JEL F16, J23, J24, J31）

records.title_en: Equity Concerns Are Narrowly Framed
records.title_cn: 公平关切是狭隘框架的
records.abstract_en: Distributional decisions regularly involve multiple payoff components. In a series of experiments, we show that individuals sometimes exhibit narrow equity concerns: applying fairness preferences narrowly on a specific component of payoffs rather than on broader payoff consequences. This behavior results in different distributional decisions depending on which payoff component we frame individuals to consider. We document narrow equity concerns in an exceedingly simple setting—in which payoff components are tokens worth $0.01 and $0.02—and in context-rich applications including tax policy and worker compensation. (JEL C91, D63, D81, D91, H20, J33)
records.abstract_cn: 分配决策通常涉及多个收益组成部分。在一系列实验中，我们表明个体有时表现出狭隘的公平关切：将公平偏好狭隘地应用于收益的特定组成部分，而非更广泛的收益后果。这种行为导致不同的分配决策，取决于我们引导个体考虑的收益组成部分。我们在一个极其简单的环境中记录了狭隘的公平关切——其中收益组成部分是价值0.01美元和0.02美元的代币——以及在包括税收政策和工人补偿在内的丰富情境应用中。（JEL C91, D63, D81, D91, H20, J33）

records.title_en: Variety-Based Congestion in Online Markets: Evidence from Mobile Apps
records.title_cn: 在线市场中的品种拥堵：来自移动应用的证据
records.abstract_en: In many online markets, consumers have to spend time and effort browsing through products. The addition of new products could make other products less visible, creating congestion externalities. Using Android app store data, I take advantage of a natural experiment—a redesign of part of the store—to show evidence of congestion externalities online: more apps in the market directly reduce per app usage/downloads.
