We further identify two economic mechanisms, one is reduced cost of equity and increased equity and short-term loan issuance in both the equity and credit markets, the other is increased attention of stakeholders, which are the main channels through which fintech development boosts corporate ESG practices. Our research shed lights on how technological progress influences corporate organizations' long-term value behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 金融科技的兴起以及对环境、社会和治理（ESG）实践在企业战略方面的关注，代表了近年来两大主要经济趋势。本文考察了在新兴市场背景下，金融科技的发展如何影响企业的ESG实践。我们发现，金融科技的发展有助于改善企业的ESG活动，这一发现在多种定量扩展中均保持稳健。我们进一步识别出两种经济机制，一是降低股权成本并增加股权和短期贷款发行，在股权和信贷市场中均如此；二是利益相关者关注度的提高，这些是金融科技发展促进企业ESG实践的主要渠道。我们的研究揭示了技术进步如何影响企业组织的长期价值行为。

records.title_en: Understanding the effects of artificial intelligence on energy transition: The moderating role of Paris Agreement
records.title_cn: 理解人工智能对能源转型的影响：《巴黎协定》的调节作用
records.abstract_en: This study contributes to the existing literature by investigating and confirming a range of diverse outcomes related to the interplay of factors shaping the global energy transition (ET). Employing advanced methodologies, including the extension of the QVAR technique to short-term (SR), medium-term (MR), and long-term (LR) connectedness analysis, as well as the application of the CQ method to explore relationships within varying market conditions and timeframes, the study examines the interconnectedness of critical variables: artificial intelligence (AI), the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), the Paris Agreement (PA), green technologies (GT), geopolitical risk (GPR), and ET. The findings highlight several crucial insights. Firstly, all selected variables demonstrate substantial interconnectedness across different time horizons, except for MR, which exhibits comparatively weaker connectedness than SR and LR. Secondly, independent series reveal diverse impacts on ET across various market conditions and periods. For example, in SR, most series produce mixed effects on ET, with BRI having primarily adverse consequences and GPR predominantly yielding positive impacts. In MR, the influence of AI, PA, and GT on ET varies, while BRI enhances ET, and GPR essentially hampers it. Notably, in LR, AI, BRI, PA, and GT significantly promote ET, while GPR disrupts its progress. Additionally, the study underscores the dynamic and time-varying nature of the relationships between AI, BRI, PA, GT, GPR, and ET across different market conditions, thus holding essential implications for shaping global policies to foster sustainable energy transitions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究通过调查并确认一系列与塑造全球能源转型（ET）的因素相互作用相关的多样化结果，为现有文献做出了贡献。采用先进方法，包括将QVAR技术扩展到短期（SR）、中期（MR）和长期（LR）连通性分析，以及应用CQ方法探索不同市场条件和时间框架内的关系，本研究考察了关键变量之间的相互联系：人工智能（AI）、“一带一路”倡议（BRI）、《巴黎协定》（PA）、绿色技术（GT）、地缘政治风险（GPR）和ET。研究结果强调了几个关键见解。首先，所有选定变量在不同时间范围内表现出显著的相互联系，但MR除外，其连通性相对弱于SR和LR。其次，独立序列揭示了在不同市场条件和时期对ET的多样化影响。例如，在SR中，大多数序列对ET产生混合效应，其中BRI主要产生不利后果，而GPR主要产生积极影响。在MR中，AI、PA和GT对ET的影响各不相同，而BRI增强ET，GPR则基本阻碍ET。值得注意的是，在LR中，AI、BRI、PA和GT显著促进ET，而GPR则扰乱其进展。此外，研究强调了AI、BRI、PA、GT、GPR和ET之间关系在不同市场条件下的动态和时变性质，从而对制定促进可持续能源转型的全球政策具有重要意义。

records.title_en: Welfare implications of a tax on electricity: A semi-parametric specification of the incomplete EASI demand system
records.title_cn: 电力税负的福利影响：不完全EASI需求系统的半参数设定
records.abstract_en: We perform a welfare analysis due to a tax on electricity consumption based on the incomplete exact affine Stone index (EASI) model using a novel data set in the Colombian economy. We provide a novel inferential framework based on a non-parametric specification of the stochastic errors using Dirichlet processes mixtures that allows handling non-normal errors, gaining efficiency, and taking into account, microeconomic restrictions, censoring, simultaneous endogeneity and non-linearity. We find that there is a 95% probability that the equivalent variation of the representative household is between US¢34.1 and US¢34.3, given an approximately 0.8% tariff increase (US¢0.12 per kWh). In addition, we observe that the welfare loss of the representative household of the lowest socioeconomic characteristics is approximately twice the loss of the representative household of the highest socioeconomic characteristics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于不完全精确仿射斯通指数（EASI）模型，使用哥伦比亚经济中的一组新颖数据集，对电力消费征税的福利影响进行了分析。我们提供了一个新颖的推断框架，该框架基于使用狄利克雷过程混合对随机误差进行非参数设定，允许处理非正态误差、提高效率，并考虑微观经济约束、审查、同时内生性和非线性。我们发现，在关税大约增加0.8%（每千瓦时0.12美分）的情况下，代表性家庭的等价变差有95%的概率介于34.1美分和34.3美分之间。此外，我们观察到，社会经济特征最低的代表性家庭的福利损失大约是社会经特征最高的代表性家庭福利损失的两倍。

records.title_en: Household's willingness to pay for renewable electricity: A meta-analysis
records.title_cn: 家庭对可再生能源电力支付意愿的元分析
records.abstract_en: Increasing the penetration of renewable electricity is a key solution to achieving the climate target. Demand-side payment is one crucial financial source to support the development of renewable electricity by influencing the cost-benefit tradeoff, which is usually measured by the willingness to pay. However, the willingness to pay estimation is mostly based on survey and hence incomparable due to different questions asked, assumptions made, and methods used. This paper reviewed 244 results from 134 empirical studies in 28 countries and applied a meta-regression to analyze how such features affect households' willingness to pay. We find that the willingness to pay turns scope-insensitive once the change in the penetration rate of renewables reaches the threshold (12%). Studies using contingent valuation methods yield higher estimation results compared with the other methods. Based on these results, we further calibrated previous willingness to pay results and provided a comparable worldwide dataset.
records.abstract_cn: 提高可再生能源电力的渗透率是实现气候目标的关键解决方案。需求侧支付是支持可再生能源发展的重要资金来源之一，它通过影响成本效益权衡来衡量，通常以支付意愿表示。然而，支付意愿的估计大多基于调查，由于所问问题、假设和方法的不同，结果往往不可比。本文回顾了28个国家134项实证研究中的244个结果，并应用元回归分析这些特征如何影响家庭的支付意愿。我们发现，一旦可再生能源渗透率的变化达到阈值（12%），支付意愿就变得对规模不敏感。使用条件价值评估法的研究相比其他方法得出的估计结果更高。基于这些结果，我们进一步校准了以往的支付意愿结果，并提供了一个可比的全球数据集。

records.title_en: Geopolitical risk: An opportunity or a threat to the green bond market?
records.title_cn: 地缘政治风险：绿色债券市场的机遇还是威胁？
records.abstract_en: Against the backdrop of growing political instability, the interaction between green bond prices (GBP) and geopolitical risk (GPR) has attracted widespread attention. By employing the rolling-window Granger causality method, we probe their dynamic relationship and investigate GPR's role in shaping green bond (GB) market prospects. Our outcomes disclose that GBP is positively and negatively affected by GPR. The favourable effect suggests that GPR creates an opportunity for the GB market development, which also reveals the significance of GB as a hedge asset in times of geopolitical turmoil. However, high GPR can raise investors' concerns about the GB market outlook, and the reduction in investment demand causes GBP to decline. In contrast, GBP produces a favourable shock in GPR, as interest competition for renewable energy backed by GB will exacerbate the outbreak of geopolitical conflicts. In the context of geopolitical turmoil, investors can include GB in their portfolios to mitigate external shocks from the geopolitical environment. Moreover, governments can predict GPR changes by grasping the GB market fluctuations, thereby reducing the adverse effects triggered by geopolitical shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 在政治不稳定性日益加剧的背景下，绿色债券价格（GBP）与地缘政治风险（GPR）之间的相互作用引起了广泛关注。通过采用滚动窗口格兰杰因果方法，我们探讨了它们之间的动态关系，并研究了GPR在塑造绿色债券（GB）市场前景中的作用。我们的研究结果显示，GBP受到GPR的正向和负向影响。有利的影响表明，GPR为GB市场发展创造了机遇，这也揭示了GB在地缘政治动荡时期作为对冲资产的重要性。然而，高GPR可能提高投资者对GB市场前景的担忧，投资需求的减少导致GBP下降。相反，GBP对GPR产生有利冲击，因为由GB支持的可再生能源的利益竞争将加剧地缘政治冲突的爆发。在地缘政治动荡的背景下，投资者可以将GB纳入其投资组合，以减轻来自地缘政治环境的外部冲击。此外，政府可以通过把握GB市场波动来预测GPR的变化，从而减少地缘政治冲击引发的不利影响。

records.title_en: Assessing the influence of artificial intelligence on the energy efficiency for sustainable ecological products value
records.title_cn: 评估人工智能对可持续生态产品价值能源效率的影响
records.abstract_en: In the context of sustainable development, the enhancement of energy efficiency (EF) for achieving cleaner production has become a prominent area of academic interest. Accordingly, this study explores the correlation between artificial intelligence (AI) investments and corporate EF to strike a balance between economic growth and ecological products value realization. In light of the “double carbon” target constraints and economic challenges, addressing this question holds paramount theoretical and practical significance. This study primarily utilizes data from Chinese listed companies from 2007 to 2021 to gauge the influence of AI on corporate EF. Results of our benchmark regression analysis reveal that a 1 percentage point increase in AI investment can lead to a corresponding 0.0228 percentage point improvement in enterprise EF. Additionally, employing the Heckman model, our study establishes that the enterprise EF data examined herein has no sample selection bias. Furthermore, no endogenous selection issues were observed within the scope of our study. Exploring the mechanisms of this relationship, our analysis demonstrates that the number of independent green patent applications and the sustainability accounting index strengthen the positive impact of AI on corporate EF. Thus, this paper offers valuable insights and reference points for businesses aiming to enhance their energy conservation and emissions reduction efforts.
records.abstract_cn: 在可持续发展的背景下，提高能源效率（EF）以实现清洁生产已成为学术界关注的焦点。因此，本研究探讨了人工智能（AI）投资与企业EF之间的相关性，以平衡经济增长与生态产品价值实现。在“双碳”目标约束和经济挑战下，回答这一问题具有重要的理论和实践意义。本研究主要利用2007年至2021年中国上市公司的数据来衡量AI对企业EF的影响。我们的基准回归分析结果显示，AI投资每增加1个百分点，企业EF相应提高0.0228个百分点。此外，采用Heckman模型，我们的研究证实了所考察的企业EF数据不存在样本选择偏差。而且，在我们的研究范围内未观察到内生选择问题。在探讨这种关系的机制时，我们的分析表明，独立绿色专利申请数量和可持续性会计指数增强了AI对企业EF的积极影响。因此，本文为企业提升节能减排工作提供了有价值的见解和参考点。

records.title_en: Network infrastructure and corporate environmental performance: Empirical evidence from “Broadband China”
records.title_cn: 网络基础设施与企业环境绩效：来自“宽带中国”的经验证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines the effects and mechanisms of network infrastructure construction on corporate environmental performance (CEP). We use Broadband China (BC) as an exogenous shock and construct a staggered Difference-in-differences (DID) model using data of Chinese firm's pollution between 2009 and 2015. We find that the implementation of BC can significantly reduce firms' pollutant emissions and improve CEP. The results are robust to various checks, including the parallel trend tests, elimination of other policies, placebo tests and the consideration of the policy's time-varying heterogeneous treatment effect. The mechanism test results indicate that the implementation of BC encourages firms to cut down emissions through the channel of strengthening external supervision, improving technological innovation, and optimizing management. The heterogeneous analysis reveals that BC has more significant effects on pollutant emissions of state-owned enterprises (SOEs), firms in regions with low marketization, and firms in regions with strong government intervention.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了网络基础设施建设对企业环境绩效（CEP）的影响及机制。我们以“宽带中国”（BC）作为外生冲击，利用2009年至2015年间中国企业的污染数据，构建了交错双重差分（DID）模型。我们发现，BC的实施能显著降低企业的污染物排放并改善CEP。该结果在多种检验下均保持稳健，包括平行趋势检验、排除其他政策、安慰剂检验以及考虑政策时变异质性处理效应。机制检验结果表明，BC的实施通过加强外部监督、促进技术创新和优化管理渠道促使企业减少排放。异质性分析显示，BC对国有企业（SOEs）、市场化程度较低地区的企业以及政府干预较强地区的企业的污染物排放具有更显著的影响。

records.title_en: Does voluntary environmental information disclosure prevent stock price crash risk? – Comparative analysis of chaebol and non-chaebol in Korea
records.title_cn: 自愿性环境信息披露能否防范股价崩盘风险？——韩国财阀与非财阀的比较分析
records.abstract_en: This research sheds light upon the relationship between Korean firms' voluntary carbon disclosure tendency, as measured in Environmental Information Disclosure (EID), and their stock price crash. We pay attention to whether firms' affiliation to the chaebols, unique conglomerates in the nation, and environmentally sensitive industry, play as decisive role in mitigating stock price crash. For analysis, we divide samples into two different categories – namely, chaebols and non-chaebols, and environmentally sensitive and non-environmentally sensitive firms. Our findings are as following. First, we find the negative relation between EID for Korean firms and price crash risk in general. Second, we prove a negative relationship between EID and stock price crash for non-chaebols, which implies that their effort for voluntary environmental information disclosure reduces information asymmetries, thereby mitigating firm risk. Lastly, we find the negative relationship between EID and stock price crash for firms in non-environmentally sensitive industries, implying that their effort for voluntary carbon disclosure is more rewarded by investors and capital market.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究揭示了韩国企业自愿性碳披露倾向（以环境信息披露（EID）衡量）与其股价崩盘之间的关系。我们关注企业是否隶属于财阀（该国特有的企业集团）以及是否属于环境敏感行业，在缓解股价崩盘方面是否起到决定性作用。为进行分析，我们将样本分为两类——即财阀与非财阀，以及环境敏感型与非环境敏感型企业。我们的发现如下。首先，我们发现韩国企业的EID与股价崩盘风险总体上呈负相关关系。其次，我们证明了非财阀企业的EID与股价崩盘之间存在负相关关系，这表明其自愿性环境信息披露的努力减少了信息不对称，从而降低了企业风险。最后，我们发现非环境敏感行业企业的EID与股价崩盘之间存在负相关关系，这表明其自愿性碳披露的努力更受投资者和资本市场的回报。

records.title_en: New media environment, green technological innovation and corporate productivity: Evidence from listed companies in China
records.title_cn: 新媒体环境、绿色技术创新与企业生产率：来自中国上市公司的证据
records.abstract_en: Amid new media growth in China, the environment of media information becomes an emerging factor in corporate production, while corporate green technological innovation has both signal and substance attributes in production decisions. However, few studies discuss this phenomenon, and clarifying the mechanisms between the new media environment (NME), green technological innovation (GTI), and corporate productivity is essential to enhance enterprise competitiveness. To investigate the new media environment, green technological innovation, and their synergy effect on corporate production performance, this paper employs a semi-parametric method to measure corporate total factor productivity. Then, we employ the online news data to measure the new media environment with different types of attitudes, and the green innovation authorization, application, and citation data to substitute for the quantity and quality of green technology. We employ the listed companies in China from 2010 to 2021 as our study subjects. The results demonstrate that (i) the NME and GTI have significant and positive effects on corporate productivity; (ii) the synergy effect of NME and GTl has a significant and positive effect on corporate productivity. After endogeneity and robustness tests, the conclusions of (i) and (ii) are still valid. (iii) Heterogeneity exists in (i) - (ii) due to the NME and GTl aspects, corporate factor intensive, and locations. Based on these findings, we propose implications for business and government administration.
records.abstract_cn: 在中国新媒体发展的背景下，媒体信息环境成为企业生产中的新兴因素，而企业绿色技术创新在生产决策中兼具信号和实质属性。然而，鲜有研究探讨这一现象，厘清新媒体环境（NME）、绿色技术创新（GTI）与企业生产率之间的机制对于提升企业竞争力至关重要。为考察新媒体环境、绿色技术创新及其对企业生产绩效的协同效应，本文采用半参数方法测算企业全要素生产率。随后，我们利用在线新闻数据衡量具有不同态度类型的新媒体环境，并利用绿色创新授权、申请和引用数据替代绿色技术的数量和质量。我们以2010年至2021年中国上市公司为研究对象。结果表明：（i）新媒体环境和绿色技术创新对企业生产率具有显著正向影响；（ii）新媒体环境与绿色技术创新的协同效应对企业生产率具有显著正向影响。经过内生性和稳健性检验后，（i）和（ii）的结论仍然成立。（iii）由于新媒体环境和绿色技术创新方面的差异、企业要素密集度和地理位置，（i）-（ii）存在异质性。基于这些发现，我们为企业管理和政府管理提出了启示。

records.title_en: An option game model applicable to multi-agent cooperation investment in energy storage projects
records.title_cn: 适用于储能项目多主体合作投资的一种期权博弈模型
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes an option game model that is applicable to multi-agent cooperation investment in energy storage projects. A power grid enterprise and power generation enterprise are assumed to act as the cooperation investors. A revenue sharing coefficient and cost distribution coefficient are introduced to simulate the realistic cooperation behavior of energy storage investment. The uncertainty of electricity prices and investment cost are also integrated into the model. The proposed model is used to carry out a comparative static analysis and a case study. The results show the investment value and the optimal investment trigger for the cooperation investment. Compared with single-agent investment, cooperation investment will bring high investment value for the power generation enterprise, while the investment trigger would also be raised. The revenue sharing coefficient is positively related to the investment value and the investment trigger of the power grid enterprise. The cost distribution coefficient is positively related to the investment trigger of the power generation enterprise, but negatively related to the power grid enterprise. The volatility of electricity prices is positively related to the investment trigger, both for the power generation enterprise and the power grid enterprise. Also, the investment trigger of the power generation enterprise is more affected by the volatility of electricity prices. Learning effects and subsidy can reduce the investment trigger.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种适用于储能项目多主体合作投资的期权博弈模型。假设电网企业和发电企业作为合作投资者。引入收益分配系数和成本分摊系数来模拟储能投资中现实合作行为。电价的不确定性和投资成本也被纳入模型中。利用所提出的模型进行了比较静态分析和案例研究。结果表明了合作投资的投资价值和最优投资触发值。与单一主体投资相比，合作投资将为发电企业带来更高的投资价值，同时投资触发值也会提高。收益分配系数与电网企业的投资价值和投资触发值正相关。成本分摊系数与发电企业的投资触发值正相关，但与电网企业负相关。电价波动性与发电企业和电网企业的投资触发值均正相关。此外，发电企业的投资触发值受电价波动性的影响更大。学习效应和补贴可以降低投资触发值。

records.title_en: Connectedness between oil price shocks and US sector returns: Evidence from TVP-VAR and wavelet decomposition
records.title_cn: 油价冲击与美国行业收益之间的关联性：来自TVP-VAR和小波分解的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the dynamic return and volatility connectedness between oil price shocks (demand, supply, and risk shocks) and US sector returns from October 2001 to January 2022. For this purpose, we combine the decomposition of the time series in time scales through the wavelet approach with the application of the TVP-VAR model proposed by Antonakakis et al. (2020). Our results show the high dynamic connectedness between markets and allow the identification of the role of all sector indices (except Communication Services, Utilities and Real Estate) and risk shocks as net contributors of shocks to the system, whereas demand and supply shocks are net receivers of spillovers. We further explore and document from a portfolio performance perspective the benefits of diversified portfolios comprised of all consider sector indices that include assets linked to the calculation of oil price shocks according to Ready (2018).
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了从2001年十月到2022年一月期间，油价冲击（需求、供给和风险冲击）与美国行业收益之间的动态收益和波动率关联性。为此，我们将小波方法对时间序列的时间尺度分解与Antonakakis等人（2020）提出的TVP-VAR模型相结合。我们的结果显示市场之间存在高度的动态关联性，并能够识别所有行业指数（除通信服务、公用事业和房地产外）以及风险冲击作为系统冲击的净贡献者的角色，而需求和供给冲击则是溢出效应的净接收者。我们进一步从投资组合绩效的角度探讨并记录了由所有考虑的行业指数组成的多元化投资组合的收益，这些指数包括与Ready（2018）根据油价冲击计算相关的资产。

records.title_en: Does gender diversity in politics improve access to electricity and electrification inequality? A global analysis
records.title_cn: 政治中的性别多样性是否改善了电力获取和电气化不平等？一项全球分析
records.abstract_en: Vast literature expounds that women are more sustainability-conscious and are more affected by issues of energy poverty. Another strand of literature upholds the effect of women's empowerment on social and sustainability outcomes. Goal 5 of the Sustainable Development Goals, among other things, seeks to reduce gender inequality, intensify women's empowerment and increase the participation and involvement of women in decision-making and politics. In line with this, this paper seeks to examine the impact of women's involvement in decision-making, and in this case, politics on access to electricity and the rural-urban divide in access to electricity. Women's involvement in politics is measured with the percentage of women holding seats in national parliaments. With a global sample of 111 countries over the period 2000–2020 and employing event study analysis and instrumental variable estimation with gender quota as an instrument, the following results are observed. Firstly, the event study analysis shows that access to electricity and equality in access to electricity are higher and significantly different for the adopters of gender quotas than the countries that never adopted the gender quotas policy. Secondly, an increase in women parliamentarians is associated with a significant increase in access to electricity and rural-urban equality in access to electricity. Thirdly, these findings are broadly consistent and robust across geographical regions and income groups (except for upper-middle-income countries). Lastly, increase in women parliamentarians is associated with a significant increase in access to electricity and rural-urban equality in access to electricity in countries with reserved seat quotas and not countries with candidate quotas. Our findings highlight that empowering women politically could contribute to addressing global energy poverty while ensuring equity in energy access.
records.abstract_cn: 大量文献阐述女性更具可持续性意识，且更容易受到能源贫困问题的影响。另一部分文献则支持女性赋权对社会和可持续性成果的影响。可持续发展目标中的目标5，除其他事项外，旨在减少性别不平等、加强女性赋权并提高女性在决策和政治中的参与度。据此，本文旨在考察女性参与决策（在此指政治）对电力获取以及城乡电力获取差距的影响。女性在政治中的参与度以国家议会中女性议员所占百分比来衡量。基于2000-2020年期间111个国家的全球样本，采用事件研究分析和以性别配额为工具变量的工具变量估计，观察到以下结果。首先，事件研究分析显示，采用性别配额的国家在电力获取和电力获取平等方面显著高于从未采用性别配额政策的国家。其次，女性议员比例的增加与电力获取和城乡电力获取平等的显著提高相关。第三，这些发现在不同地理区域和收入群体（除中高收入国家外）中大体一致且稳健。最后，女性议员比例的增加与实行保留席位配额的国家而非候选人配额国家的电力获取和城乡电力获取平等的显著提高相关。我们的发现强调，赋予女性政治权力可能有助于解决全球能源贫困问题，同时确保能源获取的公平性。

records.title_en: Impacts of electricity price reform on Saudi regional fuel consumption and CO2 emissions
records.title_cn: 电价改革对沙特区域燃料消耗和二氧化碳排放的影响
records.abstract_en: Saudi Arabia enacted two waves of energy price reforms in 2016 and 2018 to effectively gauge their impact to curb historically fast-growing electricity demand. We quantify the effects of these policy measures on regional fuel consumption and carbon emissions. We model the resulting emissions and fuel savings on the supply side using an optimization model representing Saudi Arabia's power generation sector. We estimate that between 2016 and 2019, electricity demand decreased by 8.8% per year on average following price reforms, resulting in USD 1.4 billion in fuel savings. International oil prices would bring the total savings up to USD 9.8 billion. Moreover, we show that the two waves of reforming electricity prices avoided 81–102 million tons of carbon dioxide emissions, i.e., a potential increase of 8.2%–10.4% of the power sector's emissions. Our results for Saudi Arabia demonstrate the benefits of reforming energy prices for countries with administered tariffs as an effective tool to reduce inefficient demand and carbon emissions to achieve climate pledges.
records.abstract_cn: 沙特阿拉伯在1.4年和9.8年实施了两轮能源价格改革，以有效衡量其对抑制历史上快速增长的电力的需求的影响。我们量化了这些政策措施对区域燃料消耗和碳排放的影响。我们使用代表沙特阿拉伯发电部门的优化模型，在供应侧模拟了由此产生的排放和燃料节约。我们估计，在2016年至2018年间，价格改革后电力需求平均每年下降2016，节省了2019亿美元的燃料成本。国际油价将使总节省额达到8.8%亿美元。此外，我们表明，两轮电价改革避免了81万至102亿吨二氧化碳排放，即电力部门排放量可能增加8.2%至10.4%。我们对沙特阿拉伯的研究结果证明了，对于实行行政定价的国家来说，能源价格改革作为减少低效需求和碳排放以实现气候承诺的有效工具的好处。

records.title_en: Greening through finance: Green finance policies and firms' green investment
records.title_cn: 通过金融实现绿色：绿色金融政策与企业绿色投资
records.abstract_en: Green investment plays a crucial role in bolstering pollution control efforts and enhancing environmental quality. As an influential financial instrument, Green Finance has gained significant traction among global policymakers for its ability to motivate businesses to actively participate in sustainable practices. This study seeks to bridge existing research gaps by examining how the implementation of Green Finance Reform and Innovation Pilot Zones (GFRI) influences corporate green investments causally. Utilizing the Difference-in-Differences identification strategy with the establishment of GFRI in 2017, our findings provide strong evidence that GFRI effectively stimulates corporate green investments. The conclusion remains robust through a series of tests. Furthermore, we investigate three potential mechanisms that may elucidate this positive impact: external financing, corporate environmental consciousness, and government attention to the environment. Specifically, GFRI imposes penalties on high-pollution enterprises (HPEs), leading to decreased access to external funding, while rewarding non-high-pollution (NHPEs) enterprises with increased access to external funding. Simultaneously, it fosters corporate awareness of environmental issues and amplifies governmental focus on the environment and the effectiveness of environmental law enforcement. Additionally, our findings suggest that GFRI's influence is more pronounced for HPEs and state-owned enterprises but less significant for companies that have already established environmental management systems. In summary, our research offers novel insights into the impact of green finance on corporate investment.
records.abstract_cn: 绿色投资在加强污染控制和提升环境质量方面发挥着关键作用。作为一种有影响力的金融工具，绿色金融因其能够激励企业积极参与可持续实践而受到全球政策制定者的广泛关注。本研究旨在通过考察绿色金融改革创新试验区（GFRI）的实施如何因果性地影响企业绿色投资，来弥合现有研究空白。利用双重差分识别策略，以2017年GFRI的设立为基础，我们的研究结果提供了强有力的证据，表明GFRI有效刺激了企业绿色投资。这一结论在一系列检验中保持稳健。此外，我们探讨了可能解释这一积极影响的三个潜在机制：外部融资、企业环保意识和政府对环境的关注。具体而言，GFRI对高污染企业（HPEs）施加惩罚，导致其外部融资渠道减少，同时奖励非高污染企业（NHPEs），使其外部融资渠道增加。同时，它促进了企业对环境问题的认识，并增强了政府对环境的关注以及环境执法的有效性。此外，我们的研究结果表明，GFRI的影响对高污染企业和国有企业更为显著，但对已经建立环境管理体系的企业影响较小。总之，我们的研究为绿色金融对企业投资的影响提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: A pathway to coordinated regional development: Energy utilization efficiency and green development - Evidence from China's major national strategic zones
records.title_cn: 迈向区域协调发展的路径：能源利用效率与绿色发展——来自中国主要国家战略区的证据
records.abstract_en: According to the new economic geography hypothesis, this study establishes an analytical framework to assess the efficiency of energy use and the progress of green development. The framework is based on panel data collected from 254 cities at the prefecture level in China. The spatial Durbin model is employed to examine the influence and spatial spillover effect of energy utilization efficiency on green development in major national strategic zones. The results show that: improving energy utilization efficiency promotes green development in major national strategic regions, with a stronger intra-regional transfer effect than inter-regional. This is confirmed by robustness and endogeneity analyses. The spillover intensity of energy utilization efficiency on green development varies across regions. It shows an inverted U-shape curve in the Yangtze River Economic Belt, a U-shape curve in the Yellow River Basin and Yangtze River Delta region, a diminishing margin in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and a growing margin in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. There is significant spatial heterogeneity within these regions. Different mediating mechanisms affect green development in different regions. The knowledge spillover effect mediates energy utilization efficiency's impact on green development in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the industry linkage effect in the Yangtze River Economic Belt and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the environmental improvement effect in the Yellow River Basin, and the market linkage effect in the Yangtze River Delta region. To promote regional coordinated development with energy utilization efficiency, the country should not only consider differences between national strategic areas but also focus on the effects of different paths to realize the complementarity between energy utilization efficiency and green development.
records.abstract_cn: 根据新经济地理学假说，本研究建立了一个评估能源利用效率和绿色发展进展的分析框架。该框架基于从中国254个地级市收集的面板数据。采用空间杜宾模型考察能源利用效率对主要国家战略区绿色发展的影响及空间溢出效应。结果表明：提高能源利用效率促进了主要国家战略区域的绿色发展，且区域内转移效应强于区域间。这一结论通过稳健性和内生性分析得到证实。能源利用效率对绿色发展的溢出强度在不同区域间存在差异。在长江经济带呈倒U型曲线，在黄河流域和长三角地区呈U型曲线，在京津冀地区呈边际递减，在粤港澳大湾区呈边际递增。这些区域内存在显著的空间异质性。不同的中介机制对不同区域的绿色发展产生影响。知识溢出效应在粤港澳大湾区中介了能源利用效率对绿色发展的影响，产业联动效应在长江经济带和京津冀地区起作用，环境改善效应在黄河流域起作用，市场联动效应在长三角地区起作用。为以能源利用效率促进区域协调发展，国家不仅应考虑国家战略区域间的差异，还应关注不同路径的效果，以实现能源利用效率与绿色发展的互补性。

records.title_en: Do the benefits outweigh the disadvantages? Exploring the role of artificial intelligence in renewable energy
records.title_cn: 利大于弊吗？探讨人工智能在可再生能源中的作用
records.abstract_en: Probing the essential role of artificial intelligence in the energy market is crucial to improving the development of renewable energy. The research adopts the full and sub sample methodologies to identify the interrelation of artificial intelligence index (AII) and renewable energy indicator (REI) in China. From the quantitative discussions, it is shown that there are favourable and negative impacts from AII to REI, and the positive ones indicate that artificial intelligence plays an incentive role in developing renewable energy. However, this incentive role cannot permanently be established if AII's effect on REI is negative, which is mainly caused by non-renewable energy with less costs. In turn, there is a favourable influence from REI to AII during COVID-19, highlighting that the downturn in renewable energy and stock markets caused by this epidemic impedes the progress of artificial intelligence in China. In the context of a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation, the research would offer meaningful recommendations to facilitate the development of artificial intelligence, accelerate the application and promotion of artificial intelligence technology in the field of renewable energy, and build efficient models, processors and data centres through shifting to renewable energy.
records.abstract_cn: 探究人工智能在能源市场中的关键作用对于改善可再生能源的发展至关重要。本研究采用全样本和子样本方法，以识别中国人工智能指数（AII）与可再生能源指标（REI）之间的相互关系。定量讨论表明，AII对REI既有有利影响也有负面影响，其中正面影响表明人工智能在可再生能源发展中起到激励作用。然而，如果AII对REI的影响为负，这种激励作用无法持久，这主要是由于成本较低的非可再生能源所致。反过来，在COVID-19期间，REI对AII存在有利影响，这凸显了该流行病导致的可再生能源和股票市场的低迷阻碍了中国人工智能的进步。在新一轮科技革命和产业变革的背景下，本研究将为促进人工智能发展、加速人工智能技术在可再生能源领域的应用与推广，以及通过转向可再生能源构建高效模型、处理器和数据中心提供有意义的建议。

records.title_en: Income elasticity of residential electricity consumption in rural South Africa
records.title_cn: 南非农村居民电力消费的收入弹性
records.abstract_en: Analyses of residential electricity demand primarily rely on expenditure or aggregate data. However, newer sources of data, such as that from meter readings, are becoming available. In most circumstances, these newer sources cannot be matched to detailed information about the household. In this research, we make use of South Africa’s Domestic Electrical Load Study, one of the only sources available in a developing country that includes both meter and household level data. Due to some gaps in the meter readings, we focus our attention on average peak electricity consumption, estimating the income elasticity with respect to morning, evening, and the average across both morning and evening peaks. Although we find differences in income responsiveness in the morning, relative to the afternoon, and across quantiles of electricity consumption, these differences tend not to be statistically significant. We do, however, find heterogeneities in those elasticities that can be correlated with, in particular, appliance ownership, suggesting that the ownership of appliances makes electricity more of a necessity, or at least makes the services derived from electricity more necessary for the household.
records.abstract_cn: 居民电力需求的分析主要依赖于支出或总量数据。然而，新的数据来源，如抄表数据，正变得可用。在大多数情况下，这些较新的数据源无法与关于家庭的详细信息相匹配。在本研究中，我们利用了南非的家庭电力负荷研究，这是发展中国家可获得的少数同时包含抄表和家庭层面数据的数据源之一。由于抄表数据存在一些缺口，我们将注意力集中在平均峰值电力消费上，估计了相对于早晨、傍晚以及早晨和傍晚峰值的平均值的收入弹性。尽管我们发现早晨相对于下午的收入响应性以及电力消费分位数之间存在差异，但这些差异往往在统计上不显著。然而，我们确实发现了这些弹性中的异质性，这些异质性尤其可以与电器拥有量相关联，表明拥有电器使电力更成为一种必需品，或者至少使从电力中获得的服务对家庭更为必要。

records.title_en: A global perspective on the nexus between energy and stock markets in light of the rise of renewable energy
records.title_cn: 可再生能源崛起背景下能源与股票市场关系的全球视角
records.abstract_en: The rise in renewable energy and the associated divestment initiatives from fossil fuel around the world have become prominent in combating climate change. This paper revisits the relationship between energy and stock markets by accounting for renewable energy through the use of the Divisia index method. The paper contributes to the literature by using three renewable energy tariffs rather than relying on clean energy stocks as a proxy for renewable energy. We retrieve data for both the price and consumption of fossil energy (oil, coal and gas) and renewable energy (solar, wind and hydro). We estimate a Vector Autoregressive (VAR) model over the period 2000–2019 across 25 countries globally. Our study identifies a significant time-dependent dynamics between renewable energy and both the energy stock and carbon markets, while fossil energy has no significant influence on those markets. The increasing influence of renewable energy in this nexus signals to policymakers that investors have started to shift their focus of attention from fossil to renewable energy.
records.abstract_cn: 可再生能源的崛起以及全球范围内与之相关的化石燃料撤资倡议，在应对气候变化中日益突出。本文通过使用Divisia指数方法，将可再生能源纳入考量，重新审视了能源与股票市场之间的关系。本文的贡献在于使用三种可再生能源电价，而非依赖清洁能源股票作为可再生能源的代理变量。我们获取了化石能源（石油、煤炭和天然气）和可再生能源（太阳能、风能和水能）的价格与消费数据。我们估计了一个向量自回归（VAR）模型，时间跨度为2000年至2019年，覆盖全球25个国家。我们的研究识别出可再生能源与能源股票和碳市场之间存在显著的时间依赖动态关系，而化石能源对这些市场没有显著影响。可再生能源在这一关系中的影响力日益增强，向政策制定者传递出投资者已开始将关注焦点从化石能源转向可再生能源的信号。

records.title_en: Optimal revenue adjustment in the presence of exogenous demand variation
records.title_cn: 外生需求变动下的最优收入调整
records.abstract_en: This article examines optimal adjustments to a regulated firm’s revenue when realized revenue diverges from expected revenue due to exogenous variation in demand. The adjustments that are considered include those that arise under two popular forms of incentive regulation — price cap regulation (PCR) and revenue cap regulation (RCR). It is shown that the optimal revenue adjustment reflects the firm’s Lerner Index. The optimal policy differs from both PCR and RCR, but more closely resembles PCR (RCR) when the prevailing fixed charge for the firm’s service is large (small).
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了当实际收入因外生需求变动而与预期收入出现偏差时，对受管制企业收入的最优调整。所考虑的调整包括在两种流行的激励性管制形式——价格上限管制（PCR）和收入上限管制（RCR）——下产生的调整。研究表明，最优收入调整反映了企业的勒纳指数。最优政策不同于PCR和RCR，但当企业服务的现行固定收费较大（较小）时，更接近于PCR（RCR）。

records.title_en: The shift of embodied energy flows among the Global South and Global North in the post-globalisation era
records.title_cn: 后全球化时代全球南方与全球北方之间隐含能源流动的转变
records.abstract_en: Concerns about the energy associated with the manufacturing of a product or service or so-called embodied energy in international trade have been increasing due to global energy shortages and environmental degradation. With globalisation slowing, the shifting global spatial patterns and driving forces of energy embodied in international trade deserve deeper investigation. Using the most up-to-date multi-regional input-output database (GTAP 11), we analyse the spatial pattern and driving forces of change for energy embodied in international trade among the Global North and South, namely developed and developing countries, from 2000 to 2019. The results show that North-North trade dominates global embodied energy transfers, although its dominance is waning. The growth of embodied energy transfers is shifting from South-North to South-South trade. Yet the difference in embodied energy transfers between the Global South to Global North remains huge. In further parsing the drivers behind embodied energy transfers, we find that the scale of trade was the primary driver of growth in global embodied energy transfers, but its effect was fading and even had a weak negative effect on North-North and North-South embodied energy transfers between 2014 and 2019. Energy intensity was the primary inhibitor of global embodied energy transfers but with a declining influence except for South-South trade in the later stage (−24.28% during 2014–2019). The role of trade structure effects on global embodied energy transfers became increasingly evident, especially in the later phase (2014–2019) for South-South (33.08%) and South-North trade (13.22%). In contrast, changes in production structure had a small impact on global embodied energy transfers. The findings show the importance of portraying embodied energy flows to help identify the main drivers and reemphasize the need to reduce energy consumption along global value chains.
records.abstract_cn: 由于全球能源短缺和环境退化，人们对产品或服务制造过程中相关能源（即国际贸易中的隐含能源）的关注日益增加。随着全球化放缓，国际贸易中隐含能源的全球空间格局及其驱动力的变化值得深入研究。利用最新的多区域投入产出数据库（GTAP 11），我们分析了2000年至2019年间全球北方和南方（即发达和发展中国家）之间国际贸易中隐含能源的空间格局及变化驱动力。结果表明，北北贸易主导着全球隐含能源转移，尽管其主导地位正在减弱。隐含能源转移的增长正从南北贸易转向南南贸易。然而，全球南方到全球北方的隐含能源转移差异仍然巨大。在进一步解析隐含能源转移背后的驱动因素时，我们发现贸易规模是全球隐含能源转移增长的主要驱动力，但其影响正在减弱，甚至在2014年至2019年间对北北和南北隐含能源转移产生了微弱的负面影响。能源强度是全球隐含能源转移的主要抑制因素，但其影响在减弱，除了后期（2014-2019年间为−24.28%）的南南贸易。贸易结构效应对全球隐含能源转移的作用日益明显，尤其是在后期（2014-2019年）对南南贸易（33.08%）和南北贸易（13.22%）的影响。相比之下，生产结构的变化对全球隐含能源转移的影响较小。研究结果表明，描绘隐含能源流动有助于识别主要驱动因素，并重新强调减少全球价值链中能源消耗的必要性。

records.title_en: Energy Transition and the role of new natural gas turbines for power production: The case of GT11N2 M generators
records.title_cn: 能源转型与新型天然气涡轮机在电力生产中的作用：GT11N2 M发电机的案例
records.abstract_en: We study General Electric’s new combined-cycle natural gas generator called GT11N2 M upgrade and quantify its economic benefits and the environmental implications in Ontario. We propose a structural power supply chain model involving upstream supplier General Electric and downstream power firm TransAlta at Sarnia, construct generation, service and maintenance cost functions, and calibrate different customer demand curves using actual market and firm data in the Ontario market. We solve for Stackelberg equilibrium outcomes, and quantify prices, outputs, and emissions based on efficiency rates of GT11N2 M. We consider two types of cost efficiencies implied by GT11N2 M: upstream service and maintenance cost efficiency experienced by General Electric and downstream fuel cost efficiency experienced by TransAlta. We provide new insights in the realm of technology adoption. We find in equilibrium that there exists a large variation in electricity generation over operational modes of GT11N2 M: the total generation can increase in the range of 5% (under “Lifetime” mode) to 18% (under ”Maximum Continuous Load” mode). The output variation is nonlinear and the amount of carbon emissions is largely impacted by operating modes. In particular, the total greenhouse gas emission is expected to increase by 12% in the mixed-mode. Consequently, a policy implication of this research is that clean energy adoption facilitated by GT11N2 M is expected to increase carbon emission due to the “rebound effect”.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了通用电气的新型联合循环天然气发电机GT11N2 M升级版，并量化了其在安大略省的经济效益和环境影响。我们提出了一个结构化的电力供应链模型，涉及上游供应商通用电气和下游电力公司TransAlta在萨尼亚的运营，构建了发电、服务和维护成本函数，并使用安大略市场的实际市场和公司数据校准了不同的客户需求曲线。我们求解了Stackelberg均衡结果，并根据GT11N2 M的效率率量化了价格、产出和排放。我们考虑了GT11N2 M所隐含的两种成本效率：通用电气所经历的上游服务和维护成本效率，以及TransAlta所经历的下游燃料成本效率。我们在技术采用领域提供了新的见解。我们在均衡中发现，GT11N2 M在不同运行模式下的发电量存在很大差异：总发电量可以在“寿命”模式下的5%到“最大连续负荷”模式下的18%范围内增加。产出变化是非线性的，碳排放量在很大程度上受到运行模式的影响。特别是，在混合模式下，温室气体总排放量预计将增加12%。因此，这项研究的一个政策含义是，由GT11N2 M促进的清洁能源采用预计会因“反弹效应”而增加碳排放。

records.title_en: Low-carbon city pilots and site selection for migrant employment: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 低碳城市试点与农民工就业地点选择：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of China's Low-Carbon City Pilot (LCCP) program on employment site selection using the difference-in-differences (DID) method. We found that the LCCP significantly promoted the inflow of labor into pilot cities by promoting city-level industrial innovation and facilitating the transfer of industrial firms, while high-tech laborers were more inclined to migrate. We also found that laborers lacked incentives to integrate into local society after moving to the pilot cities, but their welfare levels certainly improved. The findings demonstrate the employment effects of a low-carbon policy and provide micro-empirical evidence for the driving factors of urban industrial transformation and labor geographical distribution.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究采用双重差分法（DID）考察了中国低碳城市试点（LCCP）项目对就业地点选择的影响。我们发现，LCCP通过促进城市层面的产业创新和推动工业企业转移，显著促进了劳动力向试点城市的流入，而高技术劳动力更倾向于迁移。我们还发现，劳动力在迁入试点城市后缺乏融入当地社会的动力，但其福利水平确实有所提高。研究结果展示了低碳政策的就业效应，并为城市产业转型和劳动力地理分布的驱动因素提供了微观实证证据。

records.title_en: Technological innovation and its influence on energy risk management: Unpacking China’s energy consumption structure optimisation amidst climate change
records.title_cn: 技术创新及其对能源风险管理的影响：气候变化背景下中国能源消费结构优化的解构
records.abstract_en: In the context of intensifying climate challenges, adept energy risk management is more pertinent than ever. This research pioneers an in-depth exploration into China’s pronounced reliance on high-polluting fossil fuels, utilising a decade’s worth of provincial data (2010–2020) to shed light on the intricate dynamics between technological innovation and energy consumption structure refinement. Notably, our findings unveil that technological advancements act as catalysts in streamlining energy consumption structures, serving as a bulwark against emergent climate-related risks. Yet, this positive trajectory is not immune to disruptions: volatility in crude oil futures prices has the potential to dampen these benefits, ushering in heightened financial risks. Our work further underscores pronounced regional variances; technological innovation yields diminished returns in the central and western regions compared to their eastern counterparts. An intriguing observation is the resilience exhibited by coal-dependent provinces to technological evolution, pointing towards entrenched energy infrastructure challenges. Crucially, this study is among the first to identify the dual roles of industrial structure evolution and energy pricing dynamics as mediators in energy risk management. Drawing from these insights, we advocate for a proactive harnessing of technological innovation, not merely as a tool, but as an imperative to drive China’s energy transformation, foster sustainable consumption, and lay the foundation for a fortified green and low-carbon technological ecosystem.
records.abstract_cn: 在气候挑战日益加剧的背景下，熟练的能源风险管理比以往任何时候都更为关键。本研究开创性地深入探讨了中国对高污染化石燃料的显著依赖，利用十年间的省级数据（2010-2020年）来阐明技术创新与能源消费结构优化之间的复杂动态。值得注意的是，我们的研究结果揭示，技术进步在优化能源消费结构中起到催化剂作用，成为抵御新兴气候相关风险的堡垒。然而，这一积极轨迹并非不受干扰：原油期货价格的波动有可能削弱这些益处，带来更高的金融风险。我们的工作进一步强调了显著的地区差异；与东部地区相比，中西部地区的技术创新回报递减。一个有趣的观察是，依赖煤炭的省份对技术演进表现出韧性，指向根深蒂固的能源基础设施挑战。至关重要的是，本研究是首批识别产业结构演进和能源定价动态作为能源风险管理中介的双重作用的研究之一。基于这些见解，我们主张积极利用技术创新，不仅作为工具，而且作为推动中国能源转型、促进可持续消费以及为强化绿色低碳技术生态系统奠定基础的当务之急。

records.title_en: Carbon emission and firms’ value: Evidence from Europe
records.title_cn: 碳排放与企业价值：来自欧洲的证据
records.abstract_en: Amidst the growing global concern about climate change, societies have taken increased interest in corporations’ output of greenhouse gas emissions, primarily CO2. Our study examines the direct and indirect effect of carbon emissions on firm value. We document that, in the European context, corporate carbon emissions are negatively associated with a company’s market valuation. Moreover, we find that CO2 emissions reduce the relevance of earnings (i.e., for high-polluting firms, earnings are less relevant for market valuation). Additionally, we show that the results are driven by Scope 1 emissions, not by Scopes 2 and 3. Finally, we establish that the country-level formal and informal institutions shape these effects.
records.abstract_cn: 在全球对气候变化日益关注的背景下，社会对企业温室气体排放（主要是二氧化碳）的关注度不断提高。我们的研究考察了碳排放对企业价值的直接和间接影响。我们证明，在欧洲背景下，企业碳排放与公司市场估值呈负相关。此外，我们发现二氧化碳排放降低了盈余的相关性（即对于高污染企业，盈余对市场估值的重要性降低）。进一步地，我们表明这一结果是由范围1排放驱动的，而非范围2和范围3。最后，我们确定国家层面的正式和非正式制度塑造了这些效应。

records.title_en: Oil price uncertainty shocks and the gender gap in U.S. unemployment
records.title_cn: 油价不确定性冲击与美国失业率的性别差距
records.abstract_en: This study relates to a new literature which investigates the distributional effects of uncertainty shocks. In particular, we examine the effect of oil price uncertainty on unemployment rates of different age cohorts based on gender in the U.S. We find that oil price uncertainty shocks tend to increase the female unemployment rate, although the effect tends to be smaller in magnitude than for the male unemployment rate in each age cohort, except those over 55. The largest disparity between males and females occurs in the younger working age cohorts. Our results are robust to three different measures of oil price uncertainty from three different empirical models: an SVAR with multivariate GARCH, an SVAR with implied volatility, and an asymmetric Markov switching ARCH model. Our results are also robust to a structural VAR which separately identifies shocks to oil demand and oil supply.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究涉及一项新的文献，该文献探讨不确定性冲击的分配效应。具体而言，我们考察了油价不确定性对美国不同年龄段按性别划分的失业率的影响。我们发现，油价不确定性冲击倾向于提高女性失业率，尽管在每个年龄段，其影响幅度往往小于男性失业率，但55岁以上年龄段除外。男女之间最大的差距出现在较年轻的劳动年龄组。我们的结果对来自三个不同实证模型的三种不同油价不确定性度量具有稳健性：具有多元GARCH的SVAR、具有隐含波动率的SVAR以及非对称马尔可夫转换ARCH模型。我们的结果也对一个分别识别石油需求和石油供应冲击的结构VAR具有稳健性。

records.title_en: How does artificial intelligence affect pollutant emissions by improving energy efficiency and developing green technology
records.title_cn: 人工智能如何通过提高能源效率和开发绿色技术影响污染物排放
records.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) can revolutionize production process by improving energy efficiency, reducing costs, and developing green technology. Among the most important applications of AI technology, industrial robots are increasingly being used in production and have become significant feature of high-quality ecinomic development. Concerning this issue, this study uses the provincial panel data from China from 2010 to 2019 to explore how adopting industrial robots affects regional pollution emissions. We find that industrial robots significantly reduce the pollution emissions intensity in various provinces of China, and this conclusion holds following a series of robustness tests. Mechanism analysis shows that industrial robots reduce pollutant emissions intensity by improving energy efficiency and enhancing pollution reduction technologies. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that industrial robots significantly reduce pollution emissions intensity in the eastern and western regions of China, as well as in regions outside the Yangtze River Economic Belt, while this effect is significant for the central region and the Yangtze River Economic Belt. Industrial robots primarily promote pollution reduction in the eastern region, rather than enhancing regional energy efficiency. For the western region and regions outside the Yangtze River Economic Belt, the reduction in pollution emissions intensity appears to be attributable to both mechanisms. The above findings enrich the study on the impact of industrial robots on green production behavior and provide insights into pollution emissions control for some provinces of China.
records.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）可以通过提高能源效率、降低成本和开发绿色技术来革新生产过程。在AI技术最重要的应用中，工业机器人越来越多地用于生产，并已成为高质量经济发展的重要特征。针对这一问题，本研究利用中国2010年至2019年的省级面板数据，探讨采用工业机器人如何影响区域污染排放。我们发现，工业机器人显著降低了中国各省的污染排放强度，这一结论在一系列稳健性检验后仍然成立。机制分析表明，工业机器人通过提高能源效率和增强污染减排技术来降低污染物排放强度。异质性分析显示，工业机器人显著降低了中国东部和西部地区以及长江经济带以外地区的污染排放强度，而这一效应对中部地区和长江经济带显著。工业机器人主要促进东部地区的污染减排，而非提高区域能源效率。对于西部地区和长江经济带以外地区，污染排放强度的降低似乎归因于这两种机制。上述发现丰富了关于工业机器人对绿色生产行为影响的研究，并为中国部分省份的污染排放控制提供了见解。

records.title_en: Religious atmosphere, seismic impact, and corporate charitable donations in China
records.title_cn: 宗教氛围、地震影响与中国企业慈善捐赠
records.abstract_en: This study examines the external socio-cultural and natural environment factors that driving corporate philanthropy in China. We focus on two predominant influences: religiosity, specifically the traditional Three-Teachings (Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism), and seismic activities. Using a large sample of 31,673 firm-year observations from Chinese listed firms from 2009 to 2020, our findings reveal that (a) firms immersed in more pronounced religious-cultural presence have higher donation incentives, and (b) firms experiencing higher seismic impacts or are located in high seismic risk areas show heightened corporate philanthropic tendencies. Our multidisciplinary approach bridges various academic disciplines, presenting an innovative framework for understanding the intersection of corporate philanthropy, socio-cultural environments, and natural disasters in China. Overall, we highlight the importance of external environmental factors in shaping corporate charitable behaviours.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了驱动中国企业慈善捐赠的外部社会文化和自然环境因素。我们关注两个主要影响：宗教性，特别是传统三教（儒教、佛教和道教），以及地震活动。使用2009年至2020年中国上市公司31,673个公司-年度观测值的大样本，我们的研究结果显示：（a）沉浸在更显著宗教文化氛围中的公司具有更高的捐赠动机，（b）经历更高地震影响或位于高地震风险区域的公司表现出更强的企业慈善倾向。我们的跨学科方法连接了多个学术领域，为理解中国企业中企业慈善、社会文化环境和自然灾害的交汇提供了一个创新框架。总体而言，我们强调了外部环境因素在塑造企业慈善行为中的重要性。

records.title_en: Organization capital and GHG emissions
records.title_cn: 组织资本与温室气体排放
records.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of organization capital on greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Utilizing a sample of 3817 firm-year observations of US publicly listed companies over the period from 2002 to 2019, we find that firms with higher organization capital are associated with lower GHG emissions. Our cross-sectional analysis reveals a stronger negative relationship between organizational capital and GHG emissions among firms characterized by better corporate governance and lower financing constraints. Moreover, this negative relationship is more evident for firms operating in carbon sensitive industries and regions that have implemented an emissions trading scheme (ETS). This result survives after applying a range of robustness tests and addressing endogeneity concerns. Further, we disaggregate total GHG emissions into direct and indirect emissions and find that high-organization capital firms tend to reduce both direct and indirect emissions. Taken together, our analysis suggests that organization capital has considerable implications for corporate GHG emissions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了组织资本对温室气体（GHG）排放的影响。利用2002年至2019年间美国上市公司3817个公司-年度观测样本，我们发现组织资本较高的公司与较低的温室气体排放相关。我们的横截面分析显示，在公司治理较好和融资约束较低的企业中，组织资本与温室气体排放之间的负相关关系更为显著。此外，这种负相关关系在碳敏感行业和已实施排放交易计划（ETS）地区的企业中更为明显。这一结果在应用一系列稳健性检验和处理内生性问题后仍然成立。进一步，我们将总温室气体排放分解为直接排放和间接排放，发现高组织资本企业倾向于减少直接和间接排放。综合来看，我们的分析表明组织资本对企业温室气体排放具有重要影响。

records.title_en: U.S. light tight oil supply flexibility - A multivariate dynamic model for production and rig activity
records.title_cn: 美国轻质致密油供应灵活性——产量与钻机活动的多变量动态模型
records.abstract_en: I examine U.S. light tight oil (LTO) production theoretically and empirically. The theoretical model combines endogenous rig activity and stylized reservoir pressure mechanics with the Hotelling model for exhaustible resources. The empirical section presents a vector error correction model for U.S. LTO production. A one percent increase in the West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price results in up to a 0.7 percent increase in LTO supply and a 1.5 percent increase in rig activity. A positive shock to LTO supply has a negative but insignificant effect on the WTI oil price. The results indicate a structural break in March 2020, with LTO being less responsive to the WTI after the outbreak of Covid-19.
records.abstract_cn: 我从理论和实证两方面考察了美国轻质致密油（LTO）产量。理论模型将内生钻机活动和风格化的油藏压力机制与可耗竭资源的霍特林模型相结合。实证部分提出了一个针对美国LTO产量的向量误差修正模型。西德克萨斯中质原油（WTI）价格每上涨百分之一，LTO供应最多增加0.7%，钻机活动增加1.5%。LTO供应的正向冲击对WTI原油价格有负向但不显著的影响。结果表明，2020年三月存在结构性断裂，在Covid-19爆发后，LTO对WTI的响应减弱。

records.title_en: Dynamic pricing and joint carbon reduction strategies at the production and consumption end in a dual-channel fuel vehicle supply chain
records.title_cn: 双渠道燃油汽车供应链中生产端与消费端的动态定价与联合碳减排策略
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates carbon reduction in a fuel automotive supply chain. It consists of a manufacturer responsible for carbon reduction and opening an online channel opportunely and a retailer who markets and sells the product through traditional offline channels. Consumers have a preference for low-carbon and low-fuel consumption. It first analyzes decentralized and centralized decision-making under dual channels as a benchmark for comparison. Then, compare the performance of single and dual channels under decentralized decision-making to explore the advantages and conditions of dual channels and link centralized decision-making to reveal the double marginal effect of the supply chain. Finally, it designs a marketing cost-sharing contract to coordinate the behavior of all parties in the supply chain. The results suggest that as long as consumer preference for online channels reaches a certain threshold, dual-channel operation leads to higher double-ended carbon reduction investment, lower prices, and higher total supply chain profits than single-channel, but instead decreases profits for the retailer. Besides, in contrast to decentralized decision-making, marketing cost-sharing contracts can improve profits for all parties in the supply chain, enhance carbon and fuel consumption reduction investment, and partially address the double-marginal effect of the supply chain.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了燃油汽车供应链中的碳减排问题。该供应链由负责碳减排并适时开通线上渠道的制造商和通过传统线下渠道营销和销售产品的零售商组成。消费者对低碳和低油耗有偏好。首先，分析了双渠道下的分散决策和集中决策，作为比较的基准。然后，比较分散决策下单一渠道和双渠道的表现，以探讨双渠道的优势和条件，并结合集中决策揭示供应链的双重边际效应。最后，设计了一个营销成本分摊契约来协调供应链各方的行为。结果表明，只要消费者对线上渠道的偏好达到一定阈值，双渠道运营相比单一渠道会带来更高的双端碳减排投资、更低的价格和更高的供应链总利润，但反而会降低零售商的利润。此外，与分散决策相比，营销成本分摊契约可以提高供应链各方的利润，增强碳和油耗减排投资，并部分解决供应链的双重边际效应问题。

records.title_en: Dust and Death: Evidence from the West African Harmattan
records.title_cn: 沙尘与死亡：来自西非哈马丹风的证据
records.abstract_en: Using two decades of data from 12 low-income countries in West Africa, we show that dust carried by harmattan trade winds increases infant and child mortality. Health investments respond to dust exposure, consistent with compensating behaviours. Despite these efforts, surviving children still exhibit negative health impacts. Our data allow us to investigate differential impacts over time and across countries. We find declining impacts over time, suggesting adaptation. Using national-level measures of macroeconomic conditions and health resources, we find suggestive evidence that both economic development and public health improvements have contributed to this adaptation, with health improvements playing a larger role.
records.abstract_cn: 利用西非12个低收入国家二十年的数据，我们表明哈马丹信风携带的沙尘增加了婴儿和儿童死亡率。健康投资对沙尘暴露作出反应，与补偿行为一致。尽管有这些努力，幸存的儿童仍然表现出负面的健康影响。我们的数据使我们能够研究时间和国家间的差异性影响。我们发现影响随时间递减，表明存在适应性。利用国家层面的宏观经济状况和卫生资源指标，我们发现有提示性证据表明经济发展和公共卫生改善都促进了这种适应性，其中卫生改善发挥了更大的作用。

records.title_en: Do Celebrity Endorsements Matter? A Twitter Experiment Promoting Vaccination in Indonesia
records.title_cn: 名人代言重要吗？印度尼西亚推广疫苗接种的推特实验
records.abstract_en: Do celebrity endorsements matter? And if so, how can celebrities communicate effectively? We conduct a nationwide Twitter experiment in Indonesia promoting vaccination. Celebrity messages are 72% more likely to be passed on or liked than similar messages without a celebrity’s imprimatur. In total, 66% of the celebrity effect comes from authorship, compared to passing on messages. Citing external medical sources decreases retweets by 27%. Phone surveys show that those randomly exposed to messaging have fewer incorrect beliefs and report more vaccination among friends and neighbours. The results can inform public health campaigns and celebrity public service more generally.
records.abstract_cn: 名人代言重要吗？如果重要，名人如何有效沟通？我们在印度尼西亚进行了一项全国性的推特实验，推广疫苗接种。名人发布的信息被转发或点赞的可能性比没有名人背书的类似信息高出72%。总体而言，名人效应的66%来自作者身份，而非转发信息。引用外部医学来源会使转发量减少27%。电话调查显示，随机接触到这些信息的人错误观念更少，并报告朋友和邻居中接种疫苗的人数更多。这些结果可以为公共卫生运动和更广泛的名人公益服务提供参考。

records.title_en: Human Capital and Financial Development: Firm-Level Interactions and Macroeconomic Implications
records.title_cn: 人力资本与金融发展：企业层面的互动与宏观经济影响
records.abstract_en: Capital-skill complementarity in production implies non-trivial interactions between the availability of human capital and financial constraints. Firms that are constrained in their access to finance hire a lower proportion of skilled workers than do unconstrained firms. Conversely, a lack of human capital increases skilled wages, reducing firms’ desired capital intensity and thus loosening firms’ effective financial constraints. To assess the macroeconomic implications of such firm-level interactions, we build an occupational-choice model with capital-skill complementarity in production, which we calibrate to US data. We vary financial frictions, educational attainment and total factor productivity across countries, and we quantify how aggregate output, wage inequality and entrepreneurship are affected by financial market liberalizations and increases in educational attainment. For aggregate output, the joint effect of both factors is, on average, 30% larger than the sum of the individual effects. Taking the educational attainment of the population as given, in countries with a negligible share of tertiary-educated workers and low total factor productivity, financial development has only small effects on aggregate output.
records.abstract_cn: 生产中的资本-技能互补性意味着人力资本可得性与金融约束之间存在非平凡的互动。融资受限的企业雇佣的技能工人比例低于不受约束的企业。相反，人力资本的缺乏会提高技能工资，降低企业期望的资本密集度，从而放松企业的有效金融约束。为了评估这种企业层面互动的宏观经济影响，我们构建了一个具有资本-技能互补性的职业选择模型，并用美国数据进行了校准。我们改变各国的金融摩擦、教育程度和全要素生产率，并量化金融市场自由化和教育程度提高对总产出、工资不平等和创业的影响。对于总产出，两者的联合效应平均比各自效应之和大30%。在给定人口教育程度的情况下，在受过高等教育工人占比可忽略且全要素生产率低的国家，金融发展对总产出的影响很小。

records.title_en: The Limitations of Activity-Based Instruction to Improve the Productivity of Schooling
records.title_cn: 活动式教学在提高学校教育生产力方面的局限性
records.abstract_en: There is substantial emphasis on improving classroom practices, primarily through activity-based instruction, to increase the productivity of schooling. We study a large programme that seeks to promote mathematics learning in government primary schools in India. Through a cluster-randomised trial we find that the programme increased activity-based instruction, but yielded only muted impacts on learning. We provide a potential explanation: school value-added models suggest a negative relationship between activity-based instruction and test score gains. Our findings are robust to adding a community-engagement component to the intervention. These results highlight the limitations of activity-based instruction programmes for increasing school productivity.
records.abstract_cn: 目前，人们高度重视改进课堂实践，主要通过活动式教学来提高学校的教育生产力。我们研究了一个旨在促进印度公立小学数学学习的大型项目。通过一项整群随机试验，我们发现该项目增加了活动式教学，但对学习的影响却微乎其微。我们提供了一个可能的解释：学校增值模型表明，活动式教学与考试成绩提升之间存在负相关关系。我们的发现在干预中加入社区参与成分后依然稳健。这些结果凸显了活动式教学项目在提高学校生产力方面的局限性。

records.title_en: p -Hacking, Data type and Data-Sharing Policy
records.title_cn: p-操纵、数据类型与数据共享政策
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the relationship between p-hacking, publication bias and data-sharing policies. We collect 38,876 test statistics from 1,106 articles published in leading economic journals between 2002–20. We find that, while data-sharing policies increase the provision of data, they do not decrease the extent of p-hacking and publication bias. Similarly, articles that use hard-to-access administrative data or third-party surveys, as compared to those that use easier-to-access (e.g., author-collected) data, are not different in their p-hacking and publication extent. Voluntary provision of data by authors on their home pages offers no evidence of reduced p-hacking.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了p-操纵、发表偏倚与数据共享政策之间的关系。我们收集了38876年至1106年间发表于顶级经济学期刊的2002篇文章中的20个检验统计量。我们发现，虽然数据共享政策增加了数据的提供，但并未减少p-操纵和发表偏倚的程度。同样，与使用较易获取（如作者自行收集）数据的文章相比，使用难以获取的行政数据或第三方调查数据的文章在p-操纵和发表程度上并无差异。作者在其主页上自愿提供数据并未显示出减少p-操纵的证据。

records.title_en: Radicalisation
records.title_cn: 激进化
records.abstract_en: This paper analyses the rise of radical movements and the design of counter-radicalisation policies. A group derives meaning from participation in identity-based activities and a forward-looking organisation provides a platform for these activities. The warning sign for radicalisation is cultural purification by the organisation, i.e., the screening out of moderates and exclusive recruitment of radicals. While this shrinks the club, it puts it on a growth path along which it becomes larger and more extreme over time. Conventional counter-radicalisation policies can backfire. The radicalisation mechanisms we identify can be disabled by mild anti-radical messaging and informational interventions that eliminate stereotypes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了激进运动的兴起及反激进化政策的设计。一个群体从参与基于身份认同的活动中获得意义，而一个前瞻性的组织为这些活动提供平台。激进化的警示信号是组织的文化净化，即筛选掉温和派并专门招募激进分子。虽然这缩小了俱乐部规模，但使其走上了一条增长路径，随着时间推移，该组织变得更大且更极端。传统的反激进化政策可能适得其反。我们识别的激进化机制可以通过温和的反激进信息和消除刻板印象的信息干预来削弱。

records.title_en: Declining Search Frictions, Unemployment and Self-Employment
records.title_cn: 搜索摩擦下降、失业与自雇
records.abstract_en: In most OECD countries, unemployment rates show no trend, which is puzzling if advancements in information and communication technologies decrease labour-market frictions. We show, both analytically and quantitatively, that accounting for the secular decline in self-employment rates solves the puzzle. While declining labour-market frictions can theoretically explain these trends, we provide contradictory causal evidence that the roll-out of broadband internet has increased self-employment and decreased unemployment rates. We reconcile these observations with a new model featuring frictions in both labour and goods markets. We explain falling self-employment and non-trending unemployment quantitatively by labour-market frictions declining relatively more than goods-market frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 在大多数OECD国家，失业率没有趋势性变化，如果信息和通信技术的进步减少了劳动力市场摩擦，这一现象令人费解。我们在分析和数量上都表明，考虑自雇率的长期下降可以解决这一难题。虽然劳动力市场摩擦的下降在理论上可以解释这些趋势，但我们提供了矛盾的因果证据，即宽带互联网的推广增加了自雇并降低了失业率。我们通过一个同时包含劳动力市场和商品市场摩擦的新模型来调和这些观察结果。我们通过劳动力市场摩擦相对于商品市场摩擦下降得更多，在数量上解释了自雇率的下降和失业率的无趋势变化。

records.title_en: Immigration, Female Labour Supply and Local Cultural Norms
records.title_cn: 移民、女性劳动供给与地方文化规范
records.abstract_en: We study the local evolution of female labour supply and cultural norms in West Germany in reaction to the sudden presence of East Germans who migrated to the West after reunification. These migrants grew up with high rates of maternal employment, whereas West German families mostly followed the traditional breadwinner-housewife model. We find that West German women increase their labour supply and that this holds within households. We provide additional evidence on stated gender norms, West-East friendships, intermarriage and child care infrastructure. The dynamic evolution of the effects on labour supply is best explained by local cultural learning.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了西德在统一后东德人突然涌入的情况下，女性劳动供给和文化规范的局部演变。这些移民在母亲就业率高的环境中长大，而西德家庭大多遵循传统的养家糊口-家庭主妇模式。我们发现西德女性增加了劳动供给，且这一效应在家庭内部成立。我们提供了关于陈述性别规范、东西德友谊、通婚和儿童保育基础设施的额外证据。劳动供给效应的动态演变最好由地方文化学习来解释。

records.title_en: Commuting for Crime
records.title_cn: 通勤犯罪
records.abstract_en: People care about crime, with the spatial distribution of both actual and perceived crime affecting the local amenities from living in different areas and residential decisions. The literature finds that crime tends to happen close to the offender's residence, but does not clearly establish whether this is because the location of likely offenders and crime opportunities are close to each other, whether more local crimes are likely to be solved or whether there is a high commuting cost for criminals. We use a rich administrative dataset from one of the biggest UK police forces to disentangle these hypotheses, proposing a procedure for controlling for the selection bias induced by the fact that an offender’s location is only known when they are caught. We find that the cost of distance is very high, especially for crimes without any financial gain. For property crimes, we find a similar cost of distance to commuting for legal work. We also investigate how local socio-economic characteristics affect both the number of criminals and the number of crimes.
records.abstract_cn: 人们关心犯罪，实际犯罪和感知犯罪的空间分布都会影响居住在不同地区的本地便利设施以及居住决策。文献发现，犯罪往往发生在犯罪者住所附近，但并未明确确定这是因为潜在犯罪者和犯罪机会的位置彼此接近，还是因为更多本地犯罪可能被侦破，或者是因为犯罪者面临较高的通勤成本。我们使用来自英国最大警察部队之一的丰富行政数据集来厘清这些假设，提出了一种控制因犯罪者仅在被捕时其位置才被知晓而产生的选择偏差的程序。我们发现距离成本非常高，尤其是对于没有任何经济收益的犯罪。对于财产犯罪，我们发现距离成本与合法工作通勤成本相似。我们还调查了当地社会经济特征如何影响犯罪者数量和犯罪数量。

records.title_en: Austerity Harmed Student Achievement
records.title_cn: 紧缩政策损害了学生成绩
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that austerity spending cuts harmed student performance in standardised national tests. To identify this relationship, we use cross-municipality variation in the timing of eligibility for the Italian Domestic Stability Pact as an exogenous shifter of local public spending. We then compare test scores for students that were from the same municipality, but who were exposed to different levels of austerity cuts based on their birth year. Combining administrative data on public spending and test scores with an instrumental variable model, we show that the test score impact from austerity spending cuts is around 5.1% of a standard deviation in math and 4.6% in reading. These effects are more pronounced for children with limited resources at home. We provide suggestive evidence that school budget cuts account for most of the observed test score impact.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，紧缩性支出削减损害了学生在标准化国家测试中的表现。为识别这一关系，我们利用意大利国内稳定公约资格时间在市政间的差异作为地方公共支出的外生变动因素。然后，我们比较来自同一市政、但根据出生年份面临不同紧缩削减水平的学生测试成绩。结合公共支出和测试成绩的行政数据与工具变量模型，我们表明，紧缩性支出削减对测试成绩的影响约为数学标准差的5.1%和阅读标准差的4.6%。这些影响对于家中资源有限的儿童更为显著。我们提供了提示性证据，表明学校预算削减解释了大部分观察到的测试成绩影响。

records.title_en: The Welfare Effects of Mobile Internet Access: Evidence from Roam-Like-at-Home
records.title_cn: 移动互联网接入的福利效应：来自“漫游如在家”的证据
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the welfare effects of the Roam-like-at-home regulation, which has drastically reduced the price of accessing the mobile Internet for residents of the European Economic Area when travelling abroad in the European Economic Area. Our estimates using individual-level consumption data suggest that consumer surplus increased by around €2.44 per user and travel day. We show that around 40% of the consumer surplus gains originated from a reduction in deadweight loss, that is, new users accessing the mobile Internet. We also highlight that the regulation had a heterogeneous impact on consumers, varying with usage intensity and the reason for travel (business versus leisure).
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了“漫游如在家”法规的福利效应，该法规大幅降低了欧洲经济区居民在欧洲经济区内出国旅行时使用移动互联网的价格。我们使用个人层面消费数据的估计表明，消费者剩余增加了约每用户每旅行日2.44欧元。我们显示，约40%的消费者剩余收益源于无谓损失的减少，即新用户接入移动互联网。我们还强调，该法规对消费者的影响具有异质性，随使用强度和旅行原因（商务与休闲）而变化。

records.title_en: Macroevolutionary Origins of Comparative Development
records.title_cn: 比较发展的宏观进化起源
records.abstract_en: Advances in evolutionary theories (the Extended Synthesis) demonstrate that organisms systematically modify environments in ways that influence their own and other species’ evolution. This paper utilises these theories to examine the economic consequences of human dispersal from Africa. Evidence shows that early humans’ dispersal affected the adaptability of animal species to human environments and, through this, the extinction of large mammals during Homo sapiens’ out-of-Africa migration. Empirical analyses explore the variation in extinction rates as a source of exogenous pressure for cooperation and innovation among hunter-gatherers and examine the impact of extinction on long-run development. The results indicate that extinction affects economic performance by driving continental differences in biogeography, disease environments and institutions. Eurasia’s location along the out-of-Africa migratory path provided human and animal populations with co-evolutionary foundations for domestication and agriculture, which gave Eurasians technological and institutional advantages in comparative development.
records.abstract_cn: 进化理论（扩展综合）的进展表明，生物体系统地改变环境，以影响自身及其他物种的进化。本文利用这些理论来考察人类从非洲扩散的经济后果。证据显示，早期人类的扩散影响了动物物种对人类环境的适应性，并由此影响了智人走出非洲迁徙期间大型哺乳动物的灭绝。实证分析探讨了灭绝率的变化作为狩猎采集者中合作与创新的外生压力来源，并考察了灭绝对长期发展的影响。结果表明，灭绝通过驱动生物地理学、疾病环境和制度的大陆差异来影响经济表现。欧亚大陆位于走出非洲的迁徙路径上，为人类和动物种群提供了驯化和农业的共同进化基础，这赋予了欧亚人在比较发展中的技术和制度优势。

records.title_en: Judicial Capture
records.title_cn: 司法俘获
records.abstract_en: We use data from Pakistan to establish a reciprocal exchange relationship between the judiciary and the government. We document large transfers in the form of expensive real estate from the government to the judiciary, and reciprocation in the form of pro-government rulings from the judiciary to the government. Our estimates indicate that the allocation of houses to judges increases pro-government rulings and reduces decisions on case merits. The allocation also incurs a cumulative cost of 0.03% of GDP to the government. However, it allows the government to expropriate additional land worth 0.2% of GDP in one year.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用巴基斯坦的数据来确立司法与政府之间的互惠交换关系。我们记录了政府向司法部门转移昂贵房地产的大规模行为，以及司法部门向政府回报以支持政府的裁决。我们的估计表明，向法官分配住房增加了支持政府的裁决，并减少了基于案件是非曲直的判决。这种分配还给政府带来了累计占GDP 0.03%的成本。然而，它使政府能够在一年内额外征用价值占GDP 0.2%的土地。

records.title_en: Attributes: Selective Learning and Influence
records.title_cn: 属性：选择性学习与影响
records.abstract_en: An agent selectively samples attributes of a complex project so as to influence the decision of a principal. The players disagree about the weighting, or relevance, of attributes. The correlation across attributes is modeled through a Gaussian process, the covariance function of which captures pairwise attribute similarity. The key trade‐off in sampling is between the alignment of the players' posterior values for the project and the variability of the principal's decision. Under a natural property of the attribute correlation—the nearest‐attribute property (NAP)—each optimal attribute is relevant for some player and at most two optimal attributes are relevant for only one player. We derive comparative statics in the strength of attribute correlation and examine the robustness of our findings to violations of NAP for a tractable class of distance‐based covariances. The findings carry testable implications for attribute‐based product evaluation and strategic selection of pilot sites.
records.abstract_cn: 一个代理人选择性地对复杂项目的属性进行抽样，以影响委托人的决策。双方对属性的权重或相关性存在分歧。属性间的相关性通过高斯过程建模，其协方差函数捕捉属性间的成对相似性。抽样中的关键权衡在于双方对项目后验值的对齐程度与委托人决策的变异性之间。在属性相关性的一个自然性质——最近属性性质（NAP）下，每个最优属性对某个参与者是相关的，且至多两个最优属性仅对一个参与者相关。我们推导了属性相关性强度下的比较静态分析，并检验了我们的发现在一类可处理的基于距离的协方差下对NAP违反的稳健性。这些发现对基于属性的产品评估和试点地点的战略选择具有可检验的含义。

records.title_en: Adapting to Climate Risk With Guaranteed Credit: Evidence From Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 适应气候风险与信贷担保：来自孟加拉国的证据
records.abstract_en: Climate change is increasing the frequency of extreme weather events, with low‐income countries being disproportionately impacted. However, these countries often face market frictions that hinder their ability to adopt effective adaptation strategies. In this paper, I explore the role of credit market failures in limiting adaptation. To achieve this, I collaborate with a large microfinance institution and offer a randomly selected group of farmers access to guaranteed credit through an “Emergency Loan” following a negative climate shock. I document three key results. First, farmers who have access to the emergency loan make less costly adaptation choices and are less severely affected when a flood occurs. Second, I find no evidence of adverse spillover effects on households that did not receive the Emergency Loan. Finally, I demonstrate that providing the Emergency Loan is profitable for the microfinance institution, making it a viable tool for the private sector to employ in similar circumstances.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化正在增加极端天气事件的频率，低收入国家受到的影响尤为严重。然而，这些国家往往面临市场摩擦，阻碍其采取有效的适应策略。在本文中，我探讨了信贷市场失灵在限制适应方面的作用。为此，我与一家大型小额信贷机构合作，随机选择一组农民，在遭受负面气候冲击后，通过“紧急贷款”为他们提供有担保的信贷。我记录了三个关键结果。首先，获得紧急贷款的农民在洪水发生时做出成本较低的适应选择，且受到的影响较轻。其次，我没有发现对未获得紧急贷款的家庭产生不利溢出效应的证据。最后，我证明提供紧急贷款对小额信贷机构是有利可图的，使其成为私营部门在类似情况下可采用的一种可行工具。

records.title_en: Flexible Moral Hazard Problems
records.title_cn: 灵活的道德风险问题
records.abstract_en: This paper considers a moral hazard problem where the agent can choose any output distribution with a support in a given compact set. The agent's effort‐cost is smooth and increasing in first‐order stochastic dominance. To analyze this model, we develop a generalized notion of the first‐order approach applicable to optimization problems over measures. We demonstrate each output distribution can be implemented and identify those contracts that implement that distribution. These contracts are characterized by a simple first‐order condition for each output that equates the agent's marginal cost of changing the implemented distribution around that output with its marginal benefit. Furthermore, the agent's wage is shown to be increasing in output. Finally, we consider the problem of a profit‐maximizing principal and provide a first‐order characterization of principal‐optimal distributions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了一个道德风险问题，其中代理人可以选择任何支撑在给定紧集内的产出分布。代理人的努力成本是光滑的，并且在一阶随机占优意义下递增。为了分析该模型，我们发展了一种适用于测度上优化问题的一阶方法的广义概念。我们证明了每个产出分布都是可实施的，并识别了实施该分布的合同。这些合同的特征在于每个产出满足一个简单的一阶条件，该条件使代理人围绕该产出改变已实施分布的边际成本与其边际收益相等。此外，代理人的工资被证明随产出递增。最后，我们考虑了利润最大化委托人的问题，并提供了委托人最优分布的一阶特征描述。

records.title_en: Bootstrap Inference for Fixed‐Effect Models
records.title_cn: 固定效应模型的Bootstrap推断
records.abstract_en: The maximum‐likelihood estimator of nonlinear panel data models with fixed effects is asymptotically biased under rectangular‐array asymptotics. The literature has devoted substantial effort to devising methods that correct for this bias as a means to salvage standard inferential procedures. The chief purpose of this paper is to show that the (recursive, parametric) bootstrap replicates the asymptotic distribution of the (uncorrected) maximum‐likelihood estimator and of the likelihood‐ratio statistic. This justifies the use of confidence sets and decision rules for hypothesis testing constructed via conventional bootstrap methods. No modification for the presence of bias needs to be made.
records.abstract_cn: 在矩形阵列渐近下，具有固定效应的非线性面板数据模型的最大似然估计量存在渐近偏误。文献中已投入大量精力设计纠正此偏误的方法，以挽救标准推断程序。本文的主要目的是证明（递归、参数）Bootstrap复制了（未纠正的）最大似然估计量和似然比统计量的渐近分布。这证明了通过常规Bootstrap方法构建的置信集和假设检验决策规则的合理性。无需针对偏误的存在进行修正。

records.title_en: Production and Learning in Teams
records.title_cn: 团队中的生产与学习
records.abstract_en: To what extent is a worker's human capital growth affected by the quality of his coworkers? To answer this question, we develop and estimate a model in which the productivity and the human capital growth of an individual depend on the average human capital of his coworkers. The measured production function is supermodular: The marginal product of a more knowledgeable individual is increasing in the human capital of his coworkers. The measured human capital accumulation function is convex: An individual's human capital growth is increasing in coworkers' human capital only when paired with more knowledgeable coworkers, but independent of coworkers' human capital when paired with less knowledgeable coworkers. Learning from coworkers accounts for two thirds of the stock of human capital accumulated on the job. Technological changes that increase production supermodularity lead to labor market segregation and, by reducing the opportunities for low human capital workers to learn from better coworkers, lead to a decline in aggregate human capital and output.
records.abstract_cn: 工人的人力资本增长在多大程度上受到其同事质量的影响？为了回答这个问题，我们开发并估计了一个模型，在该模型中，个体的生产率和人力资本增长取决于其同事的平均人力资本。测得的生产函数是超模的：知识更丰富的个体的边际产品随其同事的人力资本增加而增加。测得的人力资本积累函数是凸的：个体的人力资本增长仅在同事知识更丰富时随同事人力资本增加而增加，但在同事知识较少时与同事人力资本无关。从同事那里学习占工作岗位上积累的人力资本存量的三分之二。增加生产超模性的技术变革导致劳动力市场隔离，并通过减少低人力资本工人向更好同事学习的机会，导致总人力资本和产出下降。

records.title_en: Networks, Barriers, and Trade
records.title_cn: 网络、壁垒与贸易
records.abstract_en: We study a flexible class of trade models with international production networks and arbitrary wedge‐like distortions like markups, tariffs, or nominal rigidities. We characterize the general equilibrium response of variables to shocks in terms of microeconomic statistics. Our results are useful for decomposing the sources of real GDP and welfare growth, and for computing counterfactuals. Using the same set of microeconomic sufficient statistics, we also characterize societal losses from increases in tariffs and iceberg trade costs and dissect the qualitative and quantitative importance of accounting for disaggregated details. Our results, which can be used to compute approximate and exact counterfactuals, provide an analytical toolbox for studying large‐scale trade models and help to bridge the gap between computation and theory.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一类灵活的交易模型，其中包含国际生产网络和任意楔形扭曲，如加成、关税或名义刚性。我们以微观经济统计量刻画了变量对冲击的一般均衡反应。我们的结果有助于分解实际GDP和福利增长的来源，并用于计算反事实。利用同一组微观充分统计量，我们还刻画了关税和冰山贸易成本增加带来的社会损失，并剖析了考虑分解细节的定性和定量重要性。我们的结果可用于计算近似和精确的反事实，为研究大规模贸易模型提供了分析工具箱，并有助于弥合计算与理论之间的差距。

records.title_en: Toward a General Theory of Peer Effects
records.title_cn: 迈向同伴效应的通用理论
records.abstract_en: There is substantial empirical evidence showing that peer effects matter in many activities. The workhorse model in empirical work on peer effects is the linear‐in‐means (LIM) model, whereby it is assumed that agents are linearly affected by the mean action of their peers. We develop a new general model of peer effects that relaxes the linear assumption of the best‐reply functions and the mean peer behavior and that encompasses the spillover, conformist model, and LIM model as special cases. Then, using data on adolescent activities in the United States, we structurally estimate this model. We find that for many activities, individuals do not behave according to the LIM model. We run some counterfactual policies and show that imposing the mean action as an individual social norm is misleading and leads to incorrect policy implications.
records.abstract_cn: 有大量经验证据表明，同伴效应在许多活动中很重要。关于同伴效应的实证研究中的主力模型是线性均值（LIM）模型，该模型假设个体受到同伴平均行为的线性影响。我们开发了一个新的通用同伴效应模型，该模型放宽了最佳反应函数和平均同伴行为的线性假设，并将溢出效应、从众模型和LIM模型作为特例包含在内。然后，利用美国青少年活动的数据，我们对这一模型进行了结构估计。我们发现，对于许多活动，个体的行为并不符合LIM模型。我们进行了一些反事实政策模拟，并表明将平均行为作为个体社会规范是具有误导性的，会导致错误的政策含义。

records.title_en: Randomization Tests for Peer Effects in Group Formation Experiments
records.title_cn: 群体形成实验中同伴效应的随机化检验
records.abstract_en: Measuring the effect of peers on individuals' outcomes is a challenging problem, in part because individuals often select peers who are similar in both observable and unobservable ways. Group formation experiments avoid this problem by randomly assigning individuals to groups and observing their responses; for example, do first‐year students have better grades when they are randomly assigned roommates who have stronger academic backgrounds? In this paper, we propose randomization‐based permutation tests for group formation experiments, extending classical Fisher Randomization Tests to this setting. The proposed tests are justified by the randomization itself, require relatively few assumptions, and are exact in finite samples. This approach can also complement existing strategies, such as linear‐in‐means models, by using a regression coefficient as the test statistic. We apply the proposed tests to two recent group formation experiments.
records.abstract_cn: 衡量同伴对个体结果的影响是一个具有挑战性的问题，部分原因在于个体往往选择在可观测和不可观测方面相似的同伴。群体形成实验通过将个体随机分配到群体并观察其反应来避免这一问题；例如，当一年级学生被随机分配具有更强学术背景的室友时，他们的成绩是否更好？在本文中，我们提出了针对群体形成实验的基于随机化的置换检验，将经典费希尔随机化检验扩展到这一情境。所提出的检验由随机化本身证明合理，所需假设相对较少，并且在有限样本中是精确的。这种方法还可以通过使用回归系数作为检验统计量，补充现有策略，如线性均值模型。我们将所提出的检验应用于两个最近的群体形成实验。

records.title_en: Elena Irwin
records.title_cn: 埃琳娜·欧文
records.abstract_en: Elena Irwin is a Distinguished University Professor at Ohio State University in the Department of Agricultural, Environmental, and Development Economics and the faculty director and co-founder of the Sustainability Institute at Ohio State University. Currently she also serves as a Faculty Fellow in the Office of Academic Affairs to lead a university-wide effort that is engaging faculty, staff, students, employers, and other external partners to develop a transformational vision for advancing sustainability research, education, and community engagement at Ohio State University. Irwin's research focuses on the economics of land use and development in urban, urbanizing, and agricultural regions, including spatial models of land, water, and ecosystem services.
