She has led research projects totaling over $19 million, with funding from the National Science Foundation, U.S. Department of Agriculture, and other private and public agencies. Her current research includes development of a dynamic model of food, energy, and water systems for the Great Lakes regional economy and models of land use and management systems under a changing climate. As a professor in the Department of Agricultural, Environmental, and Development Economics, she advises graduate students and teaches in the Environment, Economy, Development and Sustainability undergraduate major, a program she co-founded in 2012 and that has graduated over 500 students to date. Irwin co-directs the Sustainability Institute, including leading and facilitating interdisciplinary research programs and sustainability curriculum development across the breadth of the university. She mentors the institute's core faculty and collaborates with faculty leaders on research development of the Sustainability Institute's priority areas of healthy air, land, and water; sustainable and resilient communities; and sustainable energy. She co-leads the Sustainability Education and Learning Committee, which catalyzes new education programs and courses in sustainability at the undergraduate and graduate levels across the university. Irwin is an appointed member of the U.S. EPA Scientific Advisory Board. In 2022 she was selected as a fellow of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists and in 2023 as a fellow of the Applied and Agricultural Economics Association. Irwin holds an undergraduate dual degree in history and German from Washington University and a Ph.D. in agricultural and resource economics from the University of Maryland.
records.abstract_cn: 埃琳娜·欧文是俄亥俄州立大学农业、环境与发展经济学系的杰出大学教授，同时也是俄亥俄州立大学可持续发展研究所的教师主任和联合创始人。目前，她还担任学术事务办公室的教师研究员，领导一项全校范围内的努力，旨在联合教师、员工、学生、雇主及其他外部合作伙伴，为推进俄亥俄州立大学的可持续发展研究、教育和社区参与制定变革性愿景。欧文的研究聚焦于城市、城市化及农业地区的土地利用与开发经济学，包括土地、水资源和生态系统服务的空间模型。她领导的研究项目总额超过19万美元，资金来自国家科学基金会、美国农业部及其他私人和公共机构。她目前的研究包括为五大湖区域经济开发粮食、能源和水系统的动态模型，以及气候变化下土地利用和管理系统的模型。作为农业、环境与发展经济学系的教授，她指导研究生，并在环境、经济、发展与可持续性本科专业授课，该专业是她于2012年联合创办的，至今已毕业超过500名学生。欧文共同指导可持续发展研究所，包括领导和促进跨学科研究项目以及覆盖大学各领域的可持续发展课程开发。她指导研究所的核心教师，并与教师领袖合作，开展可持续发展研究所优先领域的研究开发，包括健康的空气、土地和水；可持续和有韧性的社区；以及可持续能源。她共同领导可持续教育与学习委员会，该委员会在大学范围内推动本科和研究生层次的可持续发展新教育项目和课程。欧文是美国环保署科学顾问委员会的指定成员。2022年，她当选为环境与资源经济学家协会会士，2023年当选为应用与农业经济学协会会士。欧文拥有华盛顿大学历史与德语的双学士学位，以及马里兰大学的农业与资源经济学博士学位。

records.title_en: Dawn Thilmany
records.title_cn: 道恩·蒂尔马尼
records.abstract_en: Dr. Dawn Thilmany is a professor of Ag and Resource Economics with Colorado State University, serving in that role since 1997, and currently serves as the co-director of CSU's Regional Economic Development a Center. Starting in 2023, she will direct the Northwest and Rocky Mountain USDA Regional Food Business Center She was selected as the CSU Nutrien Distinguished Scholar in 2020. Dawn received her degrees at Iowa State University (BS, Public Service and Administration in Ag, 1990) and UC-Davis (MS and PhD Ag Econ, 1991 & 1994). She specializes in regional economic development related to local, organic, entrepreneurs, and food market supply chains, and more recently, has focused on developing engaged community development initiatives focused on rural Colorado and the Western US with support from the Economic Development Administration. An underlying theme of her research and extension is the analysis and framing of alternatives related to the unique attributes, amenities, and assets of places and how they may affect the market and policy dynamics that shape the environment and choices faced by household, farms, businesses, and communities. She has over 110 peer-reviewed publications and presented to over 500 academic, industry, community, and policy audiences. She has secured over $5 million in funding with various partners and interdisciplinary teams, providing funding for research, but also community initiatives, student funding, and pilot programs. She focuses many of her projects on the mentoring of young professionals and has been an advisor or co-advisor for over 25 MS and PhD students, and on the committee for over 90 students during her career. Her investments in young professionals are her greatest pride and rewarded by all she has learned from those she has mentored and co-authored with throughout the years. At the undergraduate level, she has taught a dozen different offerings, been the advisor for student clubs and competitive teams, and guided a number of undergraduate honors theses. She serves on and formerly chaired the Colorado Food Systems Advisory Council and established and co-led the CSU Food Systems team through 2017, when she was appointed to the leadership team for CSU's Community Development programming. She has collaborated with numerous Colorado state agencies and several USDA agencies including the ERS, AMS, NIFA, and APHIS, and served as a reviewer or panel manager for over a dozen USDA grant programs. She has served as president and led several organizations including the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association, the Western Agricultural Economics Association, and the Food Distribution Research Society. She represented the AAEA on USDA's Advisory Board on Research, Extension, Education and Economics from 2012 to 2018.
records.abstract_cn: 道恩·蒂尔马尼博士是科罗拉多州立大学农业与资源经济学教授，自1997年起担任该职务，目前担任该校区域经济发展中心的联合主任。从2023年开始，她将领导美国农业部西北和落基山区域食品商业中心。她于2020年被选为科罗拉多州立大学Nutrien杰出学者。道恩在爱荷华州立大学获得学士学位（农业公共服务与管理，1990年），在加州大学戴维斯分校获得硕士和博士学位（农业经济学，1991年和1994年）。她专攻与本地、有机、创业者和食品市场供应链相关的区域经济发展，最近专注于在经济发展管理局的支持下，开展针对科罗拉多农村和美国西部的社区发展倡议。她研究和推广的一个基本主题是分析与构建与地方独特属性、便利设施和资产相关的替代方案，以及这些因素如何影响塑造家庭、农场、企业和社区所面临环境和选择的市场和政策动态。她发表了超过110篇同行评审论文，并向超过500个学术、行业、社区和政策受众进行了演讲。她与各种合作伙伴和跨学科团队获得了超过5万美元的资助，为研究以及社区倡议、学生资助和试点项目提供资金。她将许多项目重点放在指导年轻专业人士上，并曾担任超过25名硕士和博士生的导师或联合导师，并在职业生涯中担任过90多名学生的委员会成员。她对年轻专业人士的投资是她最大的骄傲，并因多年来从她指导和共同撰写的人那里学到的一切而得到回报。在本科层面，她教授了十多种不同的课程，担任学生俱乐部和竞赛团队的顾问，并指导了多项本科荣誉论文。她曾在科罗拉多食品系统咨询委员会任职并担任主席，并在2017年前建立并共同领导了科罗拉多州立大学食品系统团队，当时她被任命为该校社区发展项目的领导团队成员。她与科罗拉多州多个州机构以及美国农业部多个机构合作，包括经济研究局、农业营销服务局、国家食品与农业研究所和动植物卫生检验局，并担任过十多个美国农业部资助项目的评审员或小组经理。她曾担任多个组织的主席并领导这些组织，包括农业与应用经济学协会、西部农业经济学协会和食品分销研究学会。她于2012年至2018年代表农业与应用经济学协会在美国农业部研究、推广、教育和经济咨询委员会任职。

records.title_en: Rodolfo M. Nayga, Jr
records.title_cn: 小鲁道夫·M·奈加
records.abstract_en: Rodolfo M. Nayga, Jr. is currently professor and head of the Department of Agricultural Economics at Texas A&M University. Dr. Nayga's research interests include the economics of food valuation, consumption, policy, and health. Prior to rejoining Texas A&M University in 2021, Dr. Nayga was Distinguished Professor and Tyson Endowed Chair in Food Policy Economics at the University of Arkansas. He also was a faculty member at Rutgers University and at Massey University, New Zealand. He has been a Fulbright Senior Scholar at Wageningen University, The Netherlands; adjunct professor at Korea University and Norwegian Institute for Bioeconomy Research; NBER research economist; and senior research fellow of the Waseda Institute for Advanced Study in Tokyo. He is a Fellow of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association (AAEA).
records.abstract_cn: Rodolfo M. Nayga, Jr. 现任德克萨斯农工大学农业经济系教授兼系主任。 Nayga 博士的研究兴趣包括食品估值、消费、政策和健康的经济学。在 2021 重新加入德克萨斯农工大学之前，Nayga 博士是阿肯色大学食品政策经济学的杰出教授和泰森捐赠主席。他还曾任罗格斯大学和新西兰梅西大学的教员。曾任荷兰瓦赫宁根大学富布赖特高级学者；高丽大学和挪威生物经济研究所兼职教授； NBER 研究经济学家；东京早稻田高等研究院高级研究员。他是农业与应用经济学协会（AAEA）的会员。

records.title_en: The looming demographic cliff: A wake‐up call for the agricultural and applied economics profession
records.title_cn: 迫在眉睫的人口悬崖：对农业与应用经济学专业的警钟
records.abstract_en: The looming demographic cliff, characterized by a projected decline in college student enrollment, can have important impacts for the agricultural and applied economics profession, academic departments, and universities more broadly across the US. This decline will not only affect the financial stability and sustainability of many agricultural economics departments but also the number of high‐skilled professionals available for the agricultural industry, government bodies, and academia. This article discusses the main factors leading to the demographic cliff, as well as potential strategies for curbing its negative impacts on the profession. In the face of this challenge, it is important to develop a thoughtful, proactive, and strategic approach, and to engage industry, government, and academic partnerships.
records.abstract_cn: 迫在眉睫的人口悬崖，以预计的大学生入学人数下降为特征，可能对美国各地的农业与应用经济学专业、学术部门和大学产生重要影响。这种下降不仅会影响许多农业经济学系的财务稳定性和可持续性，还会影响可供农业产业、政府机构和学术界使用的高技能专业人才数量。本文讨论了导致人口悬崖的主要因素，以及遏制其对专业负面影响的潜在策略。面对这一挑战，重要的是制定一个深思熟虑、积极主动和战略性的方法，并促进产业、政府和学术界的合作。

records.title_en: Making a difference through trusted, high‐quality research and statistics
records.title_cn: 通过可信、高质量的研究和统计产生影响
records.abstract_en: As applied and agricultural economists, Agricultural & Applied Economics Association (AAEA) members work to provide high quality research and data to inform policy decisions. How do we ensure that decision makers see, and use, our research findings or data in the policy formulation process that includes many actors? The paper provides a framework for how information flows during the policy process and a strategy for effective research and data built around five equally important attributes: relevance; quality; trust; diversity, equity, and inclusion; and communication. Examples illustrate how the attributes lead to high impact information and focus on two federal research and statistics agencies, the Economic Research Service and the Bureau of Economic Analysis. The paper concludes with strategies and examples of metrics to measure the impact of research and statistics.
records.abstract_cn: 作为应用经济学家和农业经济学家，农业与应用经济学协会（AAEA）的成员致力于提供高质量的研究和数据，为政策决策提供信息。我们如何确保决策者在包含众多参与者的政策制定过程中看到并利用我们的研究发现或数据？本文提供了一个关于政策过程中信息流动的框架，以及围绕五个同等重要的属性构建的有效研究和数据策略：相关性；质量；信任；多样性、公平性和包容性；以及沟通。实例说明了这些属性如何带来高影响力的信息，并重点关注两个联邦研究和统计机构：经济研究局和经济分析局。本文最后提出了衡量研究和统计影响的策略和指标示例。

records.title_en: Consumer preferences for food away from home: Dine in versus delivery
records.title_cn: 外出就餐的消费者偏好：堂食与外卖
records.abstract_en: Food away from home (FAFH) is an integral part of U.S. consumer diets, with food delivery orders becoming more popular in recent years. However, little research has been done on whether choice patterns vary across dining settings and how this might affect the impact food policies such as a red meat tax would have on consumer welfare. We target this gap by implementing a food menu basket‐based experiment (FM‐BBCE) to determine consumer preferences and demand for FAFH in two dining settings: in‐restaurant dining and food delivery. The FM‐BBCE approach enables us to (a) identify the substitution and complementarity patterns between various food types (meat vs. plant‐based food) and courses (appetizers, main courses, and side dishes), and (b) determine the demand and welfare impact of a red meat tax across the two settings. We find that respondent's orders in the delivery setting are typically higher in calories, and most items act as complements for one another, whereas menu items are substitutes in the dine‐in setting. Consumers were generally more price elastic in dine‐in versus delivery settings. Sociodemographics influence choice; for example, urban consumers have a higher preference for plant‐based meat alternatives than rural or suburban respondents. These sociodemographic differences extend to the welfare effects of a red meat tax that we simulate, which is regressive toward low‐income individuals in the delivery setting but not in the dine‐in setting. Findings from this study provide new insights on FAFH consumption, which can be used by producers, policymakers, and academics.
records.abstract_cn: 外出就餐（FAFH）是美国消费者饮食中不可或缺的一部分，近年来外卖订单越来越受欢迎。然而，关于选择模式是否因就餐环境而异，以及这可能如何影响诸如红肉税等食品政策对消费者福利的影响，研究甚少。我们通过实施一项食品菜单篮子实验（FM‐BBCE）来填补这一空白，以确定消费者在两种就餐环境（餐厅堂食和外卖）中对FAFH的偏好和需求。FM‐BBCE方法使我们能够（a）识别不同食品类型（肉类与植物性食品）和菜品（开胃菜、主菜和配菜）之间的替代和互补模式，以及（b）确定红肉税在两种环境下的需求和福利影响。我们发现，受访者在外卖环境中的订单通常热量更高，且大多数项目互为补充，而在堂食环境中菜单项目则是替代品。消费者在堂食环境中通常比外卖环境更具价格弹性。社会人口统计学特征影响选择；例如，城市消费者对植物性肉类替代品的偏好高于农村或郊区受访者。这些社会人口统计学差异延伸到了我们模拟的红肉税的福利效应上，该税在外卖环境中对低收入个体具有累退性，但在堂食环境中则不然。本研究的结果为FAFH消费提供了新的见解，可供生产者、政策制定者和学者使用。

records.title_en: Commodity storage and the cost of capital: Evidence from Illinois grain farms
records.title_cn: 商品储存与资本成本：来自伊利诺伊州谷物农场的证据
records.abstract_en: Commodity inventories are the key state variable determining the magnitude of commodity price responses to supply and demand shocks. Many firms in commodity supply chains use storage, but we know little about which firms and why. The economic theory of storage asserts that firms in a competitive market for inventories will store based on current and expected market prices and the per‐unit cost of storing. We empirically test at the firm‐level the importance of one major cost of storage: the opportunity cost of capital used to value foregone revenue from deferred commodity sales. To do so, we use panel data from thousands of Illinois farms who hold inventories of corn and soybeans. Although interest rates as a measure of capital costs are unlikely to vary widely across firms in this context, we exploit variation in the weighted average cost of capital due to cross‐firm differences in capital structure. Using two‐way fixed effects regressions, we find a statistically significant average effect of capital costs on inventory that masks notable heterogeneity across firms. Panel quantile regressions reveal two groups of firms: one whose inventory holdings are responsive to changes in the opportunity cost of storage and another whose are not. Our results suggest some farms behave like the profit‐maximizing ones from theory but substantial inframarginal commodity inventories are held by farms for other reasons.
records.abstract_cn: 商品库存是决定商品价格对供需冲击反应程度的关键状态变量。商品供应链中的许多企业使用储存，但我们对哪些企业以及为何储存知之甚少。储存的经济理论认为，在竞争性库存市场中，企业将根据当前和预期的市场价格以及每单位储存成本进行储存。我们在企业层面实证检验了储存的一个主要成本的重要性：用于评估延迟商品销售所放弃收入的资本机会成本。为此，我们使用了来自伊利诺伊州数千个持有玉米和大豆库存的农场的面板数据。尽管利率作为资本成本的衡量标准在这种情况下不太可能在企业间有较大差异，但我们利用资本结构的企业间差异导致的加权平均资本成本的变化。通过双向固定效应回归，我们发现资本成本对库存的平均效应在统计上显著，但掩盖了企业间的显著异质性。面板分位数回归揭示了两组企业：一组企业的库存持有对储存机会成本的变化敏感，另一组则不敏感。我们的结果表明，一些农场的行为符合理论中的利润最大化者，但大量边际内商品库存是由农场出于其他原因持有的。

records.title_en: Quantifying co‐benefits of water quality policies: An integrated assessment model of land and nitrogen management
records.title_cn: 量化水质政策的协同效益：土地与氮管理综合评估模型
records.abstract_en: Due to the nature of nitrogen cycling, policies designed to address water quality concerns have the potential to provide benefits beyond the targeted water quality improvements. For example, actions to protect water quality by reducing nitrate leaching from agriculture also reduce emissions of nitrous oxide, a potent greenhouse gas. These positive effects, which are incidental to the regulation's intended target, are termed “co‐benefits.” To quantify the co‐benefits associated with reduced nitrate leaching, we integrate an economic model of farmer decision making with a model of terrestrial nitrogen cycling for the watershed surrounding Lake Mendota, Wisconsin, USA. Our modeling approach provides a framework that links air and water pollutants in an agri‐environmental system and offers a direction for future studies. Our model results highlight the finding that the co‐benefits from nitrous oxide abatement are substantial, and their inclusion increases the benefit–cost ratio of water quality policies. Consideration of these co‐benefits has the potential to reverse the conclusions of benefit–cost analysis in the assessment of current water quality policies.
records.abstract_cn: 由于氮循环的特性，旨在解决水质问题的政策有可能提供超出目标水质改善的效益。例如，通过减少农业硝酸盐淋溶来保护水质的行动，也会减少强效温室气体一氧化二氮的排放。这些附带于法规预期目标之外的积极效应被称为“协同效益”。为了量化与减少硝酸盐淋溶相关的协同效益，我们将农民决策的经济模型与美国威斯康星州门多塔湖流域的陆地氮循环模型相结合。我们的建模方法提供了一个将农业环境系统中空气和水污染物联系起来的框架，并为未来研究指明了方向。我们的模型结果强调，一氧化二氮减排的协同效益是显著的，将其纳入考虑会提高水质政策的效益成本比。考虑这些协同效益有可能逆转当前水质政策评估中效益成本分析的结论。

records.title_en: Moving policies toward racial and ethnic equality: The case of the supplemental nutrition assistance program *
records.title_cn: 推动政策走向种族和民族平等：补充营养援助计划的案例*
records.abstract_en: We analyze the role played by the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) in alleviating or exacerbating inequality across racial and ethnic groups in food expenditures and in the resources needed to meet basic food needs (the “food resource gap”). To do this, we propose a simple framework that decomposes differences across groups in SNAP benefit transfer levels into three components: eligibility, participation, and generosity. This decomposition is then linked to differences in food expenditures and the food resource gap. Our results reveal that among the three components, differences in eligibility contribute the most to SNAP benefits differentials for Black and Hispanic households relative to White households. Given that SNAP is often a target of policy changes, we employ the framework to provide counterfactual analyses of how selected SNAP policy changes can impact group differences in benefits and, ultimately, disparities in food expenditures and the food resource gap. The proposed framework can be applied to analyze other safety net programs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了补充营养援助计划（SNAP）在缓解或加剧不同种族和民族群体在食品支出以及满足基本食品需求所需资源（“食品资源缺口”）方面的不平等中所扮演的角色。为此，我们提出了一个简单的框架，将不同群体在SNAP福利转移水平上的差异分解为三个组成部分：资格、参与和慷慨程度。然后，这种分解与食品支出和食品资源缺口的差异联系起来。我们的结果显示，在这三个组成部分中，资格差异对黑人和西班牙裔家庭相对于白人家庭的SNAP福利差异贡献最大。鉴于SNAP往往是政策变革的目标，我们利用该框架提供了反事实分析，以研究选定的SNAP政策变化如何影响群体间的福利差异，并最终影响食品支出和食品资源缺口的不平等。所提出的框架可应用于分析其他安全网计划。

records.title_en: Revisiting the size–productivity relationship with imperfect measures of production and plot size
records.title_cn: 重新审视规模-生产率关系：基于不完美的产量与地块规模测量
records.abstract_en: Monitoring smallholder agricultural productivity growth, one of the targets of the Sustainable Development Goals, rests on accurate measures of crop production and land area. Existing methods and protocols for measuring smallholder production and plot size are prone to various sources and forms of mismeasurement. Inaccuracies in production and land area measurement are likely to distort descriptive and predictive inferences. We examine the sensitivity of empirical assessments of the relationship between agricultural productivity and land area to alternative measurement protocols. We implement six production and six land area measurement protocols, and show that most of these protocols differ systematically in their accuracy. We find that an apparent inverse size–productivity relationship in our data is fully explained by measurement error in both production and plot size. Moreover, we show that some of the previously used “gold standard” measures are themselves prone to nonclassical measurement error, and hence can generate spurious inverse size–productivity findings. Our results also show that slight improvements in the precision of objective measures significantly reduce the inferential bias associated with the size–productivity relationship.
records.abstract_cn: 监测小农农业生产率增长，作为可持续发展目标之一，依赖于作物产量和土地面积的准确测量。现有的测量小农产量和地块规模的方法与协议容易受到各种来源和形式的测量误差影响。产量和土地面积测量的不准确性可能会扭曲描述性和预测性推断。我们检验了农业生产力与土地面积之间关系的实证评估对替代测量协议的敏感性。我们实施了六种产量测量协议和六种土地面积测量协议，并表明这些协议中的大多数在准确性上存在系统性差异。我们发现，在我们的数据中，明显的反向规模-生产率关系完全由产量和地块规模的测量误差所解释。此外，我们表明，一些先前使用的“黄金标准”测量本身容易受到非经典测量误差的影响，因此可能产生虚假的反向规模-生产率发现。我们的结果还表明，客观测量精度的轻微提高显著减少了与规模-生产率关系相关的推断偏差。

records.title_en: Impacts of U.S. countervailing duties on phosphate fertilizers
records.title_cn: 美国反补贴税对磷肥的影响
records.abstract_en: Countervailing duties are a trade policy instrument by which importing governments tax imports that are found to benefit from foreign subsidies. Thus, in effect, these duties attempt to remedy market distortions generated by foreign subsidies by further distorting market mechanisms. On March 11, 2021, the U.S. International Trade Commission issued duties ranging between 19.97% and 47.05% on Moroccan phosphate imports upon finding that Moroccan exports had been receiving unfair government subsidies. In this research, we estimate the impacts of these duties on U.S. diammonium phosphate and triple superphosphate fertilizers, as well as long‐run downstream prices of five U.S. row crops with the largest phosphate usage. Using these results, we assess the implications for gross receipts in the U.S. fertilizer industry and gross margins for American farmers. We also calculate the implied change in expenditure for agricultural end users. We find that the countervailing duties have increased U.S. phosphate fertilizer prices by approximately 34% over counterfactual levels. This corresponds to an expected downstream price response ranging from around 10% for corn, cotton, and sorghum to between 1% and 4% for soybeans and wheat. This market distortion generates a $23 billion increase in gross receipts for a concentrated domestic fertilizer industry while shrinking gross margins for American farmers by 2% and 8% and increasing agricultural user expenditures by approximately $10.84 billion.
records.abstract_cn: 反补贴税是一种贸易政策工具，进口国政府据此对被发现受益于外国补贴的进口商品征税。因此，实际上，这些关税试图通过进一步扭曲市场机制来纠正外国补贴造成的市场扭曲。11年三月2021日，美国国际贸易委员会认定摩洛哥出口产品获得了不公平的政府补贴，因此对摩洛哥磷酸盐进口征收19.97%至47.05%的关税。在本研究中，我们估计了这些关税对美国磷酸二铵和重过磷酸钙肥料以及五种磷酸盐使用量最大的美国行播作物的长期下游价格的影响。利用这些结果，我们评估了对美国化肥行业总收入和美国农民毛利润的影响。我们还计算了农业最终用户支出的隐含变化。我们发现，反补贴税使美国磷肥价格比反事实水平上涨了约34%。这对应的预期下游价格反应范围从玉米、棉花和高粱的约10%到大豆和小麦的1%至4%不等。这种市场扭曲使集中的国内化肥行业的总收入增加了23亿美元，同时使美国农民的毛利润缩减了2%至8%，并使农业用户支出增加了约10.84亿美元。

records.title_en: Endogenous price fluctuations: Evidence from the chicken supply chain in Pakistan
records.title_cn: 内生价格波动：来自巴基斯坦鸡肉供应链的证据
records.abstract_en: Persistent agricultural price fluctuations in developing countries have revived interest in the theory of endogenous price instability. We examine the underlying cause of price instability in Pakistan's broiler and chick markets. To this end, we utilize findings from our fieldwork and estimates from unobserved component‐models to formulate a theoretical model of endogenous price fluctuations in the chicken supply chain of Pakistan. Under standard assumptions, we derive hypotheses from our theoretical model that can be tested by using vector autoregressions and weekly data on broiler and chick (farm‐gate) prices in Pakistan. Our empirical estimates conform to the predictions of our theoretical model, and evidence of endogenous dynamics in observed prices is robust to alternative specifications and estimation methods. We use numerical simulations to illustrate that empirically grounded parameterizations of our theoretical model can emulate the salient features of broiler and chick price fluctuations in Pakistan. The accumulation of evidence from our descriptive, empirical, and numerical analysis builds a compelling case for the endogenous nature of price instability in Pakistan's chicken supply chain.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家持续存在的农产品价格波动重新激发了人们对内生价格不稳定理论的兴趣。我们考察了巴基斯坦肉鸡和雏鸡市场价格不稳定的根本原因。为此，我们利用实地调查的发现和不可观测成分模型的估计结果，构建了一个巴基斯坦鸡肉供应链内生价格波动的理论模型。在标准假设下，我们从理论模型中推导出可通过向量自回归和巴基斯坦肉鸡及雏鸡（农场出场）价格周度数据检验的假设。我们的实证估计符合理论模型的预测，且观察到的价格内生动态证据对替代规格和估计方法具有稳健性。我们使用数值模拟来说明，基于实证的理论模型参数化能够模拟巴基斯坦肉鸡和雏鸡价格波动的显著特征。来自描述性、实证和数值分析的证据积累，为巴基斯坦鸡肉供应链价格波动的内生性质提供了有力论据。

records.title_en: Understanding the effect of cover crop use on prevented planting losses
records.title_cn: 理解覆盖作物使用对预防种植损失的影响
records.abstract_en: Cover cropping has the potential to improve resilience of agriculture to climate‐change‐induced extreme weather events. However, rigorous quantitative evidence on the resilience effect of cover crops is still lacking. Using a novel data set that combines satellite‐based cover crop information and county‐level crop insurance data, we examine the impact of planting cover crops on prevented‐planting‐related losses that are typically caused by heavy rainfall events. The US federal crop insurance program offers “prevented planting” coverage, which pays indemnities if insured growers are unable to plant their crop due to adverse weather. Linear fixed effects models, instrument‐based estimation methods, long‐difference models, and a number of other robustness checks are utilized in the empirical analysis to achieve the study objective. Our findings suggest that counties with higher cover crop adoption rates tend to have lower levels of crop insurance losses due to prevented planting. The resulting reduction in prevented planting risk also becomes larger with longer term, multiyear cover crop use. These results support the notion that cover crops improve soil conditions such that the likelihood and magnitude of prevented planting losses decrease. We posit that the ability of cover crops to handle excess moisture (i.e., through better water absorption and improved water infiltration in the soil) is the main factor in its ability to reduce prevented planting losses in the US Midwest.
records.abstract_cn: 覆盖作物种植有潜力提高农业对气候变化引起的极端天气事件的韧性。然而，关于覆盖作物韧性效应的严格定量证据仍然缺乏。利用结合卫星覆盖作物信息和县级作物保险数据的新数据集，我们考察了种植覆盖作物对通常由强降雨事件引起的预防种植相关损失的影响。美国联邦作物保险计划提供“预防种植”保险，如果受保种植者因不利天气无法种植作物，则支付赔偿。实证分析中采用线性固定效应模型、基于工具变量的估计方法、长期差分模型以及一系列其他稳健性检验来实现研究目标。我们的研究结果表明，覆盖作物采用率较高的县往往因预防种植导致的作物保险损失水平较低。随着长期、多年覆盖作物使用，预防种植风险的降低也变得更加显著。这些结果支持了覆盖作物改善土壤条件从而降低预防种植损失的可能性和程度的观点。我们认为，覆盖作物处理多余水分的能力（即通过更好的水分吸收和改善土壤水分渗透）是其在美国中西部减少预防种植损失的主要因素。

records.title_en: Intrahousehold preference heterogeneity and demand for labor‐saving agricultural technology
records.title_cn: 家庭内偏好异质性与节省劳动力农业技术的需求
records.abstract_en: Evaluations of agricultural technologies rarely consider the implications of how adoption may alter the labor allocation of different individuals within a household. We examine intrahousehold decision‐making dynamics that shape smallholder households' decision to use mechanical rice transplanting (MRT), a technology that disproportionately influences demand for women's labor. To study the adoption decision, we experimentally estimate the willingness to pay for MRT services both at the individual and household level. We find that women value MRT more than men, especially when they participate in transplanting on their own farms. This preference heterogeneity is evident in the unconditional differences between women's and men's valuation and differences conditional on their individual observable characteristics. Despite having stronger preferences for MRT, women have less influence on the household's technology adoption decision than men. This differential influence over the MRT adoption decision reflects the intrahousehold power structure: in households where women have less control over assets, they also have less influence over the MRT adoption decision. Our results highlight how technological changes interact with unobserved, gender‐based intrahousehold power relations to influence agricultural production decisions and, by extension, the gendered allocation of labor and welfare of women.
records.abstract_cn: 农业技术的评估很少考虑采用技术如何改变家庭内不同个体的劳动力分配。我们研究了塑造小农户家庭决定使用机械水稻移栽（MRT）的家庭内决策动态，该技术对女性劳动力的需求影响不成比例。为了研究采用决策，我们在个体和家庭层面实验性地估计了对MRT服务的支付意愿。我们发现女性比男性更看重MRT，尤其是当她们在自己农场参与移栽时。这种偏好异质性体现在女性和男性估值之间的无条件差异以及基于其个体可观测特征的差异上。尽管女性对MRT有更强的偏好，但她们对家庭技术采用决策的影响力小于男性。这种对MRT采用决策的差异性影响反映了家庭内的权力结构：在女性对资产控制较少的家庭中，她们对MRT采用决策的影响力也较小。我们的结果强调了技术变革如何与未观测到的、基于性别的家庭内权力关系相互作用，从而影响农业生产决策，进而影响劳动力的性别分配和女性福利。

records.title_en: Evaluating the tradeoff between cost effectiveness and participation in agricultural conservation programs
records.title_cn: 评估农业保护计划中成本效益与参与度之间的权衡
records.abstract_en: Using a survey of 430 farmer respondents in the Boone and North Raccoon River watersheds in Iowa, we examine the impacts of three program innovations—reverse auctions, spatially targeted payments, and higher offered payments—on agricultural conservation program cost effectiveness and participation by farmers. We combine farmer responses to a discrete choice experiment offering voluntary conservation contracts with township‐level estimates of per‐acre nitrogen reductions from each practice derived from the process‐based ecohydrological Soil and Water Assessment Tool model. Using a random‐parameters logit model, we show that both cost‐reducing and benefit‐boosting interventions reduce budgetary costs per projected pound of nitrogen removed from the watershed for each practice and thus are more cost effective than the prevailing current cost‐share programs. However, we find that these interventions can reduce participation by 30%–70%. Our policy simulations show that even with large budgets, the watershed‐level nitrogen reduction from all policy interventions remains far below the policy targets set by the Iowa Nutrient Reduction Strategy. Furthermore, we find cover crop contracts are far more cost effective than no‐till/strip‐till split nitrogen application contracts.
records.abstract_cn: 利用对爱荷华州布恩河和北浣熊河流域430名农民受访者的调查，我们考察了三种计划创新——反向拍卖、空间定向支付和更高支付金额——对农业保护计划成本效益和农民参与度的影响。我们将农民对提供自愿保护合同的选择实验的回应，与基于过程的生态水文土壤和水评估工具模型得出的每个实践每英亩氮减少量的乡镇级估计相结合。使用随机参数logit模型，我们表明，降低成本和提高效益的干预措施均降低了每个实践从流域中去除每磅氮的预算成本，因此比现行成本分摊计划更具成本效益。然而，我们发现这些干预措施可能将参与度降低30%–70%。我们的政策模拟表明，即使预算充足，所有政策干预措施在流域层面的氮减少量仍远低于爱荷华州营养减少战略设定的政策目标。此外，我们发现覆盖作物合同比免耕/条耕分次施氮合同更具成本效益。

records.title_en: Diversification and resilience of firms in the agrifood supply chain
records.title_cn: 农业食品供应链中企业的多元化与韧性
records.abstract_en: Are diversified firms more resilient to negative market shocks than specialized firms? We answer this question in the context of the COVID‐19 pandemic by analyzing data from small‐ and medium‐sized firms in the U.S. agrifood supply chain. We first develop revenue‐based measures of firms' vertical (across supply‐chain segment) and horizontal (within supply‐chain segment) diversification. We then compare post pandemic outcomes of more diversified and less diversified firms using several inverse‐probability weighting techniques. We find that vertical diversification reduces firms' resilience, whereas horizontal diversification increases firms' resilience.
records.abstract_cn: 多元化企业是否比专业化企业更能抵御负面市场冲击？我们通过分析美国农业食品供应链中中小型企业的数据，在COVID-19大流行的背景下回答这一问题。我们首先开发了基于收入的企业纵向（跨供应链环节）和横向（供应链环节内）多元化衡量指标。然后，我们使用多种逆概率加权技术比较了疫情后多元化程度较高和较低企业的结果。我们发现，纵向多元化降低了企业的韧性，而横向多元化则提高了企业的韧性。

records.title_en: Estimating SNAP purchasing power and its effect on participation
records.title_cn: 估算补充营养援助计划的购买力及其对参与率的影响
records.abstract_en: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) aims to improve food security among low‐income households and is one of the largest safety net programs in the United States. SNAP benefits are legislated at the federal level and fixed across the contiguous United States. Hence, due to regional food price differences, the real value of SNAP benefits is unequal and could have consequential impacts on program participation. This paper estimates the extent to which SNAP purchasing power differs across states by constructing the first spatially and temporally consistent Thrifty Food Plan (TFP) price index using retail scanner data for the period 2006–2016. We find that the difference in the real value of SNAP benefits between the highest and the lowest cost states ranges from 5% to 9% for a household of four during the sample period. Subsequently, we estimate the effect of real SNAP benefits on program participation. Our results show that a 10% increase in SNAP purchasing power leads to a 0.9 percentage point increase in the SNAP caseload per capita and an 8.1 percentage point increase in the SNAP caseload per eligible individual. We show that these effects would be overlooked if the TFP price index is not corrected for expenditure and outlet biases.
records.abstract_cn: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）旨在改善低收入家庭的食品安全，是美国最大的安全网计划之一。SNAP福利在联邦层面立法确定，并在美国本土各州固定不变。因此，由于地区食品价格差异，SNAP福利的实际价值不平等，可能对计划参与产生重大影响。本文通过使用2006-2016年期间的零售扫描数据，构建了第一个空间和时间上一致的节俭食品计划（TFP）价格指数，估算了各州SNAP购买力的差异程度。我们发现，在样本期间，对于一个四口之家，最高和最低成本州之间SNAP福利实际价值的差异范围从5%到9%。随后，我们估计了实际SNAP福利对计划参与的影响。我们的结果表明，SNAP购买力每增加10%，人均SNAP案例数增加0.9个百分点，每个符合条件的个人的SNAP案例数增加8.1个百分点。我们表明，如果TFP价格指数不进行支出和渠道偏差修正，这些影响将被忽视。

records.title_en: State‐contingent production technology formulation: Identifying states of nature using reduced‐form econometric models of crop yield
records.title_cn: 状态依存的农业生产技术表述：利用作物产量的简化形式计量经济模型识别自然状态
records.abstract_en: Conducting experiments can be time consuming and expensive, and may not always be reasonable. Therefore, empirical research often derives structural parameters based on observational data and reduced‐form econometric models. The state‐contingent approach presents a consistent conceptual framework for analyzing producer decisions under uncertainty. However, application of this structural modeling approach has been hampered by data constraints, particularly the lack of information for mapping producers' stochastic outputs onto a set of the states of nature representing different uncertain events. Consistent mapping of uncertainty is particularly critical in the context of multiple output production where weather shocks often have different effects across crops and in microeconometric analyses when unobserved farm heterogeneity may confound the effect of uncertainty. Our study demonstrates how the application of reduced‐form approaches can overcome constraints of structural econometric modeling associated with the lack of relevant data and presents an approach for identifying states of nature in the context of multiple output production using reduced‐form econometric models of crop yield. In an empirical application based on Hungarian farm accountancy data, we demonstrate that the proposed approach allows a consistent mapping of production uncertainty in crop farming, utilizes panel data structure, and controls for potential endogeneity due to unobserved farm heterogeneity. We anticipate the presented approach to be useful for developing further the state‐contingent approach and to stimulate further studies combining the strengths of structural approaches and reduced‐form models.
records.abstract_cn: 进行实验可能耗时且昂贵，且并非总是合理的。因此，实证研究通常基于观测数据和简化形式计量经济模型推导结构参数。状态依存方法为分析不确定性下的生产者决策提供了一致的概念框架。然而，这种结构建模方法的应用一直受到数据约束的阻碍，特别是缺乏将生产者的随机产出映射到代表不同不确定事件的一组自然状态的信息。在多种产出生产的背景下，天气冲击通常对不同作物有不同的影响，而在微观计量分析中，未观测到的农场异质性可能混淆不确定性的效应，因此一致的不确定性映射尤为关键。我们的研究展示了如何应用简化形式方法克服与缺乏相关数据相关的结构计量建模约束，并提出了一种利用作物产量的简化形式计量经济模型在多种产出生产背景下识别自然状态的方法。在基于匈牙利农场会计数据的实证应用中，我们证明了所提出的方法能够实现作物生产中生产不确定性的一致映射，利用面板数据结构，并控制因未观测到的农场异质性而导致的潜在内生性。我们预期所提出的方法有助于进一步发展状态依存方法，并促进结合结构方法和简化形式模型优势的进一步研究。

records.title_en: Estimating the effect of time‐invariant characteristics in panel data: wheat adoption in Western Canada
records.title_cn: 估计面板数据中时不变特征的影响：加拿大西部的小麦采用
records.abstract_en: A growing global population and the challenges of climate change have made the need to develop new and improved wheat varieties increasingly important. Creating varieties that are more disease resistant and tolerant to changing environmental conditions such that they will be widely adopted requires breeders to understand the needs of producers. Existing literature suggests that time‐invariant traits such as disease resistance and brand matter in crop adoption decisions; however, studies using common panel data approaches are unable to identify the individual effects of time‐invariant variables, as they are captured by fixed effects dummies. This study uses a recently developed econometric approach—the fixed effects filter model—that can estimate the effects of time‐variant, slowly changing, and time‐invariant traits. Using wheat variety adoption in the Canadian Prairies as our empirical setting, we find that both time‐variant traits, such as varietal adaptability, and time‐invariant traits, such as resistance to stripe rust infection, are positively correlated with adoption. We also find that seed brand has a statistically significant effect on adoption. Prior panel data studies on crop adoption have not given much consideration to time‐invariant variety characteristics like disease tolerance and seed brand, but a better understanding of their impact on adoption can assist breeders in responding to emerging problems, particularly new diseases, more quickly and more efficiently. This will also enhance the work by crop research institutions, prevent considerable economic loss to farmers, and improve crop production.
records.abstract_cn: 全球人口不断增长和气候变化的挑战使得开发新的改良小麦品种变得越来越重要。培育抗病性更强、更能适应不断变化的环境条件从而被广泛采用的品种，需要育种者了解生产者的需求。现有文献表明，抗病性和品牌等时不变特征在作物采用决策中很重要；然而，使用常见面板数据方法的研究无法识别时不变变量的个体效应，因为它们被固定效应虚拟变量所捕获。本研究使用一种最近开发的经济计量方法——固定效应过滤模型——该方法可以估计时变、缓慢变化和时不变特征的影响。以加拿大草原地区的小麦品种采用作为实证背景，我们发现时变特征（如品种适应性）和时不变特征（如抗条锈病感染）均与采用呈正相关。我们还发现种子品牌对采用具有统计上显著的影响。以往关于作物采用的面板数据研究对病害耐受性和种子品牌等时不变品种特征关注不多，但更好地理解它们对采用的影响可以帮助育种者更快、更有效地应对新出现的问题，特别是新病害。这也将加强作物研究机构的工作，防止农民遭受重大经济损失，并提高作物产量。

records.title_en: Dynamic model of entry: Dollar stores
records.title_cn: 动态进入模型：一元店
records.abstract_en: Dollar stores have become the fastest‐growing retail format in the United States. However, there is considerable controversy regarding their entry, particularly into markets without grocery stores, and concerns that dollar‐store entry decisions are motivated by preemptive incentives. In this paper, we aim to study the market entry of dollar stores as an equilibrium phenomenon and to examine their impact on competing store formats in a dynamic environment. We use census‐tract level data and develop a dynamic model of oligopolistic competition to estimate the impact of dollar store entry on the equilibrium entry decisions of other retailers of the same format and other formats. We find that supermarkets and other large‐format owners thrive as dollar‐store expansion removes their “competitive fringe” in shared markets, whereas other small‐format stores (other dollar stores, convenience stores, and superettes) do not. Our findings have broad implications for the effect of dollar store entry on consumer welfare, as dollar‐store entry is not associated with grocery‐store exit but rather the exit of other small‐format stores.
records.abstract_cn: 一元店已成为美国增长最快的零售业态。然而，关于其进入市场，尤其是进入没有杂货店的市场，存在相当大的争议，并且有人担心一元店的进入决策是出于先发制人的动机。在本文中，我们旨在将一元店的市场进入作为均衡现象进行研究，并考察其在动态环境中对竞争业态的影响。我们使用人口普查区层面的数据，开发了一个寡头竞争动态模型，以估计一元店进入对同业态及其他业态其他零售商均衡进入决策的影响。我们发现，超市和其他大型业态所有者因一元店的扩张在共享市场中消除了其“竞争边缘”而蓬勃发展，而其他小型业态（其他一元店、便利店和小型超市）则不然。我们的研究结果对一元店进入对消费者福利的影响具有广泛意义，因为一元店进入与杂货店退出无关，而是与其他小型业态的退出相关。

records.title_en: Price‐endogenous technology, producer welfare, and ex ante impact assessment: The case of industrial hemp
records.title_cn: 价格内生技术、生产者福利与事前影响评估：以工业大麻为例
records.abstract_en: The emerging hemp industry is an example of an important class of agricultural products where the market extent is limited, in hemp's case by laws and regulations, causing technology adoption to interact through prices with market‐level equilibrium. In this paper, we show that the equilibrium adoption rate and producer welfare impact of new technology, such as improved hemp genetics and management, are determined by the interaction between market prices and the spatial distribution of returns of both current and new technologies in the farm population. Price changes affect adoption and welfare through shifts in both the location (mean) and dispersion (variance and higher moments) of the spatial distribution of gains to the new technology. We show that an output price change may either increase or decrease the adoption rate of a new technology and in turn impact the elasticity of the market supply function. Additionally, we derive market‐equilibrium measures of welfare change for both adopters and non‐adopters and show how these welfare measures are affected by the spatial distribution of returns to a new technology. Our finding suggests that the interplay between new technologies and price changes is likely to have empirically important effects on regional supply and farm welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 新兴的大麻产业是一类重要农产品的例子，其市场范围受到限制，在大麻的情况下受到法律法规的限制，导致技术采用通过价格与市场层面的均衡相互作用。在本文中，我们表明新技术的均衡采用率和生产者福利影响，如改良的大麻遗传学和管理，是由市场价格与农场群体中现有和新技术收益的空间分布之间的相互作用决定的。价格变化通过改变新技术收益空间分布的位置（均值）和离散度（方差及更高矩）来影响采用和福利。我们表明，产出价格变化可能增加或减少新技术的采用率，并进而影响市场供给函数的弹性。此外，我们推导了采用者和非采用者福利变化的市场均衡度量，并展示了这些福利度量如何受到新技术收益空间分布的影响。我们的发现表明，新技术与价格变化之间的相互作用可能对区域供给和农场福利产生经验上重要的影响。

records.title_en: Aging out of WIC and child nutrition: Evidence from a regression discontinuity design
records.title_cn: 退出WIC计划与儿童营养：基于断点回归设计的证据
records.abstract_en: The Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) is the third largest food assistance program in the United States. Child participants lose WIC in the month following their fifth birthday. We use this exogenous program rule for identification and find diet quality declines nearly 20%, on average, for those who have yet to transition into kindergarten. Decreases are mainly driven by reduced consumption of healthier WIC‐targeted foods. A quantile regression discontinuity approach reveals children prone to lower quality diets experience the largest decreases in diet quality, reaching nearly 30%, whereas those prone to higher quality diets experience no aging‐out‐of‐WIC effects. There are no effects on calorie consumption, regardless of school attendance, indicating caregivers maintain diet quantity for children at the expense of diet quality. Policy implications include allowing children to stay on WIC until they enter kindergarten. We calculate back‐of‐the‐envelope program costs over the next 5 years for such a “kindergarten‐roll‐off” WIC policy under current rules and newly proposed rules to realign WIC packages with the Dietary Guidelines for Americans. Under current rules, costs would average $112 million over the next 5 years (2024–2028), or about 2% of total program costs. Under proposed rule changes, kindergarten‐roll‐off costs would average $144 million per year, or 2.25% of total program costs.
records.abstract_cn: 妇女、婴儿和儿童特别补充营养计划（WIC）是美国第三大食品援助计划。儿童参与者在五岁生日后的一个月内失去WIC资格。我们利用这一外生计划规则进行识别，发现对于那些尚未进入幼儿园的儿童，饮食质量平均下降近20%。下降主要由更健康的WIC目标食品消费减少所驱动。分位数断点回归方法揭示，倾向于较低饮食质量的儿童经历最大的饮食质量下降，达到近30%，而倾向于较高饮食质量的儿童则没有受到退出WIC计划的影响。无论是否上学，对卡路里摄入量均无影响，表明照护者以牺牲饮食质量为代价维持儿童的饮食数量。政策含义包括允许儿童在进入幼儿园之前继续享受WIC。我们计算了在现行规则和新提议规则下，未来5年内这种“幼儿园退出”WIC政策的粗略项目成本，以重新调整WIC套餐与《美国人膳食指南》保持一致。在现行规则下，未来112年（5-2024）的平均成本为2028亿美元，约占项目总成本的2%。在提议的规则变更下，幼儿园退出的平均成本为每年144亿美元，占项目总成本的2.25%。

records.title_en: Hazardous human–wildlife encounters, risk attitudes, and the value of shark nets for coastal recreation
records.title_cn: 危险的人与野生动物遭遇、风险态度以及防鲨网对沿海休闲的价值
records.abstract_en: Shark incidents are rare and graphic events, and their consequences can influence the behavior of beach users, including bathers, to a great extent. These incidents can be thought of as a fearsome risk that may lead decision makers to overreact or respond with inaction. This paper examines the reaction of recreational beach users, including bathers, to changes in the risk of shark incidents. In addition to valuing recreational visits to Durban Beach, South Africa, we study the reaction of beach visitors to a hypothetical scenario in which protective shark nets, deployed in coastal waters to protect bathers, are to be removed. To examine potential heterogeneity of the treatment effect in a travel cost‐contingent behavior model, we develop a semiparametric multivariate Poisson lognormal (MPLN) model to jointly analyze observed and stated visit counts. Results show that removing protective shark nets at Durban beach would decrease recreational visits by more than 20%. Applying the semiparametric MPLN model we further find that both the value of a recreational visit and the predicted change in visitation rates vary as a function of whether recreationists usually enter the water, whether they have heard of previous shark incidents, and their general risk attitude.
records.abstract_cn: 鲨鱼事件是罕见且令人震惊的事件，其后果可能在很大程度上影响海滩使用者（包括游泳者）的行为。这些事件可以被视为一种可怕的风险，可能导致决策者过度反应或无所作为。本文考察了休闲海滩使用者（包括游泳者）对鲨鱼事件风险变化的反应。除了评估南非德班海滩的休闲访问价值外，我们还研究了海滩游客对假设情景的反应，在该情景中，为保护游泳者而在沿海水域部署的防护性防鲨网将被移除。为了检验旅行成本-条件行为模型中处理效应的潜在异质性，我们开发了一个半参数多元泊松对数正态（MPLN）模型，以联合分析观测到的和陈述的访问次数。结果表明，移除德班海滩的防护性防鲨网将使休闲访问减少超过20%。应用半参数MPLN模型，我们进一步发现，休闲访问的价值和访问率预测变化均随休闲者是否通常下水、是否听说过以前的鲨鱼事件以及他们的总体风险态度而变化。

records.title_en: Social comparisons and groundwater use: Evidence from Colorado and Kansas
records.title_cn: 社会比较与地下水使用：来自科罗拉多州和堪萨斯州的证据
records.abstract_en: In the United States, agriculture is responsible for the majority of consumptive water use. To reduce consumptive use in water scarce regions, policymakers have implemented a number of costly interventions. These interventions range from land retirement to subsidies that encourage the adoption of efficient irrigation technologies. In nonagricultural contexts, costly policy interventions have been complemented by low‐cost interventions inspired by behavioral economics. Whether these behavioral interventions are effective in the context of commercial farming is not well understood. In a preregistered, randomized field intervention, we estimate the impact of social (peer) comparisons on agricultural groundwater users in Colorado and Kansas. More than three thousand irrigators were randomized to receive either an annual peer comparison or no comparison. The peer comparison contrasted each irrigator's groundwater use to the distribution of use by neighboring irrigators. The comparison intervention reduced average annual groundwater use by 4.05% [95% CI (−5.87%, − 2.21%)], resulting in an aggregate reduction of more than 21,000 acre‐feet per year at a cost less than $1.31 per acre‐foot conserved. The estimated treatment effect was larger among irrigators with lower pre‐intervention water use. In the 3‐year experiment, we observed no evidence that the treatment effect substantially attenuated over time. We did, however, detect within‐irrigator spillovers in the treatment group: groundwater use also declined among wells that were not included in the peer comparisons (peer comparisons included a maximum of three wells). The results imply that social comparisons can be a cost‐effective tool, alongside other policy interventions, aimed at reducing agricultural water use.
records.abstract_cn: 在美国，农业是消耗性用水的主要来源。为了减少水资源短缺地区的消耗性用水，政策制定者实施了多项成本高昂的干预措施。这些干预措施从土地休耕到鼓励采用高效灌溉技术的补贴不等。在非农业背景下，成本高昂的政策干预措施已辅以行为经济学启发的低成本干预措施。这些行为干预措施在商业农业背景下是否有效尚不清楚。在一项预注册的随机实地干预中，我们估计了社会（同伴）比较对科罗拉多州和堪萨斯州农业地下水使用者的影响。超过三千名灌溉者被随机分配接受年度同伴比较或不接受比较。同伴比较将每位灌溉者的地下水使用量与邻近灌溉者的使用分布进行对比。比较干预使年均地下水使用量减少了4.05% [95%置信区间（-5.87%，2.21%）]，每年总减少量超过21000英亩-英尺，成本低于每英亩-英尺节约1.31美元。估计的处理效应在干预前用水量较低的灌溉者中更大。在为期3年的实验中，我们没有观察到处理效应随时间大幅减弱的证据。然而，我们确实检测到处理组内灌溉者内部的溢出效应：未包含在同伴比较中的水井（同伴比较最多包含三口井）的地下水使用量也有所下降。结果表明，社会比较可以作为一种具有成本效益的工具，与其他政策干预措施一起，旨在减少农业用水。

records.title_en: Taxing sugar‐sweetened beverages: A nonlinear pricing approach
records.title_cn: 对含糖饮料征税：一种非线性定价方法
records.abstract_en: Taxation is frequently implemented to discourage the consumption of sugary beverages. Despite their popularity, little is known about the impacts of taxes when sellers practice price discrimination. To address this issue, we use a standard nonlinear pricing model with one product and two buyer types to study the effects of taxation on (i) consumption, (ii) consumer and producer surpluses, and (iii) the seller's choice of market segmentation scheme. We find that a tax would lead to reductions in consumption, consumer surplus, and expected profit. Additionally, the measure increases the likelihood that the sellers would exclude buyers with low preferences for the beverage to exclusively serve buyers with high willingness to pay for the product.
records.abstract_cn: 税收经常被用来抑制含糖饮料的消费。尽管税收很受欢迎，但当卖方实行价格歧视时，人们对税收的影响知之甚少。为了解决这个问题，我们使用一个标准非线性定价模型，该模型包含一种产品和两种买方类型，来研究税收对（i）消费，（ii）消费者和生产者剩余，以及（iii）卖方市场细分方案选择的影响。我们发现，税收会导致消费、消费者剩余和预期利润的减少。此外，该措施增加了卖方排除对饮料偏好较低的买方、只服务于对产品支付意愿高的买方的可能性。

records.title_en: Steady-State Social Distancing and Vaccination
records.title_cn: 稳态社交距离与疫苗接种
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes an economic-epidemiological model of infectious disease where it is possible to become infected more than once and individual agents make endogenous choices of social distancing and vaccine adoption. Protective actions adopted by any one person reduce future risks to other people. The positive externalities associated with these behaviors provide motivation for vaccine and social-distancing subsidies, but subsidizing one protective action reduces incentives for other protective actions. A vaccine subsidy increases vaccine adoption and reduces steady-state infection prevalence; a social distancing subsidy can either increase or reduce steady-state infection prevalence. (JEL D62, D91, I12, I18)
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了一个传染病的经济-流行病学模型，在该模型中，个体可能多次感染，并且个体代理人内生地选择社交距离和疫苗采用。任何一个人采取的保护性行动都会降低未来对其他人的风险。与这些行为相关的正外部性为疫苗和社交距离补贴提供了动机，但补贴一种保护性行动会减少对其他保护性行动的激励。疫苗补贴增加了疫苗采用并降低了稳态感染率；社交距离补贴可以增加或减少稳态感染率。（JEL D62, D91, I12, I18）

records.title_en: Race and the Mismeasure of School Quality
records.title_cn: 种族与学校质量的误测
records.abstract_en: In large urban districts, schools enrolling more White students tend to have higher performance ratings. We use an instrumental variables strategy leveraging centralized school assignment to explore this relationship. Estimates from Denver and New York City suggest that the correlation between school performance ratings and White enrollment shares reflects selection bias rather than causal school value added. In fact, value added in these two cities is essentially unrelated to White enrollment shares. A simple regression adjustment is shown to yield school ratings uncorrelated with race while predicting value added as well as or better than the corresponding unadjusted measures. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15)
records.abstract_cn: 在大型城市学区中，招收更多白人学生的学校往往获得更高的绩效评级。我们利用集中式学校分配的工具变量策略来探讨这一关系。来自丹佛和纽约市的估计表明，学校绩效评级与白人入学比例之间的相关性反映了选择偏差，而非因果性的学校增值。事实上，这两个城市的增值与白人入学比例基本无关。简单的回归调整被证明能产生与种族无关的学校评级，同时预测增值的效果与相应的未调整指标相当或更好。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15）

records.title_en: Wage Garnishment in the United States: New Facts from Administrative Payroll Records
records.title_cn: 美国的工资扣押：来自行政工资记录的新事实
records.abstract_en: Wage garnishment allows creditors to deduct money from workers’ paychecks to repay defaulted debts. We document new facts about wage garnishment between 2014 and 2019 using data from a large payroll processor that distributes paychecks to approximately 20 percent of US private-sector workers. By 2019, over 1 in every 100 workers was being garnished for delinquent debt. The average garnished worker experiences garnishment for five months, during which approximately 11 percent of gross earnings is remitted to their creditor(s). The beginning of a garnishment is associated with an increase in job turnover but no intensive margin change in hours worked. (JEL G51, J22, J63)
records.abstract_cn: 工资扣押允许债权人从工人的工资中扣除款项以偿还违约债务。我们利用一家大型工资处理机构的数据，记录了2014年至2019年间关于工资扣押的新事实，该机构向约20%的美国私营部门工人发放工资。到2019年，每100名工人中就有超过1人因拖欠债务而被扣押工资。平均被扣押工资的工人经历五个月的扣押期，在此期间，约11%的总收入被汇给其债权人。扣押工资的开始与工作流动性的增加有关，但在工作时间上没有集约边际的变化。(JEL G51, J22, J63)

records.title_en: The Irrelevance of Fee Structures for Certification
records.title_cn: 认证费用结构的无关性
records.abstract_en: In models of certification, possible restrictions on the nature of the fee structures are commonly analyzed. We show that they are irrelevant for the certifier’s ability to maximize profits and trade efficiency. Our results establish that certification schemes involve two substitutable dimensions—the fee structure and the disclosure rule. In the context of a canonical unit good certification setup, these dimensions act as perfect substitutes for achieving trade efficiency and (monotone) distributions of rents; adjustments in the disclosure dimension can fully mitigate restrictions in the fee dimension, but these changes do affect market transparency. (JEL D82, D83, G24, G28)
records.abstract_cn: 在认证模型中，通常会对费用结构的可能限制进行分析。我们证明这些限制对于认证者最大化利润和交易效率的能力是无关的。我们的结果确立了认证方案涉及两个可替代的维度——费用结构和披露规则。在典型的单位商品认证设置的背景下，这些维度在实现交易效率和（单调的）租金分配方面完全替代；披露维度的调整可以完全缓解费用维度的限制，但这些变化确实会影响市场透明度。（JEL D82, D83, G24, G28）

records.title_en: Real Effects of Markets on Politics: Evidence from US Presidential Elections
records.title_cn: 市场对政治的真实影响：来自美国总统选举的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite the economic importance of the US stock market, there is strikingly little evidence of its impact on elections. Using county-level variation in stock market participation, we document the impact of market returns on election outcomes. High-participation counties are more likely to vote for the incumbent party when the market has performed well relative to low-participation counties. Our findings provide evidence of a novel channel through which stock market fluctuations could be transmitted into the real economy. (JEL D72, G12, G35, G41, G51)
records.abstract_cn: 尽管美国股市具有经济重要性，但关于其对选举影响的证据却出奇地少。利用县级股市参与率的差异，我们记录了市场回报对选举结果的影响。当市场表现良好时，高参与率的县相比低参与率的县更有可能投票给现任政党。我们的发现提供了证据，表明股市波动可能通过一种新的渠道传导至实体经济。（JEL D72, G12, G35, G41, G51）

records.title_en: Interest Rates and the Spatial Polarization of Housing Markets
records.title_cn: 利率与住房市场的空间极化
records.abstract_en: Rising within-country differences in house values are a much-debated trend in the United States and internationally. Using new long-run regional data for 15 advanced economies, we show that standard explanations linking growing price dispersion to rent dispersion are contradicted by an important stylized fact: rent dispersion has increased far less than price dispersion. We propose a new explanation: a uniform decline in real risk-free interest rates can have heterogeneous spatial effects on house values. Falling real safe rates disproportionately push up prices in large agglomerations where initial rent-price ratios are low, leading to housing market polarization on the national level. (JEL E43, R21, R31)
records.abstract_cn: 国内房价差异的扩大是美国和国际上备受争议的趋势。利用15个发达经济体的新长期区域数据，我们表明，将价格离散度增长与租金离散度联系起来的标准解释与一个重要的事实相矛盾：租金离散度的增长远低于价格离散度。我们提出了一种新的解释：实际无风险利率的普遍下降可能对房价产生异质性的空间影响。实际安全利率的下降不成比例地推高了大城市群的价格，这些地区的初始租金-价格比率较低，从而导致国家层面的住房市场极化。(JEL E43, R21, R31)

records.title_en: The Marginal Disutility from Corruption in Social Programs: Evidence from Program Administrators and Beneficiaries
records.title_cn: 社会项目中腐败的边际负效用：来自项目管理者与受益者的证据
records.abstract_en: Concerns about fraud in welfare programs are common arguments worldwide against such programs. We conducted a survey experiment with over 28,000 welfare program administrators and over 19,000 beneficiaries in Indonesia to elicit the “marginal disutility from corruption”—the trade-off between more generous social assistance and losses due to corruption. Merely mentioning corruption reduced perceived program success, equivalent to distributing more than 26 percentage points less aid. However, respondents were not sensitive to the amount of corruption—respondents were willing to trade off $2 of additional losses for an additional $1 distributed to beneficiaries. Program administrators and beneficiaries had similar assessments. (JEL D73, H53, I32, I38, O15, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 对福利项目中欺诈的担忧是世界范围内反对此类项目的常见论据。我们在印度尼西亚对超过28,000名福利项目管理者和超过19,000名受益者进行了一项调查实验，以引出“腐败的边际负效用”——即更慷慨的社会援助与腐败造成的损失之间的权衡。仅仅提及腐败就会降低感知的项目成功率，相当于少分配超过26个百分点的援助。然而，受访者对腐败程度并不敏感——受访者愿意为额外分配给受益者的1美元承担2美元的额外损失。项目管理者和受益者的评估相似。(JEL D73, H53, I32, I38, O15, O17)

records.title_en: Can Financial Incentives to Firms Improve Apprenticeship Training? Experimental Evidence from Ghana
records.title_cn: 对企业的财务激励能否改善学徒培训？来自加纳的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We use a field experiment to test whether financial incentives can improve the quality of apprenticeship training. Trainers (firm owners) in the treatment group participated in a tournament incentive scheme where they received a payment based on their apprentices’ rank-order performance on a skills assessment. Trainers in the control group received a fixed payment based on their apprentices’ participation in the assessment. Performance on the assessment was higher in the treatment group. Two years later, treated apprentices scored 0.15σ higher on a low-stakes oral skills test and earned 24 percent more in total earnings, driven by higher self-employment profits. (JEL D22, D82, J24, J31, M53, O12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项实地实验来检验财务激励能否提高学徒培训的质量。处理组的培训师（企业主）参与了一项锦标赛激励计划，他们根据学徒在技能评估中的排名表现获得报酬。对照组的培训师则根据学徒参与评估的情况获得固定报酬。处理组在评估中的表现更高。两年后，接受处理的学徒在低风险口头技能测试中得分高出0.15个标准差，总收入高出24%，这主要得益于更高的自雇利润。（JEL D22, D82, J24, J31, M53, O12）

records.title_en: Cash and Conflict: Large-Scale Experimental Evidence from Niger
records.title_cn: 现金与冲突：来自尼日尔的大规模实验证据
records.abstract_en: Conflict undermines development, while adverse economic shocks, in turn, can increase conflict risk. Policy interventions such as cash transfers could attenuate conflict risk by raising poor households’ opportunity costs. However, cash transfers may also trigger looting, and expanding government programs may attract attacks to undermine state legitimacy. We study the net effect across these forces based on the large-scale randomization of a government-led cash transfer program and georeferenced conflict events. Cash transfers did not yield greater pacification but—if anything—triggered a short-term increase in conflict events (by 0.63 percentage points), substantially driven by terrorist attacks by foreign rebel groups. (JEL D72, D74, H53, I38, O15, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 冲突阻碍发展，而不利的经济冲击反过来又会增加冲突风险。诸如现金转移之类的政策干预可以通过提高贫困家庭的机会成本来降低冲突风险。然而，现金转移也可能引发抢劫，而且扩大政府项目可能招致攻击以削弱国家合法性。我们基于一个政府主导的现金转移项目的大规模随机化和地理参照冲突事件来研究这些力量的净效应。现金转移并未带来更大的和平效果，反而——如果有的话——在短期内增加了冲突事件（增加了0.63个百分点），这主要由外国叛乱团体的恐怖袭击驱动。（JEL D72, D74, H53, I38, O15, O17）

records.title_en: The Economics of the Public Option: Evidence from Local Pharmaceutical Markets
records.title_cn: 公共选项的经济学：来自地方药品市场的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of competition by state-owned firms, leveraging the decentralized entry of public pharmacies to local markets in Chile. Public pharmacies sell the same drugs at a third of private pharmacy prices, because of stronger upstream bargaining and market power in the private sector, but are of lower quality. Public pharmacies induced market segmentation and price increases in the private sector, which benefited the switchers to the public option but harmed the stayers. The countrywide entry of public pharmacies would reduce yearly consumer drug expenditure by 1.6 percent.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了国有企业竞争的影响，利用智利公共药店分散进入地方市场的特点。公共药店以私人药店价格的三分之一销售相同的药品，这是因为上游议价能力更强且私人部门具有市场势力，但公共药店的质量较低。公共药店导致了市场分割和私人部门的价格上涨，这有利于转向公共选项的消费者，但损害了留在私人部门的消费者。全国范围内公共药店的进入将使消费者年度药品支出减少1.6%。

records.title_en: The Effect of Macroeconomic Uncertainty on Household Spending
records.title_cn: 宏观经济不确定性对家庭支出的影响
records.abstract_en: We use randomized treatments that provide different types of information about the first and/or second moments of future economic growth to generate exogenous changes in the perceived macroeconomic uncertainty of treated households. The effects on their spending decisions relative to an untreated control group are measured in follow-up surveys. Our results indicate that, after taking into account first moments, higher macroeconomic uncertainty induces households to significantly and persistently reduce their total monthly spending in subsequent months. Changes in spending are broad based across spending categories and apply to larger durable good purchases as well.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用随机化处理，提供关于未来经济增长第一和/或第二矩的不同类型信息，以生成受处理家庭感知宏观经济不确定性的外生变化。在后续调查中测量了相对于未处理对照组，这些变化对其支出决策的影响。我们的结果表明，在考虑第一矩后，更高的宏观经济不确定性促使家庭在随后几个月显著且持续地减少其月度总支出。支出的变化在支出类别中广泛存在，并适用于较大的耐用品购买。

records.title_en: Optimal Inference for Spot Regressions
records.title_cn: 现货回归的最优推断
records.abstract_en: Betas from return regressions are commonly used to measure systematic financial market risks. "Good" beta measurements are essential for a range of empirical inquiries in finance and macroeconomics. We introduce a novel econometric framework for the nonparametric estimation of time-varying betas with high-frequency data. The "local Gaussian" property of the generic continuous-time benchmark model enables optimal "finite-sample" inference in a well-defined sense. It also affords more reliable inference in empirically realistic settings compared to conventional large-sample approaches. Two applications pertaining to the tracking performance of leveraged ETFs and an intraday event study illustrate the practical usefulness of the new procedures.
records.abstract_cn: 来自收益回归的贝塔值通常用于衡量系统性金融市场风险。"良好"的贝塔值测量对于金融和宏观经济学的众多实证研究至关重要。我们引入了一种新的计量经济学框架，用于高频数据下时变贝塔值的非参数估计。通用连续时间基准模型的"局部高斯"性质使得在明确定义的意义上能够进行最优的"有限样本"推断。与传统的大样本方法相比，它在实证现实环境中也提供了更可靠的推断。两个应用——涉及杠杆ETF的跟踪表现和日内事件研究——说明了新程序的实际用途。

records.title_en: The Comparative Statics of Sorting
records.title_cn: 排序的比较静态分析
records.abstract_en: We create a general and tractable theory of increasing sorting in pairwise matching models with monetary transfers. The positive quadrant dependence partial order subsumes Becker (1973) as the extreme cases with most and least sorting and implies increasing regression coefficients. Our theory turns on synergy—the cross-partial difference or derivative of match production. This reflects basic economic forces: diminishing returns, technological convexity, insurance, and learning dynamics. We prove sorting increases if match synergy globally increases, and is cross-sectionally monotone or single crossing. We use our results to derive sorting predictions in major economics sorting papers and in new applications.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个关于具有货币转移的配对匹配模型中递增排序的一般且易处理的理论。正象限依赖偏序将Becker（1973）作为排序最多和最少两个极端情况包含在内，并意味着递增的回归系数。我们的理论依赖于协同效应——匹配产出的交叉偏差异或导数。这反映了基本的经济力量：边际收益递减、技术凸性、保险和学习动态。我们证明，如果匹配协同效应全局增加，则排序增加，并且排序在横截面上是单调的或具有单交叉性质。我们利用我们的结果在主要经济学排序论文和新应用中推导出排序预测。

records.title_en: Mental Models and Learning: The Case of Base-Rate Neglect
records.title_cn: 心智模型与学习：以基率忽视为例
records.abstract_en: We experimentally document persistence of suboptimal behavior despite ample opportunities to learn from feedback in a canonical updating problem where people suffer from base-rate neglect. Our results provide insights on the mechanisms hindering learning from feedback. Importantly, our results suggest mistakes are more likely to be persistent when they are driven by incorrect mental models that miss or misrepresent important aspects of the environment. Such models induce confidence in initial answers, limiting engagement with and learning from feedback. We substantiate these insights in an alternative scenario where individuals involved in a voting problem overlook the importance of being pivotal.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验记录了一个典型更新问题中次优行为的持续性，尽管有充分的机会从反馈中学习，但人们仍遭受基率忽视。我们的结果提供了关于阻碍从反馈中学习的机制的见解。重要的是，我们的结果表明，当错误由不正确的心智模型驱动，这些模型遗漏或错误表征了环境的重要方面时，错误更可能持续存在。这类模型引发对初始答案的信心，限制了对反馈的参与和学习。我们在一个替代场景中证实了这些见解，在该场景中，参与投票问题的个体忽视了成为关键投票者的重要性。

records.title_en: Hub-and-Spoke Cartels: Theory and Evidence from the Grocery Industry
records.title_cn: 轮轴式卡特尔：来自杂货业的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: Numerous recently uncovered cartels operated along the supply chain, with firms at one end facilitating collusion at the other—hub-and-spoke arrangements. These cartels are hard to rationalize because they induce double marginalization and higher costs. We examine Canada's alleged bread cartel and provide the first comprehensive analysis of hub-and-spoke collusion. Using court documents and pricing data, we make three contributions: (i) we show that collusion was effective, increasing inflation by about 50 percent; (ii) we provide evidence that collusion existed at both ends of the supply chain; and (iii) we develop a model explaining why this form of collusion arose.
records.abstract_cn: 许多近期被揭露的卡特尔沿着供应链运作，一端的企业促进另一端的合谋——即轮轴式安排。这些卡特尔难以合理化，因为它们导致双重边际化和更高的成本。我们考察了加拿大涉嫌的面包卡特尔，并提供了对轮轴式合谋的首次全面分析。利用法院文件和定价数据，我们做出了三项贡献：（i）我们表明合谋是有效的，使通货膨胀率增加了约50%；（ii）我们提供了供应链两端均存在合谋的证据；（iii）我们建立了一个模型来解释为何会出现这种形式的合谋。

records.title_en: Does the Squeaky Wheel Get More Grease? The Direct and Indirect Effects of Citizen Participation on Environmental Governance in China
records.title_cn: 吱吱作响的轮子是否得到更多润滑？公民参与对中国环境治理的直接和间接影响
records.abstract_en: We conducted a nationwide field experiment in China to evaluate the direct and indirect impacts of assigning firms to public or private citizen appeals when they violate pollution standards. There are three main findings. First, public appeals to the regulator through social media substantially reduce violations and pollution emissions, while private appeals cause more modest environmental improvements. Second, public appeals appear to tilt regulators' focus away from facilitating economic growth and toward avoiding pollution-induced public unrest. Third, pollution reductions by treated firms are not offset by control firms, based on randomly varying the proportion of treated firms at the prefecture level.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在中国进行了一项全国性的实地实验，以评估当企业违反污染标准时，指派企业接受公众或私人公民申诉的直接和间接影响。主要有三个发现。首先，通过社交媒体向监管机构公开申诉显著减少了违规行为和污染排放，而私人申诉则带来较为温和的环境改善。其次，公开申诉似乎使监管机构的关注点从促进经济增长转向避免污染引发的公众不安。第三，基于在地级市层面随机变化处理企业比例，处理企业的污染减少并未被控制企业所抵消。

records.title_en: The Gender Gap in Confidence: Expected but Not Accounted For
records.title_cn: 性别信心差距：意料之中但未被考虑
records.abstract_en: We investigate how the gender gap in confidence affects the views that evaluators (e.g., employers) hold about men and women. We find the confidence gap is contagious, causing evaluators to form overly pessimistic beliefs about women. This result arises even though the confidence gap is expected and even though the confidence gap shouldn't be contagious if evaluators are Bayesian. Only an intervention that facilitates Bayesian updating proves (somewhat) effective. Additional results highlight how similar findings follow even when there is no room for discriminatory motives or differences in priors because evaluators are asked about arbitrary, rather than gender-specific, groups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了信心方面的性别差距如何影响评估者（如雇主）对男性和女性的看法。我们发现信心差距具有传染性，导致评估者对女性形成过度悲观的信念。即使信心差距是意料之中的，且如果评估者是贝叶斯式的，信心差距本不应具有传染性，这一结果仍然出现。只有促进贝叶斯更新的干预措施被证明（在一定程度上）有效。其他结果强调了即使在没有歧视动机或先验差异的空间时，类似发现也会出现，因为评估者被询问的是任意群体而非特定性别群体。

records.title_en: Credit Freezes, Equilibrium Multiplicity, and Optimal Bailouts in Financial Networks
records.title_cn: 金融网络中的信贷冻结、均衡多重性与最优救助
records.abstract_en: We analyze how interdependencies in financial networks can lead to self-fulfilling insolvencies and multiple possible equilibrium outcomes. Multiplicity arises if a certain type of dependency cycle exists in the network. We show that finding the cheapest bailout policy that prevents self-fulfilling insolvencies is computationally hard, but that the optimal policy has intuitive features in some typical network structures. Leveraging indirect benefits ensures systemic solvency at a cost that never exceeds half of the overall shortfall. In core-periphery networks, it is optimal to bail out peripheral banks first as opposed to core banks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了金融网络中的相互依存如何导致自我实现的破产和多种可能的均衡结果。如果网络中存在某种类型的依存循环，就会出现多重性。我们表明，找到防止自我实现破产的最便宜救助政策在计算上是困难的，但在一些典型的网络结构中，最优政策具有直观的特征。利用间接收益确保系统性偿付能力的成本永远不会超过总缺口的一半。在核心-外围网络中，最优做法是先救助外围银行，而不是核心银行。

records.title_en: Bond Price Fragility and the Structure of the Mutual Fund Industry
records.title_cn: 债券价格脆弱性与共同基金行业结构
records.abstract_en: We conjecture that mutual funds with large shares of outstanding bond issues are more inclined to internalize the negative price spillovers of fire sales and thus sell their holdings in those issues, to a lower extent, when they experience redemptions. We provide evidence consistent with this conjecture and further show that ownership concentration limits bonds’ exposures to flow-induced fire sales. We exploit variation in negative spillovers arising from the Fed’s SMCCF to confirm the economic mechanism and explore our findings’ implications for fund performance and fire-sale spillovers to other funds.
records.abstract_cn: 我们推测，持有未偿债券发行份额较大的共同基金更倾向于内化抛售的负面价格溢出效应，因此在面临赎回时，它们出售所持这些债券的程度较低。我们提供了与这一推测一致的证据，并进一步表明所有权集中限制了债券对资金流动引发的抛售的暴露。我们利用美联储SMCCF引起的负面溢出效应的变化来确认经济机制，并探讨我们的发现对基金业绩和抛售对其他基金溢出效应的影响。

records.title_en: Unsmoothing Returns of Illiquid Funds
records.title_cn: 非流动性基金收益的平滑消除
records.abstract_en: Funds investing in illiquid assets report returns with spurious autocorrelation. Consequently, investors need to unsmooth these funds’ returns when evaluating their risk exposures. We show that funds with similar investments share a common source of spurious autocorrelation not fully resolved by traditional unsmoothing methods and thereby leading to underestimation of systematic risk. Thus, we propose a generalized unsmoothing technique and apply it to hedge funds and private commercial real estate funds. Our method significantly improves the measurement of funds’ risk exposures and risk-adjusted performance, especially for highly illiquid funds. Overall, the average illiquid fund alpha is lower than previously thought. (JEL G11, G12, G23)
records.abstract_cn: 投资于非流动性资产的基金报告的收益存在虚假自相关。因此，投资者在评估其风险敞口时需要消除这些基金收益的平滑效应。我们表明，具有相似投资的基金共享一个虚假自相关的共同来源，传统平滑消除方法无法完全解决这一问题，从而导致系统性风险被低估。因此，我们提出了一种广义平滑消除技术，并将其应用于对冲基金和私募商业房地产基金。我们的方法显著改善了基金风险敞口和风险调整后绩效的度量，尤其是对于高度非流动性的基金。总体而言，平均非流动性基金的阿尔法低于先前认为的水平。（JEL G11, G12, G23）

records.title_en: Size Discount and Size Penalty: Trading Costs in Bond Markets
records.title_cn: 规模折扣与规模惩罚：债券市场中的交易成本
records.abstract_en: We show that larger trades incur lower trading costs in government bond markets (“size discount”), but costs increase in trade size after controlling for client identity (“size penalty”). The size discount is driven by the cross-client variation of larger traders obtaining better prices, consistent with theories of trading with imperfect competition. The size penalty, driven by the within-client variation, is larger for corporate bonds, during major macroeconomic surprises and during COVID-19. These differences are larger among more sophisticated clients, consistent with information-based theories.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，在政府债券市场中，较大的交易产生较低的交易成本（“规模折扣”），但在控制客户身份后，成本随交易规模增加而增加（“规模惩罚”）。规模折扣由较大交易者获得更好价格的跨客户差异驱动，与不完全竞争下的交易理论一致。规模惩罚由客户内部差异驱动，在公司债券、重大宏观经济意外事件以及COVID-19期间更为显著。这些差异在更成熟的客户中更大，与基于信息的理论一致。

records.title_en: Systemic Risk and Monetary Policy: The Haircut Gap Channel of the Lender of Last Resort
records.title_cn: 系统性风险与货币政策：最后贷款人的折扣率缺口渠道
records.abstract_en: We show that lender of last resort (LOLR) policy exacerbates bank interconnectedness. Using novel micro-level data, we analyze LOLR’s haircut gaps: the differences between the private market and central bank haircuts. LOLR policy incentivizes banks to increase pledging and holdings of higher haircut-gap bonds, especially those issued by domestic and systemically important banks. Effects only apply to banks, not to nonbanks without LOLR access. LOLR funding revives bank bond issuance associated with higher haircut gaps and increases the subsequent correlation between pledging and issuing banks’ bond prices, in particular during periods of low-market returns and for domestic, systemically important banks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，最后贷款人（LOLR）政策加剧了银行的相互关联性。利用新颖的微观层面数据，我们分析了LOLR的折扣率缺口：私人市场与中央银行折扣率之间的差异。LOLR政策激励银行增加对更高折扣率缺口债券的质押和持有，尤其是由国内和系统重要性银行发行的债券。这些效应仅适用于银行，而不适用于无法获得LOLR的非银行机构。LOLR融资重振了与更高折扣率缺口相关的银行债券发行，并增加了质押银行与发行银行债券价格之间的后续相关性，特别是在市场回报率较低的时期以及对于国内系统重要性银行而言。

records.title_en: Using Social Media to Identify the Effects of Congressional Viewpoints on Asset Prices
records.title_cn: 利用社交媒体识别国会观点对资产价格的影响
records.abstract_en: We use a high-frequency identification approach to document that individual politicians affect asset prices. We exploit the regular flow of viewpoints contained in Congress members’ tweets. Supportive (critical) tweets increase (decrease) the stock prices of the targeted firm and the corresponding industry in minutes around the tweet. The bulk of the stock price effects is concentrated in the tweets revealing news about future legislative action. The effects are amplified around committee meeting days, especially when the tweet originates from committee members and influential politicians. Overall, we show that Congress members’ social media accounts are an important source of political news.
records.abstract_cn: 我们采用高频识别方法，证明个别政治家会影响资产价格。我们利用国会议员推文中包含的常规观点流。支持性（批评性）推文在推文发布前后几分钟内提高（降低）目标公司及相应行业的股价。股价效应的大部分集中在揭示未来立法行动新闻的推文中。在委员会会议日前后，效应被放大，尤其是当推文来自委员会成员和有影响力的政治家时。总体而言，我们表明国会议员的社交媒体账户是政治新闻的重要来源。

records.title_en: The Psychological Externalities of Investing: Evidence from Stock Returns and Crime
records.title_cn: 投资的心理外部性：来自股票回报与犯罪的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the psychological effects from stock market returns. Using an FBI database of over 55 million daily reported crime incidents across the United States, crime is proposed as a measure of psychological well-being. The evidence suggests that stock returns affect the well-being of not only investors but also noninvestors. Specifically, a contemporaneous negative (positive) relationship between daily stock market returns and violent crime rates is found for investors (noninvestors). A similar relationship is also found between local earnings surprises and violent crime. The contrasting relationships for investors and noninvestors suggests that relative wealth may influence well-being.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了股票市场回报的心理效应。利用FBI数据库中美国超过55万条每日报告的犯罪事件，犯罪被提议作为心理健康的衡量指标。证据表明，股票回报不仅影响投资者的福祉，也影响非投资者的福祉。具体而言，发现每日股票市场回报与暴力犯罪率之间存在同期负（正）关系，对于投资者（非投资者）而言。类似的关系也存在于本地盈利惊喜与暴力犯罪之间。投资者与非投资者之间对比鲜明的关系表明，相对财富可能影响福祉。

records.title_en: The effects of recreational marijuana laws on drug use and crime
records.title_cn: 娱乐性大麻法律对毒品使用和犯罪的影响
records.abstract_en: Recreational marijuana laws (RMLs), which legalize the sale and possession of small quantities of marijuana for recreational use, have been adopted by 24 states and the District of Columbia. Using a generalized difference-in-differences approach and data for the period 2000–2019 from a variety of sources (the National Survey of Drug Use and Health, the Uniform Crime Reports, the Treatment Episode Data Set, and the National Vital Statistics Mortality files), this study comprehensively examines the effects of legalizing recreational marijuana on drug use, crime, and admissions to substance use treatment facilities. Our analyses show that RML adoption increases the use of marijuana by adults and reduces marijuana-related arrests. However, we find little evidence that RMLs increase the use of harder drugs, admissions to substance use treatment facilities, or property and violent crime. In fact, our results are consistent with the hypothesis that marijuana and opioids are substitutes.
records.abstract_cn: 娱乐性大麻法律（RMLs）将少量大麻用于娱乐用途的销售和持有合法化，已被24个州和哥伦比亚特区采纳。利用广义双重差分方法以及2000-2019年期间来自多种来源（全国毒品使用与健康调查、统一犯罪报告、治疗事件数据集和全国生命统计死亡率档案）的数据，本研究全面考察了娱乐性大麻合法化对毒品使用、犯罪和物质使用治疗机构入院的影响。我们的分析表明，RML的采纳增加了成年人使用大麻的情况，并减少了大麻相关的逮捕。然而，我们几乎没有发现证据表明RMLs增加了更硬性毒品的使用、物质使用治疗机构的入院或财产和暴力犯罪。事实上，我们的结果与 marijuana 和阿片类药物是替代品的假设一致。

records.title_en: Energy efficiency can deliver for climate policy: Evidence from machine learning-based targeting
records.title_cn: 能源效率可以促进气候政策：来自基于机器学习的目标的证据
records.abstract_en: Building energy efficiency has been a cornerstone of greenhouse gas mitigation strategies for decades. However, impact evaluations have revealed that energy savings typically fall short of engineering model forecasts that currently guide funding decisions. This creates a resource allocation problem that impedes progress on climate change. Using data from the Illinois implementation of the U.S.’s largest energy efficiency program, we demonstrate that a data-driven approach to predicting retrofit impacts based on previously realized outcomes is more accurate than the status quo engineering models. Targeting high-return interventions based on these predictions dramatically increases net social benefits, from $0.93 to $1.23 per dollar invested.
records.abstract_cn: 几十年来，建筑能源效率一直是温室气体减排战略的基石。然而，影响评估显示，节能通常达不到目前指导融资决策的工程模型预测。这造成了资源分配问题，阻碍了气候变化方面的进展。利用伊利诺伊州实施美国最大能源效率计划的数据，我们证明，基于先前实现的结果来预测改造影响的数据驱动方法比现状工程模型更准确。基于这些预测的有针对性的高回报干预措施极大地增加了净社会效益，从每美元投资$0.93增加到$1.23。

records.title_en: Optimal taxation of risky entrepreneurial capital
records.title_cn: 风险创业资本的最优税收
records.abstract_en: We study optimal taxation in a model with endogenous financial frictions, risky investment and occupational choice, where the wealth distribution affects how efficiently capital is used. The planner chooses linear taxes on wealth, capital and labor income to maximize the steady state utility of a newborn agent. Most agents in the model are poor, leading to an equity motive for taxation. We calibrate the model to the US economy and find low positive levels of optimal capital income and wealth taxes. We express optimal tax rates as a closed-form function of the size of tax bases and their elasticities with respect to tax rates, highlighting the forces behind the result. Because financial frictions are endogenous, higher capital income tax rates tighten financial frictions and reduce output. Thus, optimal capital income taxes are lower than in models with exogenous frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个具有内生金融摩擦、风险投资和职业选择模型中的最优税收，其中财富分配影响资本的使用效率。规划者选择对财富、资本和劳动收入的线性税收，以最大化新生代理人的稳态效用。模型中的大多数代理人贫穷，这产生了税收的公平动机。我们将模型校准到美国经济，发现最优资本收入和财富税处于较低的正水平。我们将最优税率表示为税基规模及其对税率弹性的闭式函数，突出了结果背后的力量。由于金融摩擦是内生的，较高的资本收入税率会加剧金融摩擦并减少产出。因此，最优资本收入税低于外生摩擦模型中的水平。

records.title_en: Retirement puzzles: New evidence from personal finances
records.title_cn: 退休之谜：来自个人财务的新证据
records.abstract_en: Using comprehensive transaction-level panel data, we document that individuals repay their consumer debt and save more after they retire. These findings are puzzling because, in principle, people should save more before, rather than after, the expected decrease in income upon retirement. We discuss several potential explanations for our findings, including reductions in work-related expenses and increases in medical health risks around retirement, which are the leading explanations of the so-called retirement-consumption and retirement-savings puzzles. We thereby inform the larger question of whether individuals save enough for retirement.
records.abstract_cn: 利用全面的交易级面板数据，我们记录了个人在退休后偿还消费债务并增加储蓄的现象。这些发现令人困惑，因为原则上，人们应该在预期收入下降的退休之前而非之后增加储蓄。我们讨论了这些发现可能的几种解释，包括与工作相关支出的减少和退休前后医疗健康风险的增加，这些是所谓的退休消费和退休储蓄之谜的主要解释。我们从而为个人是否为退休储蓄充足这一更广泛的问题提供了信息。

records.title_en: Relaxing financial constraints with tax credits and migrating out of rural and distressed America
records.title_cn: 通过税收抵免放松金融约束并迁离美国农村和困境地区
records.abstract_en: There is a strong and growing interest in helping families move to areas with higher economic opportunity. We exploit variation in the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) to examine how increasing household income affects migration, with a focus on women from rural and economically distressed areas. We find that higher income increases migration out of rural and distressed areas—primarily among unmarried mothers—to areas with higher employment and earnings, and lower unemployment rates. Many of these moves occur across counties or commuting zones, but we find no effect on moving across states. We also find decreases in living “doubled up” with another family, and reductions in commute length. We are the first to show that the EITC helps women move to economic opportunity, with the most likely mechanism being relaxing household financial constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 人们越来越强烈地希望帮助家庭迁往经济机会更高的地区。我们利用劳动所得税抵免（EITC）的变动来考察家庭收入增加如何影响迁移，重点关注来自农村和经济困境地区的女性。我们发现，收入增加会提高迁离农村和困境地区的概率——主要是在未婚母亲中——迁往就业率和收入更高、失业率更低的地区。这些迁移中有许多发生在县或通勤区之间，但我们发现对跨州迁移没有影响。我们还发现，与他人“合住”的情况减少，通勤距离缩短。我们是首个证明EITC帮助女性迁往经济机会更高地区的学者，最可能的机制是放松了家庭金融约束。

records.title_en: TRAP’d Teens: Impacts of abortion provider regulations on fertility & education
records.title_cn: 陷入TRAP的青少年：堕胎提供者法规对生育率与教育的影响
records.abstract_en: Following the 2022 decision of the U.S. Supreme Court, Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health several U.S. states have severely restricted or eliminated access to abortion. To shed light on the potential economic impacts of this landmark ruling, we estimate the impact of abortion access on women’s educational attainment. We first codify the legal history of all targeted regulations of abortion providers (TRAP laws) ever implemented. We document that TRAP laws, which often result in clinic closures, increased teen births by more than 3 percent and offer evidence that these impacts are driven by reductions in abortion access and abortion use.
