The research examines how capital-driven industrial policies foster changes in social metabolisms and cause new socio-environmental impacts, leading to ecological distribution conflicts. It also explores why diverse actors mobilise and resist these changes. Building on Kapp’s ecological economics theory of social costs and David Harvey’s concept of accumulation by dispossession, we highlight the role of capital accumulation in environmental injustices through cost-shifting strategies, terming it “Accumulation by Contamination” (AbC). In this context, AbC refers to the process wherein capital socialises the costs of contamination, degrading the means of existence and bodies of human beings who oppose these processes of capital valorisation and engage in environmental conflicts. We make a compelling case for AbC by exploring waste-related conflicts at various industrial developmental stages. Waste, viewed as a ’common bad,’ emerges as a strategic realm for capitalists seeking to expand the scale and scope of accumulation. The intricacies of waste management, its market potential, and guaranteed profitability through subsidies and processes of financialisation attract significant investments globally. Quantitative and qualitative waste management assessments demonstrate that waste policies often favour businesses, leading to cost-shifting of waste management to society (in Naples, Italy; and Delhi, in India) and the dispossession of waste-pickers (in Delhi). More broadly, we emphasise the importance of integrating ecological economics and Marxist critical geography to address environmental challenges. We also analytically study the diverse actors responding to various capital strategies, fostering transformative political actions for a sustainable future. Climate change is arguably the most significant waste disposal conflict due to excessive carbon dioxide production, representing a quintessential example of Accumulation by Contamination (AbC).
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提出了一种分析和概念工具，以阐明资本发展与环境不公正之间的联系。研究考察了资本驱动的产业政策如何促进社会新陈代谢的变化，并引发新的社会环境影响，导致生态分配冲突。它还探讨了为什么不同的行动者会动员起来并抵制这些变化。基于卡普的社会成本生态经济学理论和戴维·哈维的剥夺性积累概念，我们通过成本转嫁策略强调了资本积累在环境不公正中的作用，将其称为“污染式积累”（AbC）。在此背景下，AbC指的是资本将污染成本社会化的过程，贬低那些反对资本增值过程并参与环境冲突的人类的生存手段和身体。我们通过探索不同工业发展阶段与废物相关的冲突，为AbC提供了有力的案例。废物被视为“共同恶”，成为资本家寻求扩大积累规模和范围的战略领域。废物管理的复杂性、其市场潜力以及通过补贴和金融化过程保证的盈利能力吸引了全球大量投资。定量和定性的废物管理评估表明，废物政策往往有利于企业，导致废物管理成本转嫁给社会（在意大利那不勒斯和印度德里），并剥夺了拾荒者的权益（在德里）。更广泛地说，我们强调将生态经济学和马克思主义批判地理学相结合以应对环境挑战的重要性。我们还分析性地研究了应对各种资本策略的不同行动者，促进了可持续未来的变革性政治行动。气候变化可以说是最重要的废物处置冲突，由于过量的二氧化碳产生，代表了污染式积累（AbC）的典型例子。

records.title_en: Higher economic growth in poor countries, lower migration flows to the OECD – Revisiting the migration hump with panel data
records.title_cn: 贫穷国家的经济增长加快，经合组织的移民流量减少——用面板数据重新审视移民高峰
records.abstract_en: Comparing emigration rates of countries at different stages of economic development, an inverse u-shape emerges. Since the “migration hump” peaks at an average income of 6000 to 10 000 USD, economic progress in developing countries is often assumed to increase migration consistently. However, it is poorly understood to what extend country-level characteristics, individual incomes and other dimensions of development evoke this pattern, which limits its value for causal inference and concrete policy advice. In this paper we focus on the role of economic growth and investigate whether in developing countries emigration indeed increases with economic progress at shorter more policy-relevant time periods of up to 10 years. Using 35 years of data on migration flows to OECD destinations, we successfully reproduce the hump-shape in the cross-section. However, our more rigorous fixed effects panel estimations that exploit the variation over time robustly feature contrasting results: emigration rates fall as incomes increase. This finding holds independent of the level of income a country starts out at. In contrast to prevailing development emigration narratives, our results imply that rising individual incomes discourage emigration and hence conducive economic policies can reduce emigration. Our findings do not rule out that other slow-moving development dimensions such as educational advancement, demographic change, and structural economic transformation could still increase migration in the long term.
records.abstract_cn: 比较不同经济发展阶段国家的移民率，会出现倒U形。由于“移民驼峰”在平均收入 6000 至 10 000 美元时达到顶峰，因此发展中国家的经济进步通常被认为会持续增加移民。然而，人们对国家层面的特征、个人收入和其他发展维度在多大程度上引发了这种模式知之甚少，这限制了其因果推理和具体政策建议的价值。在本文中，我们重点关注经济增长的作用，并调查在发展中国家，在长达10年的较短、与政策相关的时间段内，移民是否确实随着经济进步而增加。利用35年关于流向经合组织目的地的移民流量的数据，我们成功地再现了横截面中的驼峰形状。然而，我们利用随时间变化的更严格的固定效应面板估计得出了截然不同的结果：随着收入的增加，移民率下降。这一发现与一个国家的初始收入水平无关。与流行的发展移民叙事相反，我们的研究结果表明，个人收入的增加会抑制移民，因此有利的经济政策可以减少移民。我们的研究结果并不排除其他缓慢发展的方面，如教育进步、人口变化和结构性经济转型，从长远来看仍可能增加移民。

records.title_en: Export Performance Under Domestic Anti-Dumping Protection
records.title_cn: 国内反倾销保护下的出口绩效
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between import protection and export performance employing firm-level data from Peru. We exploit product-specific information on anti-dumping (AD) measures imposed by Peru along with several indicators on the performance of Peruvian exporting firms across and within destination markets. Findings indicate that the impact of protection on export performance depends on which economies are targeted by domestic AD protection. Duties towards China are associated with substantially higher prices by exporting firms. Firms also reduce their shipments, as suggested by frameworks stressing the role of adjustment costs. These effects are mostly concentrated among small firm. In contrast, when AD measures are imposed on competitors from middle- or high-income countries, exporters ship larger quantities and tend to reduce unit values which is consistent with the existence of scale economies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用秘鲁的企业层面数据，研究了进口保护与出口绩效之间的关系。我们利用了秘鲁实施的反倾销（AD）措施的产品特定信息，以及秘鲁出口企业在不同目的地市场内外的若干绩效指标。研究结果表明，保护对出口绩效的影响取决于国内反倾销保护所针对的经济体。对中国的关税与出口企业显著更高的价格相关联。企业也减少了其出货量，这与强调调整成本作用的框架所暗示的一致。这些效应主要集中在小型企业中。相比之下，当反倾销措施针对来自中等收入或高收入国家的竞争对手时，出口商出货量更大，并倾向于降低单位价值，这与规模经济的存在相一致。

records.title_en: The effects of mining on local poverty in developing countries: Evidence from Mali
records.title_cn: 矿业对发展中国家地方贫困的影响：来自马里的证据
records.abstract_en: Recent within-country studies of the ‘resource curse’ call into question whether mining booms benefit local populations living near mineral endowments in developing countries. In particular, mining booms have been associated with increased violence, localized inflation, increased poverty, and increased inequality. Relying on volatile gold prices that have caused mining booms in West African countries (Ghana, Burkina Faso, and Mali) since the mid-2000s, we test whether these booms have increased or decreased poverty and expenditure among populations that live near the mines. Based on detailed household panel data from Mali, our results generally show positive effects of gold price booms on households. Household expenditure increased, and poverty decreased during years of high gold prices for formal and artisanal mining areas, with artisanal mining having a stronger beneficial effect. The results suggest the booms have been more of an economic blessing than a curse in Mali.
records.abstract_cn: 近期关于“资源诅咒”的国内研究质疑了矿业繁荣是否有利于发展中国家矿产禀赋附近的当地居民。特别是，矿业繁荣与暴力增加、局部通货膨胀、贫困加剧和不平等加剧相关联。依赖自2000年代中期以来导致西非国家（加纳、布基纳法索和马里）矿业繁荣的波动金价，我们检验这些繁荣是否增加或减少了矿山附近居民的贫困和支出。基于马里的详细家庭面板数据，我们的结果普遍显示金价繁荣对家庭有积极影响。在正式和手工采矿区，金价高企的年份家庭支出增加，贫困减少，其中手工采矿的有利效应更强。结果表明，在马里，这些繁荣更多是经济福音而非诅咒。

records.title_en: Decentralization, social connections and primary health care: Evidence from Kenya
records.title_cn: 分权、社会联系与初级卫生保健：来自肯尼亚的证据
records.abstract_en: This research estimates the role of social connections in primary health care provision and their impact on health-related behavior. The study employs novel survey data from Kenya, combining information on households and community health workers (CHWs). The results show that social connections strongly influence the provision of health care: Being a relative or close friend to a CHW increases the probability that a household will receive a health-related visit by about 100 percent (compared to the sample mean). Furthermore, socially connected households exhibit improved health-related behavior, largely attributable to the information they acquire during visits from CHWs. This evidence suggests the existence of nepotism in primary healthcare provision, and further demonstrates how beneficiaries of nepotism may experience improved health outcomes. At the same time, the study underscores that CHWs can deliver essential healthcare services, with the potential to enhance overall community health. In resource-constrained settings like Kenya, and many African countries, targeting CHWs to those most in need may offer a promising avenue for achieving better health outcomes at a lower cost. However, such targeting will need to account for social connections.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究估计了社会联系在初级卫生保健提供中的作用及其对健康相关行为的影响。研究采用了来自肯尼亚的新调查数据，结合了家庭和社区卫生工作者（CHWs）的信息。结果表明，社会联系强烈影响卫生保健的提供：作为CHW的亲属或密友，家庭接受健康相关访问的概率比样本均值增加约100%。此外，有社会联系的家庭表现出改善的健康相关行为，这主要归因于他们在CHW访问期间获得的信息。这一证据表明初级卫生保健提供中存在裙带关系，并进一步展示了裙带关系的受益者如何可能经历更好的健康结果。同时，研究强调CHWs能够提供基本的卫生保健服务，并有可能提升整体社区健康。在像肯尼亚和许多非洲国家这样资源受限的环境中，将CHWs针对最需要的人群可能为以较低成本实现更好的健康结果提供一条有希望的途径。然而，这种针对性需要考虑到社会联系。

records.title_en: Profit shifting of multinational corporations worldwide
records.title_cn: 跨国公司的全球利润转移
records.abstract_en: We exploit the new country-by-country reporting data of multinational corporations, with unparallelled country coverage, to reveal the distributional consequences of profit shifting. We estimate that multinational corporations worldwide shifted over $850 billion in profits in 2017, primarily to countries with effective tax rates below 10%. Countries with lower incomes lose a larger share of their total tax revenue due to profit shifting. We further show that a logarithmic function is better suited for capturing the non-linear relationship between profits and tax rates than linear or quadratic functions. Our findings highlight effective tax rates’ importance for profit shifting and tax reforms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用跨国公司新的国别报告数据，其国家覆盖范围无与伦比，揭示了利润转移的分配后果。我们估计，850年全球跨国公司转移了超过2017亿美元的利润，主要流向有效税率低于10%的国家。收入较低的国家因利润转移而损失其总税收收入的更大份额。我们进一步表明，对数函数比线性或二次函数更适合捕捉利润与税率之间的非线性关系。我们的研究结果强调了有效税率对利润转移和税收改革的重要性。

records.title_en: The economic consequences of environmental enforcement: Evidence from an anti-deforestation policy in Brazil
records.title_cn: 环境执法的经济后果：来自巴西反毁林政策的证据
records.abstract_en: Environmental degradation and economic development are two of the most pressing issues facing the world today, and public policy that aims to address one of these may unintentionally affect the other. I study the effect of an increase in environmental law enforcement on local economic conditions in rural Brazil. In the first part of this paper, I use data on more targeted anti-deforestation law enforcement activities, guided by satellite alerts, and link that to local forest conversion. I then exploit the staggered introduction of a policy that increases monitoring and enforcement in municipalities with a history of high deforestation, and link this to a range of economic development outcomes. I find that more targeted law enforcement reduces conversion rates of forest to farm land. Furthermore, economic conditions in municipalities with stricter monitoring improve, indicating that environmental enforcement and economic development need not be at odds.
records.abstract_cn: 环境退化与经济发展是当今世界面临的两个最紧迫的问题，旨在解决其中之一的公共政策可能会无意中影响另一个。我研究了环境执法力度的加强对巴西农村地区地方经济状况的影响。在本文的第一部分，我使用了基于卫星警报的更有针对性的反毁林执法活动数据，并将其与当地森林转换联系起来。然后，我利用一项政策的交错引入，该政策加强了对有高毁林历史的城市的监测和执法，并将其与一系列经济发展结果联系起来。我发现，更有针对性的执法降低了森林向农田的转换率。此外，监测更严格的城市的经济发展状况有所改善，这表明环境执法与经济发展不必相互矛盾。

records.title_en: Orchestrating self-empowerment in tribal India: Debt bondage, land rights, and the strategic uses of spirituality
records.title_cn: 在印度部落地区编排自我赋权：债务束缚、土地权利与精神性的策略性运用
records.abstract_en: Spirituality strategically enables self-empowerment in a clandestine movement of Adivasis which this paper calls ‘the Programme’. To explain how social movements and action organisations can orchestrate spirituality, this paper examines how the Programme helps landless rural people overcome debt bondage and gain land by employing spiritual repertoires. The paper addresses the question how, in the context of an increasingly tribalised politics in India, spiritual orchestration allows some Scheduled Tribes to make substantive economic gains, especially on debt freedom and land rights. The paper draws on an analysis of qualitative data collected through workshops, interviews and visits to villages across several Indian states, which has been anonymised to protect identities and avoid divulging sensitive information. The study finds that spirituality supports self-empowerment in three ways: first, it provides motivation and ideological reinforcement for people engaging in struggles against debt bondage and for land rights; second, it makes tribal identity more visible and helps groups make claims as indigenous owners; third, it offers groups protection from reprisals and creates platforms for engaging powerful actors. These findings are significant because, for activists and scholars who work with subaltern groups in India or other contexts, they demonstrate that the orchestration of spirituality can strengthen action repertoires for self-empowerment and help groups secure or protect economic and social gains. The paper adds insights to research on social movements and organisations on how to strengthen the ‘weapons of the weak’; it contributes empirical knowledge about how strategies to overcome debt and exploitation can succeed; and it underscores the importance of protecting freedom of religion and belief in development practice.
records.abstract_cn: 精神性策略性地促成了一个被本文称为“计划”的阿迪瓦西人秘密运动中的自我赋权。为了解释社会运动和行动组织如何编排精神性，本文考察了“计划”如何通过运用精神性剧目帮助无地农村人口摆脱债务束缚并获得土地。本文探讨了在印度政治日益部落化的背景下，精神性编排如何使一些在册部落获得实质性经济收益，尤其是在债务自由和土地权利方面。本文基于对印度多个邦的研讨会、访谈和村庄访问中收集的定性数据的分析，这些数据已匿名化以保护身份并避免泄露敏感信息。研究发现，精神性通过三种方式支持自我赋权：第一，它为人们参与反对债务束缚和争取土地权利的斗争提供动力和意识形态强化；第二，它使部落身份更加可见，并帮助群体以原住民所有者的身份提出主张；第三，它为群体提供免受报复的保护，并创造与强大行动者接触的平台。这些发现具有重要意义，因为对于在印度或其他背景下与次altern群体合作的活动家和学者而言，它们表明精神性的编排可以加强自我赋权的行动剧目，并帮助群体确保或保护经济和社会收益。本文为社会运动和组织的相关研究增添了关于如何加强“弱者的武器”的见解；它贡献了关于克服债务和剥削的策略如何成功的实证知识；并强调了在发展实践中保护宗教和信仰自由的重要性。

records.title_en: Identifying the poor – Accounting for household economies of scale in global poverty estimates
records.title_cn: 识别贫困人口——在全球贫困估计中考虑家庭规模经济
records.abstract_en: Estimates of the number of people living in extreme poverty, as reported by the World Bank, figure prominently in international development dialogue and policy. An assumption underpinning these poverty counts is that there are no economies of scale in household size – a family of six needs three times as much as a family of two. This paper examines the sensitivity of global estimates of extreme poverty to changing this assumption. The analysis rests on nationally representative household surveys from 162 countries covering 97.5 percent of the population estimated to be in extreme poverty in 2019. We compare current-method estimates with a constant-elasticity scale adjustment that divides total household consumption or income not by household size but by the square-root of household size. While the regional profile of extreme poverty is robust to this change, the determination of who is poor changes substantially – the poverty status of 264 million people changes. We then discuss evidence suggesting that the assumption of economies of scale more closely aligns with non-consumption measures of poverty. Specifically, we draw from existing literature of subjective assessments of poverty and wellbeing, along with new empirical evidence from examining the partial correlation (conditional on household size) between the two measures of poverty and a set of presumed poverty covariates (i.e., years of schooling, literacy, asset index, working in agriculture, access to electricity, piped drinking water, improved sanitation).
records.abstract_cn: 世界银行报告的极端贫困人口数量估计在国际发展对话和政策中占据突出地位。这些贫困人口统计的一个假设前提是家庭规模不存在规模经济——六口之家的需求是两口之家的三倍。本文考察了改变这一假设对全球极端贫困估计的敏感性。分析基于来自162个国家的具有全国代表性的家庭调查，覆盖97.5%年估计处于极端贫困人口的2019。我们将当前方法的估计与一种恒定弹性规模调整进行比较，该调整将家庭总消费或收入除以家庭规模的平方根，而非家庭规模本身。虽然极端贫困的区域分布对这一变化具有稳健性，但贫困人口的确定发生了显著变化——264亿人的贫困状态发生改变。随后，我们讨论了表明规模经济假设更符合非消费贫困衡量指标的证据。具体而言，我们借鉴了关于贫困和福祉主观评估的现有文献，以及通过考察两种贫困衡量指标与一组假定贫困协变量（即受教育年限、识字率、资产指数、从事农业、用电、管道饮用水、改善的卫生设施）之间的偏相关（在控制家庭规模的条件下）所得的新经验证据。

records.title_en: Mitigating the legacy of violence: Can flood relief improve people’s trust in government in conflict-affected areas? Evidence from Pakistan
records.title_cn: 减轻暴力的遗留影响：洪水救济能否改善冲突地区民众对政府的信任？来自巴基斯坦的证据
records.abstract_en: Climate change and violent conflict present two of the most substantial barriers to reaching the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. Many of the countries bearing the greatest impacts of a changing climate also grapple with protracted armed conflict. Despite this, we still have limited knowledge about how political and environmental insecurities affect trust in the institutions that are responsible for disaster management, security and conflict resolution. In this paper we explore whether being exposed to violent armed conflict is associated with low levels of political trust, and whether this can be mitigated by state action. Relying on a household survey covering some 2000 rural households in Pakistan, we investigate how state disaster response shaped trust in conflict-affected contexts in the years following the severe flooding of 2010. Our study suggest that negative implications of violence exposure on political trust can be offset by disaster relief efforts by the state, but only in instances when the government is not involved in the violent activities. Our findings contribute to our understanding of the joint impact of conflict and disasters on political trust, and importantly shows that in some instances, government interventions in a different political domain can reduce negative consequences of armed conflict on trust. Understanding the interplay of compound risks in contexts where multiple risks are occurring simultaneously is crucial because without adequate, coordinated government action, it will be impossible to protect the lives, health and livelihoods of affected people in Pakistan and beyond.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化和暴力冲突是实现2030年可持续发展目标的两大最重大障碍。许多受气候变化影响最大的国家也同时面临长期武装冲突。尽管如此，关于政治和环境不安全因素如何影响对负责灾害管理、安全和冲突解决的机构的信任，我们仍然知之甚少。在本文中，我们探讨了暴露于暴力武装冲突是否与较低的政治信任水平相关，以及这种影响是否可以通过国家行动得到缓解。基于一项覆盖巴基斯坦约2000户农村家庭的住户调查，我们研究了在2010年严重洪水之后的几年中，国家灾害应对如何影响冲突影响背景下的信任。我们的研究表明，暴力暴露对政治信任的负面影响可以通过国家的灾害救济努力来抵消，但仅限于政府未参与暴力活动的情况。我们的发现有助于理解冲突和灾害对政治信任的联合影响，并且重要的是表明，在某些情况下，政府在不同政治领域的干预可以减少武装冲突对信任的负面影响。理解多种风险同时发生背景下的复合风险的相互作用至关重要，因为如果没有充分、协调的政府行动，将无法保护巴基斯坦及其他地区受影响民众的生命、健康和生计。

records.title_en: How clientelism works: Evidence from the Barinas special election
records.title_cn: 庇护主义如何运作：来自巴里纳斯特别选举的证据
records.abstract_en: Do politicians target the benefits of social programs to party loyalists or to swing voters? Traditional tests of this question are clouded by an identification problem caused by the simultaneity of politician and voter choices to participate in the exchange of assistance for votes. I use the holding of an unanticipated repeat gubernatorial election in the Venezuelan state of Barinas in 2022 as a natural experiment to identify the effects of elections on the distribution of government assistance. I estimate that the holding of the election led to an increase in the probability of voters in Barinas receiving food packages in comparison with the control group of voters in the state of Apure. I also find that moderate opposition and third-party voters received larger increases in food benefits. These results are consistent with the predictions of the spatial model of distributive politics, according to which elections lead governments to direct more benefits to swing voters instead of core supporters. The findings illustrate why investigation of cross sectional correlations is insufficient to test the implications of theories of voting if it is not accompanied by a clear identification strategy to help isolate the source of the underlying shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 政治家是将社会计划的好处瞄准党内忠诚者还是摇摆选民？对这一问题的传统检验因政治家与选民参与以选票换取援助的同时性所导致的识别问题而变得模糊。我利用委内瑞拉巴里纳斯州在2022年举行的意外重复州长选举作为自然实验，以识别选举对政府援助分配的影响。我估计，与阿普雷州的对照组选民相比，选举的举行导致巴里纳斯选民收到食品包裹的概率增加。我还发现，温和反对派和第三方选民获得的食品福利增幅更大。这些结果与分配政治的空间模型的预测一致，该模型认为选举导致政府将更多好处导向摇摆选民而非核心支持者。研究结果说明，如果没有清晰的识别策略来帮助隔离潜在冲击的来源，仅调查横截面相关性不足以检验投票理论的推论。

records.title_en: Protect incomes or protect jobs? The role of social policies in post-pandemic recovery
records.title_cn: 保护收入还是保护就业？社会政策在后疫情复苏中的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the effectiveness of income protection and job protection policies for the post-pandemic economic recovery of the second half of 2020 through 2021. The paper is based on a new dataset of the budgets of social protection programs implemented as a part of the pandemic stimulus package in 154 countries. The empirical analysis shows that the effect of the social protection response is heterogeneous. In the short run, higher expenditure on job protection measures is associated with more robust GDP growth, increased employment, and decreased inactivity and poverty rates compared to the expansion of income protection programs. Both policies had a significant economic impact only in countries with weaker pre-pandemic social insurance systems. In countries with broader coverage of the social insurance system, the income and job protection programs appear to have a limited impact on post-pandemic recovery. Because the structural economic changes induced by the pandemic are expected to fully materialize in several years, more research is needed to understand the longer-term effects of job protection and income protection policies on labor markets and economic recovery.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了收入保护和就业保护政策对2020年下半年至2021年疫情后经济复苏的有效性。本文基于一个新的数据集，该数据集涵盖了154个国家作为疫情刺激计划一部分而实施的社会保护项目预算。实证分析表明，社会保护应对措施的效果具有异质性。在短期内，与扩大收入保护计划相比，在就业保护措施上更高的支出与更强劲的GDP增长、就业增加以及失业率和贫困率下降相关。这两种政策仅在疫情前社会保险体系较弱的国家产生了显著的经济影响。在社会保险体系覆盖范围更广的国家，收入和就业保护计划对疫情后复苏的影响似乎有限。由于疫情引发的结构性经济变化预计将在几年内完全显现，需要更多研究来理解就业保护和收入保护政策对劳动力市场和经济复苏的长期影响。

records.title_en: What procedures matter to social acceptance of mining? A conjoint experiment in Peru
records.title_cn: 什么程序对采矿的社会接受度重要？秘鲁的一项联合实验
records.abstract_en: Accumulated literature on the social license to operate (SLO) of mining has called attention to procedural fairness, which assumes that fair treatments enhance acceptance from people involved in mining projects. However, what procedural improvement means is theoretically underdeveloped, especially in two critical aspects. First, previous studies on SLO have always modeled procedural fairness separately from its outcomes, such as benefit and cost distribution, and failed to spot the separability in the context of acute socioeconomic needs. Under such unclarity, mining companies are less open to participatory opportunities in fear of inflated social demands. Second, institutional inventions in the last decades that attempt to enhance people’s participation in the decision-making of mining projects, such as popular consultation, free, prior, and informed consent to indigenous peoples, and public hearings in environmental impact assessments, are overlooked in the SLO literature. This paper tests the causal effect of procedural and outcome factors on people’s acceptance with a conjoint experiment that portrays hypothetical mining projects. Participants are recruited by an original household survey in four Peruvian regions where mining is a lively experience. The findings report that procedures are viewed separately from material benefits but not separately from reported environmental risks. Prior consultation with voting increases the acceptability of a mining project to some degree. The result suggests the participatory assessment of environmental risk will benefit all stakeholders, and mining companies have no reason to shy away from listening to and respecting local opinions due to a suspected increase in benefit demands.
records.abstract_cn: 关于采矿社会许可（SLO）的既有文献已引起对程序公平的关注，该概念假设公平对待能提高采矿项目相关人员的接受度。然而，程序改进的含义在理论上尚不完善，尤其在两个关键方面。首先，以往关于SLO的研究总是将程序公平与其结果（如利益和成本分配）分开建模，未能发现其在社会经济需求迫切背景下的可分离性。在这种不明确性下，采矿公司因担心社会需求膨胀而不太愿意开放参与机会。其次，近几十年来旨在增强人们参与采矿项目决策的制度创新，如全民协商、对土著人民的自由、事先和知情同意，以及环境影响评价中的公众听证，在SLO文献中被忽视。本文通过一项描绘假设采矿项目的联合实验，检验程序和结果因素对人们接受度的因果效应。参与者通过一项在秘鲁四个采矿活跃地区的原始家庭调查招募。研究结果显示，程序与物质利益是分开看待的，但与报告的环境风险并非分开。带有投票的事先协商在一定程度上提高了采矿项目的可接受性。结果表明，对环境风险的参与式评估将使所有利益相关者受益，采矿公司没有理由因怀疑利益需求增加而回避倾听和尊重当地意见。

records.title_en: Computerization, offshoring and trade: The effect on developing countries
records.title_cn: 计算机化、离岸外包与贸易：对发展中国家的影响
records.abstract_en: (Antràs, 2020) argues that whereas in the 1990s it was profitable to fragment production processes, now computerization allows the automation of human tasks, reduces labor costs, and substitutes the offshoring of certain activities. We analyze imports from six developed countries sourced from developing countries to study this hypothesis. We find a decline in imports of products from sectors characterized by low wages and routine tasks, therefore at risk of automation. Moreover, imports rose within sectors known for having a significant potential for offshoring until 2001, followed by a subsequent decline. Labor-replacing tasks technologies are changing the comparative advantages of developing economies.
records.abstract_cn: （Antràs，2020）认为，尽管在1990年代，将生产流程碎片化是有利可图的，但现在计算机化使得人类任务的自动化成为可能，降低了劳动力成本，并替代了某些活动的离岸外包。我们分析了来自六个发达国家从发展中国家进口的数据，以研究这一假设。我们发现，来自低工资和常规任务特征行业的产品的进口有所下降，因此这些行业面临自动化的风险。此外，在直到2001年以具有显著离岸外包潜力而闻名的行业内，进口有所增加，随后出现下降。替代劳动力的任务技术正在改变发展中国家的比较优势。

records.title_en: Interactions between sustainable development goals at the district level in Lao PDR
records.title_cn: 老挝人民民主共和国地区层面可持续发展目标之间的相互作用
records.abstract_en: Monitoring the status and evolution of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is typically carried out at the national level. However, significant variation can exist within countries, and this may not be captured by aggregate statistics. Here, we develop a unique dataset representing indicators for three SDGs at a district level for Lao PDR. The indicators comprise prevalence of stunting (SDG 2, Zero hunger), poverty headcount (SDG 1, No Poverty), and share of natural area (SDG 15, Life on land) for two moments in time: 2005 and 2015. In both years, we find considerable variation among district-level outcomes for stunting and poverty. We also find that higher stunting and poverty rates are significantly correlated with higher shares of natural land in both years. This is consistent with the common perception of a trade-off between environmental outcomes and socioeconomic wellbeing. The correlation vanishes, however, when we consider changes in poverty, stunting, and natural area over the ten-year study period. This holds as well when we focus on agricultural land instead of natural areas. We observe that most regions show improvements in both stunting and poverty, albeit not always in a statistically significant sense. This points to synergistic development. Similarly, improvements in both indicators are associated with losses in natural areas in all regions, indicating a trade-off. These results suggest that both trade-offs and synergies between SDGs can arise at the district level, but that context and local conditions likely moderate the strength of these interactions. Our results highlight the importance of quantifying and monitoring sustainable development at the detailed subnational level.
records.abstract_cn: 监测可持续发展目标（SDGs）的状态和演变通常在国家层面进行。然而，国家内部可能存在显著差异，而这些差异可能无法通过总体统计数据体现。在此，我们构建了一个独特的数据集，代表老挝人民民主共和国地区层面三个SDG的指标。这些指标包括发育迟缓率（SDG 2，零饥饿）、贫困人口比例（SDG 1，无贫困）以及自然区域占比（SDG 15，陆地生物），涵盖两个时间点：2005年和2015年。在这两年中，我们发现地区层面的发育迟缓率和贫困结果存在显著差异。我们还发现，在这两年中，较高的发育迟缓率和贫困率与较高的自然土地占比显著相关。这与环境成果与社会经济福祉之间存在权衡的普遍看法一致。然而，当我们考虑十年研究期间贫困、发育迟缓和自然区域的变化时，这种相关性消失了。当我们关注农业用地而非自然区域时，这一结果同样成立。我们观察到，大多数地区在发育迟缓和贫困方面均有所改善，尽管并非总是在统计上显著。这表明发展具有协同性。同样，这两个指标的改善在所有地区都与自然区域的减少相关，表明存在权衡。这些结果表明，SDG之间的权衡和协同可能出现在地区层面，但背景和当地条件可能调节这些相互作用的强度。我们的结果强调了在详细的次国家层面量化和监测可持续发展的重要性。

records.title_en: Quiet resistance speaks: A global literature review of the politics of popular resistance to climate adaptation interventions
records.title_cn: 无声的抵抗在发声：气候适应干预措施遭遇的民众抵抗政治全球文献综述
records.abstract_en: Despite that climate hazards are increasingly felt across the globe, there is widespread and often subtle resistance to climate adaptation interventions. However, adaptation research and practice have largely focused on overcoming barriers to implementation. By presuming adaptation programs are welcome, they miss that many people oppose or refuse to participate in them, and the politics hidden behind such resistance. We review the emerging academic literature on resistance to climate adaptation and uncover how diverse forms of adaptation resistance generate deep insights into overlooked local needs and aspirations. While it could be expected that ‘loud’ forms of resistance, such as protests, prompted some adaptation initiatives to accommodate local needs, it was surprising to see the effects of ‘quiet’ resistance. Quiet adaptation resistance in the forms of false compliance, foot-dragging, and gossip helped affected communities to stay in their territories, maintain certain farming practices, contest exclusionary urban policies, or simply assert their agency and freedom. These results reflect that adaptation has adopted a narrow approach to development that omits the multiple and underlying causes of vulnerability – many of which are evident to those affected. We argue that even when such acts do not directly improve material conditions, they represent an alternative political engagement to reimagine adaptation considering the needs of marginalised groups beyond the participatory and community development approach. This article provides concrete examples of how quiet resistance to adaptation speaks that can help development practitioners and policy makers to better understand the limitations of adaptation initiatives and their implications for effective local security in the face of climate change. Political accountability to adaptation-targeted populations could improve adaptation investments, making them more relevant, socially sustainable, and responsive to local needs.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管全球范围内气候危害日益显现，但对气候适应干预措施的抵抗却广泛存在且往往微妙。然而，适应研究与实践大多聚焦于克服实施障碍。由于预设适应项目受欢迎，它们忽视了许多人反对或拒绝参与其中，以及这种抵抗背后隐藏的政治。我们回顾了关于气候适应抵抗的新兴学术文献，揭示了多样化的适应抵抗形式如何为被忽视的当地需求和愿望提供深刻见解。虽然可以预期‘大声’的抵抗形式（如抗议）会促使一些适应举措迎合当地需求，但令人惊讶的是‘无声’抵抗的效果。以虚假顺从、拖延和流言形式出现的无声适应抵抗，帮助受影响社区留在其领土上，维持某些耕作方式，抵制排斥性的城市政策，或仅仅主张其能动性和自由。这些结果反映出适应采纳了一种狭隘的发展方法，忽略了脆弱性的多重根本原因——其中许多原因对受影响者而言显而易见。我们认为，即使这些行为不直接改善物质条件，它们也代表了一种替代性的政治参与，以在参与式和社区发展方法之外，重新构想适应，考虑边缘化群体的需求。本文提供了无声适应抵抗如何发声的具体例子，可帮助发展实践者和政策制定者更好地理解适应举措的局限性及其在气候变化面前对有效地方安全的影响。对适应目标人群的政治问责可以改善适应投资，使其更具相关性、社会可持续性，并更响应地方需求。

records.title_en: Appropriation pathways of water grabbing
records.title_cn: 水资源攫取的占有路径
records.abstract_en: The appropriation of water by farmers, land investors, mining operations, hydropower corporations, or other actors becomes controversial when it targets relatively scarce water resources that support rural livelihoods, food security, or environmental needs. Some of the distinctive institutional and hydrological conditions underlying water appropriations remain poorly understood, thus limiting the development of suitable policy and governance instruments to protect those users whose access to water is diminished by such appropriations. Research in this field has often focused on water acquisitions through land deals or infrastructure development while overlooking other more subtle pathways of water appropriation associated with pollution, land use change, afforestation, land–atmosphere feedback, irrigation efficiency, and virtual water trade. Such pathways frequently contribute to the loss of access to water by prior users, including rural communities, indigenous groups, women, and the environment, thus playing a critical role in undermining livelihoods, cultural identity, or ecosystem functions. Understanding the socio-environmental interplay between the institutional-legal and hydrological mechanism is crucial to the assessment of how different water appropriation pathways can affect prior users and their rights. Here we examine the different institutional and biophysical conditions that characterize the dynamics of water appropriation and identify the major pathways underlying water grabbing. We investigate the nexus between water tenure arrangements and neglected hydrological pathways of water appropriation to critically evaluate their impact on access to water.
records.abstract_cn: 农民、土地投资者、采矿作业、水电公司或其他行为者对水资源的占有，当其针对支持农村生计、粮食安全或环境需求的相对稀缺水资源时，便具有争议性。水资源占有背后的一些独特制度和水文条件仍未被充分理解，从而限制了制定适当的政策与治理工具来保护那些因这类占有而减少水资源获取的用户。该领域的研究往往侧重于通过土地交易或基础设施开发进行的水资源获取，而忽视了与污染、土地利用变化、造林、陆气反馈、灌溉效率和虚拟水贸易相关的其他更为隐蔽的水资源占有路径。这些路径常常导致先前用户（包括农村社区、土著群体、妇女和环境）失去水资源获取机会，从而在削弱生计、文化认同或生态系统功能方面发挥关键作用。理解制度法律与水文机制之间的社会环境相互作用，对于评估不同水资源占有路径如何影响先前用户及其权利至关重要。在此，我们考察了表征水资源占有动态的不同制度和生物物理条件，并识别了水资源攫取的主要路径。我们研究了水权安排与被忽视的水资源占有的水文路径之间的联系，以批判性评估其对水资源获取的影响。

records.title_en: Overlapping extractive land use rights increases deforestation and forest degradation in managed natural production forests
records.title_cn: 重叠的采掘性土地使用权增加了管理中的天然生产林的森林砍伐和森林退化
records.abstract_en: Guyana manages an estimated 5.3 million hectares of old-growth tropical forests, 29% of its total forest area, for timber extraction. Individuals and companies can apply for time-limited leases that allocate access, management, and extraction rights for timber through a concession system. In many tropical regions, including Guyana, a lack of integrated land use planning often leads to overlapping extractive and forest use rights for logging and mining. Overlapping land rights in turn create uncertainty and limit investments toward sustainable forest management, affecting deforestation and forest degradation rates. In this study, we use matched fixed-effect and difference-in-differences panel data models to quantify the impact of establishing logging tenure on deforestation and forest degradation. We assess the impact of different tenure use allocations for Guyana, a high forest cover low deforestation country, utilizing a 31-year (1990–2020) remotely sensed annual time series dataset on deforestation and forest degradation. The rate of forest loss (deforestation plus degradation) in public forests managed by the State with no authorized use allocation activities were 0.062% per year. The issuance of timber concessions increases the probability of deforestation by 33.5% and forest degradation by 8.9% compared to unallocated state forests. Forests with overlapping use rights for timber and mining had a 156% and 19.1% higher probability of deforestation and degradation relative to unallocated public forests and forests where only timber harvesting was authorized, respectively. We conclude that overlapping land use allocations result in conflicting resource use strategies that ultimately will limit sustainability and climate goals related to reducing deforestation and degradation.
records.abstract_cn: 圭亚那管理着估计5.3万公顷的原始热带森林，占其总森林面积的29%，用于木材采伐。个人和公司可以通过特许经营制度申请有时间限制的租约，分配木材的获取、管理和采伐权。在包括圭亚那在内的许多热带地区，缺乏综合土地利用规划常常导致伐木和采矿的采掘性及森林使用权重叠。重叠的土地权利反过来又造成不确定性，并限制对可持续森林管理的投资，影响森林砍伐和森林退化率。在本研究中，我们使用匹配固定效应和双重差分面板数据模型来量化建立伐木权属对森林砍伐和森林退化的影响。我们评估了圭亚那（一个高森林覆盖低森林砍伐国家）不同权属使用分配的影响，利用了31年（1990-2020年）的遥感年度时间序列数据集，涵盖森林砍伐和森林退化。国家管理的无授权使用分配活动的公共森林的年森林损失率（森林砍伐加退化）为0.062%。发放木材特许权使森林砍伐概率增加33.5%，森林退化概率增加8.9%，与未分配的国有森林相比。具有木材和采矿重叠使用权的森林，其森林砍伐和退化概率分别比未分配的公共森林和仅授权木材采伐的森林高156%和19.1%。我们得出结论，重叠的土地使用分配导致资源使用策略冲突，最终将限制与减少森林砍伐和退化相关的可持续性和气候目标。

records.title_en: Income inequality effect of public utility infrastructure: Evidence from rural China
records.title_cn: 公共事业基础设施的收入不平等效应：来自中国农村的证据
records.abstract_en: The income inequality effect of infrastructure investment is under-researched despite the fact that the world has been confronted with the formidable challenge of worsening income distribution. This paper addresses this gap by: (i) highlighting deficiencies in conventional inequality modeling, (ii) proposing an empirical framework that entails estimation of both income growth and income inequality effect of infrastructure using one model, and (iii) applying this model to individual-level data from rural China to estimate income growth and income inequality effect of specific public utility infrastructures. Our findings reveal that the usage of telephone and tap water infrastructure fosters rural income growth, particularly benefiting lower-income individuals, indicating benign income inequality effect. These effects are particularly notable in inland China. An investigation into underlying mechanisms shows that public utility infrastructures help improve educational attainment and health status in lower-income rural households, stimulating growth in income and reducing income inequality. These findings imply that development of public utility infrastructure can serve as a powerful policy instrument for government interventions to reduce income inequality and promote growth, especially in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管世界一直面临收入分配恶化的严峻挑战，但基础设施投资的收入不平等效应研究不足。本文通过以下方式弥补这一空白：（i）指出传统不平等建模的缺陷，（ii）提出一个实证框架，该框架需使用一个模型同时估计基础设施的收入增长和收入不平等效应，以及（iii）将该模型应用于中国农村的个人层面数据，以估计特定公共事业基础设施的收入增长和收入不平等效应。我们的研究结果表明，电话和自来水基础设施的使用促进了农村收入增长，尤其惠及低收入群体，显示出良性的收入不平等效应。这些效应在中国内陆地区尤为显著。对潜在机制的研究表明，公共事业基础设施有助于提高低收入农村家庭的教育水平和健康状况，刺激收入增长并减少收入不平等。这些发现意味着，公共事业基础设施的发展可以作为政府干预的有力政策工具，以减少收入不平等并促进增长，尤其是在发展中国家。

records.title_en: Development Goals, commercial interest and EU Aid-for-Trade
records.title_cn: 发展目标、商业利益与欧盟贸易援助
records.abstract_en: The extent to which official development assistance (ODA) conforms to internationally agreed goals and principles of aid effectiveness may be influenced by donors’ national interests. Disentangling the extent to which national ODA is motivated by development goals vs. commercial self-interest is difficult. European Union (EU) member states provide external aid through EU-level institutions and independently through national aid programs. Theory suggests pooled EU-level aid facilitates satisfying development effectiveness principles while bilateral ODA is more likely to reflect national interests. We investigate this hypothesis for a subset of ODA, aid for trade (AfT), provided by donors to recipient countries between 2002 and 2018. We find a strong, statistically significant positive relationship between AfT provided by EU donors and their exports to recipient countries. In contrast, AfT provided by EU institutions and non-European states enhances merchandise imports from recipient countries.
records.abstract_cn: 官方发展援助（ODA）在多大程度上符合国际商定的援助有效性目标和原则，可能受到捐助国国家利益的影响。厘清国家ODA在多大程度上受发展目标与商业自身利益驱动是困难的。欧盟（EU）成员国通过欧盟层面机构以及独立的国家援助计划提供外部援助。理论表明， pooled 的欧盟层面援助有助于满足发展有效性原则，而双边ODA更可能反映国家利益。我们针对ODA的一个子集——贸易援助（AfT），即捐助方在2002年至2018年间向受援国提供的援助，检验了这一假设。我们发现，欧盟捐助方提供的AfT与其对受援国的出口之间存在强烈且统计显著的正相关关系。相比之下，欧盟机构和非欧洲国家提供的AfT则促进了从受援国的商品进口。

records.title_en: More unequal or not as rich? Revisiting the Latin American exception
records.title_cn: 更不平等还是没那么富有？重新审视拉丁美洲的例外性
records.abstract_en: Latin America is often portrayed as a global exception to the rising or consolidating income inequality trends of the early twenty-first century. In this paper we revisit this exceptionalism by innovatively combining harmonised surveys, social security and tax data, and national accounts for ten countries. The reconciliation of micro and macro incomes present us with a critical dilemma: either the region is more unequal or it is not as rich as officially reported. Distributing the data gaps shows a more heterogeneous region in terms of inequality trends. Falling inequality is most visible among the bottom 99%, but the trend flattens or reverses in the largest economies once the top 1% and capital incomes are better accounted for. Taxes and transfers do not alter the main picture, except when in-kind social spending is considered. These results confirm the strengths and highlight the limits of Latin America’s redistributive policies during the period.
records.abstract_cn: 拉丁美洲常被描绘为二十一世纪初全球收入不平等上升或巩固趋势中的一个例外。在本文中，我们通过创新性地结合十个国家的协调调查、社会保障和税收数据以及国民账户，重新审视了这一例外性。微观与宏观收入的对账给我们带来了一个关键的两难困境：要么该地区比官方报告更不平等，要么不如官方报告那么富有。分配数据缺口显示，该地区在不平等趋势方面更加异质。不平等下降在底部99%最为明显，但在最大经济体中，一旦顶部1%和资本收入得到更好核算，趋势便趋于平缓或逆转。税收和转移支付并未改变主要图景，除非考虑实物社会支出。这些结果证实了拉丁美洲再分配政策在该时期的优势，并凸显了其局限性。

records.title_en: The Great Lockdown and the Small Business: Impact, Channels and Adaptation to the Covid Pandemic
records.title_cn: 大封锁与小企业：新冠疫情的影响、渠道与适应
records.abstract_en: In this paper we estimate the effects of the pandemic on Tunisian small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and examine their adaptation processes during the first lockdown. Three simultaneous shocks are examined employing a Difference-in-Differences (DID) framework applied to the national firm census: the labor input shock, the demand shock and the intermediate input shock. We show that SME performance in the first year of the crisis was heavily affected by a combination of labor input, demand and intermediate input shocks, but only the effects of the demand and intermediate input shocks persisted in the following year. Using our own firm survey, we examine three kinds of adaptation strategies: workplace and process adaptation, and trade credit. We find that firms in non-essential sectors were less able to adapt during the first lockdown, suggesting that firm adaptation seems to be more driven by capability than by necessity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估算了疫情对突尼斯中小企业的影响，并考察了它们在首次封锁期间的适应过程。我们利用全国企业普查数据，采用双重差分法分析了三个同时发生的冲击：劳动力投入冲击、需求冲击和中间投入冲击。我们发现，危机第一年中小企业的绩效受到劳动力投入、需求和中间投入冲击组合的严重影响，但只有需求和中间投入冲击的影响在第二年持续存在。利用我们自己的企业调查，我们考察了三种适应策略：工作场所和流程适应，以及贸易信贷。我们发现，非必需行业的企业在首次封锁期间适应能力较弱，这表明企业适应似乎更多由能力而非必要性驱动。

records.title_en: Scaling up and scaling out of darkness: Elucidating the influences of institutional dysfunction in scaling up solar PV in Sub-Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 黑暗的扩大与扩展：阐明制度功能障碍对撒哈拉以南非洲太阳能光伏推广的影响
records.abstract_en: Although researchers increasingly recognize the significant impact of institutional dysfunction on emerging economies, there remains a major gap regarding its influence on firms’ upstream and downstream activities in scaling up renewable efforts. Drawing on data from solar photovoltaic (PV) intermediary business owners/entrepreneurs and regulators in Ghana, this paper examines the mechanisms through which these activities interact to facilitate the scaling-up efforts of renewable energy. The study uncovers three unique interactive processes through which institutional dysfunctions shape scaling-up efforts. Phase 1 focuses on unmasking institutional dysfunctions as impeding forces on both upstream and downstream activities. Phase 2 signifies a paradigm shift towards proactively re-engaging and reshaping institutional dysfunctions. This phase entails a range of organizational actions, including strategic interventions, dismantling ineffective practices, and wider concerted efforts geared towards turning dysfunctional institutions into potential sources of opportunity. Phase 3 represents the final stage in the evolution towards scaling up, focusing on deficiencies in the aftermarket support environment, specifically maintenance and repair services after sales. The insights derived from the study offer valuable implications for practitioners, policymakers, and scholars.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管研究者日益认识到制度功能障碍对新兴经济体的重大影响，但其对企业上游和下游活动在推广可再生能源努力中的影响仍存在重大空白。本文利用来自加纳太阳能光伏（PV）中间商企业主/企业家和监管机构的数据，考察了这些活动如何相互作用以促进可再生能源的推广努力。研究揭示了制度功能障碍塑造推广努力的三种独特互动过程。第一阶段1侧重于揭示制度功能障碍作为对上游和下游活动的阻碍力量。第二阶段2标志着向主动重新参与和重塑制度功能障碍的范式转变。这一阶段涉及一系列组织行动，包括战略干预、废除无效做法以及旨在将功能障碍机构转变为潜在机会来源的更广泛的协同努力。第三阶段三代表了向推广演进的最后阶段，侧重于售后支持环境中的缺陷，特别是销售后的维护和修理服务。本研究得出的见解为从业者、政策制定者和学者提供了宝贵的启示。

records.title_en: Resilience counter-currents: Water infrastructures, informality, and inequities in Cape Town, South Africa
records.title_cn: 韧性逆流：南非开普敦的水基础设施、非正规性与不平等
records.abstract_en: In 2017 and 2018, Cape Town faced historically unprecedented water shortages. With the imminent possibility of running out of water, the city’s leadership prioritized reducing water demand and expanding new water sources, while also reinvigorating the goal of seeking to build system-level water resilience for the longer term. Beyond the context of Cape Town, the crisis captured global attention, highlighting ongoing and future water security challenges, the realities of climate change, and the critical need to foster transitions towards more resilient water futures. Given that much of the discourse and implementation around water resilience remains squarely focused on the biophysical and engineering aspects of water supply and distribution systems, despite repeated calls for the need for greater attention to issues of equity and power, there remains little understanding of the ways that persistent inequities might serve or inhibit possibilities for urban socio-hydrological (or water) resilience. This paper draws on examples from Cape Town to argue that patterns and legacies of inequality, marginalization, and exclusion erode and inhibit possibilities for water resilience. Providing needed empirical evidence on the nature of these linkages, we theorize that deeply rooted inequities and related dynamics act as “counter-currents”—trends that undermine and present persistent challenges to efforts to enhance socio-hydrological resilience. Documenting examples of disconnections between the state and civil society as well as disconnected socio-ecological systems, we argue that these persistent inequities mean that efforts to achieve socio-hydrological resilience are likely to remain elusive. It is only by foregrounding these processes that it will be possible to make cities more resilient in the face of ongoing and future water-related risks, uncertainties, and climatic and environmental change.
records.abstract_cn: 在2017年和2018年，开普敦面临历史上前所未有的水资源短缺。随着水资源耗尽的迫在眉睫，该市领导层优先考虑减少用水需求和扩大新水源，同时也重新激发了寻求长期建立系统级水韧性的目标。在开普敦的背景下，这场危机引起了全球关注，凸显了持续和未来的水安全挑战、气候变化的现实，以及促进向更具韧性的水未来转型的关键需求。尽管围绕水韧性的许多讨论和实施仍然主要集中在供水与分配系统的生物物理和工程方面，尽管一再呼吁需要更加关注公平和权力问题，但对于持续的不平等可能如何服务于或阻碍城市社会水文（或水）韧性的可能性，仍然知之甚少。本文借鉴开普敦的例子，论证不平等、边缘化和排斥的模式与遗留问题侵蚀并阻碍了水韧性的可能性。通过提供关于这些联系性质的必要经验证据，我们理论化认为，根深蒂固的不平等及相关动态起到了“逆流”的作用——这些趋势削弱并对增强社会水文韧性的努力构成持续挑战。通过记录国家与公民社会之间脱节以及社会生态系统脱节的例子，我们认为，这些持续的不平等意味着实现社会水文韧性的努力可能仍然难以实现。只有将这些过程置于前台，才有可能在面对持续和未来的水相关风险、不确定性以及气候和环境变化时，使城市更具韧性。

records.title_en: The robustness mechanism of the rural social-ecological system in response to the impact of urbanization——Evidence from irrigation commons in China
records.title_cn: 乡村社会-生态系统应对城市化冲击的稳健性机制——来自中国灌溉公地的证据
records.abstract_en: Urbanization is essential for achieving rapid development. In this process, the labor outmigration from rural areas to cities caused by urbanization has diversified the impacts on the robustness of the rural social-ecological system. However, existing research has rarely discussed the internal mechanism of the response of the rural social-ecological system to the impact of urbanization. Based on the coupled infrastructure systems framework, in this paper, the internal interactions of the rural social-ecological system responding to the impact of urbanization are discussed. An empirical test is conducted using survey data from 123 villages of 14 Chinese provinces. Focusing on the specific practice of China, this paper further discusses how the robustness of the rural social-ecological system can be ensured under external impact. The main conclusions are as follows: under the impact of urbanization, the internal interaction paths with which the rural social-ecological system maintains robustness at the operational level are not unique. These different internal interaction paths may not only make the rural social-ecological system automatically realize a virtuous and robust cycle under the impact of urbanization, they may also cause a gradual collapse of the rural social-ecological system. Further, the discussion of China’s specific practice shows that it is key to provide institutional rules to guarantee the operational processes through the collective-choice process, thus ensuring the robustness of the rural social-ecological system under the impact of urbanization. The inspection of the interaction mechanisms in this study may obtain some restricted views on the general laws that may be contained in the complex interaction within the rural social-ecological system, and provide a theoretical basis developing countries can apply to realize rural revitalization when faced with the irreversible wave of urbanization.
records.abstract_cn: 城市化是实现快速发展的重要途径。在这一过程中，城市化引起的农村劳动力向城市的外流，对乡村社会-生态系统的稳健性产生了多样化的影响。然而，现有研究很少讨论乡村社会-生态系统应对城市化冲击的内部机制。基于耦合基础设施系统框架，本文探讨了乡村社会-生态系统应对城市化冲击的内部互动。利用中国14个省份123个村庄的调查数据进行了实证检验。聚焦中国的具体实践，本文进一步讨论了在外部冲击下如何确保乡村社会-生态系统的稳健性。主要结论如下：在城市化冲击下，乡村社会-生态系统在操作层面维持稳健性的内部互动路径并非唯一。这些不同的内部互动路径不仅可能使乡村社会-生态系统在城市化冲击下自动实现良性稳健循环，也可能导致乡村社会-生态系统的逐渐崩溃。进一步，对中国具体实践的讨论表明，通过集体选择过程提供制度规则以保障操作过程是关键，从而确保乡村社会-生态系统在城市化冲击下的稳健性。本研究对互动机制的考察可能获得对乡村社会-生态系统复杂互动中可能包含的一般规律的有限视角，并为发展中国家在面对不可逆转的城市化浪潮时实现乡村振兴提供理论基础。

records.title_en: Is there a fiscal resource curse? Resource rents, fiscal capacity and political institutions in developing economies
records.title_cn: 是否存在财政资源诅咒？发展中经济体的资源租金、财政能力与政治制度
records.abstract_en: While it is recognised that the ability of states to raise revenues (i.e., fiscal capacity) is important for the provision of key public goods in less developed economies, it is less clear what its determinants are and what explains cross-country differences. We focus on the impact of natural resources. Standard arguments suggest that natural resource rents may harm fiscal capacity, as governments tend to substitute tax revenues with revenues from natural resources. We argue, instead, that a fiscal resource curse may materialise or not depending on whether political institutions can limit the power of the executive and on how easy it is to control or appropriate natural resources. We investigate this hypothesis using panel data methods covering the period 1995–2015 for 62 developing countries. The results suggest that: (i) point-source resources are negatively associated with fiscal capacity, while diffuse resources are not; (ii) developing economies with political institutions placing institutionalised constraints on the executive power are able to neutralise the negative effect of point-source resources on fiscal capacity. Our findings imply that it is possible to develop a natural resources sector without necessarily harming fiscal capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 虽然人们认识到国家筹集收入的能力（即财政能力）对于欠发达经济体提供关键公共产品至关重要，但其决定因素以及跨国差异的原因尚不明确。我们关注自然资源的影响。标准观点认为，自然资源租金可能损害财政能力，因为政府倾向于用自然资源收入替代税收收入。相反，我们认为，财政资源诅咒是否显现取决于政治制度能否限制行政权力，以及控制或侵占自然资源的难易程度。我们使用覆盖1995-2015年62个发展中国家的面板数据方法检验了这一假设。结果表明：（i）点源资源与财政能力负相关，而扩散资源则不然；（ii）政治制度对行政权力施加制度化约束的发展中经济体能够抵消点源资源对财政能力的负面影响。我们的发现意味着，发展自然资源部门不一定损害财政能力。

records.title_en: Understanding ‘refugee resettlement’ from below: Decoding the Rohingya refugees’ lived experience in Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 从底层理解“难民重新安置”：解读孟加拉国罗兴亚难民的生活经历
records.abstract_en: While the resettlement of displaced people often denotes rehabilitation in one way or another, the paper illuminates the paradox of resettlement between repatriation and relocation with the case of Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh. The Rohingya, considered the most persecuted ethnic minority in the world at present as per the United Nations (UN), are an ethnolinguistic and religious minority of Myanmar but at present most of them are living in Bangladesh as refugees. About 750 thousand Rohingyas fled a deadly genocidal attack perpetrated by the Myanmar security forces in 2017 and took refuge in Bangladesh. Combining with the previously living ones, Bangladesh now hosts more than 1.3 million Rohingyas as refugees in 34 temporary camps in Ukhia and Teknaf, two south-eastern sub-districts of Cox’s Bazar. This massive Rohingya presence has heavily impacted the local lives and resources and thereby the local community gradually became reluctant, though not yet hostile, to host them anymore. To accommodate the local pressure, Bangladesh made two consecutive repatriation attempts (the first one on November 15, 2018, and the second one on August 22, 2019) to send the Rohingya back to Myanmar but failed since none willingly returned to their ‘homeland’. The refusal was interpreted as non-cooperation of the international community, and non-preparation on Myanmar's part to accept the Rohingyas back and let them resume their lives safely in the Rakhine state where they used to live. Since the repatriation attempt did not work and local pressures started mounting, Bangladesh initiated a program to relocate a few thousand Rohingya families to Bhasan Char, a newly emerged island located in the Bay of Bengal under Noakhali district. Empirical data reveal that the physical facilities of Bhasan Char seem far better than the same of Ukhia and Teknaf. Still, Rohingya refugees remain reluctant to move due to their entrenched fear of cyclones, floods and tidal surges which, they believe, could wash them away anytime. The entire process of Rohingya relocation to Bhasan Char has created huge debates about whether the Island is safe-liveable for the Rohingya people since it is a twenty-year-old island and there was no experience of people living there. Still, it does not appear to be a convincing plan to resolve the displacement problem of the Rohingya refugees. Given the background, what the Rohingya people articulate their aspiration in the name of resettlement is completely missing in the entire planning and action to redress the Rohingya crisis. Empirical findings show that the majority of Rohingyas are willing to return ‘home’ if three conditions are met: legal recognition amid conferring citizenship, social safety through the deployment of UN peace troops, and human dignity so that they can enjoy all forms of human rights. So, the Rohingya perception of resettlement is repatriation with aforesaid conditions. Therefore, the paper argues that beyond the populist idea of resettlement in the form of rehabilitation or relocation, the whole discourse of resettlement could come up from the bottom and people’s perspectives which could be both crucial and instrumental in policy framing and action planning. The Rohingya refugees desire dignified repatriation with legal recognition and social safety which is largely absent in the activism of the human rights bodies and the action of the international communities as well as the state-level movements. Given the matrix of relocation and repatriation, resettlement takes a central point of discussion and debates whether resettlement could settle the Rohingya crisis in the place of migration. The paper with the experience of decade-long ethnographic research intends to rearticulate the people’s perception and ground-level view of (re)settlement to redress the Rohingya crisis in the interface of repatriation and relocation.
records.abstract_cn: 虽然流离失所者的重新安置通常以某种方式意味着康复，但本文通过孟加拉国罗兴亚难民的案例，阐明了遣返与搬迁之间重新安置的悖论。罗兴亚人被认为是目前世界上受迫害最严重的少数民族（根据联合国的说法），他们是缅甸的族裔语言和宗教少数群体，但目前大多数人作为难民生活在孟加拉国。约750万罗兴亚人在2017年逃离缅甸安全部队实施的致命种族灭绝袭击，并在孟加拉国避难。加上先前居住的人，孟加拉国现在在考克斯巴扎尔东南部的两个分区乌基亚和特克纳夫的1.3个临时营地收容了超过34万罗兴亚难民。罗兴亚人的大量存在严重影响了当地的生活和资源，因此当地社区逐渐变得不情愿（尽管尚未敌对）继续收容他们。为了缓解当地压力，孟加拉国进行了两次连续的遣返尝试（第一次在15年十一月2018日，第二次在22年八月2019日），试图将罗兴亚人送回缅甸，但均未成功，因为没有人愿意返回他们的“家园”。拒绝被解释为国际社会的不合作，以及缅甸方面未准备好接受罗兴亚人返回并让他们在若开邦安全恢复生活。由于遣返尝试未奏效，当地压力开始增加，孟加拉国启动了一项计划，将数千个罗兴亚家庭搬迁到位于诺阿卡利区孟加拉湾的新兴岛屿巴山查尔。实证数据显示，巴山查尔的物理设施似乎远优于乌基亚和特克纳夫。尽管如此，罗兴亚难民仍然不愿搬迁，因为他们对气旋、洪水和风暴潮的根深蒂固的恐惧，他们认为这些随时可能将他们冲走。罗兴亚人搬迁到巴山查尔的整个过程引发了关于该岛是否适合罗兴亚人安全居住的巨大争议，因为它是一个有二十年历史的岛屿，且没有人在那里居住的经验。尽管如此，这似乎并不是解决罗兴亚难民流离失所问题的令人信服的计划。在此背景下，罗兴亚人以重新安置之名表达他们的愿望，在解决罗兴亚危机的整个规划和行动中完全缺失。实证研究结果表明，如果满足三个条件，大多数罗兴亚人愿意返回“家园”：获得公民身份的法律承认、通过部署联合国维和部队实现社会安全，以及享有各种形式人权的人类尊严。因此，罗兴亚人对重新安置的看法是带有上述条件的遣返。因此，本文认为，在康复或搬迁形式的民粹主义重新安置观念之外，整个重新安置话语可以从底层和人民的角度出发，这在政策制定和行动规划中可能既关键又具有工具性。罗兴亚难民渴望有尊严的遣返，并伴有法律承认和社会安全，而这在人权机构的活动、国际社会的行动以及国家层面的运动中基本缺失。在搬迁和遣返的矩阵中，重新安置成为讨论和辩论的中心点，即重新安置能否在移民问题上解决罗兴亚危机。本文基于长达十年的民族志研究经验，旨在重新阐述人民对（重新）安置的看法和基层观点，以在遣返与搬迁的交叉中解决罗兴亚危机。

records.title_en: Evaluating the determinants of participation in conservancy land leases and its impacts on household wealth in the Maasai Mara, Kenya: Equity and gender implications
records.title_cn: 评估肯尼亚马赛马拉保护区土地租赁参与的决定因素及其对家庭财富的影响：公平与性别含义
records.abstract_en: Understanding the impact of conservation interventions on local communities is important in determining their effects on livelihoods and wellbeing. However, impacts are often not uniform and there are important equity dimensions when evaluating interventions. Therefore, in this paper, we investigate determinants of participation in conservation land leases in the Mara Conservancies in southern Kenya and its impact on household wealth. We find that land ownership determines who can participate in and benefit from conservancy land lease payments, and by how much. The design of the land lease payment scheme therefore has the potential to reinforce and, in cases, amplify existing inequities as it is built upon a legacy of unequal historical land distribution processes that limit the participation of women and poor landless households. We observed significantly higher incomes amongst participant households compared to non-participants, but these differences disappeared after propensity score matching. These results suggest that the differences were not caused by participation in conservancies. Our findings suggest that the design and outcomes of land-based conservation or payment for ecosystem services schemes should consider historic and existing land tenure systems if they are to reduce inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 理解保护干预对当地社区的影响对于确定其对生计和福祉的作用至关重要。然而，影响往往并非均匀分布，在评估干预措施时存在重要的公平维度。因此，在本文中，我们研究了肯尼亚南部马拉保护区参与保护性土地租赁的决定因素及其对家庭财富的影响。我们发现，土地所有权决定了谁能够参与并从保护区土地租赁付款中受益，以及受益多少。因此，土地租赁付款计划的设计有可能强化并在某些情况下放大现有的不平等，因为它建立在历史上不平等的土地分配过程之上，这些过程限制了妇女和无地贫困家庭的参与。我们观察到参与家庭的收入显著高于非参与家庭，但在倾向得分匹配后这些差异消失了。这些结果表明，这些差异并非由参与保护区所致。我们的研究结果表明，基于土地的保护或生态系统服务付费计划的设计和结果应考虑历史和现有的土地权属制度，以实现减少不平等的目的。

records.title_en: The impact of large-scale land acquisitions on child food insecurity in Africa
records.title_cn: 大规模土地收购对非洲儿童粮食不安全的影响
records.abstract_en: Food insecurity is a major concern in most African countries. Large-scale land acquisitions (LSLAs) frequently have a negative impact on local communities. In this paper, I examine the impact of LSLAs on the nutritional status of neighboring children. To this end, I use a difference-in-differences methodology applied to LSLAs in a large number of African countries at different times since the early 2000s. I analyze data from Demographic and Health Surveys combined with data from the Land Matrix Initiative, supplemented by my own research, ultimately covering 18,276 children living in the vicinity of 45 LSLAs. I show that LSLAs have had a significant negative impact on child nutrition in Africa over the past two decades. Specifically, the dietary diversity scores of children living close to LSLAs were reduced by 20 per cent after acquisition. The results are robust to various statistical tests. I find no changes in work status or household assets. While the impact of LSLAs may be positive for agricultural practices, it is negative for child food security. The analysis highlights the importance of supporting local communities following foreign agricultural investment.
records.abstract_cn: 粮食不安全是大多数非洲国家的主要关切问题。大规模土地收购（LSLAs）常常对当地社区产生负面影响。在本文中，我考察了LSLAs对邻近儿童营养状况的影响。为此，我采用双重差分方法，应用于自2000年代初以来不同时间在众多非洲国家发生的LSLAs。我分析了来自人口与健康调查的数据，并结合土地矩阵倡议的数据，辅以我自己的研究，最终涵盖了居住在45个LSLAs附近的18,276名儿童。我表明，在过去二十年中，LSLAs对非洲儿童营养产生了显著的负面影响。具体而言，居住在LSLAs附近的儿童的膳食多样性评分在收购后降低了20%。结果对各种统计检验均稳健。我发现工作状态或家庭资产没有变化。虽然LSLAs对农业实践的影响可能是积极的，但对儿童粮食安全的影响却是消极的。该分析强调了在外国农业投资后支持当地社区的重要性。

records.title_en: Locating Kadu in Adivasi portrayals of protected forest areas in Southern India
records.title_cn: 定位卡杜：南印度保护林区阿迪瓦西人描绘中的森林
records.abstract_en: Globally, Indigenous Peoples are the stewards of a large portion of the global land base, and their interactions and associations with the land have shaped and sustained it for centuries. Yet conservation studies and land management practices still struggle to understand or use Indigenous interpretations of the natural world. In many cases, this perpetuates a colonial sensibility across land use policies, which also dangerously misrepresents Indigenous relationships with that land. This paper focuses on Kattunayakans, a hunter-forager Adivasi (Indigenous) community living within the Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary in Kerala, India. Our focus is how they characterize kadu (‘forest’ in Kattunayakan language), both what it is constituted of and what it means from an Adivasi point of view. Using open-ended interviews, transect walks, and spatial mapping we find that for Kattunayakans, the forest is seen as an entity with agency; and a body of discrete biocultural landscape units classified as: a convergence of good places and God people; and a realm of spaces populated by kinfolk with fluid human-and-nonhuman identities that do not follow any physical boundaries of protected areas. This understanding of what a protected area forest is and is comprised of is neither adequately represented and discussed in the history of India's protected areas nor addressed in forest and wildlife management policies and approaches. This is highly consequential for Adivasi communities such as Kattunayakans, who do not have written or material evidence of their productive and historical relationship to forest land. We argue, as well, that when engaged appropriately, Adivasi portrayals of the kadu can bolster equity in land management and strengthen collaborative governance that more broadly advances human rights alongside the goals of biodiversity conservation.
records.abstract_cn: 在全球范围内，原住民是地球大部分土地的管理者，他们与土地的互动和联系塑造并维持了这片土地数百年。然而，保护研究和土地管理实践仍然难以理解或利用原住民对自然世界的诠释。在许多情况下，这导致土地政策中延续了殖民主义观念，同时也危险地歪曲了原住民与土地的关系。本文聚焦于卡图纳亚坎人，一个居住在印度喀拉拉邦瓦亚纳德野生动物保护区的狩猎采集阿迪瓦西（原住民）社区。我们关注的是他们如何描述卡杜（卡图纳亚坎语中的“森林”），既包括其构成，也包括从阿迪瓦西视角来看的意义。通过开放式访谈、样带行走和空间绘图，我们发现，对于卡图纳亚坎人而言，森林被视为具有能动性的实体；并且是一系列离散的生物文化景观单元，被分类为：好地方与神之人的汇聚；以及由具有流动人性和非人身份的亲属所占据的领域，这些身份不遵循保护区的任何物理边界。这种对保护区森林及其构成的理解，在印度保护区的历史中既未得到充分呈现和讨论，也未在森林和野生动物管理政策及方法中得到解决。这对像卡图纳亚坎人这样的阿迪瓦西社区具有重大影响，因为他们没有关于其与森林土地的生产性和历史关系的书面或物质证据。我们还认为，如果适当参与，阿迪瓦西人对卡杜的描绘可以增强土地管理中的公平性，并加强协作治理，从而在生物多样性保护目标的同时更广泛地推进人权。

records.title_en: Cash Transfers, Time Discounting, and Agricultural Inputs Utilization in Lesotho
records.title_cn: 莱索托的现金转移、时间贴现与农业投入品利用
records.abstract_en: Cash transfers are shown to improve production, increase investment, and induce productive practices by farmers. Despite rich literature showing these desired outcomes, little is known about the pathways that produce these impacts. We use Lesotho’s Child Grants Program, a large-scale cash transfer program, to study if cash transfers affect input utilization by farmers through their impact on intertemporal choice. We exploit the random assignment of treatment to identify the indirect and total effect of the program and to isolate the influence of the time discounting channel. We find that cash transfers make it six percentage points more likely for households to use pesticides. Based on our preferred method, eleven percent of this effect is mediated through the increase in the patience of recipients.
records.abstract_cn: 现金转移被证明能改善农民的生产、增加投资并诱导生产性实践。尽管有丰富的文献显示这些预期结果，但对其产生这些影响的路径知之甚少。我们利用莱索托的儿童补助计划（一项大规模现金转移计划）来研究现金转移是否通过其对跨期选择的影响而影响农民的投入品利用。我们利用治疗的随机分配来识别该计划的间接效应和总效应，并隔离时间贴现渠道的影响。我们发现，现金转移使农户使用农药的可能性提高六个百分点。根据我们的首选方法，这一效应的百分之十一通过受助者耐心程度的提高而中介传导。

records.title_en: The effects of illegal armed groups on municipal expenditures in Colombia
records.title_cn: 非法武装团体对哥伦比亚市政支出的影响
records.abstract_en: This study assesses the effects of illegal armed groups on expenditures made by municipal governments in Colombia between 2000 and 2013. Specifically, the study examines how the presence of illegal armed groups seems to affect the level of municipal expenditures, while distinguishing between capital investments and current social spending. Limits on political participation and institutional weaknesses helped to propagate the violence that disrupted Colombia in the 1970s and 1980s. Searching for solutions, Colombia transferred important decision-making responsibilities from the central government to regional and local governments. Paradoxically this decentralization opened an opportunity for illegal armed groups to play meaningful roles in local political and economic life, eventually taking control over local resources in several municipalities. To assess the role of these non-state armed groups in municipal resource allocation, our empirical analysis exploits annual data on municipal expenditures and local armed conflict. Empirical results suggest a differentiated impact on capital investments and social spending. These results are robust to multiple treatment framings and definitions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了2000年至2013年间非法武装团体对哥伦比亚市政政府支出的影响。具体而言，研究考察了非法武装团体的存在如何影响市政支出水平，同时区分资本投资和经常性社会支出。政治参与的限制和制度弱点助长了扰乱哥伦比亚1970年代和1980年代的暴力。为寻求解决方案，哥伦比亚将重要的决策责任从中央政府转移给地区和地方各级政府。矛盾的是，这种权力下放为非法武装团体在地方政治和经济生活中发挥重要作用提供了机会，最终在若干市政当局控制了地方资源。为评估这些非国家武装团体在市政资源配置中的作用，我们的实证分析利用了市政支出和地方武装冲突的年度数据。实证结果表明对资本投资和社会支出存在差异化影响。这些结果在多种处理框架和定义下均保持稳健。

records.title_en: Elongating the causes of social vulnerability: Historical analysis of social sustainability dimensions in the Ivorian cocoa sector
records.title_cn: 延伸社会脆弱性的成因：科特迪瓦可可部门社会可持续性维度的历史分析
records.abstract_en: Despite efforts by governments, industry, civil society and other key stakeholders to ensure fairer farmer incomes, eradicate child labour, and address causes of cocoa-related deforestation, results on the ground in Côte d’Ivoire are limited. Given the less tangible social dimensions that evade quantitative methods and unfold over time in complex ways, knowledge and methodological gaps remain. Using Comparative Historical Analysis (CHA), this study analyses social sustainability priorities, statuses, and gaps in the Ivorian cocoa sector, providing a contextual reflection of current social outcomes. Findings highlight underlying social structures that (a) show slow progress (e.g., weak infrastructure, disparities in access to basic services, especially in rural areas); (b) amplify (e.g., structural poverty magnified by demographic changes, power held by a few firms); and (c) erode (e.g., institutional decay dynamics). Analysis shows that structural factors that increase vulnerability in the Ivorian cocoa sector are not adequately addressed. Thus, cocoa producers are highly vulnerable to price shocks and production related risks, ultimately unable to achieve a decent standard of living. Addressing research and knowledge gaps while making complex social issues a more explicit part of the policy and practice agenda is crucial for successful long-term multi-sectoral and multi-actor planning.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管政府、行业、民间社会和其他关键利益相关者努力确保农民获得更公平的收入、消除童工并解决与可可相关的森林砍伐原因，但科特迪瓦的实际成果有限。鉴于难以捉摸的社会维度往往规避定量方法并随时间以复杂方式展开，知识和方法的空白仍然存在。本研究采用比较历史分析（CHA），分析了科特迪瓦可可部门的社会可持续性优先事项、现状和差距，对当前社会成果提供了背景性反思。研究结果凸显了潜在的社会结构，这些结构（a）显示出缓慢进展（例如，基础设施薄弱，基本服务获取方面的差距，尤其是在农村地区）；（b）放大（例如，人口变化加剧的结构性贫困，少数公司持有的权力）；以及（c）侵蚀（例如，制度衰败动态）。分析表明，增加科特迪瓦可可部门脆弱性的结构性因素未得到充分解决。因此，可可生产者极易受到价格冲击和生产相关风险的影响，最终无法实现体面的生活水平。解决研究和知识空白，同时使复杂的社会问题成为政策和实践议程中更明确的部分，对于成功的长期多部门和多方参与者规划至关重要。

records.title_en: The effects of exposure to violence on social network composition and formation
records.title_cn: 暴力暴露对社会网络构成与形成的影响
records.abstract_en: How does exposure to violence affect civilian social networks during wartime? Social networks play critical roles in civil wars by enabling civilians to endure the destruction of conflict. However, little is known about how these networks change in response to violence. I employ original survey data from camps for the internally displaced in Kachin State, Myanmar, an area of active civil conflict, to determine how exposure to violence affects the social networks of internally displaced people (IDPs). I find that those exposed to violence have fewer initial, new, and close ties. However, those exposed to violence do not form ties with other exposed IDPs at a higher rate than with non-exposed IDPs.
records.abstract_cn: 战时暴力暴露如何影响平民的社会网络？社会网络在内战中扮演关键角色，使平民能够承受冲突带来的破坏。然而，关于这些网络如何响应暴力而变化，我们知之甚少。我利用来自缅甸克钦邦（一个活跃的内战冲突地区）境内流离失所者营地的原始调查数据，来确定暴力暴露如何影响境内流离失所者（IDPs）的社会网络。我发现，那些暴露于暴力的人拥有更少的初始、新建立和紧密的联系。然而，暴露于暴力的人与其他暴露的IDPs形成联系的比例并不高于与非暴露的IDPs形成联系的比例。

records.title_en: Money backfires: How Chinese investment fuels anti-China protests abroad
records.title_cn: 金钱反噬：中国投资如何助长海外反华抗议
records.abstract_en: China has been expanding its global economic presence through foreign direct investment, foreign aid, and trade. China’s growing economic influence, however, is inviting worries and suspicion in many countries, leading to the rise of anti-China protests. How and when does China’s economic expansion promote anti-China protests? We explore this question by examining the effect of Chinese FDI on the rise of anti-China protests across 127 countries. First, we argue that Chinese FDI promotes anti-China protests, but the effects are contingent on the level of political competition. We find that the effect of Chinese FDI on anti-China protests is particularly stronger in countries where citizens have limited institutional routes to express their grievances and pursue policy alternatives through political competition. Second, we find that the pattern of increasing anti-China protests does not appear in the context of Chinese foreign aid or trade with China. The finding that Chinese FDI backfires and incites anti-China protests has profound implications for our understanding of China’s global economic influence and its limits.
records.abstract_cn: 中国通过对外直接投资、对外援助和贸易不断扩大其全球经济存在。然而，中国日益增长的经济影响力正在许多国家引发担忧和猜疑，导致反华抗议活动的兴起。中国的经济扩张如何以及何时促进反华抗议？我们通过考察中国对外直接投资对127个国家反华抗议兴起的影响来探讨这一问题。首先，我们认为中国对外直接投资会促进反华抗议，但其效果取决于政治竞争的程度。我们发现，在公民通过政治竞争表达不满和寻求政策替代方案的制度渠道有限的国家，中国对外直接投资对反华抗议的影响尤为显著。其次，我们发现反华抗议增加的模式并未出现在中国对外援助或与中国贸易的背景下。中国对外直接投资反噬并激起反华抗议这一发现，对我们理解中国全球经济影响力及其局限性具有深远意义。

records.title_en: The Determinants of Refugees’ Destinations: Where do refugees locate within the EU?
records.title_cn: 难民目的地的决定因素：他们在欧盟内部选择在哪里定居？
records.abstract_en: The recent so called Mediterranean refugee crisis has ignited concerns about the magnitude of the flows of asylum seekers to Europe. This paper examines the determinants of the destination choice of first time non-EU asylum applicants to the EU, between 2008–2020. It investigates the role played by policies related to employment rights, processing of asylum applications, attractiveness of the welfare system, economic factors and networks on the destination of asylum seekers within the EU. We find that the strongest pull factor for asylum seekers to a destination is social networks both in terms of previous asylum applicants as well as stock of previous migrants. Our findings also suggest that employment bans are not a strong deterrence for asylum seekers given their modest association to asylum flows.
records.abstract_cn: 近期所谓的地中海难民危机引发了人们对前往欧洲的寻求庇护者流量的担忧。本文考察了2008-2020年间首次申请非欧盟庇护者在欧盟内部目的地选择的决定因素。它研究了与就业权利、庇护申请处理、福利制度吸引力、经济因素和网络相关的政策对寻求庇护者在欧盟内部目的地选择的作用。我们发现，对寻求庇护者而言，最强的拉力因素是社交网络，无论是之前的庇护申请者还是之前的移民存量。我们的研究结果还表明，就业禁令对寻求庇护者并非强有力的威慑，因为它们与庇护流量的关联不大。

records.title_en: Vent-for-surplus in Southeast Asian development since 1870
records.title_cn: 1870年以来东南亚发展中的剩余出路
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a new vent-for-surplus model to analyze Southeast Asia’s two phases of rapid export-led growth. During the first, from 1870 to 1929, international trade provided the ‘vent’ to utilize frontier land and labour surpluses in the production of primary commodities. Intra-regional exchange both allowed and created specialization. Four commodities— rice, rubber, tin and sugar — accounted for most exports. A second growth phase from 1970 depended on exporting manufactures and vented surplus labour through trade or its substitute of emigration. Western markets and regional integration again drove growth, transforming Southeast Asian countries from agricultural to predominantly industrial. This time, Southeast Asian development depended on integration with markets in the West but, crucially, also on supply chains within the region to enable specialization. By giving scope for consumer preferences and regional integration, the model can better explain the realities of Southeast Asia’s growth and extreme specialization. In both phases, trade served as the growth engine, but in neither was technical change the chief expansionary source.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个新的剩余出路模型，用以分析东南亚两个阶段的快速出口导向型增长。第一阶段，从1870年到1929年，国际贸易提供了‘出路’，利用边疆土地和劳动力剩余生产初级商品。区域内交换既允许也创造了专业化。四种商品——大米、橡胶、锡和糖——占据了大部分出口。第二阶段，从1970年开始，依赖于制成品出口，并通过贸易或其替代形式——移民——来释放剩余劳动力。西方市场和区域一体化再次推动了增长，将东南亚国家从农业国转变为以工业为主的国家。这一次，东南亚的发展依赖于与西方市场的整合，但关键在于，也依赖于区域内供应链以实现专业化。通过考虑消费者偏好和区域一体化，该模型能更好地解释东南亚增长和极端专业化的现实。在两个阶段中，贸易都充当了增长引擎，但技术变革都不是主要的扩张来源。

records.title_en: Impact of energy poverty on public health: A non-linear study from an international perspective
records.title_cn: 能源贫困对公共健康的影响：基于国际视角的非线性研究
records.abstract_en: Research on energy poverty and its impact has been quite extensive, but the impact of such poverty on public health is still lacking. This paper thus presents the relationship between energy poverty and public health of 185 countries from 2000 to 2020 as well as the role of urbanization development levels in this nexus. To achieve this goal, this study uses a partial linear function coefficient (PLFC) method to analyze the relationship between them, which can also clearly exhibit the non-linear impact of energy poverty on public health. First, both linear and non-linear regression results show that energy poverty has significantly negative impacts on public health. Second, urbanization level plays a significant moderating effect in the energy poverty and public health nexus, meaning that energy poverty affects public health under the influence of urbanization. According to the PLFC model results, countries that exceed the threshold of urbanization have significantly reduced the adverse effects of energy poverty on public health. Third, this study investigates the heterogeneous impact of energy poverty across different regions, comparing the Sub-Saharan Africa region with other areas. The results reveal in the Sub-Saharan Africa region that affordable energy under the influence of urbanization provides a new pathway for improving public health in that region, whereas this effect is considerably smaller in other regions. Additionally, a series of tests confirm the robustness of the results. This paper offers a reference for the development and implementation of renewable energy-related public health policies.
records.abstract_cn: 关于能源贫困及其影响的研究已经相当广泛，但此类贫困对公共健康的影响仍然缺乏。因此，本文呈现了2000年至2020年间185个国家能源贫困与公共健康之间的关系，以及城市化发展水平在这一关系中的作用。为实现这一目标，本研究采用部分线性函数系数（PLFC）方法分析它们之间的关系，该方法也能清晰展示能源贫困对公共健康的非线性影响。首先，线性和非线性回归结果均表明，能源贫困对公共健康具有显著的负面影响。其次，城市化水平在能源贫困与公共健康的关系中发挥着显著的调节作用，这意味着能源贫困在城市化影响下影响公共健康。根据PLFC模型结果，超过城市化阈值的国家显著减少了能源贫困对公共健康的不利影响。第三，本研究考察了能源贫困在不同地区的异质性影响，将撒哈拉以南非洲地区与其他地区进行比较。结果显示，在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，城市化影响下的可负担能源为该地区改善公共健康提供了新途径，而在其他地区这种效应要小得多。此外，一系列检验证实了结果的稳健性。本文为可再生能源相关公共健康政策的制定和实施提供了参考。

records.title_en: Caste Differences in Child Growth: Disentangling Endowment and Investment Effects
records.title_cn: 种姓差异与儿童生长：区分禀赋与投资效应
records.abstract_en: Using the fourth round of the Indian National Family Health Survey (NFHS-4), and subsequently replicating our results using the fifth round (NFHS-5), we document differential child physical growth patterns across caste groups in India, demonstrating that lower caste children are born shorter and grow less quickly than children from higher-caste households. We then show that, in line with work from previous rounds of the NFHS, these differences are largely explainable by observable covariates, particularly maternal characteristics and household wealth variables. Our research also reveals a previously undocumented dynamic, that the influence of these variables changes as children develop, and suggests that caste-gaps are the result of multiple mechanisms impacting the child growth process at different stages of development. Using age-disaggregated decomposition methods, we demonstrate that health endowment related variables (e.g. maternal height) largely explain birth length gaps, and that variables related to health investments (e.g. household wealth, health care usage) become increasingly influential as children age. Children from lower caste households thus face two margins generating height gaps as they age: a persistent endowment disparity present from birth, and a post birth investment differential that exacerbates the initial deficit.
records.abstract_cn: 利用印度全国家庭健康调查（NFHS-4）第四轮数据，并随后使用第五轮（NFHS-5）数据复制我们的结果，我们记录了印度不同种姓群体儿童身体生长模式的差异，表明低种姓儿童出生时更矮，且比高种姓家庭的儿童生长更慢。然后我们表明，与之前几轮NFHS的研究一致，这些差异在很大程度上可由可观测的协变量解释，特别是母亲特征和家庭财富变量。我们的研究还揭示了一个先前未记录的现象，即这些变量的影响随儿童发育而变化，并表明种姓差距是多种机制在儿童发育不同阶段影响生长过程的结果。使用按年龄分解的方法，我们证明健康禀赋相关变量（如母亲身高）在很大程度上解释了出生身长差距，而健康投资相关变量（如家庭财富、医疗保健使用）随着儿童年龄增长而变得越来越有影响。因此，低种姓家庭的儿童在成长过程中面临两个产生身高差距的边际：出生时就存在的持续禀赋差距，以及出生后加剧初始缺陷的投资差异。

records.title_en: Parental early-life exposure to land reform and household investment in children’s education
records.title_cn: 父母早年经历土地改革与家庭教育投资
records.abstract_en: We examine the intergenerational relationship between the early-life exposure of parents to China’s Household Responsibility System (HRS) reform, which assigned collective-owned farmland to individual households, and investment in their children’s education. We find that an increase in the length of exposure of parents to the HRS reform when they were children or adolescents increases the extent to which they invest in their children’s education, although there is some evidence of non-linearities with investment peaking at 13–14 years of exposure to the HRS. We find that parental income and wealth, parental human capital and the improvement in public benefits that stem from land reform are channels through which parental early-life reform exposure affects expenditure on their children’s education. We also find considerable heterogeneity in the relationship across subsamples of individuals. Specifically, we find that education investment in children in junior high and senior high schools and children in the eastern region benefit more from parents’ early-life exposure to the HRS.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了父母早年接触中国家庭联产承包责任制（HRS）改革（将集体所有的农田分配给个体农户）与其子女教育投资之间的代际关系。我们发现，父母在儿童或青少年时期接触HRS改革的时长增加，会提高他们对子女教育投资的程度，尽管有一些证据表明存在非线性关系，投资在接触HRS约13-14年时达到峰值。我们发现，父母收入和财富、父母人力资本以及土地改革带来的公共福利改善是父母早年改革经历影响子女教育支出的渠道。我们还发现，这一关系在个体子样本中存在相当大的异质性。具体而言，我们发现初中和高中阶段的子女以及东部地区子女的教育投资从父母早年接触HRS的经历中获益更多。

records.title_en: Real exchange rate and import substitution episodes: Evidence from a developing economy
records.title_cn: 实际汇率与进口替代阶段：来自发展中经济体的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of the real exchange rate (RER) on the growth of import-substituting sectors using the quasi-natural experiment of Argentina’s large and lasting RER depreciation following the end of the Convertibility regime. To this end, we developed an episode detection algorithm to identify sectors with substantial import reductions from 2003 to 2008, while controlling for changes in aggregate income. Our analysis examines the theoretical transmission mechanisms through which the RER influences the performance of the tradable sector competing with imports. The results reveal three main findings: First, labor-intensive sectors showed a higher probability of occurrence of import substitution episodes during 2003–2008.
