To fill this gap, we examine a variety of potentially useful schemes for ReP and quantify their impact on subsequent inference. Specifically, we focus on three estimators of the average treatment effect from the unadjusted, additive, and interacted linear regressions of the outcome on treatment, respectively, and derive their asymptotic sampling properties under ReP. The main findings are threefold. First, the estimator from the interacted regression is asymptotically the most efficient under all ReP schemes examined, and permits convenient regression-assisted inference identical to that under complete randomization. Second, ReP, in contrast to complete randomization, improves the asymptotic efficiency of the estimators from the unadjusted and additive regressions. Standard regression analyses are accordingly still valid but in general overconservative. Third, ReP reduces the asymptotic conditional biases of the three estimators and improves their coherence in terms of mean squared difference. These results establish ReP as a convenient tool for improving covariate balance in designing randomized experiments, and we recommend using the interacted regression for analyzing data from ReP designs.
records.abstract_cn: 随机实验平均平衡所有协变量，被视为估计处理效应的金标准。然而，在实现的处理分配中，偶然的不平衡很常见。为了让读者了解基线时处理组的可比性，当代科学出版物通常报告协变量平衡表，不仅包括各处理组的协变量均值，还包括其差异显著性检验的相应p值。避免小p值作为平衡不佳指标的实际需求，使得基于这些协变量平衡检验p值的平衡检查和再随机化（ReP）成为设计随机实验中改善协变量平衡的有吸引力的工具。尽管这种策略直观且可能在实践中已被广泛使用，但文献缺乏关于其对后续推断影响的结果，使许多实际上的再随机化实验可能面临低效的分析。为填补这一空白，我们考察了多种可能有用的ReP方案，并量化它们对后续推断的影响。具体而言，我们关注来自未调整、加性和交互线性回归的三种平均处理效应估计量，并推导它们在ReP下的渐近抽样性质。主要发现有三点。第一，在所有考察的ReP方案下，交互回归的估计量渐近最有效，并允许与完全随机化下相同的便捷回归辅助推断。第二，与完全随机化相比，ReP提高了未调整和加性回归估计量的渐近效率。标准回归分析因此仍然有效，但通常过于保守。第三，ReP降低了三个估计量的渐近条件偏差，并改善了它们在均方差异方面的一致性。这些结果确立了ReP作为设计随机实验中改善协变量平衡的便捷工具，我们建议使用交互回归分析来自ReP设计的数据。

records.title_en: Sieve bootstrap inference for linear time-varying coefficient models
records.title_cn: 线性时变系数模型的筛子自助法推断
records.abstract_en: We propose a sieve bootstrap framework to conduct pointwise and simultaneous inference for time-varying coefficient regression models based on a local linear estimator. The asymptotic validity of the sieve bootstrap in the presence of autocorrelation is established. The bootstrap automatically produces a consistent estimate of nuisance parameters, both at the interior and boundary points. In addition, we develop a bootstrap-based test for parameter constancy and examine its asymptotic properties. An extensive simulation study demonstrates a good finite sample performance of our methods. The proposed methods are applied to assess the price development of CO2 certificates in the European Emissions Trading System. We find evidence of time variation in the relationship between allowance prices and their fundamental price drivers. The time variation might offer an explanation for previous contradicting findings using linear regression models with constant coefficients.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种筛子自助法框架，基于局部线性估计量对时变系数回归模型进行逐点和同时推断。在存在自相关的情况下，建立了筛子自助法的渐近有效性。自助法自动产生干扰参数的一致估计，无论是在内部点还是边界点。此外，我们开发了一种基于自助法的参数恒定性检验，并考察了其渐近性质。一项广泛的模拟研究证明了我们方法良好的有限样本性能。所提出的方法被应用于评估欧洲排放交易体系中二氧化碳证书的价格发展。我们发现配额价格与其基本价格驱动因素之间的关系存在时变性。这种时变性可能为先前使用常数系数线性回归模型得出的矛盾结果提供解释。

records.title_en: On LASSO for high dimensional predictive regression
records.title_cn: 高维预测回归中的LASSO方法研究
records.abstract_en: This paper examines LASSO, a widely-used L1-penalized regression method, in high dimensional linear predictive regressions, particularly when the number of potential predictors exceeds the sample size and numerous unit root regressors are present. The consistency of LASSO is contingent upon two key components: the deviation bound of the cross product of the regressors and the error term, and the restricted eigenvalue of the Gram matrix. We present new probabilistic bounds for these components, suggesting that LASSO’s rates of convergence are different from those typically observed in cross-sectional cases. When applied to a mixture of stationary, nonstationary, and cointegrated predictors, LASSO maintains its asymptotic guarantee if predictors are scale-standardized. Leveraging machine learning and macroeconomic domain expertise, LASSO demonstrates strong performance in forecasting the unemployment rate, as evidenced by its application to the FRED-MD database.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在高维线性预测回归中广泛使用的L1惩罚回归方法LASSO，特别是在潜在预测因子数量超过样本量且存在大量单位根回归因子的情况下。LASSO的一致性取决于两个关键组成部分：回归因子与误差项叉积的偏差界，以及Gram矩阵的限制特征值。我们为这些组成部分提出了新的概率界，表明LASSO的收敛速率与横截面情形下通常观察到的速率不同。当应用于平稳、非平稳和协整预测因子的混合时，如果预测因子经过尺度标准化，LASSO保持其渐近保证。利用机器学习和宏观经济领域专业知识，LASSO在预测失业率方面表现出强劲性能，其对FRED-MD数据库的应用证明了这一点。

records.title_en: Measuring diagnostic test performance using imperfect reference tests: A partial identification approach
records.title_cn: 使用不完美参考检验测量诊断检验性能：一种部分识别方法
records.abstract_en: Diagnostic tests are almost never perfect. Studies quantifying their performance use knowledge of the true health status, measured with a reference diagnostic test. Researchers commonly assume that the reference test is perfect, which is often not the case in practice. When the assumption fails, conventional studies identify “apparent” performance or performance with respect to the reference, but not true performance. This paper provides the smallest possible bounds on the measures of true performance — sensitivity (true positive rate) and specificity (true negative rate), or equivalently false positive and negative rates, in standard settings. Implied bounds on policy-relevant parameters are derived: (1) Prevalence in screened populations; (2) Predictive values. Methods for inference based on moment inequalities are used to construct uniformly consistent confidence sets in level over a relevant family of data distributions. Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) and independent study data for the BinaxNOW COVID-19 antigen test demonstrate that the bounds can be very informative. Analysis reveals that the estimated false negative rates for symptomatic and asymptomatic patients are up to 3.17 and 4.59 times higher than the frequently cited “apparent” false negative rate. Further applicability of the results in the context of imperfect proxies such as survey responses and imputed protected classes is indicated.
records.abstract_cn: 诊断检验几乎从不完美。量化其性能的研究依赖于真实健康状况的知识，该知识通过参考诊断检验测量。研究者通常假设参考检验是完美的，但在实践中往往并非如此。当该假设不成立时，常规研究识别的是“表观”性能或相对于参考的性能，而非真实性能。本文提供了在标准设置下真实性能度量——灵敏度（真阳性率）和特异度（真阴性率），或等价地假阳性率和假阴性率——的最小可能界限。推导了政策相关参数的隐含界限：（1）筛查人群中的患病率；（2）预测值。基于矩不等式的推断方法被用于在相关数据分布族上构建水平上的一致置信集。BinaxNOW COVID-19抗原检测的紧急使用授权（EUA）和独立研究数据表明，这些界限可能非常具有信息量。分析显示，有症状和无症状患者的估计假阴性率分别是经常引用的“表观”假阴性率的3.17倍和4.59倍。结果在诸如调查响应和插补受保护类别等不完美代理的背景下具有进一步适用性。

records.title_en: A comparison of the GB2 and skewed generalized log-t distributions with an application in finance
records.title_cn: 第二类广义贝塔分布与偏态广义对数t分布的比较及其在金融中的应用
records.abstract_en: Several families of statistical distributions have been used to model financial data. The four-parameter generalized beta of the second kind (GB2) and five-parameter skewed generalized t (SGT) have been fit to return and log-return data, respectively. We introduce the skewed generalized log-t (SGLT) distribution and note that the GB2 and SGLT share such distributions as the asymmetric log-Laplace (ALL), log-Laplace (LL), and log-normal (LN). We then compare the relative performance of the GB2 and SGLT in modeling the distribution of daily, weekly, and monthly stock return data. We find that the GB2 and SGLT perform similarly and that the three-parameter log-t (LT) distribution is quite robust.
records.abstract_cn: 已有多个统计分布族被用于对金融数据进行建模。四参数的第二类广义贝塔分布（GB2）和五参数的偏态广义t分布（SGT）分别被拟合到收益和对数收益数据上。我们引入了偏态广义对数t（SGLT）分布，并注意到GB2和SGLT共享诸如非对称对数拉普拉斯（ALL）、对数拉普拉斯（LL）和对数正态（LN）等分布。然后，我们比较了GB2和SGLT在建模日、周和月股票收益数据分布方面的相对表现。我们发现GB2和SGLT的表现相似，且三参数的对数t（LT）分布相当稳健。

records.title_en: Parametric risk-neutral density estimation via finite lognormal-Weibull mixtures
records.title_cn: 基于有限对数正态-威布尔混合的参数化风险中性密度估计
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new parametric risk-neutral density (RND) estimator based on a finite lognormal-Weibull mixture (LWM) density. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the LWM method in a general misspecified parametric framework. Based on the theoretical results, we propose a sequential test procedure to evaluate the goodness-of-fit of the LWM model, which leads to an adaptive choice for the number and type of mixture components. Our simulation results show that, in finite samples with various observation error specifications, the LWM method can approximate complex RNDs generated by state-of-the-art multi-factor stochastic volatility models with a few (typically less than 4) mixtures. Application of the LWM model on index options confirms its reliability in recovering empirical RNDs with a heavy left tail or bimodality, which can be incorrectly identified as bimodality or a heavy left tail by existing (semi)-nonparametric methods if the goodness-of-fit to the observed data is ignored.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种基于有限对数正态-威布尔混合（LWM）密度的新型参数化风险中性密度（RND）估计器。我们在一般误设参数框架下建立了LWM方法的一致性和渐近正态性。基于理论结果，我们提出了一种序贯检验程序来评估LWM模型的拟合优度，从而自适应选择混合成分的数量和类型。我们的模拟结果表明，在具有各种观测误差设定的有限样本中，LWM方法可以用少量（通常少于4个）混合成分逼近由最先进的多因子随机波动率模型生成的复杂RND。将LWM模型应用于指数期权证实了其在恢复具有重左尾或双峰性的经验RND方面的可靠性，而如果忽略对观测数据的拟合优度，现有（半）非参数方法可能会错误地将这些RND识别为双峰性或重左尾。

records.title_en: Reprint of: Robust inference on correlation under general heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 重印：一般异质性下的相关性稳健推断
records.abstract_en: Considerable evidence in past research shows size distortion in standard tests for zero autocorrelation or zero cross-correlation when time series are not independent identically distributed random variables, pointing to the need for more robust procedures. Recent tests for serial correlation and cross-correlation in Dalla, Giraitis, and Phillips (2022) provide a more robust approach, allowing for heteroskedasticity and dependence in uncorrelated data under restrictions that require a smooth, slowly-evolving deterministic heteroskedasticity process. The present work removes those restrictions and validates the robust testing methodology for a wider class of innovations and regression residuals allowing for heteroscedastic uncorrelated and non-stationary data settings. The updated analysis given here enables more extensive use of the methodology in practical applications. Monte Carlo experiments confirm excellent finite sample performance of the robust test procedures even for extremely complex white noise processes. The empirical examples show that use of robust testing methods can materially reduce spurious evidence of correlations found by standard testing procedures.
records.abstract_cn: 过去研究中的大量证据表明，当时间序列不是独立同分布随机变量时，标准检验在零自相关或零互相关检验中存在规模失真，这表明需要更稳健的程序。Dalla、Giraitis和Phillips（2022）最近提出的序列相关和互相关检验提供了一种更稳健的方法，允许不相关数据中存在异方差性和依赖性，但需满足要求平滑、缓慢演变的确定性异方差过程的限制。本研究去除了这些限制，并验证了稳健检验方法适用于更广泛的创新和回归残差类别，允许异方差不相关和非平稳数据设置。这里给出的更新分析使得该方法在实际应用中得到更广泛的使用。蒙特卡洛实验证实，即使对于极其复杂的白噪声过程，稳健检验程序也具有出色的有限样本性能。实证例子表明，使用稳健检验方法可以显著减少标准检验程序发现的虚假相关性证据。

records.title_en: An information–Theoretic approach to partially identified auction models
records.title_cn: 部分识别拍卖模型的信息论方法
records.abstract_en: We consider a situation in which we have data from ascending auctions with symmetric bidders, independent private values, and exogenous entry in which the bidders’ value distribution is partially identified. Focusing on the case in which the seller intends to use a second price auction, we discuss how to determine an optimal reserve price. We justify the use of maximum entropy, explore the properties of the estimand, determine the asymptotic properties of our maximum entropy estimator, evaluate its behavior in a simulation study, and demonstrate its use in a modest application. As an extension, we propose a maxmin decision rule with entropy regularization, which includes Aryal and Kim (2013) and the maximum entropy solution as extreme cases.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一种情况，即我们拥有来自对称竞标者、独立私人价值和外生进入的升价拍卖数据，其中竞标者的价值分布是部分识别的。关注卖方打算使用第二价格拍卖的情形，我们讨论如何确定最优保留价格。我们论证了最大熵的使用，探讨了估计量的性质，确定了我们的最大熵估计量的渐近性质，在模拟研究中评估了其行为，并在一个适度的应用中展示了其使用。作为扩展，我们提出了一种带有熵正则化的最大最小决策规则，该规则将Aryal和Kim（2013）和最大熵解作为极端情况包含在内。

records.title_en: 2SLS with multiple treatments
records.title_cn: 多重处理下的两阶段最小二乘法
records.abstract_en: We study what two-stage least squares (2SLS) identifies in models with multiple treatments under treatment effect heterogeneity. Two conditions are shown to be necessary and sufficient for the 2SLS to identify positively weighted sums of agent-specific effects of each treatment: average conditional monotonicity and no cross effects. Our identification analysis allows for any number of treatments, any number of continuous or discrete instruments, and the inclusion of covariates. We provide testable implications and present characterizations of choice behavior implied by our identification conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在处理效应异质性下，具有多重处理的两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）所识别的内容。证明了两个条件是2SLS识别每种处理的个体特定效应的正加权和的充分必要条件：平均条件单调性和无交叉效应。我们的识别分析允许任意数量的处理、任意数量的连续或离散工具变量，以及协变量的包含。我们提供了可检验的含义，并给出了由我们的识别条件所隐含的选择行为的特征描述。

records.title_en: Bias in local projections
records.title_cn: 局部投影中的偏差
records.abstract_en: Local projections (LPs) are a popular tool in macroeconomic research. We show that LPs are often used with very small samples in the time dimension and, consequently, that LP point estimates can be severely biased. Under regularity conditions, we derive simple expressions to approximate this bias and propose a way to correct for bias in LPs. Using a medium-scale macroeconomic time-series model, we demonstrate that the bias in point estimates can be economically meaningful. We also show that the same small-sample bias issue can lead some autocorrelation-robust standard errors to understate sampling uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 局部投影（LPs）是宏观经济研究中的一种流行工具。我们表明，LPs常常在时间维度上使用非常小的样本，因此，LP点估计可能存在严重偏差。在正则条件下，我们推导出近似此偏差的简单表达式，并提出一种纠正LPs中偏差的方法。使用一个中等规模的宏观经济时间序列模型，我们证明了点估计中的偏差在经济上可能具有重要意义。我们还表明，同样的小样本偏差问题可能导致某些自相关稳健标准误低估抽样不确定性。

records.title_en: Simultaneously Incomplete and Incoherent (SII) Dynamic LDV Models: With an Application to Financing Constraints and Firms’ Decision to Innovate
records.title_cn: 同时不完整且不一致（SII）的动态LDV模型：应用于融资约束与企业创新决策
records.abstract_en: We develop novel methods for establishing coherency and completeness conditions in Static and Dynamic Limited Dependent Variables (LDV) Models. We characterize the two distinct problems as “empty-region” incoherency and “overlap-region” incoherency or incompleteness and show that the two properties can co-exist. We focus on the class of models that can be Simultaneously Incomplete and Incoherent (SII). We propose estimation strategies based on Conditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation (CMLE) for simultaneous dynamic LDV models without imposing recursivity. Point identification is achieved through sign-restrictions on parameters or other prior assumptions that complete the underlying data process. Using as modelling framework the Panel Bivariate Probit model with State Dependence, we analyse the impact of financing constraints on innovation: ceteris paribus, a firm facing binding finance constraints is substantially less likely to undertake innovation, while the probability that a firm encounters a binding finance constraint more than doubles if the firm is innovative. In addition, a strong role for state dependence in dynamic versions of our models is established.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了新的方法，用于在静态和动态有限因变量（LDV）模型中建立一致性和完整性条件。我们将这两个不同的问题分别描述为“空区域”不一致性和“重叠区域”不一致性或完整性缺失，并表明这两个性质可以共存。我们关注可以同时不完整且不一致（SII）的模型类别。我们提出了基于条件最大似然估计（CMLE）的估计策略，用于同时动态LDV模型，而不施加递归性。点识别通过参数上的符号限制或其他完成底层数据过程的先验假设来实现。使用具有状态依赖的面板双变量Probit模型作为建模框架，我们分析了融资约束对创新的影响：在其他条件相同的情况下，面临约束性融资约束的企业进行创新的可能性显著降低，而如果企业具有创新性，则其遇到约束性融资约束的概率增加一倍以上。此外，在我们的动态模型版本中，状态依赖发挥了重要作用。

records.title_en: Wild bootstrap inference for instrumental variables regressions with weak and few clusters
records.title_cn: 弱聚类和少聚类工具变量回归的野自助推断
records.abstract_en: We study the wild bootstrap inference for instrumental variable regressions under an alternative asymptotic framework that the number of independent clusters is fixed, the size of each cluster diverges to infinity, and the within cluster dependence is sufficiently weak. We first show that the wild bootstrap Wald test controls size asymptotically up to a small error as long as the parameters of endogenous variables are strongly identified in at least one of the clusters. Second, we establish the conditions for the bootstrap tests to have power against local alternatives. We further develop a wild bootstrap Anderson–Rubin test for the full-vector inference and show that it controls size asymptotically even under weak identification in all clusters. We illustrate their good performance using simulations and provide an empirical application to a well-known dataset about US local labor markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在一种替代渐近框架下工具变量回归的野自助推断，该框架中独立聚类的数量固定，每个聚类的大小趋于无穷大，且聚类内的依赖性足够弱。我们首先证明，只要内生变量的参数在至少一个聚类中被强识别，野自助Wald检验在渐近上控制规模，误差较小。其次，我们建立了自助检验对局部备择假设具有功效的条件。我们进一步开发了一种野自助Anderson–Rubin检验，用于全向量推断，并证明即使在所有聚类中弱识别的情况下，它也能在渐近上控制规模。我们通过模拟说明了它们的良好性能，并提供了一个关于美国地方劳动力市场的知名数据集的实证应用。

records.title_en: The validity of bootstrap testing for threshold autoregression
records.title_cn: 阈值自回归的Bootstrap检验有效性
records.abstract_en: We consider bootstrap-based testing for threshold effects in non-linear threshold autoregressive (TAR) models. It is well-known that classic tests based on asymptotic theory tend to be biased in case of small, or even moderate sample sizes, especially when the estimated parameters indicate non-stationarity, or in presence of heteroskedasticity, as often witnessed in the analysis of financial or climate data. To address the issue we propose a supremum Lagrange Multiplier test statistic (sLM), where the null hypothesis specifies a linear autoregressive (AR) model against the alternative of a TAR model. We consider both the classical recursive residual i.i.d. bootstrap (sLMi) and a wild bootstrap (sLMw), applied to the sLM statistic, and establish their validity under the null hypothesis. The framework is new, and requires the proof of non-standard results for bootstrap analysis in time series models; this includes a uniform bootstrap law of large numbers and a bootstrap functional central limit theorem. The Monte Carlo evidence shows that the bootstrap tests have correct empirical size even for small samples; the wild bootstrap version (sLMw) is also robust against the presence of heteroskedasticity. Moreover, there is no loss of empirical power when compared to the asymptotic test and the size of the tests is not affected if the order of the tested model is selected through AIC. Finally, we use our results to analyse the time series of the Greenland ice sheet mass balance. We find a significant threshold effect and an appropriate specification that manages to reproduce the main non-linear features of the series, such as the asymmetric seasonal cycle, the main periodicities, and the multimodality of the probability density function.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑非线性阈值自回归（TAR）模型中阈值效应的基于Bootstrap的检验。众所周知，基于渐近理论的经典检验在小样本甚至中等样本情况下往往有偏，特别是当估计参数表明非平稳性，或存在异方差性时，这在金融或气候数据分析中经常出现。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个上确界拉格朗日乘数检验统计量（sLM），其中原假设指定线性自回归（AR）模型，备择假设为TAR模型。我们考虑将经典递归残差i.i.d. bootstrap（sLMi）和wild bootstrap（sLMw）应用于sLM统计量，并建立它们在原假设下的有效性。该框架是新的，需要证明时间序列模型中bootstrap分析的非标准结果；这包括一致bootstrap大数定律和bootstrap泛函中心极限定理。蒙特卡洛证据表明，即使在小样本下，bootstrap检验也具有正确的经验大小；wild bootstrap版本（sLMw）对异方差性的存在也具有稳健性。此外，与渐近检验相比，经验功效没有损失，并且如果通过AIC选择被检验模型的阶数，检验的大小不受影响。最后，我们使用我们的结果分析格陵兰冰盖质量平衡的时间序列。我们发现显著的阈值效应和适当的设定，能够再现序列的主要非线性特征，如不对称季节循环、主要周期性和概率密度函数的多模态性。

records.title_en: Semiparametrically optimal cointegration test
records.title_cn: 半参数最优协整检验
records.abstract_en: This paper aims to address the issue of semiparametric efficiency for cointegration rank testing in finite-order vector autoregressive models, where the innovation distribution is considered an infinite-dimensional nuisance parameter. Our asymptotic analysis relies on Le Cam’s theory of limit experiment, which in this context is of the Locally Asymptotically Brownian Functional (LABF) type likelihood ratios. By exploiting the structural representation of LABF, an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck experiment, we develop the asymptotic power envelopes of asymptotically invariant tests for both cases with and without time trends. We propose feasible tests based on a nonparametrically estimated density and demonstrate that their power can achieve the semiparametric power envelopes, making them semiparametrically optimal. We validate the theoretical results through large-sample simulations and illustrate satisfactory size control and excellent power performance of our tests under small samples. In both cases with and without time trends, we show that a remarkable amount of additional power can be obtained from non-Gaussian distributions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文旨在解决有限阶向量自回归模型中协整秩检验的半参数效率问题，其中创新分布被视为无限维 nuisance 参数。我们的渐近分析依赖于 Le Cam 的极限实验理论，在此背景下，似然比属于局部渐近布朗函数（LABF）类型。通过利用 LABF 的结构表示，即 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 实验，我们为有趋势和无趋势两种情况开发了渐近不变检验的渐近功效包络。我们提出了基于非参数估计密度的可行检验，并证明其功效可以达到半参数功效包络，从而使其成为半参数最优的。我们通过大样本模拟验证了理论结果，并展示了我们的检验在小样本下具有令人满意的尺寸控制和优异的功效表现。在有趋势和无趋势两种情况下，我们表明从非高斯分布中可以获得显著的额外功效。

records.title_en: Latent utility and permutation invariance: A revealed preference approach
records.title_cn: 潜在效用与置换不变性：一种显示性偏好方法
records.abstract_en: This paper provides partial identification results for latent utility models that satisfy an invariance property on unobservables such as exchangeability. We employ a simple revealed preference argument to “difference out” unobservables, obtaining identifying inequalities for utility indices. We show the differencing argument is also useful for counterfactual analysis. The framework generalizes existing work in discrete choice by allowing latent feasibility sets and by allowing individuals to purchase multiple (possibly continuous) goods. We present a new framework leveraging nesting structures that generalizes nested logit. In a panel setting, we innovate by allowing preferences for variety.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为满足可交换性等不可观测变量不变性属性的潜在效用模型提供了部分识别结果。我们采用简单的显示性偏好论证来“差分掉”不可观测变量，从而获得效用指数的识别不等式。我们证明差分论证对于反事实分析同样有用。该框架通过允许潜在可行集以及允许个体购买多种（可能是连续的）商品，推广了离散选择中的现有工作。我们提出了一个利用嵌套结构的新框架，该框架推广了嵌套logit模型。在面板设定中，我们通过允许对多样性的偏好进行了创新。

records.title_en: Local regression distribution estimators
records.title_cn: 局部回归分布估计量
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the large sample properties of local regression distribution estimators, which include a class of boundary adaptive density estimators as a prime example. First, we establish a pointwise Gaussian large sample distributional approximation in a unified way, allowing for both boundary and interior evaluation points simultaneously. Using this result, we study the asymptotic efficiency of the estimators, and show that a carefully crafted minimum distance implementation based on “redundant” regressors can lead to efficiency gains. Second, we establish uniform linearizations and strong approximations for the estimators, and employ these results to construct valid confidence bands. Third, we develop extensions to weighted distributions with estimated weights and to local L2 estimation. Finally, we illustrate our methods with two applications in program evaluation: counterfactual density testing, and IV specification and heterogeneity density analysis. Companion software packages in Stata and R are available.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了局部回归分布估计量的大样本性质，其中包括一类边界自适应密度估计量作为主要例子。首先，我们以统一的方式建立了逐点高斯大样本分布近似，同时允许边界点和内部评估点。利用这一结果，我们研究了估计量的渐近效率，并表明基于“冗余”回归量的精心设计的最小距离实现可以带来效率提升。其次，我们建立了估计量的均匀线性化和强近似，并利用这些结果构建有效的置信带。第三，我们将扩展应用于具有估计权重的加权分布和局部L2估计。最后，我们通过项目评估中的两个应用来说明我们的方法：反事实密度检验，以及工具变量设定和异质性密度分析。可提供Stata和R语言的配套软件包。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference for high dimensional factor model with regime switching
records.title_cn: 高维因子模型在机制转换下的估计与推断
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes maximum (quasi)likelihood estimation for high dimensional factor models with regime switching in the loadings. The model parameters are estimated jointly by the EM (expectation maximization) algorithm, which in the current context only requires iteratively calculating regime probabilities and principal components of the weighted sample covariance matrix. When regime dynamics are taken into account, smoothed regime probabilities are calculated using a recursive algorithm. Consistency, convergence rates and limit distributions of the estimated loadings and the estimated factors are established under weak cross-sectional and temporal dependence as well as heteroscedasticity. It is worth noting that due to high dimension, regime switching can be identified consistently after the switching point with only one observation period. Simulation results show good performance of the proposed method. An application to the FRED-MD dataset illustrates the potential of the proposed method for detection of business cycle turning points.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了载荷具有机制转换的高维因子模型的最大（拟）似然估计。模型参数通过EM（期望最大化）算法联合估计，在当前背景下，该算法仅需迭代计算机制概率和加权样本协方差矩阵的主成分。当考虑机制动态时，使用递归算法计算平滑机制概率。在弱横截面和时间依赖性以及异方差性下，建立了估计载荷和估计因子的一致性、收敛速率和极限分布。值得注意的是，由于高维性，机制转换在转换点后仅需一个观测周期即可一致识别。模拟结果显示所提方法具有良好的性能。对FRED-MD数据集的应用说明了所提方法在检测商业周期转折点方面的潜力。

records.title_en: Reprint of: The likelihood ratio test for structural changes in factor models
records.title_cn: 转载：因子模型中结构变化的似然比检验
records.abstract_en: A factor model with a break in its factor loadings is observationally equivalent to a model without changes in the loadings but with a change in the variance of its factors. This approach effectively transforms a high-dimensional structural change problem into a low-dimensional problem. This paper considers the likelihood ratio (LR) test for a variance change in the estimated factors. The LR test implicitly explores a special feature of the estimated factors: the pre-break and post-break variances can be a singular matrix under the alternative hypothesis, making the LR test diverging faster and thus more powerful than Wald-type tests. The better power property of the LR test is also confirmed by simulations. We also consider mean changes and multiple breaks. We apply this procedure to the factor modeling of the US employment and study the structural change problem using monthly industry-level data.
records.abstract_cn: 因子载荷存在断点的因子模型在观测上等价于载荷无变化但因子方差发生变化的模型。这种方法有效地将高维结构变化问题转化为低维问题。本文考虑了针对估计因子方差变化的似然比（LR）检验。LR检验隐含地探索了估计因子的一个特殊特征：在备择假设下，断点前和断点后的方差可以是奇异矩阵，这使得LR检验发散更快，因此比Wald型检验更有效。LR检验更好的功效性质也通过模拟得到了证实。我们还考虑了均值变化和多重断点。我们将此程序应用于美国就业的因子建模，并使用月度行业层面数据研究结构变化问题。

records.title_en: Identification and estimation of sequential games of incomplete information with multiple equilibria
records.title_cn: 多重均衡下不完全信息序贯博弈的识别与估计
records.abstract_en: This paper discusses the identification and estimation of game-theoretic models, mainly focusing on sequential games of incomplete information. In most empirical games, researchers cannot observe the exact order of actions played in the game and rely on the assumption of simultaneous actions. My structural modeling generalizes an empirical game to encompass simultaneous and sequential actions as special cases. I specify a sequential game allowing for multiple players in each stage and multiple Perfect Bayesian Nash Equilibria, showing that the structural parameters, including the payoff function parameters, the order of actions, and the equilibrium selection mechanism, are separately identified. The various exclusion restrictions in the finite mixture literature help attain point identification of structural parameters and provide a testable method to verify identification conditions. Next, I consider a Sieve Minimum Distance (SMD) estimator of Ai and Chen (2003) for the structural parameters and verify its asymptotic properties. The Monte Carlo simulations evaluate the performance of the proposed estimator and provide numerical evidence of potential bias under the misspecified order of actions. The empirical application of Walmart and Kmart’s entry game demonstrates that retailers compete sequentially in a significant portion of markets.
records.abstract_cn: 本文讨论了博弈论模型的识别与估计，主要关注不完全信息的序贯博弈。在大多数实证博弈中，研究者无法观察到博弈中行动的确切顺序，并依赖于同时行动的假设。我的结构建模将实证博弈推广为涵盖同时行动和序贯行动作为特例。我指定了一个允许每个阶段有多个参与者和多个完美贝叶斯纳什均衡的序贯博弈，表明结构参数，包括支付函数参数、行动顺序和均衡选择机制，是分别识别的。有限混合文献中的各种排除限制有助于实现结构参数的点识别，并提供了一种可检验的方法来验证识别条件。接下来，我考虑了Ai和Chen（2003）的结构参数筛最小距离（SMD）估计量，并验证了其渐近性质。蒙特卡洛模拟评估了所提出估计量的性能，并提供了在错误指定行动顺序下潜在偏差的数值证据。沃尔玛和凯马特的进入博弈的实证应用表明，零售商在相当一部分市场中是序贯竞争的。

records.title_en: A simple specification test for models with many conditional moment inequalities
records.title_cn: 具有许多条件矩不等式的模型的简单设定检验
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a simple specification test for partially identified models with a large or possibly uncountably infinite number of conditional moment (in)equalities. The approach is valid under weak assumptions, allowing for both weak identification and non-differentiable moment conditions. Computational simplifications are obtained by reusing certain expensive-to-compute components of the test statistic when constructing the critical values. Because of the weak assumptions, the procedure faces a new set of interesting theoretical issues which we show can be addressed by an unconventional sample-splitting procedure that runs multiple tests of the same null hypothesis. The resulting specification test controls size uniformly over a large class of data generating processes, has power tending to 1 for fixed alternatives, and has power against certain local alternatives which we characterize. Finally, the testing procedure is demonstrated in three simulation exercises.
records.abstract_cn: 本文针对具有大量或可能不可数无限多个条件矩（不）等式的部分识别模型，提出了一种简单的设定检验。该方法在弱假设下有效，允许弱识别和非可微矩条件。通过在建临界值时重用检验统计量中某些计算成本高昂的组成部分，获得了计算简化。由于弱假设，该过程面临一系列新的有趣理论问题，我们表明可以通过一种非常规的样本分割程序来解决这些问题，该程序对相同的原假设进行多次检验。由此产生的设定检验在广泛的数据生成过程类别上均匀控制大小，对固定备择假设的功效趋于1，并且对某些我们表征的局部备择假设具有功效。最后，该检验程序在三个模拟练习中得到了演示。

records.title_en: Volatility of volatility and leverage effect from options
records.title_cn: 期权的波动率的波动率与杠杆效应
records.abstract_en: We propose model-free (nonparametric) estimators of the volatility of volatility and leverage effect using high-frequency observations of short-dated options. At each point in time, we integrate available options into estimates of the conditional characteristic function of the price increment until the options’ expiration and we use these estimates to recover spot volatility. Our volatility of volatility estimator is then formed from the sample variance and first-order autocovariance of the spot volatility increments, with the latter correcting for the bias in the former due to option observation errors. The leverage effect estimator is the sample covariance between price increments and the estimated volatility increments. The rate of convergence of the estimators depends on the diffusive innovations in the latent volatility process as well as on the observation error in the options with strikes in the vicinity of the current spot price. Feasible inference is developed in a way that does not require prior knowledge of the source of estimation error that is asymptotically dominating.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了利用短期期权的高频观测数据对波动率的波动率和杠杆效应进行无模型（非参数）估计的方法。在每个时间点，我们将可获得的期权整合到对直至期权到期日的价格增量的条件特征函数的估计中，并利用这些估计来恢复现货波动率。然后，我们的波动率的波动率估计量由现货波动率增量的样本方差和一阶自协方差构成，后者用于校正前者因期权观测误差而产生的偏差。杠杆效应估计量是价格增量与估计的波动率增量之间的样本协方差。估计量的收敛速度取决于潜在波动率过程中的扩散创新以及当前现货价格附近执行价的期权中的观测误差。可行推断的开发方式不需要事先了解渐近占主导的估计误差来源。

records.title_en: Optimal nonparametric range-based volatility estimation
records.title_cn: 最优非参数基于区间的波动率估计
records.abstract_en: We present a general framework for optimal nonparametric spot volatility estimation based on intraday range data, comprised of the first, highest, lowest, and last price over a given time-interval. We rely on a decision-theoretic approach together with a coupling-type argument to directly tailor the form of the nonparametric estimator to the specific volatility measure of interest and relevant loss function. The resulting new optimal estimators offer substantial efficiency gains compared to existing commonly used range-based procedures.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个基于日内区间数据（包括给定时间间隔内的首个价格、最高价、最低价和最后价格）进行最优非参数瞬时波动率估计的一般框架。我们采用决策理论方法并结合耦合型论证，直接针对感兴趣的特定波动率度量和相关损失函数来定制非参数估计量的形式。由此产生的新最优估计量相比现有常用的基于区间的程序，提供了显著的效率提升。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference of seller’s expected revenue in first-price auctions
records.title_cn: 第一价格拍卖中卖方预期收益的估计与推断
records.abstract_en: I propose an estimator for the seller’s expected revenue function in a first-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values and symmetric bidders, who can exhibit constant relative risk aversion and bid according to the Bayesian Nash equilibrium. I build the proposed estimator from pseudo-private values, which can be estimated from observed bids, and show that it is pointwise and uniformly consistent: the corresponding optimal nonparametric rates of convergence can be achieved. Then I construct asymptotically valid confidence intervals and uniform confidence bands. Suggestions for critical values are based on first-order asymptotics, as well as on the bootstrap method.
records.abstract_cn: 我提出了一种在第一价格密封投标拍卖中卖方预期收益函数的估计量，该拍卖具有独立私人价值和对称投标人，投标人可以表现出常数相对风险厌恶，并根据贝叶斯纳什均衡进行投标。我从伪私人价值构建所提出的估计量，这些伪私人价值可以从观察到的投标中估计出来，并证明它是一致的点态和一致一致：可以实现相应的最优非参数收敛速率。然后我构造了渐近有效的置信区间和一致置信带。临界值的建议基于一阶渐近性以及自举方法。

records.title_en: Modelling circular time series
records.title_cn: 循环时间序列建模
records.abstract_en: Circular variables often play an important role in the construction of models for analysing and forecasting the consequences of climate change and its impact on the environment. Such variables pose special problems for time series modelling. This article shows how the score-driven approach, developed primarily in econometrics, provides a natural solution to the difficulties and leads to a coherent and unified methodology for estimation, model selection and testing. The new methods are illustrated with data on wind direction.
records.abstract_cn: 循环变量在构建用于分析和预测气候变化后果及其对环境影响的模型中往往扮演重要角色。这类变量给时间序列建模带来了特殊问题。本文展示了主要发展于计量经济学中的得分驱动方法如何为这些困难提供自然解决方案，并引向一种连贯统一的方法论，用于估计、模型选择和检验。新方法以风向数据为例进行说明。

records.title_en: Change-point analysis of time series with evolutionary spectra
records.title_cn: 具有演化谱的时间序列的变点分析
records.abstract_en: This paper develops change-point methods for the spectrum of a locally stationary time series. We focus on series with a bounded spectral density that change smoothly under the null hypothesis but exhibits change-points or becomes less smooth under the alternative. We address two local problems. The first is the detection of discontinuities (or breaks) in the spectrum at unknown dates and frequencies. The second involves abrupt yet continuous changes in the spectrum over a short time period at an unknown frequency without signifying a break. Both problems can be cast into changes in the degree of smoothness of the spectral density over time. We consider estimation and minimax-optimal testing. We determine the optimal rate for the minimax distinguishable boundary, i.e., the minimum break magnitude such that we are able to uniformly control type I and type II errors. We propose a novel procedure for the estimation of the change-points based on a wild sequential top-down algorithm and show its consistency under shrinking shifts and possibly growing number of change-points.
records.abstract_cn: 本文发展了局部平稳时间序列谱的变点方法。我们关注具有有界谱密度的序列，在原假设下这些序列平滑变化，但在备择假设下表现出变点或变得不那么平滑。我们处理两个局部问题。第一个是在未知日期和频率下检测谱中的不连续性（或断点）。第二个涉及在未知频率下短时间内谱的突然但连续的变化，而不表示断点。这两个问题都可以归结为谱密度随时间平滑程度的变化。我们考虑估计和极小极大最优检验。我们确定了极小极大可区分边界的最优速率，即能够统一控制第一类和第二类错误的最小断点幅度。我们提出了一种基于野生顺序自顶向下算法的新程序来估计变点，并证明了其在收缩偏移和可能增加的变点数量下的一致性。

records.title_en: Testing for sparse idiosyncratic components in factor-augmented regression models
records.title_cn: 因子增强回归模型中稀疏特质成分的检验
records.abstract_en: We propose a novel bootstrap test of a dense model, namely factor regression, against a sparse plus dense alternative model augmented with sparse idiosyncratic components. The asymptotic properties of the test are established under time series dependence and polynomial tails. We outline a data-driven rule to select the tuning parameter and prove its theoretical validity. In simulation experiments, our procedure exhibits high power against sparse alternatives and low power against dense deviations from the null. Moreover, we apply our test to various datasets in macroeconomics and finance and often reject the null. This suggests the presence of sparsity — on top of a dense component — in commonly studied economic applications. The R package ‘FAS’ implements our approach.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的bootstrap检验，用于检验密集模型（即因子回归）相对于带有稀疏特质成分的稀疏加密集替代模型。在时间序列依赖和多项式尾部条件下，我们建立了该检验的渐近性质。我们概述了一种数据驱动规则来选择调整参数，并证明了其理论有效性。在模拟实验中，我们的方法对稀疏替代方案表现出高功效，而对密集偏离原假设的情况表现出低功效。此外，我们将我们的检验应用于宏观经济学和金融学的各种数据集，并经常拒绝原假设。这表明在常见的经济应用中，除了密集成分之外，还存在稀疏性。R包‘FAS’实现了我们的方法。

records.title_en: Testing and relaxing the exclusion restriction in the control function approach
records.title_cn: 控制函数方法中排除性约束的检验与放松
records.abstract_en: The control function approach which employs an instrumental variable excluded from the outcome equation is a very common solution to deal with the problem of endogeneity in nonseparable models. Exclusion restrictions, however, are frequently controversial. We first argue that, in a nonparametric triangular structure typical of the control function literature, one can actually test this exclusion restriction provided the instrument satisfies a local irrelevance condition. Second, we investigate identification without such exclusion restrictions, i.e., if the “instrument” that is independent of the unobservables in the outcome equation also directly affects the outcome variable. In particular, we show that identification of average causal effects can be achieved in the two most common special cases of the general nonseparable model: linear random coefficients models and single index models.
records.abstract_cn: 控制函数方法采用一个从结果方程中排除的工具变量，是处理不可分离模型中内生性问题的非常常见的解决方案。然而，排除性约束经常存在争议。我们首先论证，在控制函数文献中典型的非参数三角结构中，如果工具变量满足局部无关条件，实际上可以检验这一排除性约束。其次，我们研究在没有此类排除性约束的情况下的识别问题，即如果与结果方程中不可观测因素独立的“工具变量”也直接影响结果变量。特别地，我们表明，在一般不可分离模型的两个最常见的特例中，即线性随机系数模型和单指数模型中，可以实现平均因果效应的识别。

records.title_en: Robust inference of panel data models with interactive fixed effects under long memory: A frequency domain approach
records.title_cn: 长记忆下具有交互固定效应的面板数据模型的稳健推断：一种频域方法
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a linear panel data model with interactive fixed effects wherein regressors, factors and idiosyncratic error terms are all stationary but with potential long memory. The setup involves a new formulation of panel data models, where weakly dependent regressors, factors and idiosyncratic errors are embedded as a special case. Standard methods based on principal component decomposition and least squares estimation, as in Bai (2009), are found to be biased and distorted in inference. To cope with this failure and to provide a simple implementable estimation procedure, a frequency domain least squares estimation is proposed. The limit distribution of the frequency domain estimator is established and a self-normalized approach to inference without the need for plug-in estimation of memory parameters is developed. Simulations show that the frequency domain estimator performs robustly under short memory and outperforms the time domain estimator when long range dependence is present. An empirical illustration is provided, examining the long-run relationship between stock returns and realized volatility.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个具有交互固定效应的线性面板数据模型，其中回归变量、因子和异质性误差项均为平稳但可能具有长记忆。该设定涉及面板数据模型的一种新形式，其中弱依赖的回归变量、因子和异质性误差作为特例被包含在内。基于主成分分解和最小二乘估计的标准方法（如Bai（2009））在推断中表现出偏差和失真。为应对这一失败并提供一种简单可行的估计程序，本文提出了一种频域最小二乘估计。建立了频域估计量的极限分布，并发展了一种无需插入估计记忆参数的自归一化推断方法。模拟表明，频域估计量在短记忆下表现稳健，并在存在长程依赖时优于时域估计量。本文提供了一个实证示例，检验股票收益与已实现波动率之间的长期关系。

records.title_en: Reprint of: Out-of-sample tests for conditional quantile coverage: An application to Growth-at-Risk
records.title_cn: 重印：条件分位数覆盖率的样本外检验——在增长风险中的应用
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes tests for out-of-sample comparisons of interval forecasts based on parametric conditional quantile models. The tests rank the distance between actual and nominal conditional coverage with respect to the set of conditioning variables from all models, for a given loss function. We propose a pairwise test to compare two models for a single predictive interval. The set-up is then extended to a comparison across multiple models and/or intervals. The limiting distribution varies depending on whether models are strictly non-nested or overlapping. In the latter case, degeneracy may occur. We establish the asymptotic validity of wild bootstrap based critical values across all cases. An empirical application to Growth-at-Risk (GaR) uncovers situations in which a richer set of financial indicators are found to outperform a commonly-used benchmark model when predicting downside risk to economic activity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了基于参数条件分位数模型的区间预测样本外比较检验。这些检验针对给定的损失函数，根据所有模型的条件变量集，对实际条件覆盖率与名义条件覆盖率之间的距离进行排序。我们提出了一种成对检验，用于比较两个模型的单一预测区间。该设置随后扩展到多个模型和/或区间的比较。极限分布根据模型是严格非嵌套还是重叠而有所不同。在后一种情况下，可能出现退化。我们建立了野生自助法临界值在所有情况下的渐近有效性。对增长风险（GaR）的实证应用揭示了在某些情况下，更丰富的金融指标集在预测经济活动下行风险时优于常用基准模型。

records.title_en: Unconditional effects of general policy interventions
records.title_cn: 一般政策干预的无条件效应
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the unconditional effects of a general policy intervention, which includes location-scale shifts and simultaneous shifts as special cases. The location-scale shift is intended to study a counterfactual policy aimed at changing not only the mean or location of a covariate but also its dispersion or scale. The simultaneous shift refers to the situation where shifts in two or more covariates take place simultaneously. For example, a shift in one covariate is compensated at a certain rate by a shift in another covariate. Not accounting for these possible scale or simultaneous shifts will result in an incorrect assessment of the potential policy effects on an outcome variable of interest. The unconditional policy parameters are estimated with simple semiparametric estimators, for which asymptotic properties are studied. Monte Carlo simulations are implemented to study their finite sample performances. The proposed approach is applied to a Mincer equation to study the effects of changing years of education on wages and to study the effect of smoking during pregnancy on birth weight.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一般政策干预的无条件效应，该干预包括位置-尺度平移和同时平移作为特例。位置-尺度平移旨在研究旨在不仅改变协变量的均值或位置，还改变其离散度或尺度的反事实政策。同时平移指的是两个或多个协变量的平移同时发生的情况。例如，一个协变量的平移以一定比率由另一个协变量的平移所补偿。不考虑这些可能的尺度或同时平移将导致对感兴趣的结果变量的潜在政策效应的错误评估。无条件政策参数用简单的半参数估计量估计，并研究了其渐近性质。进行了蒙特卡洛模拟以研究其有限样本性能。所提出的方法应用于明瑟方程，以研究教育年限变化对工资的影响，并研究怀孕期间吸烟对出生体重的影响。

records.title_en: Maximum likelihood estimation of a spatial autoregressive model for origin–destination flow variables
records.title_cn: 起点-终点流量变量空间自回归模型的最大似然估计
records.abstract_en: We introduce a spatial autoregressive hurdle model for nonnegative origin–destination flows yN,ij. The model incorporates a hurdle formulation to elucidate the different data-generating processes for zero and positive flows. Our model specifies three types of spatial influences on flow yN,ij that quantify the impact of third-party characteristics on the flow yN,ij: (i) the effect of outflows from origin j, (ii) the effect of inflows to destination i, and (iii) the effect of flows among third-party units. We account for two-way fixed effects in the model to capture the inherent characteristics of both origins and destinations. We employ maximum likelihood estimation to estimate the model parameters. To address statistical inference issues, we analyze the asymptotic properties of the ML estimator using the spatial near-epoch dependence concept. We confirm the presence of an asymptotic bias that arises from the fixed effects, whose dimensions grow with the sample size. Applying our model to migration flows among U.S. states, we estimate significant spatial influences, particularly from inflows to destinations and outflows from origins. Our findings support the notion that zero and positive flow formations are distinct. Consequently, our proposed model outperforms the spatial autoregressive Tobit specification for origin–destination flows, thus providing a better fit to the data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个针对非负起点-终点流量yN,ij的空间自回归障碍模型。该模型采用障碍公式来阐明零流量和正流量的不同数据生成过程。我们的模型指定了三种对流量yN,ij的空间影响类型，用以量化第三方特征对流量yN,ij的影响：(i) 来自起点j的流出效应，(ii) 流向目的地i的流入效应，以及(iii) 第三方单位之间的流动效应。我们在模型中考虑了双向固定效应，以捕捉起点和目的地的固有特征。我们采用最大似然估计来估计模型参数。为了解决统计推断问题，我们使用空间近邻依赖概念分析了ML估计量的渐近性质。我们确认了由固定效应引起的渐近偏差的存在，其维度随样本量增长。将我们的模型应用于美国各州之间的迁移流量，我们估计出显著的空间影响，特别是来自目的地的流入和起点的流出。我们的发现支持零流量和正流量形成是不同的这一观点。因此，我们提出的模型优于起点-终点流量的空间自回归Tobit规范，从而更好地拟合了数据。

records.title_en: Identification of a rational inattention discrete choice model
records.title_cn: 理性疏忽离散选择模型的识别
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the non-parametric identification and estimation of an empirical rational inattention discrete choice model. Decision-makers do not observe their realized utility perfectly but can obtain a costly signal to inform them about the utility. This model nests the standard discrete choice model as a special case. We characterize the identified set of decision-makers’ prior beliefs based on cross-sectional market-level choice probabilities. We show that the standard discrete choice model is always observationally equivalent to some rational inattention discrete choice models with costly information. We then characterize the moment conditions that can be used to estimate the model parameters. When an exogenous variation of the choice set is available, we show that we can distinguish the standard discrete choice model from the rational inattention discrete choice model with costly information. We apply the model to study the Fox News effect on the 2000 U.S. presidential election. We compare the voters’ prior beliefs with and without the Fox News influence. The result shows that the presence of Fox News has heterogeneous effects for voters with different educational backgrounds.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了经验理性疏忽离散选择模型的非参数识别与估计。决策者无法完美观察其已实现效用，但可以通过获取成本信号来了解其效用。该模型将标准离散选择模型作为特例包含在内。我们基于横截面市场层面的选择概率刻画了决策者先验信念的识别集。我们表明，标准离散选择模型总是与某些具有成本信息的理性疏忽离散选择模型在观测上等价。然后，我们刻画了可用于估计模型参数的矩条件。当选择集存在外生变化时，我们表明可以区分标准离散选择模型与具有成本信息的理性疏忽离散选择模型。我们将该模型应用于研究福克斯新闻对2000年美国总统选举的影响。我们比较了有和没有福克斯新闻影响时选民的先验信念。结果表明，福克斯新闻的存在对不同教育背景的选民具有异质性影响。

records.title_en: Local linearization based subvector inference in moment inequality models
records.title_cn: 矩不等式模型中基于局部线性化的子向量推断
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a bootstrap-based profiling inference method for subvectors in moment inequality models following insights from Bugni et al. (2017). Compared to their paper, the new method calculates the critical value by searching over a local neighborhood of a pre-estimator, instead of the whole null parameter space, to profile out nuisance parameters. In this way, non-linear moment conditions are simplified by linear expansion and the bootstrap iterates over quadratic programming problems, which significantly simplifies and accelerates computation. This method controls asymptotic size uniformly over a large class of data generating processes. In the Monte Carlo simulations, the new procedure improves upon the computing time of Bugni et al. (2017) and Kaido et al. (2019) significantly. I provide an empirical illustration estimating an airline entry game.
records.abstract_cn: 本文借鉴Bugni等人（2017）的见解，提出了一种基于自助法的剖面推断方法，用于矩不等式模型中的子向量。与他们的论文相比，新方法通过在一个预估计量的局部邻域内搜索临界值，而非整个零参数空间，来剖面化处理多余参数。这样，非线性矩条件通过线性展开简化，自助法迭代求解二次规划问题，显著简化并加速了计算。该方法在一大类数据生成过程上均匀控制渐近大小。在蒙特卡洛模拟中，新程序显著改善了Bugni等人（2017）和Kaido等人（2019）的计算时间。我提供了一个估计航空公司进入博弈的实证说明。

records.title_en: A vector monotonicity assumption for multiple instruments
records.title_cn: 多工具变量的向量单调性假设
records.abstract_en: When a researcher combines multiple instrumental variables for a single binary treatment, the monotonicity assumption of the local average treatment effects (LATE) framework can become restrictive: it requires that all units share a common direction of response even when separate instruments are shifted in opposing directions. What I call vector monotonicity, by contrast, simply assumes treatment uptake to be monotonic in all instruments. I characterize the class of causal parameters that are point identified under vector monotonicity, when the instruments are binary. This class includes, for example, the average treatment effect among units that are in any way responsive to the collection of instruments, or those that are responsive to a given subset of them. The identification results are constructive and yield a simple estimator for the identified treatment effect parameters. An empirical application revisits the labor market returns to college.
records.abstract_cn: 当研究者将多个工具变量合并用于单一二元处理时，局部平均处理效应（LATE）框架的单调性假设可能变得具有限制性：它要求所有单元在即使不同工具变量向相反方向变动时也共享共同的反应方向。相比之下，我所称的向量单调性仅假设处理采纳在所有工具变量上是单调的。我刻画了在向量单调性下，当工具变量为二元时，点识别的因果参数类别。该类别包括，例如，对工具变量集合以任何方式响应的单元的平均处理效应，或对给定子集响应的单元的平均处理效应。识别结果是构造性的，并为识别的处理效应参数提供了一个简单估计量。一个实证应用重新审视了大学教育的劳动力市场回报。

records.title_en: Common volatility shocks driven by the global carbon transition
records.title_cn: 全球碳转型驱动的共同波动冲击
records.abstract_en: We propose a novel approach to measure the global effects of climate change news on financial markets. For that purpose, we first calculate the global common volatility of the oil and gas industry. Then we project it on climate-related shocks constructed using text-based proxies of climate change news. We show that rising concerns about the energy transition make oil and gas share prices move at the global scale, controlling for shocks to the oil price, US and world stock markets. Despite the clear exposure of oil and gas companies to carbon transition risk, not all geoclimatic shocks are alike. The signs and magnitudes of the impacts differ across climate risk drivers. Regarding sentiment, climate change news tends to create turmoil only when the news is negative. Moreover, the adverse effect is amplified by oil price movements but weakened by stock market shocks. Finally, our findings point out climate news materialises when it reaches the global scale, supporting the relevance of modelling geoclimatic volatility.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法来衡量气候变化新闻对金融市场的全球影响。为此，我们首先计算石油和天然气行业的全球共同波动性。然后，我们将其投影到基于气候变化新闻的文本代理构建的气候相关冲击上。我们表明，在控制油价、美国和全球股市冲击的情况下，对能源转型日益增长的担忧使得石油和天然气股价在全球范围内波动。尽管石油和天然气公司明显面临碳转型风险，但并非所有地理气候冲击都是相同的。影响的符号和幅度因气候风险驱动因素而异。关于情绪，气候变化新闻往往只在负面新闻时引发动荡。此外，不利影响被油价变动放大，但被股市冲击削弱。最后，我们的研究结果表明，气候新闻在全球范围内实现时才会具体化，支持了建模地理气候波动性的相关性。

records.title_en: Empirical risk minimization for time series: Nonparametric performance bounds for prediction
records.title_cn: 时间序列的经验风险最小化：预测的非参数性能界
records.abstract_en: Empirical risk minimization is a standard principle for choosing algorithms in learning theory. In this paper we study the properties of empirical risk minimization for time series. The analysis is carried out in a general framework that covers different types of forecasting applications encountered in the literature. We are concerned with 1-step-ahead prediction of a univariate time series belonging to a class of location-scale parameter-driven processes. A class of recursive algorithms is available to forecast the time series. The algorithms are recursive in the sense that the forecast produced in a given period is a function of the lagged values of the forecast and of the time series. The relationship between the generating mechanism of the time series and the class of algorithms is not specified. Our main result establishes that the algorithm chosen by empirical risk minimization achieves asymptotically the optimal predictive performance that is attainable within the class of algorithms.
records.abstract_cn: 经验风险最小化是学习理论中选择算法的标准原则。本文研究了时间序列经验风险最小化的性质。分析在一个涵盖文献中遇到的不同类型预测应用的通用框架内进行。我们关注属于一类位置-尺度参数驱动过程的单变量时间序列的1步超前预测。有一类递归算法可用于预测该时间序列。这些算法是递归的，因为在给定时期产生的预测是预测滞后值和时间序列的函数。时间序列的生成机制与算法类别之间的关系未被指定。我们的主要结果表明，由经验风险最小化选择的算法渐近地达到了算法类别内可达到的最优预测性能。

records.title_en: Using Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks for the design of Monte Carlo simulations
records.title_cn: 使用Wasserstein生成对抗网络设计蒙特卡洛模拟
records.abstract_en: When researchers develop new econometric methods it is common practice to compare the performance of the new methods to those of existing methods in Monte Carlo studies. The credibility of such Monte Carlo studies is often limited because of the discretion the researcher has in choosing the Monte Carlo designs reported. To improve the credibility we propose using a class of generative models that has recently been developed in the machine learning literature, termed Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) which can be used to systematically generate artificial data that closely mimics existing datasets. Thus, in combination with existing real data sets, GANs can be used to limit the degrees of freedom in Monte Carlo study designs for the researcher, making any comparisons more convincing. In addition, if an applied researcher is concerned with the performance of a particular statistical method on a specific data set (beyond its theoretical properties in large samples), she can use such GANs to assess the performance of the proposed method, e.g. the coverage rate of confidence intervals or the bias of the estimator, using simulated data which closely resembles the exact setting of interest. To illustrate these methods we apply Wasserstein GANs (WGANs) to the estimation of average treatment effects. In this example, we find that (i) there is not a single estimator that outperforms the others in all three settings, so researchers should tailor their analytic approach to a given setting, (ii) systematic simulation studies can be helpful for selecting among competing methods in this situation, and (iii) the generated data closely resemble the actual data.
records.abstract_cn: 当研究人员开发新的计量经济学方法时，通常的做法是在蒙特卡洛研究中将新方法的性能与现有方法进行比较。由于研究人员在选择所报告的蒙特卡洛设计时具有自由裁量权，此类蒙特卡洛研究的可信度往往受到限制。为了提高可信度，我们提出使用一类最近在机器学习文献中开发的生成模型，称为生成对抗网络（GANs），它可以系统地生成与现有数据集非常相似的人工数据。因此，结合现有的真实数据集，GANs可用于限制研究人员在蒙特卡洛研究设计中的自由度，使任何比较更具说服力。此外，如果应用研究人员关注特定统计方法在特定数据集上的表现（超越其在大样本中的理论性质），她可以使用此类GANs来评估所提出方法的性能，例如置信区间的覆盖率或估计量的偏差，使用与感兴趣的确切设置非常相似的模拟数据。为了说明这些方法，我们将Wasserstein GANs（WGANs）应用于平均处理效应的估计。在这个例子中，我们发现（i）在所有三种设置中，没有一种估计器能优于其他估计器，因此研究人员应根据给定设置调整其分析方法，（ii）在这种情况下，系统模拟研究有助于在竞争方法中进行选择，（iii）生成的数据与实际数据非常相似。

records.title_en: The local to unity dynamic Tobit model
records.title_cn: 局部单位根动态Tobit模型
records.abstract_en: This paper considers highly persistent time series that are subject to nonlinearities in the form of censoring or an occasionally binding constraint, such as are regularly encountered in macroeconomics. A tractable candidate model for such series is the dynamic Tobit with a root local to unity. We show that this model generates a process that converges weakly to a non-standard limiting process, that is constrained (regulated) to be positive. Surprisingly, despite the presence of censoring, the OLS estimators of the model parameters are consistent. We show that this allows OLS-based inferences to be drawn on the overall persistence of the process (as measured by the sum of the autoregressive coefficients), and for the null of a unit root to be tested in the presence of censoring. Our simulations illustrate that the conventional ADF test substantially over-rejects when the data is generated by a dynamic Tobit with a unit root, whereas our proposed test is correctly sized. We provide an application of our methods to testing for a unit root in the Swiss franc/euro exchange rate, during a period when this was subject to an occasionally binding lower bound.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了高度持久的时间序列，这些序列受到审查或偶尔约束形式的非线性影响，例如在宏观经济学中经常遇到的情况。对于此类序列，一个易于处理的候选模型是根局部单位根的动态Tobit模型。我们证明该模型生成的过程弱收敛于一个非标准极限过程，该过程被约束（调节）为正值。令人惊讶的是，尽管存在审查，模型参数的OLS估计量是一致的。我们表明，这使得基于OLS的推断可以用于过程的整体持久性（以自回归系数之和衡量），并且可以在存在审查的情况下检验单位根的原假设。我们的模拟表明，当数据由具有单位根的动态Tobit模型生成时，传统的ADF检验显著过度拒绝，而我们提出的检验具有正确的检验水平。我们将我们的方法应用于瑞士法郎/欧元汇率在受到偶尔约束下限期间的单位根检验。

records.title_en: Vector autoregressions with dynamic factor coefficients and conditionally heteroskedastic errors
records.title_cn: 具有动态因子系数和条件异方差误差的向量自回归
records.abstract_en: We introduce a new and general methodology for analyzing vector autoregressive models with time-varying coefficient matrices and conditionally heteroskedastic disturbances. The proposed approach is transparent and simple to implement. It allows the derivation of well-defined impulse response functions that rely on the overall stability of the system. We present the finite sample properties of the model in a simulation study. In an empirical illustration we investigate the possibly time-varying relationships between U.S. industrial production, inflation, and bond spread. We empirically identify a time-varying linkage between economic and financial variables which are effectively described by a common dynamic factor. The impulse response analysis identifies substantial differences in the effects of financial shocks on output and inflation during crisis and non-crisis periods. The results also illustrate how the widely-used approach of fixing the VAR coefficients in the derivation of the impulse responses leads to a sizeable underestimation of the impact of a financial shock on output and inflation during some of the crises in our sample.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种新的通用方法，用于分析具有时变系数矩阵和条件异方差扰动的向量自回归模型。所提出的方法透明且易于实施。它允许推导出依赖于系统整体稳定性的定义良好的脉冲响应函数。我们在模拟研究中展示了模型的有限样本性质。在一个实证示例中，我们调查了美国工业生产、通货膨胀和债券利差之间可能存在的时变关系。我们实证识别出经济变量与金融变量之间的时变联系，这些联系有效地由一个共同的动态因子描述。脉冲响应分析识别出在危机和非危机时期，金融冲击对产出和通货膨胀的影响存在显著差异。结果还说明了广泛使用的在推导脉冲响应时固定VAR系数的方法，如何导致在我们样本中的某些危机期间，金融冲击对产出和通货膨胀的影响被大幅低估。

records.title_en: Role models and revealed gender-specific costs of STEM in an extended Roy model of major choice
records.title_cn: 角色模型与扩展罗伊模型下专业选择中揭示的STEM性别特定成本
records.abstract_en: We derive sharp bounds on the non consumption utility component in an extended Roy model of sector selection. We interpret this non consumption utility component as a compensating wage differential. The bounds are derived under the assumption that potential utilities in each sector are (jointly) stochastically monotone with respect to an observed selection shifter. The research is motivated by the analysis of women’s choice of university major, their under representation in mathematics intensive fields, and the impact of role models on choices and outcomes. To illustrate our methodology, we investigate the cost of STEM fields with data from a German graduate survey, and using the mother’s education level and the proportion of women on the STEM faculty at the time of major choice as selection shifters.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个扩展的罗伊部门选择模型中推导出非消费效用成分的尖锐边界。我们将这一非消费效用成分解释为补偿性工资差异。这些边界是在假设每个部门的潜在效用相对于观察到的选择转移变量（联合）随机单调的情况下推导出来的。该研究受到女性大学专业选择、在数学密集型领域代表性不足以及角色模型对选择和结果影响的动机驱动。为说明我们的方法，我们使用德国毕业生调查数据，并以母亲的教育水平和专业选择时STEM学院女性比例作为选择转移变量，调查STEM领域的成本。

records.title_en: On the performance of the Neyman Allocation with small pilots
records.title_cn: 关于小规模预试验下Neyman分配的绩效研究
records.abstract_en: The Neyman Allocation is used in many papers on experimental design, which typically assume that researchers have access to large pilot studies. This may be unrealistic. To understand the properties of the Neyman Allocation with small pilots, we study its behavior in an asymptotic framework that takes pilot size to be fixed even as the size of the main wave tends to infinity. Our analysis shows that the Neyman Allocation can lead to estimates of the ATE with higher asymptotic variance than with (non-adaptive) balanced randomization. In particular, this happens when the outcome variable is relatively homoskedastic with respect to treatment status or when it exhibits high kurtosis. We provide a series of empirical examples showing that such situations can arise in practice. Our results suggest that researchers with small pilots should not use the Neyman Allocation if they believe that outcomes are homoskedastic or heavy-tailed. Finally, we examine some potential methods for improving the finite sample performance of the FNA via simulations.
records.abstract_cn: Neyman分配在众多实验设计论文中被使用，这些论文通常假设研究者能够获得大规模的预试验。这可能并不现实。为了理解小规模预试验下Neyman分配的性质，我们在一个渐近框架下研究其行为，该框架将预试验规模视为固定，即使主波次规模趋于无穷大。我们的分析表明，Neyman分配可能导致ATE估计的渐近方差高于（非自适应的）平衡随机化。特别是，当结果变量相对于处理状态相对同方差或表现出高峰度时，这种情况会发生。我们提供了一系列实证例子，表明这种情况在实践中可能出现。我们的结果表明，如果研究者认为结果是同方差或重尾的，那么拥有小规模预试验的研究者不应使用Neyman分配。最后，我们通过模拟检验了一些可能改善FNA有限样本性能的方法。

records.title_en: Time-varying multivariate causal processes
records.title_cn: 时变多元因果过程
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider a wide class of time-varying multivariate causal processes that nests many classical and new examples as special cases. We first show the existence of a weakly dependent stationary approximation to initiate our theoretical investigation. We then consider a quasi-maximum likelihood estimation (QMLE), and provide both point-wise and uniform inferences to coefficient functions of interest. The theoretical findings are further examined through extensive simulations. Finally, we show empirical relevance of our study by evaluating both temporal and contemporaneous connectedness between the stock markets of China and U.S.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考虑了一类广泛的时变多元因果过程，该过程将许多经典和新颖的例子作为特例包含在内。我们首先证明了弱依赖平稳近似的存在性，以启动我们的理论研究。然后，我们考虑拟极大似然估计（QMLE），并为感兴趣的系数函数提供逐点和一致推断。理论发现通过广泛的模拟进一步检验。最后，我们通过评估中国和美国股票市场之间的时间与同期连通性，展示了我们研究的实证相关性。

records.title_en: Binary choice with misclassification and social interactions, with an application to peer effects in attitude
records.title_cn: 带有误分类和社会互动的二元选择模型：在态度同伴效应中的应用
records.abstract_en: The interaction of economic agents is one of the most important elements in economic analyses. Social interactions on subjective outcomes, behavior, or decisions, are inherently difficult to identify and estimate because these variables are prone to misclassification errors. This paper puts forth a binary choice model with misclassification and social interactions to rectify the misclassification problems in social interactions studies. We achieve the identification of the conditional choice probability of the latent dependent variable by the technique of repeated measurements and a monotonicity condition. We construct the complete likelihood function from the two repeated measurements and propose a nested pseudo likelihood algorithm for estimation. Consistency and asymptotic normality results are shown for the proposed estimation method. We illustrate the finite sample performance of the model and the estimation method by three Monte Carlo experiments and an application to the study of peer effects among students in their attitudes towards learning.
records.abstract_cn: 经济主体的互动是经济分析中最重要的元素之一。主观结果、行为或决策上的社会互动，由于这些变量容易受到误分类误差的影响，其识别和估计 inherently 困难。本文提出了一个带有误分类和社会互动的二元选择模型，以纠正社会互动研究中的误分类问题。我们通过重复测量技术和单调性条件实现了潜在因变量条件选择概率的识别。我们从两次重复测量构建了完整的似然函数，并提出了一种嵌套伪似然算法进行估计。我们证明了所提出估计方法的一致性和渐近正态性。我们通过三个蒙特卡洛实验和一个关于学生对待学习态度中同伴效应的应用研究，展示了模型和估计方法的有限样本性能。

records.title_en: Testing identification conditions of LATE in fuzzy regression discontinuity designs
records.title_cn: 模糊回归不连续设计中LATE识别条件的检验
records.abstract_en: This paper derives testable implications of the identifying conditions for the local average treatment effect in fuzzy regression discontinuity designs. We show that the testable implications of these identifying conditions are a finite number of inequality restrictions on the observed data distribution. We then propose a specification test for the testable implications and show that the proposed test controls the size and is asymptotically consistent. We apply our test to several fuzzy regression discontinuity designs in the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 本文推导了模糊回归不连续设计中局部平均处理效应识别条件的可检验含义。我们表明，这些识别条件的可检验含义是对观测数据分布的有限数量的不等式约束。然后，我们提出了针对这些可检验含义的设定检验，并证明所提出的检验能控制规模且渐近一致。我们将该检验应用于文献中的多个模糊回归不连续设计。

records.title_en: Long monthly temperature series and the Vector Seasonal Shifting Mean and Covariance Autoregressive model
records.title_cn: 长期月度温度序列与向量季节性移动均值和协方差自回归模型
records.abstract_en: We consider a vector version of the Shifting Seasonal Mean Autoregressive model. The model is used for describing dynamic behaviour of and contemporaneous dependence between a number of long monthly temperature series for 20 cities in Europe, extending from the second half of the 18th century until mid-2010s. The results indicate strong warming in the winter months, February excluded, and cooling followed by warming during the summer months. Error variances are mostly constant over time, but for many series there is systematic decrease between 1820 and 1850 in April. Error correlations are considered by selecting two small sets of series and modelling correlations within these sets. Some correlations do change over time, but a large majority remains constant. Not surprisingly, the correlations generally decrease with the distance between cities, but the precise geographical location also plays a role.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了一个向量版本的移动季节性均值自回归模型。该模型用于描述欧洲20个城市的长期月度温度序列的动态行为及同期依赖性，这些序列从18世纪下半叶延伸至2010年中期。结果表明冬季月份（二月除外）显著变暖，而夏季月份则先降温后升温。误差方差大多随时间保持不变，但对于许多序列，四月在1820年至1850年间存在系统性下降。通过选择两组较小的序列并建模组内相关性来考虑误差相关性。一些相关性随时间变化，但绝大多数保持不变。不出所料，相关性通常随城市间距离增加而减小，但精确的地理位置也起作用。

records.title_en: Large Bayesian SVARs with linear restrictions
records.title_cn: 带线性限制的大型贝叶斯SVAR
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm for Bayesian inference in large structural vector autoregressions (SVARs) with linear restrictions. Our proposed method is based on a novel parameter transformation scheme, which aims to facilitate sampling from the posterior distribution of model parameters when linear equality and inequality restrictions are imposed on contemporaneous impulse responses. A prominent feature of the proposed methodology is its applicability for inference in SVARs with over-identifying restrictions. In our empirical application, we demonstrate the usefulness of our method by employing a large Proxy-SVAR with multiple proxy variables to simultaneously identify multiple macroeconomic shocks and investigate their contributions to the 2007–09 Recession.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种用于带线性限制的大型结构向量自回归（SVAR）中贝叶斯推断的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）算法。我们提出的方法基于一种新颖的参数变换方案，旨在当对同期脉冲响应施加线性等式和不等式限制时，便于从模型参数的后验分布中抽样。所提出方法的一个显著特点是其适用于具有过度识别限制的SVAR推断。在我们的实证应用中，我们通过使用一个带有多个代理变量的大型代理SVAR来同时识别多个宏观经济冲击，并研究它们对2007-09年衰退的贡献，从而证明了我们方法的实用性。

records.title_en: Nonseparable sample selection models with censored selection rules
records.title_cn: 带有删失选择规则的非可分样本选择模型
records.abstract_en: We consider identification and estimation of nonseparable sample selection models with censored selection rules. We employ a control function approach and discuss different objects of interest based on (1) local effects conditional on the control function, and (2) global effects obtained from integration over ranges of values of the control function. We derive conditions for identification of these different objects and suggest strategies for estimation. Moreover, we provide the associated asymptotic theory. These strategies are illustrated in an empirical investigation of the determinants of female wages in the United Kingdom.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑带有删失选择规则的非可分样本选择模型的识别与估计。我们采用控制函数方法，并基于（1）条件于控制函数的局部效应，以及（2）通过对控制函数值范围进行积分得到的全局效应，讨论不同的感兴趣对象。我们推导了这些不同对象识别的条件，并提出了估计策略。此外，我们提供了相关的渐近理论。这些策略在英国女性工资决定因素的经验研究中得到了说明。

records.title_en: Measuring tail risk
records.title_cn: 衡量尾部风险
records.abstract_en: We comprehensively investigate the usefulness of tail risk measures proposed in the literature. We evaluate their statistical as well as their economic validity. The option-implied measure of Bollerslev and Todorov (2011b) (BT11Q) performs best overall. While some other tail risk measures excel at specialized tasks, BT11Q performs well in all tests: First, BT11Q can predict both future tail events and future tail volatility. Second, it has predictive power for returns in both the time series and the cross-section, as well as for real economic activity. Finally, a simulation analysis shows that the main driver of performance is measurement error.
records.abstract_cn: 我们全面调查了文献中提出的尾部风险度量的有用性。我们评估了它们的统计有效性和经济有效性。Bollerslev和Todorov（2011b）（BT11Q）的期权隐含度量总体表现最佳。虽然其他一些尾部风险度量在特定任务上表现出色，但BT11Q在所有测试中均表现良好：首先，BT11Q能够预测未来的尾部事件和未来的尾部波动性。其次，它对时间序列和横截面中的回报以及实际经济活动具有预测能力。最后，模拟分析表明，性能的主要驱动因素是测量误差。

records.title_en: Functional quantile autoregression
records.title_cn: 函数分位数自回归
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new class of time series models, the functional quantile autoregression (FQAR) models, in which the conditional distribution of the observation at the current time point is affected by its past distributional information, and is expressed as a functional of the past conditional quantile functions. Different from the conventional functional time series models which are based on functionally observed data, the proposed FQAR method studies functional dynamics in traditional time series data. We propose a sieve estimator for the model. Asymptotic properties of the estimators are derived. Numerical investigations are conducted to highlight the proposed method.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一类新的时间序列模型，即函数分位数自回归（FQAR）模型，其中当前时间点观测值的条件分布受其过去分布信息的影响，并表示为过去条件分位数函数的函数。与基于函数型观测数据的传统函数型时间序列模型不同，所提出的FQAR方法研究传统时间序列数据中的函数动态。我们为该模型提出了一个筛子估计量。推导了估计量的渐近性质。进行了数值研究以突出所提出的方法。

records.title_en: Estimation of complier expected shortfall treatment effects with a binary instrumental variable
records.title_cn: 二元工具变量下依从者预期短缺处理效应的估计
records.abstract_en: Estimating the causal effect of a treatment or exposure for a subpopulation is of great interest in many biomedical and economical studies. Expected shortfall, also referred to as the super-quantile, is an attractive effect-size measure that can accommodate data heterogeneity and aggregate local information of effect over a certain region of interest of the outcome distribution. In this article, we propose the ComplieRExpected Shortfall Treatment Effect (CRESTE) model under an instrumental variable framework to quantity the CRESTE for a binary endogenous treatment variable. By utilizing the special characteristics of a binary instrumental variable and a specific formulation of Neyman-orthogonalization, we propose a two-step estimation procedure, which can be implemented by simply solving weighted least-squares regression and weighted quantile regression with estimated weights. We develop the asymptotic properties for the proposed estimator and use numerical simulations to confirm its validity and robust finite-sample performance. An illustrative analysis of a National Job Training Partnership Act study is presented to show the practical utility of the proposed method.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多生物医学和经济学研究中，估计治疗或暴露对某一亚群体的因果效应具有重要意义。预期短缺，也称为超分位数，是一种有吸引力的效应量度量，能够适应数据异质性，并汇总结果分布中特定感兴趣区域效应的局部信息。在本文中，我们提出在工具变量框架下的依从者预期短缺处理效应（CRESTE）模型，以量化二元内生处理变量的CRESTE。利用二元工具变量的特殊性和Neyman正交化的特定形式，我们提出了一种两步估计程序，该程序可通过简单求解加权最小二乘回归和带估计权重的加权分位数回归来实现。我们发展了所提出估计量的渐近性质，并通过数值模拟确认其有效性和稳健的有限样本表现。最后，通过对国家职业培训伙伴关系法案研究的一个示例性分析，展示了所提出方法的实际效用。

records.title_en: Prewhitened long-run variance estimation robust to nonstationarity
records.title_cn: 预白化长期方差估计对非平稳性的稳健性
records.abstract_en: We introduce a nonparametric nonlinear VAR prewhitened long-run variance (LRV) estimator for the construction of standard errors robust to autocorrelation and heteroskedasticity that can be used for hypothesis testing in a variety of contexts including the linear regression model. Existing methods either are theoretically valid only under stationarity and have poor finite-sample properties under nonstationarity (i.e., fixed-b methods), or are theoretically valid under the null hypothesis but lead to tests that are not consistent under nonstationary alternative hypothesis (i.e., both fixed-b and traditional HAC estimators). The proposed estimator accounts explicitly for nonstationarity, unlike previous prewhitened procedures which are known to be unreliable, and leads to tests with accurate null rejection rates and good monotonic power. We also establish MSE bounds for LRV estimation that are sharper than previously established and use them to determine the data-dependent bandwidths.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种非参数非线性VAR预白化长期方差（LRV）估计量，用于构建对自相关和异方差稳健的标准误，可在包括线性回归模型在内的多种情境下用于假设检验。现有方法要么仅在平稳性下理论上有效，且在非平稳性下有限样本性质较差（即固定b方法），要么在零假设下理论上有效，但在非平稳备择假设下导致检验不一致（即固定b和传统HAC估计量）。所提出的估计量明确考虑了非平稳性，不同于已知不可靠的先前预白化程序，并导致具有准确零假设拒绝率和良好单调功效的检验。我们还建立了比先前更尖锐的LRV估计的均方误差界，并利用它们确定数据依赖的带宽。

records.title_en: Panel quantile regression for extreme risk
records.title_cn: 极端风险的面板分位数回归
records.abstract_en: Panel quantile regression models play an essential role in finance, insurance, and risk management applications. However, a direct application of panel regression for extreme conditional quantiles may suffer from a significant estimation uncertainty due to data sparsity on the far tail. We introduce a two-stage method to predict extreme conditional quantiles over cross-sections, which uses panel quantile regression at a selected intermediate level and then extrapolates the intermediate level to an extreme level with extreme value theory. This combination of panel quantile regression at an intermediate level and extreme value theory relies on a set of second-order conditions for heteroscedastic extremes. A metric called Average Absolute Relative Error is proposed to evaluate the prediction performance of both intermediate and extreme conditional quantiles. Allowing individual fixed effects in panel quantile regressions challenges the asymptotic analysis of the two-stage method and prediction metric. We demonstrate the finite sample performance of the extreme conditional quantile prediction compared to the direct use of panel quantile regression. Finally, an application of the two-stage method to the macroeconomic and housing price data finds strong evidence of housing bubbles and common economic factors.
records.abstract_cn: 面板分位数回归模型在金融、保险和风险管理应用中扮演着重要角色。然而，直接应用面板回归来估计极端条件分位数可能因尾部数据稀疏而遭受显著的估计不确定性。我们引入了一种两阶段方法来预测横截面上的极端条件分位数，该方法在选定的中间水平上使用面板分位数回归，然后利用极值理论将中间水平外推到极端水平。这种在中间水平上的面板分位数回归与极值理论的结合依赖于一组用于异方差极值的二阶条件。我们提出了一种称为平均绝对相对误差的度量来评估中间和极端条件分位数的预测性能。在面板分位数回归中允许个体固定效应给两阶段方法和预测度量的渐近分析带来了挑战。我们展示了极端条件分位数预测相对于直接使用面板分位数回归的有限样本性能。最后，将两阶段方法应用于宏观经济和房价数据，发现了房价泡沫和共同经济因素的强有力证据。

records.title_en: Detecting identification failure in moment condition models
records.title_cn: 检测矩条件模型中的识别失败
records.abstract_en: This paper develops an approach to detect identification failure in moment condition models. This is achieved by introducing a quasi-Jacobian matrix computed as the slope of a linear approximation of the moments on an estimate of the identified set. It is asymptotically singular when local and/or global identification fails, and equivalent to the usual Jacobian matrix which has full rank when the model is globally and locally identified. Building on this property, a simple test with chi-squared critical values is introduced to conduct subvector inferences allowing for strong, semi-strong, and weak identification without a priori knowledge about the underlying identification structure. Monte-Carlo simulations and an empirical application to the Long-Run Risks model illustrate the results.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种检测矩条件模型中识别失败的方法。这是通过引入一个拟雅可比矩阵来实现的，该矩阵计算为矩在识别集估计上的线性近似斜率。当局部和/或全局识别失败时，该矩阵渐近奇异，而当模型全局和局部识别时，该矩阵等价于满秩的通常雅可比矩阵。基于这一性质，引入了一个具有卡方临界值的简单检验，以进行子向量推断，允许强识别、半强识别和弱识别，而无需事先了解潜在的识别结构。蒙特卡洛模拟和对长期风险模型的实证应用说明了结果。

records.title_en: Covariate adjustment in experiments with matched pairs
records.title_cn: 匹配对实验中的协变量调整
records.abstract_en: This paper studies inference for the average treatment effect (ATE) in experiments in which treatment status is determined according to “matched pairs” and it is additionally desired to adjust for observed, baseline covariates to gain further precision. By a “matched pairs” design, we mean that units are sampled i.i.d. from the population of interest, paired according to observed, baseline covariates, and finally, within each pair, one unit is selected at random for treatment. Importantly, we presume that not all observed, baseline covariates are used in determining treatment assignment. We study a broad class of estimators based on a “doubly robust” moment condition that permits us to study estimators with both finite-dimensional and high-dimensional forms of covariate adjustment. We find that estimators with finite-dimensional, linear adjustments need not lead to improvements in precision relative to the unadjusted difference-in-means estimator. This phenomenon persists even if the adjustments interact with treatment; in fact, doing so leads to no changes in precision. However, gains in precision can be ensured by including fixed effects for each of the pairs. Indeed, we show that this adjustment leads to the minimum asymptotic variance of the corresponding ATE estimator among all finite-dimensional, linear adjustments. We additionally study an estimator with a regularized adjustment, which can accommodate high-dimensional covariates. We show that this estimator leads to improvements in precision relative to the unadjusted difference-in-means estimator and also provides conditions under which it leads to the “optimal” nonparametric, covariate adjustment. A simulation study confirms the practical relevance of our theoretical analysis, and the methods are employed to reanalyze data from an experiment using a “matched pairs” design to study the effect of macroinsurance on microenterprise.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在治疗状态根据“匹配对”确定且额外希望调整观测到的基线协变量以获得更高精度的实验中，平均处理效应（ATE）的推断问题。所谓“匹配对”设计，是指从目标总体中独立同分布地抽取单位，根据观测到的基线协变量进行配对，最后在每对内随机选择一个单位接受治疗。重要的是，我们假设并非所有观测到的基线协变量都用于确定治疗分配。我们研究了一类基于“双重稳健”矩条件的广泛估计量，该条件使我们能够研究具有有限维和高维协变量调整形式的估计量。我们发现，具有有限维线性调整的估计量相对于未调整的均值差估计量不一定能提高精度。即使调整与治疗交互，这种现象仍然存在；事实上，这样做不会导致精度变化。然而，通过包含每对的固定效应可以确保精度的提高。实际上，我们表明这种调整在所有有限维线性调整中导致了相应的ATE估计量的最小渐近方差。我们还研究了一个具有正则化调整的估计量，它可以适应高维协变量。我们表明，该估计量相对于未调整的均值差估计量提高了精度，并提供了其导致“最优”非参数协变量调整的条件。模拟研究证实了我们理论分析的实际相关性，并且这些方法被用于重新分析一项使用“匹配对”设计研究宏观保险对微型企业影响的实验数据。

records.title_en: On model selection criteria for climate change impact studies
records.title_cn: 气候变化影响研究中的模型选择标准
records.abstract_en: Climate change impact studies inform policymakers on the estimated damages of future climate change on economic, health and other outcomes. In most studies, an annual outcome variable is observed, e.g. agricultural yield, along with a higher-frequency regressor, e.g. daily temperature. Applied researchers then face a problem of selecting a model to characterize the nonlinear relationship between the outcome and the high-frequency regressor to make a policy recommendation based on the model-implied damage function. We show that existing model selection criteria are only suitable for the policy objective if one of the models under consideration nests the true model. If all models are seen as imperfect approximations of the true nonlinear relationship, the model that performs well in the historical climate conditions is not guaranteed to perform well at the projected climate. We therefore propose a new criterion, the proximity-weighted mean squared error (PWMSE) that directly targets precision of the damage function at the projected future climate. To make this criterion feasible, we assign higher weights to historical years that can serve as “weather analogs” to the projected future climate when evaluating competing models using the PWMSE. We show that our approach selects the best approximate regression model that has the smallest weighted squared error of predicted impacts for a projected future climate. A simulation study and an application revisiting the impact of climate change on agricultural production illustrate the empirical relevance of our theoretical analysis.
