records.abstract_cn: 气候变化影响研究为政策制定者提供关于未来气候变化对经济、健康及其他结果估计损害的信息。在大多数研究中，观测到年度结果变量，如农业产量，以及高频回归变量，如日温度。应用研究者随后面临选择模型以刻画结果与高频回归变量之间非线性关系的问题，以便基于模型隐含的损害函数提出政策建议。我们表明，现有的模型选择标准仅当所考虑的模型之一嵌套真实模型时才适用于政策目标。如果所有模型都被视为真实非线性关系的不完美近似，那么在历史气候条件下表现良好的模型并不能保证在预测气候下表现良好。因此，我们提出一个新的标准，即邻近加权均方误差（PWMSE），直接针对预测未来气候下损害函数的精度。为了使该标准可行，我们在使用PWMSE评估竞争模型时，对能够作为预测未来气候“天气类比”的历史年份赋予更高权重。我们表明，我们的方法选择了对于预测未来气候具有最小预测影响加权平方误差的最佳近似回归模型。模拟研究和重新审视气候变化对农业生产影响的应用程序说明了我们理论分析的经验相关性。

records.title_en: High-dimensional model-assisted inference for treatment effects with multi-valued treatments
records.title_cn: 高维模型辅助的多值处理效应推断
records.abstract_en: Consider estimation of average treatment effects with multi-valued treatments using augmented inverse probability weighted (IPW) estimators, depending on outcome regression and propensity score models in high-dimensional settings. These regression models are often fitted by regularized likelihood-based estimation, while ignoring how the fitted functions are used in the subsequent inference about the treatment parameters. Such separate estimation can be associated with known difficulties in existing methods. We develop regularized calibrated estimation for fitting propensity score and outcome regression models, where sparsity-including penalties are employed to facilitate variable selection but the loss functions are carefully chosen such that valid confidence intervals can be obtained under possible model misspecification. Unlike in the case of binary treatments, the usual augmented IPW estimator is generalized to ensure just-identification of parameters from new calibration equations. For propensity score estimation, the new loss function and estimating functions are directly tied to achieving covariate balance between weighted treatment groups. We develop practical algorithms for computing the regularized calibrated estimators with group Lasso by innovatively exploiting Fisher scoring, and provide rigorous high-dimensional analysis for the resulting augmented IPW estimators under suitable sparsity conditions, while tackling technical issues absent or overlooked in previous analyses. We present simulation studies and an empirical application to estimate the effects of maternal smoking on birth weights. The proposed methods are implemented in the R package mRCAL.
records.abstract_cn: 考虑使用增强逆概率加权（IPW）估计量来估计多值处理的平均处理效应，该估计量依赖于高维设定下的结果回归和倾向得分模型。这些回归模型通常通过正则化似然估计进行拟合，而忽略了拟合函数在后续处理参数推断中的使用方式。这种分离估计可能与现有方法中的已知困难相关。我们开发了正则化校准估计来拟合倾向得分和结果回归模型，其中采用包含稀疏性的惩罚以促进变量选择，但损失函数经过精心选择，以便在可能的模型误设定下获得有效的置信区间。与二元处理情形不同，通常的增强IPW估计量被推广以确保新校准方程中参数的恰好识别。对于倾向得分估计，新的损失函数和估计函数直接与实现加权处理组之间的协变量平衡相关联。我们开发了实用算法，通过创新性地利用Fisher得分法计算带有组Lasso的正则化校准估计量，并在适当的稀疏性条件下对所得的增强IPW估计量提供严格的高维分析，同时解决先前分析中不存在或被忽视的技术问题。我们进行了模拟研究，并应用实证分析来估计母亲吸烟对出生体重的影响。所提出的方法已在R包mRCAL中实现。

records.title_en: On uniform inference in nonlinear models with endogeneity
records.title_cn: 内生性非线性模型中的均匀推断
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the uniformity of inference for parameters of interest in nonlinear econometric models with endogeneity. Here the notion of uniformity arises because the behavior of estimators of parameters of interest is shown to vary with where either they or nuisance parameters lie in the parameter space. As a result, inference becomes nonstandard in a fashion that is loosely analogous to inference complications found in the unit root and weak instruments literature, as well as the models recently studied in Andrews and Cheng (2012), Chen et al. (2014), Han and McCloskey (2019). Our main illustrative example is the standard sample selection model, where the parameter of interest is the intercept term as in Heckman (1990), Andrews and Schafgans (1998) and Lewbel (2007). We show here there is a discontinuity in the limiting distribution for an estimator of this parameter despite it being uniformly consistent. This discontinuity prevents standard inference procedures from being valid, and motivates the development of new methods, for which we establish asymptotic properties. Finite sample properties of the procedure are explored through a simulation study and an empirical illustration using the Mroz (1987) data set as in Newey, Powell, and Walker (1990).
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了具有内生性的非线性计量经济模型中感兴趣参数的推断均匀性。这里的均匀性概念源于所关注参数估计量的行为会随着其自身或 nuisance 参数在参数空间中的位置而变化。因此，推断变得非标准，其方式大致类似于单位根和弱工具变量文献以及 Andrews 和 Cheng (2012)、Chen 等人 (2014)、Han 和 McCloskey (2019) 最近研究的模型中所发现的推断复杂性。我们的主要示例是标准样本选择模型，其中感兴趣参数是截距项，如 Heckman (1990)、Andrews 和 Schafgans (1998) 以及 Lewbel (2007) 所述。我们在此表明，尽管该参数的估计量是一致一致的，但其极限分布存在不连续性。这种不连续性使得标准推断程序无效，并促使我们开发新方法，我们为其建立了渐近性质。通过模拟研究和基于 Mroz (1987) 数据集的实证说明（如 Newey、Powell 和 Walker (1990) 所述），探讨了该过程的有限样本性质。

records.title_en: Extreme expectile estimation for short-tailed data
records.title_cn: 短尾数据的极端期望分位数估计
records.abstract_en: The use of expectiles in risk management has recently gathered remarkable momentum due to their excellent axiomatic and probabilistic properties. In particular, the class of elicitable law-invariant coherent risk measures only consists of expectiles. While the theory of expectile estimation at central levels is substantial, tail estimation at extreme levels has so far only been considered when the tail of the underlying distribution is heavy. This article is the first work to handle the short-tailed setting where the loss (e.g. negative log-returns) distribution of interest is bounded to the right and the corresponding extreme value index is negative. This is motivated by the assessment of long-term market risk carried by low-frequency (e.g. weekly) returns of equities that show evidence of being generated from short-tailed distributions. We derive an asymptotic expansion of tail expectiles in this challenging context under a general second-order extreme value condition, which allows to come up with two semiparametric estimators of extreme expectiles, and with their asymptotic properties in a general model of strictly stationary but weakly dependent observations. We also extend the applicability of the proposed method to the regression setting. A simulation study and a real data analysis from a forecasting perspective are performed to compare the proposed competing estimation procedures.
records.abstract_cn: 期望分位数在风险管理中的应用近年来因其优异的公理和概率性质而受到显著关注。特别是，可激励的律不变一致风险度量类仅由期望分位数组成。虽然中心水平期望分位数估计的理论已相当完善，但极端水平的尾部估计迄今为止仅在基础分布尾部为重尾时被考虑。本文是首篇处理短尾设定的工作，其中所关注的损失（例如负对数收益）分布右侧有界，且相应的极端值指数为负。这一研究动机源于对低频（例如周度）股票收益所承担的长期市场风险的评估，这些收益显示出由短尾分布生成的证据。我们在一般的二阶极端值条件下推导了此挑战性背景下尾部期望分位数的渐近展开，从而提出了两种极端期望分位数的半参数估计量，并给出了它们在严格平稳但弱相依观测的一般模型中的渐近性质。我们还将所提方法的适用性扩展到回归设定。进行了模拟研究和从预测角度的真实数据分析，以比较所提出的竞争性估计程序。

records.title_en: Some fixed-b results for regressions with high frequency data over long spans
records.title_cn: 长期跨度高频数据回归的固定b结果
records.abstract_en: This paper develops fixed-b asymptotic results for heteroskedasticity autocorrelation robust (HAR) Wald tests for high frequency data using the continuous time framework of Chang et al. (2023) (CLP). It is shown that the fixed-b limit of HAR Wald tests for high frequency stationary regressions is the same as the standard fixed-b limit in Kiefer and Vogelsang (2005). For the case of cointegrating regression the form of the fixed-b limits are different from the stationary case and may or may not be pivotal but also have the same fixed-b limits that have been obtained for tests based on ordinary least squares (OLS) (Bunzel, 2006) and integrated modified OLS (Vogelsang and Wagner, 2014). A simulation study shows that fixed-b critical values provide rejection probabilities closer to nominal levels than traditional chi-square critical values when using data-dependent bandwidths. The Andrews (1991) data-dependent method works reasonably well for a wider range of persistence parameters than those considered by CLP. In contrast, the Newey and West (1994) data-dependent method is sensitive to the choice of pre-tuning parameters. The data-dependent method of Sun et al. (2008) give results similar to the Andrews (1991) method with slightly less over-rejection problems when used with fixed-b critical values. Our results for bandwidth choice reinforce the importance of high frequency compatibility of bandwidths as emphasized by CLP. Regardless of the bandwidth method used in practice, it is clear that fixed-b critical values can and should be used for high frequency data whenever HAR tests are based on kernel estimators of long run variances. Our results complement the analysis of Pellatt and Sun (2023) who focused on HAR tests based on orthonormal series estimators of long run variance estimator.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于Chang等人（2023）（CLP）的连续时间框架，为高频数据的异方差自相关稳健（HAR）Wald检验发展了固定b渐近结果。研究表明，高频平稳回归的HAR Wald检验的固定b极限与Kiefer和Vogelsang（2005）中的标准固定b极限相同。对于协整回归的情况，固定b极限的形式与平稳情况不同，可能具有也可能不具有枢轴性，但也具有与基于普通最小二乘（OLS）（Bunzel，2006）和修正OLS（Vogelsang和Wagner，2014）的检验所获得的相同固定b极限。模拟研究表明，当使用数据依赖带宽时，固定b临界值提供的拒绝概率比传统卡方临界值更接近名义水平。Andrews（1991）的数据依赖方法在比CLP考虑的更广泛的持久性参数范围内表现良好。相比之下，Newey和West（1994）的数据依赖方法对预调参数的选择敏感。Sun等人（2008）的数据依赖方法给出的结果与Andrews（1991）方法相似，但在使用固定b临界值时略微减少了过度拒绝问题。我们关于带宽选择的结果强化了CLP所强调的带宽高频兼容性的重要性。无论实践中使用何种带宽方法，很明显，只要HAR检验基于长期方差的核估计量，固定b临界值就可以且应该用于高频数据。我们的结果补充了Pellatt和Sun（2023）的分析，他们专注于基于长期方差估计量的正交序列估计量的HAR检验。

records.title_en: Nested Pseudo likelihood estimation of continuous-time dynamic discrete games
records.title_cn: 连续时间动态离散博弈的嵌套伪似然估计
records.abstract_en: We introduce a sequential estimator for continuous time dynamic discrete choice models (single-agent models and games) by adapting the nested pseudo likelihood (NPL) estimator of Aguirregabiria and Mira (2002, 2007), developed for discrete time models with discrete time data, to the continuous time case with data sampled either discretely (i.e., uniformly-spaced snapshot data) or continuously. We establish conditions for consistency and asymptotic normality of the estimator, a local convergence condition, and, for single agent models, a zero Jacobian property assuring local convergence. We carry out a series of Monte Carlo experiments using an entry-exit game with five heterogeneous firms to confirm the large-sample properties and demonstrate finite-sample bias reduction via iteration. In our simulations we show that the convergence issues documented for the NPL estimator in discrete time models are less likely to affect comparable continuous-time models. We also show that there can be large bias in economically-relevant parameters, such as the competitive effect and entry cost, from estimating a misspecified discrete time model when in fact the data generating process is a continuous time model.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过将Aguirregabiria和Mira（2002，2007）为离散时间模型和离散时间数据开发的嵌套伪似然（NPL）估计器适应到连续时间情形，引入了一种针对连续时间动态离散选择模型（单代理模型和博弈）的序贯估计器，其中数据可以是离散采样（即均匀间隔的快照数据）或连续采样。我们建立了该估计器的一致性和渐近正态性条件、局部收敛条件，以及对于单代理模型，确保局部收敛的零雅可比性质。我们使用一个包含五家异质企业的进入退出博弈进行了一系列蒙特卡洛实验，以确认大样本性质并展示通过迭代减少有限样本偏差。在我们的模拟中，我们表明，在离散时间模型中记录的NPL估计器的收敛问题不太可能影响可比较的连续时间模型。我们还表明，当数据生成过程实际上是连续时间模型时，估计一个错误设定的离散时间模型可能会导致经济相关参数（如竞争效应和进入成本）出现较大偏差。

records.title_en: Enhanced pricing and management of bundled insurance risks with dependence-aware prediction using pair copula construction
records.title_cn: 基于pair copula构造的相依感知预测在捆绑保险风险定价与管理中的增强
records.abstract_en: We propose a dependence-aware predictive modeling framework for multivariate risks stemmed from an insurance contract with bundling features — an important type of policy increasingly offered by major insurance companies. The bundling feature naturally leads to longitudinal measurements of multiple insurance risks, and correct pricing and management of such risks is of fundamental interest to financial stability of the macroeconomy. We build a novel predictive model that fully captures the dependence among the multivariate repeated risk measurements. Specifically, the longitudinal measurement of each individual risk is first modeled using pair copula construction with a D-vine structure, and the multiple D-vines are then integrated by a flexible copula. While our analysis mainly focuses on multivariate insurance risks, the proposed model indeed contributes to the broad research area of longitudinal data analysis. In particular, it provides a unified modeling framework for multivariate longitudinal data that can accommodate different scales of measurements, including continuous, discrete, and mixed observations, and thus can be potentially useful for various economic studies. A computationally efficient sequential method is proposed for model estimation and inference, and its performance is investigated both theoretically and via simulation studies. In the application, we examine multivariate bundled risks in multi-peril property insurance using proprietary data from a commercial property insurance provider. The proposed model is found to provide improved decision making for several key insurance operations. For underwriting, we show that the experience rate priced by the proposed model leads to a 9% lift in the insurer’s net revenue. For reinsurance, we show that the insurer underestimates the risk of the retained insurance portfolio by 10% when ignoring the dependence among bundled insurance risks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种相依感知的预测建模框架，用于处理具有捆绑特征的保险合同所产生的多元风险——这是大型保险公司日益提供的一种重要保单类型。捆绑特征自然导致多个保险风险的纵向测量，而对此类风险的正确定价和管理对宏观经济的金融稳定具有根本重要性。我们构建了一个新颖的预测模型，充分捕捉多元重复风险测量之间的相依性。具体而言，首先使用具有D-vine结构的pair copula构造对每个个体风险的纵向测量进行建模，然后通过灵活的copula整合多个D-vine。虽然我们的分析主要关注多元保险风险，但所提出的模型确实对纵向数据分析的广泛研究领域有所贡献。特别是，它为多元纵向数据提供了一个统一的建模框架，可以适应不同尺度的测量，包括连续、离散和混合观测，因此可能对各种经济研究有用。我们提出了一种计算高效的序贯方法用于模型估计和推断，并通过理论和模拟研究考察了其性能。在应用中，我们使用来自商业财产保险提供商的专有数据，检查了多险种财产保险中的多元捆绑风险。发现所提出的模型为几个关键保险运营提供了改进的决策。对于承保，我们表明所提出模型定价的经验费率导致保险公司净收入提升9%。对于再保险，我们表明当忽略捆绑保险风险之间的相依性时，保险公司低估了自留保险组合的风险10%。

records.title_en: Inference in models with partially identified control functions
records.title_cn: 部分识别控制函数模型中的推断
records.abstract_en: In multiple contributions to the literature, James L. Powell and coauthors have developed estimators for semiparametric models where sample selectivity and/or endogeneity can be handled through a “control function”. Their methods rely on pairwise comparisons of observations which match (asymptotically) the control functions. Conditional on this matching, a moment condition can identify the parameters of the model. However, there exist instances where the control functions are unobserved, but we have bounds for them which depend on observable covariates. These bounds can arise directly from the nature of the data available (e.g, with interval data), or they can be derived from an economic model. The inability to observe the control functions precludes the matching proposed in Powell’s methods. In this paper we show that, under certain conditions, testable implications can still be obtained through pairwise comparisons of observations for which the control-function bounds are disjoint. Testable implications now take the form of pairwise functional inequalities. We propose an inferential procedure based on these pairwise inequalities and we analyze its properties.
records.abstract_cn: 在文献的多项贡献中，James L. Powell及其合著者开发了半参数模型的估计量，其中样本选择性和/或内生性可以通过“控制函数”来处理。他们的方法依赖于对（渐近地）匹配控制函数的观测值进行两两比较。在这种匹配条件下，矩条件可以识别模型参数。然而，在某些情况下，控制函数是不可观测的，但我们有依赖于可观测协变量的界限。这些界限可以直接来自可用数据的性质（例如，区间数据），也可以从经济模型中推导出来。无法观测控制函数排除了Powell方法中提出的匹配。在本文中，我们表明，在特定条件下，仍然可以通过对控制函数界限不相交的观测值进行两两比较来获得可检验的隐含条件。可检验的隐含条件现在采取成对函数不等式的形式。我们提出了一种基于这些成对不等式的推断程序，并分析了其性质。

records.title_en: The law of large numbers for large stable matchings
records.title_cn: 大规模稳定匹配的大数定律
records.abstract_en: In many empirical studies of a large two-sided matching market (such as in a college admissions problem), the researcher performs statistical inference under the assumption that they observe a random sample from a large matching market. In this paper, we consider a setting in which the researcher observes either all or a nontrivial fraction of outcomes from a stable matching. We establish a concentration inequality for empirical matching probabilities assuming strong correlation among the colleges’ preferences while allowing students’ preferences to be fully heterogeneous. Our concentration inequality yields laws of large numbers for the empirical matching probabilities and other statistics commonly used in empirical analyses of a large matching market. To illustrate the usefulness of our concentration inequality, we prove consistency for estimators of conditional matching probabilities and measures of positive assortative matching.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多关于大规模双边匹配市场（如大学录取问题）的实证研究中，研究者假设他们从大规模匹配市场中观察到随机样本，并在此假设下进行统计推断。本文考虑研究者观察到稳定匹配的全部或非平凡比例结果的情形。我们建立了经验匹配概率的集中不等式，假设高校偏好之间存在强相关性，同时允许学生偏好完全异质。我们的集中不等式为经验匹配概率以及大规模匹配市场实证分析中常用的其他统计量提供了大数定律。为说明我们集中不等式的实用性，我们证明了条件匹配概率估计量和正分类匹配度量的一致性。

records.title_en: Sparse generalized Yule–Walker estimation for large spatio-temporal autoregressions with an application to NO2 satellite data
records.title_cn: 大规模时空自回归的稀疏广义Yule–Walker估计及其在NO2卫星数据中的应用
records.abstract_en: We consider a high-dimensional model in which variables are observed over time and space. The model consists of a spatio-temporal regression containing a time lag and a spatial lag of the dependent variable. Unlike classical spatial autoregressive models, we do not rely on a predetermined spatial interaction matrix, but infer all spatial interactions from the data. Assuming sparsity, we estimate the spatial and temporal dependence fully data-driven by penalizing a set of Yule–Walker equations. This regularization can be left unstructured, but we also propose customized shrinkage procedures when observations originate from spatial grids (e.g. satellite images). Finite sample error bounds are derived and estimation consistency is established in an asymptotic framework wherein the sample size and the number of spatial units diverge jointly. Exogenous variables can be included as well. A simulation exercise shows strong finite sample performance compared to competing procedures. As an empirical application, we model satellite measured nitrogen dioxide (NO2) concentrations in London. Our approach delivers forecast improvements over a competitive benchmark and we discover evidence for strong spatial interactions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个高维模型，其中变量在时间和空间上被观测。该模型包含一个时空回归，包括因变量的时间滞后和空间滞后。与经典的空间自回归模型不同，我们不依赖于预定的空间交互矩阵，而是从数据中推断所有空间交互。假设稀疏性，我们通过惩罚一组Yule–Walker方程来完全数据驱动地估计空间和时间依赖性。这种正则化可以保持非结构化，但我们也提出了当观测来自空间网格（例如卫星图像）时的定制收缩程序。推导了有限样本误差界，并在样本量和空间单元数量共同发散的渐近框架中建立了估计一致性。外生变量也可以包含在内。模拟实验显示，与竞争方法相比，具有强大的有限样本性能。作为实证应用，我们对伦敦的卫星测量二氧化氮（NO2）浓度进行建模。我们的方法在竞争基准上提供了预测改进，并发现了强空间交互的证据。

records.title_en: GMM estimation for high-dimensional panel data models
records.title_cn: 高维面板数据模型的GMM估计
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we study a class of high dimensional moment restriction panel data models with interactive effects, where the factors are unobserved and these factor loadings are nonparametrically unknown smooth functions of individual characteristic variables. We allow the dimension of the parameter vector and the number of moment conditions to diverge with the sample size. This is a very general framework and is closely related to many existing linear and nonlinear panel data models. In order to estimate the unknown parameters, factors and factor loadings, we propose a sieve-based generalized method of moments estimation method and we show that under a set of simple identification conditions, all those unknown quantities can be consistently estimated. Further we establish asymptotic distributions of the proposed estimators. In addition, we propose tests for over-identification, specification of factor loading functions, and establish their large sample properties. Moreover, a number of simulation studies are conducted to examine the performance of the proposed estimators and test statistics in finite samples. An empirical example on stock return prediction is studied to demonstrate both the empirical relevance and the applicability of the proposed framework and corresponding estimation and testing methods.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了一类具有交互效应的高维矩条件面板数据模型，其中因子是不可观测的，且这些因子载荷是单个特征变量的非参数未知光滑函数。我们允许参数向量的维度和矩条件的数量随样本量发散。这是一个非常一般的框架，与许多现有的线性和非线性面板数据模型密切相关。为了估计未知参数、因子和因子载荷，我们提出了一种基于筛的广义矩估计方法，并证明在一组简单的识别条件下，所有这些未知量都可以被一致估计。进一步，我们建立了所提出估计量的渐近分布。此外，我们提出了过度识别、因子载荷函数设定的检验，并建立了它们的大样本性质。此外，我们进行了多项模拟研究，以检验所提出的估计量和检验统计量在有限样本中的表现。我们通过一个关于股票收益预测的实证例子来展示所提出框架及相应估计和检验方法的实证相关性和适用性。

records.title_en: Testing unconditional and conditional independence via mutual information
records.title_cn: 通过互信息检验无条件独立性和条件独立性
records.abstract_en: Testing independence has garnered increasing attention in the econometric and statistical literature. Many tests have been proposed, most of which are inconsistent against all departures from independence. Few of those tests, though consistent, suffer a significant loss of local power. This study proposes a mutual information test for testing independence. The proposed test is simple to implement and, with a slight loss of local power, is consistent against all departures from independence. The key driving factor is that we estimate the density ratio directly. This value is constant in a state of independence. This is in contrast with related studies that estimate the joint and marginal density functions to form the density ratio. A small-scale simulation study indicates that the proposed test outperforms the existing alternatives in various dependence structures.
records.abstract_cn: 检验独立性在计量经济学和统计学文献中受到越来越多的关注。许多检验已被提出，其中大多数对独立性的所有偏离都不具有一致性。少数检验虽然具有一致性，但在局部功效上损失显著。本研究提出了一种用于检验独立性的互信息检验。所提出的检验易于实施，并且在局部功效略有损失的情况下，对独立性的所有偏离都具有一致性。关键驱动因素是我们直接估计密度比。该值在独立状态下是常数。这与相关研究中估计联合密度函数和边际密度函数以形成密度比的方法形成对比。一个小规模模拟研究表明，所提出的检验在各种依赖结构下优于现有的替代方法。

records.title_en: Identifiability and estimation of possibly non-invertible SVARMA Models: The normalised canonical WHF parametrisation
records.title_cn: 可能不可逆的SVARMA模型的识别性与估计：归一化典范WHF参数化
records.abstract_en: This article focuses on the parametrisation, identifiability, and (quasi-) maximum likelihood (QML) estimation of possibly non-invertible structural vector autoregressive moving average (SVARMA) models. SVAR models are routinely adopted due to their well-known implementation strategy. However, for various economic and statistical reasons, multivariate SVARMA settings are often more suitable. These settings introduce complexity in the analysis, primarily due to the presence of the moving average (MA) polynomial. We propose a novel representation of the MA polynomial matrix using the Wiener–Hopf factorization (WHF). A significant advantage of the WHF is its ability to handle possible non-invertibility and thus models with informational asymmetry between economic agents and outside observers. Since solutions of Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) models often involve this informational asymmetry, SVARMA models in WHF parametrisation can be considered data-driven alternatives to DSGE models and used for their evaluation. Furthermore, we provide low-level conditions for the asymptotic normality of the (Q)ML estimator and analytic expressions for the score and information matrix. As application, we estimate the Blanchard and Quah model, and compare our results and implied impulse response function with the ones in the SVAR model by Blanchard and Quah and a non-invertible SVARMA model by Gouriéroux and co-authors. Importantly, we have implemented this novel method in a well-documented R-package, making it readily accessible for researchers and practitioners.
records.abstract_cn: 本文关注可能不可逆的结构向量自回归移动平均（SVARMA）模型的参数化、识别性以及（拟）极大似然（QML）估计。SVAR模型因其众所周知的实施策略而被常规采用。然而，出于各种经济和统计原因，多元SVARMA设定往往更为合适。这些设定引入了分析中的复杂性，主要由于移动平均（MA）多项式的存在。我们提出了一种使用Wiener–Hopf分解（WHF）的MA多项式矩阵的新表示。WHF的一个显著优势是它能够处理可能的不可逆性，从而处理经济主体与外部观察者之间存在信息不对称的模型。由于动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型的解通常涉及这种信息不对称，WHF参数化下的SVARMA模型可以被视为DSGE模型的数据驱动替代品，并用于其评估。此外，我们提供了（Q）ML估计量渐近正态性的低层条件以及得分和信息矩阵的解析表达式。作为应用，我们估计了Blanchard和Quah模型，并将我们的结果和隐含脉冲响应函数与Blanchard和Quah的SVAR模型以及Gouriéroux及其合著者的不可逆SVARMA模型进行比较。重要的是，我们已在一个文档完善的R包中实现了这一新方法，使其易于研究人员和从业者使用。

records.title_en: Scenario-based quantile connectedness of the U.S. interbank liquidity risk network
records.title_cn: 基于情景的美国银行间流动性风险网络分位数关联性
records.abstract_en: We characterize the U.S. interbank liquidity risk network based on a supervisory dataset, using a scenario-based quantile network connectedness approach. In terms of methodology, we consider a quantile vector autoregressive model with unobserved heterogeneity and propose a Bayesian nuclear norm estimation method. A common factor structure is employed to deal with unobserved heterogeneity that may exhibit endogeneity within the network. Then we develop a scenario-based quantile network connectedness framework by accommodating various economic scenarios, through a scenario-based moving average expression of the model where forecast error variance decomposition under a future pre-specified scenario is derived. The methodology is used to study the quantile-dependent liquidity risk network among large U.S. bank holding companies. The estimated quantile liquidity risk network connectedness measures could be useful for bank supervision and financial stability monitoring by providing leading indicators of the system-wide liquidity risk connectedness not only at the median but also at the tails or even under a pre-specified scenario. The measures also help identify systemically important banks and vulnerable banks in the liquidity risk transmission of the U.S. banking system.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于监管数据集，采用基于情景的分位数网络关联性方法，刻画了美国银行间流动性风险网络。在方法论上，我们考虑了一个具有未观测异质性的分位数向量自回归模型，并提出了一种贝叶斯核范数估计方法。采用共同因子结构来处理可能在网络内表现出内生性的未观测异质性。然后，我们通过模型的情景化移动平均表达，推导出未来预设情景下的预测误差方差分解，从而构建了基于情景的分位数网络关联性框架。该方法被用于研究大型美国银行控股公司之间的分位数依赖流动性风险网络。估计的分位数流动性风险网络关联性指标不仅在中位数处，而且在尾部甚至预设情景下，都能提供系统性流动性风险关联性的先行指标，有助于银行监管和金融稳定监测。这些指标还有助于识别美国银行体系中流动性风险传导中的系统重要性银行和脆弱银行。

records.title_en: Quantile analysis of “hazard-rate” game models
records.title_cn: “风险率”博弈模型的分位数分析
records.abstract_en: This paper consists of an econometric analysis of a broad class of games of incomplete information. In these games, a player’s action depends both on her unobservable characteristic (the private information), as well as on the ratio of the distribution of the unobservable characteristic and its density function (which we call the ”hazard-rate”). The goal is to use data on players’ actions to recover the distribution of private information. We show that the structural parameter (the quantile of the unobservable characteristic, denoted by L) can be related to the reduced form parameter (the quantile of the data, denoted by Q) through a differential equation Q(α)=a(L(α),αL′(α)). We analyse the local and global identification of this equation in L. At the same time, under suitable assumptions, we establish the local and global well-posedness of the inverse problem Q=T(L). We solve the differential equation and, as a consequence of the well-posedness, we estimate nonparametrically the quantile and the c.d.f. function of the unobserved variables at a root-n speed of convergence (conditional on the quantile of the data being estimated at root-n). Moreover as the transformation of Q in L is continuous with respect to a topology that implies also the derivatives, we estimate nonparametrically the quantile density and the density the unobserved variables (that are continuous functions with respect to Q) at root-n speed of convergence. We provide also several generalisations of the model accounting for exogenuous variables, implicit expression of the strategy function and integral expression of the strategy function. Our results have several policy applications, including better design of auctions, regulation models, estimation of war of attrition in patent races, and public good contracts.
records.abstract_cn: 本文对一类广泛的不完全信息博弈进行了计量经济学分析。在这类博弈中，参与者的行动既取决于其不可观测的特征（私人信息），也取决于不可观测特征的分布与其密度函数之比（我们称之为“风险率”）。目标是利用参与者行动的数据来恢复私人信息的分布。我们表明，结构参数（不可观测特征的分位数，记为L）可以通过微分方程Q(α)=a(L(α),αL′(α))与简化形式参数（数据的分位数，记为Q）相关联。我们分析了该方程在L中的局部和全局识别性。同时，在适当的假设下，我们建立了反问题Q=T(L)的局部和全局适定性。我们求解了该微分方程，并且作为适定性的结果，我们以根号n的收敛速度（在数据分位数以根号n速度估计的条件下）非参数地估计了不可观测变量的分位数和累积分布函数。此外，由于Q到L的变换在包含导数的拓扑意义下是连续的，我们以根号n的收敛速度非参数地估计了分位数密度和不可观测变量的密度（这些是关于Q的连续函数）。我们还提供了模型的若干推广，包括外生变量、策略函数的隐式表达式和策略函数的积分表达式。我们的结果具有多项政策应用，包括更好的拍卖设计、监管模型、专利竞赛中消耗战的估计以及公共品合同。

records.title_en: Identifying the effects of a program offer with an application to Head Start
records.title_cn: 识别项目提供效应：以启蒙计划为例
records.abstract_en: I propose a treatment selection model that introduces unobserved heterogeneity in both choice sets and preferences to evaluate the average effects of a program offer. I show how to exploit the model structure to define parameters capturing these effects and then computationally characterize their identified sets under instrumental variable variation in choice sets. I illustrate these tools by analyzing the effects of providing an offer to the Head Start preschool program using data from the Head Start Impact Study. I find that such a policy affects a large number of children who take up the offer, and that they subsequently have positive effects on test scores. These effects arise from children who do not have any preschool as an outside option. A cost–benefit analysis reveals that the earning benefits associated with the test score gains can be large and outweigh the net costs associated with offer take up.
records.abstract_cn: 我提出一个处理选择模型，该模型在选择集和偏好中引入不可观测的异质性，以评估项目提供的平均效应。我展示了如何利用模型结构来定义捕捉这些效应的参数，然后在选择集的工具变量变化下计算其识别集。我通过使用启蒙影响研究的数据分析提供启蒙学前项目offer的效应来说明这些工具。我发现这样的政策影响了大量接受offer的儿童，并且他们随后在测试分数上产生了积极影响。这些效应来自那些没有学前班作为外部选择的儿童。成本效益分析显示，与测试分数提高相关的收入收益可能很大，并且超过与接受offer相关的净成本。

records.title_en: Causal inference of general treatment effects using neural networks with a diverging number of confounders
records.title_cn: 使用神经网络对发散维数混杂因素的一般处理效应进行因果推断
records.abstract_en: Semiparametric efficient estimation of various multi-valued causal effects, including quantile treatment effects, is important in economic, biomedical, and other social sciences. Under the unconfoundedness condition, adjustment for confounders requires estimating the nuisance functions relating outcome or treatment to confounders nonparametrically. This paper considers a generalized optimization framework for efficient estimation of general treatment effects using artificial neural networks (ANNs) to approximate the unknown nuisance function of growing-dimensional confounders. We establish a new approximation error bound for the ANNs to the nuisance function belonging to a mixed smoothness class without a known sparsity structure. We show that the ANNs can alleviate the “curse of dimensionality” under this circumstance. We establish the root-n consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed general treatment effects estimators, and apply a weighted bootstrap procedure for conducting inference. The proposed methods are illustrated via simulation studies and a real data application.
records.abstract_cn: 半参数有效估计各种多值因果效应，包括分位数处理效应，在经济、生物医学和其他社会科学中非常重要。在无混杂性条件下，对混杂因素的调整需要非参数地估计将结果或处理与混杂因素联系起来的干扰函数。本文考虑了一个广义优化框架，使用人工神经网络（ANNs）逼近增长维数混杂因素的未知干扰函数，以有效估计一般处理效应。我们为属于混合光滑性类别且没有已知稀疏结构的干扰函数建立了新的ANNs逼近误差界。我们表明，在这种情况下，ANNs可以缓解“维度灾难”。我们建立了所提出的一般处理效应估计量的根号n一致性和渐近正态性，并应用加权自助法进行推断。通过模拟研究和实际数据应用对所提出的方法进行了说明。

records.title_en: Bayesian estimation of cluster covariance matrices of unknown form
records.title_cn: 未知形式聚类协方差矩阵的贝叶斯估计
records.abstract_en: We develop a flexible Bayesian model for cluster covariance matrices in large dimensions where the number of clusters and the assignment of cross-sectional units to a cluster are a-priori unknown and estimated from the data. In a cluster covariance matrix, the variances and covariances are equal within each diagonal block, while the covariances are equal in each off-diagonal block. This reduces the number of parameters by pooling those parameters together that are in the same cluster. In order to treat the number of clusters and the cluster assignments as unknowns, we build a random partition model which assigns a prior distribution over the space of partitions of the data into clusters. Sampling from the posterior over the space of partitions creates a flexible estimator because it averages across a wide set of cluster covariance matrices. We illustrate our methods on linear factor models and large vector autoregressions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个灵活的贝叶斯模型，用于大维度下的聚类协方差矩阵，其中聚类数量以及横截面单元到聚类的分配是先验未知的，并从数据中估计。在聚类协方差矩阵中，每个对角块内的方差和协方差相等，而每个非对角块内的协方差相等。这通过将同一聚类中的参数合并来减少参数数量。为了将聚类数量和聚类分配视为未知，我们构建了一个随机划分模型，该模型在数据划分成聚类的空间上分配先验分布。从划分空间的后验中抽样创建了一个灵活的估计器，因为它平均了广泛的聚类协方差矩阵集合。我们在线性因子模型和大规模向量自回归上展示了我们的方法。

records.title_en: Testing for coefficient distortion due to outliers with an application to the economic impacts of climate change
records.title_cn: 检验异常值导致的系数失真及其在气候变化经济影响中的应用
records.abstract_en: Outlying observations can bias regression estimates, requiring the use of outlier-robust estimators. Comparing robust estimates to those obtained using ordinary least squares (OLS) is a common robustness check, however, such comparisons have been mostly informal due to the lack of available tests. Here we introduce a formal test for coefficient distortion due to outliers in regression models. Our proposed test is based on the difference between OLS and robust estimates obtained using a class of Huber-skip M-type estimators (such as Impulse Indicator Saturation or Robustified Least Squares). We show that our distortion test has an asymptotic chi-squared distribution by establishing the asymptotics of the corresponding Huber-skip M-estimators using an empirical process Central Limit Theorem recently developed in the literature. The test is valid for cross-sectional, as well as panel, and stationary or deterministically-trending time series models. To improve finite sample performance and to alleviate concerns on distributional assumptions, we explore several bootstrap testing schemes. We apply our outlier distortion test to estimates of the macro-economic impacts of climate change allowing for adaptation.
records.abstract_cn: 异常观测值可能使回归估计产生偏差，因此需要使用对异常值稳健的估计量。将稳健估计与普通最小二乘法（OLS）得到的估计进行比较是一种常见的稳健性检验，然而，由于缺乏可用的检验方法，此类比较大多是非正式的。在此，我们提出一种正式的检验方法，用于检验回归模型中因异常值导致的系数失真。我们提出的检验基于OLS估计与使用一类Huber-skip M型估计量（如脉冲指示饱和或稳健最小二乘）得到的稳健估计之间的差异。我们通过利用文献中最近发展的经验过程中心极限定理，建立了相应的Huber-skip M估计量的渐近性质，证明我们的失真检验具有渐近卡方分布。该检验适用于横截面数据、面板数据以及平稳或确定性趋势时间序列模型。为了改善有限样本性能并缓解对分布假设的担忧，我们探讨了几种自助抽样检验方案。我们将异常值失真检验应用于考虑适应性的气候变化宏观经济影响估计。

records.title_en: Identification in discrete choice models with imperfect information
records.title_cn: 不完全信息下离散选择模型的识别
records.abstract_en: We study identification of preferences in static single-agent discrete choice models where decision makers may be imperfectly informed about the state of the world. Leveraging the notion of one-player Bayes Correlated Equilibrium by Bergemann and Morris (2016), we provide a tractable characterisation of the sharp identified set. We develop a procedure to practically construct the sharp identified set following a sieve approach, and provide sharp bounds on counterfactual outcomes of interest. Using our methodology and data on the 2017 UK general election, we estimate a spatial voting model under weak assumptions on agents’ information about the returns to voting. Counterfactual exercises quantify the consequences of imperfect information on the well-being of voters and parties.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了静态单主体离散选择模型中偏好的识别问题，其中决策者可能对世界状态信息不完全。利用Bergemann和Morris（2016）提出的单主体贝叶斯相关均衡概念，我们提供了尖锐识别集的可处理特征化。我们开发了一种遵循筛法的程序来实际构建尖锐识别集，并提供了感兴趣的反事实结果的尖锐边界。使用我们的方法和关于2017年英国大选的数据，我们在关于投票回报信息的弱假设下估计了一个空间投票模型。反事实练习量化了不完全信息对选民和政党福祉的影响。

records.title_en: Kernel density estimation for undirected dyadic data
records.title_cn: 无向二元数据的核密度估计
records.abstract_en: We study nonparametric estimation of density functions for undirected dyadic random variables (i.e., random variables defined for all n≡defN2 unordered pairs of agents/nodes in a weighted network of order N). These random variables satisfy a local dependence property: any random variables in the network that share one or two indices may be dependent, while those sharing no indices in common are independent. In this setting, we show that density functions may be estimated by an application of the kernel estimation method of Rosenblatt (1956) and Parzen (1962). We suggest an estimate of their asymptotic variances inspired by a combination of (i) Newey’s (1994) method of variance estimation for kernel estimators in the “monadic” setting and (ii) a variance estimator for the (estimated) density of a simple network first suggested by Holland and Leinhardt (1976). More unusual are the rates of convergence and asymptotic (normal) distributions of our dyadic density estimates. Specifically, we show that they converge at the same rate as the (unconditional) dyadic sample mean: the square root of the number, N, of nodes. This differs from the results for nonparametric estimation of densities and regression functions for monadic data, which generally have a slower rate of convergence than their corresponding sample mean.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了无向二元随机变量（即，在N阶加权网络中，为所有n≡defN2个无序代理/节点对定义的随机变量）密度函数的非参数估计。这些随机变量满足局部依赖性质：网络中共享一个或两个索引的任何随机变量可能是依赖的，而共享无共同索引的随机变量是独立的。在此设定下，我们表明密度函数可以通过应用Rosenblatt（1956）和Parzen（1962）的核估计方法进行估计。我们建议一种由其渐近方差的估计，灵感来源于（i）Newey（1994）在“一元”设定中核估计量方差估计方法，和（ii）Holland和Leinhardt（1976）首次提出的简单网络（估计）密度方差估计量的组合。更不寻常的是我们二元密度估计的收敛速率和渐近（正态）分布。具体来说，我们表明它们以与（无条件）二元样本均值相同的速率收敛：节点数N的平方根。这与一元数据的密度和回归函数的非参数估计结果不同，后者通常比其对应的样本均值具有更慢的收敛速率。

records.title_en: Specification tests for non-Gaussian structural vector autoregressions
records.title_cn: 非高斯结构向量自回归的设定检验
records.abstract_en: We propose specification tests for independent component analysis and structural vector autoregressions that assess the cross-sectional independence of non-Gaussian shocks by comparing their joint cumulative distribution with the product of their marginals at both discrete and continuous grids of argument values, the latter yielding a consistent test. We explicitly consider the sampling variability from computing the shocks using consistent estimators. We study the finite sample size of resampled versions of our tests in simulation exercises and show their non-negligible power against a variety of empirically plausible alternatives. Finally, we apply them to a dynamic model for three popular volatility indices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了针对独立成分分析和结构向量自回归的设定检验，通过比较非高斯冲击的联合累积分布与其边缘分布乘积在离散和连续参数网格上的差异来评估冲击的横截面独立性，其中连续网格产生一致检验。我们明确考虑了使用一致估计量计算冲击时的抽样变异性。我们在模拟练习中研究了重采样版本检验的有限样本大小，并展示了它们对多种经验上合理的备择假设具有不可忽略的功效。最后，我们将它们应用于一个包含三个流行波动率指数的动态模型。

records.title_en: A conditional linear combination test with many weak instruments
records.title_cn: 具有许多弱工具变量的条件线性组合检验
records.abstract_en: We consider a linear combination of jackknife Anderson-Rubin (AR), jackknife Lagrangian multiplier (LM), and orthogonalized jackknife LM tests for inference in IV regressions with many weak instruments and heteroskedasticity. Following I.Andrews (2016), we choose the weights in the linear combination based on a decision-theoretic rule that is adaptive to the identification strength. Under both weak and strong identifications, the proposed test controls asymptotic size and is admissible among certain class of tests. Under strong identification, our linear combination test has optimal power against local alternatives among the class of invariant or unbiased tests which are constructed based on jackknife AR and LM tests. Simulations and an empirical application to Angrist and Krueger’s (1991) dataset confirm the good power properties of our test.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了一种由刀切安德森-鲁宾（AR）、刀切拉格朗日乘数（LM）和正交化刀切LM检验组成的线性组合，用于在具有许多弱工具变量和异方差性的IV回归中进行推断。遵循I.安德鲁斯（2016），我们基于一种对识别强度自适应的决策理论规则来选择线性组合中的权重。在弱识别和强识别下，所提出的检验控制了渐近规模，并在某类检验中是可容许的。在强识别下，我们的线性组合检验在基于刀切AR和LM检验构造的不变或无偏检验类中，对局部备择假设具有最优功效。模拟和对安格里斯特和克鲁格（1991）数据集的实证应用证实了我们检验的良好功效性质。

records.title_en: A computational approach to identification of treatment effects for policy evaluation
records.title_cn: 政策评估中处理效应识别的计算方法
records.abstract_en: For counterfactual policy evaluation, it is important to ensure that treatment parameters are relevant to policies in question. This is especially challenging under unobserved heterogeneity, as is well featured in the definition of the local average treatment effect (LATE). Being intrinsically local, the LATE is known to lack external validity in counterfactual environments. This paper investigates the possibility of extrapolating local treatment effects to different counterfactual settings when instrumental variables can be only binary. We propose a novel framework to systematically calculate sharp nonparametric bounds on various policy-relevant treatment parameters that are defined as weighted averages of the marginal treatment effect (MTE). Our framework is flexible enough to fully incorporate statistical independence (rather than mean independence) of instruments and a large menu of identifying assumptions beyond the shape restrictions on the MTE that have been considered in prior studies. We apply our method to understand the effects of medical insurance policies on the use of medical services.
records.abstract_cn: 对于反事实政策评估，确保处理参数与所考虑的政策相关至关重要。在未观测异质性下，这一挑战尤为突出，正如局部平均处理效应（LATE）的定义所充分体现的那样。LATE本质上是局部的，已知在反事实环境中缺乏外部有效性。本文研究了当工具变量只能为二元时，将局部处理效应外推到不同反事实设定的可能性。我们提出了一个新框架，系统计算各种政策相关处理参数的尖锐非参数边界，这些参数定义为边际处理效应（MTE）的加权平均值。我们的框架足够灵活，可以完全纳入工具的统计独立性（而非均值独立性）以及先前研究中考虑过的除MTE形状限制之外的大量识别假设菜单。我们应用我们的方法来理解医疗保险政策对医疗服务使用的影响。

records.title_en: Estimation and bootstrapping under spatiotemporal models with unobserved heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 具有未观测异质性的时空模型下的估计与自助法
records.abstract_en: Proposed herein is a novel spatiotemporal model to characterize the unobserved heterogeneity across individuals using quantile-function-based correlated random effects and heteroscedastic innovations in a general framework. This model can be used to explore the influence of space-specific factors on latent effects at different quantile levels by controlling for spatiotemporal effects. A two-stage estimation procedure is introduced in which (i) the method of moments is used to estimate spatiotemporal effects then (ii) quantile regression is used for individual effects. A hybrid double bootstrapping procedure is then proposed to approximate the asymptotic distributions of coefficient estimators. The validity of the estimation and bootstrapping is established theoretically and then confirmed by simulation studies, and the usefulness of the proposed model is demonstrated with a real example involving city air quality.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖的时空模型，用以在一般框架下通过基于分位函数的相关随机效应和异方差新息来刻画个体间的未观测异质性。该模型可用于在控制时空效应的同时，探索空间特定因素在不同分位水平上对潜在效应的影响。引入了一种两阶段估计程序，其中（i）使用矩方法估计时空效应，然后（ii）使用分位回归估计个体效应。随后提出了一种混合双重自助程序，以近似系数估计量的渐近分布。估计和自助法的有效性在理论上得到确立，并通过模拟研究得到证实，同时通过一个涉及城市空气质量的真实例子展示了所提出模型的实用性。

records.title_en: Reprint of: When will Arctic sea ice disappear? Projections of area, extent, thickness, and volume
records.title_cn: 重印：北极海冰何时消失？面积、范围、厚度和体积的预测
records.abstract_en: Rapidly diminishing Arctic summer sea ice is a strong signal of the pace of global climate change. We provide point, interval, and density forecasts for four measures of Arctic sea ice: area, extent, thickness, and volume. Importantly, we enforce the joint constraint that these measures must simultaneously arrive at an ice-free Arctic. We apply this constrained joint forecast procedure to models relating sea ice to atmospheric carbon dioxide concentration and models relating sea ice directly to time. The resulting “carbon-trend” and “time-trend” projections are mutually consistent and predict a nearly ice-free summer Arctic Ocean by the mid-2030s with an 80% probability. Moreover, the carbon-trend projections show that global adoption of a lower carbon path would likely delay the arrival of a seasonally ice-free Arctic by only a few years.
records.abstract_cn: 北极夏季海冰的迅速减少是全球气候变化速度的一个强烈信号。我们提供了北极海冰四个指标的点预测、区间预测和密度预测：面积、范围、厚度和体积。重要的是，我们强制执行这些指标必须同时达到无冰北极的联合约束。我们将这种受约束的联合预测程序应用于将海冰与大气二氧化碳浓度相关联的模型以及将海冰直接与时间相关联的模型。由此产生的“碳趋势”和“时间趋势”预测相互一致，并预测到2030年代中期，北极夏季海洋几乎无冰的概率为80%。此外，碳趋势预测表明，全球采用较低碳路径可能只会将季节性无冰北极的到来推迟几年。

records.title_en: Identification and estimation of unconditional policy effects of an endogenous binary treatment: An unconditional MTE approach
records.title_cn: 内生二元处理变量的无条件政策效应的识别与估计：一种无条件MTE方法
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the identification and estimation of policy effects when treatment status is binary and endogenous. We introduce a new class of marginal treatment effects (MTEs) based on the influence function of the functional underlying the policy target. We show that an unconditional policy effect can be represented as a weighted average of the newly defined MTEs over the individuals who are indifferent about their treatment status. We provide conditions for point identification of the unconditional policy effects. When a quantile is the functional of interest, we introduce the UNconditional Instrumental Quantile Estimator (UNIQUE) and establish its consistency and asymptotic distribution. In the empirical application, we estimate the effect of changing college enrollment status, induced by higher tuition subsidy, on the quantiles of the wage distribution.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当处理状态为二元且内生时政策效应的识别与估计问题。我们基于政策目标所隐含泛函的影响函数，引入了一类新的边际处理效应（MTEs）。我们证明，无条件政策效应可以表示为新定义的MTEs在处理状态无差异个体上的加权平均值。我们给出了无条件政策效应点识别的条件。当分位数是感兴趣的泛函时，我们引入了无条件工具变量分位数估计量（UNIQUE），并建立了其一致性和渐近分布。在实证应用中，我们估计了由更高学费补贴引起的大学入学状态变化对工资分布分位数的影响。

records.title_en: One instrument to rule them all: The bias and coverage of just-ID IV
records.title_cn: 一器统御：恰好识别工具变量的偏误与覆盖率
records.abstract_en: We revisit the finite-sample behavior of single-variable just-identified instrumental variables (just-ID IV) estimators, arguing that in most microeconometric applications, the usual inference strategies are likely reliable. Three widely-cited applications are used to explain why this is so. We then consider pretesting strategies of the form t1>c, where t1 is the first-stage t-statistic, and the first-stage sign is given. Although pervasive in empirical practice, pretesting on the first-stage F-statistic exacerbates bias and distorts inference. We show, however, that median bias is both minimized and roughly halved by setting c=0, that is by screening on the sign of the estimated first stage. This bias reduction is a free lunch: conventional confidence interval coverage is unchanged by screening on the estimated first-stage sign. To the extent that IV analysts sign-screen already, these results strengthen the case for a sanguine view of the finite-sample behavior of just-ID IV.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视单变量恰好识别工具变量（just-ID IV）估计量的有限样本行为，认为在大多数微观计量应用中，通常的推断策略可能是可靠的。我们使用三个被广泛引用的应用来解释为何如此。然后我们考虑形式为t1>c的预检验策略，其中t1是一阶段t统计量，且一阶段符号已知。尽管在实证实践中普遍存在，对一阶段F统计量进行预检验会加剧偏误并扭曲推断。然而，我们表明，通过设定c=0，即根据估计的一阶段符号进行筛选，中位数偏误既被最小化又被大致减半。这种偏误减少是免费的午餐：传统置信区间覆盖率不因根据估计的一阶段符号进行筛选而改变。就IV分析者已经进行符号筛选而言，这些结果强化了对恰好识别IV有限样本行为持乐观态度的理由。

records.title_en: Estimation of continuous-time linear DSGE models from discrete-time measurements
records.title_cn: 从离散时间测量中估计连续时间线性DSGE模型
records.abstract_en: We provide a general state space framework for estimation of the parameters of continuous-time linear DSGE models from discrete-time data. Our approach relies on the exact discrete-time representation of the equilibrium dynamics, hence avoiding discretization errors. We construct the exact likelihood for data sampled either as stocks or flows, based on the Kalman filter, and provide necessary and sufficient conditions for local identification of the frequency-invariant structural parameters of the underlying continuous-time model. We recover the unobserved structural shocks at measurement times from the reduced-form residuals in the state space representation by exploiting the underlying causal links implied by the economic model. We illustrate our approach using an off-the-shelf real business cycle model. Extensive Monte Carlo experiments show that the finite sample properties of our estimator are superior to those of an estimator relying on a naive Euler–Maruyama discretization of the economic model. In an application to postwar U.S. macroeconomic data, we estimate the model using series sampled at mixed frequencies, and combinations of series sampled as stocks and flows, and we provide a historical decomposition of the effects of shocks on observables into those stemming from structural supply and demand shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个通用的状态空间框架，用于从离散时间数据中估计连续时间线性DSGE模型的参数。我们的方法依赖于均衡动力学的精确离散时间表示，从而避免了离散化误差。我们基于卡尔曼滤波器，为以存量或流量形式采样的数据构建了精确似然函数，并提供了底层连续时间模型的频率不变结构参数局部识别的必要和充分条件。我们通过利用经济模型隐含的底层因果联系，从状态空间表示中的简化形式残差中恢复测量时间点的未观测结构冲击。我们使用一个现成的实际经济周期模型来说明我们的方法。广泛的蒙特卡洛实验表明，我们估计量的有限样本性质优于依赖朴素欧拉-丸山离散化经济模型的估计量。在对战后美国宏观经济数据的应用中，我们使用混合频率采样的序列以及存量与流量组合采样的序列来估计模型，并提供了冲击对可观测变量影响的历史分解，将其分解为结构性供给和需求冲击的影响。

records.title_en: Kolmogorov–Smirnov type testing for structural breaks: A new adjusted-range based self-normalization approach
records.title_cn: 结构突变的Kolmogorov–Smirnov型检验：一种新的基于调整极差的自标准化方法
records.abstract_en: A popular self-normalization (SN) approach in time series analysis uses the variance of a partial sum as a self-normalizer. This is known to be sensitive to irregularities such as persistent autocorrelation, heteroskedasticity, unit roots and outliers. We propose a novel SN approach based on the adjusted-range of a partial sum, which is robust to these aforementioned irregularities. We develop an adjusted-range based Kolmogorov–Smirnov type test for structural breaks for both univariate and multivariate time series, and consider testing parameter constancy in a time series regression setting. Our approach can rectify the well-known power decrease issue associated with existing self-normalized KS tests without having to use backward and forward summations as in Shao and Zhang (2010), and can alleviate the “better size but less power” phenomenon when the existing SN approaches (Shao, 2010; Zhang et al., 2011; Wang and Shao, 2022) are used. Moreover, our proposed tests can cater for more general alternatives. Monte Carlo simulations and empirical studies demonstrate the merits of our approach.
records.abstract_cn: 时间序列分析中一种流行的自标准化（SN）方法使用部分和的方差作为自标准化器。已知该方法对持续自相关、异方差性、单位根和异常值等不规则性敏感。我们提出了一种基于部分和调整极差的新型SN方法，该方法对这些前述不规则性具有稳健性。我们开发了基于调整极差的Kolmogorov–Smirnov型检验，用于单变量和多变量时间序列的结构突变，并考虑在时间序列回归设置中检验参数恒定性。我们的方法可以纠正现有自标准化KS检验中众所周知的功效下降问题，而无需像Shao和Zhang（2010）那样使用向后和向前求和，并且可以缓解使用现有SN方法（Shao，2010；Zhang等，2011；Wang和Shao，2022）时出现的“更好的尺寸但更低的功效”现象。此外，我们提出的检验可以适应更一般的备择假设。蒙特卡洛模拟和实证研究证明了我们方法的优点。

records.title_en: The variance of regression coefficients when the population is finite
records.title_cn: 总体有限时回归系数的方差
records.abstract_en: Recent work has returned attention to the role of finite-population corrections in empirical settings. It is well established that if the only source of variation arises from the sampling design, then the asymptotic variance of regression estimators must include the proportion of the finite population that is sampled. If there is, in addition, a random shock to each element of the finite population, then it is commonly observed that the resulting super-population renders the finite-population correction moot. We explore this setting and find that this common observation does not fully capture the richness of the result. The fraction of the finite population that is sampled defines bounds on the variance of regression estimators. Ignoring the finite-population correction yields the upper bound, which can be quite conservative.
records.abstract_cn: 近期研究重新关注了有限总体修正经验设置中的作用。已充分确立的是，如果变异的唯一来源是抽样设计，那么回归估计量的渐近方差必须包括有限总体中被抽样的比例。此外，如果有限总体的每个元素还受到随机冲击，那么通常观察到由此产生的超总体使得有限总体修正变得无关紧要。我们探讨了这一设置，并发现这一常见观察并未完全捕捉到结果的丰富性。有限总体中被抽样的比例定义了回归估计量方差的界限。忽略有限总体修正得到的是上界，该上界可能相当保守。

records.title_en: Nonparametric Gini-Frisch bounds
records.title_cn: 非参数基尼-弗里施界
records.abstract_en: The Gini-Frisch bounds partially identify the constant slope coefficient in a linear equation when the explanatory variable suffers from classical measurement error. This paper generalizes these quintessential bounds to accommodate nonparametric heterogeneous effects. It provides suitable conditions under which the main insights that underlie the Gini-Frisch bounds apply to partially identify the average marginal effect of an error-laden variable in a nonparametric nonseparable equation. To this end, the paper puts forward a nonparametric analogue to the standard “forward” and “reverse” linear regression bounds. The nonparametric forward regression bound generalizes the linear regression “attenuation bias” due to classical measurement error.
records.abstract_cn: 基尼-弗里施界在解释变量遭受经典测量误差时，部分识别线性方程中的常数斜率系数。本文将这些典型界推广以适应非参数异质性效应。它提供了合适的条件，在这些条件下，基尼-弗里施界背后的主要见解适用于部分识别非参数不可分离方程中带误差变量的平均边际效应。为此，本文提出了标准“正向”和“反向”线性回归界的非参数类比。非参数正向回归界推广了由于经典测量误差导致的线性回归“衰减偏差”。

records.title_en: Estimating option pricing models using a characteristic function-based linear state space representation
records.title_cn: 使用基于特征函数的线性状态空间表示估计期权定价模型
records.abstract_en: We develop a novel filtering and estimation procedure for parametric option pricing models driven by general affine jump-diffusions. Our procedure is based on the comparison between an option-implied, model-free representation of the conditional log-characteristic function and the model-implied conditional log-characteristic function, which is functionally affine in the model’s state vector. We formally derive an associated linear state space representation and the asymptotic properties of the corresponding measurement errors. The state space representation allows us to use a suitably modified Kalman filtering technique to learn about the latent state vector and a quasi-maximum likelihood estimator of the model parameters, for which we establish asymptotic inference results. Accordingly, the filtering and estimation procedure brings important computational advantages. We analyze the finite-sample behavior of our procedure in Monte Carlo simulations. The applicability of our procedure is illustrated in two case studies that analyze S&P 500 option prices and the impact of exogenous state variables capturing Covid-19 reproduction and economic policy uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种新的滤波和估计程序，用于由一般仿射跳跃扩散驱动的参数期权定价模型。我们的程序基于期权隐含的、模型无关的条件对数特征函数表示与模型隐含的条件对数特征函数之间的比较，后者在模型的状态向量中是函数仿射的。我们正式推导了相应的线性状态空间表示以及相应测量误差的渐近性质。状态空间表示使我们能够使用适当修改的卡尔曼滤波技术来了解潜在状态向量，并建立模型参数的拟极大似然估计量，我们为其建立了渐近推断结果。因此，滤波和估计程序带来了重要的计算优势。我们在蒙特卡洛模拟中分析了我们程序的有限样本行为。我们程序的应用性在两个案例研究中得到说明，这些研究分析了S&P 500期权价格以及捕获Covid-19繁殖和经济政策不确定性的外生状态变量的影响。

records.title_en: Is Newey–West optimal among first-order kernels?
records.title_cn: Newey-West 是一阶核中最优的吗？
records.abstract_en: Newey–West (1987) standard errors are the dominant standard errors used for heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation robust (HAR) inference in time series regression. The Newey–West estimator uses the Bartlett kernel, which is a first-order kernel, meaning that its characteristic exponent, q, is equal to 1, where q is defined as the largest value of r for which the quantity k[r](0)=limt→0|t|−r(k(0)−k(t)) is defined and finite. This raises the apparently uninvestigated question of whether the Bartlett kernel is optimal among first-order kernels. We demonstrate that, for q<2, there is no optimal qth-order kernel for HAR testing in the Gaussian location model or for minimizing the MSE in spectral density estimation. In fact, for any q<2, the space of qth-order positive-semidefinite kernels is not closed and, moreover, all continuous qth-order kernels can be decomposed into a weighted sum of qth and second-order kernels, which suggests that there is no meaningful notion of ‘pure’ qth-order kernels for q<2. Nevertheless, it is possible to rank any given collection of qth-order kernels using the functional Iq[k]=k[q](0)1/q∫k2(t)dt with smaller values corresponding to better asymptotic performance. We examine the value of Iq[k] for a wide variety of first-order estimators and find that none improve upon the Bartlett kernel. These comparisons provide additional justification for the continued use of the Newey–West estimator with testing-optimal smoothing parameters and fixed-b critical values despite the lack of optimality of Bartlett among first-order kernels.
records.abstract_cn: Newey–West (1987) 标准误差是时间序列回归中用于异方差性和自相关稳健 (HAR) 推理的主要标准误差。 Newey-West 估计器使用 Bartlett 核，它是一阶核，这意味着它的特征指数 q 等于 1，其中 q 被定义为 r 的最大值，其中量 k[r](0)=limt→0|t|−r(k(0)−k(t)) 被定义并且是有限的。这提出了一个显然未经研究的问题：Bartlett 核是否在一阶核中是最优的。我们证明，对于 q<2，不存在用于高斯位置模型中的 HAR 测试或最小化谱密度估计中的 MSE 的最佳 q 阶核。事实上，对于任何 q<2，q 阶正半定核的空间不是封闭的，此外，所有连续 q 阶核都可以分解为 q 阶核和二阶核的加权和，这表明对于 q<2，不存在“纯”q 阶核的有意义的概念。尽管如此，可以使用函数 Iq[k]=k[q](0)1/q∫k2(t)dt 对任何给定的 q 阶核集合进行排序，较小的值对应于更好的渐近性能。我们检查了各种一阶估计器的 Iq[k] 值，发现没有一个比 Bartlett 核有所改进。这些比较为继续使用具有测试最佳平滑参数和固定 b 临界值的 Newey-West 估计器提供了额外的理由，尽管一阶核中缺乏 Bartlett 的最优性。

records.title_en: Local projections vs. VARs: Lessons from thousands of DGPs
records.title_cn: 局部投影与VAR：来自数千个DGP的经验教训
records.abstract_en: We conduct a simulation study of Local Projection (LP) and Vector Autoregression (VAR) estimators of structural impulse responses across thousands of data generating processes, designed to mimic the properties of the universe of U.S. macroeconomic data. Our analysis considers various identification schemes and several variants of LP and VAR estimators, employing bias correction, shrinkage, or model averaging. A clear bias–variance trade-off emerges: LP estimators have lower bias than VAR estimators, but they also have substantially higher variance at intermediate and long horizons. Bias-corrected LP is the preferred method if and only if the researcher overwhelmingly prioritizes bias. For researchers who also care about precision, VAR methods are the most attractive—Bayesian VARs at short and long horizons, and least-squares VARs at intermediate and long horizons.
records.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一项模拟研究，比较了局部投影（LP）和向量自回归（VAR）估计量在数千个数据生成过程中的结构脉冲响应，这些过程旨在模仿美国宏观经济数据总体的特性。我们的分析考虑了多种识别方案以及LP和VAR估计量的几种变体，采用了偏差校正、收缩或模型平均。一个清晰的偏差-方差权衡出现了：LP估计量比VAR估计量具有更低的偏差，但在中期和长期视野中，它们的方差也显著更高。当且仅当研究者极度优先考虑偏差时，偏差校正的LP是首选方法。对于也关注精度的研究者，VAR方法最具吸引力——在短期和长期视野中为贝叶斯VAR，在中期和长期视野中为最小二乘VAR。

records.title_en: An identification and testing strategy for proxy-SVARs with weak proxies
records.title_cn: 弱工具变量下代理SVAR的识别与检验策略
records.abstract_en: When proxies (external instruments) used to identify target structural shocks are weak, inference in proxy-SVARs (SVAR-IVs) is nonstandard and the construction of asymptotically valid confidence sets for the impulse responses of interest requires weak-instrument robust methods. In the presence of multiple target shocks, test inversion techniques require extra restrictions on the proxy-SVAR parameters other than those implied by the proxies that may be difficult to interpret and test. We show that frequentist asymptotic inference in these situations can be conducted through Minimum Distance estimation and standard asymptotic methods if the proxy-SVAR can be identified by using ‘strong’ instruments for the non-target shocks; i.e., the shocks which are not of primary interest in the analysis. The suggested identification strategy hinges on a novel pre-test for the null of instrument relevance, based on bootstrap resampling, which is not subject to pre-testing issues. Specifically, the validity of post-test asymptotic inferences remains unaffected by the test outcomes due to an asymptotic independence result between the bootstrap and non-bootstrap statistics. The test is robust to conditionally heteroskedastic and/or zero-censored proxies, is computationally straightforward and applicable regardless of the number of shocks being instrumented. Some illustrative examples show the empirical usefulness of the suggested identification and testing strategy.
records.abstract_cn: 当用于识别目标结构性冲击的代理变量（外部工具）较弱时，代理SVAR（SVAR-IV）中的推断是非标准的，并且为感兴趣的脉冲响应构建渐近有效的置信集需要弱工具稳健方法。在存在多个目标冲击的情况下，检验反转技术需要对代理SVAR参数施加除代理变量所隐含的限制之外的额外限制，这些限制可能难以解释和检验。我们表明，如果代理SVAR可以通过使用针对非目标冲击（即分析中非主要关注的冲击）的“强”工具来识别，那么在这些情况下，频率学派的渐近推断可以通过最小距离估计和标准渐近方法进行。所建议的识别策略依赖于一个新颖的预检验，用于检验工具相关性的原假设，该检验基于自助重抽样，并且不受预检验问题的影响。具体而言，由于自助统计量与非自助统计量之间的渐近独立性结果，检验后渐近推断的有效性不受检验结果的影响。该检验对条件异方差和/或零截断的代理变量具有稳健性，计算简便，并且适用于任何数量的被工具化冲击。一些说明性例子显示了所建议的识别与检验策略的经验实用性。

records.title_en: Inference for low-rank completion without sample splitting with application to treatment effect estimation
records.title_cn: 低秩补全的推断理论：无需样本分割及其在治疗效果估计中的应用
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the inferential theory for estimating low-rank matrices. It also provides an inference method for the average treatment effect as an application. We show that the least square estimation of eigenvectors following the nuclear norm penalization attains the asymptotic normality. The key contribution of our method is that it does not require sample splitting. In addition, this paper allows dependent observation patterns and heterogeneous observation probabilities. Empirically, we apply the proposed procedure to estimating the impact of the presidential vote on allocating the U.S. federal budget to the states.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了低秩矩阵估计的推断理论，并作为应用提供了平均治疗效果的一种推断方法。我们证明，在核范数惩罚之后，特征向量的最小二乘估计达到了渐近正态性。我们方法的关键贡献在于它不需要样本分割。此外，本文允许依赖的观测模式和异质的观测概率。在实证上，我们将所提出的程序应用于估计总统投票对美国联邦预算分配给各州的影响。

records.title_en: Identification of multi-valued treatment effects with unobserved heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 具有未观测异质性的多值处理效应的识别
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we establish sufficient conditions for identifying treatment effects on continuous outcomes in endogenous and multi-valued discrete treatment settings with unobserved heterogeneity. We employ the monotonicity assumption for multi-valued discrete treatments and instruments, and our identification condition has a clear economic interpretation. In addition, we identify the local treatment effects in multi-valued treatment settings and derive closed-form expressions of the identified treatment effects. We provide examples to illustrate the usefulness of our result.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们建立了在内生且多值离散处理设置中，具有未观测异质性时连续结果处理效应的充分识别条件。我们采用多值离散处理和工具变量的单调性假设，且我们的识别条件具有清晰的经济解释。此外，我们识别了多值处理设置中的局部处理效应，并推导出已识别处理效应的闭式表达式。我们提供示例以说明我们结果的有用性。

records.title_en: On uniform confidence intervals for the tail index and the extreme quantile
records.title_cn: 关于尾部指数和极端分位数的均匀置信区间
records.abstract_en: This paper presents two results concerning uniform confidence intervals for the tail index and the extreme quantile. First, we show that there exists a lower bound of the length for confidence intervals that satisfy the correct uniform coverage over a nonparametric family of tail distributions. Second, in light of the impossibility result, we construct honest confidence intervals that are uniformly valid by incorporating the worst-case bias in the nonparametric family. The proposed method is applied to simulated data and real data of financial time series.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了关于尾部指数和极端分位数的均匀置信区间的两个结果。首先，我们证明了在满足尾部分布非参数族上正确均匀覆盖的置信区间存在长度下界。其次，鉴于不可能性结果，我们通过纳入非参数族中的最坏情况偏差，构建了均匀有效的诚实置信区间。所提出的方法应用于模拟数据和金融时间序列的真实数据。

records.title_en: Instrumental variable estimation with first-stage heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 具有第一阶段异质性的工具变量估计
records.abstract_en: We propose a simple data-driven procedure that exploits heterogeneity in the first-stage correlation between an instrument and an endogenous variable to improve the asymptotic mean squared error (MSE) of instrumental variable estimators. We show that the resulting gains in asymptotic MSE can be quite large in settings where there is substantial heterogeneity in the first-stage parameters. We also show that a naive procedure used in some applied work, which consists of selecting the composition of the sample based on the value of the first-stage t-statistic, may cause substantial over-rejection of a null hypothesis on a second-stage parameter. We apply the methods to study (1) the return to schooling using the minimum school leaving age as the exogenous instrument and (2) the effect of local economic conditions on voter turnout using energy supply shocks as the source of identification.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种简单的数据驱动程序，利用工具变量与内生变量之间第一阶段相关性的异质性来改进工具变量估计量的渐近均方误差（MSE）。我们表明，在第一阶段参数存在显著异质性的情况下，渐近MSE的改进可能相当大。我们还表明，一些应用工作中使用的朴素程序，即根据第一阶段t统计量的值选择样本构成，可能导致对第二阶段参数的零假设的过度拒绝。我们将这些方法应用于研究（1）使用最低离校年龄作为外生工具变量时的教育回报率，以及（2）使用能源供应冲击作为识别来源时当地经济状况对选民投票率的影响。

records.title_en: Estimation and variable selection for high-dimensional spatial dynamic panel data models
records.title_cn: 高维空间动态面板数据模型的估计与变量选择
records.abstract_en: Spatiotemporal modeling of networks is of great practical importance, with modern applications in epidemiology and social network analysis. Despite rapid methodological advances, how to effectively and efficiently estimate the parameters of spatial dynamic panel models remains a challenging problem. To tackle this problem, we construct consistent complex least-squares estimators by the eigendecomposition of a spatial weight matrix method originally proposed for undirected networks. We no longer require all eigenvalues and eigenvectors to be real, which is a remarkable achievement as it implies that the proposed method is now applicable to spatiotemporal data modeling of directed networks. Under mild, interpretable conditions, we show that the proposed parameter estimators are consistent and asymptotically normally distributed. We also present a complex orthogonal greedy algorithm for variable selection and rigorously investigate its convergence properties. Moreover, we incorporate fixed effects into the spatial dynamic panel models and provide a model transformation so that the proposed method can also be applied to the transformed model. Extensive simulation studies and data examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
records.abstract_cn: 网络的时空建模具有重要的实际意义，在现代流行病学和社会网络分析中有着广泛应用。尽管方法学上取得了快速进展，如何有效且高效地估计空间动态面板模型的参数仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。为解决这一问题，我们通过空间权重矩阵的特征分解方法构建了一致复最小二乘估计量，该方法最初是为无向网络提出的。我们不再要求所有特征值和特征向量为实数，这是一项显著成就，因为它意味着所提出的方法现在适用于有向网络的时空数据建模。在温和且可解释的条件下，我们证明了所提出的参数估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性。我们还提出了一种复正交贪婪算法用于变量选择，并严格研究了其收敛性质。此外，我们将固定效应纳入空间动态面板模型，并提供模型变换，使得所提出的方法也能应用于变换后的模型。广泛的模拟研究和数据实例证明了所提出方法的有效性。

records.title_en: Confidence intervals of treatment effects in panel data models with interactive fixed effects
records.title_cn: 具有交互固定效应的面板数据模型中处理效应的置信区间
records.abstract_en: We augment the factor-based estimation of treatment effects proposed by Bai and Ng (2021) with easy-to-implement and nonparametric confidence intervals of treatment effects on every treated unit at every post-treatment time. The construction of confidence intervals entails a residual-based bootstrap resampling procedure. This method does not rely on any parametric assumption on the distribution of idiosyncratic errors and it is robust to weak cross-sectional and time-series dependence among idiosyncratic errors. We prove the asymptotic validity of the proposed confidence intervals as the numbers of control units and pre-treatment times go to infinity. We also extend this method to cases where the common factors and covariates (if any) are unit root processes. Monte Carlo experiments show that the proposed confidence intervals are well-behaved in finite samples and outperform confidence intervals based on normal quantiles. Empirical applications with two classical datasets add informative confidence intervals to existing point estimates of treatment effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我们扩展了Bai和Ng（2021）提出的基于因子的处理效应估计方法，为每个处理后时期每个受处理单位的处理效应提供了易于实现且非参数的置信区间。置信区间的构建涉及基于残差的bootstrap重抽样程序。该方法不依赖于对异质性误差分布的任何参数假设，并且对异质性误差之间的弱横截面和时间序列依赖性具有稳健性。我们证明了当控制单位数量和处理前时间趋于无穷时，所提出的置信区间具有渐近有效性。我们还将该方法扩展到共同因子和协变量（如果有）为单位根过程的情况。蒙特卡洛实验表明，所提出的置信区间在有限样本中表现良好，并且优于基于正态分位数的置信区间。使用两个经典数据集的实证应用为现有的处理效应点估计增加了信息丰富的置信区间。

records.title_en: Population interference in panel experiments
records.title_cn: 面板实验中的总体干扰
records.abstract_en: The phenomenon of population interference, where a treatment assigned to one experimental unit affects another experimental unit’s outcome, has received considerable attention in standard randomized experiments. The complications produced by population interference in this setting are now readily recognized, and partial remedies are well known. Less understood is the impact of population interference in panel experiments where treatment is sequentially randomized in the population, and the outcomes are observed at each time step. This paper proposes a general framework for studying population interference in panel experiments and presents new finite population estimation and inference results. Our findings suggest that, under mild assumptions, the addition of a temporal dimension to an experiment alleviates some of the challenges of population interference for certain estimands. In contrast, we show that the presence of carryover effects — that is, when past treatments may affect future outcomes — exacerbates the problem. Our results are illustrated through both an empirical analysis and an extensive simulation study.
records.abstract_cn: 总体干扰现象，即分配给一个实验单元的处理影响另一个实验单元的结果，在标准随机化实验中已受到相当关注。在此背景下，总体干扰所产生的复杂性现已得到充分认识，部分补救措施也已广为人知。然而，对于总体干扰在面板实验中的影响，即处理在总体中顺序随机化且每个时间步观测结果的情况，人们了解较少。本文提出了一个研究面板实验中总体干扰的通用框架，并给出了新的有限总体估计和推断结果。我们的研究结果表明，在温和假设下，向实验添加时间维度可缓解总体干扰对某些估计量带来的部分挑战。相反，我们证明，携带效应的存在——即过去的处理可能影响未来的结果——会加剧这一问题。我们的结果通过实证分析和广泛的模拟研究加以说明。

records.title_en: Tuning-parameter-free propensity score matching approach for causal inference under shape restriction
records.title_cn: 形状约束下无调参倾向得分匹配的因果推断方法
records.abstract_en: Propensity score matching (PSM) is a pseudo-experimental method that uses statistical techniques to construct an artificial control group by matching each treated unit with one or more untreated units of similar characteristics. To date, the problem of determining the optimal number of matches per unit, which plays an important role in PSM, has not been adequately addressed. We propose a tuning-parameter-free PSM approach to causal inference based on the nonparametric maximum-likelihood estimation of the propensity score under the monotonicity constraint. The estimated propensity score is piecewise constant, and therefore automatically groups data. Hence, our proposal is free of tuning parameters. The proposed causal effect estimator is asymptotically semiparametric efficient when the covariate is univariate or the outcome and the propensity score depend on the covariate through the same index X⊤β. We conclude that matching methods based on the propensity score alone cannot, in general, be efficient.
records.abstract_cn: 倾向得分匹配（PSM）是一种准实验方法，通过统计技术构建人工对照组，将每个处理单元与一个或多个特征相似的未处理单元进行匹配。迄今为止，确定每个单元的最优匹配数量（在PSM中起重要作用）的问题尚未得到充分解决。我们提出了一种无调参的PSM因果推断方法，该方法基于在单调性约束下对倾向得分进行非参数最大似然估计。估计的倾向得分是分段常数，因此自动对数据进行分组。因此，我们的方法无需调整参数。当协变量是单变量，或者结果和倾向得分通过相同的指标X⊤β依赖于协变量时，所提出的因果效应估计量渐近半参数有效。我们得出结论，仅基于倾向得分的匹配方法通常不能达到有效估计。

records.title_en: Heterogeneity of consumption responses to income shocks in the presence of nonlinear persistence
records.title_cn: 非线性持续性存在下消费对收入冲击响应的异质性
records.abstract_en: In this paper we use the enhanced consumption data in the Panel Survey of Income Dynamics (PSID) from 2005–2017 to explore the transmission of income shocks to consumption. We build on the nonlinear quantile framework introduced in Arellano et al. (2017). Our focus is on the estimation of consumption responses to persistent nonlinear income shocks in the presence of unobserved heterogeneity. To reliably estimate heterogeneous responses in our unbalanced panel, we develop Sequential Monte Carlo computational methods. We find substantial heterogeneity in consumption responses, and uncover latent types of households with different life-cycle consumption behavior. Ordering types according to their average log-consumption, we find that low-consumption types respond more strongly to income shocks at the beginning of the life cycle and when their assets are low, as standard life-cycle theory would predict. In contrast, high-consumption types respond less on average, and in a way that changes little with age or assets. We examine various mechanisms that might explain this heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们使用面板收入动态调查（PSID）中2005-2017年的增强消费数据来探讨收入冲击向消费的传导。我们基于Arellano等人（2017）引入的非线性分位数框架。我们的重点是估计在存在未观测异质性的情况下，消费对持续性非线性收入冲击的响应。为了在我们的非平衡面板中可靠地估计异质性响应，我们开发了序贯蒙特卡洛计算方法。我们发现消费响应存在显著的异质性，并揭示了具有不同生命周期消费行为的潜在家庭类型。根据平均对数消费对类型进行排序，我们发现低消费类型在生命周期初期和资产较低时对收入冲击的响应更强，这与标准生命周期理论的预测一致。相比之下，高消费类型的平均响应较弱，且其响应随年龄或资产的变化很小。我们考察了可能解释这种异质性的各种机制。

records.title_en: Tail behavior of ACD models and consequences for likelihood-based estimation
records.title_cn: ACD模型的尾部行为及其对基于似然估计的影响
records.abstract_en: We establish new results for estimation and inference in financial durations models, where events are observed over a given time span, such as a trading day, or a week. For the classical autoregressive conditional duration (ACD) models by Engle and Russell (1998), we show that the large sample behavior of likelihood estimators is highly sensitive to the tail behavior of the financial durations. In particular, even under stationarity, asymptotic normality breaks down for tail indices smaller than one or, equivalently, when the clustering behavior of the observed events is such that the unconditional distribution of the durations has no finite mean. Instead, we find that estimators are mixed Gaussian and have non-standard rates of convergence. The results are based on exploiting the crucial fact that for duration data the number of observations within any given time span is random. Our results apply to general econometric models where the number of observed events is random.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为金融持续时间模型的估计和推断建立了新的结果，其中事件在给定的时间跨度内被观测，例如一个交易日或一周。对于Engle和Russell（1998）提出的经典自回归条件持续时间（ACD）模型，我们证明了似然估计量的大样本行为对金融持续时间的尾部行为高度敏感。特别是，即使在平稳性下，当尾部指数小于一时，或者等价地，当观测事件的聚类行为使得持续时间的无条件分布没有有限均值时，渐近正态性会失效。相反，我们发现估计量是混合高斯的，并且具有非标准的收敛速率。这些结果基于利用一个关键事实：对于持续时间数据，任何给定时间跨度内的观测数量是随机的。我们的结果适用于观测事件数量随机的通用计量经济模型。

records.title_en: Panel data models with time-varying latent group structures
records.title_cn: 具有时变潜在群组结构的面板数据模型
records.abstract_en: This paper considers a linear panel model with interactive fixed effects and unobserved individual and time heterogeneities that are captured by some latent group structures and an unknown structural break, respectively. To enhance realism, the model may have different numbers of groups and/or different group memberships before and after the break. With preliminary nuclear norm regularized estimation followed by row- and column-wise linear regressions, we estimate the break point based on the idea of binary segmentation and the latent group structures together with the number of groups before and after the break by sequential testing K-means algorithm simultaneously. It is shown that the break point, the number of groups and the group memberships can each be estimated correctly with probability approaching one. Asymptotic distributions of the estimators of the slope coefficients are established. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate excellent finite sample performance for the proposed estimation algorithm. An empirical application to real house price data across 377 Metropolitan Statistical Areas in the US from 1975 to 2014 suggests the presence both of structural breaks and of changes in group membership.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了一个具有交互固定效应的线性面板模型，其中未观测到的个体和时间的异质性分别由一些潜在的群组结构和未知的结构突变所捕捉。为了增强现实性，该模型在突变前后可能具有不同数量的群组和/或不同的群组成员。通过初步的核范数正则化估计，随后进行行和列的线性回归，我们基于二元分割的思想估计突变点，并通过序贯检验K均值算法同时估计突变前后的潜在群组结构及群组数量。结果表明，突变点、群组数量和群组成员均能以趋近于一的概率被正确估计。建立了斜率系数估计量的渐近分布。蒙特卡洛模拟表明所提出的估计算法具有优异的有限样本性能。对1975年至2014年间美国377个大都市统计区的真实房价数据的实证应用表明，存在结构突变和群组成员的变化。

records.title_en: Tuning parameter-free nonparametric density estimation from tabulated summary data
records.title_cn: 基于表格汇总数据的无调参非参数密度估计
records.abstract_en: Administrative data are often easier to access as tabulated summaries than in the original format due to confidentiality concerns. Motivated by this practical feature, we propose a novel nonparametric density estimation method from tabulated summary data based on maximum entropy and prove its strong uniform consistency. Unlike existing kernel-based estimators, our estimator is free from tuning parameters and admits a closed-form density that is convenient for post-estimation analysis. We apply the proposed method to the tabulated summary data of the U.S. tax returns to estimate the income distribution.
records.abstract_cn: 行政数据由于保密性的考虑，往往以表格汇总的形式比原始格式更容易获取。受这一实际特点的启发，我们提出了一种基于最大熵的表格汇总数据非参数密度估计新方法，并证明了其强一致收敛性。与现有的基于核的估计器不同，我们的估计器无需调整参数，且具有封闭形式的密度，便于估计后分析。我们将所提出的方法应用于美国纳税申报表的表格汇总数据，以估计收入分布。

records.title_en: A method of moments approach to asymptotically unbiased Synthetic Controls
records.title_cn: 矩方法在渐近无偏合成控制中的应用
records.abstract_en: A common approach to constructing a Synthetic Control unit is to fit on the outcome variable and covariates in pre-treatment time periods, but it has been shown by Ferman and Pinto (2021) that this approach does not provide asymptotic unbiasedness when the fit is imperfect and the number of controls is fixed. Many related panel methods have a similar limitation when the number of units is fixed. I introduce and evaluate a new method in which the Synthetic Control is constructed using a General Method of Moments approach where units not being included in the Synthetic Control are used as instruments. I show that a Synthetic Control Estimator of this form will be asymptotically unbiased as the number of pre-treatment time periods goes to infinity, even when pre-treatment fit is imperfect and the number of units is fixed. Furthermore, if both the number of pre-treatment and post-treatment time periods go to infinity, then averages of treatment effects can be consistently estimated. I provide a model selection procedure for deciding whether a unit should be used as an instrument or as a control. I also conduct simulations and an empirical application to compare the performance of this method with existing approaches in the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 构建合成控制单元的一种常见方法是在预处理时间段内对结果变量和协变量进行拟合，但Ferman和Pinto（2021）已证明，当拟合不完美且控制单元数量固定时，这种方法不能提供渐近无偏性。当单元数量固定时，许多相关的面板方法也有类似的局限性。我介绍并评估了一种新方法，其中使用广义矩方法构建合成控制，将未包含在合成控制中的单元用作工具变量。我证明了这种形式的合成控制估计量在预处理时间段数趋于无穷时是渐近无偏的，即使预处理拟合不完美且单元数量固定。此外，如果预处理和后处理时间段数都趋于无穷，则可以一致地估计处理效应的平均值。我提供了一种模型选择程序，用于决定一个单元应作为工具变量还是作为控制单元。我还进行了模拟和实证应用，以将该方法的性能与文献中现有方法进行比较。

records.title_en: Robust testing for explosive behavior with strongly dependent errors
records.title_cn: 强相依误差下爆炸行为的稳健检验
records.abstract_en: A heteroskedasticity-autocorrelation robust (HAR) test statistic is proposed to test for the presence of explosive roots in financial or real asset prices when the equation errors are strongly dependent. Limit theory for the test statistic is developed and extended to heteroskedastic models. The new test has stable size properties unlike conventional test statistics that typically lead to size distortion and inconsistency in the presence of strongly dependent equation errors. The new procedure can be used to consistently time-stamp the origination and termination of an explosive episode under similar conditions of long memory errors. Simulations are conducted to assess the finite sample performance of the proposed test and estimators. An empirical application to the S&P 500 index highlights the usefulness of the proposed procedures in practical work.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种异方差自相关稳健（HAR）检验统计量，用于在方程误差强相依时检验金融或实物资产价格中是否存在爆炸根。发展了该检验统计量的极限理论，并将其扩展到异方差模型。与在强相依方程误差下通常导致尺寸失真和不一致的传统检验统计量不同，新检验具有稳定的尺寸性质。新方法可用于在长记忆误差的类似条件下一致地标记爆炸性发作的开始和结束。进行了模拟以评估所提检验和估计量的有限样本性能。对S&P 500指数的实证应用突出了所提方法在实际工作中的有用性。

records.title_en: Non-representative sampled networks: Estimation of network structural properties by weighting
records.title_cn: 非代表性抽样网络：通过加权估计网络结构属性
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes statistical issues arising from non-representative samples of a network. Sampled network data could systematically bias the network properties and generate non-classical measurement error problems. Apart from the sampling rate and the elicitation procedure, the biases on network structural measures depend non-trivially on which subpopulations of nodes are missing with higher probability.
