We propose a methodology, adapting weighted estimators to networked contexts, which enables researchers to recover several network-level statistics and reduce the biases in the estimated network effects. The proposed weighted estimators are consistent and asymptotically normally distributed and have good performance in finite samples. Notably, our approach does not require users to assume any network formation model and is straightforward to implement.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了网络非代表性样本引发的统计问题。抽样网络数据可能系统性地偏倚网络属性，并产生非经典测量误差问题。除抽样率和诱导程序外，网络结构测度的偏倚还非平凡地依赖于哪些节点亚群以更高概率缺失。我们提出了一种方法，将加权估计器适应于网络情境，使研究者能够恢复若干网络层面统计量并减少估计网络效应中的偏倚。所提出的加权估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性，且在有限样本中表现良好。值得注意的是，我们的方法不要求用户假设任何网络形成模型，且易于实施。

records.title_en: Asset pricing with neural networks: Significance tests
records.title_cn: 神经网络资产定价：显著性检验
records.abstract_en: This study proposes a novel hypothesis test for evaluating the statistical significance of input variables in multi-layer perceptron (MLP) regression models. Theoretical foundations are established through consistency results and estimation rate analysis using the sieves method. To validate the test’s performance in complex and realistic settings, an extensive Monte Carlo simulation is conducted. Results of the simulation reveal that the test has a high power and low rate of false positives, making it a powerful tool for detecting true effects in data. The test is further applied to identify the most influential predictors of equity risk premiums, with results indicating that only a small number of characteristics have statistical significance and all macroeconomic predictors are insignificant at the 1% level. These findings are consistent across a variety of neural network architectures.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一种新颖的假设检验方法，用于评估多层感知器（MLP）回归模型中输入变量的统计显著性。通过筛法（sieves method）的一致性结果和估计速率分析，建立了理论基础。为了在复杂和现实的环境中验证检验的性能，进行了广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟。模拟结果显示，该检验具有较高的功效和较低的误报率，使其成为检测数据中真实效应的有力工具。该检验进一步应用于识别股票风险溢价最具影响力的预测因子，结果表明只有少数特征具有统计显著性，且所有宏观经济预测因子在1%水平上均不显著。这些发现在各种神经网络架构中保持一致。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous treatment effect bounds under sample selection with an application to the effects of social media on political polarization
records.title_cn: 样本选择下的异质性处理效应边界：以社交媒体对政治两极分化的影响为例
records.abstract_en: We propose a method for estimation and inference for bounds for heterogeneous causal effect parameters in general sample selection models where the treatment can affect whether an outcome is observed and no exclusion restrictions are available. The method provides conditional effect bounds as functions of policy relevant pre-treatment variables. It allows for conducting valid statistical inference on the unidentified conditional effects. We use a flexible debiased/double machine learning approach that can accommodate non-linear functional forms and high-dimensional confounders. Easily verifiable high-level conditions for estimation, misspecification robust confidence intervals, and uniform confidence bands are provided as well. We re-analyze data from a large scale field experiment on Facebook on counter-attitudinal news subscription with attrition. Our method yields substantially tighter effect bounds compared to conventional methods and suggests depolarization effects for younger users.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种方法，用于在一般样本选择模型中对异质性因果效应参数的边界进行估计和推断，其中处理可能影响结果是否被观测到，且没有排除限制可用。该方法提供了作为政策相关预处理变量函数的条件效应边界。它允许对未识别的条件效应进行有效的统计推断。我们采用灵活的去偏/双机器学习方法，能够适应非线性函数形式和高维混杂因素。还提供了易于验证的高阶条件，用于估计、误设稳健置信区间和一致置信带。我们重新分析了Facebook上一项关于反态度新闻订阅并存在流失的大规模现场实验数据。与常规方法相比，我们的方法产生了显著更紧的效应边界，并提示年轻用户存在去极化效应。

records.title_en: Distributed estimation and inference for spatial autoregression model with large scale networks
records.title_cn: 大规模网络空间自回归模型的分布式估计与推断
records.abstract_en: The rapid growth of online network platforms generates large-scale network data and it poses great challenges for statistical analysis using the spatial autoregression (SAR) model. In this work, we develop a novel distributed estimation and statistical inference framework for the SAR model on a distributed system. We first propose a distributed network least squares approximation (DNLSA) method. This enables us to obtain a one-step estimator by taking a weighted average of local estimators on each worker. Afterwards, a refined two-step estimation is designed to further reduce the estimation bias. For statistical inference, we utilize a random projection method to reduce the expensive communication cost. Theoretically, we show the consistency and asymptotic normality of both the one-step and two-step estimators. In addition, we provide theoretical guarantee of the distributed statistical inference procedure. The theoretical findings and computational advantages are validated by several numerical simulations implemented on the Spark system. Lastly, an experiment on the Yelp dataset further illustrates the usefulness of the proposed methodology.
records.abstract_cn: 在线网络平台的快速增长产生了大规模网络数据，这给使用空间自回归（SAR）模型进行统计分析带来了巨大挑战。在这项工作中，我们为分布式系统上的SAR模型开发了一种新颖的分布式估计和统计推断框架。我们首先提出了一种分布式网络最小二乘近似（DNLSA）方法。这使得我们能够通过对每个工作节点上的局部估计量进行加权平均来获得一步估计量。随后，设计了一种精细的两步估计方法以进一步减少估计偏差。对于统计推断，我们利用随机投影方法来降低昂贵的通信成本。理论上，我们证明了一步和两步估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。此外，我们为分布式统计推断过程提供了理论保证。通过在Spark系统上实施的若干数值模拟验证了理论发现和计算优势。最后，在Yelp数据集上的实验进一步说明了所提出方法的实用性。

records.title_en: Nonparametric estimation for high-frequency data incorporating trading information
records.title_cn: 结合交易信息的高频数据非参数估计
records.abstract_en: We propose nonparametric estimators for the explicative part of the noise in a model where the market microstructure noise is an unknown function of the trading information while allowing for the presence of an additional residual noise component. Our method allows for dependence in the observable trading information and accommodates the presence of infinite variation jumps in the efficient price process. We establish the convergence and asymptotic normality of the proposed estimators. We also propose a two-step Laplace estimator of integrated volatility where we replace the observed price with the estimated price by removing the explicative part of the market microstructure noise. The finite sample properties of both the nonparametric estimators and the two-step Laplace estimator are examined through Monte Carlo simulations. We find that our method is robust to misspecification of the unknown functional form given finite sample size. Furthermore, an empirical application using high-frequency data demonstrates that our method outperforms commonly employed parametric methods.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个模型中噪声解释部分的非参数估计量，其中市场微观结构噪声是交易信息的未知函数，同时允许存在额外的残余噪声成分。我们的方法允许可观测交易信息中的依赖性，并适应有效价格过程中无限变差跳跃的存在。我们建立了所提出估计量的收敛性和渐近正态性。我们还提出了一种两步拉普拉斯积分波动率估计量，其中通过去除市场微观结构噪声的解释部分，用估计价格替换观测价格。通过蒙特卡洛模拟检验了非参数估计量和两步拉普拉斯估计量的有限样本性质。我们发现，在有限样本量下，我们的方法对未知函数形式的错误设定具有稳健性。此外，使用高频数据的实证应用表明，我们的方法优于常用的参数方法。

records.title_en: Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Non-Stationary Location Models with Mixture of Normal Distributions
records.title_cn: 混合正态分布非平稳位置模型的最大似然估计
records.abstract_en: We consider an observation-driven location model where the unobserved location variable is modeled as a random walk process and where the error variable is from a mixture of normal distributions. The time-varying location can be extended with a stationary process to account for cyclical and/or higher order autocorrelation. The mixed normal distribution can accurately approximate many continuous error distributions. We obtain a flexible modeling framework for the robust filtering and forecasting based on time-series models with non-stationary and nonlinear features. We provide sufficient conditions for strong consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator of the parameter vector in the specified model. The asymptotic properties are valid under correct model specification and can be generalized to allow for potential misspecification of the model. A simulation study is carried out to monitor the forecast accuracy improvements when extra mixture components are added to the model. In an empirical study we show that our approach is able to outperform alternative observation-driven location models in forecast accuracy for a time-series of electricity spot prices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个观测驱动的位置模型，其中未观测的位置变量被建模为随机游走过程，误差变量来自正态分布的混合。时变位置可以扩展一个平稳过程以考虑周期性和/或高阶自相关。混合正态分布可以准确近似许多连续误差分布。我们获得了一个灵活的建模框架，用于基于具有非平稳和非线性特征的时间序列模型的稳健滤波和预测。我们提供了指定模型中参数向量最大似然估计强一致性和渐近正态性的充分条件。渐近性质在正确模型设定下有效，并可推广以允许模型的潜在错误设定。进行了一项模拟研究，以监测当模型中添加额外混合成分时预测精度的改进。在一项实证研究中，我们表明我们的方法在电力现货价格时间序列的预测精度上能够优于替代的观测驱动位置模型。

records.title_en: Autoregressive conditional betas
records.title_cn: 自回归条件贝塔
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces an autoregressive conditional beta (ACB) model that allows regressions with dynamic betas (or slope coefficients) and residuals with GARCH conditional volatility. The model fits in the (quasi) score-driven approach recently proposed in the literature, and it is semi-parametric in the sense that the distributions of the innovations are not necessarily specified. The time-varying betas are allowed to depend on past shocks and exogenous variables. We establish the existence of a stationary solution for the ACB model, the invertibility of the score-driven filter for the time-varying betas, and the asymptotic properties of one-step and multistep QMLEs for the new ACB model. The finite sample properties of these estimators are studied by means of an extensive Monte Carlo study. Finally, we also propose a strategy to test for the constancy of the conditional betas. In a financial application, we find evidence for time-varying conditional betas and highlight the empirical relevance of the ACB model in a portfolio and risk management empirical exercise.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种自回归条件贝塔（ACB）模型，该模型允许具有动态贝塔（或斜率系数）的回归以及具有GARCH条件波动率的残差。该模型适用于文献中最近提出的（拟）得分驱动方法，并且是半参数的，因为创新项的分布不一定需要指定。时变贝塔被允许依赖于过去的冲击和外生变量。我们建立了ACB模型平稳解的存在性、时变贝塔的得分驱动滤波器的可逆性，以及新ACB模型的一步和多步QMLE的渐近性质。通过广泛的蒙特卡洛研究，我们研究了这些估计量的有限样本性质。最后，我们还提出了一种检验条件贝塔恒定性的策略。在一个金融应用中，我们发现了时变条件贝塔的证据，并强调了ACB模型在投资组合和风险管理实证练习中的实证相关性。

records.title_en: Finite underidentification
records.title_cn: 有限欠识别
records.abstract_en: I adapt the Generalised Method of Moments to deal with nonlinear models in which a finite number of isolated parameter values satisfy the moment conditions. I also study the closely related class of first-order underidentified models, whose expected Jacobian is rank deficient but not necessarily zero. In both cases, my proposed procedures exploit the underidentification structure to yield parameter estimators and underidentification tests within a standard asymptotically normal GMM framework. I study nonlinear models with and without separation of data and parameters. I also illustrate my proposed inference procedures with applications to production function estimation and dynamic panel data models.
records.abstract_cn: 我将广义矩方法加以调整，以处理非线性模型中有限个孤立参数值满足矩条件的情形。我还研究了与之密切相关的一阶欠识别模型类别，其期望雅可比矩阵秩不足但不一定为零。在这两种情况下，我提出的程序利用欠识别结构，在标准渐近正态GMM框架内得到参数估计量和欠识别检验。我研究了数据与参数分离和不分离的非线性模型。我还用生产函数估计和动态面板数据模型的应用来说明我提出的推断程序。

records.title_en: Semi-parametric single-index predictive regression models with cointegrated regressors
records.title_cn: 具有协整回归元的半参数单指数预测回归模型
records.abstract_en: This paper considers the estimation of a semi-parametric single-index regression model that allows for nonlinear predictive relationships. This model is useful for predicting financial asset returns, whose observed behaviour resembles a stationary process, if the multiple nonstationary predictors are cointegrated. The presence of cointegrated regressors imposes a single-index structure in the model, and this structure not only balances the nonstationarity properties of the multiple predictors with the stationarity properties of asset returns but also avoids the curse of dimensionality associated with nonparametric regression function estimation. An orthogonal series expansion is used to approximate the unknown link function for the single-index component. We consider the constrained nonlinear least squares estimator of the single-index (or the cointegrating) parameters and the plug-in estimator of the link function, and derive their asymptotic properties. In an empirical application, we find some evidence of in-sample nonlinear predictability of U.S. stock returns using cointegrated predictors. We also find that the single-index model in general produces better out-of-sample forecasts than both the historical average benchmark and the linear predictive regression model.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑允许非线性预测关系的半参数单指数回归模型的估计。当多个非平稳预测变量存在协整时，该模型对于预测金融资产收益非常有用，其观测行为类似于平稳过程。协整回归元的存在在模型中施加了单指数结构，这种结构不仅平衡了多个预测变量的非平稳性与资产收益的平稳性，而且避免了与非参数回归函数估计相关的维数灾难。采用正交级数展开来逼近单指数分量的未知联系函数。我们考虑单指数（或协整）参数的有约束非线性最小二乘估计量和联系函数的插入估计量，并推导其渐近性质。在实证应用中，我们发现了使用协整预测变量对美国股票收益进行样本内非线性预测的一些证据。我们还发现，单指数模型总体上比历史平均基准和线性预测回归模型产生更好的样本外预测。

records.title_en: The likelihood ratio test for structural changes in factor models
records.title_cn: 因子模型中结构变化的似然比检验
records.abstract_en: A factor model with a break in its factor loadings is observationally equivalent to a model without changes in the loadings but with a change in the variance of its factors. This approach effectively transforms a high-dimensional structural change problem into a low-dimensional problem. This paper considers the likelihood ratio (LR) test for a variance change in the estimated factors. The LR test implicitly explores a special feature of the estimated factors: the pre-break and post-break variances can be a singular matrix under the alternative hypothesis, making the LR test diverging faster and thus more powerful than Wald-type tests. The better power property of the LR test is also confirmed by simulations. We also consider mean changes and multiple breaks. We apply this procedure to the factor modeling of the US employment and study the structural change problem using monthly industry-level data.
records.abstract_cn: 因子载荷发生断裂的因子模型在观测上等价于载荷不变但因子方差发生变化的模型。这种方法有效地将高维结构变化问题转化为低维问题。本文考虑了估计因子方差变化的似然比（LR）检验。LR检验隐含地探索了估计因子的一个特殊特征：在备择假设下，断裂前和断裂后的方差可以是奇异矩阵，这使得LR检验发散更快，因此比Wald型检验更有效。LR检验更好的功效性质也通过模拟得到了证实。我们还考虑了均值变化和多重断裂。我们将此程序应用于美国就业的因子建模，并使用月度行业层面数据研究结构变化问题。

records.title_en: Time-varying forecast combination for factor-augmented regressions with smooth structural changes
records.title_cn: 具有平滑结构变化的因子增强回归的时变预测组合
records.abstract_en: This study proposes a time-varying forecast combination for factor-augmented (TVFCFA) regressions with smooth structural changes. First, we establish the limiting distribution of the estimators of the time-varying factor-augmented regressions. To estimate the optimal time-varying combination weights, we propose a local leave-l-out cross-validation (LLOCV) criterion that is asymptotically unbiased for the local mean squared forecast error (LMSFE). The TVFCFA method was shown to be asymptotically optimal in the sense that its LMSFE attains the infeasible lower bound. We establish the convergence rate of the selected weights and demonstrate that the TVFCFA method automatically assigns all weights to correctly specified models. Because the overfitted models have nonzero weights, the TVFCFA estimator asymptotically follows a nonstandard distribution. To obtain an asymptotic normal distribution, we propose a penalized LLOCV criterion such that the weights for the overfitted models asymptotically converge to zero. The TVFCFA estimator, with weights that minimize the penalized LLOCV, asymptotically follows a normal distribution, and the convergence rate of the weights assigned to the overfitted models is inversely proportional to the penalized factor. A Monte Carlo simulation shows that the TVFCFA method outperforms competing model averaging and selection methods that are popular in the literature. Moreover, an empirical application of the TVFCFA method to inflation forecasts demonstrates its superiority.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一种针对具有平滑结构变化的因子增强（TVFCFA）回归的时变预测组合。首先，我们建立了时变因子增强回归估计量的极限分布。为了估计最优时变组合权重，我们提出了一种局部留一交叉验证（LLOCV）准则，该准则对局部均方预测误差（LMSFE）渐近无偏。TVFCFA方法在LMSFE达到不可行下界的意义上被证明是渐近最优的。我们建立了所选权重的收敛速度，并证明TVFCFA方法自动将所有权重分配给正确设定的模型。由于过拟合模型具有非零权重，TVFCFA估计量渐近遵循非标准分布。为了获得渐近正态分布，我们提出了一种惩罚LLOCV准则，使得过拟合模型的权重渐近收敛到零。使用最小化惩罚LLOCV的权重的TVFCFA估计量渐近遵循正态分布，分配给过拟合模型的权重的收敛速度与惩罚因子成反比。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，TVFCFA方法优于文献中流行的竞争模型平均和选择方法。此外，将TVFCFA方法应用于通胀预测的实证应用证明了其优越性。

records.title_en: Rank-based max-sum tests for mutual independence of high-dimensional random vectors
records.title_cn: 基于秩的高维随机向量互独立性最大和检验
records.abstract_en: We consider the problem of testing mutual independence of high-dimensional random vectors, and propose a series of high-dimensional rank-based max-sum tests, which are suitable for high-dimensional data and can be robust to distribution types of the variables, form of the dependence between variables and the sparsity of correlation coefficients. Further, we demonstrate the application of some representative members of the proposed tests on testing cross-sectional independence of the error vectors under fixed effects panel data regression models. We establish the asymptotic properties of the proposed tests under the null and alternative hypotheses, respectively, and then demonstrate the superiority of the proposed tests through extensive simulations, which suggest that they combine the advantages of both the max-type and sum-type high-dimensional rank-based tests. Finally, a real panel data analysis is performed to illustrate the application of the proposed tests.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑检验高维随机向量互独立性的问题，并提出一系列基于秩的高维最大和检验，这些检验适用于高维数据，并且对变量的分布类型、变量间依赖形式以及相关系数的稀疏性具有稳健性。进一步，我们展示了所提出检验中一些代表性成员在固定效应面板数据回归模型下检验误差向量横截面独立性的应用。我们分别在原假设和备择假设下建立了所提出检验的渐近性质，然后通过大量模拟展示了所提出检验的优越性，模拟结果表明它们结合了最大型和总和型高维基于秩检验的优点。最后，我们进行了一个真实面板数据分析以说明所提出检验的应用。

records.title_en: Bellman filtering and smoothing for state–space models
records.title_cn: 状态空间模型的贝尔曼滤波与平滑
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a new filter for state–space models based on Bellman’s dynamic-programming principle, allowing for nonlinearity, non-Gaussianity and degeneracy in the observation and/or state-transition equations. The resulting Bellman filter is a direct generalisation of the (iterated and extended) Kalman filter, enabling scalability to higher dimensions while remaining computationally inexpensive. It can also be extended to enable smoothing. Under suitable conditions, the Bellman-filtered states are stable over time and contractive towards a region around the true state at every time step. Static (hyper)parameters are estimated by maximising a filter-implied pseudo log-likelihood decomposition. In univariate simulation studies, the Bellman filter performs on par with state-of-the-art simulation-based techniques at a fraction of the computational cost. In two empirical applications, involving up to 150 spatial dimensions or highly degenerate/nonlinear state dynamics, the Bellman filter outperforms competing methods in both accuracy and speed.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于贝尔曼动态规划原理提出了一种新的状态空间模型滤波器，允许观测方程和/或状态转移方程存在非线性、非高斯性和退化性。由此产生的贝尔曼滤波器是（迭代和扩展）卡尔曼滤波器的直接推广，能够在保持计算成本低廉的同时扩展到更高维度。它还可以扩展以实现平滑。在适当条件下，贝尔曼滤波状态随时间稳定，并在每个时间步向真实状态周围的区域收缩。通过最大化滤波器隐含的伪对数似然分解来估计静态（超）参数。在单变量模拟研究中，贝尔曼滤波器的性能与最先进的基于模拟的技术相当，而计算成本仅为其一小部分。在两个实证应用中，涉及多达150个空间维度或高度退化/非线性状态动态，贝尔曼滤波器在准确性和速度方面均优于竞争方法。

records.title_en: High frequency principal component analysis based on correlation matrix that is robust to jumps, microstructure noise and asynchronous observation times
records.title_cn: 基于相关矩阵的高频主成分分析：对跳跃、微观结构噪声和非同步观测时间具有稳健性
records.abstract_en: This paper developed the high frequency estimation for the principal component analysis (PCA) based on correlation matrix. This estimation methodology is robust to jumps, microstructure noise and asynchronous observation times simultaneously, which is enabled by the newly proposed Truncated and Smoothed Two-Scales Realized Volatility (Truncated S-TSRV) estimator. The general framework of our methodology is constructed based on the estimation of realized spectral functions with respect to the spot correlation matrix. A new asymptotic representation for the element-wise estimation error of the spot correlation matrix estimate has been derived, resulting in a new bias correction term which is much more complex than that of the PCA based covariance matrix. Central limit theorem and rate of convergence have been developed for the bias-corrected estimator. The standard error estimator has also been proposed. As the empirical study of our methodology, we have constructed the first eigen-portfolio based on the eigenvector estimate corresponding to the largest eigenvalue in the spot correlation matrix. We regress the returns of first eigen-portfolio against that of the market ETF, which obtained non-significant alpha estimate and significant beta estimate which is very close to one.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于相关矩阵发展了主成分分析（PCA）的高频估计。该估计方法同时对跳跃、微观结构噪声和非同步观测时间具有稳健性，这得益于新提出的截断和平滑双尺度已实现波动率（Truncated S-TSRV）估计量。我们方法的一般框架是基于现货相关矩阵的已实现谱函数的估计构建的。我们推导了现货相关矩阵估计的逐元素估计误差的新渐近表示，从而产生了一个新的偏差校正项，该校正项比基于协方差矩阵的PCA更为复杂。我们为偏差校正后的估计量发展了中心极限定理和收敛速度。还提出了标准误估计量。作为我们方法的实证研究，我们基于现货相关矩阵中最大特征值对应的特征向量估计构建了第一特征投资组合。我们将第一特征投资组合的收益对市场ETF的收益进行回归，得到了不显著的alpha估计和非常接近一的显著beta估计。

records.title_en: Matching points: Supplementing instruments with covariates in triangular models
records.title_cn: 匹配点：在三角模型中用协变量补充工具变量
records.abstract_en: Models with a discrete endogenous variable and an instrument that takes on fewer values are common in economics. This paper presents a new method that matches pairs of covariates and instruments to restore the order condition in this scenario and to achieve point-identification of the outcome function. The outcome function must be monotonic in a scalar disturbance, but it can be nonseparable. The first stage for the discrete endogenous variable needs to have a multi-index structure but allows for multidimensional heterogeneity. This paper also provides estimators of the outcome function. Two empirical examples of the return to education and of selection into Head Start illustrate the usefulness and limitations of the method.
records.abstract_cn: 具有离散内生变量和取值较少的工具变量的模型在经济学中很常见。本文提出了一种新方法，通过匹配协变量和工具变量的配对来恢复这种情况下的阶条件，并实现结果函数的点识别。结果函数必须在标量扰动项中单调，但可以是不可分离的。离散内生变量的第一阶段需要具有多指数结构，但允许多维异质性。本文还提供了结果函数的估计量。关于教育回报和选择进入启智计划的两个实证例子说明了该方法的实用性和局限性。

records.title_en: Advances in nowcasting economic activity: The role of heterogeneous dynamics and fat tails
records.title_cn: 经济活动的即时预测进展：异质动态与肥尾的作用
records.abstract_en: A key question for households, firms, and policy makers is: how is the economy doing now? This paper develops a Bayesian dynamic factor model that allows for nonlinearities, heterogeneous lead–lag patterns and fat tails in macroeconomic data. Explicitly modeling these features changes the way that different indicators contribute to the real-time assessment of the state of the economy, and substantially improves the out-of-sample performance of this class of models. In a formal evaluation, our nowcasting framework beats benchmark econometric models and professional forecasters at predicting US GDP growth in real time.
records.abstract_cn: 家庭、企业和政策制定者面临的一个关键问题是：当前经济状况如何？本文开发了一个贝叶斯动态因子模型，该模型允许宏观经济数据中存在非线性、异质领先-滞后模式和肥尾。明确建模这些特征改变了不同指标对经济状况实时评估的贡献方式，并显著提高了这类模型的样本外表现。在一项正式评估中，我们的即时预测框架在实时预测美国GDP增长方面优于基准计量经济模型和专业预测者。

records.title_en: Classical p-values and the Bayesian posterior probability that the hypothesis is approximately true
records.title_cn: 经典p值与假设近似为真的贝叶斯后验概率
records.abstract_en: This paper relates p-values for the hypothesis that θ=c to the Bayesian posterior probability that the hypothesis is approximately true, in the sense that θ∈[c−ϵ,c+ϵ] for a selected ϵ>0. In a setup with a continuous prior for θ, the results show that a larger (respectively, smaller) p-value does not necessarily correspond to a higher (respectively, lower) probability that θ is close to c. Therefore, the results suggest caution about common ways of using p-values, specifically the use of small p-values as a key standard in empirical research.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了关于θ=c的假设的p值与贝叶斯后验概率之间的关系，其中后验概率衡量的是假设近似为真的程度，即对于选定的ϵ>0，θ∈[c−ϵ,c+ϵ]。在θ具有连续先验分布的设定下，结果表明，较大的（或较小的）p值并不必然对应较高的（或较低的）θ接近c的概率。因此，这些结果提示，在实证研究中常见的p值使用方式，特别是将小p值作为关键标准，应持谨慎态度。

records.title_en: Mental health and abortions among young women: time-varying unobserved heterogeneity, health behaviors, and risky decisions
records.title_cn: 年轻女性的心理健康与堕胎：时变不可观测异质性、健康行为与风险决策
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we provide causal evidence on abortions and risky health behaviors as determinants of mental health development among young women. Using administrative in- and outpatient records from Sweden, we apply a novel grouped fixed-effects estimator proposed by Bonhomme and Manresa (2015) to allow for time-varying unobserved heterogeneity. We show that the positive association obtained from standard estimators shrinks to zero once we control for grouped unobserved heterogeneity that varies across ages. We estimate the group profiles of unobserved heterogeneity, which reflect differences in unobserved risk to be diagnosed with a mental health condition. In addition, we analyze mental health development and risky health behaviors other than unintended pregnancies across groups. Our results suggest that these are determined by the same type of unobserved heterogeneity, which we attribute to the same unobserved process of decision-making. We develop and estimate a theoretical model of risky choices and mental health that is consistent with our empirical results. In the model, mental health disparity across groups is generated by different degrees of self-control problems. Our findings imply that mental health concerns cannot be used to justify restrictive abortion policies.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提供了关于堕胎和风险健康行为作为年轻女性心理健康发展决定因素的因果证据。利用瑞典的行政住院和门诊记录，我们应用了Bonhomme和Manresa（2015）提出的新型分组固定效应估计量，以允许时变不可观测异质性。我们表明，一旦我们控制了随年龄变化的分组不可观测异质性，从标准估计量获得的正相关关系会缩小至零。我们估计了不可观测异质性的组轮廓，这些轮廓反映了被诊断出心理健康状况的不可观测风险的差异。此外，我们分析了各组中心理健康发展和除意外怀孕外的风险健康行为。我们的结果表明，这些是由相同类型的不可观测异质性决定的，我们将其归因于相同的不可观测决策过程。我们开发并估计了一个与我们的实证结果一致的风险选择和心理健康理论模型。在该模型中，各组间的心理健康差异是由不同程度的自我控制问题产生的。我们的研究结果表明，心理健康问题不能用来为限制性堕胎政策辩护。

records.title_en: Observation-driven filtering of time-varying parameters using moment conditions
records.title_cn: 基于矩条件的观测驱动时变参数滤波
records.abstract_en: We develop a new and flexible semi-parametric approach for time-varying parameter models when the true dynamics are unknown. The time-varying parameters are estimated using a recursive updating scheme that is driven by the influence function of a conditional moments-based criterion. We show that the updates ensure local improvements of the conditional criterion function in expectation. The dynamics are observation driven, which yields a computationally efficient methodology that does not require advanced simulation techniques for estimation. We illustrate the new approach using both simulated and real empirical data and derive new, robust filters for time-varying scales based on characteristic functions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为真实动态未知的时变参数模型开发了一种新的、灵活的半参数方法。时变参数通过一种递归更新方案进行估计，该方案由基于条件矩准则的影响函数驱动。我们证明，这些更新确保了条件准则函数在期望上的局部改进。动态是观测驱动的，这产生了一种计算高效的方法，不需要先进的模拟技术进行估计。我们使用模拟和真实经验数据来说明新方法，并基于特征函数推导出新的、稳健的时变尺度滤波器。

records.title_en: Robust inference on correlation under general heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 一般异质性下相关性的稳健推断
records.abstract_en: Considerable evidence in past research shows size distortion in standard tests for zero autocorrelation or zero cross-correlation when time series are not independent identically distributed random variables, pointing to the need for more robust procedures. Recent tests for serial correlation and cross-correlation in Dalla, Giraitis, and Phillips (2022) provide a more robust approach, allowing for heteroskedasticity and dependence in uncorrelated data under restrictions that require a smooth, slowly-evolving deterministic heteroskedasticity process. The present work removes those restrictions and validates the robust testing methodology for a wider class of innovations and regression residuals allowing for heteroscedastic uncorrelated and non-stationary data settings. The updated analysis given here enables more extensive use of the methodology in practical applications. Monte Carlo experiments confirm excellent finite sample performance of the robust test procedures even for extremely complex white noise processes. The empirical examples show that use of robust testing methods can materially reduce spurious evidence of correlations found by standard testing procedures.
records.abstract_cn: 过去研究中的大量证据表明，当时间序列不是独立同分布随机变量时，标准检验在零自相关或零互相关检验中存在规模失真，这表明需要更稳健的程序。Dalla、Giraitis和Phillips（2022）最近提出的序列相关和互相关检验提供了一种更稳健的方法，允许在非相关数据中存在异方差性和依赖性，但限制条件要求一个平滑、缓慢演变的确定性异方差过程。本研究去除了这些限制，并验证了稳健检验方法适用于更广泛的创新和回归残差类别，允许异方差非相关和非平稳数据设置。本文提供的更新分析使得该方法在实际应用中得到更广泛的使用。蒙特卡洛实验证实，即使对于极其复杂的白噪声过程，稳健检验程序也具有优异的有限样本性能。实证例子表明，使用稳健检验方法可以实质性地减少标准检验程序发现的虚假相关性证据。

records.title_en: Endogeneity in weakly separable models without monotonicity
records.title_cn: 弱可分模型中无单调性条件下的内生性问题
records.abstract_en: We identify and estimate treatment effects when potential outcomes are weakly separable with a binary endogenous treatment. Vytlacil and Yildiz (2007) proposed an identification strategy that exploits the mean of observed outcomes, but their approach requires a monotonicity condition. In comparison, we exploit full information in the entire outcome distribution, instead of just its mean. As a result, our method does not require monotonicity and is also applicable to general settings with multiple indices. We provide examples where our approach can identify treatment effect parameters of interest whereas existing methods would fail. These include models where potential outcomes depend on multiple unobserved disturbance terms, such as a Roy model, a multinomial choice model, as well as a model with endogenous random coefficients. We establish consistency and asymptotic normality of our estimators.
records.abstract_cn: 当潜在结果具有弱可分性且处理变量为二元内生变量时，我们识别并估计处理效应。Vytlacil和Yildiz（2007）提出了一种利用观测结果均值的识别策略，但他们的方法需要单调性条件。相比之下，我们利用整个结果分布中的全部信息，而不仅仅是其均值。因此，我们的方法不需要单调性，并且也适用于具有多个指数的一般设定。我们提供了示例，说明我们的方法能够识别感兴趣的处理效应参数，而现有方法则会失效。这些示例包括潜在结果依赖于多个不可观测扰动项的模型，如Roy模型、多项选择模型，以及具有内生随机系数的模型。我们建立了估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。

records.title_en: Identification of heterogeneous elasticities in gross-output production functions
records.title_cn: 总产出生产函数中异质性弹性的识别
records.abstract_en: This paper presents the identification of heterogeneous elasticities in gross-output production functions with non-separable unobserved productivity. We propose that the ex-ante flexible input cost shares identify the heterogeneous output elasticities with respect to flexible inputs for each firm. Applying the proposed method to a panel of firms in the food production industry in Chile, we find that the extent of heterogeneity in the output elasticities with respect to intermediate inputs has significantly declined from 1985 to 1995, with its distribution tending to concentrate toward zero as time progresses.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了在具有不可分离的未观测生产率的总产出生产函数中识别异质性弹性的方法。我们提出，事前灵活投入成本份额可以识别每个企业相对于灵活投入的异质性产出弹性。将所提出的方法应用于智利食品生产行业的企业面板数据，我们发现，从1985年到1995年，相对于中间投入的产出弹性的异质性程度显著下降，其分布随时间推移趋向于集中于零。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference by stochastic optimization
records.title_cn: 随机优化的估计与推断
records.abstract_en: In non-linear estimations, it is common to assess sampling uncertainty by bootstrap inference. For complex models, this can be computationally intensive. This paper combines optimization with resampling: turning stochastic optimization into a fast resampling device. Two methods are introduced: a resampled Newton–Raphson (rnr) and a resampled quasi-Newton (rqn) algorithm. Both produce draws that can be used to compute consistent estimates, confidence intervals, and standard errors in a single run. The draws are generated by a gradient and Hessian (or an approximation) computed from batches of data that are resampled at each iteration. The proposed methods transition quickly from optimization to resampling when the objective is smooth and strictly convex. Simulated and empirical applications illustrate the properties of the methods on large scale and computationally intensive problems. Comparisons with frequentist and Bayesian methods highlight the features of the algorithms.
records.abstract_cn: 在非线性估计中，通常通过自助法推断来评估抽样不确定性。对于复杂模型，这可能计算量很大。本文将优化与重抽样相结合：将随机优化转变为快速的重抽样工具。介绍了两种方法：重抽样牛顿-拉夫森（rnr）算法和重抽样拟牛顿（rqn）算法。两者都能产生可用于在单次运行中计算一致估计、置信区间和标准误的抽样。这些抽样由梯度和海森矩阵（或其近似）生成，这些梯度和海森矩阵基于每次迭代中重抽样的数据批次计算。当目标函数光滑且严格凸时，所提出的方法能快速从优化过渡到重抽样。模拟和实证应用展示了这些方法在大规模和计算密集型问题上的性质。与频率学派和贝叶斯方法的比较突出了这些算法的特点。

records.title_en: Nonparametric estimation of stochastic frontier models with weak separability
records.title_cn: 弱可分性随机前沿模型的非参数估计
records.abstract_en: We propose a robust and versatile approach to estimate the stochastic frontier model which avoids parametric assumptions. Our approach requires a single continuous covariate which monotonically influences the conditional mean of inefficiency. Subject to these conditions, the frontier and the conditional mean of inefficiency can be estimated nonparametrically. The estimator we propose uses local least squares and marginal integration making it easy to implement across statistical software. A range of Monte Carlo simulations suggests that when our main identification condition holds, our proposed estimator outperforms other proposals that currently exist. Finally, we provide an application to the study of undercounting COVID-19 cases across the United States. Whereas our method indicates significant undercounting, consistent with existing evidence, other nonparametric methods suggest far less undercounting.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种稳健且多用途的方法来估计随机前沿模型，该方法避免了参数假设。我们的方法要求一个单一的连续协变量，该协变量单调影响无效率的条件均值。在这些条件下，前沿和无效率的条件均值可以非参数地估计。我们提出的估计器使用局部最小二乘和边际积分，使其易于在各种统计软件中实现。一系列蒙特卡洛模拟表明，当我们的主要识别条件成立时，我们提出的估计器优于目前存在的其他提议。最后，我们将其应用于研究美国COVID-19病例的低报问题。尽管我们的方法表明存在显著的低报，与现有证据一致，但其他非参数方法表明低报程度要小得多。

records.title_en: Semiparametric Bayesian estimation of dynamic discrete choice models
records.title_cn: 动态离散选择模型的半参数贝叶斯估计
records.abstract_en: We propose a tractable semiparametric estimation method for structural dynamic discrete choice models. The distribution of additive utility shocks in the proposed framework is modeled by location-scale mixtures of extreme value distributions with varying numbers of mixture components. Our approach exploits the analytical tractability of extreme value distributions in the multinomial choice settings and the flexibility of the location-scale mixtures. We implement the Bayesian approach to inference using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and an approximately optimal reversible jump algorithm. In our simulation experiments, we show that the standard dynamic logit model can deliver misleading results, especially about counterfactuals, when the shocks are not extreme value distributed. Our semiparametric approach delivers reliable inference in these settings. We develop theoretical results on approximations by location-scale mixtures in an appropriate distance and posterior concentration of the set identified utility parameters and the distribution of shocks in the model.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种可处理的半参数估计方法，用于结构动态离散选择模型。在所提出的框架中，加性效用冲击的分布通过位置-尺度混合的极值分布来建模，其中混合成分的数量可变。我们的方法利用了极值分布在多项选择设置中的解析可处理性以及位置-尺度混合的灵活性。我们使用哈密顿蒙特卡洛和近似最优的可逆跳跃算法实现贝叶斯推断。在我们的模拟实验中，我们表明，当冲击不服从极值分布时，标准动态logit模型可能给出误导性结果，尤其是在反事实分析方面。我们的半参数方法在这些设置中提供了可靠的推断。我们发展了关于位置-尺度混合在适当距离下的逼近以及模型中集合识别的效用参数和冲击分布的后验集中性的理论结果。

records.title_en: High-dimensional IV cointegration estimation and inference
records.title_cn: 高维IV协整估计与推断
records.abstract_en: A semiparametric triangular systems approach shows how multicointegrating linkages occur naturally in an I(1) cointegrated regression model when the long run error variance matrix in the system is singular. Under such singularity, cointegrated I(1) systems embody a multicointegrated structure that makes them useful in many empirical settings. Earlier work shows that such systems may be analyzed and estimated without appealing to the associated I(2) system but with suboptimal convergence rates and potential asymptotic bias. The present paper develops a robust approach to estimation and inference of such systems using high dimensional IV methods that have appealing asymptotic properties like those known to apply in the optimal estimation of cointegrated systems (Phillips, 1991). The approach uses an extended version of high-dimensional trend IV (Phillips, 2006, 2014) estimation with deterministic orthonormal instruments. The methods and derivations involve new results on high-dimensional IV techniques and matrix normalization in the limit theory that are of independent interest. Wald tests of general linear restrictions are constructed using a fixed-b long run variance estimator that leads to robust pivotal HAR inference in both cointegrated and multicointegrated cases. Simulations show good properties of the estimation and inferential procedures in finite samples. An empirical illustration to housing stocks, starts and completions is provided.
records.abstract_cn: 一个半参数三角系统方法展示了当系统中的长期误差方差矩阵奇异时，多协整联系如何在I(1)协整回归模型中自然出现。在这种奇异性下，协整的I(1)系统体现了多协整结构，使其在许多实证环境中很有用。早期的工作表明，这样的系统可以在不涉及相关的I(2)系统的情况下进行分析和估计，但收敛速度次优且可能存在渐近偏差。本文开发了一种使用高维IV方法的稳健估计和推断方法，这些方法具有吸引人的渐近性质，类似于已知在协整系统的最优估计中适用的性质（Phillips, 1991）。该方法使用了扩展版本的高维趋势IV（Phillips, 2006, 2014）估计，采用确定性正交工具。方法和推导涉及高维IV技术和极限理论中矩阵归一化的新结果，这些结果具有独立的意义。使用固定b长期方差估计量构建Wald检验，该估计量在协整和多协整情况下都能导致稳健的枢轴HAR推断。模拟显示估计和推断程序在有限样本中具有良好的性质。提供了对住房存量、开工和竣工的实证说明。

records.title_en: The fixed-b limiting distribution and the ERP of HAR tests under nonstationarity
records.title_cn: 非平稳性下HAR检验的固定b极限分布与拒绝概率误差
records.abstract_en: We show that the limiting distribution of HAR test statistics under fixed-b asymptotics is not pivotal when the data are nonstationary (i.e., time-varying autocovariance structure). It takes the form of a complicated function of Gaussian processes and depends on the second moments of the relevant series (e.g., of the regressors and errors for the case of the linear regression model). Hence, fixed-b inference methods based on stationarity are not theoretically valid in general. The nuisance parameters entering the fixed-b limiting distribution can be consistently estimated under small-b asymptotics but only with nonparametric rate of convergence. We show that the error in rejection probability (ERP) is an order of magnitude larger than that under stationarity and can be also larger than that of HAR tests based on HAC estimators under conventional asymptotics. These theoretical results reconcile with recent finite-sample evidence showing that existing fixed-b HAR tests can perform poorly when the data are nonstationary. They can be conservative under the null hypothesis and have non-monotonic power under the alternative hypothesis irrespective of how large the sample size is. Based on the new nonstationary fixed-b distribution, we propose a feasible method that controls the null rejection rates well regardless of whether the data are stationary or not and of the strength of the serial dependence as verified for some representative data-generating processes in a simple location model.
records.abstract_cn: 我们证明，当数据非平稳（即时变自协方差结构）时，固定b渐近下HAR检验统计量的极限分布不是枢轴的。它表现为高斯过程的复杂函数形式，并依赖于相关序列的二阶矩（例如，线性回归模型中的回归量和误差）。因此，基于平稳性的固定b推断方法在理论上一般不成立。进入固定b极限分布的 nuisance 参数可以在小b渐近下一致估计，但仅以非参数收敛速度。我们表明，拒绝概率误差（ERP）比平稳性下的误差大一个数量级，也可能大于基于HAC估计量的HAR检验在常规渐近下的误差。这些理论结果与最近的有限样本证据一致，表明当数据非平稳时，现有的固定b HAR检验可能表现不佳。它们在原假设下可能保守，在备择假设下具有非单调功效，无论样本量多大。基于新的非平稳固定b分布，我们提出了一种可行的方法，无论数据是否平稳以及序列依赖的强度如何，都能很好地控制原假设拒绝率，这在简单位置模型中的一些代表性数据生成过程中得到了验证。

records.title_en: Monetary policy and the persistent aggregate effects of wealth redistribution
records.title_cn: 货币政策与财富再分配的持续性总量效应
records.abstract_en: Monetary easing redistributes from savers, some of whom are retired and not adjusting labor supply, to borrowers who reduce their labor supply. This results in persistently lower aggregate labor and output. Hence the interaction of labor supply heterogeneity with heterogeneity in net nominal positions of households creates a monetary policy trade-off whereby short-term economic stimulus is followed by lower output over the medium term. The policy trade-off is stronger in economies with more nominal household debt and a larger wealth share of retired households but weakened by a more aggressive monetary policy stance and under price-level targeting.
records.abstract_cn: 货币宽松政策将财富从储蓄者（其中一些已退休且不调整劳动供给）再分配给减少劳动供给的借款者。这导致总量劳动和产出持续下降。因此，劳动供给异质性与家庭净名义头寸异质性的相互作用产生了货币政策权衡，即短期经济刺激之后是中期产出下降。在名义家庭债务更多、退休家庭财富份额更大的经济体中，这种政策权衡更强，但更积极的货币政策立场和价格水平目标制会削弱这种权衡。

records.title_en: A model of risk sharing in a dual labor market
records.title_cn: 双重劳动力市场中的风险分担模型
records.abstract_en: In OECD countries, the labor market features a coexistence of open-ended, permanent jobs subject to strict employment protection and fixed-term, temporary jobs. This paper studies a search-and-matching model with risk-averse workers and dynamic employment contracts subject to limited commitment. In equilibrium, permanent and temporary jobs coexist when the match quality is sufficiently dispersed: firing costs generate insurance gains implying that permanent contracts are optimal for high-quality matches. Consistent with recent empirical evidence, quantitative analysis of the model shows that temporary contracts crowd out permanent jobs and do not generate employment gains.
records.abstract_cn: 在OECD国家，劳动力市场的特点是开放式永久性工作与受严格就业保护的限制性定期临时工作并存。本文研究了一个具有风险厌恶工人和受有限承诺约束的动态雇佣合同的搜索匹配模型。在均衡状态下，当匹配质量足够分散时，永久性和临时性工作并存：解雇成本产生保险收益，意味着永久合同对于高质量匹配是最优的。与近期经验证据一致，模型的定量分析表明，临时合同挤出了永久性工作，并未产生就业收益。

records.title_en: Why do rational investors like variance at the peak of a crisis? A learning-based explanation
records.title_cn: 为什么理性投资者在危机高峰期偏好方差？一个基于学习的解释
records.abstract_en: Investors’ learning can drastically alter the dynamics of the variance risk premium: it no longer increases as economic conditions deteriorate but exhibits a highly nonlinear pattern, occasionally even turning negative. We demonstrate this intuition using a model where investors rationally form their belief about the hidden economic state. When the “bad” state becomes probable, investors start liking high future variance because it overwhelmingly correlates with lower marginal utility. This mechanism rationalizes the puzzling observation that risk-neutral volatility falls short of physical volatility at the peak of a severe crisis. Our results shed light on the interpretation of good economic uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 投资者的学习可以极大地改变方差风险溢价的动态：它不再随着经济状况恶化而增加，而是呈现出高度非线性的模式，偶尔甚至转为负值。我们通过一个模型来展示这一直觉，在该模型中，投资者理性地形成对隐藏经济状态的信念。当“坏”状态变得可能时，投资者开始偏好高未来方差，因为它与较低的边际效用高度相关。这一机制合理化了在严重危机高峰期风险中性波动率低于物理波动率这一令人困惑的观察。我们的结果有助于解释良好经济不确定性的含义。

records.title_en: Contagion in debt and collateral markets
records.title_cn: 债务与抵押品市场中的传染
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates contagion in financial networks through collateralized debt and its effects on social welfare. Our model incorporates contagion through both counterparty debt exposures and endogenous collateral asset pricing. We find that collateral mitigates counterparty exposures and reduces social inefficiency when faced with negative shocks, but not always. We also show the importance of the interaction between the level of collateral and network structure as contagion can change dramatically depending on that interaction. The model also provides policy-relevant collateral-to-debt ratios (haircuts) to attain robust and fully insulated macroprudential states for any network and also the optimal collateral ratio to attain full insulation for a specific network.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过抵押债务研究金融网络中的传染及其对社会福利的影响。我们的模型同时纳入了通过交易对手债务敞口和内生抵押资产定价的传染渠道。我们发现，在面对负面冲击时，抵押品缓解了交易对手敞口并减少了社会无效率，但并非总是如此。我们还展示了抵押品水平与网络结构之间相互作用的重要性，因为传染可能因这种相互作用而发生显著变化。该模型还提供了政策相关的抵押品债务比率（ haircuts ），以实现任何网络的稳健且完全隔离的宏观审慎状态，以及针对特定网络实现完全隔离的最优抵押品比率。

records.title_en: Averaging impulse responses using prediction pools
records.title_cn: 使用预测池对脉冲响应进行平均
records.abstract_en: Macroeconomists construct impulse responses using many competing time series models and different statistical paradigms (Bayesian or frequentist). We adapt optimal linear prediction pools to efficiently combine impulse response estimators for the effects of the same economic shock from this vast class of possible models. We thus alleviate the need to choose one specific model, obtaining weights that are typically positive for more than one model. Our Monte Carlo simulations and empirical applications illustrate how the weights leverage the strengths of each model by (i) trading off properties of each model depending on variable, horizon, and application and (ii) accounting for the full predictive distribution rather than being restricted to specific moments.11MATLAB replication code is available on Matthes’ GitHub repository.
records.abstract_cn: 宏观经济学家使用许多竞争性时间序列模型和不同的统计范式（贝叶斯或频率学派）构建脉冲响应。我们将最优线性预测池应用于有效组合来自这一广泛可能模型类别中同一经济冲击效应的脉冲响应估计量。因此，我们减轻了选择特定模型的需要，获得的权重通常对多个模型为正。我们的蒙特卡洛模拟和实证应用说明了权重如何通过（i）根据变量、视界和应用权衡每个模型的属性，以及（ii）考虑完整预测分布而非局限于特定矩，来利用每个模型的优势。11MATLAB复制代码可在Matthes的GitHub仓库中获取。

records.title_en: The sentimental propagation of lottery winnings: Evidence from the Spanish Christmas lottery
records.title_cn: 彩票中奖的情绪传播：来自西班牙圣诞彩票的证据
records.abstract_en: Using the Spanish Christmas lottery as a natural experiment, the impact of geographically clustered lottery winnings on consumer sentiment and intended durable consumption is analyzed. Albeit not receiving lottery prizes, consumers in winning provinces become significantly more optimistic about the Spanish macroeconomic conditions than those living elsewhere. This variation in sentiment is shown to be orthogonal to changes in regional fundamentals and leads to a rise in spending intentions. Young, less educated, low-income, and unemployed individuals react stronger to the lottery shock. At the regional level, lottery wins significantly increase car licenses, reduce unemployment, and intensify job creation and prices.
records.abstract_cn: 利用西班牙圣诞彩票作为自然实验，分析了地理聚集的彩票中奖对消费者情绪和预期耐用品消费的影响。尽管未获得彩票奖金，中奖省份的消费者对西班牙宏观经济状况的乐观程度显著高于其他地区的消费者。这种情绪变化被证明与区域基本面的变化正交，并导致支出意愿上升。年轻人、受教育程度较低者、低收入者和失业者对彩票冲击的反应更为强烈。在区域层面，彩票中奖显著增加了汽车牌照，降低了失业率，并促进了就业创造和价格上涨。

records.title_en: How to limit the spillover from an inflation surge to inflation expectations?
records.title_cn: 如何限制通胀飙升对通胀预期的溢出效应？
records.abstract_en: Using a randomized control trial on German consumers we show that information about rising inflation increases inflation expectations. This initial increase in expectations can be mitigated by providing forecasts of inflation. Information about (future) inflation affects the whole term structure of inflation expectations, where the effects are smaller for longer-run expectations. This information also causes changes in consumption and savings decisions. In subsequent months—when consumers realize that inflation is much higher than the provided forecasts—they reverse the reliance on information about inflation forecasts and rely again more on their initial priors.
records.abstract_cn: 通过对德国消费者进行随机对照试验，我们发现关于通胀上升的信息会提高通胀预期。这种预期的初始上升可以通过提供通胀预测来缓解。关于（未来）通胀的信息影响通胀预期的整个期限结构，其中对长期预期的影响较小。这些信息还会引起消费和储蓄决策的变化。在随后的几个月里，当消费者意识到实际通胀远高于所提供的预测时，他们会逆转对通胀预测信息的依赖，并再次更多地依赖其初始先验。

records.title_en: Carbon pricing and inflation expectations: Evidence from France
records.title_cn: 碳定价与通胀预期：来自法国的证据
records.abstract_en: We study how firms’ price expectations and decisions are affected by carbon pricing, using a survey of French manufacturing firms. Exogenous variations in the price of carbon are obtained by high-frequency identification. A change in carbon price increases firms’ inflation expectations as well as their own expected and realized price growth. Initially, positive forecast errors emerge, but over time, the impact on price expectations proves to be more enduring than on actual price growth, leading to negative forecast errors in the medium- to long-run. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that firms’ responses to these carbon pricing shocks exhibit considerable heterogeneity. Low energy-intensive firms are worse at forecasting the effects of the shock on the evolution of their own prices and firms with narrower profit margins are less able to pass through the increase in energy costs to the prices of their final products. These findings align with models of information rigidities, shedding new light on how firms navigate and adapt to carbon pricing policies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用对法国制造业企业的调查，研究碳定价如何影响企业的价格预期和决策。通过高频识别获得碳价格的外生变动。碳价格的变化会提高企业的通胀预期以及其自身预期和实际的价格增长。最初，出现正的预测误差，但随着时间的推移，对价格预期的影响比对实际价格增长的影响更为持久，导致中长期出现负的预测误差。此外，我们的分析显示，企业对碳定价冲击的反应表现出相当大的异质性。低能源密集型企业更不擅长预测冲击对其自身价格演变的影响，而利润率较窄的企业则更难以将能源成本的增加转嫁到其最终产品的价格上。这些发现与信息刚性模型一致，为企业在碳定价政策中如何导航和适应提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Marginal tax rates and income in the long run: Evidence from a structural estimation
records.title_cn: 边际税率与长期收入：来自结构估计的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate a life-cycle model of savings, labor productivity and entrepreneurs to measure the long-run response of income to marginal tax rate cuts in the US. Long-run tax elasticities of income are largest for the richest 1% but are also positive and substantial for other income groups. In equilibrium, entrepreneurs obtain higher returns on wealth. This increases the investment response of rich, high-return entrepreneurs, amplifying their income elasticity to tax cuts. This leads to a reallocation of capital which increases TFP, and generates a boost in wages that magnifies the estimated income response of the bottom 90% as well.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一个包含储蓄、劳动生产率和企业家的生命周期模型，以衡量美国边际税率削减对收入的长期反应。收入的长期税收弹性对于最富有的1%人群最大，但对于其他收入群体也为正且显著。在均衡中，企业家获得更高的财富回报。这增加了富有且高回报企业家的投资反应，放大了他们对减税的收入弹性。这导致资本重新配置，提高了全要素生产率，并产生了工资提升，从而也放大了对底层90%人群估计的收入反应。

records.title_en: A theory of the dynamics of factor shares
records.title_cn: 要素份额动态的理论
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a theory of the dynamics of factor shares within the context of an equilibrium model of endogenous innovation, growth, and cycles. Our deterministic model rests on two assumptions: (i) production requires two complementary inputs, capital, and labor, and (ii) technical progress is labor-saving and embodied in capital goods. The model’s unique equilibrium path displays recurring growth cycles, each consisting of an adoption and innovation phase, along which factor shares fluctuate within bounds. The interaction between factor prices and opportunities for labor-saving innovations brings about both persistent growth and aggregate oscillations through which it takes place. We provide evidence that the model-implied correlations between factor shares and the other labor market variables are consistent with the data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在内生创新、增长和周期的均衡模型背景下，提出了要素份额动态的理论。我们的确定性模型基于两个假设：（i）生产需要两种互补投入，资本和劳动，（ii）技术进步是节约劳动的，并体现在资本品中。模型的唯一均衡路径呈现出周期性的增长循环，每个循环包括采用阶段和创新阶段，要素份额在界限内波动。要素价格与节约劳动创新机会之间的相互作用带来了持续增长和总体波动，增长正是通过这种波动实现的。我们提供的证据表明，模型隐含的要素份额与其他劳动力市场变量之间的相关性与数据一致。

records.title_en: (Trade) War and peace: How to impose international trade sanctions
records.title_cn: (贸易)战争与和平：如何实施国际贸易制裁
records.abstract_en: What is the most cost-efficient way to impose trade sanctions against Russia? We build a quantitative model of international trade with input–output connections. Sanctioning countries choose import tariffs to simultaneously maximize their income and minimize Russia’s income, with different weights placed on these objectives. We find, first, that for countries with low willingness to pay for sanctions against Russia, the most cost-efficient sanction is an approximately 20% tariff on all Russian products. Second, if countries are willing to pay at least US$0.70 for each US$1 drop in Russian welfare, an embargo on Russia’s mining and energy products is the most cost-efficient policy.
records.abstract_cn: 对俄罗斯实施贸易制裁的最具成本效益的方式是什么？我们构建了一个具有投入产出联系的国际贸易定量模型。制裁国选择进口关税，以同时最大化其收入并最小化俄罗斯的收入，对这些目标赋予不同的权重。我们发现，首先，对于对制裁俄罗斯支付意愿较低的国家，最具成本效益的制裁是对所有俄罗斯产品征收约20%的关税。其次，如果各国愿意为俄罗斯福利每下降1美元支付至少0.70美元，那么对俄罗斯的采矿和能源产品实施禁运是最具成本效益的政策。

records.title_en: How does the fed affect corporate credit costs? Default risk, creditor segmentation and the post-FOMC drift
records.title_cn: 美联储如何影响企业信贷成本？违约风险、债权人分割与FOMC公告后的漂移
records.abstract_en: Surprise changes in monetary policy rates have a causal impact on credit risk measures, which display a significant post-FOMC drift. I employ a tight identification strategy to decompose the influence of firm-specific and creditor-specific factors across horizons. Firms with narrower income gaps and lower Tobin’s Q ratios exhibit heightened sensitivity at both short and long horizons. Bonds predominantly held by bond funds demonstrate only temporarily more sensitivity, indicating that credit market segmentation fails to account for the observed drift. Aggregate broker dealer capital scarcity is linked to an amplified response in the drift component. A large portion of the drift remains unexplained, revealing the limitations of cross-sectional characteristics in explaining the transmission mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 货币政策利率的意外变化对信用风险度量具有因果影响，这些度量显示出显著的FOMC公告后漂移。我采用严格的识别策略，在不同时间跨度上分解企业特定因素和债权人特定因素的影响。收入差距较窄且托宾Q比率较低的企业在短期和长期均表现出更高的敏感性。主要由债券基金持有的债券仅表现出暂时更高的敏感性，表明信贷市场分割无法解释观察到的漂移。总体交易商资本稀缺与漂移成分中放大的反应相关。漂移的很大一部分仍未得到解释，揭示了横截面特征在解释传导机制方面的局限性。

records.title_en: Oil price shocks in real time
records.title_cn: 实时油价冲击
records.abstract_en: Oil prices contain information on global shocks of key relevance for monetary policy decisions. We propose a novel approach to identify these shocks at the daily frequency in a Structural Vector Autoregression (SVAR). Our method is devised to be used in real time to interpret the developments in the oil market and their implications for the macroeconomy, circumventing the problem of publication lags that plagues monthly data used in workhorse SVAR models. It proves particularly valuable for monetary policymakers at times when macroeconomic conditions evolve rapidly, like during the COVID-19 pandemic or the invasion of Ukraine by Russia.
records.abstract_cn: 油价包含与货币政策决策关键相关的全球冲击信息。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，在结构向量自回归（SVAR）中于日度频率识别这些冲击。我们的方法旨在实时使用，以解读石油市场的发展及其对宏观经济的影响，从而规避了在主流SVAR模型中使用月度数据时困扰的发布滞后问题。在宏观经济状况迅速演变时期，如COVID-19大流行或俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间，该方法对货币政策制定者尤为有价值。

records.title_en: Consumption categories, household attention, and inflation expectations: Implications for optimal monetary policy
records.title_cn: 消费类别、家庭关注与通胀预期：对最优货币政策的影响
records.abstract_en: What inflation measure should central banks target? This paper highlights a mechanism where monetary policy optimally targets headline inflation if households pay limited attention to different consumption categories when forming inflation expectations. This result stands in contrast to standard rational expectations models, where optimal policy targets core inflation. The core inflation rate excludes volatile energy and food prices (non-core) from headline inflation. Using novel survey data on inflation expectations for disaggregated consumption categories, I find household expectations are disproportionately driven by beliefs about future non-core prices. A model of bounded rationality accounts for the empirical evidence. While forming inflation expectations, households pay more attention to the volatile non-core components. Embedding this framework into a multi-sector New Keynesian model, I show that targeting headline rather than core inflation provides welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 中央银行应以何种通胀指标为目标？本文揭示了一种机制，即如果家庭在形成通胀预期时对不同消费类别的关注有限，货币政策最优地以整体通胀为目标。这一结果与标准理性预期模型形成对比，后者中最优政策以核心通胀为目标。核心通胀率从整体通胀中排除了波动性较大的能源和食品价格（非核心）。利用关于分项消费类别通胀预期的新调查数据，我发现家庭预期不成比例地受到对未来非核心价格信念的驱动。一个有限理性模型解释了实证证据。在形成通胀预期时，家庭更加关注波动性较大的非核心成分。将该框架嵌入多部门新凯恩斯模型，我表明以整体通胀而非核心通胀为目标可带来福利收益。

records.title_en: More than words: Fed Chairs’ communication during congressional testimonies
records.title_cn: 不只是言语：美联储主席在国会作证期间的沟通
records.abstract_en: We study soft information contained in congressional testimonies by the Federal Reserve Chairs and analyze its effects on financial markets. Using machine learning, we construct high-frequency measures of Fed Chair’s and Congress members’ emotions expressed via their words, voice and face. Increases in the Chair’s text-, voice-, or face-emotion indices during the testimony generally raise the S&P500 index and lower the VIX. Stock prices are particularly sensitive to the Fed Chair’s answers to questions directly related to monetary policy. The effects during the testimony add up and propagate after the testimony, reaching magnitudes comparable to those after a policy rate cut. Our findings resonate with the view in psychology that communication is much more than words and underscore the need for a holistic approach to central bank communication.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究美联储主席国会证词中包含的软信息，并分析其对金融市场的影响。利用机器学习，我们构建了对美联储主席和国会议员通过言语、声音和表情表达的情绪的高频测量。主席在作证期间的文字、声音或面部情绪指数的增加通常会提高 S&P500 指数并降低 VIX。股价对美联储主席对与货币政策直接相关问题的回答特别敏感。证词期间的影响会在证词结束后叠加并传播，达到与政策降息后相当的程度。我们的研究结果与心理学的观点产生共鸣，即沟通不仅仅是言语，并强调了央行沟通采取整体方法的必要性。

records.title_en: Learning about labor markets
records.title_cn: 学习劳动力市场
records.abstract_en: We study a general equilibrium model of the labor market in which agents slowly learn about their suitability for jobs. Our model reproduces desirable features of the data, many of which standard models fail to replicate. We explore how, in such an environment, asymmetric information can lead to substantial misallocation. We calibrate our model to US data and quantify the welfare loss arising from misallocation due to informational frictions. The tractability of the model allows us to explore the responsiveness of wages and employment to an aggregate shock. We find that wage rigidity arises endogenously because of protracted learning, and in line with the data, the model is able to generate a larger and more persistent employment response.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个劳动力市场的一般均衡模型，其中代理人缓慢地学习他们是否适合工作。我们的模型再现了数据中令人满意的特征，其中许多特征是标准模型无法复制的。我们探讨了在这种环境下，信息不对称如何导致严重的错配。我们将模型校准到美国数据，并量化了因信息摩擦导致的错配所产生的福利损失。模型的可处理性使我们能够探索工资和就业对总冲击的反应性。我们发现，由于长期学习，工资刚性内生地出现，并且与数据一致，模型能够产生更大且更持久的就业反应。

records.title_en: The Fed takes on corporate credit risk: An analysis of the efficacy of the SMCCF
records.title_cn: 美联储承担企业信用风险：SMCCF有效性分析
records.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the efficacy of the Secondary Market Corporate Credit Facility, a program designed to stabilize the U.S. corporate bond market during the COVID-19 pandemic. The program announcements on March 23 and April 9, 2020, significantly reduced investment-grade credit spreads across the maturity spectrum – irrespective of the program’s maturity-eligibility criterion – and ultimately restored the normal upward-sloping term structure of credit spreads. The Federal Reserve’s actual purchases reduced credit spreads of eligible bonds 3 basis points more than those of ineligible bonds, a sizable effect given the modest volume of purchases. A calibrated variant of the preferred habit model shows that a “dash for cash” – a selloff of shorter-term lowest-risk investment-grade bonds – combined with a spike in the arbitrageurs’ risk aversion, can account for the inversion of the investment-grade credit curve during the height of turmoil in the market. Consistent with the empirical findings, the Fed’s announcements, by reducing risk aversion and alleviating market segmentation, helped restore the upward-sloping credit curve in the investment-grade segment of the market.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了二级市场企业信贷便利（SMCCF）的有效性，该计划旨在COVID-19大流行期间稳定美国公司债券市场。2020年三月23日和四月9日的计划公告显著降低了整个期限范围内的投资级信用利差——无论该计划的期限资格标准如何——并最终恢复了正常的向上倾斜的信用利差期限结构。美联储的实际购买使合格债券的信用利差比不合格债券低3个基点，考虑到购买量不大，这是一个相当大的效应。校准的偏好习惯模型变体表明，“现金争夺”——即短期最低风险投资级债券的抛售——加上套利者风险厌恶情绪的飙升，可以解释市场动荡最严重时期投资级信用曲线的倒挂。与实证结果一致，美联储的公告通过降低风险厌恶和缓解市场分割，帮助恢复了投资级市场板块向上倾斜的信用曲线。

records.title_en: Asymmetric information and misaligned inflation expectations
records.title_cn: 信息不对称与通胀预期错位
records.abstract_en: Recent survey evidence reveals misaligned inflation expectations among economic agents. While households associate higher expected inflation with lower output growth, professional forecasters link higher future inflation to higher output growth. Firms’ expectations display neither negative nor positive correlations. We explain such patterns jointly in a general equilibrium New Keynesian framework. Asymmetric information arises naturally as (i) households and firms receive imperfect, asymmetric information about supply and demand shocks, and (ii) the central bank learns from equilibrium outcomes (i.e., output and inflation) as opposed to the private sector. Survey data help uncover the magnitudes of information frictions among economic agents.
records.abstract_cn: 近期调查证据显示，经济主体之间的通胀预期存在错位。家庭将更高的预期通胀与较低产出增长相联系，而专业预测者则将更高的未来通胀与较高产出增长相联系。企业的预期既未表现出负相关也未表现出正相关。我们在一个一般均衡新凯恩斯框架中共同解释了这些模式。信息不对称自然产生于：（i）家庭和企业接收到关于供给和需求冲击的不完美、不对称信息，以及（ii）中央银行从均衡结果（即产出和通胀）中学习，而非私人部门。调查数据有助于揭示经济主体之间信息摩擦的程度。

records.title_en: Estimating the Fed’s unconventional policy shocks
records.title_cn: 估计美联储非常规政策冲击
records.abstract_en: Financial market responses to Fed monetary policy announcements are often very small, but sometimes very large and the mix of news contained in these announcements varies over time. I exploit these features of the data to estimate different types of Fed policy shocks. The resulting shocks can be naturally labeled as standard monetary policy, Odyssean forward guidance, large scale asset purchases and Delphic forward guidance. They affect risk-free interest rates, stock prices and the dollar on impact and have delayed but pronounced effects on corporate bond spreads and breakeven inflation rates.
records.abstract_cn: 金融市场对美联储货币政策声明的反应通常非常小，但有时非常大，且这些声明中包含的新闻组合随时间变化。我利用这些数据特征来估计不同类型的美联储政策冲击。由此产生的冲击可以自然地标记为标准货币政策、奥德赛式前瞻指引、大规模资产购买和德尔斐式前瞻指引。它们影响无风险利率、股票价格和美元，并对公司债券利差和盈亏平衡通胀率产生延迟但显著的影响。

records.title_en: Macroprudential policy with earnings-based borrowing constraints
records.title_cn: 基于收益借贷约束的宏观审慎政策
records.abstract_en: A large literature has studied optimal regulatory policy in macroeconomic models with asset-based collateral constraints. A common conclusion is that agents ‘over-borrow’ and optimal policy reduces debt positions through taxes. The reason is that agents do not internalize the effects of their choices on asset prices. However, recent empirical evidence shows that firms primarily borrow against their earnings rather than their assets. This paper studies optimal macroprudential policy with earnings-based borrowing constraints, both in closed and open economies. We reach the opposite conclusion to the previous literature. Agents ‘over-save’ (and ‘under-borrow’) relative to the social optimum, as they do not internalize changes in wages, which in turn affect firms’ earnings. A numerical model exercise demonstrates that incorrectly rolling out a tax policy derived under the assumption of asset-based constraints in an economy where firms actually borrow based on earnings leads to a consumption equivalent welfare loss of up to 2.55%. Optimal macroprudential policy thus critically depends on the specific form of financial constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 大量文献研究了在具有资产抵押约束的宏观经济模型中的最优监管政策。一个普遍结论是，经济主体会“过度借贷”，而最优政策通过税收减少债务头寸。原因在于经济主体没有内化其选择对资产价格的影响。然而，近期经验证据表明，企业主要基于其收益而非资产进行借贷。本文研究了在封闭和开放经济中，基于收益借贷约束下的最优宏观审慎政策。我们得出了与先前文献相反的结论。相对于社会最优，经济主体会“过度储蓄”（和“借贷不足”），因为他们没有内化工资变化，而工资变化反过来影响企业的收益。一个数值模型练习表明，在假设资产约束下推导出的税收政策，若错误地应用于企业实际基于收益借贷的经济中，会导致高达2.55%的消费等价福利损失。因此，最优宏观审慎政策关键取决于金融约束的具体形式。

records.title_en: The chronology of Brexit and UK monetary policy
records.title_cn: 英国脱欧的时间顺序与英国货币政策
records.abstract_en: The outcome of the Brexit referendum in June 2016 was largely unanticipated. Even after the “Leave” vote, surprises regarding the withdrawal process affected the UK economy. We draw on an official list of political events published by the House of Commons Library and daily data on asset prices and economic policy uncertainty to construct a novel instrument for Brexit surprises. Including a monthly aggregate of this instrument into a vector-autoregressive model of the UK economy, an adverse Brexit surprise lowers GDP growth while raising CPI inflation. We provide evidence that the Bank of England fended off a worse economic contraction.
records.abstract_cn: 2016年六月英国脱欧公投的结果在很大程度上是出乎意料的。即使在“脱欧”投票之后，有关退出进程的意外事件仍影响了英国经济。我们利用下议院图书馆发布的官方政治事件清单以及资产价格和经济政策不确定性的每日数据，构建了一个新颖的英国脱欧意外冲击工具。将这一工具的月度汇总纳入英国经济的向量自回归模型中，不利的脱欧意外冲击会降低GDP增长，同时推高CPI通胀。我们提供的证据表明，英国央行抵御了更严重的经济收缩。

records.title_en: Tiers of joy? Reserve tiering and bank behavior in a negative-rate environment
records.title_cn: 喜悦的层级？负利率环境下的准备金分层与银行行为
records.abstract_en: Negative interest rate regimes typically involve reserve tiering to exempt a portion of bank reserves from negative rates. We study the effects on bank behavior of a large and unanticipated change in reserve tiering by the Swiss National Bank that generated substantial variation across banks and was not related to other events. We find a sizable reallocation of liquidity and deposits within the banking system. Higher exemptions reduce the pass-through of negative rates to deposit rates, especially at retail banks with limited access to the interbank market. Effects on lending are moderate and suggest that higher profitability lessens pressure to reach for yield. Our results are informative about the transmission channels of monetary policy through the banking sector more broadly. We discuss how effects of reserve tiering may differ from effects of changes in interest rates, emphasizing that reserve tiering affects the economy through a narrower set of channels.
records.abstract_cn: 负利率制度通常涉及准备金分层，以豁免部分银行准备金免受负利率影响。我们研究了瑞士国家银行对准备金分层进行的一次大规模且未预期的调整对银行行为的影响，该调整在银行间产生了显著差异，且与其他事件无关。我们发现银行体系内流动性和存款发生了显著的重新配置。更高的豁免降低了负利率向存款利率的传导，尤其是在进入银行间市场渠道有限的零售银行中。对贷款的影响较为温和，表明更高的盈利能力减轻了追求收益的压力。我们的结果对于更广泛地理解货币政策通过银行部门的传导渠道具有启示意义。我们讨论了准备金分层的影响可能如何不同于利率变化的影响，强调准备金分层通过更窄的渠道影响经济。

records.title_en: Adverse selection and search congestion in over-the-counter markets
records.title_cn: 场外市场中的逆向选择与搜寻拥堵
records.abstract_en: Asymmetric information about both private valuations of assets and their quality gives rise to uncertainty over sellers’ motives of trade, allowing high-valuation holders of low-quality assets to engage in speculative trades that involve no allocative gains. When sellers compete to find buyers, such speculative behaviour not only dilutes the average quality of assets but also creates a welfare-detrimental congestion externality that lengthens the time on market for each individual seller. A market designer can mitigate the inefficiencies by imposing a transaction tax and, in the case of severe adverse selection, limiting market participation.
records.abstract_cn: 关于资产私人估值及其质量的信息不对称引发了对卖方交易动机的不确定性，使得持有低质量资产的高估值者能够从事不涉及配置收益的投机性交易。当卖方竞争寻找买方时，这种投机行为不仅稀释了资产的平均质量，还产生了损害福利的拥堵外部性，延长了每个个体卖方在市场上的时间。市场设计者可以通过征收交易税来缓解低效率，并且在严重逆向选择的情况下，限制市场参与。

records.title_en: Does risk matter more in recessions than in expansions? Implications for monetary policy
records.title_cn: 风险在经济衰退时期比扩张时期更重要吗？对货币政策的影响
records.abstract_en: We employ a nonlinear vector autoregression and a non-recursive identification strategy to show that an equal-sized uncertainty shock generates a larger contraction in real activity when growth is low (as in recessions) than when growth is high (as in expansions). An estimated New Keynesian model with recursive preferences replicates these state-contingent responses when approximated to third order around its risky steady state due to a stronger upward nominal pricing bias in recessions than in expansions. Empirical evidence supports this state-contingent channel, and we show that it can greatly reduce the ability of systematic monetary policy to stabilize output during recessions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们采用非线性向量自回归和非递归识别策略来表明，当增长较低（如衰退期）时，同等规模的不确定性冲击对实际经济活动产生的收缩效应大于增长较高（如扩张期）时。一个具有递归偏好的估计新凯恩斯模型，在其风险稳态附近进行三阶近似时，由于衰退期比扩张期存在更强的向上名义定价偏差，复制了这些状态依存的响应。经验证据支持这一状态依存渠道，并且我们表明，它可能大大降低系统性货币政策在衰退期间稳定产出的能力。

records.title_en: Global risk and the dollar
records.title_cn: 全球风险与美元
records.abstract_en: The dollar is a safe-haven currency and appreciates when global risk goes up. We investigate the dollar’s role for the transmission of global risk to the world economy within a Bayesian proxy structural vector autoregressive model. We identify global risk shocks using high-frequency asset-price surprises around narratively selected events. Global risk shocks appreciate the dollar, induce tighter global financial conditions and a synchronized contraction of world economic activity. We benchmark these effects against counterfactuals in which the dollar does not appreciate. In the absence of dollar appreciation, the contractionary impact of a global risk shock is much weaker, both in the rest of the world and the US. For the rest of the world, contractionary financial channels thus dominate expansionary expenditure switching when global risk rises and the dollar appreciates.
records.abstract_cn: 美元是一种避险货币，当全球风险上升时，美元升值。我们研究了美元在全球风险向世界经济传导中的作用，采用贝叶斯代理结构向量自回归模型。我们利用围绕叙事选择事件的高频资产价格意外来识别全球风险冲击。全球风险冲击使美元升值，导致全球金融条件收紧，并引发世界经济活动的同步收缩。我们将这些效应与美元不升值的反事实情况进行了比较。在没有美元升值的情况下，全球风险冲击的收缩效应要弱得多，无论是在世界其他地区还是在美国。对于世界其他地区而言，当全球风险上升且美元升值时，收缩性金融渠道主导了扩张性支出转换效应。

records.title_en: Cross-sectional financial conditions, business cycles and the lending channel
records.title_cn: 横截面金融状况、商业周期与贷款渠道
records.abstract_en: I document business cycle properties of the cross-sectional distributions of U.S. stock returns and credit spreads. The skewness of returns of financial firms (SRF) best predicts economic activity, while being a barometer for the lending channel—credit supply shifts beyond what is explained by borrowers’ conditions. SRF also predict firm-level investment beyond firms’ balance sheets. Using a structural model, I estimate that while SRF is highly cyclical, shocks to the cross-sectional skewness of financial firms’ asset quality help explain GDP growth in historical episodes. These results point to the cross-section of financial firms playing a prominent role in business cycles.
records.abstract_cn: 我记录了美国股票回报率和信用利差的横截面分布的商业周期特性。金融企业回报率的偏度（SRF）最能预测经济活动，同时作为贷款渠道的晴雨表——信贷供给的变动超出了借款人状况所能解释的范围。SRF也能在企业资产负债表之外预测企业层面的投资。通过使用结构模型，我估计虽然SRF具有高度周期性，但金融企业资产质量横截面偏度的冲击有助于解释历史时期内的GDP增长。这些结果表明，金融企业的横截面在商业周期中扮演着重要角色。

records.title_en: Haste makes waste? Quantity-based subsidies under heterogeneous innovations
records.title_cn: 欲速则不达？异质性创新下的数量型补贴
records.abstract_en: With quantity-based innovation targets and subsidy programs launched since the mid-2000s, China has seen a patent surge, accounting for 46% of the world’s total patent applications in 2020; however, the overall patent quality has been declining after 2008. This paper develops a Schumpeterian growth model featuring innovating firms’ quantity–quality trade-off between radical and incremental innovations, and decomposes subsidies’ aggregate impact into quantity and quality channels. We calibrate the model to Chinese firm-level data in the early 2010s. Our quantitative analysis shows that the quality channel effects are negative and dominant, and quantity-based subsidies in that period reduce the TFP growth rate and welfare by 0.19 percentage points and 3.31%, respectively. We evaluate welfare gains under a constrained planner’s problem, and propose skill subsidies which are quality-biased and effectively recover the optimal allocation.
records.abstract_cn: 自2000年代中期以来，中国实施了基于数量的创新目标和补贴计划，导致专利激增，2020年占全球专利申请总量的46%；然而，2008年后整体专利质量持续下降。本文构建了一个熊彼特增长模型，刻画创新企业在激进式创新与渐进式创新之间的数量-质量权衡，并将补贴的总体影响分解为数量渠道和质量渠道。我们将模型校准至2010年代初的中国企业层面数据。定量分析表明，质量渠道效应为负且占主导地位，该时期数量型补贴使全要素生产率增长率和福利分别降低0.19个百分点和3.31%。我们评估了受约束计划者问题下的福利收益，并提出偏向质量的技能补贴，该补贴能有效恢复最优配置。

records.title_en: The macroeconomic effects of universal basic income programs
records.title_cn: 全民基本收入项目的宏观经济效应
records.abstract_en: I develop a heterogeneous agents overlapping generations model to assess the welfare effects of substituting the US income security system with a UBI policy. I study two counterfactual exercises: an expenditure-neutral reform and a large, policy-oriented UBI reform with a transfer equivalent to $1000 monthly, both financed by changes in the consumption tax. The first exercise has a moderate fiscal impact, induces increases in the aggregate output and employment, and reduces earnings and wealth inequality. The second exercise requires a large increase in the consumption tax rate, decreases employment and output, and increases earnings inequality, which moves sideways for wealth. In both cases, disposable income and consumption are more equally distributed, with less accrual at the top. The two economies generate positive welfare gains, with those for the generous UBI economy being larger.
records.abstract_cn: 我开发了一个异质性代理人重叠世代模型，以评估用全民基本收入政策替代美国收入保障体系的福利效应。我研究了两个反事实实验：一个支出中性的改革和一个大规模的、政策导向的全民基本收入改革，其转移支付相当于每月1000美元，两者均通过消费税的变化来融资。第一个实验具有适度的财政影响，促使总产出和就业增加，并降低了收入和财富不平等。第二个实验需要大幅提高消费税税率，降低了就业和产出，并增加了收入不平等，而财富不平等则横向移动。在两种情况下，可支配收入和消费的分配更加平等，顶部的累积减少。这两种经济都产生了正的福利收益，其中慷慨的全民基本收入经济的福利收益更大。

records.title_en: Blended identification in structural VARs
records.title_cn: 结构VAR中的混合识别
records.abstract_en: The proposed blended approach combines identification via heteroskedasticity with sign/narrative restrictions, and instrumental variables. Since heteroskedasticity can point identify shocks, its use results in a sharp reduction of the potentially large identified sets stemming from other approaches. Conversely, sign/narrative restrictions or instrumental variables offer natural solutions to the labeling problem and can help when conditions for point identification through heteroskedasticity are not met. Blending these methods together resolves their respective key issues and leverages their advantages. We illustrate the benefits of the approach in Monte Carlo experiments, and apply it to several examples taken from the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 所提出的混合方法将异方差性识别与符号/叙事限制及工具变量相结合。由于异方差性可以点识别冲击，其使用导致其他方法产生的潜在较大识别集大幅缩减。相反，符号/叙事限制或工具变量为标签问题提供了自然解决方案，并在通过异方差性进行点识别的条件不满足时有所帮助。将这些方法混合在一起解决了它们各自的关键问题，并利用了它们的优势。我们在蒙特卡洛实验中展示了该方法的好处，并将其应用于文献中的几个例子。

records.title_en: Rational overoptimism and limited liability
records.title_cn: 理性过度乐观与有限责任
records.abstract_en: Is excessive risk-taking in credit cycles driven by incentives or biased beliefs? I propose a framework suggesting that the two are actually related and, specifically, that procyclical overoptimism can arise rationally from risk-taking incentives. I show that when firms and banks have a limited liability payoff structure, they have lower incentives to pay attention to the aggregate conditions that generate risk. This leads to systematic underestimation of the accumulation of risk during economic booms and overoptimistic beliefs. As a result, agents lend and borrow excessively, further increasing downside risk. Credit cycles driven by this new “uninformed” risk-taking are consistent with existing evidence such as high credit and low-risk premia predicting a higher probability of crises and negative returns for banks. My model suggests that regulating incentives can decrease overoptimistic beliefs and thus mitigate boom-and-bust cycles.
records.abstract_cn: 信贷周期中的过度风险承担是由激励还是偏差信念驱动的？我提出了一个框架，表明这两者实际上是相关的，具体而言，顺周期的过度乐观可以理性地源于风险承担激励。我表明，当企业和银行具有有限责任支付结构时，它们关注产生风险的总体条件的激励较低。这导致在经济繁荣期间对风险积累的系统性低估和过度乐观的信念。结果，主体过度借贷，进一步增加了下行风险。由这种新的“不知情”风险承担驱动的信贷周期与现有证据一致，如高信贷和低风险溢价预测危机概率更高以及银行负回报。我的模型表明，监管激励可以减少过度乐观信念，从而缓解繁荣-萧条周期。

records.title_en: Housing cycles and gentrification
records.title_cn: 住房周期与绅士化
records.abstract_en: The analysis in this paper documents a high-frequency link between housing markets and downtown gentrification since the mid-1990s. Specifically, property values and the share of formally educated residents increase more in downtown locations than in suburbs during MSA-wide housing market expansions. This relationship holds conditional on changes in MSA-level high-end incomes and is evident at short (three-year) and longer time horizons. I propose a mechanism to account for this evidence based on stronger pass-through from housing market expansions to housing costs for low-income (less formally educated) households. This evidence has implications for the effects of macroeconomic stabilization policies on inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 本文的分析记录了自1990年代中期以来住房市场与市中心绅士化之间的高频联系。具体而言，在大都市统计区（MSA）范围内的住房市场扩张期间，市中心地区的房产价值和受过正规教育的居民比例增长幅度大于郊区。这种关系在控制了MSA层面高收入变化后依然成立，并且在短期（三年）和更长时间范围内均表现明显。我提出了一种机制来解释这一证据，该机制基于住房市场扩张对低收入（受教育程度较低）家庭住房成本的更强传导效应。这一证据对宏观经济稳定政策对不平等的影响具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Unusual shocks in our usual models
records.title_cn: 我们常规模型中的异常冲击
records.abstract_en: We propose a method to allow usual business cycle models to account for the unusual COVID episode. The pandemic and the public and private responses to it are represented by a new shock called the Covid shock, which loads onto wedges that underlie the usual shocks and comes with news about its evolution. We apply our method to a standard medium-scale model, estimating the loadings with 2020q2 data and the evolving news using professional forecasts. The Covid shock accounts for most of the early macroeconomic dynamics, was inflationary and a persistent drag on activity, and the majority of its effects were unanticipated. We also show how the Covid shock can be used to estimate DSGE models with data before, during, and after the pandemic.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出一种方法，使常规商业周期模型能够解释异常的COVID事件。疫情以及公共和私人的应对措施由一种称为Covid冲击的新冲击表示，该冲击加载到构成常规冲击基础的楔子上，并带有其演变的新闻。我们将该方法应用于标准的中等规模模型，使用2020Q2的数据估计载荷，并使用专业预测估计不断演变的新闻。Covid冲击解释了早期宏观经济动态的大部分，具有通胀性，并对经济活动造成持续拖累，其影响的大部分是未预料到的。我们还展示了如何使用Covid冲击来估计包含疫情前、期间和之后数据的DSGE模型。

records.title_en: Optimal monetary policy with r∗<0
records.title_cn: r∗<0时的最优货币政策
records.abstract_en: We study the optimal monetary policy problem in a New Keynesian economy with a zero lower bound (ZLB) on the nominal interest rate, when the steady state natural rate (r∗) becomes permanently negative. We show that the optimal policy aims to approach gradually a new steady state with positive average inflation. Around that steady state, the optimal policy implies well defined (second-best) paths for inflation and output in response to shocks to the natural rate. Under plausible calibrations, the optimal policy implies that the nominal rate remains at its ZLB most of the time. Despite the latter feature, the central bank can implement the optimal outcome as a unique equilibrium by means of an appropriate nonlinear interest rate rule. In order to establish that result, we derive sufficient conditions for local determinacy in a general model with endogenous regime switches.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在名义利率存在零下限（ZLB）的新凯恩斯经济体中，当稳态自然利率（r∗）永久性为负时的最优货币政策问题。我们表明，最优政策旨在逐步趋近一个具有正平均通胀率的新稳态。在该稳态附近，最优政策意味着对自然利率冲击做出明确界定的（次优的）通胀和产出路径。在合理的校准下，最优政策意味着名义利率大部分时间保持在零下限。尽管有后一特征，中央银行可以通过适当的非线性利率规则将最优结果作为唯一均衡实施。为了确立该结果，我们在具有内生制度转换的一般模型中推导了局部确定性的充分条件。

records.title_en: Tariff wars, unemployment, and top incomes
records.title_cn: 关税战、失业与最高收入
records.abstract_en: Motivated by the 2018–19 global tariff war, we develop a multi-country trade model with occupational choice, heterogeneous firms, and unemployment. The model features a complete tariff pass-through and positive optimal tariffs addressing product and labor-market distortions. The quantitative analysis of the model with four countries/regions shows that raising tariffs unilaterally by a country increases welfare but also raises unemployment and top incomes in that country, whereas having the opposite impact on tariff-targeted countries. A global tariff war reduces every country’s welfare, unemployment, and top-income inequality, whereas moving from a worldwide tariff war to free trade raises every country’s welfare, unemployment, and top-income inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 受2018-19年全球关税战的启发，我们构建了一个包含职业选择、异质性企业和失业的多国贸易模型。该模型具有完全的关税传导效应和正的关税最优性，以解决产品市场和劳动力市场的扭曲。对包含四个国家/地区的模型进行的定量分析表明，一国单方面提高关税会增加其福利，但也会提高该国的失业率和最高收入，而对关税目标国家则产生相反的影响。全球关税战会降低每个国家的福利、失业率和最高收入不平等，而从全球关税战转向自由贸易则会提高每个国家的福利、失业率和最高收入不平等。

records.title_en: Cross-border regulatory spillovers and macroprudential policy coordination
records.title_cn: 跨境监管溢出与宏观审慎政策协调
