records.abstract_en: We develop a core–periphery model with financial frictions and cross-border banking to assess the magnitude of regulatory spillovers and the gains from macroprudential policy coordination. A core global bank lends to its affiliates in the periphery and banks in both regions are subject to risk-sensitive capital regulation. Following an expansionary monetary policy in the core, a countercyclical response in capital requirements in that region induces the global bank to increase cross-border lending. We calculate welfare gains associated with countercyclical capital buffers under a range of policy regimes, including independent policymaking, full coordination, and reciprocity—a regime in which capital ratios set in the core are imposed on the global bank’s affiliates abroad. One of our key results is that, even when regulatory spillovers are strong, reciprocity can make all parties better off if regulators attach a sufficient weight to financial stability considerations. With a standard, utility-based welfare criterion, reciprocity may also perform better than independent policymaking when regulatory spillovers are weak.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦和跨境银行的核心-外围模型，以评估监管溢出的程度以及宏观审慎政策协调的收益。一个核心全球银行向其在外围地区的附属机构放贷，两个地区的银行都受到风险敏感资本监管的约束。在核心地区实施扩张性货币政策后，该地区资本要求的逆周期反应促使全球银行增加跨境贷款。我们计算了在多种政策制度下逆周期资本缓冲相关的福利收益，包括独立决策、全面协调以及互惠制度——在这种制度下，核心地区设定的资本比率适用于全球银行在国外的附属机构。我们的一个关键结果是，即使监管溢出很强，如果监管机构对金融稳定考虑给予足够权重，互惠可以使所有各方受益。使用标准的基于效用的福利标准，当监管溢出较弱时，互惠也可能优于独立决策。

records.title_en: Make-up strategies with finite planning horizons but infinitely forward-looking asset prices
records.title_cn: 有限规划视野但资产价格具有无限前瞻性的弥补策略
records.abstract_en: How effective are forward-guidance and make-up strategies? Standard models find them extremely effective, but by assuming households’ inflation expectations respond much more strongly than in the data. Models where households discount the future find them much less effective and match the small reaction of inflation expectations, but not the actual large reaction of asset prices. We build a model that rationalizes both. Households cognitively discount the future, but more forward-looking financial market professionals incorporate their expectations of future policy into the long-term nominal rates faced by all. We find that make-up strategies have sizably better stabilization properties than inflation targeting.
records.abstract_cn: 前瞻指引和弥补策略的效果如何？标准模型发现它们极其有效，但前提是假设家庭通胀预期的反应远强于数据所显示的水平。家庭对未来贴现的模型发现这些策略效果较差，并且与通胀预期的小幅反应相匹配，但无法匹配资产价格的实际大幅反应。我们构建了一个模型，将两者合理化。家庭在认知上对未来贴现，但更具前瞻性的金融市场专业人士将其对未来政策的预期纳入所有人面临的长期名义利率中。我们发现，弥补策略比通胀目标制具有更好的稳定性质。

records.title_en: Mortgage interest deductions? Not a bad idea after all
records.title_cn: 抵押贷款利息扣除？毕竟不是个坏主意
records.abstract_en: Mortgage interest deductions and other homeownership subsidies are widely believed to be harmful because they redistribute resources from lower-income renters to higher-income homeowners. We argue that renters actually benefit from these policies in general equilibrium for two reasons. First, the rental supply curve is relatively inelastic, which means that rents fall when these policies reduce rental demand. Second, many renters spend most of their income on housing, and these renters gain substantially from rent decreases. We calibrate a quantitative model to match empirical evidence on these factors and show they are strong enough that subsidizing homeownership actually increases welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 抵押贷款利息扣除和其他住房所有权补贴被广泛认为是有害的，因为它们将资源从低收入租房者重新分配给高收入房主。我们认为，在一般均衡中，租房者实际上从这些政策中受益，原因有二。首先，租赁供给曲线相对缺乏弹性，这意味着当这些政策减少租赁需求时，租金会下降。其次，许多租房者将大部分收入用于住房，而这些租房者从租金下降中获益颇丰。我们校准了一个定量模型以匹配关于这些因素的实证证据，并表明这些因素足够强大，以至于补贴住房所有权实际上增加了福利。

records.title_en: Effects of monetary policy on household expectations: The role of homeownership
records.title_cn: 货币政策对家庭预期的影响：住房所有权的作用
records.abstract_en: We study the role of homeownership in the effectiveness of monetary policy on households’ expectations based on individual-level microdata in the U.S. We find that homeowners lower their near-term inflation expectations and optimism about the labor market outlook in response to a rise in mortgage rates, while renters are less likely to do so. We further show that forward guidance shocks lead to similar differences between homeowners and renters. Our results suggest that homeowners pay attention to news on interest rates and adjust their expectations accordingly in a manner consistent with the intended effect of monetary policy. We characterize this empirical finding with a rational inattention model where mortgage payments create an incentive for homeowners to acquire information on monetary policy, unlike renters. This housing-driven endogenous attentiveness is the key mechanism behind the compelling empirical link among homeownership, attention, and the transmission of monetary policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于美国个体层面的微观数据，研究住房所有权在货币政策对家庭预期有效性中的作用。我们发现，当抵押贷款利率上升时，房主会降低其近期通胀预期和对劳动力市场前景的乐观程度，而租房者则不太可能这样做。我们进一步表明，前瞻性指引冲击会导致房主与租房者之间出现类似的差异。我们的结果表明，房主关注利率新闻，并相应地调整其预期，其方式与货币政策的预期效果一致。我们用一个理性疏忽模型来刻画这一实证发现，在该模型中，抵押贷款支付激励房主获取货币政策信息，而租房者则不然。这种由住房驱动的内生关注度是住房所有权、关注度与货币政策传导之间令人信服的实证联系背后的关键机制。

records.title_en: The emergence of procyclical fertility: The role of breadwinner women
records.title_cn: 顺周期生育率的出现：女性养家者的作用
records.abstract_en: Fertility in the US exhibits an increasingly more procyclical pattern. We argue that women’s breadwinner status is behind procyclical and lower fertility: (i) women’s relative income in the family has increased over time; and (ii) women are more likely to work in relatively stable and countercyclical industries whereas men tend to work in volatile and procyclical industries. This creates a countercyclical gender income gap as women become breadwinners in recessions, producing an insurance effect of women’s income. Our quantitative framework shows that rising breadwinner status of women can explain both the emergence of procyclical fertility and the decline in fertility rate in the second half of the 20th century.
records.abstract_cn: 美国的生育率呈现出越来越强的顺周期模式。我们认为，女性的养家者地位是顺周期和较低生育率背后的原因：（i）女性在家庭中的相对收入随时间增加；（ii）女性更可能从事相对稳定和逆周期的行业，而男性则倾向于在波动性和顺周期性的行业工作。这造成了逆周期的性别收入差距，因为女性在经济衰退中成为养家者，产生了女性收入的保险效应。我们的定量框架表明，女性养家者地位的上升可以解释20世纪下半叶顺周期生育率的出现和生育率的下降。

records.title_en: Shopping behavior and the effect of monetary policy on inflation heterogeneity along the income distribution
records.title_cn: 购物行为与货币政策对收入分配沿线通胀异质性的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of monetary policy on inflation along the income distribution in the euro area and shows that monetary policy has differential effects. In response to monetary tightenings, high-income households engage in more intense product substitution and trade down in the product and store space relative to low-income households, such that their inflation responds relatively more. This channel stands in contrast to the effect arising from different consumption bundles, which imply that the inflation experienced by high-income households responds less to monetary policy. The paper also reveals substantial cross-country heterogeneity, with the product substitution channel being more pronounced in countries where price differences between possible substitutes are larger.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了欧元区货币政策对收入分配沿线通胀的影响，并表明货币政策具有差异性效应。面对货币紧缩，高收入家庭相对于低收入家庭进行更强烈的产品替代，并在产品和商店空间上进行降级消费，因此其通胀反应相对更大。这一渠道与不同消费篮子所产生的效应形成对比，后者意味着高收入家庭所经历的通胀对货币政策的反应较小。本文还揭示了显著的跨国异质性，产品替代渠道在可能替代品之间价格差异较大的国家更为明显。

records.title_en: Expectation-driven boom-bust cycles
records.title_cn: 预期驱动的繁荣-萧条周期
records.abstract_en: Using data from the Survey of Professional Forecasters, we observe that a large fraction of analysts’ expectations about future economic growth is not due to technology or other shocks to fundamentals measured by the business cycle literature. We find that these unexplained changes in forecast revisions predict significant boom-bust dynamics in the key macroeconomic aggregates. We offer a novel theory where boom-bust dynamics stem from expectation shocks orthogonal to fundamentals.
records.abstract_cn: 利用专业预测者调查的数据，我们观察到，分析师对未来经济增长预期的很大一部分并非源于技术或商业周期文献所衡量的基本面冲击。我们发现，这些预测修正中无法解释的变化预示着关键宏观经济总量中显著的繁荣-萧条动态。我们提出了一种新颖的理论，其中繁荣-萧条动态源于与基本面正交的预期冲击。

records.title_en: Consumer demand and credit supply as barriers to growth for Black-owned startups
records.title_cn: 消费者需求与信贷供给作为黑人初创企业增长的障碍
records.abstract_en: We formulate a framework showing that differences in capital returns and capital intensity between groups of firms can identify relative differences in consumer demand and credit constraints. Using micro-data on Black- and White-owned startups, we find robust evidence that Black-owned startups have lower capital returns, implying that Black-owned startups face lower consumer demand due to race. In contrast, we find mixed evidence of tighter credit constraints due to race. We further show that differences in capital returns are persistent over time, whereas capital intensity differences are transitory. This suggests that lower demand, rather than credit constraints, might be the main barrier to growth for Black-owned startups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个框架，表明不同企业群体之间的资本回报率和资本密集度差异可以识别消费者需求和信贷约束的相对差异。利用黑人和白人拥有的初创企业的微观数据，我们发现强有力的证据表明，黑人拥有的初创企业资本回报率较低，这意味着由于种族原因，黑人拥有的初创企业面临较低的消费者需求。相比之下，我们发现关于种族导致的更严格的信贷约束的证据不一。我们进一步表明，资本回报率的差异随时间持续存在，而资本密集度的差异则是暂时的。这表明，较低的需求，而非信贷约束，可能是黑人拥有的初创企业增长的主要障碍。

records.title_en: Parameter learning in production economies
records.title_cn: 生产经济中的参数学习
records.abstract_en: We examine how parameter learning amplifies the impact of macroeconomic shocks on equity prices and quantities in a standard production economy where a representative agent has Epstein-Zin preferences. An investor observes technology shocks that follow a regime-switching process but does not know the underlying model parameters governing the short-term and long-run perspectives of economic growth. We show that rational belief updating endogenously generates long-run risks that help explain various asset pricing facts, most prominently, dividend yield variance decomposition. The asset pricing implications of endogenous long-run risks depend crucially on the introduction of a procyclical dividend process.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在标准生产经济中，参数学习如何放大宏观经济冲击对股票价格和数量的影响，其中代表性代理人具有Epstein-Zin偏好。投资者观察到遵循制度转换过程的技术冲击，但不知道控制经济增长短期和长期前景的潜在模型参数。我们表明，理性信念更新内生地产生长期风险，这有助于解释各种资产定价事实，最显著的是股息收益率方差分解。内生长期风险的资产定价含义关键取决于顺周期股息过程的引入。

records.title_en: Household Consumption and Dispersed Information
records.title_cn: 家庭消费与分散信息
records.abstract_en: By introducing an information friction to a heterogeneous agent model, we are able to explain two patterns of small economies experiencing large income changes: (1) excess volatility in consumption and (2) household consumption elasticities that have low correlation with income. With a standard dispersed information structure, households cannot distinguish aggregate income shocks from idiosyncratic ones. Their consumption responds excessively to aggregate shocks, which they incorrectly forecast to be too persistent. This effect occurs homogeneously across the income distribution, lowering the correlation of the consumption elasticity with income. We corroborate our central mechanism using survey data on household expectations of their future earnings.
records.abstract_cn: 通过将信息摩擦引入异质性代理人模型，我们能够解释小型经济体经历大幅收入变化的两种模式：（1）消费的过度波动和（2）家庭消费弹性与收入的相关性较低。在标准的分散信息结构下，家庭无法区分总体收入冲击与个体冲击。他们的消费对总体冲击反应过度，因为他们错误地预测这些冲击过于持久。这种效应在收入分布中均匀发生，降低了消费弹性与收入的相关性。我们使用关于家庭未来收入预期的调查数据证实了我们的核心机制。

records.title_en: Credit constraints and firms’ decisions: Lessons from the COVID-19 outbreak
records.title_cn: 信贷约束与企业决策：COVID-19疫情爆发的启示
records.abstract_en: Using novel survey data on Italian firms’ expectations, collected just before and after the beginning of the COVID-19 outbreak, we investigate the role of credit constraints in the transmission of adverse economic shocks. Our results show that credit-constrained firms plan to charge higher prices than unconstrained ones while expecting a larger fall in quantities. When we consider realized outcomes, however, these differences are less pronounced. This evidence is consistent with the credit programs implemented during the crisis being largely unanticipated at its outbreak and benefiting constrained firms relatively more.
records.abstract_cn: 利用在COVID-19疫情爆发前后收集的关于意大利企业预期的新调查数据，我们研究了信贷约束在不利经济冲击传导中的作用。我们的结果表明，信贷约束企业计划收取比无约束企业更高的价格，同时预期数量下降幅度更大。然而，当我们考虑实际结果时，这些差异不那么明显。这一证据与危机期间实施的信贷计划在很大程度上是疫情爆发时未预料到的，并且相对更多地惠及受约束企业的情况一致。

records.title_en: Credit cards, credit utilization, and consumption
records.title_cn: 信用卡、信用利用与消费
records.abstract_en: We use credit bureau data to show that credit card limits grow rapidly early in life and are an important early-life liquidity source. Yet individual credit utilization is stable over the short and long term. To explain these new findings, we propose a life-cycle consumption model with heterogeneous preferences, the option to revolve, and credit cards used for payments. Using diary data to identify payment use and the revealed preference that some people with credit cards borrow at high interest, while others do not to help identify heterogeneous preferences, the estimated model matches consumption and credit use at every frequency. The model suggests that around half the population has an endogenously high marginal propensity to consume. This targetable population explains the large consumption response to unexpected cash.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用信用局数据表明，信用卡额度在生命早期快速增长，是重要的早期流动性来源。然而，个人信用利用率在短期和长期内保持稳定。为解释这些新发现，我们提出了一个具有异质性偏好、循环选择权以及用于支付的信用卡的生命周期消费模型。利用日记数据识别支付用途，并利用揭示偏好——即一些持卡人以高利率借款，而另一些则不这样做——来帮助识别异质性偏好，估计模型匹配了各个频率下的消费和信用使用。模型表明，大约一半的人口具有内生的高边际消费倾向。这一可针对的人群解释了消费对意外现金的大幅反应。

records.title_en: The consumption expenditure response to unemployment: Evidence from Norwegian households
records.title_cn: 失业的消费支出反应：来自挪威 households 的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines heterogeneity in household income and consumption responses to unemployment, using granular administrative tax data from Norway. On average, unemployment results in a significant, lasting income reduction, accompanied by a decrease in consumption expenditures of between one-third to one-half of the income loss. We find that households with greater liquid assets at the outset experience less of a decline in consumption, whereas those with higher levels of debt encounter a more substantial decrease. Notably, also the interaction of liquid assets and debt holdings matters for the consumption response. While households with larger initial liquid asset holdings on average respond less, the analyses show that this is not the case among households that simultaneously hold substantial amounts of debt, thus adding to a more nuanced view of the importance of household heterogeneity for economic outcomes. Furthermore, our investigation into heterogeneity across family composition and child age uncovers distinct patterns in consumption responses, highlighting the varied impacts of unemployment. Lastly, we find that spending patterns, as indicated by the marginal propensity to consume (MPC), become more pronounced during recessions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用挪威的精细行政税收数据，考察了家庭收入和消费对失业反应的异质性。平均而言，失业导致收入显著且持久地减少，同时消费支出下降幅度为收入损失的三分之一至二分之一。我们发现，初始流动资产较多的家庭消费下降较少，而债务水平较高的家庭消费下降幅度更大。值得注意的是，流动资产与债务持有的交互作用对消费反应也很重要。虽然初始流动资产持有较多的家庭平均反应较小，但分析表明，在同时持有大量债务的家庭中并非如此，从而为家庭异质性对经济结果的重要性提供了更为细致的视角。此外，我们对家庭构成和子女年龄异质性的考察揭示了消费反应的不同模式，凸显了失业影响的多样性。最后，我们发现，以边际消费倾向（MPC）衡量的支出模式在经济衰退期间变得更加明显。

records.title_en: Cyclicality of uncertainty and disagreement
records.title_cn: 不确定性与分歧的周期性
records.abstract_en: The empirical literature often uses disagreement (dispersion in forecasts) as a proxy for uncertainty, yet disagreement and uncertainty behave differently throughout the business cycle. The difference is especially salient in non-crisis periods, in which measures of disagreement are positively correlated with growth, while measures of uncertainty are negatively correlated with it. I explain this finding using a noisy information model with endogenous learning. In the model, agents observe noisy private information, but only when they are active. Holding uncertainty fixed, a rise in activity introduces noisy information to the market, and agents’ beliefs diverge, i.e., disagreement rises.
records.abstract_cn: 实证文献通常使用分歧（预测的离散度）作为不确定性的代理指标，然而分歧和不确定性在整个商业周期中的表现有所不同。这种差异在非危机时期尤为显著，此时分歧的度量与增长正相关，而不确定性的度量与增长负相关。我通过一个具有内生学习的噪声信息模型来解释这一发现。在该模型中，代理人观察噪声私人信息，但仅在活跃时如此。在保持不确定性固定的情况下，活动的增加将噪声信息引入市场，代理人的信念发生分化，即分歧上升。

records.title_en: Internal migration, remittances and economic development
records.title_cn: 内部迁移、汇款与经济发展
records.abstract_en: We develop a quantitative spatial equilibrium model with endogenous migration and remittance decisions within households to examine the joint effect of migration and remittances on economic development. We apply the model to internal migration in China. Counterfactual analysis of the calibrated model shows that the presence of remittances increases migration and welfare, reduces regional inequality and facilitates structural change. Compared to a conventional single-person migration model, our household model suggests a larger reduction in regional inequality and stronger reallocation of employment from agriculture to manufacturing and services in response to the decline in migration costs over the period of 2000 to 2010.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个定量空间均衡模型，其中包含家庭内部的迁移和汇款内生决策，以考察迁移和汇款对经济发展的联合效应。我们将该模型应用于中国的内部迁移。校准模型的反事实分析表明，汇款的存在增加了迁移和福利，减少了区域不平等，并促进了结构变革。与传统的单人迁移模型相比，我们的家庭模型表明，在2000年至2010年期间，随着迁移成本的下降，区域不平等的减少幅度更大，就业从农业向制造业和服务业的重新配置更为强劲。

records.title_en: Heteroskedastic supply and demand estimation: Analysis and testing
records.title_cn: 异方差供给与需求估计：分析与检验
records.abstract_en: The Feenstra (1994) method is widely used in the international trade literature to estimate supply and demand elasticities. The method is mechanically an IV strategy, and we demonstrate that this has important implications for its application and reliability. The assumptions needed for it to yield unbiased estimates are stronger than previously understood, and in practice, estimates are subject to bias due to both weak instruments and violations of the exclusion restriction. We illustrate how these arise in context and show that standard tests identify estimates that are likely to be biased. In an application to U.S. import data, estimates of import demand and export supply elasticities are substantially lower among goods that pass standard tests relative to those that fail. We find evidence that this difference in elasticities reflects reduction of bias as well as some selection in the set of goods that tend to pass both tests.
records.abstract_cn: Feenstra（1994）方法在国际贸易文献中被广泛用于估计供给和需求弹性。该方法在机制上是一种工具变量策略，我们证明这对它的应用和可靠性具有重要含义。使其产生无偏估计所需的假设比之前理解的更强，在实践中，估计会因弱工具变量和排他性约束的违反而受到偏误。我们阐述了这些情况如何在具体情境中出现，并表明标准检验能够识别出可能偏误的估计。在对美国进口数据的应用中，通过标准检验的商品其进口需求和出口供给弹性的估计值显著低于未通过检验的商品。我们发现证据表明，这种弹性差异既反映了偏误的减少，也反映了在倾向于通过两项检验的商品集合中存在一定的选择性。

records.title_en: A generalization of the Symmetric Translog functional form
records.title_cn: 对称超越对数函数形式的一种推广
records.abstract_en: Feenstra and Weinstein introduced a special case of the translog cost function, the Symmetric Translog (ST) Cost Function, which replaced all of the second order parameters which are present in the Translog functional form by a single positive parameter. The ST functional form is useful in the context of estimating consumer preferences over related products and provides an alternative to the use of Constant Elasticity of Substitution (CES) preferences in this context. The ST functional form has a potential advantage over the CES functional form that it produces finite estimates for reservation prices for missing products whereas the CES reservation prices are always infinite. The present paper proposes a Generalized Symmetric Translog Cost Function which also generates finite reservation prices but is more flexible than the ST functional form.
records.abstract_cn: Feenstra和Weinstein引入了超越对数成本函数的一个特例，即对称超越对数（ST）成本函数，该函数将超越对数函数形式中存在的所有二阶参数替换为单一的正参数。ST函数形式在估计消费者对相关产品的偏好方面很有用，并在此背景下提供了对常替代弹性（CES）偏好的替代方案。ST函数形式相对于CES函数形式的一个潜在优势是，它为缺失产品产生了有限的保留价格估计，而CES的保留价格总是无限的。本文提出了一种广义对称超越对数成本函数，该函数也产生有限的保留价格，但比ST函数形式更灵活。

records.title_en: Preparing for export opportunities
records.title_cn: 为出口机会做准备
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how firms prepare their workforce to export. We employ a novel identification strategy to isolate how a firm’s hiring decision at home responds to export opportunities that arise from exogenous changes to product demand abroad. Combining Brazilian exporter and linked employer–employee data, we show that firms act on better chances to export by hiring workers with prior experience at exporting firms. We find that firms concentrate this preparatory hiring of experts in skilled blue-collar occupations and that firms separate from the previously hired experts when the predicted export-market participation fails to materialize. The evidence is consistent with the tenet that a few exporting experts in select occupations shape a firm’s competitive advantage.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了企业如何为其劳动力做好出口准备。我们采用一种新颖的识别策略，以隔离企业在国内招聘决策如何响应由国外产品需求外生变化所产生的出口机会。结合巴西出口商和关联的雇主-雇员数据，我们表明，企业会通过招聘具有出口企业先前经验的工人来应对更好的出口机会。我们发现，企业将这种专家预备性招聘集中在技能型蓝领职业中，并且当预测的出口市场参与未能实现时，企业会与先前聘用的专家分离。证据与以下原则一致：少数在特定职业中的出口专家塑造了企业的竞争优势。

records.title_en: The dark side of the boom: Dutch disease, competition with China, and technological upgrading in Colombian manufacturing
records.title_cn: 繁荣的阴暗面：荷兰病、与中国的竞争以及哥伦比亚制造业的技术升级
records.abstract_en: The natural resource boom of the 2000s spurred growth in income and consumption in many commodity-exporting nations. However, this paper brings together a previously unused combination of data sets from Colombia to document evidence of a downside – the currency appreciation associated with this boom led to a significant and persistent decline in R&D spending and in investment in technological upgrading by Colombian manufacturing firms. Our empirical strategy exploits differences in firms' sales across products and export destinations to create firm-specific measures of exposure to exchange rate shocks both abroad and at home. We link these new measurements of exchange rate exposure with Colombian micro data on R&D investment and technology upgrading. The key finding is that real exchange rate appreciation drives significant reductions in both firm-level R&D investment and a measure of technology upgrading that includes expenditure on capital goods, technology licensing, worker training, and other expenditures related to the adoption of new technology. Even after key commodity prices dropped significantly in the mid-2010s, inducing a substantial and long-lasting Colombian currency depreciation, investments in R&D and technology upgrading remained at subdued levels. Our estimated effects suggest that the resource boom and associated appreciation had a significant and persistent negative effect on technological development of Colombian manufacturing firm, and these conclusions remain even after careful attempts to simultaneously control for rising competition with Chinese manufacturers, which also had a negative effect on Colombian firms' technology investments, and the effects of trade liberalization at home and abroad. Similarities between Colombia and other commodity-exporters suggest that the effects documented in this paper may be widespread.
records.abstract_cn: 2000年代的自然资繁荣推动了许多大宗商品出口国的收入和消费增长。然而，本文整合了来自哥伦比亚的此前未使用的数据集组合，以记录其负面影响的证据——与这一繁荣相关的货币升值导致哥伦比亚制造业企业在研发支出和技术升级投资方面出现显著且持续的下降。我们的实证策略利用企业在不同产品和出口目的地的销售差异，构建企业层面在国内外面临汇率冲击的特定暴露度量。我们将这些新的汇率暴露度量与哥伦比亚关于研发投资和技术升级的微观数据联系起来。关键发现是，实际汇率升值显著减少了企业层面的研发投资以及包括资本品支出、技术许可、员工培训和其他与新技术的采用相关的支出在内的技术升级度量。即使在2010年代中期主要大宗商品价格大幅下跌，导致哥伦比亚货币大幅且持久贬值之后，研发和技术升级投资仍保持在低迷水平。我们的估计效应表明，资源繁荣及其相关的升值对哥伦比亚制造业企业的技术发展产生了显著且持续的负面影响，即使在仔细尝试同时控制与中国制造商日益激烈的竞争（这也对哥伦比亚企业的技术投资产生了负面影响）以及国内外贸易自由化的影响之后，这些结论仍然成立。哥伦比亚与其他大宗商品出口国之间的相似性表明，本文记录的效应可能具有普遍性。

records.title_en: Nonbank lenders as global shock absorbers: Evidence from US monetary policy spillovers
records.title_cn: 非银行放贷机构作为全球冲击吸收器：来自美国货币政策溢出效应的证据
records.abstract_en: We show that nonbank lenders act as global shock absorbers from US monetary policy spillovers. For identification, we exploit monetary policy surprises and the global syndicated lending market, where detailed loan-level data allow us to compare the participation of banks and nonbanks in the same loan. When US policy tightens, dollar credit to non-US firms falls, but nonbanks increase credit supply (relative to banks), thereby mitigating the total credit reduction. This relative increase is stronger for riskier non-US firms, proxied by emerging market firms, high-yield firms, or firms in countries with stronger capital inflow restrictions. Finally, there are real effects associated with the international nonbank channel of monetary policy, as firms with better access to nonbank credit relatively increase total corporate debt, investment, and employment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，非银行放贷机构在美国货币政策溢出效应中充当全球冲击吸收器。为识别因果效应，我们利用货币政策意外和全球银团贷款市场，其中详细的贷款层面数据使我们能够比较同一笔贷款中银行和非银行的参与情况。当美国政策收紧时，对非美国企业的美元信贷下降，但非银行机构（相对于银行）增加信贷供给，从而缓解了总信贷减少。这种相对增加对于风险较高的非美国企业更为显著，这些企业以新兴市场企业、高收益企业或资本流入限制较强的国家的企业为代表。最后，货币政策国际非银行渠道存在实际效应，因为获得非银行信贷渠道更好的企业相对增加了总企业债务、投资和就业。

records.title_en: You can’t always get what you want (where you want it): Cross-border effects of the US money market fund reform
records.title_cn: 你不能总是得到你想要的（在你想要的地方）：美国货币市场基金改革的跨境效应
records.abstract_en: This paper documents significant cross-border effects of the 2014 US money market fund (MMF) reform on euro area MMFs. As US-based prime funds became less money-like due to the reform, euro area-based prime funds received large inflows from foreign investors. These cross-border flows were mainly motivated by the search for stable NAV instruments. Consistent with an easing of competitive pressure, euro area prime MMFs reduced their risk-taking. Lastly, the 2017 EU MMF regulation, a weaker regulatory intervention compared to the US reform, did not lead to a reversal of the documented cross-border flows.
records.abstract_cn: 本文记录了2014年美国货币市场基金（MMF）改革对欧元区MMF产生的显著跨境效应。由于改革使美国主要基金变得不那么像货币，欧元区主要基金从外国投资者那里获得了大量流入。这些跨境流动主要是出于对稳定净值工具的寻求。与竞争压力缓解相一致，欧元区主要MMF降低了风险承担。最后，2017年欧盟MMF法规，作为比美国改革更弱的监管干预，并未导致所记录的跨境流动的逆转。

records.title_en: Sovereign debt crises and low interest rates
records.title_cn: 主权债务危机与低利率
records.abstract_en: We revisit the occurrence of self-fulfilling crises in sovereign debt markets under time-varying interest rates and growth in Eaton and Gersovitz (1981)’s model. We show that, when long-term interest rates exceed growth, insolvency is solely caused by the exhaustion of the sovereign’s debt repayment capacity subject to limited commitment. Indeed, high interest rates impose discipline on market sentiments, because creditors necessarily become more optimistic about solvency when the sovereign reduces debt exposure. Creditors’ beliefs respond instead ambiguously under low interest rates fluctuating around growth. As long as interest rates exceed growth, debt reduction alleviates the fiscal burden. However, the sovereign also benefits from the prospect of rolling over outstanding debt as long as interest rates remain below growth. Thus, creditors’ sentiments might adjust adversely to fiscal consolidation. When the default punishment is not disproportionately severe, this mechanism sustains belief-driven debt crises even when fundamentals would otherwise ensure solvency.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视了在Eaton和Gersovitz（1981）模型中，利率和增长随时间变化时主权债务市场中自我实现危机的发生。我们表明，当长期利率超过增长时，无偿付能力仅由主权债务偿还能力的耗尽引起，且受有限承诺约束。实际上，高利率对市场情绪施加纪律，因为当主权国家减少债务敞口时，债权人必然对偿付能力更加乐观。相反，在围绕增长波动的低利率下，债权人的信念反应模糊。只要利率超过增长，债务减少就能减轻财政负担。然而，只要利率保持在增长之下，主权国家也能从展期未偿债务的前景中受益。因此，债权人的情绪可能对财政整顿产生不利调整。当违约惩罚并非不成比例地严重时，即使基本面本可确保偿付能力，这一机制也能维持由信念驱动的债务危机。

records.title_en: Worker reallocation, firm innovation, and Chinese import competition
records.title_cn: 工人重新配置、企业创新与中国进口竞争
records.abstract_en: While recent work has documented a nexus between international trade and firm innovation, the underlying mechanisms explaining firms’ innovation in response to import competition are, thus far, poorly understood. To identify the mechanism of labor adjustments and its economic relevance, we use longitudinal linked employer–employee data from Denmark (1995–2012). We first show that import competition triggers a significant increase in the share of R&D workers at the firm level. The majority of the increase in the share of R&D workers is explained by between-firm, not within-firm, worker reallocation. The significance of this reallocation becomes evident when we show that innovation improvements are observed only among firms that experience a large increase in the share of R&D workers, especially if this increase is achieved through between-firm worker reallocation. We then extend our analysis to Portugal where the labor market is more rigid and find contrasting yet consistent results: labor reallocation occurs only within firms and it does not result in increased innovation.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管近期研究已记录了国际贸易与企业创新之间的联系，但迄今为止，对于企业应对进口竞争而进行创新的潜在机制仍知之甚少。为识别劳动力调整机制及其经济相关性，我们使用了丹麦1995-2012年的纵向关联雇主-雇员数据。我们首先表明，进口竞争在企业层面显著提高了研发工人的占比。研发工人占比增加的大部分可由企业间而非企业内的工人重新配置来解释。当我们展示创新改善仅出现在研发工人占比大幅增加的企业中，尤其是当这种增加通过企业间工人重新配置实现时，这种重新配置的重要性变得显而易见。随后，我们将分析扩展到劳动力市场更为僵化的葡萄牙，并发现了对比鲜明但一致的结果：劳动力重新配置仅发生在企业内部，且并未带来创新的增加。

records.title_en: When are tariff cuts not enough? Heterogeneous effects of trade preferences for the least developed countries
records.title_cn: 关税削减何时不够？最不发达国家贸易优惠的异质性效应
records.abstract_en: Poor countries export a remarkably narrow range of products. To what extent have trade preferences targeted to the least developed countries (LDCs) changed this situation? We study a large set of recent reforms to the LDC trade preferences offered by OECD countries. Leveraging trade policy variation by importer, exporter, product and year, we show that tariff reductions have increased the prevalence of positive trade flows. However, new flows have been far more likely to emerge in cases with previous ‘export experience’, i.e. where countries already exported the same product to another OECD country, or exported a related product to the same importer. So this wave of tariff cuts for LDCs has resulted in an extension of existing patterns of trade rather than wider export diversification.
records.abstract_cn: 贫穷国家出口的产品范围极为狭窄。针对最不发达国家（LDCs）的贸易优惠在多大程度上改变了这一状况？我们研究了OECD国家向最不发达国家提供的贸易优惠近期的一系列重大改革。利用进口国、出口国、产品和年份层面的贸易政策变化，我们表明关税削减增加了正向贸易流动的普遍性。然而，新的贸易流动更可能出现在具有先前‘出口经验’的情况下，即这些国家已经向另一个OECD国家出口了相同产品，或向同一进口国出口了相关产品。因此，这一轮针对最不发达国家的关税削减导致了现有贸易模式的延伸，而非更广泛的出口多样化。

records.title_en: A rising tide? The local incidence of the second wave of globalization
records.title_cn: 涨潮？第二波全球化的地方性影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate the short- and long-run local labor market impacts of the large increase in U.S. imports and exports that occurred over the 1970s. We exploit the sequential opening of overseas shipping container ports over the period, which generated export and import shocks that were largely non-overlapping across U.S. labor markets thereby providing substantial variation to distinguish their effects. We find that the average net impact on the employment-to-population ratio was positive and concentrated in the initial decade, with little longer-run impact. At the same time, in-migration due to the export shock greatly exceeded out-migration due to the import shock. We show that these different migration responses were largely due to asymmetry in the housing supply curve. The largest gains accrued to residents of labor markets that simultaneously experienced a relatively large export shock, had a relatively low housing supply elasticity, and had a relatively high home-ownership rate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了1970年代美国进口和出口大幅增加对地方劳动力市场的短期和长期影响。我们利用该时期海外航运集装箱港口的相继开放，这些港口产生了在美国劳动力市场上基本不重叠的出口和进口冲击，从而提供了充分的变异性来区分它们的影响。我们发现，对就业人口比率的平均净影响是正的，且集中在最初十年，长期影响较小。同时，由出口冲击引起的迁入人口大大超过了由进口冲击引起的迁出人口。我们表明，这些不同的迁移反应在很大程度上是由于住房供给曲线的非对称性。最大的收益流向了同时经历相对较大出口冲击、住房供给弹性相对较低且住房拥有率相对较高的劳动力市场的居民。

records.title_en: Whatever-it-takes policymaking during the pandemic
records.title_cn: 疫情期间的“不惜一切代价”政策制定
records.abstract_en: Central banks across the globe introduced large-scale asset purchase programs to address the unprecedented circumstances experienced during the pandemic. Many of these programs were announced as open-ended to shock-and-awe market participants and restore confidence in financial markets. This paper examines whether these whatever-it-takes announcements had larger effects than announcements with explicit limits on scale. We use a narrative approach to categorize announcements made by twenty-two central banks, and event study, propensity-score-matching, and local projection methods to measure the short-term effects of policy announcements on exchange rates and sovereign bond yields. We find that on average a central bank’s first whatever-it-takes announcement lowers 10-year bond yields by an additional 47 basis points relative to size-limited announcements, suggesting that communication of potential policy scale matters. Our results for yields hold for both advanced and emerging economies, while exchange rates go in opposing directions, muting their response when we group all countries together.
records.abstract_cn: 全球各国央行推出了大规模资产购买计划，以应对疫情期间前所未有的情况。其中许多计划在宣布时并未设定上限，旨在震慑市场参与者并恢复金融市场的信心。本文考察了这些“不惜一切代价”的公告是否比明确限制规模的公告产生了更大的影响。我们采用叙事方法对二十二家央行的公告进行分类，并运用事件研究、倾向得分匹配和局部投影方法衡量政策公告对汇率和主权债券收益率的短期影响。我们发现，平均而言，央行首次“不惜一切代价”的公告相对于有限规模的公告，额外降低了10年期债券收益率47个基点，这表明潜在政策规模的沟通很重要。我们的收益率结果在发达经济体和新兴经济体中均成立，而汇率则呈现相反方向，当我们将所有国家汇总在一起时，汇率反应被抵消了。

records.title_en: Bound by ancestors: Immigration, credit frictions, and global supply chain formation
records.title_cn: 受祖先束缚：移民、信贷摩擦与全球供应链形成
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that the ancestry composition shaped by century-long immigration to the US can explain the current structure of global supply chains. Using an instrumental variable strategy combined with a novel dataset that links firm-to-firm global supply chains with their location information and historical migration data, we find that the co-ethnic networks have a positive causal impact on global supply chain relationships between foreign countries and US counties. The positive impact not only exists in supplier–customer relationships but also extends to strategic partnerships and trade in services. The positive impact is stronger in counties in which a larger number of firms are credit constrained, and such a stronger effect becomes even more pronounced when foreign firms are located in countries with weak contract enforcement. The results suggest that co-ethnic networks serve as social collateral to overcome credit constraints and facilitate global supply chain formation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，由长达一个世纪的美国移民所塑造的祖先构成可以解释当前全球供应链的结构。利用工具变量策略结合一个新颖的数据集，该数据集将企业间全球供应链与其位置信息和历史迁移数据联系起来，我们发现同族网络对外国与美国县之间的全球供应链关系具有正向因果影响。这种正向影响不仅存在于供应商-客户关系中，还扩展到战略伙伴关系和服务贸易。在信贷受限企业数量较多的县，这种正向影响更强，并且当外国企业位于合同执行薄弱的国家时，这种更强的效应变得更加显著。结果表明，同族网络作为社会抵押品，以克服信贷约束并促进全球供应链的形成。

records.title_en: Opening up in the 21st century: A quantitative accounting of Chinese export growth
records.title_cn: 21世纪开放：中国出口增长的量化核算
records.abstract_en: China’s rapid export growth has spurred extensive research investigating its effects on other economies. The exact causes of the boom as well as the slowdown in Chinese exporting after 2007 are less well-understood. We quantify the drivers of Chinese export growth using a general equilibrium model estimated with detailed trade and production data that capture rich heterogeneity across destinations, firm ownership types, production locations, and sectors. We find that the three key drivers of Chinese export growth overall are rising foreign demand, improvements in access to imported intermediates, and factor productivity growth within China. Weakening foreign demand and a lack of further improvements in imported inputs access largely explain the slowdown in exporting after 2007. Furthermore, important differences especially across sectors and firms of different ownership types caution against any single narrative.
records.abstract_cn: 中国出口的快速增长引发了对其对其他经济体影响的广泛研究。但对中国出口繁荣及2007年后放缓的确切原因了解较少。我们使用一个通过详细贸易和生产数据估计的一般均衡模型来量化中国出口增长的驱动因素，这些数据捕捉了目的地、企业所有权类型、生产地点和部门之间的丰富异质性。我们发现，中国出口增长的三个关键驱动因素总体上是外国需求上升、进口中间品获取改善以及中国国内要素生产率增长。外国需求减弱和进口投入品获取缺乏进一步改善在很大程度上解释了2007年后出口放缓的原因。此外，特别是不同部门和不同所有权类型企业之间的重要差异提醒我们不要采用任何单一解释。

records.title_en: Global knowledge and trade flows: Theory and measurement
records.title_cn: 全球知识与贸易流动：理论与测度
records.abstract_en: We present a model of trade, global innovation, and diffusion, inspired by Eaton and Kortum (1999). The specific structure for innovation and diffusion we propose, which leverages general results developed in our previous work (Lind and Ramondo, 2023a), allows us to measure the flow of ideas across countries and over time. By deriving tractable expressions for productivity and expenditure, we can use easily-available international trade data to estimate both innovation and diffusion rates across countries and over time. We find that, although innovation is correlated with economic growth, there are many high income countries that primarily produce using diffused ideas from foreign sources.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个贸易、全球创新与扩散模型，其灵感来源于Eaton和Kortum（1999）。我们提出的创新与扩散的具体结构，利用了我们在先前工作中（Lind和Ramondo, 2023a）发展的一般性结果，使我们能够衡量思想在国家间和跨时间的流动。通过推导生产率和支出的可处理表达式，我们可以利用易于获得的国际贸易数据来估计各国及跨时间的创新率和扩散率。我们发现，尽管创新与经济增长相关，但许多高收入国家主要利用来自外国的扩散思想进行生产。

records.title_en: FDI and superstar spillovers: Evidence from firm-to-firm transactions
records.title_cn: 外商直接投资与超级明星企业溢出效应：来自企业间交易的证据
records.abstract_en: Using firm-to-firm transactions, we show that starting to supply a ‘superstar’ firm (large domestic firms, exporters and multinationals) boosts productivity by 8% after three years. Placebos on starting relationships with smaller firms and novel identification strategies support a causal interpretation of “superstar spillovers”. Consistent with a model of technology transfer, we find bigger treatment effects from technology-intensive superstars and also falls in markups (in order to win superstar contracts). We also show that firms that start supplying superstar firms enjoy a ‘dating agency’ effect — an increase in the number of new buyers that is particularly strong within the superstar firm’s network. Taken together, the results suggest an important role for raising productivity through superstars’ supply chains regardless of multinational status.
records.abstract_cn: 利用企业间交易数据，我们发现开始向“超级明星”企业（大型国内企业、出口商和跨国公司）供货会在三年后使生产率提高8%。针对与较小企业建立供应关系的安慰剂检验以及新颖的识别策略支持了“超级明星溢出效应”的因果解释。与技术转移模型一致，我们发现来自技术密集型超级明星企业的处理效应更大，同时企业为赢得超级明星合同而降低加成率。我们还发现，开始向超级明星企业供货的企业享有“婚介所”效应——新买家数量增加，且在超级明星企业的网络内尤为显著。综合来看，结果表明无论是否具有跨国企业身份，通过超级明星企业的供应链提升生产率具有重要作用。

records.title_en: The boom of corporate debt in emerging markets: Carry trade or save to invest?
records.title_cn: 新兴市场企业债务的繁荣：套利交易还是储蓄以投资？
records.abstract_en: The decline in international interest rates following the global financial crisis encouraged firms in emerging markets to increase their corporate bond issuance abroad. Evidence shows that issuing offshore debt increases cash holdings, suggesting firms may exploit interest rate arbitrage. We argue that increasing contemporaneous cash holdings may also be undertaken for a “save to invest” motive to finance future investment opportunities. Using a sample of nonfinancial listed firms from 15 emerging market economies from 2001 to 2016, we show that companies accumulate cash when carry trade is favorable; however, we find that the increased cash holdings substantially revert in the following two periods, consistent with arguments for a “save to invest” motive. Indeed, offshore debt has a significant impact on both current and next-year investment.
records.abstract_cn: 全球金融危机后国际利率的下降鼓励了新兴市场的企业增加其在海外的公司债券发行。证据表明，发行离岸债务会增加现金持有量，暗示企业可能利用利率套利。我们认为，增加同期现金持有也可能是出于“储蓄以投资”的动机，以资助未来的投资机会。使用来自15个新兴市场经济体2001年至2016年的非金融上市公司样本，我们表明当套利交易有利时，公司会积累现金；然而，我们发现增加的现金持有量在接下来的两个时期内大幅回落，这与“储蓄以投资”动机的论点一致。确实，离岸债务对当前和下一年的投资都有显著影响。

records.title_en: Global natural rates in the long run: Postwar macro trends and the market-implied r∗ in 10 advanced economies
records.title_cn: 长期全球自然利率：战后宏观趋势与10个发达经济体的市场隐含r∗
records.abstract_en: Benchmark finance and macroeconomic models appear to deliver conflicting estimates of the natural rate and bond risk premia. This natural rate puzzle applies not only in the U.S. but across many advanced economies. We use a unified no-arbitrage macro-finance model with two trend factors to estimate the natural rate r∗ for 10 advanced economies. We cover a longer and wider sample than previous studies and draw on new sources to construct yield curves and excess returns. The two-trend model improves the explanatory power of yield regressions and return forecasts. Most variation in yields is due to the macro trends r∗ and π∗, and not bond risk premia, which are flatter than previous estimates. Our r∗ estimates covary with growth and demographic variables in a manner consistent with theory and previous findings.
records.abstract_cn: 基准金融和宏观经济模型似乎对自然利率和债券风险溢价给出了相互矛盾的估计。这一自然利率之谜不仅适用于美国，也适用于许多发达经济体。我们使用一个包含两个趋势因子的统一无套利宏观金融模型来估计10个发达经济体的自然利率r∗。我们覆盖了比以往研究更长、更广泛的样本，并利用新来源构建收益率曲线和超额收益。双趋势模型提高了收益率回归和回报预测的解释力。收益率的大部分变动归因于宏观趋势r∗和π∗，而非债券风险溢价，后者比之前的估计更为平坦。我们的r∗估计与增长和人口统计变量的协变方式与理论和先前发现一致。

records.title_en: International input–output linkages and changing business cycle volatility
records.title_cn: 国际投入产出关联与商业周期波动性的变化
records.abstract_en: We quantify the effects of changes in international input–output linkages on the nature of business cycles. We build a multi-country international business cycle model with manufacturing and non-manufacturing sectors that matches the input–output structure within and across countries. We find that, in our 23-country sample, changes in the international input–output linkages between 1970 and 2007 have led to a drop in output volatility in all countries, explaining up to a half of the drop in output volatility in a median country observed in the data. In the model, stronger international linkages tend to stabilize output in response to domestic shocks, and destabilize for foreign shocks. Since foreign shocks still play a modest role in driving domestic business cycles, the stabilization effects dominate. Nevertheless, changing international linkages have generated larger shock transmission across countries, increasing the risk of a global recession.
records.abstract_cn: 我们量化了国际投入产出关联变化对商业周期性质的影响。我们构建了一个包含制造业和非制造业部门的多国国际商业周期模型，该模型匹配了国内及跨国间的投入产出结构。我们发现，在我们的23国样本中，1970年至2007年间国际投入产出关联的变化导致所有国家的产出波动性下降，解释了数据中观察到的中位数国家产出波动性下降的一半。在模型中，更强的国际关联倾向于稳定国内冲击下的产出，但对外国冲击则起到不稳定作用。由于外国冲击在国内商业周期驱动中仍扮演次要角色，稳定效应占主导。然而，国际关联的变化导致了跨国间更大的冲击传导，增加了全球衰退的风险。

records.title_en: Capital controls and firm performance
records.title_cn: 资本管制与企业绩效
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the differential effects of capital controls (CCs) on firms’ performance depending on the firm’s production technology and export status. We empirically characterize the firm’s responses to the introduction of a CC using the Chilean encaje implemented between 1991 and 1998. Motivated by the empirical insights, we build a general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms, financial constraints and international trade and calibrate it to the Chilean economy. We find that CCs have heterogeneous effects on firms. Exporting firms operating in more capital-intensive sectors are more negatively affected than exporting firms operating in less capital-intensive sectors. Non-exporting firms in capital-intensive sectors experience more negative effects on capital than firms in less-capital intensive sectors, but the opposite is true for domestic sales. These results are a consequence of the increase in financing costs, the depreciation of the real exchange rate, and compositional effects on the mass of exporters and non-exporters.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了资本管制（CCs）对企业绩效的差异化影响，这种影响取决于企业的生产技术及出口状态。我们利用智利在1991至1998年间实施的encaje政策，实证刻画了企业对引入资本管制的反应。基于实证洞察，我们构建了一个包含异质性企业、金融约束和国际贸易的一般均衡模型，并将其校准至智利经济。我们发现资本管制对企业具有异质性影响。在资本更密集型行业运营的出口企业，其受到的负面影响大于在资本密集度较低行业运营的出口企业。资本密集型行业中的非出口企业在资本方面受到的负面影响大于资本密集度较低行业中的企业，但国内销售方面则相反。这些结果是融资成本上升、实际汇率贬值以及出口商和非出口商数量构成效应共同作用的结果。

records.title_en: Inflation expectations and risk premia in emerging bond markets: Evidence from Mexico
records.title_cn: 新兴债券市场的通胀预期与风险溢价：来自墨西哥的证据
records.abstract_en: To study inflation expectations and associated risk premia in emerging bond markets, we provide estimates for Mexico based on an arbitrage-free dynamic term structure model of nominal and real bond prices that accounts for their liquidity risk. Beyond documenting the existence of large and weakly correlated liquidity premia in nominal and real bond prices, our results indicate that long-term inflation expectations in Mexico are well anchored close to the Bank of Mexico’s inflation target. Furthermore, Mexican inflation risk premia are larger and more volatile than those in Canada and the United States.
records.abstract_cn: 为了研究新兴债券市场的通胀预期及相关风险溢价，我们基于一个考虑流动性风险的无套利动态期限结构模型，对名义和实际债券价格进行了估计，提供了墨西哥的估计结果。除了证明名义和实际债券价格中存在规模较大且相关性较弱的流动性溢价外，我们的结果表明，墨西哥的长期通胀预期很好地锚定在墨西哥银行通胀目标附近。此外，墨西哥的通胀风险溢价比加拿大和美国的更大且更波动。

records.title_en: Dollar reserves and U.S. yields: Identifying the price impact of official flows
records.title_cn: 美元储备和美国收益率：确定官方资金流动对价格的影响
records.abstract_en: By exploiting changes in the volatility of U.S. Treasury yields and foreign official (FO) flows into U.S. Treasuries after the 2008 Global Financial Crisis, we identify a FO flow shock via heteroskedasticity in a structural VAR. We estimate that a $100B FO flow shock moves 5 and 10-year U.S. yields by about 100 basis points within a month. An event study of the intraday U.S. Treasury yield curve response to Japan’s FX intervention in September 2022 validates our VAR estimates. Our findings imply that a 1% reduction in the Dollar share of China’s reserves could raise long-term U.S. yields by about 20 basis points.
records.abstract_cn: 通过利用2008全球金融危机后美国国债收益率和外国官方 (FO) 流入美国国债的波动性变化，我们通过结构性 VAR 中的异方差确定了 FO 流量冲击。我们估计，$100B FO 流量冲击将在一个月内使 5 和 10 年期美国收益率上升约 100 个基点。 九月2022对美国国债盘中收益率曲线对日本外汇干预的反应进行的事件研究验证了我们的 VAR 估计。我们的研究结果表明，中国储备中美元份额的下降 1% 可能会使美国长期收益率提高约 20 个基点。

records.title_en: How firms accumulate inputs: Evidence from import switching
records.title_cn: 企业如何积累投入品：来自进口转换的证据
records.abstract_en: We uncover new dynamic facts in Colombian manufacturing importers’ data. First, imported input switching, a firm’s simultaneous adding and dropping of foreign intermediates, is pervasive and a substantial fraction of firm’s imports. Second, larger firms switch more conditional on age, whereas younger firms switch more conditional on size. Third, the number of imported varieties increases with firm age. Fourth, inputs of lower expenditure are more frequently dropped. Fifth, firms that switch more, have larger sales growth. Analogous facts also hold for suppliers. We propose a dynamic model where firms accumulate foreign suppliers and choose which heterogeneously productive intermediates to import. A firm compares each input’s productivity across suppliers and keeps the best source, switching, lowering its unit cost, and growing in size. In the calibrated model, a 20% tariff reduction: (1) generates a 5.2% increase in welfare across steady states, and (2) upon impact only 76% of the gains accrue.
records.abstract_cn: 我们揭示了哥伦比亚制造业进口商数据中新的动态事实。首先，进口投入品转换，即企业同时增加和减少外国中间品，是普遍存在的，并且占企业进口的相当大比例。其次，在给定年龄条件下，规模较大的企业转换更多，而在给定规模条件下，较年轻的企业转换更多。第三，进口品种类数量随企业年龄增加而增加。第四，支出较低的投入品更频繁地被淘汰。第五，转换更多的企业销售增长更大。类似的事实也适用于供应商。我们提出了一个动态模型，其中企业积累外国供应商并选择进口哪些具有异质性生产率的中间品。企业比较每种投入品在不同供应商之间的生产率，保留最佳来源，进行转换，降低单位成本，并扩大规模。在校准模型中，关税降低20%：（1）在稳态之间福利增加5.2%，（2）在冲击发生时，只有76%的收益得以实现。

records.title_en: Unmitigated disasters? Risk sharing and macroeconomic recovery in a large international panel
records.title_cn: 未减轻的灾难？大型国际面板中的风险分担与宏观经济复苏
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the patterns of macroeconomic recovery following natural disasters. In a panel with global coverage from 1960 to 2011, we make use of insurer-assessed losses to estimate growth responses conditional on risk transfer. We find that major disasters reduce growth by 1 to 2 percentage points on impact, and over time produce an output cost of 2% to 4% of GDP, on top of the initial damage to property and infrastructure. Akin to wars and financial crises, natural disasters have permanent effects, in the sense that output losses are not fully recovered over time. But it is the uninsured losses that drive the macroeconomic cost; insured losses are less consequential in the aggregate, and can even stimulate growth. By helping to finance the recovery, insurance mitigates the macroeconomic cost of disasters. Many countries lack the capacity to (re)insure themselves and would stand to benefit from more international risk sharing.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了自然灾害后宏观经济复苏的模式。在一个覆盖全球、时间跨度为1960年至2011年的面板中，我们利用保险公司评估的损失来估计在风险转移条件下的增长反应。我们发现，重大灾害在冲击当年使增长降低1至2个百分点，并且随着时间的推移，除了对财产和基础设施的初始损害之外，还会产生相当于GDP的2%至4%的产出成本。与战争和金融危机类似，自然灾害具有永久性影响，即产出损失不会随时间完全恢复。但正是未保险的损失推动了宏观经济成本；保险损失在总体上影响较小，甚至可能刺激增长。通过帮助为复苏提供资金，保险减轻了灾害的宏观经济成本。许多国家缺乏（再）保险自身的能力，并将从更多的国际风险分担中受益。

records.title_en: Permanent and temporary monetary policy shocks and the dynamics of exchange rates
records.title_cn: 永久性和暂时性货币政策冲击与汇率动态
records.abstract_en: We show the distinction between permanent and temporary monetary policy shocks is helpful to understand the impacts of monetary policy on exchange rates in the short as well as over the long run. Drawing on monthly data for several advanced economies from 1971 to 2019 and resorting to a simple structural vector error correction (SVEC) model, we find that a shock leading to a temporary increase in U.S. nominal interest rates leads to a temporary appreciation of the USD against the other currencies. In turn, a monetary policy shock leading to a permanent rise in nominal interest rates – e.g., one associated with a normalisation of monetary policy after a long period at the zero lower bound – results in a depreciation of the USD, in the short as well as over the long run that may contribute to higher (not lower) inflation also in the short run.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，区分永久性和暂时性货币政策冲击有助于理解货币政策对汇率在短期和长期的影响。利用1971年至2019年多个发达经济体的月度数据，并采用简单的结构向量误差修正（SVEC）模型，我们发现，导致美国名义利率暂时上升的冲击会导致美元对其他货币暂时升值。反过来，导致名义利率永久性上升的货币政策冲击——例如，在长期处于零利率下限后货币政策正常化相关的冲击——会导致美元在短期和长期内贬值，这可能有助于在短期内推高（而非降低）通胀。

records.title_en: A theory of economic sanctions as terms-of-trade manipulation
records.title_cn: 经济制裁作为贸易条件操纵的理论
records.abstract_en: How can a country design economic sanctions to maximize their economic cost to the sanctioned country at the lowest cost to the sanctioner? I consider this problem from the perspective of international trade and draw a close connection between trade restrictions as economic sanctions and trade restrictions as terms-of-trade manipulation. This connection has useful implications for the design of trade taxes as sanctions: Small sanctions increase welfare in the sanctioning country. Sanctions target the same goods as terms-of-trade manipulation. Sanctions ignore elasticities of demand and supply in the sanctioning country.
records.abstract_cn: 一个国家如何设计经济制裁，以在对制裁国成本最低的情况下，最大化对被制裁国的经济成本？我从国际贸易的角度考虑这一问题，并将作为经济制裁的贸易限制与作为贸易条件操纵的贸易限制紧密联系起来。这种联系对设计作为制裁的贸易税具有有用的启示：小规模制裁会增加制裁国的福利。制裁针对的商品与贸易条件操纵相同。制裁忽略了制裁国国内的需求和供给弹性。

records.title_en: Financial crises, bailouts and monetary policy in open economies
records.title_cn: 开放经济中的金融危机、救助与货币政策
records.abstract_en: I jointly study the optimal bailout policy and monetary policy in open economies that borrow in foreign currency from international lenders. A policy dilemma emerges during financial crises. Policymakers trade off the benefit of more bailouts alleviating firms’ financial constraints against the cost of larger currency devaluation, which tightens firms’ financial constraints. I embed the optimal bailout in an otherwise standard “sudden stop” model with nominal rigidities. The model sheds light on the role of bailouts and currency mismatch in driving the exchange rate dynamics, firms’ balance sheets and economic recovery. Quantitatively, the model matches key business cycle moments. A welfare evaluation shows that there are in general welfare gains from the systemic bailout policy despite ex ante moral hazard problems of firms.
records.abstract_cn: 我共同研究了从国际贷款人处借入外币的开放经济中的最优救助政策和货币政策。金融危机期间出现了政策困境。政策制定者需要在更多救助缓解企业财务约束的收益与更大货币贬值加剧企业财务约束的成本之间进行权衡。我将最优救助嵌入到一个具有名义刚性的标准“突然停止”模型中。该模型揭示了救助和货币错配在驱动汇率动态、企业资产负债表和经济复苏中的作用。在定量方面，该模型匹配了关键的经济周期矩。福利评估表明，尽管存在企业的事前道德风险问题，系统性救助政策通常仍能带来福利收益。

records.title_en: Corporate foreign bond issuance and interfirm loans in China
records.title_cn: 中国企业海外债券发行与企业间贷款
records.abstract_en: We use firm-level data to analyze international bond issuance by Chinese non-financial corporations, distinguishing those by sectors classed as ‘risky’. Dollar issuance is positively correlated with the differential between domestic and foreign interest rates, and this effect is particularly strong for firms in risky sectors. Strikingly, firms in risky sectors use the proceeds to do more interfirm lending than firms in non-risky sectors. Moreover, this lending rose significantly after the authorities sought to restrict the financial activities of risky sectors in 2008–09. Firms in risky sectors compound risk by engaging in speculative activities that mimic the behavior of financial institutions while escaping prudential regulation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用企业层面数据来分析中国非金融企业的国际债券发行，并区分那些被归类为“高风险”行业的企业。美元发行量与国内外利率差异呈正相关，且这一效应在风险行业企业中尤为显著。引人注目的是，风险行业企业比非风险行业企业更多地将发行所得用于企业间贷款。此外，在当局于2008-09年试图限制风险行业金融活动之后，这种贷款显著增加。风险行业企业通过从事模仿金融机构行为、同时逃避审慎监管的投机活动，加剧了风险。

records.title_en: The distributional impacts of transportation networks in China
records.title_cn: 中国交通网络的分布效应
records.abstract_en: We document that the quality of roads and railroads vary substantially over time and space in China, and neglecting these variations biases the distributional impacts of transportation networks. To account for quality differences, we construct a new panel dataset and approximate quality using the design speed of roads and railroads that varies by vintage, class, and terrain at the pixel level. We then build a dynamic spatial general equilibrium model for multiple modes, transportation routes, and forward-looking migration decisions. Our findings demonstrate that disregarding quality differences leads to a median bias of approximately 31% in estimating real wage growth rates at the prefecture level. Moreover, this bias is non-random and correlates with the initial conditions of the prefectures, resulting in significant errors when predicting the distributional effects of transportation networks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录到中国公路和铁路的质量在时间和空间上存在显著差异，而忽视这些差异会使交通网络的分布效应产生偏差。为了考虑质量差异，我们构建了一个新的面板数据集，并使用像素级别上随年代、等级和地形变化的设计速度来近似质量。随后，我们构建了一个包含多种交通方式、运输路线和前瞻性迁移决策的动态空间一般均衡模型。我们的研究结果表明，忽视质量差异会导致地级市实际工资增长率估计的中位数偏差约为31%。此外，这种偏差并非随机，且与地级市的初始条件相关，从而在预测交通网络的分布效应时产生显著误差。

records.title_en: Reprint of: Quantifying the Germany shock: Structural labor-market reforms and spillovers in a currency union
records.title_cn: 重印：量化德国冲击：货币联盟中的结构性劳动力市场改革与溢出效应
records.abstract_en: We examine the effects of unilateral structural reforms within a currency union. Focusing on the surge of German competitiveness following the introduction of the Euro, we first provide reduced-form causal evidence supporting the notion that German structural labor-market reforms in the early 2000s led to a crowding-out of manufacturing employment in other Eurozone economies. To assess the impact of this German competitiveness shock, we build a quantitative multi-sector trade model that features downward nominal wage rigidities, endogenous labor supply, unemployment-insurance benefits and international savings. The fixed nominal exchange rate can create binding nominal rigidities in response to a foreign real supply shock – like the one prompted by the German reforms – resulting in significant contraction of manufacturing sectors and increased involuntary unemployment across other Eurozone countries. We consider a number of counterfactual scenarios, such as the impact of German labor-market reforms in the absence of a fixed exchange-rate regime, the role of coordinated reforms within the Eurozone and a higher average inflation rate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了货币联盟内单边结构性改革的影响。聚焦于欧元引入后德国竞争力的激增，我们首先提供了简化形式的因果证据，支持德国早期2000的结构性劳动力市场改革导致了欧元区其他经济体制造业就业被挤出的观点。为了评估这一德国竞争力冲击的影响，我们构建了一个定量多部门贸易模型，该模型具有名义工资刚性、内生劳动力供给、失业保险福利和国际储蓄的特征。固定名义汇率可能应对外国实际供给冲击（如德国改革所引发的冲击）而产生约束性名义刚性，导致欧元区其他国家制造业部门显著收缩和非自愿失业增加。我们考虑了一系列反事实情景，例如在没有固定汇率制度的情况下德国劳动力市场改革的影响、欧元区内协调改革的作用以及更高的平均通胀率。

records.title_en: The costs and benefits of rules of origin in modern free trade agreements
records.title_cn: 现代自由贸易协定中原产地规则的成本与收益
records.abstract_en: Rules of origin offer preferred market access for final goods whose inputs originate mostly within a free trade agreement. Governments often champion such rules for boosting investment. We use a property-rights framework to study when this motivation is justifiable. The rule does not bind for all supply chains, as some (very-high-productivity) suppliers comply in an unconstrained way and some (very-low-productivity) suppliers do not comply. For those suppliers it affects, the rule both increases investments and induces excessive sourcing within the trading bloc. From a social standpoint, the best rule binds for relatively high-productivity suppliers, because the marginal net welfare gain from tightening it increases with productivity. Therefore, when industry productivity is high, a strict rule is socially desirable. In contrast, a lenient rule binds for relatively low-productivity suppliers and is more likely to be harmful. For output tariffs that are not too high, a sufficiently strict rule ensures welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 原产地规则为最终产品提供优惠市场准入，前提是其投入品主要来自自由贸易协定内部。政府常以促进投资为由支持此类规则。我们运用产权框架研究这一动机何时合理。该规则并非对所有供应链都具有约束力，因为一些（极高生产率）供应商以不受约束的方式合规，而一些（极低生产率）供应商则不合规。对于受其影响的供应商，该规则既增加了投资，也导致在贸易集团内部过度采购。从社会角度看，最优规则应约束生产率相对较高的供应商，因为收紧规则带来的边际净福利收益随生产率提高而增加。因此，当行业生产率较高时，严格规则在社会上是可取的。相反，宽松规则约束生产率相对较低的供应商，更可能有害。对于不太高的产出关税，足够严格的规则可确保福利收益。

records.title_en: Quantifying the Germany shock: Structural labor-market reforms and spillovers in a currency union
records.title_cn: 量化德国冲击：货币联盟中的结构性劳动力市场改革与溢出效应
records.abstract_en: We examine the effects of unilateral structural reforms within a currency union. Focusing on the surge of German competitiveness following the introduction of the Euro, we first provide reduced-form causal evidence supporting the notion that German structural labor-market reforms in the early 2000s led to a crowding-out of manufacturing employment in other Eurozone economies. The fixed nominal exchange rate can create binding nominal rigidities in response to a foreign real supply shock – like the one prompted by the German reforms – resulting in significant contraction of manufacturing sectors and increased involuntary unemployment across other Eurozone countries. We consider a number of counterfactual scenarios, such as the impact of German labor-market reforms in the absence of a fixed exchange-rate regime, the role of coordinated reforms within the Eurozone and a higher average inflation rate.

records.title_en: All aboard: The effects of port development
records.title_cn: 全员登船：港口发展的影响
records.abstract_en: Seaports facilitate the fast flow of goods across space, but ports also entail local costs borne by host cities. We use the introduction of containerized shipping to explore the effects of port development. At the local level, we find that seaport development increases city population by making a city more attractive, but this market access effect is offset by costs which make the city less attractive. At the aggregate level, we find that the local costs associated with port development are heterogeneous across cities and reduce aggregate welfare gains. Net of the costs, our results suggest that containerization in seaports increased world welfare by 3.4%.
records.abstract_cn: 海港促进了货物在空间上的快速流动，但港口也给所在城市带来了地方性成本。我们利用集装箱运输的引入来探讨港口发展的影响。在地方层面，我们发现海港发展通过使城市更具吸引力来增加城市人口，但这种市场准入效应被使城市吸引力下降的成本所抵消。在总体层面，我们发现与港口发展相关的地方成本在不同城市间存在异质性，并降低了总体福利收益。扣除成本后，我们的结果表明，海港集装箱化使世界福利增加了3.4%。

records.title_en: Financial crises and the global supply network: Evidence from multinational enterprises
records.title_cn: 金融危机与全球供应网络：来自跨国企业的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper empirically examines the effects of financial crises on the organization of production of multinational enterprises. We construct a panel of European multinational networks from 2003 through 2015. We compute a multinational-specific shock based on the geographical structure of the network and the extent of the financial crisis in the countries belonging to the network. We document that multinationals facing a larger shock to their network experience lower growth in their number of affiliates and a deterioration in parents’ performance. This adjustment to the financial crisis is accounted for by multinationals with initially more leveraged parents, and it is exacerbated in networks more dependent on external financing. Moreover, initially more leveraged affiliates are more likely to be dropped from a multinational network. These findings lend support to financial frictions shaping multinational activity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文实证研究了金融危机对跨国企业生产组织的影响。我们构建了从2003年到2015年的欧洲跨国网络面板数据。我们基于网络的地理结构和网络所属国家金融危机的程度，计算了一个跨国企业特定的冲击。我们发现，面临更大网络冲击的跨国企业，其子公司数量增长较低，且母公司绩效恶化。这种对金融危机的调整主要由初始杠杆率较高的母公司所解释，并且在更依赖外部融资的网络中更为严重。此外，初始杠杆率较高的子公司更有可能被从跨国网络中剔除。这些发现支持了金融摩擦塑造跨国活动的观点。

records.title_en: The politics of redistribution and sovereign default
records.title_cn: 再分配政治与主权违约
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how distributional and electoral concerns shape sovereign default incentives within a quantitative model of sovereign debt with heterogeneous agents and non-linear income taxation. The small open economy is characterized by a two-party system in which the left-wing party has a larger preference for redistribution than the right-wing party. Political turnover is the endogenous outcome of the electoral process. Fiscal policy faces a tradeoff: On the one hand, the government has incentives to finance its spending via external debt to avoid distortionary income taxation. On the other hand, the accumulation of external debt raises the cost of borrowing. Quantitative findings suggest that the left-wing party implements a more progressive income tax, is more prone to default, and has a lower electoral support than the right-wing party due to worse borrowing conditions and the distortionary effects of income taxation. In equilibrium, electoral uncertainty raises sovereign default risk.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个具有异质性主体和非线性所得税的主权债务定量模型中，研究分配和选举关切如何塑造主权违约激励。小型开放经济以两党制为特征，其中左翼政党比右翼政党更偏好再分配。政治更替是选举过程的内生结果。财政政策面临权衡：一方面，政府有动机通过外部债务为其支出融资，以避免扭曲性所得税；另一方面，外部债务的积累提高了借贷成本。定量研究结果表明，左翼政党实施更具累进性的所得税，更倾向于违约，并且由于更差的借贷条件和所得税的扭曲效应，其选举支持率低于右翼政党。在均衡状态下，选举不确定性提高了主权违约风险。

records.title_en: From dominant to producer currency pricing: Dynamics of Chilean exports
records.title_cn: 从主导货币定价到生产者货币定价：智利出口的动态
records.abstract_en: We revisit a central question for international macroeconomics: the response of export prices and quantities to movements in the exchange rate (ER). We use granular export data for Chile and study how the effects of ER movements vary over time with the currency of invoicing and the destination of exports. For prices, we find that the short-run effects of bilateral ER movements vanish when controlling for U.S. dollar ER, which supports dominant currency pricing. However, over longer horizons a more significant role is played by bilateral ER movements, in line with the predictions of producer currency pricing. These dynamics do not depend on the invoicing currency. The results we find for quantities support the view that bilateral ER movements contribute to macroeconomic adjustment through export volumes over the medium term.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视国际宏观经济学的核心问题：出口价格和数量对汇率变动的反应。我们使用智利的微观出口数据，研究汇率变动的影响如何随计价货币和出口目的地随时间变化。对于价格，我们发现，在控制美元汇率后，双边汇率变动的短期效应消失，这支持主导货币定价。然而，在更长的时间跨度上，双边汇率变动发挥更显著的作用，这与生产者货币定价的预测一致。这些动态不依赖于计价货币。我们针对数量发现的结果支持了双边汇率变动通过出口量在中期内促进宏观经济调整的观点。

records.title_en: Who leads and who follows? The cross-border peer effect in investment by Chinese and US firms
records.title_cn: 谁引领，谁跟随？中美企业投资的跨境同伴效应
records.abstract_en: We document a cross-border peer effect in corporate investment across two key economies, China and the US. Results show that investment by individual Chinese firms lags US peers without feedback in the other direction. This association is stronger for Chinese firms in manufacturing, with innovative US peers, once China joined WTO, or targeted by anti-dumping investigations or measures as reported to the WTO. These findings are robust to diagnostic tests and alternative specifications. Furthermore, Chinese firms respond to domestic competition by learning from US peers. Our findings illustrate how peer competition induced by foreign trade and international institutions affects corporate decision-making in China’s rapidly-growing economy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了中国和美国这两个关键经济体中企业投资的跨境同伴效应。结果显示，中国个体企业的投资滞后于美国同行，且没有反向反馈。这种关联对于制造业中的中国企业、拥有创新美国同行、中国加入WTO后，或根据向WTO报告的反倾销调查或措施所针对的企业更为显著。这些发现在诊断测试和替代规格下依然稳健。此外，中国企业通过向美国同行学习来应对国内竞争。我们的发现说明了由对外贸易和国际机构引发的同伴竞争如何影响中国快速增长经济体中的企业决策。

records.title_en: Sovereign debt and economic growth when government is myopic and self-interested
records.title_cn: 当政府短视且自利时的主权债务与经济增长
records.abstract_en: We examine how a sovereign’s ability to borrow abroad affects the country’s growth and steady-state consumption when the government is both myopic and self-interested. Surprisingly, government myopia can increase a country’s access to external borrowing and extend the government’s effective horizon, giving it a stake in incentivizing private production and savings despite its self-interest. In a high-saving country, the lengthening of the government’s effective horizon can incentivize it to tax less, resulting in a “growth boost”, with higher steady-state household consumption than if it could not borrow abroad. However, in a country that saves little, the government may engage in repressive tax policies to channel domestic savings into government bonds. This increases future governments’ costs of default, and in turn enhances current debt capacity and spending, but can lead to a “growth trap” where steady-state household consumption is lower than without government’s access to external borrowing.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了当政府既短视又自利时，主权国家在国外借款的能力如何影响该国的增长和稳态消费。令人惊讶的是，政府短视可以增加一个国家获得外部借款的渠道，并延长政府的有效视野，使其尽管自利，却有动力激励私人生产和储蓄。在高储蓄国家，政府有效视野的延长可以激励其减少征税，从而产生“增长提振”，使稳态家庭消费高于其无法在国外借款的情况。然而，在储蓄较少的国家，政府可能采取压制性税收政策，将国内储蓄引导至政府债券。这增加了未来政府的违约成本，进而增强了当前的债务能力和支出，但可能导致“增长陷阱”，即稳态家庭消费低于政府无法获得外部借款的情况。

records.title_en: Consumption, exchange rate, and external adjustment during a crisis
records.title_cn: 危机期间的消费、汇率与外部调整
records.abstract_en: I develop a two-country open economy model featuring asymmetric financial frictions to explain two puzzling observations during the 2008 global financial crisis: (1) real consumption growth declined more in foreign countries than in the US, despite the crisis originating in the US, and (2) the US dollar appreciated against foreign currencies despite a significant deterioration in the US net foreign asset position. Subject to a less stringent financial constraint, the US tends to hold more risky assets relative to foreign countries in tranquil times, thereby exposing itself more to financial risks. As the crisis unfolds, the US incurs greater capital losses and is forced to liquidate its risky asset holdings to deleverage. This deleveraging process triggers a capital retrenchment in the US, thereby smoothing US consumption and prompting a US dollar appreciation. Consequently, this model challenges the “exorbitant duty” hypothesis and provides insights into the “reserve currency paradox”.
records.abstract_cn: 我构建了一个具有不对称金融摩擦的两国开放经济模型，以解释2008年全球金融危机期间的两个令人困惑的观察现象：（1）尽管危机起源于美国，但外国的实际消费增长下降幅度大于美国；（2）尽管美国净外国资产状况显著恶化，但美元兑外币升值。由于受到较宽松的金融约束，美国在平静时期往往比外国持有更多风险资产，从而使其更容易暴露于金融风险。随着危机的展开，美国遭受更大的资本损失，并被迫清算其风险资产持有以去杠杆化。这一去杠杆化过程引发了美国的资本回流，从而平滑了美国的消费并促使美元升值。因此，该模型挑战了“过高特权”假说，并为“储备货币悖论”提供了见解。

records.title_en: The widening of cross-currency basis: When increased FX swap demand meets limits of arbitrage
records.title_cn: 交叉货币基差的扩大：当外汇掉期需求增加遇上套利限制
records.abstract_en: This paper examines customer demand-side factors that affect deviation from covered interest rate parity (CIP) with respect to the dollar (i.e., cross-currency basis), particularly when arbitrageurs are constrained. Using novel detailed daily transaction-level data on the universe of Israeli institutional investors (IIs), we employ a granular instrumental variable (GIV) estimation to investigate how IIs’ FX swap demand affects CIP deviation. Our findings demonstrate that a one standard deviation shock to IIs’ FX swap demand when capital is abundant has no effect on IIs’ basis. However, when capital is scarce, the demand shock produces a significant reduction of 12 basis points in IIs’ basis. Our results showcase how limits of arbitrage, together with demand shocks from a large customer base, can drive CIP deviations.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了影响美元计价利率平价（CIP）偏离（即交叉货币基差）的客户需求侧因素，特别是在套利者受到约束的情况下。利用以色列机构投资者（IIs）全体的新型详细每日交易层面数据，我们采用颗粒工具变量（GIV）估计来研究IIs的外汇掉期需求如何影响CIP偏离。我们的研究结果表明，在资本充裕时，IIs外汇掉期需求的一个标准差冲击对IIs的基差没有影响。然而，在资本稀缺时，需求冲击会导致IIs的基差显著减少12个基点。我们的结果展示了套利限制，加上大型客户群的需求冲击，如何驱动CIP偏离。

records.title_en: UIP deviations: Insights from event studies
records.title_cn: UIP偏离：来自事件研究的洞见
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the behavior of the UIP relationship around monetary policy and global uncertainty shocks using event studies. We find that the covariance between exchange rate movements and changes in long-term yield differentials is conditional on the nature of shocks. A model of partial arbitrage between domestic and US bond markets predicts that tighter US monetary policy appreciates the dollar while increasing US yields relative to domestic bonds, a response that is consistent with UIP forces, while global uncertainty shocks appreciate the dollar while raising domestic yields relative to US bonds, exacerbating the widely documented UIP violation. The empirical analysis supports these mechanisms, specially for developed economies. For emerging economies, both relationships are weaker, consistent with more pervasive currency stabilization policies that mute the FX response at the expense of higher volatility in longer yields. Our results suggest a more nuanced interpretation of the unconditional failure of the UIP.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过事件研究评估了货币政策与全球不确定性冲击下UIP关系的行为。我们发现，汇率变动与长期收益率差变化之间的协方差取决于冲击的性质。一个关于国内与美国债券市场之间部分套利的模型预测，更紧缩的美国货币政策会使美元升值，同时提高美国相对于国内债券的收益率，这一反应与UIP力量一致，而全球不确定性冲击则使美元升值，同时提高国内相对于美国债券的收益率，加剧了广泛记录的UIP违背。实证分析支持这些机制，尤其是对发达经济体。对于新兴经济体，这两种关系都较弱，这与更普遍的货币稳定政策一致，这些政策以长期收益率波动性增加为代价来抑制外汇反应。我们的结果表明，对UIP无条件失败的解释应更为细致。

records.title_en: Reprint of “Sovereign debt and economic growth when government is myopic and self-interested”
records.title_cn: 重印：“当政府短视且自利时的主权债务与经济增长”

records.title_en: Supply chain risk: Changes in supplier composition and vertical integration
records.title_cn: 供应链风险：供应商构成变化与纵向一体化
records.abstract_en: Using textual analysis of earnings conference calls, we quantify firms' supply chain risk and explore how firms react when supply chain risk increases. We show that firms with supply chains that span across continents, multinationals, and firms with fewer suppliers of an input face higher supply chain risk. In addition, firms exhibit high supply chain risk when their suppliers also do so. Firms manage supply chain risk by establishing relationships with closer and domestic suppliers and with suppliers that are industry leaders and by vertically integrating, but they continue to work with suppliers in other continents.
records.abstract_cn: 通过对财报电话会议进行文本分析，我们量化了企业的供应链风险，并探讨了当供应链风险增加时企业如何应对。我们发现，供应链跨越各大洲的企业、跨国公司以及某种投入品供应商较少的企业面临更高的供应链风险。此外，当企业的供应商也面临高风险时，企业自身也表现出较高的供应链风险。企业通过与更近的、国内的供应商以及行业领先的供应商建立关系，并通过纵向一体化来管理供应链风险，但它们仍继续与其他大洲的供应商合作。

records.title_en: Firm input choice under trade policy uncertainty
records.title_cn: 贸易政策不确定性下的企业投入选择
records.abstract_en: We examine the role of trade policy uncertainty (TPU) in shaping the import decisions of firms. In a model where firms must incur sunk costs to adopt new imported varieties of an input, a reduction in TPU for a given input increases imports of that input (a substitution effect) and possibly other inputs (a scale effect). We explore this in the context of China’s accession to the WTO, which bound China’s tariffs. We find that, controlling for current tariffs, the threat of reversion to past high tariffs reduces imports, but much less so after WTO accession, consistent with lower TPU. The current-tariff trade elasticity also increases after WTO entry, reflecting a greater perceived permanence of current tariffs. We find evidence of both substitution and scale effects for imports, and post accession, firms were more likely to adopt products previously subject to higher tariff risk.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）在塑造企业进口决策中的作用。在一个模型中，企业必须承担沉没成本才能采用新的进口投入品种，某一给定投入的TPU降低会增加该投入的进口（替代效应），并可能增加其他投入的进口（规模效应）。我们在中国加入WTO的背景下探讨这一点，这约束了中国的关税。我们发现，在控制当前关税的情况下，恢复到过去高关税的威胁会减少进口，但在加入WTO后这种影响要小得多，这与较低的TPU一致。当前关税的贸易弹性在加入WTO后也有所增加，反映出当前关税被认为更具持久性。我们发现了进口的替代效应和规模效应的证据，并且在加入WTO后，企业更有可能采用以前面临较高关税风险的产品。

records.title_en: Capital controls and trade policy
records.title_cn: 资本管制与贸易政策
records.abstract_en: How does optimal capital-flow management change with prevailing trade policies? We study the joint optimal determination of capital controls and trade tariffs in a two-country, two-good model with trade in goods and assets. Because countries are large in both markets, a country-planner can achieve higher domestic welfare by departing from free trade in addition to levying capital controls, despite the cooperative optimal allocation being efficient. However, time variation in the optimal tariff induces households to over- or under-borrow through its effects on the path of the real exchange rate. As a result, optimal capital controls are generally smaller when trade policy is constrained (i.e., by a Free-Trade Agreement), but, absent retaliation, can be larger depending on the paths of underlying fundamentals.
records.abstract_cn: 最优资本流动管理如何随现行贸易政策而变化？我们在一个包含商品和资产贸易的两国、两商品模型中研究资本管制和贸易关税的联合最优决定。由于两国在两个市场上都是大国，尽管合作最优配置是有效的，但国家计划者可以通过偏离自由贸易并征收资本管制来实现更高的国内福利。然而，最优关税的时间变化通过其对实际汇率路径的影响，导致家庭过度或不足借贷。因此，当贸易政策受到约束（例如，通过自由贸易协定）时，最优资本管制通常较小，但在没有报复的情况下，根据基础基本面的路径，资本管制可能更大。

records.title_en: Escaping the trade war: Finance and relational supply chains in the adjustment to trade policy shocks
records.title_cn: 逃离贸易战：金融与关系型供应链在贸易政策冲击调整中的作用
records.abstract_en: The impact of the 2018–2019 trade war on total US exports depends on the direct effect of foreign retaliatory tariffs as well as on the ability of US exporters to reorganize global supply chains and redirect exports to other markets, away from retaliating countries. We document that the sharp decline in US exports to retaliating countries was compensated by a gradual increase in exports to other markets. We then develop a model of export reallocation to study the role of financial constraints and the persistence or stickiness of trade relationships as underlying mechanisms shaping both the direct impact of retaliatory tariffs and the extent of the reallocation toward alternative markets. In line with the predictions of the model, we find that in industries with high leverage, Chinese retaliatory tariffs led to a stronger decline in US exports to China but a larger increase in exports to the rest of the world. We find a similar pattern among industries with less persistent trade relationships. Finally, we document that other potential mechanisms do not appear to be economically and/or statistically significant in shaping the response to tariffs.
records.abstract_cn: 2018-2019年贸易战对美国总出口的影响取决于外国报复性关税的直接效应，以及美国出口商重组全球供应链并将出口转向其他市场（远离报复国家）的能力。我们记录了美国对报复国家的出口急剧下降，但被对其他市场的出口逐渐增加所补偿。然后，我们开发了一个出口再配置模型，以研究金融约束和贸易关系的持续性或粘性作为潜在机制，如何塑造报复性关税的直接冲击以及向替代市场再配置的程度。与模型预测一致，我们发现，在高杠杆行业中，中国的报复性关税导致美国对华出口下降更剧烈，但对世界其他地区的出口增加更多。在贸易关系持续性较弱的行业中也观察到类似模式。最后，我们记录了其他潜在机制在塑造对关税的反应方面似乎在经济和/或统计上不显著。

records.title_en: International migration and illegal costs: Evidence from Africa-to-Europe smuggling routes
records.title_cn: 国际移民与非法成本：来自非洲至欧洲偷渡路线的证据
records.abstract_en: The 2011 Arab Spring marked the opening of the Central Mediterranean Route for irregular border crossings between Libya and Italy, which produced heterogeneous reductions of bilateral smuggling distances between country pairs in the Mediterranean region. We exploit this source of spatial and temporal variation in bilateral distance along land and sea routes to estimate the elasticity of irregular migration intentions for African and Near East countries. We estimate an elasticity of migration intentions to smuggling distances exceeding −3, mainly driven by countries with weak rule of law and high internet penetration. Our findings are consistent across irregular migration measures both at the aggregate and individual levels. We show that irregular migration elasticity is higher for youth, relatively skilled individuals and those with an informative advantage (having a social network abroad or a mobile phone).
records.abstract_cn: 2011年阿拉伯之春标志着中地中海路线对利比亚与意大利之间非正规边境过境的开放，这导致了地中海地区国家间双边偷渡距离的异质性减少。我们利用这一沿陆路和海路双边距离的空间和时间变异来源，来估计非洲和近东国家非正规移民意愿的弹性。我们估计的移民意愿对偷渡距离的弹性超过-3，主要由法治薄弱和互联网普及率高的国家驱动。我们的发现在总体和个人层面的非正规移民测量中保持一致。我们表明，非正规移民弹性在青年、相对技能较高的个体以及具有信息优势（在国外有社交网络或拥有手机）的个体中更高。

records.title_en: Reprint of “Unveiling the dance of commodity prices and the global financial cycle”
records.title_cn: 重印：“揭示大宗商品价格与全球金融周期的舞蹈”
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of commodity price changes on the business cycles and capital flows in emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs), distinguishing between their role as a source of shock and as a channel of transmission of global shocks. Our findings reveal that surges in export prices, triggered by commodity price shocks, boost domestic GDP, an effect further amplified by the endogenous decline of country spreads. However, the effects on capital flows appear muted. Shifts in U.S. monetary policy and global risk appetite drive the global financial cycle in EMDEs. Eased global credit conditions, attributed to looser U.S. monetary policy or lower global risk appetite, lead to a rise in export prices, higher output, a decrease in government borrowing costs, and stimulate greater capital flows. The endogenous response of export prices amplifies the output effects of a more accommodative U.S. monetary policy while country spreads magnify the impact of shifts in global risk appetite.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了大宗商品价格变化对新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）商业周期和资本流动的影响，区分其作为冲击来源和全球冲击传导渠道的作用。我们的研究结果表明，由大宗商品价格冲击引发的出口价格飙升，会提振国内GDP，而国家利差的内生性下降进一步放大了这一效应。然而，对资本流动的影响似乎较为温和。美国货币政策的变化和全球风险偏好的转变驱动着EMDEs的全球金融周期。宽松的全球信贷条件，归因于美国货币政策放松或全球风险偏好降低，导致出口价格上升、产出提高、政府借贷成本下降，并刺激更大的资本流动。出口价格的内生反应放大了更为宽松的美国货币政策对产出的影响，而国家利差则放大了全球风险偏好转变的影响。

records.title_en: Accounting for trade patterns
records.title_cn: 解释贸易模式
records.abstract_en: We develop a quantitative framework for decomposing trade patterns. We derive price indexes that determine comparative advantage and the aggregate cost of living. If firms and products are imperfect substitutes, we show that these price indexes depend on variety, average appeal (including quality), and the dispersion of appeal-adjusted prices. We show that they are only weakly related to standard empirical measures of average prices.
