We find that 40 percent of the cross-section variation in comparative advantage, and 90 percent of the time-series variation, is accounted for by variety and average appeal, with less than 10 percent attributed to average prices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个用于分解贸易模式的定量框架。我们推导出决定比较优势和总体生活成本的价格指数。如果企业和产品是不完全替代的，我们表明这些价格指数取决于品种、平均吸引力（包括质量）以及吸引力调整后价格的离散度。我们表明它们与标准的平均价格实证度量只有微弱的相关性。我们发现，比较优势截面变异的40%和时间序列变异的90%由品种和平均吸引力解释，而平均价格所解释的部分不到10%。

records.title_en: Dynamic trade, education and intergenerational inequality
records.title_cn: 动态贸易、教育与代际不平等
records.abstract_en: I present a dynamic trade model spanning many countries to explore the transitional paths of trade-induced inequality. By incorporating capital-skill complementarity, human capital accumulation, and capital accumulation, this paper examines the exact transitional path following a shift from autarky to trade. It reveals that trade increases the skill premium, skill share, and real wages for both skilled and unskilled workers in the majority of countries at the steady state. However, the short-term impact of trade on inequality is more pronounced. The exact transitional path indicates that the dynamic of trade-induced inequality is influenced by the flexibility in adjusting factor supplies during the transition at different stages, and education alleviates approximately 50% of trade-induced inequality in the long run. Furthermore, the analysis illuminates the observed patterns of skill premium in recent trade liberalization episodes in Mexico, China, and South Korea, and raises the possibility that globalization may intensify intergenerational inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 我提出了一个涵盖多国的动态贸易模型，以探索贸易引发的不平等的转型路径。通过纳入资本-技能互补性、人力资本积累和资本积累，本文考察了从自给自足转向贸易后的精确转型路径。研究表明，在稳态下，贸易提高了大多数国家中技能溢价、技能份额以及技能和非技能工人的实际工资。然而，贸易对不平等的短期影响更为显著。精确转型路径表明，贸易引发的不平等的动态受到转型不同阶段要素供给调整灵活性的影响，而教育在长期中缓解了约50%的贸易引发的不平等。此外，分析阐明了近期墨西哥、中国和韩国贸易自由化事件中观察到的技能溢价模式，并提出了全球化可能加剧代际不平等的可能性。

records.title_en: From carry trades to trade credit: Financial intermediation by non-financial corporations
records.title_cn: 从套息交易到贸易信贷：非金融企业的金融中介
records.abstract_en: We use detailed firm-level data from Mexico to document that non-financial corporations engage in carry trades by borrowing in foreign currency (FX) and lending in domestic currency, largely in the form of trade credit, accumulating currency risk in the process. Firms are more active in carry-trades when FX borrowing is relatively cheaper and build currency risk by accumulating peso assets. We use the 2009 Mexican peso depreciation to show that firms that were more active in carry trades experienced larger reductions in investment. Nevertheless, their extension of trade credit remained stable, insulating their trading partners from their balance sheet exposure to the shock.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用墨西哥的详细企业层面数据，记录了非金融企业通过借入外币（FX）并以本币放贷（主要以贸易信贷形式）进行套息交易，在此过程中积累货币风险。当外币借款相对便宜时，企业更积极地参与套息交易，并通过积累比索资产来构建货币风险。我们利用2009年墨西哥比索贬值来表明，套息交易更活跃的企业经历了更大的投资减少。然而，它们提供的贸易信贷保持稳定，使其贸易伙伴免受其资产负债表对冲击的敞口影响。

records.title_en: Exchange rate pass-through in small, open, commodity-exporting economies: Lessons from Canada
records.title_cn: 小型开放商品出口经济体中的汇率传导：来自加拿大的经验教训
records.abstract_en: This paper analyses the exchange rate pass-through in small, open, commodity-exporting economies, taking Canada as a case study. I estimate it as being conditional on commodity shocks and compare the results with those of a standard approach, showing that the pass-through sign changes drastically across frameworks for consumer prices. My approach leads to a positive pass-through, thus implying a positive co-movement between exchange rate appreciation and consumer price inflation, conditional on the shocks. Conversely, standard models find a negative pass-through. I explain my findings by using the commodity-exporter characteristic of Canada and the nature of the shocks, which raise the demand for commodities. This, in turn, causes a currency appreciation and has inflationary effects domestically through higher commodity prices.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了小型开放商品出口经济体中的汇率传导，以加拿大为案例研究。我将其估计为以商品冲击为条件，并将结果与标准方法的结果进行比较，表明在消费者价格方面，传导符号在不同框架下发生剧烈变化。我的方法得出正传导，从而意味着在冲击条件下，汇率升值与消费者价格通胀之间存在正相关关系。相反，标准模型发现负传导。我通过加拿大的商品出口国特征以及冲击的性质来解释我的发现，这些冲击提高了对商品的需求。这反过来导致货币升值，并通过更高的商品价格在国内产生通胀效应。

records.title_en: The Laffer curve for rules of origin
records.title_cn: 原产地规则的拉弗曲线
records.abstract_en: Firms in regional trade areas choose whether to comply with rules of origin (RoO) or pay a tariff penalty. Stricter content requirements initially expand regional part sourcing, but contract it when set at levels above a threshold, analogously to the Laffer curve for taxes. We calibrate the model to fit part cost shares for autos sold in North America. The effects of the 75% RoO imposed in 2020 depend on the relevant tariff and the ability to relocate assembly. With fixed assembly locations, the higher RoO reduces employment in all three countries for cars, where tariffs are low. For trucks, the 25% US tariff induces more compliance in Canada and Mexico, increasing employment in those countries. With the option to relocate assembly, higher RoOs redistribute employment to the US, but Canada and Mexico lose more, leading to a half percent decline in North American employment for both cars and trucks.
records.abstract_cn: 区域贸易区内的企业选择遵守原产地规则（RoO）或支付关税罚款。更严格的内容要求最初会扩大区域零部件采购，但当设定在高于阈值水平时则会收缩，类似于税收的拉弗曲线。我们校准模型以拟合北美销售的汽车零部件成本份额。2020年实施的75%原产地规则的效果取决于相关关税和重新安置组装的能力。在组装地点固定的情况下，较高的原产地规则降低了所有三个国家中关税较低的汽车的就业。对于卡车，25%的美国关税促使加拿大和墨西哥更多合规，增加了这些国家的就业。在可以选择重新安置组装的情况下，较高的原产地规则将就业重新分配到美国，但加拿大和墨西哥损失更多，导致北美汽车和卡车的就业下降半个百分点。

records.title_en: Bond convenience curves and funding costs
records.title_cn: 债券便利收益率曲线与融资成本
records.abstract_en: A convenience yield represents a difference between yield on a safe bond and yield on a synthetic safe bond, constructed by combining a risky bond with a CDS contract. We explain the shapes of eurozone sovereign convenience curves using a model in which arbitrageurs face higher funding costs on bonds with credit risk and bond demand shocks induce funding risk. We provide novel causal evidence for our mechanism using variation in funding costs generated through exogenous haircut category changes. Changes in convenience yields represent a key transmission channel of unconventional monetary policy to bond yields.
records.abstract_cn: 便利收益率代表安全债券收益率与通过将风险债券与信用违约互换合约组合构建的合成安全债券收益率之间的差异。我们用一个模型解释欧元区主权便利收益率曲线的形状，在该模型中，套利者面临信用风险债券的更高融资成本，而债券需求冲击引发融资风险。我们利用通过外生折扣率类别变化产生的融资成本变动，为我们的机制提供了新颖的因果证据。便利收益率的变化代表了非常规货币政策向债券收益率传导的关键渠道。

records.title_en: A tale of tier 3 cities
records.title_cn: 一线 3 城市的故事
records.abstract_en: China's outsized real estate sector has long been a key engine of growth. However, with decades of construction at break-neck speeds having produced a massive increase in the quantity and quality of China's housing stock, the question arises as to whether diminishing returns are beginning to set in. At the same time, there is the question of whether real estate has been a major driver of today's high levels of local government debt, which may create heightened financial vulnerabilities. We investigate these questions using a new database that includes city level estimates of China's housing stock. Our formal statistical results suggest that real estate is indeed running into diminishing returns to growth while at the same time being a significant driver of local government debt, with both effects being driven mainly by China's smaller and less prosperous tier 3 cities (which nevertheless account for 60% of GDP).
records.abstract_cn: 中国庞大的房地产业长期以来一直是经济增长的关键引擎。然而，几十年来的极速建设使中国住房存量的数量和质量大幅提高，随之而来的问题是，收益递减是否开始出现。与此同时，还有一个问题是，房地产是否一直是当今地方政府债务水平高企的主要推动因素，而地方政府债务水平可能会加剧金融脆弱性。我们使用一个新的数据库来调查这些问题，其中包括对中国城市住房存量的估计。我们的正式统计结果表明，房地产确实正在面临增长回报递减的局面，同时也是地方政府债务的重要驱动因素，这两种影响主要是由中国规模较小且不太繁荣的一线城市3（尽管如此，它们占GDP的60%）推动的。

records.title_en: Sudden stop with local currency debt
records.title_cn: 本币债务下的突然停止
records.abstract_en: Over the past two decades, emerging market economies have improved their liability structures by increasing the share of their debt denominated in local currency. This paper introduces a local currency debt (i.e., in units of aggregate consumption) into a sudden stop model and explores how this alternative structure sheds new perspectives on financial regulations. Decentralized agents do not internalize the effects of their portfolio decisions on financial amplification and undervalue the insurance benefit of using local currency debt. However, due to debt-deflation incentives and the cost of buying insurance, a discretionary planner is reluctant to issue local currency debts, and capital controls are primarily used to restrict credit volumes. In contrast, a social planner with commitment would promise a higher future payoff to obtain a more favorable bond price. The capital control under commitment encourages borrowing in local currency, mitigates the severity of crises, and improves welfare relative to laissez-faire.
records.abstract_cn: 在过去二十年中，新兴市场经济体通过提高本币计价债务的份额改善了其负债结构。本文在本币债务（即以总消费为单位）的突然停止模型中引入这一概念，并探讨这种替代结构如何为金融监管提供新的视角。分散化的代理人未将其投资组合决策对金融放大效应的影响内部化，低估了使用本币债务的保险收益。然而，由于债务通缩激励和购买保险的成本，一个自由裁量的规划者不愿发行本币债务，资本管制主要用于限制信贷规模。相比之下，一个有承诺的社会规划者会承诺更高的未来回报以获得更有利的债券价格。承诺下的资本管制鼓励以本币借款，减轻危机的严重性，并相对于自由放任提高福利。

records.title_en: The unequal effects of trade and automation across local labor markets
records.title_cn: 贸易与自动化对地方劳动力市场的不平等影响
records.abstract_en: We quantify the joint impact of the China shock and automation of labor, across US commuting zones (CZs) in the period 2000–2007. To this end, we employ a multi-sector gravity model of trade with Roy-Fréchet worker heterogeneity across sectors, where labor input can be automated. Automation and increased import competition from China are both sector-specific; they lead to contractions in a sector’s labor demand and a decline in relative income for CZs more specialized in that sector, amplified by a voluntary reduction in hours worked and an increase in frictional unemployment. The estimated model fits well with the aggregate performance of manufacturing subsectors and with the variation across CZs in changes in average income, the hourly wage, hours worked, the employment rate and employment in manufacturing. By itself, the China shock has stronger distributional effects than automation, but its impact on aggregate gains is less than a third of automation’s impact.
records.abstract_cn: 我们量化了在2000-2007年期间，中国冲击和劳动力自动化对美国通勤区的联合影响。为此，我们采用了一个多部门重力贸易模型，其中包含罗伊-弗雷谢特工人跨部门异质性，且劳动力投入可以被自动化。自动化和来自中国的进口竞争加剧都是部门特定的；它们导致部门劳动力需求收缩，并使专门从事该部门的通勤区的相对收入下降，这种效应因自愿减少工作时间和摩擦性失业增加而被放大。估计模型与制造业子行业的总体表现以及通勤区在平均收入、小时工资、工作时间、就业率和制造业就业变化上的差异拟合良好。单独来看，中国冲击的分配效应强于自动化，但其对总体收益的影响不到自动化影响的三分之一。

records.title_en: US trade policy and the US dollar
records.title_cn: 美国贸易政策与美元
records.abstract_en: We show that the US dollar response to trade policy uncertainty (TPU) is key to assessing the impact of US trade policy. Employing structural vector autoregressive models, we find that TPU shocks supported a multilateral USD appreciation during the 2018–19 trade tensions between the US and some of its major trading partners. We rationalize this in a two-country New Keynesian model with financial frictions that links the increase in TPU to rising demand for safe USD assets. Our findings suggest that the TPU-induced appreciation of the USD in 2018–19 significantly counteracted US trade policy attempts to raise US competitiveness.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，美元对贸易政策不确定性（TPU）的反应是评估美国贸易政策影响的关键。采用结构向量自回归模型，我们发现，在2018-19年美国与其一些主要贸易伙伴之间的贸易紧张局势期间，TPU冲击支持了多边美元升值。我们在一个具有金融摩擦的两国新凯恩斯模型中对此进行合理化解释，该模型将TPU的增加与对安全美元资产需求的上升联系起来。我们的研究结果表明，2018-19年TPU引发的美元升值显著抵消了美国贸易政策提升美国竞争力的尝试。

records.title_en: The political economy of currency unions
records.title_cn: 货币联盟的政治经济学
records.abstract_en: How can monetary and fiscal policy sustain a currency union when member states have an exit option? This paper derives an interest rate rule that features state-dependent country weights with which the central bank can prevent a break-up. A simulation reveals that this policy rule lacks firepower and can only extend the lifetime of the union for a while. While monetary policy is more potent in unions with more member states or setups with local currency pricing, it is still true that even a simple fiscal union with lump-sum transfers is better suited to prevent a break-up. Environments with lower risk sharing, the ZLB or wage rigidity make monetary policy even less effective.
records.abstract_cn: 当成员国拥有退出选项时，货币和财政政策如何维持货币联盟？本文推导出一个利率规则，该规则具有随国家状态变化的权重，中央银行可以借此防止联盟解体。模拟显示，这一政策规则缺乏效力，只能延长联盟的存续时间。虽然货币政策在成员国更多或采用本币定价的联盟中更为有效，但即使是一个简单的、采用一次性转移支付的财政联盟也更能防止解体。风险分担较低、零利率下限或工资刚性的环境会使货币政策的效果更差。

records.title_en: The internal geography of firms
records.title_cn: 企业的内部地理
records.abstract_en: We document that plants belonging to small and mid-sized firms are geographically concentrated, while large firms are much more dispersed. These differences are sizable; firms with 2 plants have a dispersion that is 5 log points lower than predicted by industry location patterns, while the corresponding figure is less than 2 log points for firms with 40 plants and less than a half log point for firms with 100 or more plants. These patterns are qualitatively robust across industries, time periods, and alternative specifications. We also find that plants that are farther from the firm headquarters employ less workers than closer plants within the same firm, and that this relationship is attenuated in large firms. We interpret these findings through the lens of a model of plant location in which more productive firms endogenously choose to lower their cost of geographic expansion.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了中小型企业所属工厂在地理上集中，而大型企业则分散得多。这些差异相当大；拥有2家工厂的企业，其分散度比行业区位模式预测的低5个对数点，而拥有40家工厂的企业相应数字小于2个对数点，拥有100家或更多工厂的企业则小于半个对数点。这些模式在行业、时间段和替代规格上定性稳健。我们还发现，与同一企业内较近的工厂相比，距离企业总部较远的工厂雇佣的工人较少，并且这种关系在大型企业中有所减弱。我们通过一个工厂区位模型来解释这些发现，在该模型中，生产率更高的企业内生地选择降低其地理扩张成本。

records.title_en: Unveiling the dance of commodity prices and the global financial cycle
records.title_cn: 揭示大宗商品价格与全球金融周期的互动
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of commodity price changes on the business cycles and capital flows in emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs), distinguishing between their role as a source of shock and as a channel of transmission of global shocks. Our findings reveal that surges in export prices, triggered by commodity price shocks, boost domestic GDP, an effect further amplified by the endogenous decline of country spreads. However, the effects on capital flows appear muted. Shifts in U.S. monetary policy and global risk appetite drive the global financial cycle in EMDEs. Eased global credit conditions, attributed to looser U.S. monetary policy or lower global risk appetite, lead to a rise in export prices, higher output, a decrease in government borrowing costs, and stimulate greater capital flows. The endogenous response of export prices amplifies the output effects of a more accommodative U.S. monetary policy while country spreads magnify the impact of shifts in global risk appetite.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了大宗商品价格变动对新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）商业周期和资本流动的影响，区分其作为冲击来源和全球冲击传导渠道的作用。我们的研究结果表明，由大宗商品价格冲击引发的出口价格飙升会提振国内GDP，而这一效应又因国家利差的内生性下降而进一步放大。然而，对资本流动的影响似乎较为温和。美国货币政策的变化和全球风险偏好的转变驱动着EMDEs的全球金融周期。宽松的全球信贷条件，归因于美国货币政策的放松或全球风险偏好的降低，会导致出口价格上升、产出增加、政府借贷成本下降，并刺激更大的资本流动。出口价格的内生反应放大了更为宽松的美国货币政策对产出的影响，而国家利差则放大了全球风险偏好转变的影响。

records.title_en: Underinvestment and capital misallocation under sovereign risk
records.title_cn: 主权风险下的投资不足与资本错配
records.abstract_en: Capital and its sectoral allocation affect default incentives. Under general assumptions, default risk is decreasing in the total stock of capital and increasing in the share of capital allocated to non-tradable production. This implies that when competitive households make all investment decisions capital has two externalities: a capital-stock externality and a portfolio externality. These hamper the ability of a benevolent government to make optimal borrowing and default decisions and are exacerbated during periods of distress. Competitive equilibria feature underinvestment, larger non-traded sectors, more default, and lower debt and consumption than a centralized planner’s allocation.
records.abstract_cn: 资本及其部门配置影响违约激励。在一般假设下，违约风险随资本总存量递减，随配置于非贸易品生产的资本份额递增。这意味着，当竞争性家庭做出所有投资决策时，资本具有两种外部性：资本存量外部性和投资组合外部性。这些外部性阻碍了仁慈政府做出最优借贷和违约决策的能力，并在困境时期加剧。竞争性均衡的特征是投资不足、非贸易部门规模更大、违约更多，以及债务和消费低于中央计划者的配置。

records.title_en: Dollar and government bond liquidity: Evidence from Korea
records.title_cn: 美元与国债流动性：来自韩国的证据
records.abstract_en: Using unique tick-by-tick data from an exchange, this paper examines the relationship between the US dollar and liquidity in the Korean government (Treasury) bond market. We find that a strong US dollar deteriorates the Treasury market's liquidity by increasing the bid-ask spread and the price impact and lowering market depth. The effects of fluctuations in the broad US dollar index on Treasury market liquidity become more pronounced when funding liquidity conditions are tighter, when banks' total capital ratio is lower with greater foreign currency risk, or when there is a larger sell-off of Korea Treasury bonds by foreign investors. The empirical evidence supports the financial channel of exchange rates affecting Treasury market liquidity. In particular, a strong dollar as a barometer of global financial conditions is likely to limit the market intermediation capacity of emerging market dealers and thus tighten emerging market conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 利用交易所提供的独特逐笔数据，本文考察了美元与韩国国债（国库券）市场流动性之间的关系。我们发现，美元走强会通过增加买卖价差和价格冲击、降低市场深度来恶化国债市场的流动性。当融资流动性条件更紧张、银行总资本比率较低且外汇风险较大，或外国投资者大规模抛售韩国国债时，广义美元指数波动对国债市场流动性的影响更为显著。实证证据支持汇率影响国债市场流动性的金融渠道。特别是，作为全球金融状况晴雨表的强势美元可能限制新兴市场做市商的市场中介能力，从而收紧新兴市场条件。

records.title_en: Did Trump’s trade war impact the 2018 election?
records.title_cn: 特朗普的贸易战是否影响了2018年选举？
records.abstract_en: We uncover evidence that the US–China trade war was consequential for voting outcomes in the 2018 congressional midterm election. Republican House candidates lost support in counties more exposed to tariff retaliation, but saw no appreciable gains in counties that received more direct US tariff protection. The electoral losses were only modestly mitigated by the US agricultural subsidies announced in summer 2018. Republicans also fared worse in counties that had seen recent gains in health insurance coverage (where efforts to repeal the Affordable Care Act may have been more consequential), and where a new federal cap on state and local tax (SALT) deductions disadvantaged more taxpayers. Counterfactual calculations suggest that Republicans would have lost ten fewer House seats absent the trade war, in a similar range to either health care or SALT policies in the number of lost seats it can account for.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发现了证据表明，中美贸易战对2018年国会中期选举的投票结果产生了影响。在更容易受到关税报复的县，共和党众议院候选人失去了支持，但在获得更多美国直接关税保护的县，他们并未看到明显的收益。选举损失仅被2018年夏季宣布的美国农业补贴适度缓解。共和党在近期健康保险覆盖率有所增加的县（废除《平价医疗法案》的努力可能在这些县更具影响力）以及新的联邦州和地方税收（SALT）扣除上限使更多纳税人处于不利地位的县表现也更差。反事实计算表明，如果没有贸易战，共和党将少失去十个众议院席位，这一数字与医疗保健或SALT政策所能解释的席位损失数量范围相似。

records.title_en: Preemptive austerity with rollover risk
records.title_cn: 预防性紧缩与展期风险
records.abstract_en: By preemptive austerity, we mean a policy that increases taxes to deter potential rollover crises. The policy is so successful that the usual danger signal of a rollover crisis, a high yield on new bonds sold, does not show up, because the policy eliminates the danger. Mechanically, high taxes make the safe zone in the model – the set of sovereign debt levels for which the government prefers to repay its debt rather than default – larger. By announcing a high tax rate at the beginning of the period, the government ensures that tax revenue will be high enough to service sovereign debt becoming due, which deters panics by international lenders but is ex-post suboptimal. That is why, as it engages in preemptive austerity, the government continues to reduce the level of debt to a point where, at least asymptotically, high taxes are no longer necessary.
records.abstract_cn: 所谓预防性紧缩，是指一种通过增税来阻止潜在展期危机的政策。该政策非常成功，以至于展期危机的通常危险信号——新发行债券的高收益率——并未出现，因为该政策消除了危险。从机制上讲，高税收使模型中的安全区域——即政府更倾向于偿还债务而非违约的主权债务水平集合——扩大。通过在期初宣布高税率，政府确保税收收入足以偿还到期的主权债务，这阻止了国际贷款人的恐慌，但事后却是次优的。这就是为什么在实施预防性紧缩时，政府会继续将债务水平降低到至少渐近意义上不再需要高税收的程度。

records.title_en: Fly the unfriendly skies: The role of transport costs in gravity models of trade
records.title_cn: 飞越不友好的天空：运输成本在贸易引力模型中的作用
records.abstract_en: We exploit exogenous shocks to flight distances over time to estimate the distance effect in airborne trade within panel regressions. We find a negative distance effect, which we interpret as evidence of a link between transportation costs and airborne trade. Notably, this relationship is driven almost entirely by changes at the extensive margin. Specifically, trade in HS 6 product categories with intermittent trading histories becomes dormant when flight distances increase. Conversely, the intensive margin of trade remains largely unaffected.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用飞行距离随时间变化的外生冲击，在面板回归中估计航空贸易中的距离效应。我们发现负的距离效应，并将其解释为运输成本与航空贸易之间存在联系的证据。值得注意的是，这种关系几乎完全由扩展边际的变化驱动。具体而言，具有间歇性贸易历史的HS 6位产品类别的贸易在飞行距离增加时变得停滞。相反，贸易的集约边际基本不受影响。

records.title_en: Offshoring and job polarisation between firms
records.title_cn: 离岸外包与企业间的就业极化
records.abstract_en: Using linked employer–employee data for Germany, we provide evidence for job polarisation between firms and identify offshoring as an important determinant of these employment changes. To accommodate these findings, we set up a model in which offshoring to a low-wage country can lead to job polarisation in the high-wage country due to a reallocation of labour across firms that differ in productivity and pay wages that are positively linked to their profits. Offshoring is chosen only by the most productive firms, and only for those tasks with the lowest variable offshoring costs. A reduction in those variable costs increases offshoring at the intensive and at the extensive margin. Well in line with our evidence, this causes domestic employment shifts from the newly offshoring firms in the middle of the productivity distribution to firms at the tails of this distribution, paying either very low or very high wages.
records.abstract_cn: 利用德国的关联雇主-雇员数据，我们提供了企业间就业极化的证据，并确定离岸外包是这些就业变化的重要决定因素。为适应这些发现，我们建立了一个模型，在该模型中，向低工资国家的离岸外包可导致高工资国家的就业极化，这是由于劳动力在生产率不同且工资与其利润正相关的企业之间重新配置所致。只有生产率最高的企业才会选择离岸外包，且仅针对那些可变离岸外包成本最低的任务。这些可变成本的降低会在集约边际和广延边际上增加离岸外包。与我们的证据高度一致，这导致国内就业从生产率分布中部的、新进行离岸外包的企业，转向该分布尾部的、支付极低或极高工资的企业。

records.title_en: On regional borrowing, default, and migration
records.title_cn: 关于地方借贷、违约与迁移
records.abstract_en: How do local government borrowing, default, and migration interact? We find in-migration results in excessive debt accumulation due to a key externality: Immigrants help repay previously-issued debt. In addition to providing direct IV evidence on this mechanism, we show cities are heavily indebted, near state-imposed borrowing limits, vulnerable to interest rate increases, and default even after periods of robust population and productivity growth. Our quantitative model reproduces these features of the data and reveals a bifurcation: in-migration strongly affects borrowing, but borrowing only weakly affects migration. The model predicts large interest rate declines in the Great Recession prevented a wave of municipal defaults.
records.abstract_cn: 地方政府借贷、违约与迁移如何相互作用？我们发现，由于一个关键的外部性，迁入人口导致过度债务积累：移民帮助偿还先前发行的债务。除了为此机制提供直接的IV证据外，我们还表明，城市负债累累，接近国家规定的借贷限额，易受利率上升影响，甚至在人口和生产率强劲增长期之后也会违约。我们的定量模型再现了数据的这些特征，并揭示了一个分叉：迁入人口强烈影响借贷，但借贷仅微弱影响迁移。模型预测，大衰退期间利率的大幅下降阻止了一波市政违约潮。

records.title_en: Does democracy shape international merger activity?
records.title_cn: 民主是否影响国际并购活动？
records.abstract_en: Democracy matters for international merger activity. Using a sample of 101,834 cross-border deals announced between 1985 and 2018, we show that merger flows predominantly involve acquirers from more democratic countries than their targets. This result is primarily driven by a “pull” factor: firms in countries with weaker democratic institutions attract more cross-border deals. We find evidence of bonding as the key mechanism behind this effect. The democracy effect is stronger when target countries have weaker corporate governance standards. Furthermore, target abnormal returns around deal announcements increase with the difference in democracy between acquirer and target countries. Importantly, differences in investor protection or economic development do not directly explain the democracy effect. Combined, our findings imply that democracy is a fundamental, yet previously overlooked, determinant of cross-border mergers.
records.abstract_cn: 民主对国际并购活动具有重要意义。利用1985年至2018年间宣布的101,834笔跨境交易样本，我们发现并购流动主要涉及来自比目标国更民主国家的收购方。这一结果主要由“拉力”因素驱动：民主制度较弱国家的企业吸引了更多跨境交易。我们找到证据表明，绑定效应是这一影响背后的关键机制。当目标国公司治理标准较弱时，民主效应更强。此外，交易公告前后目标公司的异常回报随着收购方与目标国之间民主差异的增加而增加。重要的是，投资者保护或经济发展的差异并不能直接解释民主效应。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，民主是跨境并购的一个基本但此前被忽视的决定因素。

records.title_en: Sudden Stops and optimal policy in a two-agent economy
records.title_cn: 两主体经济中的突然停止与最优政策
records.abstract_en: We introduce heterogeneity between workers and entrepreneurs in a standard Fisherian model to study Sudden Stop dynamics and optimal policy. The distinction between workers and entrepreneurs introduces a redistributive motive that meaningfully interacts with Fisherian deflation. While in tranquil times redistribution is driven by the relative marginal utilities of consumption, the planner additionally favors entrepreneurs during Sudden Stops to mitigate Fisherian deflation. We show how heterogeneity adds to the understanding of how ex ante and ex post policies can be best designed to alleviate the negative effects of Sudden Stops.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在标准的费雪模型中引入工人与企业家之间的异质性，以研究突然停止动态和最优政策。工人与企业家之间的区别引入了一种再分配动机，该动机与费雪式通货紧缩有意义地相互作用。虽然在平静时期，再分配由消费的相对边际效用驱动，但计划者在突然停止期间还会额外偏向企业家，以缓解费雪式通货紧缩。我们展示了异质性如何增进对如何最优设计事前和事后政策以减轻突然停止负面效应的理解。

records.title_en: Banking regulation with risk of sovereign default
records.title_cn: 主权违约风险下的银行业监管
records.abstract_en: Banking regulation routinely designates domestic government debt as safe, even when this debt is risky. We show, in a parsimonious model, that this failure to recognize the riskiness of government debt induces domestic banks to “gamble” with depositors’ funds by purchasing risky government bonds and assets correlated with them. Sovereign defaults then result in banking crises; however, by permitting banks to gamble, the regulator lowers the government’s borrowing costs ex-ante. Thus, the government has an incentive to ignore the riskiness of the sovereign bonds. We derive a set of testable implications and present supporting empirical evidence from sovereign debt crises in Russia, Argentina, and the Eurozone.
records.abstract_cn: 银行业监管通常将国内政府债务指定为安全资产，即使该债务存在风险。我们在一个简约模型中表明，这种未能识别政府债务风险的做法会诱导国内银行利用存款人资金进行“赌博”，购买有风险的政府债券及与其相关的资产。主权违约随后导致银行业危机；然而，通过允许银行赌博，监管者事前降低了政府的借贷成本。因此，政府有动机忽视主权债券的风险。我们推导出一系列可检验的推论，并提供了来自俄罗斯、阿根廷和欧元区主权债务危机的支持性经验证据。

records.title_en: Cross-country price dispersion: Retail network or national border?
records.title_cn: 跨国价格离散：零售网络还是国家边界？
records.abstract_en: Why do prices differ among regions without significant trade frictions, such as the euro area? This study examines the impact of a national border on grocery prices in the economically and culturally integrated German–Austrian border region. Based on retail transactions from a large household panel, we analyse price differences of identical products sold within a narrow band along the border. We show that even retailers operating in both countries charge different prices for identical products on each side of the border. Over all products, prices are on average more than 14% higher on the Austrian side. The underlying absolute price differences average to around 20%, but vary over products and time, suggesting limits to arbitrage in cross-border shopping. This study demonstrates that even in highly integrated areas, national borders continue to matter for retail pricing.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么在没有显著贸易摩擦的地区（如欧元区）价格会有所不同？本研究考察了国家边界对经济和文一体化程度较高的德奥边境地区食品杂货价格的影响。基于大型家庭面板的零售交易数据，我们分析了沿边境狭窄地带内销售的相同产品的价格差异。我们表明，即使在两国运营的零售商，在边界两侧对相同产品收取的价格也不同。在所有产品中，奥地利一侧的价格平均高出14%以上。潜在的绝对价格差异平均约为20%，但随产品和时间而变化，表明跨境购物中的套利存在限制。本研究表明，即使在高度一体化的地区，国家边界对零售定价仍然具有重要影响。

records.title_en: The international dimension of trend inflation
records.title_cn: 趋势通胀的国际维度
records.abstract_en: A trend-cycle BVAR decomposition investigates the role of different slow-moving trends – i.e., globalization, expectations, automation, labor demand and supply – in shaping the slow-moving dynamics of trend inflation. Despite well-anchored expectations, slow-moving imported “cost-push” factors induced disinflationary pressure keeping trend inflation below target. The cycle block provides evidence of inflation volatility increasingly driven by international factors. These results can explain why, from 2000 in the U.S. and before the recent surge, inflation remained both below target and silent to domestic slack.
records.abstract_cn: 一项趋势-周期BVAR分解研究了不同慢变动趋势——即全球化、预期、自动化、劳动力需求与供给——在塑造趋势通胀慢变动动态中的作用。尽管预期锚定良好，慢变动的进口“成本推动”因素引发了通缩压力，使趋势通胀保持在目标水平之下。周期板块提供了通胀波动日益由国际因素驱动的证据。这些结果可以解释为何自2000年以来在美国以及近期飙升之前，通胀既低于目标又对国内松弛无反应。

records.title_en: Sovereign risk and bank lending: Evidence from 1999 Turkish Earthquake
records.title_cn: 主权风险与银行信贷：来自1999年土耳其地震的证据
records.abstract_en: We use an exogenous fiscal shock to identify the transmission of government risk to bank lending due to banks holding government bonds. We illustrate with a theoretical model that for banks with higher exposure to government bonds, a higher sovereign default risk implies lower bank net worth and less lending. Our empirical estimates confirm the model’s predictions. The exogenous change in sovereign default risk of Turkish government debt as a result of the 1999 Earthquake impacted banks whose balance sheets were exposed more to government bonds. The resulting lower bank net worth translates into a lower credit supply. We rule out alternative explanations. Our estimates suggest this channel can explain half of the decline in bank lending following the earthquake. This underlines the importance of the bank balance-sheet channel in transmitting a higher sovereign default risk to reduced real economic activity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用外生财政冲击来识别因银行持有政府债券而导致政府风险向银行信贷的传导。我们通过理论模型说明，对于政府债券敞口较高的银行，较高的主权违约风险意味着较低的银行净值与较少的信贷。我们的实证估计证实了模型的预测。1999年土耳其地震导致的土耳其政府债务主权违约风险的外生变化，影响了那些资产负债表对政府债券敞口较大的银行。由此导致的银行净值下降转化为信贷供给的减少。我们排除了其他替代解释。我们的估计表明，这一渠道可以解释地震后银行信贷下降的一半。这凸显了银行资产负债表渠道在将较高的主权违约风险传导至实体经济活动的减少中的重要性。

records.title_en: The small open economy in a generalized gravity model
records.title_cn: 广义引力模型中的小型开放经济体
records.abstract_en: To provide sharp answers to basic questions in international trade, a standard approach is to focus on a small open economy (SOE). Whereas the classic tradition is to define a SOE as an economy that takes world prices as given, in the new trade literature it is defined instead as one that takes foreign-good prices and export demand schedules as given. We develop a gravity model that nests all its standard microfoundations and show how to take the limit so that an economy that becomes infinitesimally small behaves like a SOE. We then derive comparative statics and optimal policy for the SOE. Ignoring standard tax indeterminacies, optimal policy is characterized by export taxes and import tariffs equal to the (inverse) foreign demand and supply elasticities, respectively, and employment subsidies determined by the scale elasticity (under perfect competition) or markups (under monopolistic competition).
records.abstract_cn: 为了对国际贸易中的基本问题提供明确的答案，标准方法是关注小型开放经济体（SOE）。经典传统将SOE定义为将世界价格视为给定的经济体，而在新贸易文献中，它则被定义为将外国商品价格和出口需求表视为给定的经济体。我们开发了一个引力模型，该模型包含了其所有标准的微观基础，并展示了如何取极限，使得一个变得无穷小的经济体表现得像一个SOE。然后，我们推导了SOE的比较静态分析和最优政策。忽略标准的税收不确定性，最优政策的特征是出口税和进口关税分别等于（反向的）外国需求和供给弹性，以及由规模弹性（在完全竞争下）或加成率（在垄断竞争下）决定的就业补贴。

records.title_en: Financial spillovers of foreign direct investment: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 外商直接投资的金融溢出效应：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the financial spillovers of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) to local suppliers through a trade credit channel and a bank loan channel. Using rich Chinese firm-level data, we provide robust evidence that a high concentration of FDI in downstream industries substantially reduces domestic suppliers' trade credit provision and improves their access to bank loans, especially unsecured loans. A variety of empirical strategies suggest that the effects are causal. Furthermore, the beneficial bank loan effect is more pronounced for local suppliers facing more severe information frictions. We also use supplier-customer links to provide additional evidence for FDI's financial spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了外商直接投资（FDI）通过贸易信贷渠道和银行贷款渠道对本地供应商的金融溢出效应。利用丰富的中国企业层面数据，我们提供了有力的证据表明，下游行业FDI的高度集中显著减少了国内供应商的贸易信贷供给，并改善了它们获得银行贷款（尤其是无担保贷款）的机会。多种实证策略表明这些效应具有因果性。此外，对于面临更严重信息摩擦的本地供应商，银行贷款的有利效应更为显著。我们还利用供应商-客户关联为FDI的金融溢出效应提供了额外证据。

records.title_en: Trade and technology adoption in distorted economies
records.title_cn: 扭曲经济体中的贸易与技术采纳
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how labor market imperfections distort firm-level technology choices and alter the gains from trade in developing countries. Motivated by evidence that firms using modern technologies are disproportionately exposed to labor market distortions, we introduce firm-level technology choices and labor market distortions into an otherwise standard quantitative trade model. We then provide formulas for the welfare and labor productivity gains from trade liberalization, highlighting the role of distortions and technology choice. Our quantitative analysis reveals that labor market distortions provide a possible explanation for the inefficiently low levels of modern technology adoption in developing countries. Moreover, labor market distortions erode one-third of the potential labor productivity gains from trade liberalization among low-income countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了劳动力市场不完善如何扭曲企业层面的技术选择，并改变发展中国家的贸易收益。基于使用现代技术的企业不成比例地暴露于劳动力市场扭曲的证据，我们将企业层面的技术选择和劳动力市场扭曲引入一个原本标准的量化贸易模型。然后，我们提供了贸易自由化带来的福利和劳动生产率收益的公式，强调了扭曲和技术选择的作用。我们的量化分析揭示，劳动力市场扭曲为发展中国家现代技术采纳水平低下的无效率提供了一种可能的解释。此外，在低收入国家中，劳动力市场扭曲侵蚀了贸易自由化潜在劳动生产率收益的三分之一。

records.title_en: Common trade exposure and business cycle comovement
records.title_cn: 共同贸易暴露与商业周期联动
records.abstract_en: Bilateral trade is considered a key driver of business-cycle transmission, as countries with higher bilateral trade have more correlated business cycles. We show, however, that when we account for the common trade exposure of a country pair to similar foreign cycles, the effect of bilateral trade on comovement falls sharply. Furthermore, common trade exposure is also a robust predictor of comovement. We conclude that trade is indeed a driver of business-cycle transmission, but often through common exposure to foreign cycles rather than just bilateral linkages. Finally, we consider the implications of these empirical results for the “trade-comovement puzzle.”
records.abstract_cn: 双边贸易被认为是商业周期传导的关键驱动因素，因为双边贸易较高的国家其商业周期更为相关。然而，我们表明，当我们考虑一对国家对类似外国周期的共同贸易暴露时，双边贸易对联动的影响急剧下降。此外，共同贸易暴露也是联动的稳健预测因子。我们得出结论，贸易确实是商业周期传导的驱动因素，但通常是通过对外国周期的共同暴露，而不仅仅是双边联系。最后，我们考虑了这些实证结果对“贸易-联动之谜”的含义。

records.title_en: Specialization, market access and real income
records.title_cn: 专业化、市场准入与实际收入
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impact of external demand shocks on real income. We utilize a first order approximation to a wide class of small open economy models that feature sector-level gravity in trade flows, which allows us to measure foreign shocks and characterize their welfare impact in terms of reduced-form elasticities. We use machine learning techniques to group 4-digit manufacturing sectors into a smaller number of clusters, and show that the cluster-level elasticities of income with respect to foreign shocks can be estimated using high-dimensional statistical techniques. Foreign demand shocks in complex intermediate and capital goods have large positive impacts on real income, whereas impacts in other sectors are negligible. We show that the estimates imply that countries that specialize in these sectors enjoy greater gains from increased openness, and that (small) export subsidies to these sectors are welfare-improving. Finally, a calibrated multi-sector production and trade model with input–output linkages and external economies of scale can match the empirical estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了外部需求冲击对实际收入的影响。我们利用一类广泛的小型开放经济模型的一阶近似，这些模型具有部门层面的贸易流量引力特征，使我们能够衡量外国冲击，并以其简化形式的弹性来刻画其福利影响。我们使用机器学习技术将4位数制造业部门划分为较少数量的聚类，并表明收入相对于外国冲击的聚类层面弹性可以使用高维统计技术进行估计。复杂中间品和资本品的外国需求冲击对实际收入有较大的正向影响，而其他部门的影响则可以忽略不计。我们表明，这些估计意味着专门从事这些部门的国家从开放度提高中获益更多，并且对这些部门（小规模）的出口补贴能够改善福利。最后，一个具有投入产出关联和外部规模经济的校准多部门生产与贸易模型能够匹配实证估计结果。

records.title_en: Clustered sovereign defaults
records.title_cn: 主权违约的集群现象
records.abstract_en: Clustered sovereign default is a recurring phenomenon, but there is a lack of quantitative models to study it. This paper introduces a quantitative framework aimed at untangling latent shocks and examining the mechanisms that precipitate clustered defaults. The model incorporates financial frictions into a sovereign default framework and accommodates global shocks that impact both borrowing countries and lenders. By jointly estimating structural parameters governing the output process of multiple countries, the global shocks are extracted. The framework’s ability to effectively capture multiple crisis episodes, such as the 1980s Latin American debt crisis, validates the joint robustness of the model and the estimation process. The framework uncovers the crucial role of global transitory shocks in producing clustered defaults, particularly when convex default costs are present. Additionally, contrary to what is commonly believed, the framework shows that the Volcker interest rate hike was not a decisive factor in the 1980s clustered default.
records.abstract_cn: 主权违约的集群现象是一种反复出现的现象，但缺乏定量模型来研究它。本文引入了一个定量框架，旨在解开潜在冲击并考察引发集群违约的机制。该模型将金融摩擦纳入主权违约框架，并容纳影响借款国和贷款国的全球冲击。通过联合估计多个国家产出过程的结构参数，提取了全球冲击。该框架有效捕捉多次危机事件的能力，如1980年拉丁美洲债务危机，验证了模型和估计过程的联合稳健性。该框架揭示了全球暂时性冲击在产生集群违约中的关键作用，特别是在存在凸性违约成本时。此外，与普遍看法相反，该框架表明沃尔克加息并非1980年集群违约的决定性因素。

records.title_en: Institutional specialization
records.title_cn: 制度专业化
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a theory of institutional specialization in which some countries uphold the rule of law while others choose extractive institutions, even when countries are ex-ante identical. The driving force of specialization is that for incumbents in each country, the first steps to the rule of law have the greatest cost. Good institutions require sharing power and rents, but in places where power is already shared broadly, each power base or branch of government underpinning institutions is individually less important and thus receives lower rents. Countries with diametrically opposed institutions have a symbiotic relationship in the world equilibrium. The transition from sail to steam-powered vessels in 19th-century trade provides suggestive evidence supporting the theory.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种制度专业化理论，在该理论中，即使各国在事前完全相同，一些国家维护法治，而另一些国家则选择榨取性制度。专业化的驱动力在于，对每个国家的在位者而言，迈向法治的最初几步成本最高。良好的制度要求分享权力和租金，但在权力已经广泛共享的地方，支撑制度的每个权力基础或政府分支单独来看就不那么重要，因此获得的租金较低。具有截然相反制度的国家在世界均衡中形成共生关系。从帆船到蒸汽动力船舶在19世纪贸易中的转变提供了支持该理论的启发性证据。

records.title_en: Using equity market reactions to infer exposure to trade liberalization
records.title_cn: 利用股票市场反应推断贸易自由化的暴露程度
records.abstract_en: We propose a method for identifying exposure to changes in trade policy based on asset prices that has several advantages over standard measures: it encompasses all avenues of exposure, it is natively firm-level, it yields estimates for both goods and service producers, and it can be used to study reductions in difficult-to-quantify non-tariff-barriers in a way that controls naturally for broader macroeconomic shocks. Applying our method to two well-studied US trade liberalizations provides new insight into service-sector responses and reveals dramatically different outcomes among small versus large firms, even within narrow industries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于资产价格识别贸易政策变化暴露程度的方法，该方法相比标准衡量指标具有若干优势：它涵盖了所有暴露途径，天然属于企业层面，能为商品和服务生产者提供估计，并且能以自然控制更广泛宏观经济冲击的方式用于研究难以量化的非关税壁垒的削减。将我们的方法应用于两个研究充分的美国贸易自由化案例，为服务业反应提供了新见解，并揭示了小企业与大企业之间截然不同的结果，即使在狭窄行业内也是如此。

records.title_en: Illuminating the effects of the US-China tariff war on China’s economy
records.title_cn: 揭示中美关税战对中国经济的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of the US-China tariff war on China, using high-frequency night lights data and grid-level measures of tariff exposure. Exploiting within-grid variation over time and controlling extensively for grid-specific contemporaneous trends, we find that each one-percentage-point increase in exposure to the US tariffs was associated with a 0.59% reduction in night-time luminosity. This impact was highly skewed across locations: Grids with negligible direct exposure to the US tariffs accounted for 70% of China’s population. But the tail 2.5% of China’s population with the highest exposure saw an implied 2.52% (1.62%) decrease in income per capita (employment) relative to unaffected grids. These effects were moreover concentrated in locations with a high commuting openness. By contrast, we do not find significant effects from China’s retaliatory tariffs, and offer evidence of several channels through which the impact on imported inputs was mitigated. In a parallel analysis at the prefecture level, we confirm that the US tariffs had discernible negative aggregate consequences.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用高频夜间灯光数据和网格级别的关税暴露度指标，研究了中美关税战对中国的影响。通过利用网格内随时间的变化并广泛控制网格特定的同期趋势，我们发现，对美国关税暴露度每增加一个百分点，夜间灯光亮度相应减少0.59%。这种影响在不同地区间高度不均衡：对美国关税直接暴露度可忽略不计的网格覆盖了中国70%的人口。但暴露度最高的2.5%中国人口，其人均收入（就业）相对于未受影响的网格下降了2.52%（1.62%）。此外，这些影响集中在通勤开放度高的地区。相比之下，我们没有发现中国报复性关税的显著影响，并提供了几个渠道的证据，表明进口投入品受到的影响得到了缓解。在市级层面的平行分析中，我们确认美国关税产生了明显的负面总体后果。

records.title_en: Costs of sovereign debt crises: Restructuring strategies and bank intermediation
records.title_cn: 主权债务危机的成本：重组策略与银行中介
records.abstract_en: Sovereign debt restructurings are associated with declines in the growth of GDP, investment, bank credit to the private sector and capital flows. Our empirical findings show that the intensity of these losses depends on two aspects: whether the restructuring preempts a default and the extent of the reliance of the country’s private sector on domestic bank credit. Post-default restructurings are associated with worse outcomes than restructurings that take place preemptively without missing payments and going into default. Much of that difference is driven by restructurings in countries with relatively large banking sectors, in particular during post-default episodes.
records.abstract_cn: 主权债务重组与GDP增长、投资、银行对私人部门信贷以及资本流动的下降相关。我们的实证研究发现，这些损失的强度取决于两个方面：重组是否先于违约发生，以及该国私人部门对国内银行信贷的依赖程度。违约后的重组与未拖欠付款且未进入违约状态的预防性重组相比，结果更差。这一差异在很大程度上是由银行业规模相对较大的国家的重组所驱动的，尤其是在违约后时期。

records.title_en: Imported intermediate goods and product innovation
records.title_cn: 进口中间品与产品创新
records.abstract_en: We build a structural model of multi-product firms to illustrate how access to foreign intermediate goods contributes to product innovation. We establish a stochastic dynamic model of firm evolution and allow firms to be heterogeneous in their efficiency levels. The model’s mechanism to capture the effects of importing intermediate goods is twofold: (i) importing these goods increases the revenue per each product introduced, and (ii) increases the likelihood of introducing new varieties using newly available inputs. We calibrate the model to firm-level data from India. The model successfully explains the heterogeneous innovation dynamics and statistical moments related to importing and product distribution. Counterfactual exercises further illustrate and quantify the mechanism between trade, innovation performance, and product growth. We find that the critical contribution of trade to growth and product innovation is mainly through access to new imported varieties rather than just the direct import cost.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个多产品企业的结构模型，以说明获得外国中间品如何促进产品创新。我们建立了一个企业演化的随机动态模型，并允许企业在效率水平上存在异质性。该模型捕捉进口中间品效应的机制有两方面：（i）进口这些产品增加了每种引入产品的收入，以及（ii）增加了利用新可用投入引入新品种的可能性。我们将模型校准到印度的企业层面数据。该模型成功解释了与进口和产品分布相关的异质性创新动态和统计矩。反事实实验进一步说明并量化了贸易、创新绩效和产品增长之间的机制。我们发现，贸易对增长和产品创新的关键贡献主要在于获得新的进口品种，而不仅仅是直接的进口成本。

records.title_en: Learning by exporting: Evidence from patent citations in China
records.title_cn: 出口中学习：来自中国专利引用的证据
records.abstract_en: Using matched firm-level data on operations, trade, and patents in China, we empirically investigate the impact of exporting on firms’ innovation and learning from destinations. We first show that access to export markets improves both the quantity and quality of innovation. We then construct a measure of knowledge flows based on Chinese patent citation data and demonstrate that there are actual knowledge transfers from destination markets to exporting firms, which help firms improve their innovation. These findings support the learning-by-exporting effect. Moreover, we show that this learning effect remains significant and unchanged, even after controlling for the spillover effect of FDI. To investigate how the learning process occurs, we also explore whether the learning-by-exporting effect varies with different export products or export modes. We find that vertical linkages and direct exporting facilitate Chinese firms’ learning from destination markets. Finally, we show that the learning effect is particularly salient at the extensive margin compared to the intensive margin.
records.abstract_cn: 利用中国匹配的企业层面运营、贸易和专利数据，我们实证研究了出口对企业创新及从目的地市场学习的影响。我们首先表明，进入出口市场提高了创新的数量和质量。然后，我们基于中国专利引用数据构建了一个知识流动的度量，并证明确实存在从目的地市场到出口企业的实际知识转移，这有助于企业改进其创新。这些发现支持了出口中学习效应。此外，我们表明，即使在控制了外商直接投资（FDI）的溢出效应之后，这种学习效应仍然显著且不变。为了探究学习过程如何发生，我们还探讨了出口中学习效应是否因不同的出口产品或出口模式而异。我们发现，垂直联系和直接出口促进了中国企业从目的地市场的学习。最后，我们表明，与集约边际相比，学习效应在扩展边际上尤为显著。

records.title_en: The pro-competitive effects of trade agreements
records.title_cn: 贸易协定的促进竞争效应
records.abstract_en: How does trade policy affect competition? Using the universe of product exports by firms from eleven low and middle income countries, we document that tariff reductions under trade agreements have strong pro-competitive effects — they encourage entry and reduce the (tariff exclusive) price-cost markups of exporters. This finding, that markups fall with tariff cuts, contradicts a core prediction of standard oligopolistic competition models of trade. We extend a workhorse international pricing model of oligopolistic competition to include multiple countries and a rich preference structure. Our preference structure allows for fierce competition among firms from the same country and less intense competition among firms from different countries. We show a firm’s optimal markup after a tariff cut can rise or fall depending on the parameters of the preference structure and tariff-induced reallocation of market share among firms and across countries.
records.abstract_cn: 贸易政策如何影响竞争？利用来自十一个低收入和中等收入国家的企业产品出口全样本数据，我们记录了贸易协定下的关税削减具有强烈的促进竞争效应——它们鼓励企业进入并降低出口商的（不含关税的）价格成本加成。这一发现，即加成随关税削减而下降，与标准寡头竞争贸易模型的核心预测相矛盾。我们将一个经典的寡头竞争国际定价模型扩展至包含多个国家和丰富的偏好结构。我们的偏好结构允许来自同一国家的企业之间竞争激烈，而来自不同国家的企业之间竞争不那么激烈。我们表明，企业在关税削减后的最优加成可能上升或下降，取决于偏好结构的参数以及关税引起的市场份额在企业间和国家间的重新分配。

records.title_en: Trade invoicing currencies and exchange rate pass-through: The introduction of the euro as a natural experiment
records.title_cn: 贸易计价货币与汇率传递：欧元引入作为自然实验
records.abstract_en: A recent literature emphasizes the prominence of dominant currencies in international trade invoicing and the role of invoice currencies in the transmission of exchange rate shocks. In this paper, we examine the introduction of the euro as a once-in-a-century natural experiment that induced a substantial shifting in invoice currencies, allowing us to test existing theories. We use unique data on the invoice currencies of the universe of export and import transactions of Chilean firms trading with the Eurozone over the period 1997–2010. Before the euro, exports to the Eurozone were dominated by the US dollar, and euro legacy currencies were rarely used. The introduction of the euro led a substantial number of firms to switch their invoice currencies to euros, which eventually accounted for 40% of all transactions. We first study the determinants of the adoption of the euro in exports to the Eurozone, finding a key role for strategic complementarities and for the invoice currency of imported inputs. We then show how firms switching from dollars to euros faced a radical transformation of their exchange rate pass-through, in line with recent theories. While the literature has studied trade invoice currencies in settings in which these are very persistent firm-level choices, our findings validate the conjecture that large–scale policy changes can lead to changes in these choices, and simultaneous changes in exchange rate pass-through.
records.abstract_cn: 近期文献强调主导货币在国际贸易计价中的突出地位以及计价货币在汇率冲击传导中的作用。本文考察了欧元引入这一百年一遇的自然实验，它引发了计价货币的显著转变，使我们得以检验现有理论。我们使用了1997-2010年间智利企业与欧元区进行的所有出口和进口交易的计价货币独特数据。在欧元引入之前，对欧元区的出口以美元为主导，欧元前身货币很少使用。欧元的引入导致大量企业将计价货币转换为欧元，最终欧元占所有交易的40%。我们首先研究了在向欧元区出口中采用欧元的决定因素，发现战略互补性和进口投入品计价货币起着关键作用。然后我们展示了从美元转向欧元的企业如何面临汇率传递的根本性转变，这与近期理论相符。虽然文献在研究贸易计价货币时通常将其视为企业层面的持久选择，但我们的发现验证了大规模政策变化可能导致这些选择发生变化，并同时引起汇率传递变化的猜想。

records.title_en: Taking stock of trade policy uncertainty: Evidence from China’s pre-WTO accession
records.title_cn: 贸易政策不确定性评估：来自中国入世前的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the effects on international trade from the annual tariff uncertainty about China’s MFN status renewal in the U.S. prior to joining the WTO. We have four main findings. First, in the monthly data, trade increases significantly in anticipation of uncertain future increases in tariffs and falls upon renewal. The peak-to-trough swings in trade are 62 percent of the possible tariff change. Second, the probability of a tariff increase was perceived to be relatively small, with an average annual probability of non-renewal of about 3.2 percent. Third, the anticipatory dynamics are entirely driven by the expected increase in tariffs, while uncertainty dampens them. We identify these effects using within-year variation in the risk of trade policy changes around the renewal vote and trade flows. We show that a (s̲,s¯) inventory model generates this behavior and that variation in the strength of the stockpiling in advance of the renewal decision is increasing in the storability of goods. Fourth, the costs associated with the trade policy induced stockpiling reduce entrants’ incentive to operate in a market with tariff uncertainty. Our results explain why trade may hold up in advance of a prospective policy change but may fall sharply even if expected tariff increases do not materialize.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中国加入WTO之前，美国对中国最惠国待遇地位年度续期的不确定性对国际贸易的影响。我们有四个主要发现。首先，在月度数据中，贸易在预期未来关税可能上升时显著增加，而在续期后下降。贸易的峰谷波动幅度为可能关税变化的62%。其次，关税上升的概率被认为相对较小，年度不续期的平均概率约为3.2%。第三，预期动态完全由预期关税上升驱动，而不确定性则抑制了这种动态。我们利用续期投票前后贸易政策变化风险的年内变化和贸易流量来识别这些效应。我们证明了一个(s̲,s¯)库存模型能够产生这种行为，并且续期决定前囤积强度的变化随着商品的可储存性而增加。第四，贸易政策引发的囤积所带来的成本降低了进入者在存在关税不确定性的市场中运营的激励。我们的结果解释了为什么贸易在预期政策变化之前可能保持，但即使预期的关税上升没有实现，也可能急剧下降。

records.title_en: International joint ventures and internal technology transfer vs. external technology spillovers: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 国际合资企业与内部技术转移及外部技术溢出：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the economics of international joint ventures using administrative data for China. We first show that foreign investors choose Chinese partners that are relatively large, productive, and more innovative to set up their joint venture. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we then provide evidence that joint ventures lead to domestic benefits in the form of productivity and technological spillovers to both the Chinese partners in joint ventures as well as other domestic Chinese firms. Exploiting the easing of joint venture requirements as China entered the WTO in the year 2001, we further show that intraindustry spillovers from joint ventures to other domestic firms increased in the wake of China’s WTO accession, consistent with gains from foreign technology rising due to enhanced commitment through the rules-based WTO system. Our results shed new light on the efficacy of FDI performance requirements as well as on claims regarding international technology transfer that underpinned the China–US trade war.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国的行政数据研究国际合资企业的经济学。我们首先表明，外国投资者选择规模相对较大、生产率较高且更具创新性的中国合作伙伴来设立合资企业。使用双重差分框架，我们随后提供证据表明，合资企业为国内带来了生产率和技术溢出方面的利益，既惠及合资企业中的中方合作伙伴，也惠及其他国内中国企业。利用中国于2001年加入世界贸易组织时合资企业要求的放宽，我们进一步表明，在中国加入世贸组织后，合资企业对其他国内企业的行业内溢出效应有所增加，这与通过基于规则的世界贸易组织体系增强承诺而导致的外国技术收益增加相一致。我们的结果为外商直接投资绩效要求的有效性以及支撑中美贸易战关于国际技术转移的主张提供了新的启示。

records.title_en: A theory of capital flow retrenchment
records.title_cn: 资本流动回撤理论
records.abstract_en: During a downturn in the global financial cycle there is a simultaneous retrenchment in gross capital flows and a fall in risky asset prices. The global financial cycle is closely related to fluctuations in risk appetite. We develop a model that can simultaneously produce a fall in gross outflows, inflows, and asset prices following an increase in global risk aversion. There is heterogeneity across investors within a country in the willingness to hold risky assets and to hold foreign assets. The fall in the asset price after a rise in global risk aversion shifts the wealth distribution towards investors that are less willing to hold foreign assets. This leads a drop in gross flows. We calibrate the within country heterogeneity in the model to match heterogeneity observed in micro data of household portfolios. The retrenchment in the calibrated model is quantitatively similar to what we observe in the macro data.
records.abstract_cn: 在全球金融周期下行期间，总资本流动同时出现回撤，风险资产价格下跌。全球金融周期与风险偏好的波动密切相关。我们开发了一个模型，该模型能够在全球风险厌恶情绪上升后同时产生总流出、流入和资产价格的下降。国内投资者在持有风险资产和外国资产的意愿上存在异质性。全球风险厌恶情绪上升后资产价格的下跌将财富分配转向那些不太愿意持有外国资产的投资者。这导致总流动下降。我们在模型中校准了国内异质性，以匹配家庭投资组合微观数据中观察到的异质性。校准模型中的回撤在数量上与我们在宏观数据中观察到的相似。

records.title_en: Foundation of the small open economy model with product differentiation
records.title_cn: 产品差异化小型开放经济模型的基础
records.abstract_en: We derive a small open economy (SOE) as the limit of an economy as the number or size of its trading partners goes to infinity and trade costs also go to infinity. We obtain this limit in the Armington, Eaton–Kortum, Krugman, and Melitz models. In all cases, the trade of the SOE with the foreign countries approaches a finite limit, and the domestic expenditure share for the SOE approaches a limit that is not zero or unity. The foreign countries can be either infinitely many SOEs, or alternatively, one or many large countries with domestic expenditure shares that approach unity. We illustrate the usefulness of this framework by obtaining a formula for the optimal tariff in the SOE – depending on the elasticity of domestic wages with respect to the tariff – that is consistent with all models.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将小型开放经济（SOE）推导为当贸易伙伴数量或规模趋于无穷大且贸易成本也趋于无穷大时经济的极限。我们在Armington、Eaton–Kortum、Krugman和Melitz模型中获得了这一极限。在所有情况下，SOE与外国国家的贸易趋近于有限极限，且SOE的国内支出份额趋近于既非零也非一的极限。外国国家可以是无限多个SOE，或者也可以是一个或多个国内支出份额趋近于一的大国。我们通过获得SOE中最优关税的公式——该公式取决于国内工资对关税的弹性——来说明这一框架的有用性，且该公式与所有模型一致。

records.title_en: International transmission of the U.S. dollar liquidity shock: The channel of FX borrowing and lending
records.title_cn: 美元流动性冲击的国际传导：外汇借贷渠道
records.abstract_en: Access to foreign exchange (FX) liquidity is crucial to the growth and stability of emerging market economies. We examine the impact of U.S. dollar liquidity shocks on firm investments in Korea by constructing a dataset that merges four distinct micro-level data spanning ten years from 2006 to 2015. We trace the path of FX liquidity from the international financial market to Korean banks and subsequently to listed firms. During international liquidity shocks, banks borrow less FX but pay higher interest rates. Weak banks, whose FX borrowing rates are sensitive to these shocks, reduce their FX credit supply to firms. Among the FX loan-reliant firms that are highly productive, those borrowing from weak banks reduce their investments. This channel of FX borrowing and lending accounts for 19% of the decline in the investment of listed firms during the peak of the Global Financial Crisis.
records.abstract_cn: 获取外汇流动性对新兴市场经济体的增长和稳定至关重要。我们通过构建一个数据集来研究美元流动性冲击对韩国企业投资的影响，该数据集合并了从2006年到2015年十年间四个不同的微观层面数据。我们追踪了外汇流动性从国际金融市场到韩国银行，再到上市公司的路径。在国际流动性冲击期间，银行减少外汇借款但支付更高的利率。弱银行，其外汇借款利率对这些冲击敏感，减少了对企业的外汇信贷供应。在依赖外汇贷款且生产率高的企业中，那些从弱银行借款的企业减少了投资。在全球金融危机高峰期，这种外汇借贷渠道占上市公司投资下降的19%。

records.title_en: Sovereign debt and credit default swaps
records.title_cn: 主权债务与信用违约互换
records.abstract_en: How do credit default swaps (CDS) affect sovereign debt markets? We analyze how liquidity, exposure to default risk, and regulation affect the answer to this question using a sovereign debt model where investors trade bonds and CDS over the counter via directed search. Restricting portfolios can improve bond prices and bond-market activity, but the net effect depends on relative frictions in bond and CDS markets, the exposure of investors, and how the sovereign responds to the policy. Our novel identification strategy exploits confidential microdata to quantify trading frictions and the exposure distribution. The calibrated model generates realistic CDS-bond basis deviations, bid–ask spreads, and CDS volumes and positions. Our baseline specification predicts trading frictions and an inability to short sell bonds significantly improves sovereign debt prices, but policies that restrict CDS trading have small effects.
records.abstract_cn: 信用违约互换（CDS）如何影响主权债务市场？我们通过一个主权债务模型来分析流动性、违约风险敞口和监管如何影响这一问题的答案，在该模型中，投资者通过定向搜索在场外交易债券和CDS。限制投资组合可以改善债券价格和债券市场活动，但净效应取决于债券和CDS市场的相对摩擦、投资者的敞口以及主权国家对政策的反应。我们的新颖识别策略利用机密微观数据来量化交易摩擦和敞口分布。校准模型产生了现实的CDS-债券基差偏差、买卖价差以及CDS交易量和持仓量。我们的基准设定预测，交易摩擦和无法卖空债券显著提高了主权债务价格，但限制CDS交易的政策影响较小。

records.title_en: Buying lottery tickets for foreign workers: Lost quota rents induced by H-1B policy
records.title_cn: 为外国工人购买彩票：H-1B政策导致的配额租金损失
records.abstract_en: The H-1B program allows firms in the United States to temporarily hire high-skilled foreign citizens. The government restricts inflows of new H-1B workers and therefore creates potential rents typical of a quota. Importantly, however, the US allocates H-1B status by random lottery. We develop a theoretical model demonstrating that this lottery creates a negative externality that destroys quota rents by incentivizing firms to search for more workers than can actually be hired. Some firms specialize in hiring foreign labor and contracting out those workers’ services to third-party sites. These outsourcing firms exacerbate the search externality. Numerical exercises suggest that these processes result in an annual economic loss exceeding $10,000 per new H-1B worker hired relative to what would occur in the absence of lottery allocation.
records.abstract_cn: H-1B计划允许美国公司临时雇用高技能外国公民。政府限制新H-1B工人的流入，因此产生了典型的配额租金。然而，重要的是，美国通过随机抽签分配H-1B身份。我们开发了一个理论模型，表明这种抽签产生了一种负外部性，通过激励公司寻找比实际可雇用更多的工人，从而破坏了配额租金。一些公司专门雇用外国劳动力，并将这些工人的服务外包给第三方站点。这些外包公司加剧了搜索外部性。数值模拟表明，相对于没有抽签分配的情况，这些过程导致每个新雇用的H-1B工人每年经济损失超过$10,000。

records.title_en: Are trade wars class wars? The importance of trade-induced horizontal inequality
records.title_cn: 贸易战是阶级战争吗？贸易引发的水平不平等的重要性
records.abstract_en: What is the nature of the distributional effects of trade? This paper demonstrates conceptually and empirically the importance of “trade-induced horizontal inequality,” i.e. inequality that occurs among workers with the same level of earnings before the trade shock. This type of inequality does not affect the income distribution but generates winners and losers at all income levels. To quantify the horizontal inequality and changes in the income distribution induced by trade in a data-driven way, we develop a characterization of the welfare impacts, governed by simple and intuitive statistics of labor market and consumption exposure to trade. In the U.S., we find substantial heterogeneity in exposure and thus in the welfare effects of trade shocks across workers. Over 99% of the variance of welfare changes from trade shocks arises within income deciles. These findings run against a popular narrative that “trade wars are class wars.”
records.abstract_cn: 贸易的分配效应的本质是什么？本文在概念上和实证上证明了“贸易引发的水平不平等”的重要性，即贸易冲击前收入水平相同的工人之间出现的不平等。这种类型的不平等不影响收入分配，但在所有收入水平上都会产生赢家和输家。为了以数据驱动的方式量化贸易引发的水平不平等和收入分配的变化，我们开发了福利影响的特征化，由劳动力市场和消费对贸易暴露的简单直观的统计量所支配。在美国，我们发现工人之间在暴露程度以及因此贸易冲击的福利效应上存在显著的异质性。贸易冲击福利变化方差的超过99%发生在收入十分位组内。这些发现与“贸易战是阶级战争”的流行说法相悖。

records.title_en: Religious proximity and misinformation: Experimental evidence from a mobile phone-based campaign in India
records.title_cn: 宗教亲近与错误信息：来自印度基于手机活动的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate how religion concordance influences the effectiveness of preventive health campaigns. Conducted during the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic in two major Indian cities marked by Hindu–Muslim tensions, we randomly assigned a representative sample of slum residents to receive either a physician-delivered information campaign promoting health-related preventive practices, or uninformative control messages on their mobile phones. Messages, introduced by a local citizen (the sender), were cross-randomized to start with a greeting signaling either a Hindu or a Muslim identity, manipulating religion concordance between sender and receiver. We found that doctor messages increased compliance with recommended practices and beliefs in their efficacy. Our findings suggest that the campaign’s impact is primarily driven by shared religion between sender and receiver, leading to increased message engagement and compliance with recommended practices. Additionally, we observe that religion concordance helps protect against misinformation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了宗教一致性如何影响预防性健康运动的效果。在COVID-19大流行初期，我们在印度两个以印度教-穆斯林紧张关系为特征的主要城市进行了一项实验，将具有代表性的贫民窟居民随机分配，通过手机接收由医生提供的信息宣传活动，该活动推广健康相关的预防措施，或接收无信息的对照信息。信息由当地公民（发送者）介绍，并交叉随机化以开始于一个表明印度教或穆斯林身份的问候语，从而操纵发送者与接收者之间的宗教一致性。我们发现，医生的信息增加了对推荐做法及其有效性的信念的遵从。我们的研究结果表明，该运动的影响主要由发送者与接收者之间的共同宗教驱动，导致信息参与度和对推荐做法的遵从度提高。此外，我们观察到宗教一致性有助于抵御错误信息。

records.title_en: A structural microsimulation model for demand-side cost-sharing in healthcare
records.title_cn: 医疗保健需求侧费用分担的结构性微观模拟模型
records.abstract_en: Demand-side cost-sharing reduces moral hazard in healthcare but increases exposure to out-of-pocket expenditure. We introduce a structural microsimulation model to evaluate both total and out-of-pocket expenditure for different cost-sharing schemes. We use a Bayesian mixture model to capture the healthcare expenditure distributions across different age–gender categories. We estimate the model using Dutch data and simulate outcomes for a number of policies. The model suggests that for a deductible of 300 euros shifting the starting point of the deductible away from zero to 400 euros leads to an average 4% reduction in healthcare expenditure and 47% lower out-of-pocket payments.
records.abstract_cn: 需求侧费用分担减少了医疗保健中的道德风险，但增加了自付费用的暴露。我们引入了一个结构性微观模拟模型，以评估不同费用分担方案下的总支出和自付支出。我们使用贝叶斯混合模型来捕捉不同年龄-性别类别的医疗保健支出分布。我们使用荷兰数据估计模型，并模拟多种政策的结果。模型表明，对于300欧元的免赔额，将免赔额的起点从零移至400欧元，会导致医疗保健支出平均减少4%%，自付费用降低47%%。

records.title_en: Sibling spillovers and the choice to get vaccinated: Evidence from a regression discontinuity design
records.title_cn: 兄弟姐妹溢出效应与疫苗接种选择：来自断点回归设计的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of introducing population-wide free-of-charge Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination programs on the targeted adolescent cohorts and their siblings. For identification, we rely on regression discontinuity designs and high-quality Danish administrative data to exploit that date of birth determines program eligibility. We find that the programs increased the HPV vaccine take-up of both the targeted children (53.2 percentage points for girls and 36.0 percentage points for boys) and their older same-sex siblings (4.5 percentage points for sisters and 3.5 percentage points for brothers). We show that while the direct effects of the programs reduced HPV vaccine take-up inequality, the spillover effects, in contrast, contributed to an increase in vaccine take-up inequality highlighting the potential importance of spillover effects in the determination of distributional consequences of public health programs. Finally, we find some evidence of cross-vaccine spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了面向全体人群的免费人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗接种项目对目标青少年队列及其兄弟姐妹的影响。为识别因果效应，我们依赖断点回归设计和高品质的丹麦行政数据，利用出生日期决定项目资格这一事实。我们发现，这些项目提高了目标儿童（女孩提高53.2个百分点，男孩提高36.0个百分点）及其年长同性兄弟姐妹（姐妹提高4.5个百分点，兄弟提高3.5个百分点）的HPV疫苗接种率。我们表明，虽然项目的直接效应降低了HPV疫苗接种不平等，但溢出效应反而加剧了疫苗接种不平等，凸显了溢出效应在决定公共卫生项目分配后果中的潜在重要性。最后，我们发现了跨疫苗溢出效应的一些证据。

records.title_en: Paying for advance care planning in medicare: Impacts on care and spending near end of life
records.title_cn: 为医疗保险中的预先护理计划付费：对生命末期护理和支出的影响
records.abstract_en: Spending at end of life (EOL) accounts for a large and growing share of healthcare expenditures in the US, and often reflects aggressive care with questionable value for dying patients. Using a novel instrumental variables approach, we conduct the first study on the causal effect of Medicare reimbursement for advance care planning (ACP)—the process of discussing and recording patient preferences for goals of care—on care utilization, spending, and mortality outcomes for critically ill Medicare patients. We find that billed ACP services substantially increase hospice use and hospice spending within a year, accompanied by corresponding increase in one-year mortality. The impacts of ACP services on hospice use and spending are especially prominent among patients with dementia and those of lower socioeconomic status. Among decedents, death is significantly less likely to occur in the hospital, and total and inpatient spending within the last 30 days of life fall significantly. Our findings suggest that paying for ACP services can be effective in improving hospice use for critically ill Medicare patients, with the (possibly intended) consequence of increased one-year mortality.
records.abstract_cn: 在美国，生命末期（EOL）支出占医疗保健支出的比例很大且不断增长，且往往反映了对临终患者价值存疑的激进护理。利用一种新颖的工具变量方法，我们首次研究了医疗保险对预先护理计划（ACP）——讨论并记录患者护理目标偏好的过程——的报销对重症医疗保险患者的护理利用、支出和死亡率结果的因果效应。我们发现，计费的ACP服务显著增加了临终关怀的使用和一年内的临终关怀支出，同时伴随着一年死亡率的相应增加。ACP服务对临终关怀使用和支出的影响在痴呆患者和社会经济地位较低的患者中尤为显著。在死亡者中，死亡发生在医院的可能性显著降低，生命最后30天内的总支出和住院支出显著下降。我们的研究结果表明，为ACP服务付费可以有效改善重症医疗保险患者的临终关怀使用，同时带来（可能是预期的）一年死亡率上升的后果。

records.title_en: Pharmaceutical demand response to utilization management
records.title_cn: 药品需求对利用管理的响应
records.abstract_en: Prescription drug insurance increasingly imposes prior authorization (requiring providers to request coverage before claim approval) to manage utilization. Prior authorization has been criticized because of its administrative burden on providers. The primary alternative to managing utilization is imposing out-of-pocket (OOP) payment to incentivize beneficiaries to seek lower-cost care, effectively providing beneficiaries with partial insurance. Would beneficiaries prefer indirectly paying for prior authorization through higher premiums; or would they prefer prior authorization was replaced by higher OOP costs? This tradeoff depends on how much OOP costs could be displaced by prior authorization, which depends on their relative impact on demand. I estimate the effect of prior authorization and OOP costs on pharmaceutical demand in Medicare Part D, addressing endogeneity caused by unobserved drug quality and selection into plans. Despite criticism of prior authorization, I find that Medicare beneficiaries would prefer higher premiums to pay for prior authorization, over higher OOP costs.
records.abstract_cn: 处方药保险越来越多地实施事先授权（要求提供者在索赔批准前请求覆盖）以管理利用。事先授权因其对提供者造成的行政负担而受到批评。管理利用的主要替代方案是施加自付费用，以激励受益人寻求更低成本的护理，实际上为受益人提供部分保险。受益人会更倾向于通过更高的保费间接支付事先授权，还是更倾向于用更高的自付费用替代事先授权？这种权衡取决于自付费用能被事先授权替代多少，而这又取决于它们对需求的相对影响。我估计了事先授权和自付费用对Medicare D部分药品需求的影响，解决了由未观察到的药品质量和计划选择引起的内生性问题。尽管事先授权受到批评，我发现Medicare受益人更倾向于支付更高的保费以保留事先授权，而不是承担更高的自付费用。

records.title_en: Safer sex? The effect of AIDS risk on birth rates
records.title_cn: 更安全的性行为？艾滋病风险对出生率的影响
records.abstract_en: Behavioral adjustments to mitigate increasing risk of STIs can increase or decrease the likelihood of pregnancy. This paper measures the effects of the arrival and spread of AIDS across U.S. cities in the 1980s and 1990s on births and abortions. I show that the AIDS epidemic increased the birth rate by 0.55 percent and the abortion rate by 1.77 percent. I find support for two underlying mechanisms to explain the increase in pregnancies. Some women opted into monogamous partnerships in response to the AIDS epidemic, with a corresponding increase in the marriage rate and improvement in infant health. Others switched from prescription contraceptive methods to condoms. These behavioral changes lowered the incidence of other sexually transmitted infections, but increased both planned and unplanned pregnancies.
records.abstract_cn: 为降低性传播感染风险而进行的行为调整可能增加或减少怀孕的可能性。本文衡量了1980年代和1990年代艾滋病在美国各城市的出现和传播对出生和流产的影响。我表明艾滋病流行使出生率提高了0.55%，流产率提高了1.77%。我找到了支持两种潜在机制来解释怀孕增加的证据。一些女性因应艾滋病流行而选择一夫一妻制伴侣关系，相应地结婚率上升，婴儿健康状况改善。另一些女性则从处方避孕方法转向使用避孕套。这些行为变化降低了其他性传播感染的发生率，但增加了计划内和计划外怀孕。

records.title_en: Long-run consequences of informal elderly care and implications of public long-term care insurance
records.title_cn: 非正式老年照护的长期后果及公共长期护理保险的影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate a dynamic structural model of labor supply, retirement, and informal caregiving to study short and long-term costs of informal caregiving in Germany. Incorporating labor market frictions and the German tax and benefit system, we find that in the absence of Germany’s public long-term insurance scheme, informal elderly care has adverse and persistent effects on labor market outcomes and, thus, negatively affects lifetime earnings and future pension benefits. These consequences of caregiving are heterogeneous and depend on age, previous earnings, and institutional regulations. Policy simulations suggest that while public long-term care insurance policies are fiscally costly and induce negative labor market effects, they can largely offset the personal costs of caregiving and increase welfare, especially for low-income individuals.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一个包含劳动供给、退休和非正式照护的动态结构模型，以研究德国非正式照护的短期和长期成本。结合劳动力市场摩擦以及德国的税收和福利制度，我们发现，在缺乏德国公共长期保险计划的情况下，非正式老年照护对劳动力市场结果产生不利且持久的影响，从而对终身收入和未来养老金福利产生负面影响。这些照护后果具有异质性，并取决于年龄、先前收入和制度规定。政策模拟表明，虽然公共长期护理保险政策在财政上成本高昂并引发负面劳动力市场效应，但它们可以在很大程度上抵消照护的个人成本并提高福利，尤其是对低收入个体而言。

records.title_en: Adverse selection and network design under regulated plan prices: Evidence from Medicaid
records.title_cn: 受监管计划价格下的逆向选择与网络设计：来自医疗补助计划的证据
records.abstract_en: Health plans for the poor increasingly limit access to specialty hospitals. We investigate the role of adverse selection in generating this equilibrium among private plans in Medicaid. Studying a network change, we find that covering a top cancer hospital causes severe adverse selection, increasing demand for a plan by 50% among enrollees with cancer versus no impact for others. Medicaid’s fixed insurer payments make offsetting this selection, and the contract distortions it induces, challenging, requiring either infeasibly high payment rates or near-perfect risk adjustment. By contrast, a small explicit bonus for covering the hospital is sufficient to make coverage profitable.
records.abstract_cn: 面向贫困人群的健康计划日益限制对专科医院的准入。我们研究了逆向选择在医疗补助计划中私人计划之间形成这种均衡的作用。通过研究一次网络变更，我们发现覆盖一家顶级癌症医院会导致严重的逆向选择，使癌症参保者对该计划的需求增加50%，而对其他人群没有影响。医疗补助计划的固定保险公司支付使得抵消这种选择及其引发的合同扭曲具有挑战性，需要要么不可行的高支付率，要么近乎完美的风险调整。相比之下，为覆盖该医院提供一笔小额明确奖金就足以使覆盖变得有利可图。

records.title_en: The impact of scope-of-practice restrictions on access to medical care
records.title_cn: 执业范围限制对医疗服务可及性的影响
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of scope-of-practice laws in a highly regulated and important policy setting, the provision of medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder. We consider two natural experiments generated by policy changes at the state and federal level that allow nurse practitioners more practice autonomy. Both experiments show that liberalizations of prescribing authority lead to large improvements in access to care. Further, we use rich address-level data to answer key policy questions. Expanding nurse practitioner prescribing authority reduces urban–rural disparities in health care access. Additionally, expanded autonomy increases access to care provided by physicians, driven by complementarities between providers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在高度监管且重要的政策环境中，执业范围法律对阿片类药物使用障碍的药物治疗服务提供的影响。我们考虑了州和联邦层面政策变化产生的两个自然实验，这些政策允许执业护士拥有更多实践自主权。两个实验均表明，处方权的放宽显著改善了医疗服务的可及性。此外，我们利用丰富的地址级数据来回答关键政策问题。扩大执业护士处方权缩小了城乡医疗服务可及性差距。此外，自主权的扩大增加了由医生提供的医疗服务可及性，这是由提供者之间的互补性驱动的。

records.title_en: Pharmaceutical innovation collaboration, evaluation, and matching
records.title_cn: 制药创新合作、评估与匹配
records.abstract_en: This paper theoretically studies pharmaceutical innovation collaborations, where heterogeneous firms compete for heterogeneous academics. At an interim stage, the firm evaluates the project, which allows it to monitor academics and decide whether to terminate the project to avoid the loss from a future failure. This paper explores the contract, project termination strategy, and collaboration matching. The firm’s innovation strategy (exploitations or explorations) determines the evaluation structure, which may affect the market equilibrium. By considering different innovation strategies, this paper shows that in each case, the equilibrium matching is unique (either positive or negative assortative). Consequently, the chosen innovation strategy plays a pivotal role in shaping equilibrium matching outcomes. These findings provide theoretical insights into pharma-academic alliances, shed light on the observed positive or negative assortative properties in the market, and advocate for the consideration of innovation strategies and evaluation structures in future research endeavors. Moreover, this paper also provides several empirical and policy implications.
records.abstract_cn: 本文从理论上研究了制药创新合作，其中异质性企业与异质性学者竞争。在中期阶段，企业评估项目，这使其能够监督学者并决定是否终止项目以避免未来失败的损失。本文探讨了合同、项目终止策略和合作匹配。企业的创新策略（利用或探索）决定了评估结构，这可能影响市场均衡。通过考虑不同的创新策略，本文表明在每种情况下，均衡匹配是唯一的（要么是正分类匹配，要么是负分类匹配）。因此，所选择的创新策略在塑造均衡匹配结果中起着关键作用。这些发现为制药-学术联盟提供了理论见解，揭示了市场中观察到的正或负分类匹配特性，并倡导在未来研究工作中考虑创新策略和评估结构。此外，本文还提供了一些实证和政策启示。

records.title_en: Reminder design and childhood vaccination coverage
records.title_cn: 提醒设计与儿童疫苗接种覆盖率
records.abstract_en: A major policy concern across public vaccination programs is non-compliance. Exploiting Danish population data and three national reforms in regression discontinuity designs, we document the effects of reminders for childhood vaccination coverage. Retrospective reminders are primarily effective for families with small children and when sent out close to the recommended vaccination age. Digital and postal reminders are equally effective. Prospective reminders increase timely vaccinations in later childhood and help reaching high coverage for new vaccines in increasingly complex vaccination programs. While reminders prompt additional preventive care for focal children, we find no spillovers to other health behaviors or relatives.
records.abstract_cn: 公共疫苗接种项目中的一个主要政策关注点是不合规行为。利用丹麦人口数据和三项全国性改革，在断点回归设计中，我们记录了提醒对儿童疫苗接种覆盖率的影响。回顾性提醒主要对有幼儿的家庭有效，并且在接近推荐接种年龄时发送效果最佳。数字提醒和邮政提醒同样有效。前瞻性提醒能提高儿童后期的及时接种率，并有助于在日益复杂的疫苗接种项目中实现新疫苗的高覆盖率。虽然提醒促使目标儿童接受额外的预防性护理，但我们未发现对其他健康行为或亲属的溢出效应。

records.title_en: Analyzing health outcomes measured as bounded counts
records.title_cn: 分析以有界计数衡量的健康结果
records.abstract_en: This paper assesses analytical strategies that respect the bounded-count nature of health outcomes encountered often in empirical applications. Absent in the literature is a comprehensive discussion and critique of strategies for analyzing and understanding such data. The paper's goal is to provide an in-depth consideration of prominent issues arising in and strategies for undertaking such analyses, emphasizing the merits and limitations of various analytical tools empirical researchers may contemplate. Three main topics are covered. First, bounded-count health outcomes' measurement properties are reviewed and their implications assessed. Second, issues arising when bounded-count outcomes are the objects of concern in evaluations are described. Third, the (conditional) probability and moment structures of bounded-count outcomes are derived and corresponding specification and estimation strategies presented with particular attention to partial effects. Many questions may be asked of such data in health research and a researcher's choice of analytical method is often consequential.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了尊重健康结果有界计数性质的分析策略，这种健康结果在实证应用中经常遇到。文献中缺乏对分析和理解此类数据的策略进行全面讨论和批判。本文的目标是深入考虑进行此类分析时出现的突出问题及策略，强调实证研究人员可能考虑的各种分析工具的优缺点。涵盖三个主要主题。首先，回顾了有界计数健康结果的测量属性并评估其含义。其次，描述了当有界计数结果作为评估对象时出现的问题。第三，推导了有界计数结果的（条件）概率和矩结构，并提出了相应的设定和估计策略，特别关注部分效应。在健康研究中，对此类数据可能会提出许多问题，而研究人员选择的分析方法往往会产生重要影响。

records.title_en: Who responds to longer wait times? The effects of predicted emergency wait times on the health and volume of patients who present for care
records.title_cn: 谁对更长的等待时间做出反应？预测急诊等待时间对就诊患者健康与数量的影响
records.abstract_en: Healthcare is often free at the point-of-care so that price does not deter patients. However, the dis-utility from waiting for care that often occurs could also lead to deterrence. I investigate responses in the volume and types of patients that demand emergency care when predicted waiting times quasi-randomly change. I leverage a discontinuity to compare emergency sites with similar predicted wait times but with different apparent wait times displayed to patients. I use impulse response functions estimated by local projections to estimate effects of predicted wait times on patient demand for care. An additional thirty minutes of predicted wait time results in 15% fewer waiting patients at urgent cares and 2% fewer waiting patients at emergency departments within three hours of display. Patients that stop using emergency care are also triaged as healthier. However, at very high predicted wait times, there are reductions in demand for all patients including sicker patients.
records.abstract_cn: 医疗保健在服务点通常免费，因此价格不会阻止患者。然而，等待护理常常带来的负效用也可能导致阻止。我研究了当预测等待时间准随机变化时，急诊护理需求的数量和患者类型的变化。我利用一个断点来比较预测等待时间相似但向患者显示的明显等待时间不同的急诊站点。我使用通过局部投影估计的脉冲响应函数来估计预测等待时间对患者护理需求的影响。额外三十分钟的预测等待时间导致在显示后三小时内，紧急护理中心的等待患者减少15%，急诊部门的等待患者减少2%。停止使用急诊护理的患者也被分诊为更健康。然而，在非常高的预测等待时间下，所有患者的需求都会减少，包括病情更重的患者。

records.title_en: The education-health gradient: Revisiting the role of socio-emotional skills
records.title_cn: 教育-健康梯度：重新审视社会情感技能的作用
records.abstract_en: Is the education-health gradient inflated because both education and health are associated with unobserved socio-emotional skills? We find that the gradient in health behaviors and outcomes is reduced by about 15 to 50% from accounting for fine-grained personality facets and up to another 50% from Locus of Control. Traditional aggregated Big-Five scales, however, have a much smaller contribution to the gradient. We use sibling-fixed effects to net out the contribution from genes and shared childhood environment, decomposing the gradient into its components with an order-invariant method. We rely on a large survey (N = 28,261) linked to high-quality Danish administrative registers with information on parental background and objectively measured diagnoses and care use. Accounting for Locus of Control yields the strongest gradient reduction in self-rated health status and objective diagnoses (30%–50%), and in health behaviors the most important factor is Extraversion, a skill that has been shown to be malleable in interventions.
