We consider (iii) Bayesian preference, (iv) convex dominance, and (v) mean-preserving-spread (dilation) for all priors as well as for a given full-support prior. We provide counterexamples to underscore the necessity of the assumptions underlying some of our findings, and offer a generalization of the Hirschleifer-Schlee theorem as an application.
records.abstract_cn: 布莱克威尔关于信息结构比较的定理在有限状态空间中已得到充分理解，但在无限情形下仍存在重要空白。虽然（i）充分性与（ii）更多信息性的等价性已知，我们提出一个综合理论，在一般（波兰）状态空间上建立这两个序（在其原始形式和几乎所有版本中）与三个额外的先验依赖准则之间的等价关系。我们考虑（iii）贝叶斯偏好，（iv）凸占优，以及（v）对所有先验以及给定全支持先验的均值保持展形（扩张）。我们提供反例以强调我们某些发现所依据假设的必要性，并作为应用给出赫什莱弗-施利定理的推广。

records.title_en: Informational separability and entropy
records.title_cn: 信息可分性与熵
records.abstract_en: Informational separability occurs when information decreases as the result of suppressing information that differentiates a subset of states in experiments. With multiple states, informational separability leads to entropy measures. Its implications in multiple different contexts are discussed, including segregation measurement, inference with partial information, and rational inattention.
records.abstract_cn: 当抑制实验中区分状态子集的信息导致信息减少时，即出现信息可分性。在多种状态下，信息可分性引致熵度量。本文讨论了其在多个不同情境中的含义，包括隔离度量、部分信息下的推断以及理性疏忽。

records.title_en: Contagion and equilibria in diversified financial networks
records.title_cn: 多元化金融网络中的传染与均衡
records.abstract_en: Diversified cross-shareholding networks are thought to be more resilient to shocks, but diversification also increases the channels by which a shock can spread. To resolve these competing intuitions we introduce a stochastic model of a diversified cross-shareholding network in which a firm's valuation depends on its cash endowment and the shares it owns in other firms. We show that a concentration of measure phenomenon emerges: almost all realized network instances drawn from any probability distribution in a wide class are resilient to contagion if endowments are sufficiently large. Furthermore, the size of a shock needed to trigger widespread financial distress increases with the exposure of firms to each other. Distributions in this class are characterized by the property that a firm's equity shares owned by others are weakly dependent yet lack “dominant” shareholders.
records.abstract_cn: 多元化的交叉持股网络被认为对冲击更具韧性，但多元化也增加了冲击传播的渠道。为了解决这些相互矛盾的直觉，我们引入了一个多元化交叉持股网络的随机模型，其中企业的估值取决于其现金 endowment 及其在其他企业中的持股。我们证明了一种测度集中现象的出现：如果 endowment 足够大，那么从广泛类别中的任何概率分布中抽取的几乎所有实现网络实例都对传染具有韧性。此外，触发广泛金融困境所需的冲击规模随着企业之间的相互敞口增加而增加。该类别中的分布特征在于，企业被其他企业持有的股权份额具有弱依赖性，但缺乏“主导”股东。

records.title_en: Stable allocations in discrete exchange economies
records.title_cn: 离散交换经济中的稳定配置
records.abstract_en: We study stable allocations in an exchange economy with indivisible goods. The problem is well-known to be challenging, and rich enough to express fundamentally unstable economies, such as the roommate problem. Our approach stems from generalizing the original study of an exchange economy with unit demand and unit endowments, the housing model. Our first approach uses Scarf's theorem, and proposes sufficient conditions under which a “convexify then round” technique ensures that the core is nonempty. The upshot is that a core allocation exists in categorical economies with dichotomous preferences. Our second approach uses a generalization of the TTC: it works under general conditions, and finds a solution that is a version of the stable set.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有不可分割商品的交换经济中的稳定配置。众所周知，这个问题具有挑战性，并且足够丰富，可以表达根本性不稳定的经济，例如室友问题。我们的方法源于对具有单位需求和单位禀赋的交换经济（即住房模型）的原始研究的推广。我们的第一种方法使用Scarf定理，并提出了充分条件，在这些条件下，“凸化然后取整”技术确保核非空。结果是，在具有二分偏好的分类经济中存在核配置。我们的第二种方法使用TTC的推广：它在一般条件下有效，并找到稳定集的一个版本作为解。

records.title_en: On the efficiency and fairness of deferred acceptance with single tie-breaking
records.title_cn: 关于单一打破平局的延迟接受机制的效率与公平性
records.abstract_en: As a random allocation rule for indivisible object allocation under weak priorities, deferred acceptance with single tie-breaking (DA-STB) is not ex-post constrained efficient. We first observe that it also fails to satisfy equal-top fairness, which requires that two agents be assigned their common top choice with equal probability if they have equal priority for it. Then, it is shown that DA-STB is ex-post constrained efficient, if and only if it is equal-top fair, if and only if the priority structure satisfies a certain acyclic condition. We further characterize the priority structures under which DA-STB is ex-post stable-and-efficient. Based on the characterized priority domains, and using a weak fairness notion called local envy-freeness, new theoretical support is provided for the use of this rule: for any priority structure, among the class of strategy-proof, ex-post stable, symmetric, and locally envy-free rules, each of the above desiderata—ex-post constrained efficiency, ex-post stability-and-efficiency, and equal-top fairness—can be achieved if and only if it can be achieved by DA-STB.
records.abstract_cn: 作为一种在弱优先级下对不可分割物品分配进行随机分配的规则，单一打破平局的延迟接受机制（DA-STB）并非事后受约束有效的。我们首先观察到，它也无法满足平等顶级公平性，该公平性要求如果两个代理对共同首选物品具有同等优先级，则他们应以相同概率被分配该物品。然后，我们证明了DA-STB是事后受约束有效的，当且仅当它是平等顶级公平的，当且仅当优先级结构满足某种无环条件。我们进一步刻画了DA-STB为事后稳定且有效的优先级结构。基于所刻画的优先级域，并利用一种称为局部无嫉妒的弱公平概念，为该规则的使用提供了新的理论支持：对于任何优先级结构，在策略证明、事后稳定、对称且局部无嫉妒的规则类别中，上述每个期望性质——事后受约束效率、事后稳定且有效以及平等顶级公平性——能够实现当且仅当它能够由DA-STB实现。

records.title_en: Fragile meaning - an experiment
records.title_cn: 脆弱的含义——一项实验
records.abstract_en: Absence of a shared language is an evident barrier to effective communication. Lack of common knowledge of what is shared is more insidious and a potential source of misunderstandings. We induce lack of common knowledge of a shared language in a sender-receiver game experiment by letting the availability of messages with focal meanings be uncertain. We consider an environment in which agents agree on the optimal action in every state of the world, there are equilibria in which messages with focal meanings are used in accordance with those meanings, and these equilibria maximize both sender and receiver payoffs. We do find, however, that these equilibria are fragile: Observed behavior aligns better with pooling equilibria, in which receivers ignore messages. This effect is more pronounced when the pooling action is optimal for a larger set of receiver beliefs.
records.abstract_cn: 缺乏共同语言是有效沟通的明显障碍。对共享内容缺乏共同知识则更为隐蔽，并可能成为误解的根源。我们在一个发送者-接收者博弈实验中，通过让具有焦点含义的消息的可用性变得不确定，来诱导对共享语言缺乏共同知识。我们考虑了一个环境，其中代理在世界每个状态下都同意最优行动，存在均衡，其中具有焦点含义的消息按照这些含义使用，并且这些均衡使发送者和接收者的收益都最大化。然而，我们确实发现这些均衡是脆弱的：观察到的行为更符合汇集均衡，其中接收者忽略消息。当汇集行动对更大范围的接收者信念集为最优时，这种效应更为显著。

records.title_en: Who wants to be an auctioneer?
records.title_cn: 谁想当拍卖人？
records.abstract_en: This paper endogenizes the decision whether to post a mechanism or to participate in another trader's mechanism in a competing mechanisms environment. With a population of heterogeneous buyers and sellers facing standard search frictions, each trader in our market has to decide whether to post a mechanism or to visit a mechanism posted by a trader on the other side of the market. We show that the equilibrium in this market is unique and is constrained efficient. Inefficient traders (low-value buyers and high-cost sellers) choose to visit with probability one, while more efficient traders randomize between posting and visiting. The resulting allocation differs substantially from the equilibrium allocation in the market where only one side can post mechanisms, especially when trader heterogeneity is significant. This suggests that decentralized marketplaces should allow participating buyers and sellers to self-select into making or receiving offers. We also provide conditions under which posting decisions are monotone, so that more efficient types post with higher probabilities than less efficient types.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在竞争性机制环境中，将决定是发布机制还是参与另一方交易者机制的决策内生化。在一个面临标准搜索摩擦的异质性买卖双方群体中，我们市场中的每个交易者都必须决定是发布机制还是访问市场另一方交易者发布的机制。我们证明该市场的均衡是唯一的，并且是约束有效的。低效率交易者（低价值买家和低成本卖家）选择以概率一访问，而更高效的交易者在发布和访问之间随机化。由此产生的配置与只有一方可以发布机制的市场中的均衡配置有显著差异，尤其是在交易者异质性显著时。这表明去中心化的市场应允许参与的买卖双方自我选择是发出还是接收报价。我们还提供了发布决策是单调的条件，即更高效的类型以比低效类型更高的概率发布。

records.title_en: Ambiguity, information processing, and financial intermediation
records.title_cn: 模糊性、信息处理与金融中介
records.abstract_en: This paper incorporates ambiguity and information processing constraints into the He and Krishnamurthy (2012) model of intermediary asset pricing. Financial intermediaries possess greater information processing capacity than households. In response, households optimally choose to delegate their investment decisions. The contractual relationship between households and intermediaries is subject to a moral hazard friction, which results in a financial constraint. We show that ambiguity aversion not only amplifies households' incentives to delegate but also tightens the financial constraint. The calibrated model can quantitatively explain both the unconditional and time-varying moments of observed asset prices while endogenously generating an empirically consistent crisis frequency.
records.abstract_cn: 本文将模糊性和信息处理约束纳入He和Krishnamurthy（2012）的中介资产定价模型。金融中介机构比家庭拥有更强的信息处理能力。对此，家庭最优地选择委托其投资决策。家庭与中介机构之间的契约关系受到道德风险摩擦的影响，这导致了金融约束。我们表明，模糊厌恶不仅放大家庭的委托激励，而且收紧金融约束。校准后的模型能够定量解释观察到的资产价格的无条件矩和时变矩，同时内生地产生与经验一致的危机频率。

records.title_en: Redistributive fiscal policy and marginal propensities to consume
records.title_cn: 再分配财政政策与边际消费倾向
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the output effect of transfers in a New Keynesian model with heterogeneous dynasties of overlapping generations, which allows for arbitrary heterogeneity in marginal propensities to consume (MPCs). The role of MPCs is mainly to determine the timing of the fiscal stimulus. Thus, it is not MPCs per se that determine the cumulative effect on output, but rather the interaction between the timing of the stimulus and other features of the model, such as financial frictions and an endogenous monetary policy response. Financially-constrained households always prefer a front-loaded stimulus, while the endogenous monetary policy can generate an ambiguous relation between MPCs and output. From a normative perspective, however, there is no ambiguity: with larger differences in MPCs, macro stabilization can be obtained at a smaller welfare cost.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个具有异质性代际重叠王朝的新凯恩斯模型中研究转移支付的产出效应，该模型允许边际消费倾向（MPCs）存在任意异质性。MPCs的作用主要在于决定财政刺激的时机。因此，决定产出累积效应的并非MPCs本身，而是刺激时机与模型其他特征（如金融摩擦和内生的货币政策反应）之间的相互作用。受金融约束的家庭总是偏好前置刺激，而内生的货币政策可能产生MPCs与产出之间的模糊关系。然而，从规范角度来看，并不存在模糊性：随着MPCs差异的增大，可以在更小的福利成本下实现宏观稳定。

records.title_en: Strategic limitation of market accessibility: Search platform design and welfare
records.title_cn: 市场可达性的策略性限制：搜索平台设计与福利
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the relationship between market accessibility and various participants' welfare in an intermediated directed-search market. For a general class of meeting technologies, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition under which efficiency requires imperfect accessibility, such that each seller's listing is only observed by some but not all buyers. We show that the platform optimally implements the efficient outcome, but fully extracts surplus from the transactions it intermediates. We also find that in general, buyers prefer to minimize market accessibility, while sellers prefer a weakly greater accessibility level than that which is socially efficient. The efficiency of imperfect accessibility is robust to the introduction of a second chance for unmatched buyers to search.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了在中间商主导的定向搜索市场中，市场可达性与各类参与者福利之间的关系。对于一类一般的匹配技术，我们提供了效率要求不完全可达性的充分必要条件，即每个卖家的列表仅被部分而非全部买家观察到。我们表明，平台最优地实现了有效结果，但完全提取了其中介交易的剩余。我们还发现，一般而言，买家倾向于最小化市场可达性，而卖家则倾向于比社会有效水平稍高的可达性水平。不完全可达性的效率对于引入未匹配买家的第二次搜索机会是稳健的。

records.title_en: A model of approval with an application to list design
records.title_cn: 带有列表设计应用的批准模型
records.abstract_en: Online technologies enable a host of observable acts, such as wishlisting, that do not quite amount to choice meant as a final selection. Rather, they express interest and a positive attitude towards an item. We gather this type of behaviour under the term approval. With items presented as a list, we propose a model of approval. We completely characterise the model in terms of simple properties of observed approval data. We introduce and study the problem of list design. This captures situations where an interested party can manipulate the approver's behaviour by choosing the list with the aim of maximising an objective.
records.abstract_cn: 在线技术使得许多可观察的行为成为可能，例如愿望清单，这些行为并不完全等同于作为最终选择的选择。相反，它们表达了对某个项目的兴趣和积极态度。我们将这类行为归纳为“批准”一词。在项目以列表形式呈现的情况下，我们提出了一个批准模型。我们根据观察到的批准数据的简单属性完全刻画了该模型。我们引入并研究了列表设计问题。这涵盖了感兴趣的一方可以通过选择列表来操纵批准者行为以最大化目标的情况。

records.title_en: Rank-preserving multidimensional mechanisms: An equivalence between identical-object and heterogeneous-object models
records.title_cn: 保序多维机制：同质物品模型与异质物品模型的等价性
records.abstract_en: We show that the mechanism-design problem for a monopolist selling multiple, heterogeneous objects to a buyer with ex ante symmetric and additive values is equivalent to the mechanism-design problem for a monopolist selling identical objects to a buyer with decreasing marginal values. We derive three new results for the identical-objects model: (i) a new condition for revenue monotonicity of stochastic mechanisms, (ii) a sufficient condition on priors, such that prices in optimal deterministic mechanism are not increasing, and (iii) a simplification of incentive constraints for deterministic mechanisms. We use the equivalence to establish corresponding results in the heterogeneous-objects model.
records.abstract_cn: 我们证明，垄断者向具有事前对称且可加价值的买家出售多个异质物品的机制设计问题，等价于垄断者向具有递减边际价值的买家出售同质物品的机制设计问题。我们为同质物品模型推导出三个新结果：（i）随机机制收入单调性的一个新条件，（ii）关于先验的一个充分条件，使得最优确定性机制中的价格不递增，以及（iii）确定性机制激励约束的简化。我们利用这种等价性在异质物品模型中建立相应的结果。

records.title_en: The network origins of the gains from trade
records.title_cn: 贸易收益的网络起源
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a network perspective on the gains from trade in today's international supply chains. In particular, we demonstrate that the comparative statics predictions of a standard general-equilibrium trade model with input-output linkages can be expressed as a network diffusion model. This model captures the relevant dimensions of the production network's structure by just two easily quantifiable statistics: A country's upstream exposure to supply shocks further up in the network and its downstream exposure to demand shocks further down. We then show how up- and downstream exposure crucially determine the welfare effects from various types of trade cost shocks. In some cases, they even capture the entire welfare effect.
records.abstract_cn: 本文从网络视角探讨当今国际供应链中的贸易收益。具体而言，我们证明了一个具有投入产出联系的标准一般均衡贸易模型的比较静态预测可以表示为网络扩散模型。该模型仅通过两个易于量化的统计量来捕捉生产网络结构的相关维度：一国对网络中更上游供应冲击的上游暴露度，以及其对更下游需求冲击的下游暴露度。然后，我们展示了上游和下游暴露度如何关键地决定各类贸易成本冲击的福利效应。在某些情况下，它们甚至能完全捕捉整个福利效应。

records.title_en: Communication on networks and strong reliability
records.title_cn: 网络上的沟通与强可靠性
records.abstract_en: We consider sender–receiver games, where the sender and the receiver are two distant nodes in a communication network. We show that if the network has two disjoint paths of communication between the sender and the receiver, then we can replicate all equilibrium outcomes not only of the direct communication game (i.e., when the sender and the receiver communicate directly with each other) but also of the mediated game (i.e., when the sender and the receiver communicate with the help of a mediator).
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑发送者-接收者博弈，其中发送者和接收者是通信网络中两个相距较远的节点。我们证明，如果网络中发送者和接收者之间存在两条不相交的通信路径，那么我们不仅可以复制直接沟通博弈（即发送者和接收者直接相互沟通时）的所有均衡结果，还可以复制中介博弈（即发送者和接收者借助中介进行沟通时）的所有均衡结果。

records.title_en: The formation of social groups under status concern
records.title_cn: 地位关注下的社会群体形成
records.abstract_en: I study the interaction of two forces in the formation of social groups: the preference for high quality peers and the desire for status among one's peers. I examine their equilibrium effects under different market structures and find that status concern reduces the potential for and benefit of sorting - both for a social planner and a monopolist - but the interaction between preference for quality and status can make the exclusion of some agents a second-best outcome. Even in settings with complementarities, price discrimination and screening can be necessary to facilitate sorting and increase welfare. Nevertheless, positional concerns can be beneficial for welfare if they provide sufficient incentive to engage more with one's group and thus increase positive spillovers. In those cases, welfare is higher if individuals have at least some degree of status concern, even if the welfare measure ignores such relative comparisons.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了社会群体形成中两种力量的相互作用：对高质量同伴的偏好和对同伴中地位的渴望。我考察了它们在不同市场结构下的均衡效应，发现地位关注降低了分类的潜力和收益——无论对社会计划者还是垄断者而言——但质量偏好与地位之间的相互作用可能使排除某些代理人成为次优结果。即使在存在互补性的环境中，价格歧视和筛选也可能是促进分类和提高福利所必需的。然而，如果地位关注提供了足够的激励，使个体更多地参与其群体并从而增加正向溢出，那么地位关注可能对福利有益。在这些情况下，即使福利衡量忽略了这种相对比较，如果个体至少有一定程度的地位关注，福利也会更高。

records.title_en: Monotone equilibrium in matching markets with signaling
records.title_cn: 带信号传递的匹配市场中的单调均衡
records.abstract_en: We introduce a notion of competitive signaling equilibrium (CSE) in one-to-one matching markets with a continuum of heterogeneous senders and receivers. We then study monotone CSE where equilibrium outcomes - sender actions, receiver reactions, beliefs, and matching - are all monotone in the stronger set order. We show that if the sender utility is monotone-supermodular and the receiver's utility is weakly monotone-supermodular, a CSE is stronger monotone if and only if it passes Criterion D1 (Cho and Kreps (1987), Banks and Sobel (1987)). Given any interval of feasible reactions that receivers can take, we fully characterize a unique stronger monotone CSE and establishes its existence with quasilinear utility functions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在具有连续异质性发送者和接收者的一对一匹配市场中引入了竞争性信号传递均衡（CSE）的概念。然后我们研究单调CSE，其中均衡结果——发送者行动、接收者反应、信念和匹配——都在更强的集合序下是单调的。我们证明，如果发送者效用是单调超模的，且接收者效用是弱单调超模的，那么一个CSE是更强单调的当且仅当它通过准则D1（Cho和Kreps（1987），Banks和Sobel（1987））。给定接收者可以采取的任何可行反应区间，我们完全刻画了一个唯一的更强单调CSE，并在拟线性效用函数下确立了其存在性。

records.title_en: Economic distributions, primitive distributions, and demand recovery in monopolistic competition
records.title_cn: 垄断竞争中的经济分布、原始分布与需求恢复
records.abstract_en: We link fundamental technological and taste distributions to endogenous economic distributions of prices and firm size (output, profit) generated under monopolistic competition with heterogeneous productivities as per recent Trade and Industrial Organization models. We derive full equivalence properties for monopoly mark-ups, demand shape, marginal revenue, and profits to match distributions of cost, price, output, and profit under monopolistic competition. Demand and one distribution determine the rest. We provide constructive proofs to recover demand and all distributions from just two (e.g., price and cost distributions uncover demand form), and derive restrictions on distribution pairs. Finally, we extend to analyze mark-up distributions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将基本的技术与品味分布与垄断竞争下由异质性生产率产生的价格和企业规模（产出、利润）的内生经济分布联系起来，正如近期贸易和产业组织模型所述。我们推导出垄断加价、需求形状、边际收入和利润的完全等价性质，以匹配垄断竞争下的成本、价格、产出和利润分布。需求和一个分布决定其余部分。我们提供构造性证明，仅从两个分布（例如，价格和成本分布揭示需求形式）恢复需求和所有分布，并推导出分布对的限制。最后，我们扩展分析加价分布。

records.title_en: Never stop or never start? Optimal stopping under a mixture of CPT and EUT preferences
records.title_cn: 永不停止还是永不开始？CPT与EUT混合偏好下的最优停止
records.abstract_en: We consider the problem of finding the best time to stop a diffusion process for an agent with a preference model that is a mixture of expected utility theory (EUT) and cumulative prospect theory (CPT). In view of time-inconsistency, we consider two types of agents: a naive agent, who is not aware of the time-inconsistency and thus re-plans at every instant, and a sophisticated agent, who is aware of the time-inconsistency and takes a so-called intra-personal equilibrium strategy by correctly anticipating her actions in the future. We show that under a wide range of the CPT preference parameter values, the naive agent will never stop. For a sophisticated agent, we use a different notion of intra-personal equilibrium from the one employed by Ebert and Strack (2018). We show that any two-threshold strategy, which is to stop when the diffusion process reaches either an upper threshold or a lower threshold, cannot be an intra-personal equilibrium if the agent overweights worst, unlikely outcomes disproportionally. We derive a sufficient and necessary condition for the strategy of stopping everywhere to be an intra-personal equilibrium and show that this condition does not hold and thus the sophisticated agent may choose to start the diffusion process for some commonly used probability weighting functions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个偏好模型为期望效用理论（EUT）与累积前景理论（CPT）混合的代理人，寻找停止扩散过程的最佳时间问题。鉴于时间不一致性，我们考虑两类代理人：天真代理人，其未意识到时间不一致性，因此在每一时刻重新规划；以及老练代理人，其意识到时间不一致性，并通过正确预期未来行为采取所谓的个人内均衡策略。我们表明，在广泛的CPT偏好参数值范围内，天真代理人将永不停止。对于老练代理人，我们使用了与Ebert和Strack（2018）所采用的不同个人内均衡概念。我们表明，如果代理人过度加权最坏的不太可能结果，那么任何两阈值策略（即当扩散过程达到上阈值或下阈值时停止）都不能成为个人内均衡。我们推导出处处停止策略成为个人内均衡的充分必要条件，并表明该条件不成立，因此对于某些常用的概率权重函数，老练代理人可能选择启动扩散过程。

records.title_en: Unilateral stability in matching problems
records.title_cn: 匹配问题中的单边稳定性
records.abstract_en: The canonical solution concept used in matching problems is pairwise stability, whose premise is that harmony is disrupted by any two agents intentionally leaving their partners to be with each other. We instead focus on scenarios in which harmony is disrupted merely by a single agent unilaterally initiating contact with a member of a different pair, whether or not his approach is reciprocated. A variety of solution concepts are proposed in which taboos, status, or power systematically limit such initiatives in order to achieve harmony.
records.abstract_cn: 匹配问题中使用的经典解概念是两两稳定性，其前提是任何两个代理人故意离开各自的伴侣而彼此结合会破坏和谐。我们转而关注这样一种情景：和谐仅仅因单个代理人单方面主动接触另一对中的某个成员而被破坏，无论其主动是否得到回应。我们提出了多种解概念，在这些概念中，禁忌、地位或权力系统地限制此类主动行为，以实现和谐。

records.title_en: Regret, responsibility, and randomization: A theory of stochastic choice
records.title_cn: 遗憾、责任与随机化：随机选择理论
records.abstract_en: I provide a model of deliberate stochastic choice over acts (state-contingent payoffs). In this model, the decision maker finds randomization desirable since it reduces responsibility and regret after the state uncertainty resolves. I provide an axiomatic characterization of stochastic choices compatible with this model. I also discuss the comparative statics and some behavioral implications of the model and outline potential avenues for extending and generalizing the model.
records.abstract_cn: 我提供了一个关于行为（状态依存的收益）的深思熟虑的随机选择模型。在该模型中，决策者认为随机化是可取的，因为它减少了状态不确定性解决后的责任和遗憾。我提供了与该模型兼容的随机选择的公理化特征描述。我还讨论了该模型的比较静态分析和一些行为含义，并概述了扩展和推广该模型的潜在途径。

records.title_en: Commitment and investment distortions under limited liability
records.title_cn: 有限责任下的承诺与投资扭曲
records.abstract_en: We study how frictions originating from limited liability distort firms' investment and financing choices. By financing new investments with debt, firms can use limited liability to credibly commit to defaulting earlier—allowing both firm owners and new creditors to benefit from diluting existing creditors. In a dynamic setup, this leads to time-inconsistency, increasing the cost of external funds and discouraging investment. We show that the interaction of these two forces leads to heterogeneous investment distortions, where highly-indebted firms overinvest and those with low levels of debt underinvest. Allowing firm owners to pay themselves directly from new debt issuance can mitigate overinvestment but, in the presence of repeated investment opportunities, tends to exacerbate underinvestment among low-leverage firms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了源于有限责任的摩擦如何扭曲企业的投资和融资选择。通过用债务为新投资融资，企业可以利用有限责任可信地承诺更早违约——从而使企业所有者和新债权人受益于稀释现有债权人。在动态设定中，这导致时间不一致性，增加了外部资金的成本并抑制了投资。我们表明，这两种力量的相互作用导致了异质性的投资扭曲，其中高负债企业过度投资，而低负债企业投资不足。允许企业所有者直接从新债务发行中支付自己可以缓解过度投资，但在存在重复投资机会的情况下，往往会加剧低杠杆企业的投资不足。

records.title_en: Expectational equilibria in many-to-one matching models with contracts
records.title_cn: 带合同的多对一匹配模型中的预期均衡
records.abstract_en: We introduce the notion of expectational equilibrium in a general specification of the many-to-one matching with contracts model. The endogenous variables in an expectational equilibrium are expectations about tradable contracts. Expectational equilibrium outcomes are equivalent to stable outcomes. Expectational equilibrium unifies all the other approaches used in the literature so far, in particular Walrasian equilibrium, Drèze equilibrium, and market clearing cutoffs. It also applies to cases where contracts do not involve money as well as cases where there is a smallest monetary unit of account.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在带合同的多对一匹配模型的一般规范中引入了预期均衡的概念。预期均衡中的内生变量是关于可交易合同的预期。预期均衡结果与稳定结果等价。预期均衡统一了迄今为止文献中使用的所有其他方法，特别是瓦尔拉斯均衡、德雷兹均衡和市场出清截止点。它也适用于合同不涉及货币的情况，以及存在最小货币记账单位的情况。

records.title_en: Arbitrage with financial constraints and market power
records.title_cn: 金融约束与市场势力下的套利
records.abstract_en: I study how (VaR-based) financial constraints affect liquidity and welfare under different structures of the arbitrage industry. When capital is dispersed across competitive arbitrageurs, financial constraints may impair their ability to provide liquidity, lowering other investors' welfare. However, when capital is concentrated among arbitrageurs with market power, introducing constraints can make everyone better off and increase liquidity. Further, alternative constraints (fixed margins, position limits) have the same effects as VaR constraints when arbitrageurs are competitive, but not when they have market power. These results lead to new policy implications for margin and capital requirements and yield new empirical predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了（基于VaR的）金融约束在不同套利行业结构下如何影响流动性和福利。当资本分散在竞争性套利者之间时，金融约束可能损害他们提供流动性的能力，降低其他投资者的福利。然而，当资本集中在具有市场势力的套利者手中时，引入约束可以使所有人受益并增加流动性。此外，替代性约束（固定保证金、头寸限制）在套利者竞争时与VaR约束具有相同效果，但当他们具有市场势力时则不然。这些结果对保证金和资本要求产生了新的政策含义，并产生了新的实证预测。

records.title_en: There is no known nonlinear Markov perfect equilibrium strategies for the infinite horizon linear quadratic differential game
records.title_cn: 无限时域线性二次微分博弈不存在已知的非线性马尔可夫完美均衡策略
records.abstract_en: We discuss published accounts of nonlinear equilibrium strategies in linear quadratic differential games. The main reference: Tsutsui-Mino 1990, is shown to be misleading.
records.abstract_cn: 我们讨论了线性二次微分博弈中非线性均衡策略的已发表论述。主要参考文献：Tsutsui-Mino 1990，被证明具有误导性。

records.title_en: CCP auction design
records.title_cn: 中央对手方拍卖设计
records.abstract_en: Central counterparties (CCPs) are systemically important. When a clearing member defaults, the CCP sells the defaulted portfolio to surviving members in an auction, and losses, if any, are partly absorbed by a cash pool prefunded by the surviving members. We propose a tractable auction model that incorporates this salient feature. We find that “juniorization” – the CCP first uses prefunded cash of members who submit bad bids – increases the auction price. However, too aggressive juniorization can reduce members' total profit, presenting a misalignment between the CCP's objective and that of the members. A wider customer participation can increase both the auction price and the total profit of members and customers.
records.abstract_cn: 中央对手方（CCP）具有系统重要性。当清算会员违约时，CCP通过拍卖将违约组合出售给幸存会员，损失（如有）部分由幸存会员预先注资的现金池吸收。我们提出了一个包含这一显著特征的可处理拍卖模型。我们发现，“次级化”——即CCP首先使用提交劣质报价的会员的预注资现金——会提高拍卖价格。然而，过于激进的次级化可能降低会员的总利润，导致CCP目标与会员目标之间的错位。更广泛的客户参与可以提高拍卖价格以及会员和客户的总利润。

records.title_en: Monetary policy and sentiment-driven fluctuations
records.title_cn: 货币政策与情绪驱动的波动
records.abstract_en: Sentiments, or beliefs about aggregate demand, can be self-fulfilling in models departing slightly from the complete information benchmark in the New Keynesian framework. Through its effect on aggregate variables, the policy stance determines the degree of complementarity in firms' production (pricing) decisions and consequently, the precision of endogenous signals that firms receive. As a result, aggregate fluctuations can be driven by both fundamental and non-fundamental shocks. The distribution of non-fundamental shocks is endogenous to policy, introducing a novel tradeoff between stabilizing output and inflation. Both strong inflation targeting and nominal flexibilities increase the variance of non-fundamental shocks, which are shown to be suboptimal. Moreover, the Taylor principle is no longer sufficient to rule out indeterminacy. Instead, an interest rate rule that places sufficiently low weight on inflation eliminates non-fundamental volatility and thereby the output-inflation tradeoff.
records.abstract_cn: 情绪，或关于总需求的信念，在偏离新凯恩斯框架中完全信息基准的模型中可以是自我实现的。通过其对总变量的影响，政策立场决定了企业生产（定价）决策中互补性的程度，从而决定了企业收到的内生信号的精确度。因此，总波动可以由基本面和非基本面冲击共同驱动。非基本面冲击的分布对政策是内生的，引入了稳定产出和通胀之间的新权衡。强通胀目标制和名义灵活性都增加了非基本面冲击的方差，这被证明是次优的。此外，泰勒原理不再足以排除不确定性。相反，一个对通胀赋予足够低权重的利率规则消除了非基本面波动，从而消除了产出-通胀权衡。

records.title_en: On existence of Berk-Nash equilibria in misspecified Markov decision processes with infinite spaces
records.title_cn: 无限空间误设定马尔可夫决策过程中Berk-Nash均衡的存在性
records.abstract_en: Model misspecification is a critical issue in many areas of economics. In the context of misspecified Markov Decision Processes, Esponda and Pouzo (2021) defined the notion of Berk-Nash equilibrium and established its existence with finite state and action spaces. However, many substantive applications (including two of the three motivating examples presented by Esponda and Pouzo) involve continuous state or action spaces, and are thus not covered by the Esponda-Pouzo existence theorem. We extend the existence of Berk-Nash equilibrium to compact action spaces and sigma-compact state spaces, with possibly unbounded utility functions. A complication arises because Berk-Nash equilibrium depends critically on Radon-Nikodym derivatives, which are bounded in the finite case but typically unbounded in misspecified continuous models. The proofs rely on nonstandard analysis, and draw on novel argumentation traceable to work of the second author on nonstandard representations of Markov processes.
records.abstract_cn: 模型误设定是经济学许多领域中的一个关键问题。在误设定的马尔可夫决策过程背景下，Esponda和Pouzo（2021）定义了Berk-Nash均衡的概念，并在有限状态和行动空间下确立了其存在性。然而，许多实质性应用（包括Esponda和Pouzo提出的三个激励示例中的两个）涉及连续状态或行动空间，因此未被Esponda-Pouzo存在性定理所涵盖。我们将Berk-Nash均衡的存在性扩展到紧致行动空间和西格玛紧致状态空间，且效用函数可能无界。一个复杂问题出现了，因为Berk-Nash均衡关键依赖于Radon-Nikodym导数，在有限情形下这些导数有界，但在误设定的连续模型中通常无界。证明依赖于非标准分析，并借鉴了第二作者关于马尔可夫过程非标准表示的工作中可追溯的新颖论证。

records.title_en: Growing attention
records.title_cn: 增长的关注
records.abstract_en: We model a boundedly rational agent who exhibits limited and heterogeneous attention. The agents' attention can be naturally sorted in an ascending order. We provide a characterization result using two simple behavioral postulates. Unlike earlier models, consideration sets' composition and frequency are uniquely identified. Within our framework, we accommodate unobserved heterogeneity in attention and unobserved preferences. Furthermore, we explore various extensions of our model and provide insights into the comparative statics of attentiveness levels in two probabilistic choices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个有限理性主体的模型，该主体表现出有限且异质的关注。主体的关注可以自然地按升序排列。我们利用两个简单的行为公设提供了特征化结果。与早期模型不同，考虑集合的构成和频率被唯一识别。在我们的框架内，我们容纳了关注中的未观测异质性和未观测偏好。此外，我们探讨了模型的各种扩展，并提供了关于两种概率选择中关注度水平比较静态分析的见解。

records.title_en: Benefiting from bias: Delegating to encourage information acquisition
records.title_cn: 从偏见中获益：通过委托鼓励信息获取
records.abstract_en: A principal delegates decisions to a biased agent. Payoffs depend on a state that the principal cannot observe. Initially, the agent does not observe the state, but he can acquire information about it at a cost. We characterize the principal's optimal delegation set. This set features a cap on high decisions and a gap around the agent's ex ante favorite decision. The set may even induce ex-post Pareto-dominated decisions. Under certain conditions on the cost of information acquisition, we show that the principal prefers delegating to an agent with a small bias than to an unbiased agent.
records.abstract_cn: 委托人将决策委托给有偏见的代理人。收益取决于委托人无法观察到的状态。最初，代理人无法观察到该状态，但他可以花费成本获取相关信息。我们刻画了委托人的最优委托集。该集合以高决策的上限和围绕代理人事前偏好决策的缺口为特征。该集合甚至可能诱导事后帕累托占优的决策。在信息获取成本的某些条件下，我们表明委托人更倾向于委托给有小偏见的代理人，而不是无偏见的代理人。

records.title_en: Indivisible goods, equilibrium and convex economies
records.title_cn: 不可分割商品、均衡与凸经济
records.abstract_en: We study the existence of competitive equilibria in economies with indivisible goods. The first result provides a novel sufficient condition for an economy with indivisible goods to have competitive equilibrium. This condition states that the cooperative game associated with the economy has a non-empty core. Crucially, this sufficient condition is also necessary when the economy is convex. This characterization implies that every two-agent convex economy has at least one competitive equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有不可分割商品的经济体中竞争均衡的存在性。第一个结果提供了不可分割商品经济体存在竞争均衡的一个新的充分条件。该条件表明，与该经济体相关联的合作博弈具有非空核。关键在于，当经济体是凸的时，这一充分条件也是必要的。这一特征刻画意味着，每个双代理人的凸经济体至少存在一个竞争均衡。

records.title_en: Foundations of market power in monetary economies
records.title_cn: 货币经济中市场势力的基础
records.abstract_en: We study the foundations of firms' market power in a continuous-time model where agents are price-makers who interact explicitly with each other. Market power arises from the existence of rents, the size of which depends on consumers' outside options, and firms' ability to appropriate these rents through rent seeking. We study how measures of market power (e.g., markups, concentration) are affected by search frictions, monetary policy, and self-fulfilling beliefs. An increase in the nominal interest rate affects market power by changing consumers' payment capacity and the value of their outside options, and by altering firms' rent-seeking behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个连续时间模型中企业市场势力的基础，在该模型中，代理人作为价格制定者相互明确互动。市场势力源于租金的存在，其大小取决于消费者的外部选择，以及企业通过寻租行为获取这些租金的能力。我们研究了市场势力的衡量指标（如加成率、集中度）如何受到搜索摩擦、货币政策和自我实现信念的影响。名义利率的上升通过改变消费者的支付能力及其外部选择的价值，以及改变企业的寻租行为来影响市场势力。

records.title_en: Does reducing communication barriers promote diversity?
records.title_cn: 降低沟通障碍是否促进多样性？
records.abstract_en: We study how a reduction in communication cost affects equilibrium diversity (in expertise) in hiring decisions. The key trade-off is that, while hiring a more diverse team may enlarge the team's pool of knowledge, it also makes communication between the hired experts more challenging. Equilibrium diversity balances this trade-off. We find that equilibrium diversity may exhibit a U-shape relationship with communication cost, reaching its lowest point at moderate cost values, where experts' incentives to communicate are most sensitive to changes in diversity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究沟通成本的降低如何影响招聘决策中的均衡多样性（在专业知识方面）。关键的权衡在于，虽然招聘更多样化的团队可能扩大团队的知识库，但也使得被聘专家之间的沟通更具挑战性。均衡多样性平衡了这一权衡。我们发现，均衡多样性与沟通成本之间可能呈现U型关系，在中等成本值处达到最低点，此时专家们的沟通激励对多样性变化最为敏感。

records.title_en: Cross-verification and persuasive cheap talk
records.title_cn: 交叉验证与有说服力的廉价交谈
records.abstract_en: We study a cheap-talk game where two experts offer advice to a decision-maker whose actions affect the welfare of all. The experts cannot commit to reporting strategies. Yet, we show that the decision-maker's ability to cross-verify the experts' advice acts as a commitment device for the experts. We prove the existence of an equilibrium, where an expert's equilibrium payoff is equal to what he would obtain if he could commit to truthfully revealing his information.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个廉价交谈博弈，其中两位专家向决策者提供建议，决策者的行动影响所有人的福利。专家们无法承诺报告策略。然而，我们表明，决策者交叉验证专家建议的能力充当了专家们的承诺机制。我们证明了均衡的存在性，在该均衡中，专家的均衡收益等于如果他能够承诺真实揭示其信息时所获得的收益。

records.title_en: Competition in schedules with cursed traders
records.title_cn: 受诅咒交易者下的计划竞争
records.abstract_en: We study a market with sellers that compete in supply functions, face an elastic demand, and have imperfect cost information. In our model, sellers neglect some informational content of the price. In order to capture this feature, we use the cursed expectations equilibrium concept. In the linear-quadratic-normal framework, this paper presents conditions under which the unique equilibrium in linear supply functions exists and derives some comparative statics results. Compared to markets with fully rational sellers, we find that market power and the expected price-cost margin are lower; the price reaction to private information can be higher due to imperfect competition and demand elasticity; expected profits can be greater; and expected total surplus can also increase if the efficiency gains from reduced market power outweigh the losses from cursedness.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个市场，其中卖方在供给函数上竞争，面临弹性需求，并拥有不完美的成本信息。在我们的模型中，卖方忽视了价格的某些信息内容。为了捕捉这一特征，我们使用了受诅咒期望均衡概念。在线性二次正态框架下，本文提出了线性供给函数中唯一均衡存在的条件，并得出了一些比较静态结果。与完全理性卖方的市场相比，我们发现市场势力和预期价格-成本边际较低；由于不完全竞争和需求弹性，价格对私人信息的反应可能更高；预期利润可能更大；如果市场势力减少带来的效率收益超过受诅咒性造成的损失，预期总剩余也可能增加。

records.title_en: Informativeness orders over ambiguous experiments
records.title_cn: 模糊实验上的信息量排序
records.abstract_en: We generalize Blackwell's informativeness order to ambiguous experiments. A decision maker might view a statistical experiment as ambiguous if she faces uncertainty about the data generating process for its signals. Formally, an ambiguous experiment is modeled as a mapping from an auxiliary state space to the set of unambiguous experiments. Each auxiliary state corresponds to a possible data generating process. We show that one ambiguous experiment is preferred to another by every decision maker in every decision problem if and only if they are related by a condition called prior-by-prior dominance, which states that for any first-order belief the decision maker entertains on the auxiliary state space, the expected experiment resulting from this belief for the first experiment is Blackwell more informative than that of the second. This equivalence is robust for any class of monotone ambiguity preferences that nests expected utility. We obtain another informativeness order when we restrict attention to decision makers who apply the maxmin criterion to evaluate ambiguous experiments and connect this informativeness order to comparisons of sets of Blackwell experiments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将布莱克韦尔的信息量排序推广到模糊实验。如果决策者对其信号的数据生成过程存在不确定性，她可能会将统计实验视为模糊的。形式上，模糊实验被建模为从辅助状态空间到非模糊实验集合的映射。每个辅助状态对应一个可能的数据生成过程。我们证明，当且仅当两个模糊实验通过一个称为逐先验支配的条件相关联时，每个决策者在每个决策问题中都会偏好其中一个而非另一个。该条件指出，对于决策者在辅助状态空间上持有的任何一阶信念，由该信念对第一个实验产生的期望实验在布莱克韦尔意义上比第二个实验的期望实验更具信息量。这种等价性对于任何包含期望效用的单调模糊偏好类别都是稳健的。当我们限制关注使用最大最小准则评估模糊实验的决策者时，我们获得了另一种信息量排序，并将这种信息量排序与布莱克韦尔实验集合的比较联系起来。

records.title_en: Understanding uncertainty shocks and the role of black swans
records.title_cn: 理解不确定性冲击与黑天鹅的作用
records.abstract_en: Uncertainty shocks can trigger business cycles, bank runs and asset price fluctuations. But how do those shocks translate into changes in beliefs and actions? What makes people suddenly become uncertain? This paper provides an explanation for subjective uncertainty shocks, estimated on real-time GDP data, that fits puzzling features of professional forecasts. The key ingredients are that agents do not know the true model governing the distribution of macroeconomic outcomes, but they believe that distribution to be potentially skewed. When agents estimate higher probabilities of extreme tail events, their uncertainty rises. Our estimates reveal that learning about probabilities of tail events – black swans – explains much of the fluctuations in subjective uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 不确定性冲击可能引发商业周期、银行挤兑和资产价格波动。但这些冲击如何转化为信念和行动的变化？是什么让人们突然变得不确定？本文基于实时GDP数据估计的主观不确定性冲击提供了一种解释，该解释符合专业预测的令人困惑的特征。关键要素在于，经济主体不知道支配宏观经济结果分布的真实模型，但他们相信该分布可能是偏斜的。当经济主体估计极端尾部事件的概率更高时，他们的不确定性上升。我们的估计表明，对尾部事件（即黑天鹅）概率的学习解释了主观不确定性波动的很大一部分。

records.title_en: A perfectly robust approach to multiperiod matching problems
records.title_cn: 多期匹配问题的稳健方法
records.abstract_en: Many two-sided matching markets involve multiperiod interaction. Traditional cooperative solutions, such as pairwise stability or the core, often identify unintuitive outcomes (or are empty) when applied to such markets. As an alternative, this study proposes the criterion of perfect α-stability. An outcome is perfect α-stable if no coalition prefers an alternative assignment in any period that is superior for all plausible market continuations. The solution posits that agents have foresight, but cautiously evaluate possible future outcomes. A perfect α-stable matching exists, even when assignments are inter-temporal complements. The perfect α-core, a stronger solution, is nonempty under standard regularity conditions, such as history independence. Our analysis extends to markets with arrivals and departures, transfers, and many-to-one assignments.
records.abstract_cn: 许多双边匹配市场涉及多期互动。传统的合作解，如两两稳定或核，在应用于此类市场时往往识别出非直观的结果（或为空集）。作为替代，本研究提出了完美α稳定性的标准。如果一个结果在任何时期都不存在联盟偏好于一个替代分配，且该替代分配对所有可能的市场延续都是优越的，则该结果是完美α稳定的。该解假设代理人具有前瞻性，但谨慎评估可能的未来结果。即使分配是跨期互补的，完美α稳定匹配也存在。完美α核，一个更强的解，在标准正则条件下（如历史独立性）是非空的。我们的分析扩展到具有到达和离开、转移以及多对一分配的市场。

records.title_en: Persuading large investors
records.title_cn: 说服大型投资者
records.abstract_en: A regulator who designs a public stress test to avert default of a distressed bank via private investment must account for large investors' private information on the bank's state. We provide conditions for crowding-in (crowding-out) so that the regulator offers an endogenous more (less) informative signal to better-informed investors. We show that crowding-in occurs as long as investors remain responsive to public news and they are sufficiently well informed: the regulator's test perfectly reveals the state as investors' become privately perfectly informed. Investors' value from more precise private signals may come from their effect on the public test's precision.
records.abstract_cn: 设计公开压力测试以通过私人投资避免陷入困境银行违约的监管者，必须考虑大型投资者对银行状况的私人信息。我们提供了挤入（挤出）的条件，使得监管者向信息更充分的投资者提供内生性更强（更弱）信息的信号。我们表明，只要投资者对公共新闻保持响应且信息足够充分，挤入就会发生：随着投资者私人信息变得完全充分，监管者的测试完全揭示状态。投资者从更精确的私人信号中获得的价值可能源于其对公共测试精确度的影响。

records.title_en: Delegated recruitment and statistical discrimination
records.title_cn: 委托招聘与统计歧视
records.abstract_en: We study how delegated recruitment shapes talent selection. Firms often pay recruiters via refund contracts, which specify a payment upon the hire of a suggested candidate and a refund if a candidate is hired but terminated during an initial period of employment. We develop a model of delegated recruitment and show that refund contracts with strong screening incentives lead to statistical discrimination in favor of candidates with more precise productivity information. This contrasts with a first-best direct-hiring benchmark, where the firm has option value from uncertain candidates. Under tractable parametric assumptions, we provide a closed-form expression for the unique equilibrium contract and show that it features strong screening incentives. As a result, candidates with lower expected productivity but more informative signals (“safe bets”) are hired over candidates with higher expected productivity but less informative signals (“diamonds in the rough”).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究委托招聘如何影响人才选拔。企业通常通过退款合同向招聘人员支付报酬，该合同规定在推荐候选人被录用时支付一笔费用，如果候选人在初始雇佣期内被解雇，则退还该费用。我们建立了一个委托招聘模型，并表明具有强筛选激励的退款合同会导致有利于拥有更精确生产率信息候选人的统计歧视。这与直接招聘的一阶最优基准形成对比，在该基准中，企业对不确定候选人具有期权价值。在可处理的参数假设下，我们提供了唯一均衡合同的闭式表达式，并表明其具有强筛选激励。因此，预期生产率较低但信息信号更具信息量的候选人（“稳妥之选”）会被录用，而预期生产率较高但信息信号信息量较少的候选人（“璞玉”）则不会被录用。

records.title_en: Skilled Immigrants, Firms, and the Global Geography of Innovation
records.title_cn: 技能移民、企业与创新的全球地理
records.abstract_en: This article begins with an overview of the policy environment in the United States and abroad for skilled immigration, with a particular focus on “supply-driven” versus “demand-driven” systems. The overview emphasizes that firms play a central role in the skilled immigration process in most countries. I then survey the ample evidence that skilled immigrants have a strong positive effect on firm outcomes, followed by a discussion of the many margins of adjustment that firms have when their access to skilled immigrants is affected by national immigration policy. Finally, given such margins of adjustment and the importance of skilled immigrants to firms, I consider how the policies that affect skilled migration shape the global geography and quality of innovation. I conclude by discussing policy implications and open questions. In particular, I emphasize that evaluations of the impact of skilled immigration should not be constrained within borders: immigration flows and national immigration policies affect the global geography of innovation and investment.
records.abstract_cn: 本文首先概述了美国及海外技能移民的政策环境，特别关注“供给驱动”与“需求驱动”体系。概述强调，在大多数国家，企业在技能移民过程中扮演核心角色。随后，我综述了丰富的证据表明技能移民对企业绩效有强烈的正向影响，接着讨论了当国家移民政策影响企业获取技能移民时，企业可调整的众多边际。最后，鉴于这些调整边际以及技能移民对企业的重要性，我考虑了影响技能迁移的政策如何塑造创新的全球地理和质量。我通过讨论政策启示和开放性问题作结。特别地，我强调对技能移民影响的评估不应受国界限制：移民流动和国家移民政策影响创新和投资的全球地理。

records.title_en: Migration and Innovation: Learning from Patent and Inventor Data
records.title_cn: 移民与创新：从专利和发明人数据中学习
records.abstract_en: Research on international migration and innovation relies heavily on inventor and patent data, with “migrant inventors” attracting a great deal of attention, especially for what concerns their role in easing the international transfer of knowledge. This hides the fact that many of them move to their host country before starting their inventive career or even before completing their education. We discuss the conceptual and practical difficulties that stand in the way of investigating other likely channels of influence of inventor’s migration on innovation, namely the easing of skill shortages and the increase of variety in inventive teams, firms, and location.
records.abstract_cn: 关于国际移民与创新的研究在很大程度上依赖于发明人和专利数据，其中“移民发明人”引起了广泛关注，尤其是他们在促进国际知识转移方面的作用。这掩盖了一个事实，即他们中的许多人在开始其发明生涯甚至完成教育之前就已移居东道国。我们讨论了在调查发明人移民对创新影响的其他可能渠道（即缓解技能短缺以及增加发明团队、企业和地点的多样性）方面存在的概念和实践困难。

records.title_en: Tax Equity in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
records.title_cn: 中低收入国家的税收公平
records.abstract_en: Income inequality is high and persistent in developing countries. In this paper, we ask what role taxation can or might play in reducing inequality in low and middle-income countries. Drawing on the recent literature, three findings emerge. Due to both structural factors and limited enforcement capacity, the effective distributional impacts of taxes often deviate from their ‘statutory’ objectives, in ways that are hard to predict based on evidence from high-income countries. Moreover, administrative reforms which are meant to be distributionally neutral end up having significant equity impacts because of the practical realities of implementation. Finally, the global challenges which tax authorities face to tax the very top of the income distribution appear to be even more pronounced in developing countries. We conclude by offering thoughts on future research and emphasize the need to carefully study equity characteristics of taxes at each stage of a country’s development path.
records.abstract_cn: 收入不平等在发展中国家既严重又持续存在。在本文中，我们探讨税收在减少中低收入国家不平等中可能或能够发挥的作用。基于近期文献，我们得出三个发现。由于结构性因素和有限的执法能力，税收的实际分配效应往往偏离其“法定”目标，且这种偏离方式难以根据高收入国家的证据进行预测。此外，旨在分配中立的行政改革，由于实施中的现实情况，最终会产生显著的公平影响。最后，税务机关在对收入分配顶端征税时面临的全球性挑战，在发展中国家似乎更为突出。我们最后提出对未来研究的思考，并强调需要仔细研究各国发展路径各阶段税收的公平特征。

records.title_en: How Can Lower-Income Countries Collect More Taxes? The Role of Technology, Tax Agents, and Politics
records.title_cn: 低收入国家如何增加税收？技术、税务代理和政治的作用
records.abstract_en: Increasing tax revenues is a major policy goal in many low- and lower-middle-income countries. While economic growth is an important determinant of taxation, available evidence indicates that it does not automatically increase taxation. Rather, countries must make targeted investments in their tax capacity. In this paper, we examine the rapidly growing body of evidence on different interventions to improve tax capacity and increase tax revenues in lower income countries, with a focus on two key inputs: information technology and tax officials. We examine the role and limitations of digitization for identifying taxable entities, verifying tax liabilities, and ensuring collection of tax owed. We also consider how the deployment and incentives of tax officials shape their performance, and the interplay between them and technology tools. Lastly, we emphasize the importance of political incentives and consider the conditions under which governments choose to invest in tax capacity and expand tax collection.
records.abstract_cn: 增加税收收入是许多低收入和中等偏低收入国家的主要政策目标。虽然经济增长是税收的重要决定因素，但现有证据表明，经济增长并不会自动增加税收。相反，各国必须对其税收能力进行有针对性的投资。在本文中，我们考察了关于改善低收入国家税收能力和增加税收收入的不同干预措施的迅速增长的证据，重点关注两个关键投入：信息技术和税务官员。我们考察了数字化在识别应税实体、核实纳税义务和确保征收欠税方面的作用和局限性。我们还考虑了税务官员的部署和激励如何影响其表现，以及他们与技术工具之间的相互作用。最后，我们强调政治激励的重要性，并考虑政府在何种条件下选择投资于税收能力和扩大税收征收。

records.title_en: Does the Value-Added Tax Add Value? Lessons Using Administrative Data from a Diverse Set of Countries
records.title_cn: 增值税是否增加价值？利用多国行政数据的经验教训
records.abstract_en: The value-added tax (VAT) is a cornerstone of the modern tax system. It has many desirable properties in theory: it does not distort firms' production decisions, it is difficult to evade, and it generates a substantial amount of revenue. Yet, in many countries there are discrepancies between the textbook model of the VAT and its practical implementation. Where the VAT implementation diverges from its textbook model, the tax may lose its desirable properties. We draw on firm-level administrative VAT records from 11 countries at different income levels to examine the functioning of real-world VAT systems. We document four stylized facts that capture departures from the textbook VAT model which are particularly pronounced in lower-income countries. We discuss the effects on VAT performance and simulate a counterfactual retail sales tax and a turnover tax. Despite its shortcomings, we conclude that the real-world VAT is superior to the alternatives.
records.abstract_cn: 增值税是现代税收体系的基石。理论上它具有许多理想特性：不扭曲企业的生产决策，难以逃税，并能产生大量收入。然而，在许多国家，增值税的教科书模型与其实际实施之间存在差异。当增值税的实施偏离其教科书模型时，税收可能失去其理想特性。我们利用来自11个不同收入水平国家的企业层面增值税行政记录，考察现实世界中增值税体系的运作情况。我们记录了四个典型事实，这些事实反映了与教科书增值税模型的偏离，在低收入国家尤为明显。我们讨论了这些偏离对增值税绩效的影响，并模拟了反事实的零售销售税和流转税。尽管存在缺陷，我们得出结论，现实世界中的增值税优于替代方案。

records.title_en: The Failure of Silicon Valley Bank and the Panic of 2023
records.title_cn: 硅谷银行倒闭与2023年恐慌
records.abstract_en: The failure of Silicon Valley Bank on March 10, 2023 brought attention to significant weaknesses across the banking system, leading to a panic that spread to other vulnerable banks. With subsequent failures of Signature Bank and First Republic Bank, the United States had three of the four largest bank failures in its history occur over a two-month period. Several features of the Silicon Valley Bank failure make it an ideal teaching case for explaining the underlying economics of banking (in general) and banking crises (specifically). This paper tries to do that.
records.abstract_cn: 硅谷银行于2023年三月10日倒闭，引发了对银行体系重大弱点的关注，导致恐慌蔓延至其他脆弱银行。随着签名银行和第一共和银行相继倒闭，美国历史上最大的四家银行倒闭案中有三家发生在两个月内。硅谷银行倒闭的几个特点使其成为解释银行业（一般）和银行危机（具体）基础经济学的理想教学案例。本文试图做到这一点。

records.title_en: Is Pay Transparency Good?
records.title_cn: 薪酬透明是好事吗？
records.abstract_en: Countries around the world are enacting pay transparency policies to combat pay discrimination. Since 2000, 71 percent of OECD countries have done so. Most are enacting transparency horizontally, revealing pay between coworkers doing similar work within a firm. While these policies have narrowed coworker wage gaps, they have also led to counterproductive peer comparisons and caused employers to bargain more aggressively, lowering average wages. Other pay transparency policies, without directly targeting discrimination, have benefited workers by addressing broader information frictions in the labor market. Vertical pay transparency policies reveal to workers pay differences across different levels of seniority. Empirical evidence suggests these policies can lead to more accurate and more optimistic beliefs about earnings potential, increasing employee motivation and productivity. Cross-firm pay transparency policies reveal wage differences across employers. These policies have encouraged workers to seek jobs at higher paying firms, negotiate higher pay, and sharpened wage competition between employers. We discuss the evidence on effects of pay transparency, and open questions.
records.abstract_cn: 世界各国正在制定薪酬透明政策以打击薪酬歧视。自2000年以来，71%的经合组织国家已采取此类措施。大多数国家实施的是横向透明，即揭示公司内部从事类似工作的同事之间的薪酬。虽然这些政策缩小了同事间的工资差距，但也导致了适得其反的同伴比较，并促使雇主更积极地讨价还价，从而降低了平均工资。其他薪酬透明政策，虽不直接针对歧视，但通过解决劳动力市场中更广泛的信息摩擦，使工人受益。纵向薪酬透明政策向工人揭示不同资历级别之间的薪酬差异。实证证据表明，这些政策可以带来对收入潜力更准确、更乐观的信念，从而提高员工的积极性和生产力。跨企业薪酬透明政策揭示不同雇主之间的工资差异。这些政策鼓励工人到薪酬更高的企业求职，协商更高的薪酬，并加剧了雇主之间的工资竞争。我们讨论了关于薪酬透明影响的证据及未解决的问题。

records.title_en: Immigration and Crime: An International Perspective
records.title_cn: 移民与犯罪：国际视角
records.abstract_en: The association between immigration and crime has long been a subject of debate, and only recently have we encountered systematic empirical evidence on this issue. Data shows that immigrants, often younger, male, and less educated compared to natives, are disproportionately represented among offenders in numerous host countries. However, existing research, inclusive of our analysis of new international data, consistently indicates that immigration does not significantly impact local crime rates in these countries. Furthermore, recent studies underscore that obtaining legal status diminishes immigrants’ involvement in criminal activities. Finally, we discuss potential explanations for the apparent incongruity between immigrants’ overrepresentation among offenders and the null effect of immigration on crime rates.
records.abstract_cn: 移民与犯罪之间的关联长期以来一直是争论的主题，直到最近我们才遇到关于这一问题的系统性实证证据。数据显示，与本地人相比，移民往往更年轻、男性居多且受教育程度较低，在许多东道国的犯罪者中比例过高。然而，现有研究，包括我们对新国际数据的分析，一致表明移民并未显著影响这些国家的本地犯罪率。此外，最近的研究强调，获得合法身份会减少移民参与犯罪活动。最后，我们讨论了移民在犯罪者中比例过高与移民对犯罪率无影响之间明显不一致的可能解释。

records.title_en: Care Provision and the Boundaries of Production
records.title_cn: 照护供给与生产的边界
records.abstract_en: Whether or not they provide subjective satisfaction to providers, unpaid services and non-market transfers typically contribute positively to total output, living standards, and the social climate. This essay describes some quantitative dimensions of care provision and reviews their implications for the measurement of economic growth and the explanation of relative earnings, including the gender wage differential. It also calls attention to under-explored aspects of collective conflict over legal rules and public policies that shape the distribution of the net costs of care provision.
records.abstract_cn: 无论是否为主观满足提供者，无偿服务和非市场转移通常对总产出、生活水平和社会氛围产生积极贡献。本文描述了照护供给的一些数量维度，并回顾了它们对经济增长测量和相对收入解释（包括性别工资差异）的影响。文章还提请关注围绕法律规则和公共政策的集体冲突中尚未充分探索的方面，这些规则和政策塑造了照护供给净成本的分配。

records.title_en: Job Training and Job Search Assistance Policies in Developing Countries
records.title_cn: 发展中国家的职业培训与求职援助政策
records.abstract_en: Governments around the developing world face pressure to intervene actively to help jobseekers find employment. Two of the most common policies used are job training, based on the idea that many of those seeking jobs lack the skills employers want, and job search assistance, based on the possibility that even if workers have the skills demanded, search and matching frictions make it difficult for workers to be hired in the jobs that need these skills. However, reviews of the first generation of evaluations of these programs found typical impacts to be small, casting doubt on the usefulness and cost-effectiveness of these programs. This paper re-examines the arguments for whether, when, and how, developing country governments should undertake job training and job search assistance policies. We use our experience with policy implementation, and evidence from recent impact evaluations, to argue that there is still a role for governments in using these programs. However, success depends critically on program design and delivery elements that can be difficult to scale effectively, and in many cases the binding constraint may be a lack of firms with job openings, rather than a lack of workers with the skills to fill these openings.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中世界的各国政府面临压力，需要积极干预以帮助求职者找到工作。最常用的两种政策是基于许多求职者缺乏雇主所需技能这一理念的职业培训，以及基于即使工人具备所需技能，搜索和匹配摩擦也使工人难以在需要这些技能的工作中被雇用这一可能性的求职援助。然而，对第一代项目评估的回顾发现，典型影响很小，这使人们对这些项目的实用性和成本效益产生了怀疑。本文重新审视了发展中国家政府是否、何时以及如何实施职业培训和求职援助政策的论点。我们利用政策实施的经验和近期影响评估的证据，论证政府在使用这些项目方面仍可发挥作用。然而，成功关键取决于可能难以有效扩展的项目设计和交付要素，在许多情况下，约束条件可能是缺乏有空缺职位的公司，而不是缺乏具备填补这些职位技能的工人。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Paying income tax after a natural disaster
records.title_cn: 自然灾害后的个人所得税缴纳
records.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of a climatic shock on individuals’ tax deduction and tax payable patterns, alongside their income dynamics. Using individual-level annual tax return data and exploiting the 2010–2011 Queensland Floods in Australia as a natural experiment, we find that the floods affect different income groups differently. They also lead to persistent higher tax deductions for high-income taxpayers. For the population at large, we detect spikes in certain tax deduction items that lasted longer than the income shock. Overall, our findings uncover discernible changes in tax deduction patterns following floods.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了气候冲击对个人税收扣除和应纳税额模式及其收入动态的影响。利用个人层面的年度纳税申报数据，并以澳大利亚2010-2011年昆士兰洪水作为自然实验，我们发现洪水对不同收入群体的影响不同。它们还导致高收入纳税人持续更高的税收扣除。对于广大民众，我们检测到某些税收扣除项目出现峰值，其持续时间超过了收入冲击。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了洪水后税收扣除模式的显著变化。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Wildfires and climate change have lowered the economic value of western U.S. forests by altering risk expectations
records.title_cn: 野火与气候变化通过改变风险预期降低了美国西部森林的经济价值
records.abstract_en: There is a lack of evidence regarding how natural resource markets have responded to recent increases in climate-induced extreme events like wildfire. Wildfire can affect the economic value of forests by directly damaging the existing tree stock and by altering landowner risk expectations of future wildfire arrival. This paper uses parcel data over a seventeen-year period to estimate the effects of large wildfires and drought stress on market prices for private timberland across the three Pacific states of the western U.S. In addition to estimating the land price impacts of wildfires on parcels that were directly burned, we identify changes in risk expectations by estimating the impacts from wildfires that burned in close proximity rather than directly on timberland that was sold in the land market. Results indicate that recent increases in large wildfires and drought stress over the past two decades have lowered the economic value of timberland by approximately 10%, or about $11.2 billion in damages across the three Pacific states, with approximately 5.5% (∼$6.2 billion) due to climate change. Most of the wildfire damages arise from changes in risk expectations. Results provide evidence on the costs of climate-induced extreme events on natural capital that have already occurred.
records.abstract_cn: 关于自然资源市场如何应对近期气候引发的极端事件（如野火）增加，缺乏证据。野火通过直接损害现有林木存量以及改变土地所有者对未来野火发生的风险预期，可能影响森林的经济价值。本文利用十七年期间的地块数据，估计了大型野火和干旱胁迫对美国西部三个太平洋州私人林地市场价格的影响。除了估计直接烧毁地块的野火对土地价格的影响外，我们还通过估计在土地市场上出售的林地附近而非直接烧毁的野火的影响，来识别风险预期的变化。结果表明，过去二十年大型野火和干旱胁迫的近期增加已使林地经济价值降低了约10%，即三个太平洋州约11.2亿美元的损失，其中约5.5%（约6.2亿美元）归因于气候变化。大部分野火损失源于风险预期的变化。结果提供了关于气候引发的极端事件对自然资本已造成成本的证据。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Panel data in environmental economics: Econometric issues and applications to IPAT models
records.title_cn: 环境经济学中的面板数据：计量经济学问题及其在IPAT模型中的应用
records.abstract_en: This paper addresses econometric challenges arising in panel data analyses related to IPAT (environmental Impact of Population, Affluence and Technology) models and other applications typically characterized by a large-N and large-T structure. This poses specific econometric complexities due to nonstationarity and cross-sectional error correlation, potentially affecting consistent estimation and valid inference. We provide a concise overview of these complications and how to deal with these with appropriate tests and models. Moreover, we apply these insights to empirical examples based on the IPAT identity, offering insights into the robustness of previous findings. Our results suggest that using standard panel techniques can lead to biased estimates, incorrect inference, and invalid model adequacy tests. This can potentially lead to flawed policy conclusions. We provide practical guidance to practitioners for navigating these econometric issues.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了在IPAT（人口、富裕度和技术对环境的影响）模型及其他通常具有大N和大T结构特征的应用中，面板数据分析所面临的计量经济学挑战。由于非平稳性和截面误差相关性，这带来了特定的计量经济学复杂性，可能影响一致估计和有效推断。我们简要概述了这些复杂性以及如何通过适当的检验和模型来处理它们。此外，我们将这些见解应用于基于IPAT恒等式的实证例子，为先前发现的稳健性提供了见解。我们的结果表明，使用标准面板技术可能导致有偏估计、错误推断和无效的模型充分性检验。这可能导致有缺陷的政策结论。我们为实践者提供了应对这些计量经济学问题的实用指导。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Adjusted net savings needs further adjusting: Reassessing human and resource factors in sustainability measurement
records.title_cn: 调整后的净储蓄需要进一步调整：重新评估可持续性衡量中的人力与资源因素
records.abstract_en: We build a theoretical model of optimal, closed-economy growth of production and consumption, including inputs of human and knowledge capital and growing natural resources, and give two calibrations of it to the global economy's approximately exponential growth during 1995–2014. We thereby show that the World Bank's Adjusted Net Savings (ANS) measure of an economy's sustainability, which has some practical and theoretical advantages over change in wealth, the Bank's preferred measure, ideally needs further adjusting. Our model includes omitted or undervalued estimates of the benefits of human and knowledge capital investment, net resource growth, and productivity growth, and the cost of capitals dilution by population growth. Together these raise estimated, global ANS about 10 percentage points above the Bank's estimate, to equal their growth rate times total wealth, but our adjustments could be negative overall for some countries. By reclassifying about 18% of output from consumption to human and knowledge capital investments, our second calibration needs only 0.3 %/yr of exogenous productivity growth to explain global consumption growth observed during 1995–2014. Though our model omits environmental costs and thus ignores long-run sustainability issues, our adjustments suggest desirable though difficult changes that could improve World Bank ANS as a comparative sustainability indicator.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个关于生产与消费的最优封闭经济体增长的理论模型，该模型包含人力资本和知识资本投入以及自然资源的增长，并对其进行了两次校准，以匹配1995-2014年间全球经济近似指数增长的情况。我们由此表明，世界银行的调整后净储蓄（ANS）作为经济体可持续性的衡量指标，尽管在实践和理论上相对于财富变化（世界银行偏好的指标）具有一些优势，但理想情况下仍需进一步调整。我们的模型纳入了被遗漏或低估的人力与知识资本投资效益、净资源增长、生产率增长以及人口增长导致的资本稀释成本。这些调整共同使全球ANS估计值比世界银行的估计值高出约10个百分点，等于其增长率乘以总财富，但我们的调整对某些国家而言总体上可能是负的。通过将约18%的产出从消费重新分类为人力与知识资本投资，我们的第二次校准仅需每年0.3%的外生生产率增长即可解释1995-2014年间观察到的全球消费增长。尽管我们的模型忽略了环境成本，从而忽视了长期可持续性问题，但我们的调整建议表明，世界银行ANS作为比较性可持续性指标可以进行的改进是理想但困难的。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Payments and penalties in ecosystem services programs
records.title_cn: 生态系统服务项目中的支付与罚则
records.abstract_en: Payment for ecosystem services (PES) program contracts include penalties for non-performance to ensure that these programs receive the environmental benefits they have been paying for. The standard penalty structure in PES programs requires participants to pay back all program payments received if the contract is terminated before the end of the contract lifetime. We derive the optimal non-completion penalty structure, which decouples the penalty from payments received. In contrast to the backward-looking standard penalty, the optimal penalty is forward-looking and equals the principal's net future environmental benefits lost due to contract non-completion. The optimal penalty thus falls over the life of the contract, in contrast to the standard penalty, which rises over the life of the contract. A numerical policy simulation with heterogeneous agents based on features in federal agricultural conservation programs in the United States suggests that the optimal penalty structure can increase realized net environmental benefits significantly. Our results suggest that performance of most kinds of PES programs can be enhanced by decoupling non-completion penalties from payments and by adjusting how penalties vary over contract lifetimes.
records.abstract_cn: 生态系统服务付费（PES）项目合同包含对未履约的罚则，以确保这些项目获得其已支付的环境效益。PES项目中的标准罚则结构要求，如果合同在合同期限结束前终止，参与者必须偿还所有已收到的项目付款。我们推导出最优的非完成罚则结构，该结构将罚则与已收付款脱钩。与回溯性的标准罚则相反，最优罚则是前瞻性的，等于委托人因合同未完成而损失的未来净环境效益。因此，最优罚则在合同期限内递减，而标准罚则则在合同期限内递增。基于美国联邦农业保护项目特征的异质性主体数值政策模拟表明，最优罚则结构可以显著提高实现的净环境效益。我们的结果表明，通过将非完成罚则与付款脱钩，并调整罚则随合同期限的变化方式，可以提高大多数类型的PES项目的绩效。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Punishment to promote prosocial behavior: a field experiment
records.title_cn: 惩罚以促进亲社会行为：一项实地实验
records.abstract_en: Prosocial behavior is typically promoted through behavioral interventions or modest rewards. We provide field evidence for the effectiveness of a less commonly used way to achieve the same goal: making it illegal not to engage in the desired behavior and then enforcing that rule. We partnered with a city to conduct a natural field experiment aimed at increasing the rate at which 70,000 households separate their waste. Households were informed that it was illegal not to separate their waste and that they could be fined. The announcement was followed by a month of intensive and highly conspicuous inspections of the contents of garbage containers set out for emptying. The treatment had a large and immediate positive effect on waste separation. Unlike the effects of crackdowns in typical applications such as traffic enforcement, the behavioral effect persisted at a stable rate for many months. This divergent result is consistent with a change in habits, a previously unexplored way in which law enforcement crackdowns can have a lasting effect. If habits sustain the new behavior, then this also alleviates concerns about loss of intrinsic motivation.
records.abstract_cn: 亲社会行为通常通过行为干预或适度奖励来促进。我们提供了关于一种较少使用但同样能达到此目标的方法有效性的实地证据：将不参与期望行为定为非法，并执行该规则。我们与一个城市合作开展了一项自然实地实验，旨在提高70,000户家庭垃圾分类的比例。家庭被告知不进行垃圾分类是违法的，并可能被罚款。公告发布后，进行了为期一个月的高强度且高度显眼的垃圾容器检查。处理对垃圾分类产生了巨大且即时的积极影响。与典型应用（如交通执法）中的打击行动效果不同，行为效应在数月内以稳定比率持续存在。这一不同结果与习惯的改变相一致，这是法律执法打击可能产生持久影响的一个先前未被探索的途径。如果习惯维持了新行为，那么这也缓解了关于内在动机丧失的担忧。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Barrett's paradox of cooperation: A full analytical proof 30 years after
records.title_cn: 巴雷特合作悖论：30年后的完整解析证明
records.abstract_en: In his seminal paper, Barrett (1994) argues that international environmental agreements (IEAs) are typically not successful, which he coined "the paradox of cooperation". If the potential gains from full cooperation would be large, self-enforcing IEAs have low participation and, therefore, cannot achieve much, or, if the potential gains are small, agreements are not important, even though IEAs may enjoy large participation. This message has been reiterated by several subsequent papers. Even though these papers explain the driving forces of the paradox, the analysis of membership in stable agreements and the actual and potential gains from cooperation are still mainly based on simulations. In this paper, we provide a full analytical characterization of all items on which the paradox of cooperation is based.
records.abstract_cn: 在其开创性论文中，巴雷特（1994）认为国际环境协定（IEAs）通常不成功，他称之为“合作悖论”。如果完全合作的潜在收益很大，自我执行的IEAs参与度低，因此无法取得太大成效；或者，如果潜在收益很小，即使IEAs可能获得广泛参与，协定也不重要。这一信息已被后续多篇论文重申。尽管这些论文解释了悖论的驱动因素，但对稳定协定成员资格以及合作的实际和潜在收益的分析仍主要基于模拟。在本文中，我们对合作悖论所依据的所有项目提供了完整的解析刻画。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Corporate social responsibility by joint agreement
records.title_cn: 联合协议下的企业社会责任
records.abstract_en: Industry-wide voluntary agreements are touted as a means for corporations to take more corporate social responsibility (CSR). We study what type of joint CSR agreement induces competitors to increase CSR efforts in a model of oligopolistic competition with differentiated products. Consumers have a higher willingness to pay for more responsibly produced goods and services. Firms are driven by profit, and are also possibly intrinsically motivated, to invest in CSR. We find that cooperative agreements directly on the level of CSR reduce CSR efforts compared to competition. Such agreements throttle both for-profit and intrinsic motivation for CSR. CSR efforts only increase if agreements are permitted solely on output. Such production agreements, however, reduce total welfare in the market and raise antitrust concerns. Taking externalities into account may help justify a production agreement under a broader welfare standard, but not agreements on CSR directly. Simply setting a higher mandatory CSR standard by regulation while preserving competition always gives higher within-market welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 行业范围内的自愿协议被吹捧为企业承担更多企业社会责任（CSR）的一种手段。我们在一个具有差异化产品的寡头竞争模型中，研究了何种类型的联合CSR协议会促使竞争对手增加CSR努力。消费者对更负责任地生产的商品和服务有更高的支付意愿。企业受利润驱动，也可能受内在动机驱动，投资于CSR。我们发现，直接在CSR水平上的合作协议相比竞争会减少CSR努力。此类协议会抑制营利性和内在的CSR动机。只有当协议仅允许在产出上时，CSR努力才会增加。然而，这种生产协议会降低市场中的总福利，并引发反垄断担忧。考虑外部性可能有助于在更广泛的福利标准下为生产协议辩护，但不能为直接针对CSR的协议辩护。通过监管简单地设定更高的强制性CSR标准，同时保持竞争，总是能在市场内带来更高的福利。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Benefits of diesel emission regulations: Evidence from the World's largest low emission zone
records.title_cn: 柴油排放法规的收益：来自世界最大低排放区的证据
records.abstract_en: We examined the impact of diesel emission regulations on air quality, land prices, and infant health in the Tokyo metropolitan area. The results reveal that as air pollution concentrations improved, land prices increased more in areas with higher diesel vehicle traffic, even after controlling for non-regulated vehicle traffic. In contrast, the concentrations of non-regulated air pollutants were unaffected. Estimates based on the hedonic approach show that the benefit of air quality improvement in the metropolitan area is about 14 times the cost. Improved air quality also improved infant health. The improvement in infant mortality with a one-unit improvement in suspended particulate matter was similar in magnitude to published results from the United States.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了柴油排放法规对东京都市区空气质量、土地价格和婴儿健康的影响。结果表明，随着空气污染浓度的改善，柴油车辆交通量较高地区的土地价格涨幅更大，即使在控制了非管制车辆交通量之后也是如此。相反，非管制空气污染物的浓度未受影响。基于特征价格法的估计显示，都市区空气质量改善的收益约为成本的14倍。空气质量的改善也改善了婴儿健康。悬浮颗粒物每改善一个单位所带来的婴儿死亡率改善幅度与美国已发表的研究结果相近。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The impact of energy prices on industrial investment location: Evidence from global firm level data
records.title_cn: 能源价格对工业投资区位的影响：来自全球企业层面数据的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines the influence of relative energy prices on the geographical distribution of industrial investments across 41 countries. Employing a gravity model framework to analyse firms’ investment location decisions, we estimate the model using global bilateral investment flows derived from firm-level M&A data. Our findings reveal that a 10% increase in the energy price differential between two countries results in a 3.2% rise in cross-border acquisitions. This effect is most pronounced in energy-intensive industries and transactions targeting emerging economies. Furthermore, policy simulations suggest that the impact of unilateral carbon pricing on cross-border investments is modest.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了相对能源价格对41个国家工业投资地理分布的影响。采用引力模型框架分析企业的投资区位决策，我们利用来自企业层面并购数据的全球双边投资流来估计该模型。我们的研究结果显示，两国之间能源价格差异每增加10%，跨境收购就会增加3.2%。这种效应在能源密集型行业和针对新兴经济体的交易中最为显著。此外，政策模拟表明，单边碳定价对跨境投资的影响是适度的。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Cross-ownership and green managerial delegation contracts in a mixed oligopoly
records.title_cn: 混合寡头市场中的交叉持股与绿色管理授权合同
records.abstract_en: This study examines strategic interactions between cross-ownership and managerial delegation contracts with environmental corporate social responsibility (ECSR) incentives in a mixed oligopoly. We find that private firms always utilize ECSR incentives in competing prices under cross-ownership, whereas public managers do so only when there is severe environmental damage. We also demonstrate that the ECSR incentives for welfare-weighted public managers are always lower than for their profit-weighted counterparts when they employ ECSR incentives, which leads to lower environmental damage and greater social welfare. Finally, we show that welfare-weighted public delegation increases the private firm's ECSR compared to no public delegation, which is reversed in the profit-weighted variant. Our findings suggest that the government should design an environmental incentive scheme to their public managers that can also induce private managers to behave more aggressively in abatement activities as the degree of cross-ownership increases.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了混合寡头市场中交叉持股与带有环境企业社会责任（ECSR）激励的管理授权合同之间的战略互动。我们发现，在交叉持股下，私营企业总是在价格竞争中利用ECSR激励，而公共管理者仅在环境损害严重时才这样做。我们还证明，当福利加权公共管理者采用ECSR激励时，其ECSR激励水平总是低于利润加权对应者，这导致更低的环境损害和更高的社会福利。最后，我们表明，与无公共授权相比，福利加权公共授权增加了私营企业的ECSR，而在利润加权变体中则相反。我们的研究结果表明，政府应为其公共管理者设计一种环境激励方案，该方案还能随着交叉持股程度的增加，诱导私营管理者在减排活动中表现得更积极。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The effect of water pollution regulation on prices: Evidence from Wisconsin's phosphorus rule and sewer utility bills
records.title_cn: 水污染规制对价格的影响：来自威斯康星州磷规则和下水道公用事业账单的证据
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we estimate the consumer impacts of Wisconsin's “phosphorus rule”, which created the most stringent statewide water quality and effluent standards for phosphorus in the country. We examine how compliance with the rule affects real billing rates at sewer utilities in Wisconsin, providing the first empirical estimates of water pollution regulation on utility billing rates. We find that compliance with the phosphorous rule increases the average real sewer utility bill in our sample by 7–12%. Our results imply that sewer utilities pass through approximately $65.8 million to residential sewer rate payers annually, which is roughly ⅔ of the total sewer utility compliance costs of the rule. State government subsidies cover an additional ¼ of the sewer utility compliance costs.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们估算了威斯康星州“磷规则”对消费者的影响，该规则制定了全国最严格的州级水质和污水排放标准。我们考察了遵守该规则如何影响威斯康星州下水道公用事业的实际账单费率，提供了水污染规制对公用事业账单费率的首个实证估计。我们发现，遵守磷规则使样本中的平均实际下水道公用事业账单增加了7-12%。我们的结果表明，下水道公用事业每年将约65.8百万美元转嫁给居民下水道费率支付者，这大约是该规则下水道公用事业合规总成本的三分之二。州政府补贴额外覆盖了下水道公用事业合规成本的四分之一。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Correcting misperceptions about trends and norms to address weak collective action — Experimental evidence from a recycling program
records.title_cn: 纠正关于趋势和规范的误解以应对薄弱的集体行动——来自回收项目的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Finding ways to encourage collective action in contexts where only a minority adopts the desired behavior is central to solving many of today’s global environmental problems. We study how correcting people’s beliefs about social norms and behavioral trends encourages collective action in a setting where the desired behavior is not yet prevalent. In a field experiment, we test whether low sign-up rates for a recycling program in urban Peru can be increased by providing information (1) that most people regard participation in the program as important, i.e., on the “injunctive norm”, (2) on an increasing recent trend in sign-up rates. We find that the effectiveness of the treatments depends on people’s prior beliefs: Correcting inaccurate beliefs increases sign-up decisions significantly among people who either substantially underestimate the injunctive norm or who underestimate the positive trend. As this sub-group of people is in the minority in our set-up, we do not observe statistically significant average treatment effects. We further find that the effects of the treatments increase in the level of underestimation. Our evidence demonstrates that belief updating can be used effectively to encourage collective action where it is weak as long as a meaningful number of people underestimates the relevant trends and norms.
records.abstract_cn: 在只有少数人采纳期望行为的情境中寻找鼓励集体行动的方法，是解决当今许多全球性环境问题的核心。我们研究了在期望行为尚未普及的环境中，纠正人们关于社会规范和行为的信念如何鼓励集体行动。在一项实地实验中，我们测试了通过提供信息（1）大多数人认为参与该计划很重要，即“指令性规范”，以及（2）参与率近期呈上升趋势，是否能提高秘鲁城市地区一个回收项目的低报名率。我们发现，处理的有效性取决于人们先前的信念：在那些要么严重低估指令性规范、要么低估积极趋势的人群中，纠正不准确的信念显著增加了报名决定。由于在我们的设置中这一亚群体属于少数，我们未观察到统计上显著的平均处理效应。我们进一步发现，处理效应随低估程度的增加而增强。我们的证据表明，只要相当数量的人低估了相关趋势和规范，信念更新就能有效地鼓励薄弱的集体行动。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Measuring the impact of time-of-use pricing on electricity consumption: Evidence from Spain
records.title_cn: 分时电价对电力消费影响的测量：来自西班牙的证据
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the effect of a time-of-use pricing program introduced in Spain on residential electricity consumption. Using a Difference-in-Difference approach, we find that households responded by reducing consumption during peak hours. We then use machine learning for variable selection and show that it is able to capture pre-trends unrelated to the policy, improving the credibility of our estimates. We find that the program could have reduced consumption by up to 9% during peak periods, with significant spillovers to weekends. Using a more conservative estimator, we find that it reduced consumption by at least 1%–2% during peak periods. We find evidence of habit formation during periods of uniform pricing, accompanied by an adaptation process that ends with a permanent change in consumption behavior. The results suggest that a predetermined pricing program can enhance consumer awareness and increase household price elasticity, thus making it an effective policy tool to reduce peak electricity demand and improve market efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了西班牙引入的分时电价计划对居民电力消费的影响。采用双重差分方法，我们发现家庭通过减少高峰时段的消费来做出反应。随后，我们使用机器学习进行变量选择，并表明它能够捕捉与政策无关的预先趋势，从而提高我们估计的可信度。我们发现该计划在高峰时段最多可减少9%的消费，且在周末存在显著的溢出效应。使用更保守的估计量，我们发现它在高峰时段至少减少了1%–2%的消费。我们发现了统一电价时期习惯形成的证据，伴随着一个适应过程，最终导致消费行为的永久性改变。结果表明，预定的定价计划可以增强消费者意识并提高家庭价格弹性，从而使其成为减少高峰电力需求和改善市场效率的有效政策工具。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Beyond the annual averages: Impact of seasonal temperature on employment growth in US counties
records.title_cn: 超越年度平均值：季节性温度对美国县域就业增长的影响
records.abstract_en: Using quarterly temperature and employment data between 1990 and 2021, this paper uncovers nuanced evidence on the impact of seasonal temperature within US counties: higher winter temperature increases private sector employment growth while higher summer temperature decreases it. The impacts of higher temperature in milder seasons, fall and spring, are statistically insignificant. Moreover, the negative impact of higher summer temperature persists while the positive impact of higher temperature in the winter is more short-lived. The negative effects of a hotter summer are pervasive and persistent in many sectors: most significantly in “Construction” and “Leisure and Hospitality” but also in “Trade, Transport, and Utilities” and “Financial Activities”. In contrast, the positive effects of a warmer winter are less pervasive. The employment effect of a hotter summer has been more severe in recent decades.
records.abstract_cn: 利用1990年至2021年间的季度温度和就业数据，本文揭示了美国县域内季节性温度影响的细致证据：较高的冬季温度增加了私营部门就业增长，而较高的夏季温度则降低了就业增长。在较温和的季节（秋季和春季）温度升高的影响在统计上不显著。此外，夏季温度升高的负面影响持续存在，而冬季温度升高的正面影响则较为短暂。更炎热的夏季的负面影响在许多部门中普遍且持久：最显著的是“建筑业”和“休闲与酒店业”，但也包括“贸易、运输和公用事业”以及“金融活动”。相比之下，更温暖冬季的正面影响不那么普遍。近年来，更炎热夏季对就业的影响更为严重。
