Accounting for the normative appropriateness of decisions when categorizing participants, however, reveals different motives across types: strong altruists are only marginally concerned with norms while the moderate altruists are highly sensitive to them and, once norms are taken into account, don't care at all about the outcomes of others. Our results thus recast the prior findings in a new light. Rather than the two most common types being strong altruists and moderate altruists, we find that they are better described as strong altruists and norm followers.
records.abstract_cn: 本文扩展了关于社会偏好结构估计的文献，以考虑遵守社会规范和通过道德模糊空间隐藏真实意图的愿望。我们进行了一项实验，以检验考虑规范适当行为是否能让我们区分关心结果与遵守社会规范的偏好类型，以及道德模糊空间的引入是否会破坏社会偏好估计的稳定性。我们发现，社会偏好估计对道德模糊空间的纳入表现出显著的稳健性。然而，代表性代理人受到规范的强烈驱动，而我们的模型未能考虑这一动机，导致我们高估了代理人帮助境况较差者的关心程度。使用有限混合模型内生识别潜在偏好类型，我们重复了先前的研究，发现在不考虑规范关注时，大多数受试者可以被归类为强利他主义者或中等利他主义者。然而，在分类参与者时考虑决策的规范适当性，揭示了不同类型之间的不同动机：强利他主义者仅对规范有轻微关注，而中等利他主义者对规范高度敏感，并且一旦考虑规范，他们完全不关心他人的结果。因此，我们的结果以新的视角重新诠释了先前的发现。我们发现，最常见的两种类型并非强利他主义者和中等利他主义者，而是更应被描述为强利他主义者和规范追随者。

records.title_en: Oddness of the number of Nash equilibria: The case of polynomial payoff functions
records.title_cn: 纳什均衡数量的奇异性：多项式收益函数的情形
records.abstract_en: In 1971, Wilson (1971) proved that “almost all” finite games have an odd number of mixed Nash equilibria. Since then, several other proofs have been given, but always for mixed extensions of finite games. In this paper, we present a new oddness theorem for large classes of polynomial payoff functions and semi-algebraic sets of strategies. Additionally, we provide some applications to recent models of games on networks such that Patacchini-Zenou's model about juvenile delinquency and conformism (Patacchini and Zenou, 2012), Calvó-Armengol-Patacchini-Zenou's model about social networks in education (Calvó-Armengol et al., 2009), Konig-Liu-Zenou's model about R&D networks (König et al., 2019), Helsley-Zenou's model about social networks and interactions in cities (Helsley and Zenou, 2014).
records.abstract_cn: 在1971年，Wilson（1971）证明了“几乎所有”有限博弈都有奇数个混合纳什均衡。此后，给出了若干其他证明，但总是针对有限博弈的混合扩展。在本文中，我们针对大类多项式收益函数和半代数策略集提出了一个新的奇异性定理。此外，我们将其应用于近期网络博弈模型，如Patacchini-Zenou关于青少年犯罪与从众行为的模型（Patacchini和Zenou，2012），Calvó-Armengol-Patacchini-Zenou关于教育中社交网络的模型（Calvó-Armengol等，2009），Konig-Liu-Zenou关于研发网络的模型（König等，2019），以及Helsley-Zenou关于城市中社交网络与互动的模型（Helsley和Zenou，2014）。

records.title_en: Partial credence goods on review platforms
records.title_cn: 评论平台上的部分信任品
records.abstract_en: We study a repeated credence goods market in which experts provide treatment to customers. We assume that the history of transactions is recorded on a review platform that contains information only about treatments, and not about non-treatments. We also introduce the notion of a partial credence good, where treated customers receive a noisy, ex post signal about the necessity of treatment. Absent such signals, there is a breakdown of the market. We provide a necessary and sufficient condition on the signals that guarantees the existence of any non-trivial equilibrium, as well as an efficient one.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个重复的信任品市场，其中专家向顾客提供治疗。我们假设交易历史记录在一个评论平台上，该平台仅包含关于治疗的信息，而不包含关于非治疗的信息。我们还引入了部分信任品的概念，即接受治疗的顾客会收到一个关于治疗必要性的带有噪声的事后信号。在没有此类信号的情况下，市场会崩溃。我们提供了关于信号的充分必要条件，以保证任何非平凡均衡以及一个有效均衡的存在。

records.title_en: Stability and substitutability in multi-period matching markets
records.title_cn: 多期匹配市场中的稳定性与可替代性
records.abstract_en: We analyze a multi-period matching market where matching between agents is decided for each time period. To analyze this situation, we embed the situation into the framework of many-to-many matching with contracts where the contract includes the time period at which the matching occurs. While a general stability concept is already defined for the matching with contracts framework, in a multi-period matching model, a stable outcome may not exist when contracts exhibit complementarities across time periods. Thus, we define a weaker stability concept called temporal stability by taking into account the dynamic nature of the model. We provide sufficient conditions for the existence of a temporally stable outcome, including a corresponding substitutability condition, ordered substitutability, for the multi-period matching model.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个多期匹配市场，其中代理人之间的匹配在每个时间段内决定。为了分析这种情况，我们将该情境嵌入到具有契约的多对多匹配框架中，其中契约包括匹配发生的时间段。虽然一般稳定性概念已在匹配与契约框架中定义，但在多期匹配模型中，当契约在时间段之间表现出互补性时，稳定结果可能不存在。因此，我们通过考虑模型的动态性质，定义了一个较弱的稳定性概念，称为时间稳定性。我们为时间稳定结果的存在提供了充分条件，包括相应的可替代性条件，即有序可替代性，适用于多期匹配模型。

records.title_en: Winner's effort in multi-battle team contests
records.title_cn: 多战役团队竞赛中获胜者的努力
records.abstract_en: In multi-battle team contests with pairwise battles, how battles are organized—sequentially or (partially) simultaneously—may affect the expected winner's total effort (WE), a natural objective in R&D races, elections, and sports. We focus on noise (modeled via the contest success function's discriminatory power) and across-team heterogeneity, abstracting from player-specific heterogeneity. With sufficient noise, we show that: (1) If teams are symmetric, all temporal structures yield the same WE; and (2) If teams are asymmetric, WE is maximized by a fully simultaneous contest and minimized by a fully sequential one. With no noise, we show that: (3) If teams are symmetric, WE is maximized by a fully sequential contest and minimized by a fully simultaneous one; and (4) If teams are asymmetric, neither the fully sequential nor the fully simultaneous temporal structures maximize or minimize WE. Our results use a novel technique that simplifies temporal structure comparisons: extractions and mergers.
records.abstract_cn: 在具有成对战役的多战役团队竞赛中，战役的组织方式——顺序进行或（部分）同时进行——可能影响预期获胜者的总努力（WE），这是研发竞赛、选举和体育中的一个自然目标。我们关注噪声（通过竞赛成功函数的歧视能力建模）和跨团队异质性，抽象掉选手特定异质性。在足够噪声下，我们证明：（1）如果团队对称，所有时间结构产生相同的WE；（2）如果团队不对称，WE由完全同时竞赛最大化，由完全顺序竞赛最小化。在无噪声下，我们证明：（3）如果团队对称，WE由完全顺序竞赛最大化，由完全同时竞赛最小化；（4）如果团队不对称，完全顺序和完全同时的时间结构都不最大化或最小化WE。我们的结果使用了一种简化时间结构比较的新技术：提取和合并。

records.title_en: A recursive measure of voting power that satisfies reasonable postulates
records.title_cn: 一种满足合理公设的递归投票力测度
records.abstract_en: The classical measures of voting power are based on players' decisiveness or full causal efficacy in vote configurations or divisions. We design an alternative, recursive measure departing from this classical approach. We motivate the measure via an axiomatic characterisation based on reasonable axioms and by offering two complementary interpretations of its meaning: first, we interpret the measure to represent, not the player's probability of being decisive in a voting structure, but its expected probability of being decisive in a uniform random walk from a vote configuration in the subset lattice (through which we represent the voting structure); and, second, we interpret it as representing a player's expected efficacy, thereby incorporating the notion of partial and not just full causal efficacy. We shore up our measure by demonstrating that it satisfies a set of postulates any reasonable voting measure should satisfy, namely, the iso-invariance, dummy, dominance, donation, minimum-power bloc, and quarrel postulates.
records.abstract_cn: 经典的投票力测度基于投票者在一系列投票配置或划分中的决定性作用或完全因果效力。我们设计了一种替代性的递归测度，偏离了这一经典方法。我们通过基于合理公理的公理化刻画以及提供对其含义的两种互补解释来论证该测度：首先，我们将该测度解释为，并非投票者在投票结构中的决定性概率，而是其在子集格中从投票配置出发的均匀随机游走中的预期决定性概率（通过该子集格我们表示投票结构）；其次，我们将其解释为投票者的预期效力，从而纳入部分而非仅完全因果效力的概念。我们通过证明该测度满足任何合理投票测度应满足的一组公设来支持我们的测度，即等变性、哑元、支配、捐赠、最小权力集团和争吵公设。

records.title_en: A note on motivated cognition and discriminatory beliefs
records.title_cn: 关于动机认知与歧视性信念的注记
records.abstract_en: In this note, we provide evidence that motivated reasoning can be a source of discriminatory beliefs. We employ a representative survey experiment in which we exogenously manipulate the presence of a need for justification of anti-social behavior towards an out-group. We find that survey participants devalue members of an out-group to justify taking away money from that group. Our results speak to a long-standing debate on the causes of racism and discrimination and suggest an important role of motivated cognition.
records.abstract_cn: 在本注记中，我们提供证据表明动机推理可能是歧视性信念的一个来源。我们采用了一项具有代表性的调查实验，在其中外生地操纵了针对外群体反社会行为正当化需求的存在。我们发现，调查参与者会贬低外群体成员，以证明从该群体拿走金钱是合理的。我们的结果涉及关于种族主义和歧视原因的长期争论，并表明动机认知的重要作用。

records.title_en: Tight incentive analysis of Sybil attacks against the market equilibrium of resource exchange over general networks
records.title_cn: 一般网络上资源交换市场均衡的Sybil攻击紧激励分析
records.abstract_en: The BitTorrent network, a well-known Internet-scale P2P system, applies the proportional response protocol to exchange resource, where each participant contributes resource to neighbors in proportion to the amount it received in the previous round. The dynamics of this protocol is known to converge to a market equilibrium. However, an agent may manipulate this protocol by a Sybil attack to create fictitious identities and control them to gain more benefit. We apply the concept of incentive ratio, the percentage of the new utility after a Sybil attack over the benchmark, to measure the incentive of a strategic agent to play a Sybil attack, proving a tight bound of two over general networks. This finding completes the theoretical picture for incentive analysis on Sybil attacks facing the legendary tit-for-tat protocol for Internet bandwidth sharing and other applications.
records.abstract_cn: BitTorrent网络，一个著名的互联网规模P2P系统，采用比例响应协议进行资源交换，其中每个参与者根据上一轮从邻居处收到的资源量按比例向其邻居贡献资源。该协议的动态已知会收敛到市场均衡。然而，一个代理可能通过Sybil攻击操纵该协议，创建虚构身份并控制它们以获得更多利益。我们应用激励比率的概念，即Sybil攻击后新效用相对于基准的百分比，来衡量战略代理进行Sybil攻击的激励，证明了一般网络上紧界为二。这一发现完善了面对传奇的以牙还牙协议在互联网带宽共享及其他应用中Sybil攻击激励分析的理论图景。

records.title_en: Making ends meet in refugee camps: Food distribution cycles, consumption and undernutrition
records.title_cn: 在难民营中维持生计：粮食分配周期、消费与营养不足
records.abstract_en: Years after the initial settlement, food aid remains an essential component of humanitarian assistance for protracted refugees in managed camps. From data collected among refugee households in three camps in southern Chad and an exogenous variation of time between the latest food distribution and households’ interviews, we draw the time path of household’s consumption. Consistent with the literature on intertemporal choices in high-income countries, refugee households experience an average decline of 1.1 to 1.5 percent per day in their daily caloric intake between distributions. The short-term nutritional status of children under five also responds to the distance from food aid distribution and confirms the existence of food distribution cycles. Our results suggest that households don’t smooth consumption during the interval of time between two distributions, and face regular and frequent cycles of food shortage resulting in detrimental consequences on children’s health.
records.abstract_cn: 在最初安置多年后，粮食援助仍然是管理式难民营中长期难民人道主义援助的重要组成部分。基于在乍得南部三个难民营中收集的难民家庭数据，以及最新粮食分配与家庭访谈之间时间的外生变化，我们描绘了家庭消费的时间路径。与高收入国家跨期选择研究的文献一致，难民家庭在两次分配之间的每日卡路里摄入量平均每天下降1.1至1.5%。五岁以下儿童的短期营养状况也对粮食援助分配的时间间隔作出反应，并证实了粮食分配周期的存在。我们的结果表明，家庭在两次分配之间的时间间隔内并未平滑消费，而是面临定期且频繁的粮食短缺周期，这对儿童健康产生了不利影响。

records.title_en: The effect of universal free school meals on children’s food hardship
records.title_cn: 全民免费校餐对儿童食物困难的影响
records.abstract_en: In the United States, the federal government subsidized universal free school meals (UFSM) nationwide during the COVID-19 pandemic. This policy ended in June 2022. In response, several state governments subsidized extensions of UFSM statewide into the 2022–2023 school year. I leverage variation in state extensions of UFSM to examine the policy’s impact on school meal participation and rates of food insufficiency. Using data from the Household Pulse Survey and a difference-in-differences approach, I find that children in states that did not extend UFSM were 12.6 percentage points less likely (38.3% reduction over the sample mean) to participate in school meal programs and 1.5 percentage points more likely (9.8% increase over the sample mean) to experience food insufficiency relative to those in states that did.
records.abstract_cn: 在美国，联邦政府在COVID-19大流行期间在全国范围内补贴了全民免费校餐（UFSM）。该政策于2022年六月结束。作为回应，几个州政府补贴将UFSM延长至2022-2023学年的全州范围。我利用各州延长UFSM的差异来考察该政策对校餐参与率和食物不足率的影响。使用家庭脉搏调查数据和双重差分方法，我发现，与延长UFSM的州相比，未延长UFSM的州的儿童参与校餐计划的可能性低12.6个百分点（相对于样本均值下降38.3%），而经历食物不足的可能性高1.5个百分点（相对于样本均值增加9.8%）。

records.title_en: Who takes up a free lunch? Summer Food Service Program availability and household grocery food spending
records.title_cn: 谁领取了免费午餐？夏季食品服务计划的可用性与家庭食品杂货支出
records.abstract_en: The Summer Food Service Program (SFSP) provides free meals to children in low-income neighborhoods as a summertime replacement for the National School Lunch Program (NSLP). Unlike the NSLP, the SFSP does not directly means test its recipients, and there are no large-scale administrative data describing the children it serves. I provide the first descriptive evidence of how SFSP site availability and meal provision varies across states and correlates with area demographics. I find that there is a positive relationship between an area’s likely need and SFSP availability, but availability plateaus before reaching full coverage in the highest poverty areas. As a second-best measure of household take up of the SFSP, I link these data to transaction-level records on household grocery expenditures and study the effect of SFSP availability on households’ grocery food spending. I use variation in the timing and intensity of SFSP meal provision to show that, under some assumptions, households with children reduce weekly grocery food spending by 1.8 percent for each additional meal received. These spending reductions are driven by households who are ineligible for subsidized meals during the academic year, providing suggestive evidence of targeting inefficiencies in the SFSP.
records.abstract_cn: 夏季食品服务计划（SFSP）为低收入社区的儿童提供免费餐食，作为全国学校午餐计划（NSLP）的夏季替代方案。与NSLP不同，SFSP不直接对受益者进行经济状况调查，也没有大规模行政数据描述其服务的儿童。我提供了关于SFSP站点可用性和餐食供应如何在各州之间变化以及与地区人口统计特征相关的首个描述性证据。我发现，一个地区的潜在需求与SFSP可用性之间存在正相关关系，但在最高贫困地区，可用性在达到全面覆盖之前趋于平稳。作为家庭参与SFSP的次优衡量指标，我将这些数据与家庭食品杂货支出的交易级记录相关联，并研究SFSP可用性对家庭食品杂货支出的影响。我利用SFSP餐食供应时间和强度的变化来表明，在某些假设下，有孩子的家庭每多获得一餐，每周食品杂货支出减少1.8%。这些支出减少是由在学年期间不符合补贴餐食资格的家庭驱动的，这提供了SFSP中目标定位效率低下的提示性证据。

records.title_en: Do color-coded Nutrition Facts Panels nudge the use of nutrition information?
records.title_cn: 彩色编码营养标签是否促使消费者使用营养信息？
records.abstract_en: Nutrition Facts labels or Nutrition Facts Panel(s) (NFP) are a critical channel for communicating food nutrition information to consumers. A fundamental question is how to help consumers effectively understand and use the label without missing important information. This paper introduces a color-coded NFP and investigates its impacts on information search and consumer behavior, such as attention to information, food choice, and food health perception. Results show that the color-coded NFP attracts more attention than a black-and-white NFP, specifically for nutrients such as fat, sodium, and sugars, which should be limited. Additionally, the color-coded NFP made it easier for consumers to make food purchase decisions and led consumers to make healthier choices for some products (e.g., chips). Finally, the color-coded NFP reduces the time needed and contributes to a more accurate evaluation of the products’ healthiness in the case of chips, reducing the information processing costs and increasing the utilization of information. Our research demonstrates that the color-coded NFP is more attractive, efficient, and effective in delivering nutrition information and contributes to a healthier decision for some products (e.g., chips) than the traditional NFP.
records.abstract_cn: 营养标签或营养事实面板（NFP）是向消费者传达食品营养信息的关键渠道。一个基本问题是如何帮助消费者有效理解和使用标签，而不遗漏重要信息。本文引入了一种彩色编码的NFP，并研究了其对信息搜索和消费者行为的影响，如对信息的关注、食品选择和食品健康感知。结果表明，彩色编码的NFP比黑白NFP吸引了更多关注，特别是对于脂肪、钠和糖等应限制的营养素。此外，彩色编码的NFP使消费者更容易做出食品购买决策，并促使消费者对某些产品（如薯片）做出更健康的选择。最后，彩色编码的NFP减少了所需时间，并在薯片的情况下有助于更准确地评估产品的健康性，降低了信息处理成本并提高了信息利用率。我们的研究表明，与传统NFP相比，彩色编码的NFP在传递营养信息方面更具吸引力、更高效、更有效，并有助于对某些产品（如薯片）做出更健康的决策。

records.title_en: The effects of social norms and observability on food choice
records.title_cn: 社会规范与可观察性对食物选择的影响
records.abstract_en: People often adapt their behavior to the behavior of other people. We test with the help of an experiment whether this also applies to the choice of food and whether the sensitivity regarding others’ behavior increases when the food choice is observable. Participants in the experiment are first-year students who are confronted with different statements about the diets of students already enrolled and studying at the university. Participants then choose between vouchers for vegan, vegetarian, or meat-based foods, with variation as to whether or not this choice is observable. The results show that the overall effects of social norms with and without observability are small and statistically insignificant. This is because women and men respond differently to the interventions; women are much more responsive to social norms than men, especially when their food choice can be observed by others. We discuss how our findings fit with dietary trends and what policy implications they have.
records.abstract_cn: 人们常常使自己的行为适应他人的行为。我们通过实验检验这是否也适用于食物的选择，以及当食物选择可被观察时，对他人行为的敏感性是否增加。实验的参与者是大学一年级学生，他们面对关于已注册并在大学学习的高年级学生饮食的不同陈述。参与者随后在素食、纯素或肉类食品的券之间进行选择，并变化该选择是否可被观察。结果表明，社会规范在有和无可观察性情况下的总体效应较小且统计上不显著。这是因为女性和男性对干预措施的反应不同；女性对社会规范的反应远大于男性，尤其是当她们的食物选择可以被他人观察时。我们讨论了我们的发现如何与饮食趋势相契合，以及它们具有哪些政策含义。

records.title_en: Trends and evolution of global value chains in food and agriculture: Implications for food security and nutrition
records.title_cn: 粮食和农业全球价值链的趋势与演变：对粮食安全和营养的影响
records.abstract_en: Value chains in the food and agricultural sectors are crucial for food systems transformation and economic development. As countries increasingly participate in global agrifood value chains (GAVC), their significance becomes even more pronounced. We highlight stylized facts, evolution, trends, and key players of GAVCs integration between 1990 and 2020 using data from the rich EORA multi-region input–output tables. Following this, we examine the relationship between GAVCs and dietary energy consumption, prevalence of undernourishment, overweight and stunting in low and middle income countries. Employing the Bartik shift share instrumental variable approach and several other identification strategies, we show a positive (negative) association between countries’ participation in GAVCs and dietary energy consumption (prevalence of undernourishment). We underscore substantial heterogeneity by income groups. Generally, results for countries in the upper-middle-income group are consistent with those of the global sample. However, GAVC participation of low-income countries is associated with reduced stunting only, and mixed results are found for lower-middle-income countries, including reduced stunting alongside increased undernourishment and overweight. These findings suggest that integration in global value chains could be conducive for food security and nutrition on the global level and the majority of country income groups, however contextual differences remain. Thus, policies targeting global value chain integration, food security and nutrition should be designed on a country-by-country basis and well-tailored to the specific challenges faced.
records.abstract_cn: 粮食和农业部门的价值链对于粮食系统转型和经济发展至关重要。随着各国越来越多地参与全球农业食品价值链（GAVC），其重要性愈发凸显。我们利用丰富的EORA多区域投入产出表数据，突出展示了1990年至2020年间GAVC整合的典型事实、演变、趋势和主要参与者。随后，我们考察了GAVC与低收入和中等收入国家膳食能量消耗、营养不足发生率、超重和发育迟缓之间的关系。采用Bartik份额转移工具变量方法及其他几种识别策略，我们显示国家参与GAVC与膳食能量消耗（营养不足发生率）之间存在正（负）关联。我们强调了不同收入群体间的显著异质性。总体而言，中高收入组国家的结果与全球样本一致。然而，低收入国家的GAVC参与仅与发育迟缓减少相关，而中低收入国家的结果则混合，包括发育迟缓减少伴随营养不足和超重增加。这些发现表明，融入全球价值链可能有利于全球层面及大多数国家收入群体的粮食安全和营养，但背景差异仍然存在。因此，针对全球价值链整合、粮食安全和营养的政策应逐国制定，并针对所面临的具体挑战进行量身定制。

records.title_en: Dairy trade liberalization and child stunting: Evidence from low- and middle-income countries
records.title_cn: 乳制品贸易自由化与儿童发育迟缓：来自低收入和中等收入国家的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite the well-studied nutritional benefits of dairy for child linear growth, dairy is less consumed in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) where the prevalence of child stunting is high. Previous studies have suggested the cost of dairy as a potential barrier to increased dairy consumption in these countries. Surprisingly, little research on the association between dairy consumption and child stunting in LMICs focuses on the role of trade policies, particularly the liberalization of dairy trade. To explore this, we use representative cross-country individual data on child stunting from 2006 to 2020 and link it with country-level dairy trade data. We find that a 10% decline in dairy tariff rates reduces the risk of stunting by 7.78%. Our results are robust to a subsample analysis excluding countries which joined the WTO after 2000 and to an alternative clustering method. As a falsification test, our results show child stunting is not linked with tariffs for coffee and tea. Heterogeneity analysis indicates the associations are more pronounced for boys, children aged 3–5, and children from households with lower socioeconomic status. Although we did not find significant rural–urban differences, the associations are indeed stronger for households without cattle and for countries in Western Africa, South East Asia and Europe and Central Asia. Mechanism analysis suggests that dairy tariffs are positively correlated with milk prices, while they are negatively associated with dairy import values. Lower dairy tariffs are also found to be linked with higher probability of child dairy consumption. Our findings highlight the importance of removing tariff barriers in reducing the cost of dairy and promoting dairy consumption in LMICs. This study has implications for repurposing dairy trade policies in creating nutrition-sensitive agriculture.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管乳制品对儿童线性生长的营养益处已被充分研究，但在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），乳制品消费较少，而这些国家儿童发育迟缓的患病率很高。以往研究提出，乳制品的成本可能是这些国家增加乳制品消费的潜在障碍。令人惊讶的是，关于LMICs中乳制品消费与儿童发育迟缓之间关联的研究很少关注贸易政策的作用，特别是乳制品贸易自由化。为探讨这一问题，我们使用了2006年至2020年具有代表性的跨国个体儿童发育迟缓数据，并将其与国家层面的乳制品贸易数据相关联。我们发现，乳制品关税税率下降10%可使发育迟缓风险降低7.78%。我们的结果在排除2000年后加入WTO的国家的子样本分析以及替代聚类方法下依然稳健。作为证伪检验，我们的结果显示儿童发育迟缓与咖啡和茶的关税无关。异质性分析表明，这种关联在男孩、3-5岁儿童以及社会经济地位较低家庭的儿童中更为显著。尽管我们未发现显著的城乡差异，但无牛家庭以及西非、东南亚、欧洲和中亚国家的关联确实更强。机制分析表明，乳制品关税与牛奶价格正相关，而与乳制品进口值负相关。较低的乳制品关税还与儿童乳制品消费概率较高相关。我们的发现强调了消除关税壁垒在降低乳制品成本和促进LMICs乳制品消费中的重要性。本研究对重新定位乳制品贸易政策以创建营养敏感型农业具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Who values urban community gardens and how much?
records.title_cn: 谁重视城市社区花园，重视程度如何？
records.abstract_en: With the rising interest in urban agriculture (UA), community gardens have emerged as a common instrument in UA policies aimed at addressing issues related to food security, environmental sustainability, and equality in urban development. As an impure public good, they deliver both private benefits, such as fresh produce, and public benefits, including ecosystem services. However, there has been limited research estimating the value of various features of community gardens. Consequently, assessing the benefit–cost ratio of community garden development policies is a challenging task. Furthermore, many existing community gardens might have been established without a comprehensive understanding of public preferences. To address this gap, we adopt a discrete choice experiment to quantify residents’ willingness to contribute money and time to community gardens in Los Angeles County, California. Our findings indicate that while residents highly value the gardens’ private benefits, they are not inclined to contribute to their public benefits. Additionally, residents’ preferences for community gardens differ based on their socioeconomic status and level of accumulated gardening experience.
records.abstract_cn: 随着对城市农业（UA）兴趣的日益增长，社区花园已成为城市农业政策中常见的工具，旨在解决与粮食安全、环境可持续性和城市发展平等相关的问题。作为一种非纯公共物品，它们既提供私人利益，如新鲜农产品，也提供公共利益，包括生态系统服务。然而，评估社区花园各种特征价值的研究有限。因此，评估社区花园发展政策的效益-成本比是一项具有挑战性的任务。此外，许多现有的社区花园可能是在没有全面了解公众偏好的情况下建立的。为弥补这一空白，我们采用离散选择实验来量化加利福尼亚州洛杉矶县居民对社区花园贡献金钱和时间的意愿。我们的研究结果表明，虽然居民高度重视花园的私人利益，但他们并不倾向于为其公共利益做出贡献。此外，居民对社区花园的偏好因其社会经济地位和积累的园艺经验水平而异。

records.title_en: How does recall bias in farm labor impact separability tests?
records.title_cn: 农业劳动力回忆偏差如何影响可分性检验？
records.abstract_en: In the agricultural household literature, empirical tests of separability between production and consumption decisions commonly exploit theoretical predictions of household labor allocation. Many of these studies rely on data that asks respondents to recall labor usage over the entire growing season. Two recent field experiments in Tanzania and Ghana show that such labor use data, collected at the end of the growing season, is a systematically unreliable measure of actual labor allocation. In this study, we examine how inaccurate measures of labor influence the reliability of market failure tests based on separability. In Ghana, we find no statistical evidence that recall bias influences the reliability of the separability test. In Tanzania, we find that recall bias increases the probability that such tests fail to reject separability. Thus, we find partial evidence that classic tests based on typical household survey labor data may erroneously conclude that markets are adequately functioning.
records.abstract_cn: 在农业家庭文献中，关于生产与消费决策可分性的实证检验通常利用家庭劳动力配置的理论预测。许多此类研究依赖于要求受访者回忆整个生长季节劳动力使用情况的数据。最近在坦桑尼亚和加纳进行的两项田间实验表明，这种在生长季节结束时收集的劳动力使用数据，是对实际劳动力配置的系统性不可靠度量。在本研究中，我们考察了劳动力测量的不准确性如何影响基于可分性的市场失灵检验的可靠性。在加纳，我们没有发现统计证据表明回忆偏差影响可分性检验的可靠性。在坦桑尼亚，我们发现回忆偏差增加了此类检验未能拒绝可分性的概率。因此，我们发现了部分证据表明，基于典型家庭调查劳动力数据的经典检验可能错误地得出市场功能正常的结论。

records.title_en: How do regional and demographic differences in diets affect the health and environmental impact in China?
records.title_cn: 中国饮食的地区和人口差异如何影响健康与环境影响？
records.abstract_en: A higher diet quality has been associated with lower environmental impacts, but not consistently. Considering the cultural diversity of dietary habits and the heterogeneity of socioeconomic development in China, we aimed to evaluate the association between diet quality and environmental impacts across demographic subgroups and regions. This study used dietary consumption data from the China Health Nutrition Survey 2011. Diet quality was measured with the Chinese Healthy Eating Index 2016 (CHEI2016). Diet-related environmental impact (Greenhouse Gas Emissions (GHGE), Total Water Use (TWU), and Land Use (LU)) were estimated using the Chinese Food Life Cycle Assessment Database. Multilevel regression models were used to quantify the association of the CHEI2016 score and the diet-related environmental impacts across heterogeneous population subgroups. A one-standard deviation increase in CHEI2016 score was associated with an increase of 9.7% in GHGE, 9.1% in TWU, and 6.4% in LU. This occurs because increasing the consumption of under-consumed foods (dairy products and fruit), partially offsets the environmental benefits of reduced meat consumption. Demographic subgroups characterized by either higher educated or a higher income exhibited a larger proportion of animal-based foods within their diet, consequently leading to higher diet-related environmental impacts. When expressed per standard deviation increase in CHEI2016, the dietary environmental impacts rose fastest in the Metropolitan area and slowest in the Northeast. Diets with higher CHEI2016 scores are associated with higher diet-related environmental impacts among Chinese adults but this varies per region. The development of sustainable diet strategies needs to account for potential trade-off between the health and environmental goals, and dietary habits of consumers in different regions and subpopulations.
records.abstract_cn: 较高的饮食质量与较低的环境影响相关，但并非始终一致。考虑到中国饮食文化的多样性和社会经济发展的异质性，我们旨在评估不同人口亚组和地区饮食质量与环境影响之间的关联。本研究使用了中国健康与营养调查2011的膳食消费数据。饮食质量采用中国健康饮食指数2016（CHEI2016）衡量。饮食相关环境影响（温室气体排放（GHGE）、总用水量（TWU）和土地利用（LU））使用中国食品生命周期评估数据库进行估算。采用多水平回归模型量化CHEI2016评分与不同人群亚组饮食相关环境影响之间的关联。CHEI2016评分每增加一个标准差，GHGE增加9.7%，TWU增加9.1%，LU增加6.4%。这是因为增加消费不足的食物（乳制品和水果）的消费，部分抵消了减少肉类消费带来的环境效益。受教育程度较高或收入较高的人口亚组，其饮食中动物性食品比例较大，从而导致较高的饮食相关环境影响。按CHEI2016每增加一个标准差表示时，都市区饮食环境影响上升最快，东北地区最慢。CHEI2016评分较高的饮食与中国成年人较高的饮食相关环境影响相关，但这一关联因地区而异。可持续饮食策略的制定需要考虑健康与环境目标之间的潜在权衡，以及不同地区和亚人群消费者的饮食习惯。

records.title_en: Submitted and Denied: Understanding variation in case status across Supplemental Nutrition assistance program (SNAP) applications
records.title_cn: 提交与拒绝：理解补充营养援助计划（SNAP）申请中案件状态的差异
records.abstract_en: Our study investigates the application process for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and barriers to successful SNAP participation among potentially eligible households. We know that only 84 percent of eligible individuals in the United States participated in SNAP prior to the COVID-19 pandemic. Our objective is to understand continued barriers to SNAP participation among eligible applicants by analyzing Indiana households that have formally engaged in the SNAP application process. We examine census-tract-level data from Indiana’s administrator of SNAP benefits, Family and Social Services Administration (FSSA), in combination with census-tract-level socioeconomic data from 2017 to 2019. We use existing methodologies in micro- and macro-level socioeconomic analysis of SNAP participation to examine not only the terminal participation rate (approved applications) but also the dynamics of the application process that starts with a larger pool of applicants (submitted applications) and may end with a non-participation case status (denied applications). Our linear and quantile regression analyses also seek to understand these socioeconomic factors as predictors of the response distribution of SNAP case status across communities with different rates of application submissions and denials. Our analysis of Indiana SNAP applications supports anecdotal findings that one of the most difficult hurdles in the application process is timely navigation of the paperwork and interview requirements with evidence of increased time in the application process for communities with high SNAP denial rates. We also find that broader socioeconomic trends in a community are associated with application submission rates while applicants’ personal circumstances better predict denial rates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们的研究调查了补充营养援助计划（SNAP）的申请过程，以及潜在符合条件的家庭成功参与SNAP的障碍。我们知道，在COVID-19大流行之前，美国只有84%的符合条件的个人参与了SNAP。我们的目标是通过分析印第安纳州正式参与SNAP申请过程的家庭，来理解符合条件的申请者参与SNAP的持续障碍。我们结合印第安纳州SNAP福利管理者——家庭与社会服务管理局（FSSA）的人口普查区级数据，以及2017年至2019年的人口普查区级社会经济数据。我们使用现有的微观和宏观层面SNAP参与的社会经济分析方法，不仅考察最终参与率（批准的申请），还考察申请过程的动态，该过程始于更大的申请者池（提交的申请），可能以非参与案件状态（被拒绝的申请）结束。我们的线性和分位数回归分析也旨在理解这些社会经济因素作为SNAP案件状态响应分布的预测因子，在不同申请提交率和拒绝率的社区中。我们对印第安纳州SNAP申请的分析支持了轶事发现，即申请过程中最困难的障碍之一是及时处理文书工作和面试要求，证据表明在SNAP拒绝率高的社区，申请过程时间增加。我们还发现，社区更广泛的社会经济趋势与申请提交率相关，而申请者的个人情况更能预测拒绝率。

records.title_en: Diet and disease: Examining the seasonal determinants of children’s health in Senegal
records.title_cn: 饮食与疾病：考察塞内加尔儿童健康的季节性决定因素
records.abstract_en: Seasonal changes in food availability and disease incidence put pressure on children’s health in Sub-Sahara Africa. Using year-round survey data from Senegal, we examine how seasonality in key health inputs (dietary diversity, diarrhea, and fever) helps predict seasonality in children’s health (weight-for-height z-score). We first parameterize seasonal variation in health and health inputs using second-order trigonometric polynomials, then decompose the seasonal curve of children’s health into component parts explained by seasonality in each health input. We find that lagged seasonality in disease incidence predicts seasonality in child health, while seasonality in dietary diversity does not — likely because diets are poor in Senegal even during the most food-plentiful part of the year. We also observe noticeable heterogeneity in the way these health inputs predict children’s health across different wealth levels and regions.
records.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区食物供应和疾病发病率的季节性变化给儿童健康带来压力。利用塞内加尔的全年调查数据，我们考察了关键健康投入（饮食多样性、腹泻和发烧）的季节性如何有助于预测儿童健康（身高别体重z分数）的季节性。我们首先使用二阶三角多项式对健康和健康投入的季节性变化进行参数化，然后将儿童健康的季节性曲线分解为由各健康投入的季节性解释的组成部分。我们发现，疾病发病率的滞后季节性预测了儿童健康的季节性，而饮食多样性的季节性则没有——这可能是因为即使在一年中食物最丰富的时期，塞内加尔的饮食也很差。我们还观察到这些健康投入在不同财富水平和地区预测儿童健康的方式存在显著异质性。

records.title_en: Economic impacts of a disease outbreak in Canada’s pork industry: Case of a price-taking, open country
records.title_cn: 加拿大养猪业疾病爆发的经济影响：价格接受型开放经济体的案例
records.abstract_en: The world has been experiencing a notable increase in disease outbreaks that have resulted in significant economic impacts and loss of life, both human and livestock. Here we consider the economic impacts of such an outbreak in a small (price-taking), open country case. Specifically, we consider a generic disease outbreak in the Canadian pork industry. The economic costs and animal welfare impacts of a disease outbreak in swine could prove devastating to Canada’s pork industry, due to potential border closures and large-scale animal depopulation. We build a multi-region, partial equilibrium trade model composed of three Canadian regions (Ontario, Quebec, and Western Canada), the United States, and the rest of the world. The partial equilibrium model imposes the appropriate zero feedback assumption (across world markets and domestic substitutes). Each Canadian region has a vertically integrated supply chain beginning with the breeding herd, progressing through the live animal market, processors, to end consumers with trade across regions within each of those markets. We estimate the Canadian economic impacts of a disease outbreak occurring in excess of $3.6 billion. The closure of international borders to exports is shown to be the dominant economic impact. Significant producer and processor losses are marginally offset by consumer benefits.
records.abstract_cn: 世界范围内疾病爆发显著增加，造成了重大的经济影响和生命损失，包括人类和牲畜。在此，我们考虑一个小型（价格接受型）开放经济体中此类爆发的经济影响。具体而言，我们考虑加拿大养猪业中一种普通疾病爆发的情况。由于潜在的边境关闭和大规模动物扑杀，猪群疾病爆发的经济成本和动物福利影响可能对加拿大养猪业造成毁灭性打击。我们构建了一个由三个加拿大地区（安大略省、魁北克省和加拿大西部）、美国以及世界其他地区组成的多区域局部均衡贸易模型。该局部均衡模型施加了适当的零反馈假设（跨越世界市场和国内替代品）。每个加拿大地区都有一个纵向整合的供应链，从种畜群开始，经过活体动物市场、加工商，最终到达最终消费者，并在这些市场内部进行跨区域贸易。我们估计，疾病爆发对加拿大造成的经济影响超过3.6亿美元。国际边境对出口的关闭被证明是主要的经济影响。显著的生产者和加工者损失被消费者收益略微抵消。

records.title_en: Impacts of supermarkets on child nutrition in China
records.title_cn: 超市对中国儿童营养的影响
records.abstract_en: In many emerging countries, agri-food value chains are transforming rapidly. One emblematic trend is the proliferation of supermarkets and other modern retailers. Supermarkets affect the way supply chains are organized and may also influence the types of foods purchased and eaten by consumers. Research on what this means for people’s diets and nutrition is still relatively scant. Here, we analyze the effects of supermarkets on child diets and nutrition in China, using nationally representative panel data with information on households’ access to supermarkets and individual-level dietary and anthropometric indicators. Employing a variety of difference-in-difference approaches, we find that improved access to supermarkets leads to higher child dietary diversity and nutrient intakes, especially among children in rural areas and from low-income households. Supermarkets are also found to increase child height, but not weight. The positive nutritional effects are mediated through supermarkets contributing to more variety in local food supplies and lower average food prices. Our findings suggest that the spread of supermarkets has improved child dietary quality and nutrition in China.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多新兴国家，农业食品价值链正在迅速转型。一个具有象征意义的趋势是超市和其他现代零售商的激增。超市影响了供应链的组织方式，也可能影响消费者购买和食用的食品类型。关于这对人们饮食和营养意味着什么的研究仍然相对匮乏。在此，我们利用具有全国代表性的面板数据，分析超市对中国儿童饮食和营养的影响，这些数据包含家庭获取超市的信息以及个人层面的饮食和人体测量指标。采用多种双重差分方法，我们发现超市可及性的提高导致儿童饮食多样性和营养素摄入量增加，尤其是在农村地区和低收入家庭的儿童中。超市还发现能增加儿童身高，但不增加体重。积极的营养效应是通过超市促进当地食品供应多样化和降低平均食品价格来实现的。我们的研究结果表明，超市的普及改善了中国儿童的饮食质量和营养状况。

records.title_en: Dairy consumption and household diet quality in East Africa: Evidence from survey-based simulation models
records.title_cn: 东非乳制品消费与家庭膳食质量：基于调查模拟模型的证据
records.abstract_en: Dairy foods are an important source of essential macro- and micronutrients in household diets, and their consumption is associated with reduced malnutrition, especially among young children. Low dairy consumption in many developing countries is a justification for programs that promote dairy livestock ownership, help develop dairy value chains, or stimulate dairy demand. While several studies confirm the beneficial effects of such dairy-specific interventions on nutritional outcomes, the purpose in this study is to consider more broadly the contribution of dairy to overall diet quality. Our assessment of consumer preferences for dairy, coupled with simulations of consumption responses to dairy price and household income changes, provide quantitative evidence that can inform policymakers about the possible effects of public policies on dairy consumption and diet quality. While our analysis is based on data from Kenya and Uganda, both countries with established dairy sectors, our findings are relevant for other East African countries with similar dietary patterns and emergent dairy sectors.
records.abstract_cn: 乳制品是家庭膳食中必需宏量和微量营养素的重要来源，其消费与营养不良的减少相关，尤其是在幼儿中。许多发展中国家乳制品消费量低，这为促进乳畜拥有、帮助发展乳制品价值链或刺激乳制品需求的项目提供了理由。虽然几项研究证实了此类乳制品特定干预措施对营养结果的有益影响，但本研究的目的更广泛地考虑乳制品对整体膳食质量的贡献。我们对消费者乳制品偏好的评估，结合对乳制品价格和家庭收入变化消费反应的模拟，提供了定量证据，可为政策制定者提供关于公共政策对乳制品消费和膳食质量可能影响的信息。虽然我们的分析基于肯尼亚和乌干达的数据，这两个国家都有成熟的乳制品行业，但我们的发现与其他具有类似饮食模式和新兴乳制品行业的东非国家相关。

records.title_en: Agricultural commodities’ price transmission from international to local markets in developing countries
records.title_cn: 发展中国家农产品价格从国际市场向本地市场的传导
records.abstract_en: The transmission of commodities prices from international to local markets is an interesting and deeply investigated topic. A fast and strong link between the two levels of the market is seen by economists as a sign of local market efficiency, allowing actors to respond fast to signals coming from the international market. However, empirical evidence on the topic is mixed, ranging from a very weak linkage between prices in the two markets to a high-speed and almost complete transmission. The present paper aims to advance the knowledge on the topic by focusing on the price transmission of four main cereals – maize, rice, sorghum, and wheat – in 23 developing and fragile economies. Employing a recent World Bank dataset with prices for several local markets in select countries, we estimate panel vector autoregressions (PVAR) to analyze the pass-through effects of international price shocks on local food prices. We find evidence for a relatively strong price transmission elasticity for all commodities except sorghum. Furthermore, the observed transmission of shocks is almost immediate. We present the policy implications of these findings.
records.abstract_cn: 商品价格从国际市场向本地市场的传导是一个有趣且被深入探讨的话题。经济学家将两个市场层面之间快速而紧密的联系视为本地市场效率的标志，使参与者能够对来自国际市场的信号迅速作出反应。然而，关于该主题的实证证据不一，从两个市场价格之间的非常弱联系到高速且几乎完全的传导不等。本文旨在通过关注四种主要谷物——玉米、大米、高粱和小麦——在23个发展中及脆弱经济体中的价格传导，来推进对该主题的认识。利用世界银行近期包含若干选定国家多个本地市场价格的数据集，我们估计面板向量自回归（PVAR）以分析国际价格冲击对本地食品价格的传递效应。我们发现除高粱外，所有商品的价格传导弹性相对较强。此外，观察到的冲击传导几乎是即时的。我们提出了这些发现的政策含义。

records.title_en: Tax on sugary drinks in Brazil: Simulation of impacts on the purchases of non-alcoholic drinks and family welfare
records.title_cn: 巴西含糖饮料税：对非酒精饮料购买和家庭福利影响的模拟
records.abstract_en: The objective of this study is to simulate possible impacts of adopting sugary drinks tax policies on the purchases of non-alcoholic beverages and on Brazilian family welfare, aiming to contribute with empirical evidence for Bill No. 2183, of 2019, pending in the Federal Senate, also known as CIDE-Soft Drinks. To simulate different tax scenarios, price and expenditure elasticities of non-alcoholic beverages were measured using the QUAIDS model with adaptations for zero expenditure and expenditure and price endogeneity problems. Based on the Household Budget Survey data of 2017–2018, three scenarios of fiscal policies were simulated: (1) adoption of a 20% tax on sugary drinks (CIDE-Soft Drinks); (2) adoption of a 20% tax on the price of sugary and sweetened drinks; and (3) a 20% tax on sugary drinks combined with a 41.51% subsidy on water price aiming at a neutral revenue. The results show that scenario 3 would provide greater reductions in the purchase of sugary drinks and stimulate the consumption of water. The effects of this kind of tax are greater for low-income families.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在模拟采用含糖饮料税政策对非酒精饮料购买和巴西家庭福利可能产生的影响，旨在为联邦参议院待审的第2183号法案（2019年），即所谓的CIDE-软饮料，提供实证证据。为模拟不同的税收情景，使用QUAIDS模型并针对零支出以及支出和价格内生性问题进行适应性调整，测量了非酒精饮料的价格和支出弹性。基于2017-2018年家庭预算调查数据，模拟了三种财政政策情景：(1)对含糖饮料征收20%的税（CIDE-软饮料）；(2)对含糖和加糖饮料价格征收20%的税；以及(3)对含糖饮料征收20%的税，同时结合对水价41.51%的补贴，以实现收入中性。结果表明，情景3将更大程度地减少含糖饮料的购买，并刺激水的消费。此类税收对低收入家庭的影响更大。

records.title_en: Trends in the school lunch program: Changes in selection, nutrition & health
records.title_cn: 学校午餐计划的趋势：选择、营养与健康的变化
records.abstract_en: There has been significant national attention to the issue of childhood obesity, leading policymakers to reform the National School Lunch Program (NSLP) to include stricter nutritional requirements. We use data on school lunch menus to document improvements in the nutritional quality of school meals between 1991 and 2010. We then evaluate how this change in nutritional content maps into obesity outcomes, using panel data on a nationally representative cohort of children, tracking them from kindergarten entry in fall 2010 through the end of fifth grade in spring 2016. We find little evidence that participation in the school lunch program leads to weight gain, as measured by changes in obesity, overweight, and BMI. These results suggest that improvements in the nutritional content of school lunches have been largely successful in reversing the previously negative relationship between school lunches and childhood obesity.
records.abstract_cn: 全国范围内对儿童肥胖问题给予了高度关注，促使政策制定者改革国家学校午餐计划（NSLP），纳入更严格的营养要求。我们利用学校午餐菜单数据，记录了1991年至2010年间学校膳食营养质量的改善情况。随后，我们使用一个具有全国代表性的儿童队列的面板数据，从2010年秋季进入幼儿园追踪至2016年春季五年级结束，评估了这一营养内容变化如何映射到肥胖结果上。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明参与学校午餐计划会导致体重增加，以肥胖、超重和BMI的变化来衡量。这些结果表明，学校午餐营养内容的改善在很大程度上成功扭转了学校午餐与儿童肥胖之间先前存在的负相关关系。

records.title_en: Evidence for initiating food safety policy: An assessment of the quality and safety of donated food at an Australian food bank
records.title_cn: 启动食品安全政策的证据：对澳大利亚一家食物银行捐赠食品质量和安全的评估
records.abstract_en: Food banks play a vital role in addressing the needs of people experiencing food insecurity. Food banks rely on the food industry, particularly supermarkets, for food donations, and on voluntary labor to scrutinize and sort donations for quality and safety. Currently, national food safety laws and policies in Australia regulate food businesses, but do not specifically apply to donations. There are reports of expired, spoiled, and rotten food donations and clients express dissatisfaction with the quality and safety of food provided. This study describes a novel approach to visually identify and assess the safety and quality of food donations at an Australian food bank. Data from an audit of donations to a metropolitan food bank were analyzed. Food safety assessment criterion were developed based on food safety standards and applied to 1217 items (84,996 kg) of donated food. Each product was visually inspected and assessed as ‘safe’, ‘unsuitable’, ‘potentially unsafe’, or ‘unsafe for human consumption’ upon receival. Of the 84,996 kg of donated food, 96 % was categorized as satisfactory and 4 % (3761 kg) was categorized as either unsafe (2024 kg), potentially unsafe (1313 kg) or unsuitable (424 kg) for consumption. Supermarket donations comprised 90 % (by weight) of the unsafe and unsuitable food. The overall proportion of visually unsafe and unsuitable foods was low, but consumption of any unsafe, hazardous and/or damaged products poses a risk to the consumer. Given the vulnerability of clients receiving this food, the public health risk is high. The management of potential risk is problematic too as multiple decisions to determine appropriateness for distribution, places demands on food banks and hampers efficiency. The findings underscore the clear need for a specific food safety regulatory framework for donated food in Australia.
records.abstract_cn: 食物银行在解决食物不安全人群的需求方面发挥着至关重要的作用。食物银行依赖食品行业，特别是超市，提供食品捐赠，并依赖志愿劳动来检查和分类捐赠品的质量和安全。目前，澳大利亚的国家食品安全法律和政策对食品企业进行监管，但并不具体适用于捐赠品。有报告称存在过期、变质和腐烂的食品捐赠，客户对所提供的食品质量和安全表示不满。本研究描述了一种新颖的方法，用于在澳大利亚一家食物银行视觉识别和评估食品捐赠的安全性和质量。对一家都市食物银行捐赠品的审计数据进行了分析。基于食品安全标准制定了食品安全评估标准，并应用于1217件（84,996公斤）捐赠食品。每件产品在接收时进行视觉检查，并评估为“安全”、“不适合”、“可能不安全”或“不适合人类食用”。在84,996公斤捐赠食品中，96%被归类为满意，4%（3761公斤）被归类为不安全（2024公斤）、可能不安全（1313公斤）或不适合食用（424公斤）。超市捐赠占不安全和不适合食品的90%（按重量计）。视觉上不安全和不适合食品的总体比例较低，但食用任何不安全、危险和/或损坏的产品都会对消费者构成风险。鉴于接受这些食品的客户的脆弱性，公共卫生风险很高。潜在风险的管理也存在问题，因为确定分配适宜性的多重决策给食物银行带来了压力，并阻碍了效率。研究结果强调了澳大利亚制定针对捐赠食品的具体食品安全监管框架的明确必要性。

records.title_en: Insuring consumption against Shocks: The role of informal savings in Nigeria
records.title_cn: 保障消费免受冲击：尼日利亚非正式储蓄的作用
records.abstract_en: In most low-income countries, households are exposed to a plethora of economic shocks with welfare-reducing consequences. In the absence of well-functioning financial markets, most households rely on informal savings through credit clubs/groups to reduce their vulnerability to these shocks. In this paper, we examine the extent to which participation in informal savings associations affects the ability of households to smooth their consumption in the face of both idiosyncratic and covariate shocks. Using a difference-in-difference fixed effects specification on the Nigerian household-level panel that spans four waves over eight years, with data collected in 2010/2011, 2012/2013, 2015/2016 and 2018/2019, we documented heterogenous effects of informal savings. The results suggest that informal savings help households to hedge consumption against rainfall shocks. We find heterogeneous effects of informal savings in insuring consumption against idiosyncratic shocks, depending on whether households live in urban or rural areas. These results provide new insights into the role of informal financial arrangements in sub-Saharan Africa.
records.abstract_cn: 在大多数低收入国家，家庭面临众多经济冲击，这些冲击会降低福利。在金融市场功能不健全的情况下，大多数家庭通过信贷俱乐部/团体的非正式储蓄来减少对这些冲击的脆弱性。在本文中，我们考察了参与非正式储蓄协会对家庭在面对特质性和协变量冲击时平滑消费能力的影响程度。利用尼日利亚家庭层面面板数据，该数据跨越八年四轮，数据收集于2010/2011、2012/2013、2015/2016和2018/2019年，我们采用双重差分固定效应模型，记录了非正式储蓄的异质性效应。结果表明，非正式储蓄帮助家庭对冲降雨冲击对消费的影响。我们发现非正式储蓄在保障消费免受特质性冲击方面存在异质性效应，这取决于家庭居住在城市还是农村地区。这些结果为撒哈拉以南非洲非正式金融安排的作用提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Effect of input subsidies and extension services: Evidence from rice productivity in Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 投入品补贴与推广服务的效果：来自孟加拉国水稻生产力的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines the effect of agricultural input subsidy cards and extension services on Bangladesh’s rice productivity, using plot level panel data from three waves (2011–2019) of the Bangladesh Integrated Household Survey. To control for endogeneity of the two programs, instrumental variable and control function approaches are used. Findings reveal that access to input subsidy cards and extension services raise productivity in rice-planted plots by nearly 20% and 22%, respectively. Further, the channels and type of advisory services matter. Finally, access to input subsidy cards and extension services is more beneficial in areas prone to droughts and excessive rainfall. These findings underscore the value of complementary investments in robust extension systems, especially in vulnerable regions, to optimize the performance of input subsidy programs. Expanded extension services coupled with input subsidies can be an effective policy mix to raise productivity, strengthen climate resilience, and promote inclusive agricultural growth in Bangladesh.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用孟加拉国综合住户调查三轮（2011-2019年）的地块层面面板数据，考察农业投入品补贴卡和推广服务对孟加拉国水稻生产力的影响。为控制这两个项目的内生性，采用了工具变量和控制函数方法。研究发现，获得投入品补贴卡和推广服务分别使水稻种植地块的生产力提高近20%和22%。此外，咨询服务的渠道和类型也很重要。最后，在易受干旱和过量降雨影响的地区，获得投入品补贴卡和推广服务更为有益。这些发现强调了在脆弱地区加强推广系统等互补性投资的价值，以优化投入品补贴项目的绩效。扩大推广服务与投入品补贴相结合，可以成为提高生产力、增强气候韧性并促进孟加拉国包容性农业增长的有效政策组合。

records.title_en: Choice experiments and Value-Chain modeling of attribute improvements to increase vegetable consumption in Kenya
records.title_cn: 选择实验与价值链建模：肯尼亚增加蔬菜消费的属性改进研究
records.abstract_en: Improvement of diets through increasing consumption of fruits and vegetables is of global importance. However, existing information about the factors affecting fruit and vegetable consumption often is insufficient for the development and implementation of effective policy and programmatic efforts. This research integrates choice experiments evaluating five potential attribute improvements (two quality levels, safety/hygiene, pre-cutting and lower acquisition time costs) with participatory value-chain modeling to evaluate the potential impact of these attribute improvements on spinach consumption in Kenya. Choice experiment data from 300 households in six counties of Kenya, analyzed with random parameter logit and panel Tobit models indicates quality, safety and hygiene, and acquisition time affect purchase probabilities and expected purchase quantity, but the effect of increased convenience is lower. Analyses with a dynamic value-chain model including farmers, marketing intermediaries, vendors and consumers indicate that all of the attribute improvements would increase consumption even in light of higher value-chain costs, but also facilitate larger sales and profits by value chain actors. These results suggest that a focus on increasing demand through the improvement of product attributes may be an important strategy for simultaneously increasing fruit and vegetable consumption and benefitting value chain participants in low- and middle-income country settings.
records.abstract_cn: 通过增加水果和蔬菜消费来改善饮食具有全球重要性。然而，现有关于影响水果和蔬菜消费因素的信息往往不足以制定和实施有效的政策和计划性努力。本研究将评估五种潜在属性改进（两个质量水平、安全/卫生、预切和降低获取时间成本）的选择实验与参与式价值链建模相结合，以评估这些属性改进对肯尼亚菠菜消费的潜在影响。来自肯尼亚六个县300户家庭的选择实验数据，采用随机参数logit和面板Tobit模型分析，表明质量、安全和卫生以及获取时间影响购买概率和预期购买量，但便利性增加的效果较低。使用包括农民、营销中介、商贩和消费者在内的动态价值链模型进行的分析表明，所有属性改进即使在价值链成本较高的情况下也会增加消费，同时也促进价值链参与者更大的销售和利润。这些结果表明，通过改进产品属性来关注需求增加可能是同时增加水果和蔬菜消费并使中低收入国家环境中的价值链参与者受益的重要策略。

records.title_en: What drives the reduction in sodium intake? Evidence from scanner data
records.title_cn: 什么推动了钠摄入量的减少？来自扫描数据的证据
records.abstract_en: Some evidence suggests that sodium intake in the United States has been declining, but little is known about the driving forces behind this trend. We construct detailed, barcode-level information on the near-universe of packaged food products to isolate and quantify the role that product reformulation, vis-à-vis consumer purchasing behavior, has played in this decline. We find that product reformulation has been a driving force in the decline. Consumers, on the contrary, have gravitated towards saltier products. We provide analyses across socioeconomic and demographic groups and find that disparities in diet quality have exacerbated over time. We discuss the implications of our findings for effective diet improvement policies.
records.abstract_cn: 一些证据表明，美国的钠摄入量一直在下降，但人们对这一趋势背后的驱动力知之甚少。我们构建了近乎所有包装食品产品的详细条形码级信息，以隔离并量化产品重新配方相对于消费者购买行为在这一下降中所起的作用。我们发现，产品重新配方是下降的驱动力。相反，消费者却倾向于选择更咸的产品。我们提供了跨社会经济和人口群体的分析，并发现饮食质量的差距随时间加剧。我们讨论了我们的发现对有效饮食改善政策的影响。

records.title_en: Food choices at a client choice food pantry: Do low-income pantry users respond to changed opportunity costs?
records.title_cn: 客户选择食品储藏室中的食物选择：低收入储藏室使用者是否会对改变的机会成本做出反应？
records.abstract_en: Client choice food pantries allow individuals, many of whom are food insecure, to select a preferred bundle of food. To date, interventions to improve the nutrition of food choices in pantries have not included price incentive programs like those employed in the retail food sector because pantries do not charge for food. However, economic incentives may still play a role in food pantry choices through choice architecture. We examined a natural experiment involving two client-choice regimes that effectively altered the opportunity cost of food selections. Longitudinal individual fixed effects models provide evidence that pantry clients responded to changed opportunity costs by selecting more foods that became relatively less expensive and fewer foods that became relatively more costly. Our study highlights the impact of choice architecture, and in particular relative trade-offs, on food selections in the food pantry context.
records.abstract_cn: 客户选择食品储藏室允许个人（其中许多人是食品不安全者）选择他们偏好的食品组合。迄今为止，改善储藏室食物选择营养的干预措施尚未包括像零售食品部门采用的价格激励计划，因为储藏室不收取食物费用。然而，经济激励仍可能通过选择架构在食品储藏室的选择中发挥作用。我们考察了一个涉及两种客户选择制度的自然实验，这两种制度有效地改变了食物选择的机会成本。纵向个体固定效应模型提供的证据表明，储藏室客户对改变的机会成本做出了反应，选择了更多相对变得便宜的食物，而减少了相对变得昂贵的食物。我们的研究强调了选择架构，特别是相对权衡，在食品储藏室背景下对食物选择的影响。

records.title_en: Public preferences for meat tax attributes in The Netherlands: A discrete choice experiment
records.title_cn: 荷兰肉类税属性的公众偏好：一项离散选择实验
records.abstract_en: To stay within global environmental boundaries, the food system requires significant changes. In this context, a tax on meat products is frequently proposed as a policy measure to stimulate a dietary shift away from meat products. Understanding public preferences for the design of such a tax may serve as a starting point for increasing its political feasibility. Our paper explores public preferences for meat tax attributes among inhabitants of the Netherlands, the most livestock-intensive country in Europe. Using a discrete choice experiment, we estimate relative preferences for the following tax design attributes: (i) use of tax revenues; (ii) products under taxation; and (iii) joint efforts by other countries. Our results indicate that Dutch people significantly prefer a meat tax that exempts poultry or organic products, is implemented in a joint effort with several other EU countries, and earmarks revenues for specific purposes, with the preference for using revenues to reduce the value-added tax on fruits and vegetables being the strongest. We find significant heterogeneity in these preferences, which we explore using a latent class logit model. While the classes do not exhibit highly distinct socio-economic profiles, they are characterized by a combination of factors such as gender, income levels, and education. Our results may inform ongoing discussions about meat taxation in the Netherlands and contribute to further research on meat tax preferences in other countries.
records.abstract_cn: 为了保持在全球环境边界内，食品系统需要进行重大变革。在此背景下，对肉类产品征税常被提议作为政策手段，以刺激饮食结构从肉类产品转变。了解公众对此类税收设计的偏好，可作为提高其政治可行性的起点。我们的论文探讨了荷兰居民对肉类税属性的公众偏好，荷兰是欧洲畜牧业最密集的国家。通过离散选择实验，我们估计了以下税收设计属性的相对偏好：（i）税收收入的使用；（ii）征税产品；以及（iii）其他国家的联合行动。我们的结果表明，荷兰人显著偏好豁免家禽或有机产品的肉类税，与多个欧盟国家联合实施，并将收入专款专用，其中将收入用于降低水果和蔬菜增值税的偏好最强。我们发现这些偏好存在显著异质性，我们使用潜在类别logit模型进行了探索。虽然各类别并未展现出高度不同的社会经济特征，但它们以性别、收入水平和教育等因素的组合为特征。我们的结果可能为荷兰肉类税的持续讨论提供信息，并有助于其他国家肉类税偏好的进一步研究。

records.title_en: Are dairy farmers willing to pay for improved forage varieties? Experimental evidence from Kenya
records.title_cn: 奶农是否愿意为改良饲草品种付费？来自肯尼亚的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Though improved forage varieties have the potential to supply high quality feed for livestock and optimize livestock nutrition and production, demand for them in developing countries is low. To inform interventions aiming to increase demand for the improved forages such as pricing, we assessed farmers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for different improved seeds and two types of dried feed in Meru County Kenya. We used a mix of sampling strategies to recruit 356 dairy farmers into the study. We used the Becker-De-Groote Marschak (BDM) mechanism to elicit WTP, and a mixed effects model in the analysis. We find that the WTP for the forage products (except one) was below the market prices, and that the WTP differed significantly between farmers in cooperatives and those that were not. For related varieties, none is significantly superior to other varieties in terms of WTP. We also find that farmers who had prior exposure to the forages, larger farm sizes, mainly practiced zero grazing, and owned the livestock were more likely to bid above the market prices. Our results underscore the need for strategies that can lower the prices of the improved forages such as reducing the costs associated with their production, certification, storage, and transportation. Training farmers especially on the benefits of the improved traits can potentially increase the likelihood of farmers paying premiums for the improved traits, an important ingredient for the commercialization of the improved forage products at scale.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管改良饲草品种有潜力为牲畜提供高质量饲料并优化牲畜营养和生产，但发展中国家对其需求较低。为了为旨在提高改良饲草需求（如定价）的干预措施提供信息，我们评估了肯尼亚梅鲁县农民对不同改良种子和两种干饲料的支付意愿（WTP）。我们采用混合抽样策略招募了356名奶农参与研究。我们使用Becker-De-Groote Marschak（BDM）机制来引出WTP，并在分析中使用混合效应模型。我们发现，除一种产品外，饲草产品的WTP低于市场价格，且合作社内农民与非合作社农民的WTP存在显著差异。对于相关品种，在WTP方面没有哪个品种显著优于其他品种。我们还发现，之前接触过饲草、农场规模较大、主要采用零放牧以及拥有牲畜的农民更有可能出价高于市场价格。我们的结果强调了需要采取能够降低改良饲草价格的策略，例如降低其生产、认证、储存和运输相关的成本。对农民进行培训，特别是关于改良性状益处的培训，可能会增加农民为改良性状支付溢价的概率，这是大规模商业化改良饲草产品的重要因素。

records.title_en: Review: Effectiveness and policy implications of health taxes on foods high in fat, salt, and sugar
records.title_cn: 综述：对高脂肪、高盐和高糖食品征收健康税的有效性与政策启示
records.abstract_en: Taxation on food and non-alcoholic beverages are increasingly employed to promote healthier diets and combat the escalating rates of obesity and diet-related non-communicable diseases. While sugar-sweetened beverages have been the primary focus of such taxes, taxation of high-fat, salt, or sugar (HFSS) foods, and the impact of such taxes are less clear. We conducted a systematic literature review and assessment of the evidence gathered from 20 studies on the impacts of health taxes on HFSS foods around the world. We focused on impacts on sales and consumption of taxed foods, on health outcomes, and on possible unintended consequences (e.g., substitution towards unhealthier products, job losses, ripple effects on businesses, and potential economic burden on lower-income consumers). We found evidence of decreasing sales, or purchases, and intakes of taxed HFSS foods, especially when taxes were combined with subsidies on healthy foods. Higher tax rates were more effective in reducing purchases or consumption. Tax effects differed by income level, with the lowest-income groups being most responsive. In experimental studies, combining taxes and subsidies contributed to mitigating regressive financial impacts of taxes.
records.abstract_cn: 对食品和非酒精饮料征税越来越多地被用于促进更健康的饮食，并应对不断上升的肥胖率和与饮食相关的非传染性疾病。虽然含糖饮料一直是此类税收的主要焦点，但对高脂肪、高盐或高糖（HFSS）食品征税及其影响尚不明确。我们对来自世界各地20项关于健康税对HFSS食品影响的研究进行了系统性文献回顾和证据评估。我们重点关注对征税食品销售和消费的影响、对健康结果的影响以及可能产生的意外后果（例如，转向更不健康的产品、失业、对企业的连锁效应以及对低收入消费者的潜在经济负担）。我们发现，有证据表明征税的HFSS食品的销售、购买和摄入量有所下降，尤其是当税收与健康食品补贴相结合时。较高的税率在减少购买或消费方面更为有效。税收效应因收入水平而异，最低收入群体反应最为敏感。在实验研究中，税收与补贴相结合有助于减轻税收的累退性财务影响。

records.title_en: Expanding the phytosanitary exclusion zone for Mexican avocados: Market impacts and unintended consequences
records.title_cn: 扩大墨西哥鳄梨植物检疫排除区：市场影响与意外后果
records.abstract_en: Due to phytosanitary concerns, the U.S. has historically only allowed the importation of avocados from one Mexican state—Michoacán. In Michoacán, avocados have become a source of cartel conflict and violence. In August 2022, authorized shipments of avocados from an additional Mexican state – Jalisco – were allowed to enter the U.S. This research investigates the market impacts and unintended consequences of expanding the phytosanitary exclusion zone for Mexican avocados. We find that expansion of the phytosanitary exclusion zone was unequivocally beneficial from the perspective of U.S. avocado users and consumers. However, economic outcomes in the Mexican market are more nuanced, and temporal relationships suggest expansion of the phytosanitary exclusion zone may have affected cartel-related activity both in Michoacán and Jalisco.
records.abstract_cn: 由于植物检疫方面的担忧，美国历来只允许从墨西哥的一个州——米却肯州——进口鳄梨。在米却肯州，鳄梨已成为卡特尔冲突和暴力的根源。2022年八月，来自墨西哥另一个州——哈利斯科州——的授权鳄梨 shipments 被允许进入美国。本研究调查了扩大墨西哥鳄梨植物检疫排除区的市场影响和意外后果。我们发现，从美国鳄梨使用者和消费者的角度来看，扩大植物检疫排除区无疑是有益的。然而，墨西哥市场的经济结果则更为微妙，时间关系表明，扩大植物检疫排除区可能影响了米却肯州和哈利斯科州的卡特尔相关活动。

records.title_en: Food prices and the wages of the poor: A cost-effective addition to high-frequency food security monitoring
records.title_cn: 食品价格与贫困人口的工资：为高频食品安全监测增添一种成本效益高的手段
records.abstract_en: The affordability of nutritious food for “all people, at all times” is a critically important dimension of food security. Yet surprisingly, timely high-frequency indicators of food affordability are rarely collected in any systematic fashion despite price volatility emerging as major source of food insecurity in the 21st Century. The 2008 global food crisis prompted international agencies to invest heavily in monitoring domestic food prices in low and middle income countries (LMICs). However, food price monitoring is not sufficient for measuring changes in diet affordability; for that, one must also measure changes either in income or in an income proxy. We propose using the wages of unskilled workers as a cheap and sufficiently accurate income proxy, especially for the urban and rural non-farm poor. We first outline alternative measures of “food wage” indices, defined as wages deflated either by consumer food price indices or novel healthy diet cost indices. We then discuss the conceptual strengths and limitations of food wages. Finally, we examine patterns and trends in different types of real food wage series during well-known food price crises in Ethiopia (2008, 2011 and 2022), Sri Lanka (2022) and Myanmar (2022). In all these instances, food wages declined by 20–30%, often in the space of a few months. In Myanmar, the decline in real wages during 2022 closely matches declines in household disposable income. We strongly advocate tracking the wages of the poor as a timely, accurate and cost-effective means of monitoring food affordability for important segments of the world’s poor.
records.abstract_cn: 对“所有人、所有时刻”而言，营养食品的可负担性是食品安全的一个至关重要的维度。然而，令人惊讶的是，尽管价格波动已成为21世纪食品安全问题的主要来源，但及时的高频食品可负担性指标却很少以任何系统的方式收集。2008年全球粮食危机促使国际机构大力投资于低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的国内食品价格监测。然而，食品价格监测不足以衡量饮食可负担性的变化；为此，还必须衡量收入或收入代理变量的变化。我们建议使用非熟练工人的工资作为廉价且足够准确的收入代理，特别是对于城市和农村非农贫困人口。我们首先概述了“食品工资”指数的替代衡量方法，这些指数定义为通过消费者食品价格指数或新型健康饮食成本指数进行缩减的工资。然后，我们讨论了食品工资的概念优势和局限性。最后，我们考察了在埃塞俄比亚（2008年、2011年和2022年）、斯里兰卡（2022年）和缅甸（2022年）众所周知的食品价格危机期间，不同类型的实际食品工资序列的模式和趋势。在所有这些情况下，食品工资下降了20-30%，通常是在几个月内。在缅甸，2022年实际工资的下降与家庭可支配收入的下降密切相关。我们强烈主张追踪贫困人口的工资，作为监测世界贫困人口重要群体食品可负担性的一种及时、准确且成本效益高的手段。

records.title_en: The relation between contract type and market power: Evidence from a high-value crop in India
records.title_cn: 合同类型与市场势力的关系：来自印度高价值作物的证据
records.abstract_en: Theoretical considerations suggest that production contracts systematically lead to higher market concentration and increase contracting firms’ ability to mark down farm gate prices compared to marketing contracts. Existing research on contract farming rarely differentiates market power in different types of contracts. This study investigates the impact of marketing and production contracts on farm gate prices and net profits. The analysis is based on survey data from okra production in India and controls for unobserved heterogeneity between farmer villages, a novel procedure that circumvents the problem of multicollinearity between the treatment variable and village fixed effects. Findings indicate that monopsonist production contractors depress farm gate prices below the level of oligopsonist marketing contractors. The net profits are, however, still higher for farmers with a production contract. A subsequent scenario simulation quantifies the potential income gains for farmers if contractors’ market power could be reduced, finding that the incomes of production contract farmers could increase by one-fourth in the absence of market power. Policymakers could design incentives to increase competition between contracting firms and, thus, enhance the benefits of production contracts to smallholders in contract farming.
records.abstract_cn: 理论考量表明，与营销合同相比，生产合同系统性地导致更高的市场集中度，并增强签约企业压低农场门口价格的能力。现有关于合同农业的研究很少区分不同类型合同中的市场势力。本研究考察了营销合同和生产合同对农场门口价格及净利润的影响。分析基于印度秋葵生产的调查数据，并控制了农民村庄之间的未观测异质性，这是一种规避处理变量与村庄固定效应之间多重共线性问题的新方法。研究结果表明，垄断性生产承包商将农场门口价格压低至寡头垄断性营销承包商水平之下。然而，对于签订生产合同的农民而言，净利润仍然更高。随后的情景模拟量化了如果承包商的市场势力能够被削弱，农民可能获得的潜在收入收益，发现在没有市场势力的情况下，生产合同农民的收入可能增加四分之一。政策制定者可以设计激励措施以增加签约企业之间的竞争，从而增强生产合同对小农户在合同农业中的益处。

records.title_en: The contagion mechanism and governance strategy of corporate social irresponsibility of Chinese food companies
records.title_cn: 中国食品企业社会责任缺失的传染机制与治理策略
records.abstract_en: From a global perspective, the incidents of food fraud are still increasing in recent years, which shows that the food safety issue has not been well addressed. As a major world food exporter and importer, egregious incidents of corporate social irresponsibility (CSI) for domestic food companies were discovered in China. Although the Chinese government has been strengthening the supervision on food companies, the governance effect is not obvious. This research focuses on the governance of the CSI behavior of food companies. As opposed to the existing literature based on Neoclassical economics, this article analyzes food companies' CSI by applying a behavioral economic framework. The system dynamics method is used to analyze the implementation effect of the corresponding governance strategy. Researchers discovered that the short-sighted cognitive bias of food companies is the primary reason for CSI, which results in the self-reinforcing effect and interactive contagion effect. Under the current imperfect institutional environment, these effects will be further amplified to present a crisis of collective irresponsibility. This study provides timely evidence and significant regulatory implications for the ongoing food safety crisis in China. In order to control the contagion of CSI in the food industry, the government should increase its sanctions on irresponsible food companies from the short-term perspective. The government should also establish a fair and standardized market competition order and improve the information disclosure mechanisms and third-party governance mechanisms in the long term. These actions will contribute to a more comprehensive research perspective on food safety governance and, additionally, and to develop more targeted strategic tools for the government to regulate the food market. Our insights can also provide a reference for other countries and industries facing similar challenges.
records.abstract_cn: 从全球视角来看，近年来食品欺诈事件仍在增加，这表明食品安全问题尚未得到妥善解决。作为世界主要的食品出口国和进口国，中国国内食品企业被发现存在严重的企业社会责任缺失（CSI）事件。尽管中国政府一直在加强对食品企业的监管，但治理效果并不明显。本研究聚焦于食品企业CSI行为的治理。与基于新古典经济学的现有文献不同，本文运用行为经济学框架分析食品企业的CSI。采用系统动力学方法分析相应治理策略的实施效果。研究人员发现，食品企业的短视认知偏差是CSI的主要原因，这导致了自我强化效应和交互传染效应。在当前不完善的制度环境下，这些效应将进一步放大，呈现出集体不负责任的危机。本研究为中国持续的食品安全危机提供了及时的证据和重要的监管启示。为了控制食品行业CSI的传染，政府应从短期角度加大对不负责任食品企业的制裁力度。从长期来看，政府还应建立公平规范的市场竞争秩序，完善信息披露机制和第三方治理机制。这些行动将有助于形成更全面的食品安全治理研究视角，并为政府监管食品市场制定更具针对性的战略工具。我们的见解也可以为面临类似挑战的其他国家和行业提供参考。

records.title_en: Estimating the cost and affordability of healthy diets: How much do methods matter?
records.title_cn: 估算健康膳食的成本与可负担性：方法有多重要？
records.abstract_en: Recently developed cost and affordability of healthy diet (CoAHD) metrics have quickly become mainstream food security indicators. However, published research on the sensitivity of estimation methods is limited. This paper focuses on two important innovations in CoAHD measurement at the global level. First, we develop a demographic scaling factor to adjust healthy diet costs for cross-country differences in age structures, since younger populations generally require fewer calories than older populations. Second, we improve the way in which household expenditure available for purchasing food (“food budgets”) are derived. In addition, we explore sensitivity of global CoAHD estimates to potential problems with the representativeness and food product coverage of global food price data and vary assumptions for activity levels that shape energy expenditure requirements. We apply these explorations to the EAT-Lancet reference diet in 137 countries using price data from 2017. Relative to the conventional methods, we find that demographic scaling and improved food budget derivation substantially reduces the estimated population who cannot afford a healthy diet, from 3.02 to 2.13 billion. Adjustments for low product coverage can lead to modest reductions for specific regions and food groups, while higher physical activity assumptions increase the share of people who cannot afford a healthy diet, though perhaps implausibly so. Methods clearly matter in CoAHD estimation, and more accurate and timelier CoAHD estimates have substantial scope to improve policy analysis, design and targeting.
records.abstract_cn: 最近开发的健康膳食成本与可负担性（CoAHD）指标迅速成为主流的粮食安全指标。然而，关于估算方法敏感性的已发表研究有限。本文聚焦于全球层面CoAHD测量的两项重要创新。首先，我们开发了一个人口统计缩放因子，以调整健康膳食成本，适应各国年龄结构的差异，因为较年轻的人口通常比年长人口需要更少的卡路里。其次，我们改进了用于购买食品的家庭支出（“食品预算”）的推导方式。此外，我们探讨了全球CoAHD估算对全球食品价格数据代表性和食品产品覆盖范围潜在问题的敏感性，并改变影响能量消耗需求的活动水平假设。我们将这些探讨应用于EAT-Lancet参考饮食，覆盖137个国家，使用2017年的价格数据。相对于传统方法，我们发现人口统计缩放和改进的食品预算推导显著减少了无法负担健康膳食的估计人口，从3.02亿降至2.13亿。针对低产品覆盖率的调整可能导致特定地区和食品组的适度减少，而更高的身体活动假设增加了无法负担健康膳食的人口比例，尽管这可能不太合理。方法在CoAHD估算中显然很重要，更准确和更及时的CoAHD估算有相当大的空间来改进政策分析、设计和目标定位。

records.title_en: Between dissonance and confusion: When the Nutri-Score as a nutritional signal is misinterpreted
records.title_cn: 在不和谐与困惑之间：当Nutri-Score作为营养信号被误解时
records.abstract_en: The introduction of a mandatory front-of-package nutrition label across the European Union is generating fierce controversy. Specifically, the Nutri-Score has been under debate, which has been reflected in the media. Drawing on signaling theory, this article aims to investigate how some consumers make sense of the Nutri-Score as a signal of nutritional quality in this noisy environment. First, a study analyzes how the media communicates about the Nutri-Score. Second, 15 semi-structured interviews examine how women with children interpret and use the Nutri-Score. Our findings show that media coverage of the Nutri-Score becomes ambiguous over time and that these women experience confusion due to cognitive dissonance and lack of knowledge. This article contributes to the literature on nutrition labeling and highlights the risks of confusion in interpreting this signal of nutritional quality. It suggests implications for policymakers and economic actors to promote the use of the Nutri-Score while reducing information asymmetry.
records.abstract_cn: 欧盟范围内强制实施包装正面营养标签的引入引发了激烈争议。具体而言，Nutri-Score一直处于争论之中，这一点在媒体上有所反映。借鉴信号理论，本文旨在探讨在这一嘈杂环境中，一些消费者如何理解Nutri-Score作为营养质量信号的。首先，一项研究分析了媒体如何传播关于Nutri-Score的信息。其次，15次半结构化访谈考察了有子女的女性如何解读和使用Nutri-Score。我们的研究结果表明，媒体对Nutri-Score的报道随时间变得模糊，这些女性因认知失调和知识缺乏而经历困惑。本文对营养标签文献有所贡献，并强调了在解读这一营养质量信号时产生混淆的风险。它为政策制定者和经济行为者提供了促进Nutri-Score使用同时减少信息不对称的启示。

records.title_en: Looking at gender is not enough—How diversity of farmers’ marginalization relates to varietal trait preferences
records.title_cn: 仅关注性别是不够的——农民边缘化的多样性如何与品种性状偏好相关
records.abstract_en: Improved crop varieties help farmers adapt to changing climate and socioeconomic challenges. They are essential for meeting the global food demand, but their adoption remains slow and low. One reason for this unsuccessful adoption is the disregard of trait preferences and marginalized contexts of diverse users by actors in varietal development and delivery. The general wisdom regarding trait preferences includes gender-distinct priorities, in which men focus on high yield and marketability, while women prefer good taste and other cooking attributes. However, although gender is a first step toward nuanced preferences, most analyses restrict themselves to gender-based comparisons (frequently using the sex of heads of households), which homogenizes socioeconomic conditions and preferences within gender. Using intrahousehold preference data, our study reveals that the intersection between gender and other social categories presents compounded marginalization that corresponds to similarities or differences in women’s and men’s trait preferences. Cluster analysis reveals that trait preferences of women and men overlap but differ in the traits’ relative importance. Trait preferences are comparable in low-wealth clusters as they operate in similar marginalized contexts and diverge in high-wealth clusters. Furthermore, logit regression shows that factors of marginalization, gender roles, and agency are associated with increased odds of prioritizing specific traits, such as market and culinary traits. Our results demonstrate how diversity of marginalization and intersectionality matters more than gender dichotomies. We anticipate that our intersectional approach to understanding gendered trait preferences can enhance targeted, demand-led, and inclusive varietal development and delivery in the future.
records.abstract_cn: 改良作物品种有助于农民适应不断变化的气候和社会经济挑战。它们对于满足全球粮食需求至关重要，但其采用率仍然缓慢且低下。这种采用失败的原因之一是品种开发和推广中的参与者忽视了不同用户的性状偏好和边缘化背景。关于性状偏好的普遍观点包括性别差异优先，其中男性关注高产和适销性，而女性偏好良好口味和其他烹饪属性。然而，尽管性别是迈向细致偏好的第一步，但大多数分析仅限于基于性别的比较（通常使用户主性别），这使性别内部的社会经济条件和偏好同质化。利用户内偏好数据，我们的研究揭示，性别与其他社会类别的交叉呈现复合边缘化，这与女性和男性性状偏好的相似性或差异性相对应。聚类分析显示，女性和男性的性状偏好重叠，但在性状的相对重要性上有所不同。在低财富聚类中，性状偏好具有可比性，因为它们在相似的边缘化背景下运作，而在高财富聚类中则出现分歧。此外，逻辑回归表明，边缘化因素、性别角色和自主权与优先考虑特定性状（如市场和烹饪性状）的几率增加相关。我们的结果表明，边缘化和交叉性的多样性比性别二分法更重要。我们预计，我们理解性别性状偏好的交叉方法可以增强未来有针对性的、需求导向的和包容性的品种开发和推广。

records.title_en: Price response to government disclosure of food safety information in developing markets
records.title_cn: 发展中市场政府食品安全信息披露的价格反应
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of government disclosure of food safety information on market outcomes in a real and developing market setting. Prior research either relied on data from developed countries, or hypothetical and laboratory experiments to examine market responsiveness to food safety information. Using a panel dataset of weekly pork wholesale prices and pork sampling test result variables at the city level, we find lagged and negative price responses to government quality information disclosure in the Chinese pork wholesale markets. Average pork wholesale prices began to decrease by 5% two weeks after the information disclosure. The negative information effects on pork prices are largely driven by negative pork demand shocks in particular in the main pork consumption cities, and are more evident in the treated cities with higher internet penetration rates, incidence of foodborne illness, and food safety regulatory resources. Results of this study contribute to a better understanding of the nationwide information-based food quality regulation, and importantly, inform the efficacy of public information interventions that tackle food safety issues in other developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了在真实的发展中市场环境中，政府食品安全信息披露对市场结果的影响。以往的研究要么依赖于发达国家的数据，要么依赖于假设性和实验室实验来检验市场对食品安全信息的反应。利用城市层面的周度猪肉批发价格和猪肉抽样检测结果变量的面板数据集，我们发现中国猪肉批发市场对政府质量信息披露存在滞后且负面的价格反应。信息披露两周后，平均猪肉批发价格开始下降5%。猪肉价格的负面信息效应主要由负面猪肉需求冲击驱动，尤其是在主要猪肉消费城市，并且在互联网普及率、食源性疾病发病率和食品安全监管资源较高的处理城市中更为明显。本研究结果有助于更好地理解全国性的基于信息的食品质量监管，并且重要的是，为其他发展中国家解决食品安全问题的公共信息干预措施的有效性提供了信息。

records.title_en: The transition incentive program and women farmers in the USA
records.title_cn: 过渡激励计划与美国女性农民
records.abstract_en: The US Department of Agriculture made women farmers eligible for the Transition Incentive Program (TIP) to improve their access to farmland. TIP is a federal program that transfers near-expiring lands in the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) back to agricultural use while maintaining established conservation practices. It offers incentives to landowners and requires recipients to adhere to specific conservation plans on the acquired land. Since women have shown a stronger interest in sustainable practices and face more limited access to land, TIP has the potential to enhance women’s presence in farming. However, the program’s effectiveness has not been evaluated.
records.abstract_cn: 美国农业部使女性农民有资格参加过渡激励计划（TIP），以改善她们获得农田的机会。TIP是一项联邦计划，将保护储备计划（CRP）中即将到期的土地转回农业用途，同时维持既定的保护措施。它向土地所有者提供激励，并要求接受者在获得的土地上遵守特定的保护计划。由于女性对可持续实践表现出更强的兴趣，并且面临更有限的土地获取途径，TIP有潜力增强女性在农业中的存在。然而，该计划的有效性尚未得到评估。

records.title_en: Shocked into side-selling? Production shocks and organic coffee farmers’ marketing decisions
records.title_cn: 受冲击转而私下销售？生产冲击与有机咖啡农的营销决策
records.abstract_en: Peru is the world’s leading exporter of organic coffee. Peruvian organic coffee is largely marketed through farmers’ cooperatives which have helped small farmers transition to organic production, earn price premiums over conventional coffee, and access extension services and finance. However, rising temperatures, increasingly volatile rainfall patterns, and the proliferation of pests and diseases make organic production riskier, as organic farmers cannot rely on agrochemicals to protect their farms against production shocks. If members of organic coffee cooperatives respond to production shocks by increasing their sales to private buyers (‘side-selling’), then cooperatives’ financial health could be threatened through reduced bargaining power with buyers and a decrease in scale economies. This paper explores the theoretical incentives for members to side-sell in response to production shocks and gives empirical evidence of how production shocks influence side-selling using panel data from members of two Peruvian specialty coffee cooperatives in 2013 and 2015. The study period coincides with a widespread production shock – the Coffee Leaf Rust (CLR) epidemic of 2012/13 – that decimated coffee production in Peru. We find suggestive evidence that the incidence of CLR on farms is correlated with increased side-selling. Particularly, members with high risk tolerance and high levels of non-coffee income increase side-selling when affected by production shocks. This paper contributes to a growing literature on the determinants of side-selling in agricultural cooperatives by examining the role of production shocks, extending existing theoretical frameworks, and analyzing determinants using panel data methods.
records.abstract_cn: 秘鲁是全球领先的有机咖啡出口国。秘鲁的有机咖啡主要通过农民合作社进行营销，这些合作社帮助小农户转向有机生产，获得高于传统咖啡的价格溢价，并获取推广服务和融资。然而，气温上升、降雨模式日益多变以及病虫害的扩散使得有机生产风险更高，因为有机农民无法依赖农用化学品来保护农场免受生产冲击。如果有机咖啡合作社的成员通过增加对私人买家的销售（“私下销售”）来应对生产冲击，那么合作社的财务健康可能会因与买家的议价能力减弱和规模经济下降而受到威胁。本文探讨了成员因生产冲击而进行私下销售的理论激励，并利用2013年和2015年两家秘鲁精品咖啡合作社成员的面板数据，提供了生产冲击如何影响私下销售的实证证据。研究期间恰逢一次广泛的生产冲击——2012/13年的咖啡叶锈病（CLR）疫情——该疫情使秘鲁的咖啡生产大幅减少。我们发现有提示性证据表明，农场中CLR的发生率与私下销售的增加相关。特别是，风险承受能力高且非咖啡收入水平高的成员在受到生产冲击时更倾向于增加私下销售。本文通过考察生产冲击的作用、扩展现有理论框架以及使用面板数据方法分析决定因素，为关于农业合作社中私下销售决定因素的日益增长的文献做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Technology-driven transformations in agri-food global value chains: The role of incumbent firms from a corporate venture capital perspective
records.title_cn: 技术驱动的农业食品全球价值链转型：企业风险投资视角下在位企业的作用
records.abstract_en: Agri-food global value chains (GVCs) are failing to provide healthy and affordable diets within planetary boundaries. Many cutting-edge technologies are being developed to address the sustainability challenges throughout agri-food GVCs. While several studies seek to analyze the impacts of specific innovations on socioeconomic and environmental dimensions, the relationship between industry structure and the process of technological change has not received much attention in the value chain literature. Here, we focus on the entrepreneurial landscape of innovation in agri-food GVCs to 1) identify which technologies have been receiving most support from investors and 2) analyze the corporate strategies of the largest agri-food multinational companies regarding their investments in new technologies. Using Crunchbase as our primary data source and machine learning for natural language processing, we have identified around 15,500 companies developing innovations linked to agri-food GVCs, from farming to last-mile delivery. However, our analyses show an imbalanced scene in which downstream technologies capture most investors’ interest.
