records.abstract_cn: 食品外卖配送系统的创新使得在家外制备的食品消费快速增长。这类食品通常比在家制备的食品含有更多的不利营养素。运输部门的技术进步将通过引入自主（无人驾驶）车辆，进一步扩大食品配送服务的可用性。关于消费者可能如何应对这一变化，目前知之甚少，且缺乏相关的监管框架。为填补这一证据空白并为这一新兴领域的政策提供信息，本研究旨在初步探讨消费者在自主食品配送服务广泛可用后可能选择使用的方式和原因，以及对其饮食的潜在影响。样本包括100名目前居住在澳大利亚的成年人，进行了面对面访谈。配额按年龄、性别和地理位置属性设置，以确保适当的人口分布。约三分之二的受访者表示打算使用自主食品配送服务接收杂货，约一半表示打算用于接收快餐。对便利性增强的感知主导了受访者表达的使用自主配送服务的意图原因。总体而言，受访者认为自主配送服务的大规模使用障碍很少，部分人预计由于获取渠道增加，会消费更多不健康食品。虽然自主配送服务有潜力大幅增加对健康和健康食品的获取，但需要有效的政策行动以确保健康结果得到优化。

records.title_en: Global food value chains and obesity in low- and middle-income countries
records.title_cn: 全球食品价值链与中低收入国家的肥胖问题
records.abstract_en: Low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are experiencing disproportional increases in overweight or obesity rates. Parallel to this trend, many LMICs are witnessing significant growth in their participation in global food value chains (GFVCs). This paper aims to shed light on the public health implications of increasing participation in GFVCs. Leveraging macro- and micro-level data spanning 25 years, we study the relationship between countries’ participation in GFVCs and women’s overweight or obesity rates. We explore heterogeneous implications by disaggregating countries’ participation into backward and forward linkages in GFVCs, as well as across rural and urban areas. We find that temporal increases in countries’ participation in GFVCs are significantly associated with increasing overweight or obesity rates, primarily when countries participate in backward linkages and for urban populations. Participation in GFVCs involving forward linkages appears to have negligible implications, and the relationship between participation in GFVCs and obesity disappears for rural women. Furthermore, we find that an increase in countries’ participation in GFVCs is associated with an increase in consumption of energy-dense foods such as sugar, commonly linked with obesity. Our findings have important implications for informing public policies aimed at addressing the increasing obesity rates and associated economic and health burdens in LMICs.
records.abstract_cn: 中低收入国家正在经历超重或肥胖率不成比例的增长。与这一趋势并行的是，许多中低收入国家参与全球食品价值链（GFVCs）的程度显著增加。本文旨在揭示参与全球食品价值链程度增加对公共健康的影响。利用跨越25年的宏观和微观层面数据，我们研究了国家参与全球食品价值链与女性超重或肥胖率之间的关系。我们通过将国家参与分解为全球食品价值链中的后向和前向联系，以及城乡地区之间的差异，探讨了异质性影响。我们发现，国家参与全球食品价值链的时间性增加与超重或肥胖率的上升显著相关，主要是在国家参与后向联系以及城市人口中。涉及前向联系的全球食品价值链参与似乎影响甚微，而对于农村女性，参与全球食品价值链与肥胖之间的关系消失。此外，我们发现国家参与全球食品价值链的增加与能量密集型食品（如糖，通常与肥胖相关）消费的增加有关。我们的发现对于制定旨在解决中低收入国家日益增长的肥胖率及相关经济健康负担的公共政策具有重要意义。

records.title_en: Gender, rainfall endowment, and farmers’ heterogeneity in wheat trait preferences in Ethiopia
records.title_cn: 性别、降雨禀赋与埃塞俄比亚农民小麦性状偏好异质性
records.abstract_en: Wheat is a vital cereal crop for smallholders in Ethiopia. Despite over fifty years of research on wheat varietal development, consideration of gendered trait preferences in developing target product profiles for wheat breeding is limited. To address this gap, our study used sex-disaggregated survey data and historical rainfall trends from the major wheat-growing regions in Ethiopia. The findings indicated heterogeneity in trait preferences based on gender and rainfall endowment. Men respondents tended to prefer wheat traits with high straw yield and disease-resistance potential, while women showed a greater appreciation for wheat traits related to good taste and cooking quality. Farmers in high rainfall areas seemed to prioritize high straw yield and disease resistance traits, while those in low rainfall areas valued good adaptation traits more highly. Most of the correlation coefficients among the preferred traits were positive, indicating that farmers seek wheat varieties with traits that serve multiple purposes. Understanding men’s and women’s preferences and incorporating them in breeding and seed systems could contribute to the development of more targeted and effective wheat varieties that meet the diverse needs of men and women farmers in Ethiopia.
records.abstract_cn: 小麦是埃塞俄比亚小农的重要谷类作物。尽管小麦品种开发研究已有五十多年，但在制定小麦育种目标产品概况时，对性别化性状偏好的考虑有限。为弥补这一空白，本研究使用了按性别分类的调查数据和埃塞俄比亚主要小麦种植区的历史降雨趋势。研究结果表明，基于性别和降雨禀赋的性状偏好存在异质性。男性受访者倾向于偏好具有高秸秆产量和抗病潜力的小麦性状，而女性则更看重与良好口感和烹饪品质相关的小麦性状。高降雨地区的农民似乎优先考虑高秸秆产量和抗病性状，而低降雨地区的农民则更重视良好适应性性状。偏好性状之间的相关系数大多为正，表明农民寻求具有多种用途性状的小麦品种。了解男性和女性的偏好并将其纳入育种和种子系统，有助于开发更有针对性和有效的小麦品种，以满足埃塞俄比亚男女农民的多样化需求。

records.title_en: The distributional implications of health taxes: A case study on the Italian sugar tax
records.title_cn: 健康税的收入分配影响：意大利糖税案例研究
records.abstract_en: As over-consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) is considered a major contributor to the rising prevalence of obesity and associated diseases, public authorities from different countries are considering the introduction of SSBs taxation. In this study, we evaluate the potential impact of the upcoming Italian sugar tax on SSBs and sugar consumption, also accounting for differences across socio-economic groups. We also analyze alternative SSBs tax designs (i.e., excise tax on sugar and two-tier tax based on sugar content) to compare their effectiveness and provide a more general analysis about the outcomes of SSBs taxation. In our empirical analysis, we first estimate consumers’ demand for SSBs using the random coefficient logit demand model (Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes, 1995) and Nielsen Household Panel data of SSBs purchases for the period 2019–2020. Then, the estimated demand parameters and marginal costs for SSBs are employed to conduct counterfactual simulations to derive the new market equilibria under the simulated SSBs tax scheme scenarios. Our results show that the Italian sugar tax is the most effective in reducing SSBs and sugar consumption (on average, by 18% and 24% respectively) among all the simulated tax scenarios. This is also due to the strategic reactions of SSBs manufacturers who over-shift the change in marginal cost (i.e., tax rate) to final prices. Moreover, despite being financially regressive, taxes on SSBs may be progressive from a health perspective, as low-income groups experience the greatest fall in SSBs and sugar consumption. Reinvesting tax revenues in health-related programs targeting the most vulnerable socio-economic groups (i.e., low-income households with children) may minimize the regressivity of SSBs taxes.
records.abstract_cn: 由于含糖饮料（SSBs）的过度消费被认为是肥胖及相关疾病患病率上升的主要因素，不同国家的公共当局正在考虑引入含糖饮料税。在本研究中，我们评估了即将实施的意大利糖税对含糖饮料和糖消费的潜在影响，同时考虑了不同社会经济群体之间的差异。我们还分析了替代性的含糖饮料税设计（即对糖征收消费税和基于糖含量的两级税），以比较其有效性，并对含糖饮料税的结果提供更一般的分析。在我们的实证分析中，我们首先使用随机系数logit需求模型（Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes, 1995）和Nielsen家庭面板数据（2019-2020年期间的含糖饮料购买数据）估计消费者对含糖饮料的需求。然后，利用估计的需求参数和含糖饮料的边际成本进行反事实模拟，以推导在模拟的含糖饮料税方案情景下的新市场均衡。我们的结果表明，在所有模拟的税收情景中，意大利糖税在减少含糖饮料和糖消费方面最为有效（平均分别减少18%和24%）。这也归因于含糖饮料制造商的战略反应，他们将边际成本的变化（即税率）过度转嫁到最终价格上。此外，尽管从财务角度看是累退的，但从健康角度看，含糖饮料税可能是累进的，因为低收入群体的含糖饮料和糖消费下降幅度最大。将税收收入再投资于针对最脆弱社会经济群体（即低收入有子女家庭）的健康相关项目，可以最大限度地减少含糖饮料税的累退性。

records.title_en: Temperature and children’s dietary diversity: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 温度与儿童膳食多样性：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: Children’s exposure to heat is related to both chronic and acute nutritional status. However, there is limited empirical evidence on how a rise in temperature affects dietary quality. Using the most recent rounds of the Demographic Health Survey for India, conducted in 2015–16 and 2019–20, combined with geospatial data from various sources, this study empirically explores the relationship between temperature and dietary diversity of children in the age group of 6 to 23 months. The study highlights that higher temperatures are associated with a modest yet statistically significant decrease in the dietary diversity of children aged 6 to 23 months. We also find that, while minor temperature variations may have minimal effects, larger shifts within specific temperature ranges can lead to more pronounced alterations in children’s dietary diversity. Moreover, factors such as children’s age, historical climate context, and seasonality influence the magnitude of this relationship. Additionally, access to infrastructure and maternal education significantly mediate the adverse effects of temperature on children’s dietary patterns, highlighting the importance of targeted interventions in vulnerable communities..
records.abstract_cn: 儿童暴露于高温与慢性和急性营养状况均有关。然而，关于气温上升如何影响膳食质量的实证证据有限。利用印度人口健康调查最近几轮数据（分别于2015-16年和2019-20年进行），结合来自不同来源的地理空间数据，本研究实证探讨了温度与6至23个月龄儿童膳食多样性之间的关系。研究强调，较高温度与6至23个月龄儿童膳食多样性的适度但统计显著的下降相关。我们还发现，虽然轻微的温度变化可能影响甚微，但特定温度范围内较大的变化可能导致儿童膳食多样性更显著的变化。此外，儿童年龄、历史气候背景和季节性等因素影响这种关系的强度。另外，基础设施的可及性和母亲教育显著调节了温度对儿童膳食模式的不利影响，凸显了在脆弱社区进行有针对性的干预的重要性。

records.title_en: A trade-off between lives and the economy? Subsidizing dining out under the COVID-19 pandemic in Japan
records.title_cn: 生命与经济之间的权衡？日本COVID-19疫情期间外出就餐补贴
records.abstract_en: We investigate how a government subsidy for dining out to support the restaurant industry has been associated with economic and health outcomes during the COVID-19 pandemic in Japan. Using nationwide 500-meter mesh data, we demonstrate that Japan’s Go To Eat scheme, which was gradually introduced across all prefectures beginning in October 2020, mitigated the negative impact of the pandemic on population mobility in restaurant areas, while having little association with the spread of COVID-19 afterward. The influence was particularly large for population mobility within a prefecture and in restaurant areas near train stations. The scheme also had diminishing positive spillover effects around the restaurant areas. The findings imply that such a subsidy can be a balanced policy response to the pandemic once epidemiological factors are properly managed.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在COVID-19疫情期间，日本政府为支持餐饮业而提供的外出就餐补贴如何与经济及健康结果相关联。利用全国500米网格数据，我们证明日本的“Go To Eat”计划（于2020年十月起逐步在所有都道府县实施）缓解了疫情对餐饮区域人口流动性的负面影响，同时对后续COVID-19的传播几乎没有关联。该影响在都道府县内及火车站附近的餐饮区域尤为显著。该计划在餐饮区域周围还具有递减的正向溢出效应。研究结果表明，在流行病学因素得到妥善管理的情况下，此类补贴可以成为应对疫情的平衡政策选择。

records.title_en: How do women’s empowerment metrics measure up? A comparative analysis
records.title_cn: 女性赋权指标如何衡量？一项比较分析
records.abstract_en: Research has identified women’s empowerment as a critical factor for nutritional outcomes and a priority area for understanding women’s mental health status. At the same time, there is no consensus on how empowerment should be measured. The surrounding debate has produced several empowerment metrics that are widely used, yet we know little about whether they can be substituted for one another or their respective strengths and weaknesses. Using data collected from a single sample of women from rural, northern Kenya, we compare five empowerment metrics: The Project-level Women’s Empowerment in Agriculture Index (pro-WEAI) and associated Health and Nutrition Module (HN), Women’s Empowerment in Nutrition Index (WENI), Women’s Empowerment in Livestock Index (WELI), and the Survey Based Women’s Empowerment Index (SWPER). The metrics have shared theoretical origins and are commonly used in the food, nutrition and health spaces to study rural women’s lives across low- and middle-income countries. We examine the metrics’ characteristics, distributions, pairwise correlations and capacity of each metric to predict outcomes often associated with the concept of empowerment: body mass index (BMI) and the Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale (CES-D). We find striking differences between these common empowerment metrics. The metrics’ correlations with one another are highly variable as are the predictive capacities for both outcomes. Further, our analysis finds that the choice of metric can dramatically influence which individuals are identified as empowered. In sum, our results suggest that while these metrics are used in remarkably similar ways to understand rural women’s empowerment and its consequences, unless they are computed with many identical survey questions, the metrics do not capture the same underlying concept and are not interchangeable. We recommend that our work be replicated elsewhere and caution should be taken when implementing and interpreting research using these metrics, as findings may be highly sensitive to the choice of metric.
records.abstract_cn: 研究已确定女性赋权是营养结果的关键因素，也是理解女性心理健康状况的优先领域。与此同时，关于如何衡量赋权尚未达成共识。围绕这一争论产生了多种广泛使用的赋权指标，但我们对其是否可以相互替代或各自的优缺点知之甚少。利用从肯尼亚北部农村单一女性样本收集的数据，我们比较了五种赋权指标：项目级农业女性赋权指数（pro-WEAI）及其相关的健康与营养模块（HN）、营养赋权指数（WENI）、畜牧业女性赋权指数（WELI）以及基于调查的女性赋权指数（SWPER）。这些指标具有共同的理论起源，常用于食品、营养和健康领域，以研究中低收入国家农村女性的生活。我们考察了这些指标的特征、分布、两两相关性以及每个指标预测通常与赋权概念相关的结果的能力：体重指数（BMI）和流行病学研究中心抑郁量表（CES-D）。我们发现这些常见赋权指标之间存在显著差异。指标之间的相关性高度可变，对两种结果的预测能力也是如此。此外，我们的分析发现，指标的选择可能极大地影响哪些个体被识别为赋权。总之，我们的结果表明，尽管这些指标以非常相似的方式用于理解农村女性赋权及其后果，但除非它们由许多相同的调查问题计算得出，否则这些指标并不能捕捉相同的潜在概念，且不可互换。我们建议在其他地方复制我们的工作，并在使用这些指标进行实施和解释研究时应谨慎，因为研究结果可能对指标的选择高度敏感。

records.title_en: Agricultural mechanization and the performance of the local Chinese economy
records.title_cn: 农业机械化与中国地方经济绩效
records.abstract_en: In this study, we analyze the impact of agricultural mechanization on the local Chinese economy from 2010 to 2020. Findings based on panel data and instrumental variable methods show that agricultural mechanization led to a significant decline in the local gross domestic product. In particular, agricultural mechanization changes the sector’s production and lowers its output value. Agricultural mechanization has reduced the need for labor to such an extent that young Chinese tend to seek jobs in the non-farming sector, leading to a fall in the local agricultural labor supply and household consumption, adversely affecting the development of local industries and service sectors. Mechanization has also led to cash crops being increasingly replaced by grain crops, reducing the total agricultural output. Finally, this paper presents some policy suggestions for agricultural production and rural development.
records.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们分析了2010年至2020年间农业机械化对中国地方经济的影响。基于面板数据和工具变量方法的研究结果表明，农业机械化导致了地方国内生产总值的显著下降。特别是，农业机械化改变了该部门的生产并降低了其产出值。农业机械化减少了对劳动力的需求，以至于中国年轻人倾向于在非农业部门寻找工作，导致地方农业劳动力供给和家庭消费下降，对地方工业和第三产业的发展产生了不利影响。机械化还导致经济作物日益被粮食作物替代，减少了农业总产出。最后，本文为农业生产和农村发展提出了一些政策建议。

records.title_en: Emerging outsource agricultural services enable farmer adaptation in agrifood value chains: A product cycle perspective
records.title_cn: 新兴的农业外包服务使农民适应农产品价值链：基于产品周期的视角
records.abstract_en: Outsource agricultural service enterprises emerged a century ago in high-income countries and in the past several decades in developing regions. We contribute by analyzing and illustrating the emergence of these services from the perspective of phases of the Product Cycle. These services help farmers adapt to international and domestic agrifood value chains: (1) in the commoditization phase, e.g., with rice combine harvesting services in China and Myanmar for domestic and export markets; (2) in the early product differentiation phase into quality traits, e.g., with horticultural services to Ethiopian and Indonesian farmers for urban wholesale markets; (3) in the advanced product differentiation phase into environmental traits, e.g., with A-Z services to help French farmers grow eco-labeled vegetables for supermarkets. These services addressed farmers’ shortfalls in information, skills, labor, and equipment. The services are supplied by medium/large farmers with excess capacity say of a combine; by wholesalers who want to reduce search costs and risks; by input “agro-dealers”; and by agribusinesses servicing their outgrowers. In new cases shown in France, outsource firms partner with farm input companies such as Bayer or with robot/drone companies. Governments have – and can do much more to – support the emergence of these services such as in developing regions today through: (1) promotion of a business ecosystem, based on policies of investment in hard and soft infrastructure, favoring the coadaptation of these firms with farmers’ needs; (2) policies facilitating access, such as through import liberalization, of equipment and seeds and chemicals.
records.abstract_cn: 农业外包服务企业在一个世纪前出现在高收入国家，并在过去几十年中出现在发展中地区。我们从产品周期阶段的角度分析和阐述这些服务的出现，以此做出贡献。这些服务帮助农民适应国际和国内的农产品价值链：（1）在商品化阶段，例如中国和缅甸的水稻联合收割服务，服务于国内和出口市场；（2）在早期产品差异化阶段，涉及品质性状，例如为埃塞俄比亚和印度尼西亚农民提供园艺服务，服务于城市批发市场；（3）在高级产品差异化阶段，涉及环境性状，例如提供A-Z服务帮助法国农民种植生态标签蔬菜供应超市。这些服务解决了农民在信息、技能、劳动力和设备方面的不足。这些服务由具有过剩产能（如联合收割机）的中大型农民提供；由希望降低搜索成本和风险的批发商提供；由投入品“农业经销商”提供；以及由服务其外围种植者的农业企业提供。在法国展示的新案例中，外包公司与拜耳等农业投入品公司或机器人/无人机公司合作。政府已经并且可以做得更多，以支持这些服务的出现，例如在当今发展中地区，通过：（1）基于对硬性和软性基础设施投资的政策，促进商业生态系统，有利于这些公司与农民需求的共同适应；（2）促进获取的政策，例如通过进口自由化，获取设备、种子和化学品。

records.title_en: The glass of milk half-empty? Dairy development and nutrition in low and middle income countries
records.title_cn: 半杯牛奶？低收入和中等收入国家的乳业发展与营养
records.abstract_en: Dairy products have an exceptionally rich nutrient profile and have long been promoted in high income countries to redress child malnutrition. But given all this potential, and the high burden of undernutrition in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), why isn’t dairy consumption more actively promoted in the developing world? In this review we focus on a broadly defined concept of “dairy development” to include production, trade, marketing, regulation, and demand stimulation. We address three key questions. First, how strong is the evidence on the importance of dairy production and consumption for improving nutrition among young children in LMICs? Second, which regions have the lowest consumption of dairy products? Third, what are the supply- and demand-side challenges that prevent LMICs from expanding dairy consumption? We argue that although more nutrition- and consumer-oriented dairy development interventions have tremendous potential to redress undernutrition in LMICs, the pathways for achieving this development are highly context-specific: LMICs with significant agroecological potential for dairy production primarily require institutional solutions for the complex marketing challenges in perishable milk value chains; lower potential LMICs require consumer-oriented trade and industrial approaches to the sector’s development. And all dairy strategies require a stronger focus on cross-cutting issues of nutrition education and demand creation, food safety and quality, gender and inclusiveness, and environmental sustainability and resilience. We conclude our review by emphasizing important areas for research and policy expansion.
records.abstract_cn: 乳制品具有极其丰富的营养成分，长期以来在高收入国家被用于改善儿童营养不良。但鉴于所有这些潜力，以及低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）营养不良的高负担，为什么在发展中国家不更积极地推广乳制品消费？在这篇综述中，我们关注一个广义的“乳业发展”概念，包括生产、贸易、监管和需求刺激。我们解决三个关键问题。首先，关于乳制品生产和消费对改善LMICs幼儿营养重要性的证据有多强？其次，哪些地区的乳制品消费量最低？第三，哪些供应侧和需求侧的挑战阻碍了LMICs扩大乳制品消费？我们认为，尽管更多以营养和消费者为导向的乳业发展干预措施在改善LMICs营养不良方面具有巨大潜力，但实现这一发展的途径高度依赖于具体情境：具有显著农业生态潜力的LMICs主要需要针对易腐牛奶价值链中复杂营销挑战的制度性解决方案；潜力较低的LMICs需要以消费者为导向的贸易和工业方法来发展该部门。所有乳业战略都需要更加强调营养教育和需求创造、食品安全和质量、性别和包容性以及环境可持续性和韧性等跨领域问题。我们通过强调研究和政策扩展的重要领域来结束我们的综述。

records.title_en: Measuring changes in pork demand, welfare effects, and the role of information sources in the event of an African swine fever outbreak in the United States
records.title_cn: 美国非洲猪瘟爆发时猪肉需求变化、福利效应及信息来源作用的测量
records.abstract_en: African swine fever (ASF) has never been detected in the U.S., but the current global outbreak threatens to change that. Although ASF poses no known risk to human health and is not a food safety concern, little is known about the response in U.S. consumer demand in case of an outbreak. We use an online survey experiment, following the one-and-one-half-bound dichotomous choice contingent valuation approach to estimate changes in consumers’ willingness to pay for pork in case of an ASF outbreak. Using these estimates, we find that demand for unprocessed pork (processed pork) products in the U.S. is predicted to shift downward by approximately 32 % (30 %) in the case of an ASF outbreak. Overall, the total annual welfare loss is predicted to be $55.46 billion in the pork market. We find that those consumers who are unaware about ASF, perceive it to be a risk to human health, and eat pork infrequently have a relatively larger reduction in willingness to pay for pork following an outbreak. Further, about 23 % of the survey respondents would stop purchasing pork products altogether following an ASF outbreak. Results also indicate that government institutions are most trusted when it comes to sharing news about food safety, strongly suggesting the importance of public institutions in generating awareness prior to and during an ASF outbreak.
records.abstract_cn: 非洲猪瘟（ASF）从未在美国被检测到，但当前的全球疫情可能会改变这一状况。尽管ASF对人类健康无已知风险，也不是食品安全问题，但关于疫情爆发时美国消费者需求反应的研究甚少。我们采用在线调查实验，遵循一又二分之一边界二分选择条件估值法，估计ASF爆发时消费者对猪肉支付意愿的变化。利用这些估计，我们发现，在ASF爆发的情况下，美国未加工猪肉（加工猪肉）产品的需求预计将分别下降约32%（30%）。总体而言，猪肉市场的年度总福利损失预计为$55.46十亿美元。我们发现，那些不了解ASF、认为其对人类健康构成风险以及不经常食用猪肉的消费者，在疫情爆发后对猪肉支付意愿的下降幅度相对较大。此外，约23%的调查受访者在ASF爆发后会完全停止购买猪肉产品。结果还表明，在分享食品安全新闻方面，政府机构最受信任，这强烈表明公共机构在ASF爆发前和爆发期间提高公众意识的重要性。

records.title_en: Market food environments and child nutrition
records.title_cn: 市场食品环境与儿童营养
records.abstract_en: Child malnutrition remains a widespread public health problem in sub-Saharan Africa. Providing access to nutritious foods for all is key, but it is not clear how this can be achieved in various local contexts. Here, we analyze the role of markets and food environments for child diets and nutrition in Malawi along a rural-urban continuum. We develop a new methodology to characterize food environments in terms of the variety of fresh and processed foods available in local market settings. Geocoded data of market food variety are combined with individual-level child diet and anthropometric data collected through a household survey. We find large differences in food environments, diets, and nutrition outcomes between urban, rural, and remote locations. The spatially-explicit analysis shows that market food variety is positively associated with dietary diversity and negatively associated with stunting, also after controlling for confounding factors. Strikingly, processed food variety has more favorable associations with child nutrition than fresh food variety, suggesting that lightly and moderately processed foods are important sources of nutrients in the local settings. Our findings stress the importance of improving the functioning of markets for nutritious foods, especially in rural areas. Conceptually, we add to the literature on measuring food environments.
records.abstract_cn: 儿童营养不良仍然是撒哈拉以南非洲地区普遍存在的公共卫生问题。为所有人提供营养食品的获取是关键，但在不同的地方背景下如何实现这一点尚不明确。在此，我们分析了马拉维沿城乡连续体的市场与食品环境对儿童饮食和营养的作用。我们开发了一种新方法，用以表征当地市场环境中新鲜和加工食品多样性的食品环境。将市场食品多样性的地理编码数据与通过家庭调查收集的个体儿童饮食和人体测量数据相结合。我们发现城市、农村和偏远地区之间的食品环境、饮食和营养结果存在巨大差异。空间显式分析表明，市场食品多样性与饮食多样性正相关，与发育迟缓负相关，即使在控制混杂因素后也是如此。引人注目的是，加工食品多样性与儿童营养的关联比新鲜食品多样性更有利，这表明轻度及中度加工食品在当地环境中是重要的营养来源。我们的发现强调了改善营养食品市场功能的重要性，尤其是在农村地区。在概念上，我们为测量食品环境的文献做出了贡献。

records.title_en: The impacts of widespread agricultural interventions on yields and food security in Ethiopia☆
records.title_cn: 广泛农业干预对埃塞俄比亚产量和粮食安全的影响☆
authors: Ana Paula de la O Campos
records.abstract_en: In the past decades, the Government of Ethiopia implemented widespread interventions with the objective of modernizing the agricultural sector and stimulating transformative growth. This paper assesses the agricultural yields and food security impacts of those interventions. Combining project and remote-sensing data with a nationally representative household panel survey, we identify impacts by exploiting the temporal and geographic variation in the roll-out of the interventions implemented by the Ethiopian Agricultural Transformation Agency from 2011 to 2016. Results show that large-scale agricultural interventions are associated with higher agricultural yields and better food security outcomes. These outcomes underscore the linkages that persist between agricultural development and food security for rural households living in mostly agrarian economies and the potential for systems-wide interventions to catalyze agricultural transformation.
records.abstract_cn: 在过去几十年中，埃塞俄比亚政府实施了广泛的干预措施，旨在实现农业部门现代化并刺激转型增长。本文评估了这些干预措施对农业产量和粮食安全的影响。结合项目数据、遥感数据以及具有全国代表性的住户面板调查，我们利用埃塞俄比亚农业转型局从2011年到2016年实施的干预措施在时间和地理上的推广差异来识别影响。结果表明，大规模农业干预与更高的农业产量和更好的粮食安全结果相关。这些结果强调了在主要以农业经济为主的农村家庭中，农业发展与其粮食安全之间持续存在的联系，以及全系统干预措施催化农业转型的潜力。

records.title_en: Perspectives on high U.S. retail food prices during 2020–2022
records.title_cn: 2020-2022年美国零售食品价格高企的视角
records.abstract_en: The recent food price inflation has sparked lively debates globally in media accounts, policy circles, and academics. A large body of literature has emerged across several fields of economics. However, each study typically focuses on a single or subset of causes, indicating that factors contributing to the recent food price inflation are broadly ranging and complex. This paper provides a comprehensive synthesis of what we learned about the major causes of high food prices in 2020–2022 in the United States and how they differ from those identified in prior food price hikes during the Great Recession of 2008. To provide context, we first discuss stylized facts about the U.S. food industry structure and previous empirical evidence on economy-wide drivers of high food prices. We then survey the literature on drivers of price surges observed since 2020. We document that the overall price surge, including food prices, in 2020–2022 has some unique factors primarily stemming from the consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic—specifically, U.S. fiscal support and money supply growth are the leading factors. Like in 2008, high commodity prices played a significant role in recent food price hikes—although their impacts might not be as large as in 2008. Inflation expectations due to high oil prices were a significant factor in 2008 but were not found to be an essential cause of the recent price hikes. Furthermore, the evidence on the role of factors directly related to retailers’ conduct, such as seller’s inflation or price gouging, is mixed. Considering our synthesis, we identify important gaps where future research is needed and policy priorities.
records.abstract_cn: 近期的食品价格通胀已在媒体、政策界和学术界引发了全球性的激烈辩论。经济学多个领域涌现了大量文献。然而，每项研究通常只关注单一或部分原因，表明导致近期食品价格通胀的因素广泛且复杂。本文对2020-2022年美国食品价格高企的主要原因及其与2008年大衰退期间先前食品价格上涨原因的差异进行了全面综合。为提供背景，我们首先讨论美国食品行业结构的典型事实以及先前关于经济-wide驱动因素对高食品价格影响的实证证据。然后，我们综述了自2020年以来观察到的价格飙升驱动因素的文献。我们记录了2020-2022年整体价格飙升（包括食品价格）具有一些独特因素，主要源于COVID-19大流行的后果——具体而言，美国的财政支持和货币供应增长是主要因素。与2008年类似，高商品价格在近期食品价格上涨中发挥了重要作用——尽管其影响可能不如2008年那么大。由于高油价导致的通胀预期在2008年是一个重要因素，但并未被发现是近期价格上涨的关键原因。此外，关于与零售商行为直接相关的因素（如卖方通胀或价格欺诈）的证据不一。基于我们的综合，我们指出了未来研究需要的重要空白和政策优先事项。

records.title_en: Consumer preferences for foods with varying best if used-by dates: An experimental auction and sensory evaluation analysis
records.title_cn: 消费者对具有不同最佳食用日期食品的偏好：一项实验拍卖和感官评估分析
records.abstract_en: Food waste is a significant problem in the United States with over 133 billion pounds of food wasted every year. Best-if-used-by dates (BUBDs) are a cue consumers use in evaluating foods and deciding when to dispose of them. Many consumers believe BUBDs are an expiration indicator; instead, they represent a food’s peak quality, and foods are typically safe to consume beyond their BUBDs. A non-hypothetical experimental auction with 193 participants was utilized to determine how food sensory ratings and BUBD knowledge affects consumer willingness to pay (WTP) and anticipated food waste for foods with varying BUBDs. Through three rounds, consumers evaluated the appearance and taste of salads and deli meat with varying BUBDs, and then stated their maximum WTP for the foods and the percentage of the foods they would waste. Tobit and Cragg double hurdle model results indicate BUBDs and sensory ratings were significant in determining WTP and anticipated waste. As consumers rated the taste and appearance of salads and deli meat higher, they stated they would pay more for, and consume more of, the foods. Sensory evaluations were a stronger predictor of WTP and expected waste than BUBDs in certain scenarios. Implications of this research indicate food waste could be reduced if consumers utilize food sensory evaluations prior to disposing of foods.
records.abstract_cn: 食物浪费是美国的一个重大问题，每年有超过133亿磅的食物被浪费。最佳食用日期（BUBDs）是消费者在评估食品和决定何时丢弃时使用的一个线索。许多消费者认为BUBDs是过期指标；实际上，它们代表食品的峰值质量，食品在BUBDs之后通常仍可安全食用。一项包含193名参与者的非假设性实验拍卖被用来确定食品感官评分和BUBD知识如何影响消费者对不同BUBD食品的支付意愿（WTP）和预期食物浪费。通过三轮实验，消费者评估了具有不同BUBD的沙拉和熟食肉的外观和味道，然后陈述了他们对这些食品的最大支付意愿以及他们会浪费的食品百分比。Tobit和Cragg双重障碍模型结果表明，BUBDs和感官评分在决定WTP和预期浪费方面是显著的。随着消费者对沙拉和熟食肉的味道和外观评分越高，他们表示愿意支付更多并消费更多这些食品。在某些情况下，感官评估比BUBDs更能预测WTP和预期浪费。这项研究的启示表明，如果消费者在丢弃食品之前利用食品感官评估，可以减少食物浪费。

records.title_en: Perceived business risks and observed impacts of the Russian-Ukraine war among small- and medium-sized agri-food value chain enterprises in Egypt
records.title_cn: 埃及中小型农食价值链企业感知的俄罗斯-乌克兰战争商业风险及观察到的冲击
records.abstract_en: We examine the perceived business risks and impacts on performance associated with the Russian aggression in Ukraine in February 2022 among 450 Egyptian small and medium-sized agrifood enterprises. Our analysis identifies six distinct clusters of enterprises based on their perceived risks and three clusters based on the observed impacts of the war. We find a strong association between perceived business risks and observed impacts, suggesting that the risks identified by agrifood SMEs significantly influence their actual business performance. This underscores the importance of understanding and effectively managing perceived risks to mitigate the negative impacts of external shocks, enhance operational resilience, and improve overall performance. Moreover, the results indicate that the consequences of the war extend beyond direct effects on agrifood enterprises, affecting various stages of the agrifood chain. This implies that, in times of crisis, the absence of a well-functioning agrifood SME sector may threaten the sustainability of the entire agrifood value chain. These insights contribute to a more comprehensive understanding of the experiences of agrifood SMEs during the early stages of the war, helping policymakers and enterprises prioritize risk management strategies and allocate resources effectively to enhance performance and competitiveness in times of crisis.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了2022年二月俄罗斯对乌克兰侵略行为在450家埃及中小型农食企业中感知的商业风险及其对绩效的影响。我们的分析基于感知风险识别出六个不同的企业集群，基于观察到的战争冲击识别出三个集群。我们发现感知商业风险与观察到的冲击之间存在强关联，表明农食中小企业识别的风险显著影响其实际业务绩效。这强调了理解并有效管理感知风险以减轻外部冲击负面影响、增强运营韧性并提升整体绩效的重要性。此外，结果表明战争的后果不仅直接影响农食企业，还波及农食链的各个阶段。这意味着在危机时期，缺乏运作良好的农食中小企业部门可能威胁整个农食价值链的可持续性。这些见解有助于更全面地理解农食中小企业在战争初期的经历，帮助政策制定者和企业优先考虑风险管理策略并有效分配资源，以在危机时期提升绩效和竞争力。

records.title_en: Livestock diversification mitigates the impact of farmer-herder conflicts on animal-source foods consumption in Nigeria
records.title_cn: 牲畜多样化缓解农牧民冲突对尼日利亚动物源性食品消费的影响
records.abstract_en: The escalation of farmer-herder conflicts poses a threat to agricultural production and livelihood outcomes in Nigeria. However, households with adaptive capacity may mitigate the negative impact of these conflicts on nutritious food consumption. In this study, we examine the impact of farmer-herder conflicts on animal-source foods (ASF) consumption and investigate the extent to which livestock diversification can serve as a mitigating factor. Using panel household data from Nigeria with a global georeferenced conflict dataset, we employ fixed-effects regression models to understand a causal relationship. Our findings reveal that exposure to farmer-herder conflicts reduces the quantity of ASF consumed and increases the number of days households exclude ASF from their diets. Additionally, we establish the role livestock diversification plays in mitigating the impacts of farmer-herder conflicts on ASF consumption. This evidence provides policymakers and practitioners with potential strategies for building nutrition resilience in locations that are exposed to farmer-herder conflicts. Promoting conflict-sensitive livestock production systems, such as cattle ranching, can be a strategy for sustaining nutrition and peacebuilding in Nigeria and countries in similar conflict situations.
records.abstract_cn: 农牧民冲突的升级对尼日利亚的农业生产和生计成果构成威胁。然而，具有适应能力的家庭可能会减轻这些冲突对营养食品消费的负面影响。在本研究中，我们考察了农牧民冲突对动物源性食品（ASF）消费的影响，并探讨了牲畜多样化在多大程度上可以作为缓解因素。利用尼日利亚的面板家庭数据以及全球地理参考冲突数据集，我们采用固定效应回归模型来理解因果关系。我们的研究结果显示，暴露于农牧民冲突会减少ASF的消费量，并增加家庭将ASF排除在饮食之外的天数。此外，我们确定了牲畜多样化在缓解农牧民冲突对ASF消费影响方面的作用。这一证据为政策制定者和从业者提供了在面临农牧民冲突的地区建立营养韧性的潜在策略。推广冲突敏感的牲畜生产系统，如肉牛养殖，可以成为在尼日利亚及类似冲突局势的国家维持营养和建设和平的策略。

records.title_en: Food policies for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health (FoodPATH): A systems thinking approach
records.title_cn: 原住民与托雷斯海峡岛民健康的食品政策（FoodPATH）：一种系统思维方法
records.abstract_en: First Nations peoples have the right to participate in all decisions affecting them. This includes food policy decision-making. In the Australian state of Victoria, the Food Policies for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health (FoodPATH) project aimed to determine the food policy actions that are likely to be effective and acceptable for Victorian Aboriginal Communities. Community-based workshops were held with six Aboriginal Community-Controlled Organisations (ACCOs) in urban and regional Victoria during 2022. A team of at least three Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander facilitators guided participants (n = 53) through a series of workshop activities using group model building methods. Group model building is a participatory systems science research method which enables community stakeholders to develop a shared understanding of the system-level drivers of complex problems and co-design actions to address them. Workshop discussions coincided with real-time creation of a visual system map of the interconnected determinants of food choice. Participants used these maps to develop and prioritise actions for improving food environments and nutrition in the community. Participants identified a diverse array of interconnected factors influencing food choice and nutrition in Aboriginal Communities across Victoria. Food access and affordability, junk food marketing, food knowledge and skills and diet and disease were common themes across all sites, while access to junk food, growing local food, traditional Aboriginal foods, and family, Community and culture were key themes in most sites. Results informed a Community-driven agenda, comprising five Community-led actions and five government policy recommendations for improving food environments and nutrition for Victorian Aboriginal Communities.
records.abstract_cn: 第一民族人民有权参与所有影响他们的决策。这包括食品政策决策。在澳大利亚维多利亚州，原住民与托雷斯海峡岛民健康食品政策（FoodPATH）项目旨在确定可能对维多利亚州原住民社区有效且可接受的食品政策行动。2022年，在维多利亚州城市和地区，与六个原住民社区控制组织（ACCOs）举行了社区研讨会。一个由至少三名原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民协调员组成的团队，通过小组模型构建方法，引导参与者（n = 53）完成一系列研讨会活动。小组模型构建是一种参与式系统科学研究方法，使社区利益相关者能够对复杂问题的系统级驱动因素形成共同理解，并共同设计解决这些问题的行动。研讨会讨论与实时创建食品选择相互关联决定因素的可视化系统地图同步进行。参与者利用这些地图来制定和优先考虑改善社区食品环境和营养的行动。参与者确定了影响维多利亚州原住民社区食品选择和营养的多种相互关联因素。食品获取和可负担性、垃圾食品营销、食品知识和技能以及饮食与疾病是所有地点的共同主题，而垃圾食品的获取、本地食品种植、传统原住民食品以及家庭、社区和文化是大多数地点的关键主题。结果为一个社区驱动的议程提供了信息，该议程包括五项社区主导的行动和五项政府政策建议，以改善维多利亚州原住民社区的食品环境和营养。

records.title_en: Impact of food hubs on food security and sustainability: Food hubs perspectives from Leeds, UK
records.title_cn: 食品枢纽对粮食安全和可持续性的影响：来自英国利兹的食品枢纽视角
records.abstract_en: In the context of rising food insecurity, food hubs such as food pantries, food banks, community agriculture supported schemes, social supermarkets, community kitchens and cafes, have proliferated both in number and in the roles they perform. Food hubs have a range of benefits in the communities that they serve as well as the wider food system. However, more empirical evidence is required to build a compelling case for policy support. Using the area of Leeds, UK as a case study, and taking a mixed methods approach (i.e. evidence synthesis, mapping, survey and interviews) we present the food hubs’ perspectives on the benefits that they offer to food security, sustainability, resilience and food justice. Food hubs reflect on how their activities enhance sustainability, strengthen local food systems, support local economies, and improve the health, wellbeing and agency of their communities. In doing so, food hubs contribute to regional, national and global priorities on food security, health, sustainability, justice and resilience. However, to scale up or out their positive impact, food hubs require support to transition away from emergency food provision to longer-term, holistic and financially viable models that focus on community wellbeing and empowerment, healthy diets, local economies and environmental sustainability.
records.abstract_cn: 在粮食不安全日益加剧的背景下，食品枢纽（如食品储藏室、食品银行、社区支持农业计划、社会超市、社区厨房和咖啡馆）在数量和所扮演的角色上均有所增加。食品枢纽为其服务的社区以及更广泛的食品系统带来了一系列益处。然而，需要更多的实证证据来为政策支持提供有力依据。以英国利兹地区为案例研究，采用混合方法（即证据综合、绘图、调查和访谈），我们呈现了食品枢纽对其在粮食安全、可持续性、韧性和食品正义方面所提供益处的看法。食品枢纽反思了其活动如何增强可持续性、加强本地食品系统、支持本地经济，并改善其社区的健康、福祉和自主权。通过这样做，食品枢纽为区域、国家和全球在粮食安全、健康、可持续性、正义和韧性方面的优先事项做出了贡献。然而，为了扩大其积极影响，食品枢纽需要支持，以从紧急食品供应过渡到长期、整体且财务可行的模式，这些模式侧重于社区福祉和赋权、健康饮食、本地经济和环境可持续性。

records.title_en: Too much, too soon? Early-maturing maize varieties as drought escape strategy in Malawi
records.title_cn: 太多、太快？早熟玉米品种作为马拉维干旱逃避策略
records.abstract_en: Adopting early-maturing maize varieties can substantially increase yield and yield stability in suitable environments. Actionable recommendations that specify where early-maturing varieties can be suitably applied are lacking across low-income countries. We found for maize in Malawi that varieties with longer maturity duration provide on average the highest yield. However, if water stress occurs, we found that its timing determines which seed variety performs best. If water stress conditions are confined to the late season, early-maturing varieties escape drought and perform better than medium- and late-maturing varieties. Instead, if water stress conditions start already from mid-season, early-maturing varieties perform worst. Our results demonstrate that the typical seasonal timing of water stress can serve as a suitable criterion for recommending where to adopt early-maturing varieties. Finally, we propose an integrated research framework that complements our econometric analysis and allows to derive actionable variety suitability recommendations at the country level.
records.abstract_cn: 采用早熟玉米品种可以在适宜环境中显著提高产量和产量稳定性。在低收入国家，缺乏具体说明早熟品种在哪些地方可以适宜应用的可行建议。我们发现，在马拉维的玉米中，成熟期较长的品种平均产量最高。然而，如果发生水分胁迫，我们发现其发生时间决定了哪个种子品种表现最佳。如果水分胁迫仅限于季节后期，早熟品种能够逃避干旱，表现优于中熟和晚熟品种。相反，如果水分胁迫从季节中期就开始，早熟品种表现最差。我们的结果表明，水分胁迫的典型季节性时间可以作为推荐采用早熟品种的适宜标准。最后，我们提出了一个综合研究框架，补充了我们的计量经济分析，并能够在国家层面得出可行的品种适宜性建议。

records.title_en: Crises, prices, and poverty – An analysis based on the Mozambican household budget surveys 1996/97–2019/20
records.title_cn: 危机、价格与贫困——基于莫桑比克家庭预算调查（1996/97-2019/20）的分析
records.abstract_en: From the early 1990s, Mozambique experienced sustained economic growth and both consumption and multidimensional poverty reduced until 2014/15. Starting in the second half of 2015, a deep economic crisis hit. Economic growth plummeted and the national currency devalued significantly, leading to a general increase in prices, especially food prices. Since food products account for more than half of the consumption of poor families, and a high percentage of households are net food buyers, we argue that the food price rise is likely a major factor behind the significant upsurge in the poverty rate observed in 2019/20. Using various analytical approaches and robustness checks, we analyse and link the price trends and the shocks experienced between 2014/15 and 2019/20, in an attempt to examine and uncover how they influenced poverty. While being clearly relevant for policy makers and development partners in Mozambique, who may not have fully appraised the consequences of recent shocks on household welfare, our study is relevant to other developing countries. This is especially so for those that depend on imported food, and characterised by a high percentage of net food buyer households, who spend a large part of their income on food, and experiencing contemporary shocks involving price surges, regional disparities and weak governance. This seems even more important now after the surge in global inflation that followed the invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
records.abstract_cn: 从1990年代初开始，莫桑比克经历了持续的经济增长，消费贫困和多维贫困均有所减少，直至2014/15年。从2015年下半年起，一场严重的经济危机袭来。经济增长骤降，本币大幅贬值，导致物价普遍上涨，尤其是食品价格。由于食品占贫困家庭消费的一半以上，且高比例的家庭是食品净购买者，我们认为食品价格上涨可能是2019/20年观察到的贫困率显著上升的主要因素。通过多种分析方法和稳健性检验，我们分析并联系了2014/15年至2019/20年间经历的价格趋势和冲击，试图考察并揭示它们如何影响贫困。虽然我们的研究对莫桑比克的政策制定者和发展伙伴明显相关，他们可能尚未充分评估近期冲击对家庭福利的后果，但我们的研究也与其他发展中国家相关。尤其是那些依赖进口食品、以高比例食品净购买者家庭为特征、将大部分收入用于食品，并经历涉及价格飙升、区域差异和治理薄弱的当代冲击的国家。在2022年乌克兰入侵后全球通胀飙升的背景下，这一点现在显得更加重要。

records.title_en: Robust policy frameworks for strengthening the resilience and sustainability of agri-food global value chains
records.title_cn: 加强农业食品全球价值链韧性与可持续性的稳健政策框架
records.abstract_en: Agri-food global value chains (GVCs) have transformed food production and trade, fostering efficiency and specialization across international borders and also introducing new challenges. This paper synthesizes insights from a special issue focused on agri-food GVCs, addressing four critical areas essential for enhancing the resilience and sustainability of these chains. We explore how trade connections and specialization can drive economic growth, emphasizing the importance of GVC integration. We also examine the role of transportation and infrastructure in ensuring global trade efficiency, highlighting the need for strategic investments to support robust supply chains. Additionally, we assess the impact of trade policies on sustainability, market disruptions, and overall efficiency, underscoring the importance of regulatory frameworks that promote both economic and environmental goals. Finally, we consider the implications of domestic and trade policies on welfare and equity, particularly in developing regions where inclusive growth remains a pressing concern. By identifying these essential areas for robust policy frameworks, this paper provides actionable insights for enhancing the resilience and sustainability of the global food system, which can inform policies that enhance the benefits of agri-food GVC integration while mitigating their risks.
records.abstract_cn: 农业食品全球价值链（GVCs）已经改变了食品生产和贸易，促进了跨国界的效率和专业化，同时也带来了新的挑战。本文综合了一个专注于农业食品GVCs的特刊的见解，涉及四个关键领域，这些领域对于增强这些链条的韧性和可持续性至关重要。我们探讨了贸易联系和专业化如何推动经济增长，强调了GVC整合的重要性。我们还考察了交通和基础设施在确保全球贸易效率中的作用，强调了战略投资以支持稳健供应链的必要性。此外，我们评估了贸易政策对可持续性、市场干扰和整体效率的影响，强调了促进经济和环境目标的监管框架的重要性。最后，我们考虑了国内和贸易政策对福利和公平的影响，特别是在包容性增长仍是紧迫问题的发展中地区。通过识别这些稳健政策框架的关键领域，本文为增强全球粮食系统的韧性和可持续性提供了可操作的见解，这可以为增强农业食品GVC整合的好处同时减轻其风险的政策提供信息。

records.title_en: Fertilizer prices and deforestation in Africa
records.title_cn: 化肥价格与非洲森林砍伐
records.abstract_en: This study explores the impact of fertilizer (urea) prices on local deforestation by exploiting the exogenous variation in the world price of urea inclusive of trade costs from the world market to the local market. The empirical analysis relies on a unique geo-coded dataset on the market price of urea across 158 subnational hub markets in 21 African countries and satellite-derived forest loss estimates over the period 2003 – 2012. The results suggest that fertilizer prices positively affect deforestation rate and forest cover loss. On average, a 1 % increase in local urea prices corresponds to 97.65 Ha of forest loss within a particular local market catchment. Specifically, the results reveal a price elasticity of approximatively 1 between urea prices and forest loss. The heterogeneity analysis suggests that the effects of urea prices on forest loss tend to be concentrated in markets with subtropical and tropical ecological features. Furthermore, I provide evidence for the land-conversion mechanism, implying that urea prices are positively associated with the expansion of agricultural land. Estimating an event study around exposure to a sustained jump in urea prices reveals a persistent response of deforestation and forest cover loss to fertilizer prices.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究通过利用世界尿素价格（含从世界市场到当地市场的贸易成本）的外生变动，探讨化肥（尿素）价格对当地森林砍伐的影响。实证分析依赖于一个独特的地理编码数据集，涵盖21个非洲国家158个次国家级中心市场的尿素市场价格，以及2003-2012年期间基于卫星的森林损失估计。结果表明，化肥价格对森林砍伐率和森林覆盖损失有正向影响。平均而言，当地尿素价格每上涨1%，对应特定当地市场集水区内97.65公顷的森林损失。具体而言，结果揭示了尿素价格与森林损失之间的价格弹性约为1。异质性分析表明，尿素价格对森林损失的影响往往集中在具有亚热带和热带生态特征的市场。此外，我提供了土地转换机制的证据，表明尿素价格与农业用地扩张正相关。围绕尿素价格持续上涨的事件研究估计显示，森林砍伐和森林覆盖损失对化肥价格有持续反应。

records.title_en: The impact of pre-empting dual food quality regulation on product reformulation and packaging
records.title_cn: 预先制定双重食品质量法规对产品配方调整和包装的影响
records.abstract_en: The objective of this paper is to analyse the changes in the occurrence of the Differences in Composition of Seemingly Identical, branded food Products (DC-SIP) – also known as “dual food quality” – in the EU and the role of the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive (UCPD) in affecting the food industry’s packaging and recipe formulation choices of branded food products. The occurrence of DC-SIP has decreased from 31 % in 2018/2019 to 24 % in 2021. Our regression results show that companies are more likely to alter the front packaging rather than the composition of the products to address DC-SIP issues. The likelihood that changes in recipe reformulations and front packaging are introduced simultaneously is statistically significant but not all recipe reformulations are introduced jointly with changes in front packaging. Our results provide evidence that the UCPD regulation plays a role in companies reformulating recipes or/and changing the product packaging, but it is not a main driver. Companies often justify the composition differences in DC-SIP by differences in market conditions across Member States. The DC-SIP provisions in the UCPD give companies several options for addressing DC-SIP. For this reason, it is not a significant factor in impacting the companies' choices to reformulate or change the packaging of products.
records.abstract_cn: 本文旨在分析欧盟内部看似相同品牌食品产品成分差异（DC-SIP）——也称为“双重食品质量”——发生的变化，以及《不公平商业行为指令》（UCPD）在影响食品行业品牌食品产品包装和配方选择方面的作用。DC-SIP的发生率已从2018/2019年的31%下降至2021年的24%。我们的回归结果表明，公司更倾向于改变产品的前包装而非产品成分来解决DC-SIP问题。配方调整和前包装变更同时引入的可能性在统计上显著，但并非所有配方调整都与前包装变更同时进行。我们的结果证明，UCPD法规在公司调整配方或/和改变产品包装方面发挥了一定作用，但并非主要驱动因素。公司通常将DC-SIP中的成分差异归因于各成员国市场条件的差异。UCPD中的DC-SIP条款为公司解决DC-SIP提供了多种选择。因此，它并不是影响公司选择调整配方或改变产品包装的重要因素。

records.title_en: Do moral constraints and government interventions promote the willingness and behaviors of food saving among urban residents in China? An empirical study based on structural equation model
records.title_cn: 道德约束与政府干预是否促进了中国城市居民节约食物的意愿与行为？基于结构方程模型的实证研究
records.abstract_en: As income rises and the food supply becomes more sufficient, food waste becomes increasingly severe in emerging economies. Promoting food conservation behaviors among residents is crucial; however, there is little evidence of the consumer-related driving factors behind this behavior from both internal and external perspectives. Based on the theory of planned behavior and the structural equation model, this paper examines the impact mechanism of internal moral constraints and external government intervention on the psychology of saving food among Chinese urban residents in one research framework. Survey data combined from random street-stop interviews and an online survey are applied. Results show that moral constraints, as internal factors, still play a crucial role in forming Chinese urban residents’ willingness to save food. The most influencing mechanisms are through impacts on attitude (personal moral cognition) (β = 0.311) and perceived behavioral control (comparison of economic and moral costs and benefits) (β = 0.581). In the meantime, government interventions, as external factors, significantly impact residents’ willingness and behavior to save food. The government’s efforts in guiding food conservation have a direct promoting effect (β = 0.135) on the respondents’ food-saving willingness, while services and support to food conservation from the government directly promote food-saving behaviors (β = 0.068). Also, the number of household generations and respondent age positively impact food saving willingness, while chronic diseases, income, and food consumption expenditure have adverse impacts. Policies encouraging food saving need to conduct from both internal and external intervention. On the one hand, it demands to strengthen residents’ moral constrains by promoting traditional virtues and improving the awareness of global food security challenges, which can increase the benefits of food saving behaviors in terms of moral values. On the other hand, government intervention on guiding and supporting food conservation can effectively increase both willingness and behaviors of food saving.
records.abstract_cn: 随着收入增加和食品供应更加充足，新兴经济体的食物浪费问题日益严重。促进居民的节约食物行为至关重要；然而，从内部和外部角度探讨该行为背后的消费者相关驱动因素的证据很少。基于计划行为理论和结构方程模型，本文在一个研究框架内考察了内部道德约束和外部政府干预对中国城市居民节约食物心理的影响机制。采用了随机街头拦截访谈和在线调查相结合的调查数据。结果表明，作为内部因素的道德约束在形成中国城市居民节约食物意愿方面仍发挥着关键作用。其影响机制主要通过影响态度（个人道德认知）（β = 0.311）和感知行为控制（经济与道德成本收益比较）（β = 0.581）来实现。同时，作为外部因素的政府干预显著影响居民节约食物的意愿和行为。政府在引导节约食物方面的努力对受访者的节约食物意愿有直接促进作用（β = 0.135），而政府对节约食物的服务和支持则直接促进节约食物行为（β = 0.068）。此外，家庭代际数量和受访者年龄对节约食物意愿有正向影响，而慢性疾病、收入和食品消费支出则有不利影响。鼓励节约食物的政策需要从内部和外部干预两方面进行。一方面，需要通过弘扬传统美德和提高对全球粮食安全挑战的认识来加强居民的道德约束，这可以增加节约食物行为在道德价值方面的收益。另一方面，政府在引导和支持节约食物方面的干预可以有效提高节约食物的意愿和行为。

records.title_en: Food security and poverty reduction effects of agricultural technologies adoption − a multinomial endogenous switching regression application in rural Zimbabwe
records.title_cn: 农业技术采纳的粮食安全与减贫效应——津巴布韦农村的多项内生转换回归应用
records.abstract_en: Using nationally representative household survey data and the multinomial endogenous switching regression (MESR) procedure, this study examines the productivity, food security, and poverty reduction effects of adopting improved seed and inorganic fertilizer in rural Zimbabwe. The results show that the joint adoption of improved seed and inorganic fertilizer is facilitated by household ownership of farm mechanization, years of education of the household heads, presence of a wage worker in the household, access to irrigation facilities, and government extension services. The MESR results show that the adoption of improved seed and inorganic fertilizer, as well as their joint usage, have productivity and welfare-enhancing effects on farming households in rural Zimbabwe. More importantly, we find that while the technologies appear to impact food consumption negatively, households using the technologies jointly in production are more food secure and eat more diverse foods. This implies government efforts to promote the joint adoption of the two technologies in rural Zimbabwe are encouraged.
records.abstract_cn: 利用具有全国代表性的住户调查数据和多项内生转换回归（MESR）方法，本研究考察了在津巴布韦农村采纳改良种子和无机肥料的产量、粮食安全及减贫效应。结果表明，改良种子和无机肥料的联合采纳受到农户拥有农业机械化设备、户主受教育年限、家庭中有工资劳动者、获得灌溉设施以及政府推广服务的促进。MESR结果显示，采纳改良种子和无机肥料及其联合使用对津巴布韦农村农户具有提高产量和福利的效应。更重要的是，我们发现，尽管这些技术似乎对食品消费产生负面影响，但联合使用这些技术的农户在粮食安全方面更有保障，且饮食更加多样化。这意味着政府在津巴布韦农村推广这两种技术联合采纳的努力值得鼓励。

records.title_en: Did product certification and e-commerce benefit agricultural producers in China?
records.title_cn: 产品认证和电子商务是否惠及中国农业生产者？
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the impacts of product certification and e-commerce on various production and profitability outcomes for grain and cash crop producers in China, using nationally representative survey data. Employing multinomial endogenous switching regression (MESR) estimations, we find that agricultural producers who adopt e-commerce, product certification, or both strategies have significant price premium, increased sales revenue, and greater profitability, despite the increased production costs, with cash crop producer and large-scale producers gaining more benefits. Additionally, we find a synergistic effect: agricultural producers benefit more from adopting both product certification and e-commerce simultaneously than the sum of the effects of adopting two strategies separately. This positive reinforcement between the two strategies is more pronounced among cash crop producers compared to grain crop producers, as well as among larger-scale producers compared to their small-scale counterparts. These findings provide valuable policy implications for assisting agricultural producers in adopting suitable strategies, thereby enhancing their competitiveness and profitability within the global value chains of agri-food.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用具有全国代表性的调查数据，考察了产品认证和电子商务对中国粮食和经济作物生产者的各种生产和盈利结果的影响。通过采用多元内生转换回归（MESR）估计，我们发现采用电子商务、产品认证或两者兼用的农业生产者享有显著的价格溢价、增加的销售收入和更高的盈利能力，尽管生产成本增加，其中经济作物生产者和大规模生产者获益更多。此外，我们发现一种协同效应：同时采用产品认证和电子商务的农业生产者比分别采用两种策略的效果之和获益更多。这种两种策略之间的正强化作用在经济作物生产者中比粮食作物生产者更为明显，在大规模生产者中比小规模生产者更为突出。这些发现为帮助农业生产者采用合适策略提供了有价值的政策启示，从而增强他们在农产品全球价值链中的竞争力和盈利能力。

records.title_en: Reflections on food policy in the context of healthy and sustainable diets
records.title_cn: 健康与可持续饮食背景下的食品政策反思
records.abstract_en: Governments are urged to make significant changes to food policies to reorient food production and consumption to support healthy and sustainable food systems and diets. New Zealand, like many countries, is under pressure to address the deleterious effects of its food system on food security, nutrition, and environmental health to meet global sustainable development goals. We completed a systematic policy review to assess how food policies in New Zealand support the transition to sustainable diets by aligning with sustainable diet principles and whether this is enabled through multisectoral collaboration and policy coherence. We analysed New Zealand’s food policies against a sustainable diet framework, examining if policies are aligned with all dimensions: health and nutrition, environmental, sociocultural, and economic. We found that while sustainability is a priority, the economic, environmental, and sociocultural outcomes dominate policies concerned with food production and trade, with little attention given to nutritional health. We also found that the health impacts are often left out of multisectoral collaboration efforts and that there is a lack of coherence between health, food production, and trade sector policies concerning nutrition. These findings suggest that current policies will likely undermine nutrition-related health goals and hinder New Zealand’s ability to shift to sustainable diets and food systems. Further research is required to understand how food policies influence food producer and consumer behaviours and determine how a more coherent and comprehensive sustainability-oriented policy environment shifts behaviours towards more sustainable diets and food systems.
records.abstract_cn: 政府被敦促对食品政策进行重大调整，以重新引导食品生产和消费，支持健康和可持续的食品系统与饮食。新西兰与许多国家一样，面临压力，需要解决其食品系统对粮食安全、营养和环境健康的不利影响，以实现全球可持续发展目标。我们进行了一项系统的政策审查，以评估新西兰的食品政策如何通过符合可持续饮食原则来支持向可持续饮食的过渡，以及这是否通过多部门合作和政策一致性得以实现。我们对照可持续饮食框架分析了新西兰的食品政策，检查政策是否与所有维度一致：健康与营养、环境、社会文化和经济。我们发现，虽然可持续性是一个优先事项，但经济、环境和社会文化成果主导了涉及食品生产和贸易的政策，而对营养健康的关注很少。我们还发现，健康影响往往被排除在多部门合作努力之外，并且健康、食品生产和贸易部门政策在营养方面缺乏一致性。这些发现表明，当前政策可能会削弱与营养相关的健康目标，并阻碍新西兰向可持续饮食和食品系统转变的能力。需要进一步研究以了解食品政策如何影响食品生产者和消费者的行为，并确定一个更一致和全面的以可持续性为导向的政策环境如何将行为转向更可持续的饮食和食品系统。

records.title_en: Short food supply chains: The influence of outlet and accessibility on farmer and consumer preferences. Two discrete choice experiments
records.title_cn: 短食品供应链：销售点和可达性对农民和消费者偏好的影响。两项离散选择实验
records.abstract_en: In France, Short Food Supply Chains (SFSCs) operate under specific regulatory frameworks, involving either direct sales or transactions with no more than one intermediary. SFSCs are of particular interest to local communities as they offer a potential pathway to enhancing food security through the local provisioning of urban areas. This study investigates both consumers’ and farmers’ preferences for different SFSC outlets. Harmonized discrete choice experiments (DCEs) were conducted in 2022 in France, involving 1,021 consumers and 154 market gardeners, focusing on the consumption and sale of fresh vegetables. The objective is to examine the consistency and divergence between farmers’ and consumers’ choices among different outlets and attributes. The results indicate that consumers are less sensitive to the type of outlet than farmers. For consumers, relational proximity—direct interaction with farmers—emerges as a key factor, whereas farmers value this proximity only when it does not entail additional logistical burdens. Furthermore, mutual aid among farmers is highly appreciated, with farmers willing to lower prices when collaborating on tasks such as delivery. The findings suggest that travel time and outlet accessibility are critical, with longer travel times negatively affecting consumers more than farmers. These insights provide valuable guidance for enhancing SFSCs development, suggesting that policymakers should prioritize improving outlet accessibility, promoting farmer collaboration, and addressing logistical costs to better align supply with demand.
records.abstract_cn: 在法国，短食品供应链（SFSCs）在特定的监管框架下运作，涉及直接销售或不超过一个中间商的交易。SFSCs对当地社区尤为重要，因为它们通过城市地区的本地供应为提高食品安全提供了潜在途径。本研究调查了消费者和农民对不同SFSC销售点的偏好。2022年在法国进行了统一的离散选择实验（DCEs），涉及1,021名消费者和154名市场菜农，重点关注新鲜蔬菜的消费和销售。目的是考察农民和消费者在不同销售点和属性之间的选择的一致性和分歧。结果表明，消费者对销售点类型的敏感度低于农民。对于消费者而言，关系邻近性——与农民的直接互动——成为关键因素，而农民只有在不增加额外物流负担时才重视这种邻近性。此外，农民之间的互助受到高度赞赏，农民在合作执行如配送等任务时愿意降低价格。研究结果表明，出行时间和销售点的可达性至关重要，较长的出行时间对消费者的负面影响大于农民。这些见解为促进SFSCs发展提供了有价值的指导，建议政策制定者优先改善销售点的可达性，促进农民合作，并解决物流成本，以更好地使供给与需求对齐。

records.title_en: Citizens’ perceptions of agricultural policy goals—evidence from Switzerland
records.title_cn: 公民对农业政策目标的认知——来自瑞士的证据
records.abstract_en: Agricultural policy goals should be legitimised by the population, as agriculture is an important recipient of governmental support in Europe. Questions arise as to how people assess these policy goals, which factors affect the perception of agricultural policy goals and to what extent cultural differences influence this assessment. We address these questions by conducting an online survey among 1,542 respondents in the German-, French- and Italian-speaking parts of Switzerland. We find that the multifunctional role of agriculture is strongly anchored in the population’s perception of agricultural policy. The stated preferences of the participants show that increasing animal welfare is clearly the most important agricultural policy goal for Swiss citizens. Controlling for a range of sociodemographic characteristics and personal attitudes, we find evidence of differences between language regions and thus of cultural differences in the assessment of individual agricultural policy goals. For example, compared to respondents in the other two language regions, German-speaking respondents found increasing domestic food production significantly more important, whereas reducing food prices for consumers, increasing farmers’ income, and reducing greenhouse gas emissions were perceived as significantly less important goals. Environmental attitudes were closely related to the perceived importance of agricultural policy goals; thus, we can expect heated discussions in the future, especially if environmental objectives continue to be missed.
records.abstract_cn: 农业政策目标应由民众赋予合法性，因为农业在欧洲是政府支持的重要对象。问题在于人们如何评估这些政策目标，哪些因素影响对农业政策目标的认知，以及文化差异在多大程度上影响这种评估。我们通过在瑞士德语区、法语区和意大利语区对1,542名受访者进行在线调查来解决这些问题。我们发现，农业的多功能性角色在民众对农业政策的认知中根深蒂固。参与者的陈述偏好显示，提高动物福利显然是瑞士公民最重要的农业政策目标。在控制一系列社会人口特征和个人态度后，我们发现了语言区域之间的差异，从而表明在评估个别农业政策目标时存在文化差异。例如，与其他两个语言区域的受访者相比，德语区受访者认为提高国内粮食生产显著更重要，而降低消费者食品价格、增加农民收入和减少温室气体排放则被视为显著不那么重要的目标。环境态度与农业政策目标的感知重要性密切相关；因此，我们可以预期未来会有激烈的讨论，特别是如果环境目标继续未能实现的话。

records.title_en: Impact of crop commercialization on smallholder farmers’ resilience to shocks: Evidence from panel data for rural Southeast Asia
records.title_cn: 作物商业化对小农户冲击韧性的影响：来自东南亚农村面板数据的证据
records.abstract_en: We assess the impact of crop commercialization on the resilience to shocks of smallholder farmers and examine which groups of smallholders are more resilient from crop commercialization. We use balanced panel of 1,370 smallholders from Thailand and 1,497 smallholders from Vietnam collected in three survey waves for the empirical analysis. We employ a generalized structural equation model to estimate the (latent) variable of smallholders’ resilience. Then, we apply fixed-effects estimations with an instrumental variable and a control function approach to address the endogeneity concerns of crop commercialization in assessing the impact of commercialization on the resilience of smallholders. The results show that crop commercialization has a positive effect on smallholders’ resilience capacity. To examine which groups of smallholders are more resilient from crop commercialization, we apply an unconditional quantile regression model. The results show that crop commercialization has the highest impact on smallholders in 10th and 25th quantile groups of resilience capacity. Thus, crop commercialization should be stimulated to improve smallholders’ resilience to shocks. Besides, improving infrastructure for transportation and information and communication technology at the village level and the effectiveness of public governance at the national level could lead to a better resilience of smallholders.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了作物商业化对小农户冲击韧性的影响，并考察了哪些小农户群体更能从作物商业化中获益。我们使用来自泰国1,370个小农户和越南1,497个小农户的平衡面板数据，这些数据通过三轮调查收集，用于实证分析。我们采用广义结构方程模型来估计小农户韧性的（潜在）变量。然后，我们应用带有工具变量的固定效应估计和控制函数方法，以解决作物商业化在评估其对小农户韧性影响时的内生性问题。结果表明，作物商业化对小农户的韧性能力有正向影响。为了考察哪些小农户群体更能从作物商业化中获益，我们应用了无条件分位数回归模型。结果显示，作物商业化对韧性能力处于10和25分位数的小农户影响最大。因此，应鼓励作物商业化以提高小农户对冲击的韧性。此外，改善村级交通和信息通信技术基础设施以及国家级公共治理的有效性，可以带来更好的小农户韧性。

records.title_en: Integrating system dynamics to value chain analysis to address price volatility in the Indonesian chilli value chain
records.title_cn: 整合系统动力学与价值链分析以应对印尼辣椒价值链中的价格波动
records.abstract_en: The price volatility observed in agricultural value chains presents a significant socio-economic challenge, particularly for smallholder farmers. The issue of price volatility in agricultural value chains is complex due to the dynamic and interconnected nature of these value chains. The objective of this study is to integrate system dynamics with value chain analysis in order to address price volatility in the Indonesian chilli value chain. In order to ensure stakeholder engagement and enhance the robustness of the proposed solutions, a participatory approach will be employed. The utilisation of system dynamics enables the quantitative simulation of the inherent dynamics of the chilli value chain, thereby facilitating both ex-ante and ex-post assessment of policy interventions. A collaborative process with stakeholders was employed to develop, test, and validate a system dynamics model that operates at both provincial and national levels. The findings demonstrate that the model accurately replicates the price volatility observed in the Indonesian chilli market. The key factors contributing to this volatility are seasonal production, disorganised market governance and high postharvest losses. The analysis of policy options indicates that while the importation of chillies can stabilise prices in the short term, it has a negative impact on the income of those involved in the value chain. More sustainable solutions to mitigate price volatility include the implementation of year-round planting and the enhancement of market governance. These strategies present potential avenues for achieving a more stable and equitable chilli market, offering valuable insights for broader agricultural value chain stability.
records.abstract_cn: 农业价值链中观察到的价格波动带来了重大的社会经济挑战，尤其是对小农户而言。由于农业价值链的动态性和相互关联性，价格波动问题十分复杂。本研究的目标是将系统动力学与价值链分析相结合，以应对印尼辣椒价值链中的价格波动。为了确保利益相关者的参与并增强所提解决方案的稳健性，将采用参与式方法。系统动力学的利用能够对辣椒价值链的内在动态进行定量模拟，从而促进政策干预的事前和事后评估。与利益相关者合作开发、测试和验证了一个在省级和国家级层面运作的系统动力学模型。研究结果表明，该模型准确复制了印尼辣椒市场中观察到的价格波动。导致这种波动的主要因素是季节性生产、无序的市场治理和高产后损失。政策选项分析表明，虽然进口辣椒可以在短期内稳定价格，但对价值链参与者的收入产生负面影响。缓解价格波动的更可持续解决方案包括实施全年种植和加强市场治理。这些策略为实现更稳定和公平的辣椒市场提供了潜在途径，为更广泛的农业价值链稳定性提供了宝贵见解。

records.title_en: Women improving nutrition through self-help groups in India: Does nutrition information help?
records.title_cn: 印度妇女通过自助小组改善营养：营养信息是否有帮助？
records.abstract_en: Women’s self-help groups (SHGs) are an important platform for reaching poor women in India. Despite SHGs' women-focused programming, evidence of the impact of SHG-based interventions on nutrition outcomes is limited, and most evaluations of nutrition interventions have not examined intermediate outcomes along the impact pathways or outcomes for women themselves. This paper evaluates the effectiveness of an integrated agriculture-nutrition intervention delivered through women’s SHGs in five states in central and eastern India. The interventions involved the delivery of nutrition behavior change communication to groups through participatory approaches, community engagement around key issues, and the strengthening of collective organizations. Our analysis is based on three rounds of rich panel data on close to 2700 rural women and their households from eight districts in these five states and qualitative work from an accompanying process evaluation. Using difference-in-difference models with nearest neighbor matching methods, we present results on women’s anthropometry and diet-related outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 妇女自助小组（SHGs）是印度接触贫困妇女的重要平台。尽管自助小组以妇女为重点的项目设计，但基于自助小组的干预措施对营养结果影响的证据有限，且大多数营养干预评估未考察影响路径上的中间结果或妇女自身的结果。本文评估了通过印度中部和东部五个邦的妇女自助小组实施的农业-营养综合干预的有效性。干预措施包括通过参与式方法向小组提供营养行为改变沟通、围绕关键问题的社区参与以及加强集体组织。我们的分析基于这五个邦八个地区近2700名农村妇女及其家庭的三轮丰富面板数据，以及伴随的过程评估中的定性工作。使用双重差分模型结合最近邻匹配方法，我们展示了妇女人体测量和饮食相关结果的结果。

records.title_en: Autopsy of a futures market failure: Japan’s Dojima rice futures in the early 21st century
records.title_cn: 期货市场失败的剖析：21世纪初日本的堂岛大米期货
records.abstract_en: Futures markets promise improved price transparency and risk mitigation for staple commodities important to many developing countries, but they can fail even in developed economies with modern financial institutions. We investigate rice futures trading in Japan at the Osaka Dojima Exchange to identify the reasons underlying its failure in 2021. Our analysis reviews the multiple necessary conditions for a successful commodity futures market. We find the Japanese rice market did not meet many of these conditions. The spot market was fragmented with heterogeneous goods and a single dominant firm. Futures trading was unable to facilitate price discovery or effective hedging activity. To the extent it was traded, the Dojima rice futures contract was instead used as a forward contract for making and taking physical delivery. In addition, there was political opposition and regulatory uncertainty around futures trading. Using detailed data on trader positions in the futures market, we show how these factors contributed to diminished interest in futures trading from firms who handle physical commodities. The lessons from the Japanese case are useful for traders, exchanges, and policy makers, especially those in countries where futures markets may face similarly unfavorable economic and political conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 期货市场承诺为许多发展中国家重要的主食商品提高价格透明度和风险缓解，但即使在拥有现代金融机构的发达经济体中，它们也可能失败。我们调查了日本大阪堂岛交易所的大米期货交易，以确定其在2021年失败的原因。我们的分析回顾了成功商品期货市场的多个必要条件。我们发现日本大米市场并未满足许多这些条件。现货市场是分散的，商品异质且存在单一主导企业。期货交易无法促进价格发现或有效的对冲活动。就其交易而言，堂岛大米期货合约反而被用作进行实物交割和接收的远期合约。此外，期货交易面临政治反对和监管不确定性。利用期货市场交易者头寸的详细数据，我们展示了这些因素如何导致处理实物商品的公司对期货交易兴趣减弱。日本案例的教训对交易者、交易所和政策制定者，尤其是那些期货市场可能面临类似不利经济和政治条件的国家，具有参考价值。

records.title_en: Balancing environmental policies and food security goals in the face of shifting U.S. rail transportation regulations
records.title_cn: 在变化的美国铁路运输法规下平衡环境政策与粮食安全目标
records.abstract_en: •Analyzes impacts of California’s locomotive regulation on U.S. agricultural logistics.•Explores phased regulation to mitigate disruptions in food security and rural economies.•Discusses legal precedents, including recent U.S. Supreme Court rulings.•Considers economic impacts on agricultural producers with limited transportation options.•Emphasizes the need to balance environmental policies with global food security goals.
records.abstract_cn: •分析加州机车法规对美国农业物流的影响。•探讨分阶段监管以缓解粮食安全和农村经济的中断。•讨论法律先例，包括美国最高法院最近的裁决。•考虑对运输选择有限的农业生产者的经济影响。•强调平衡环境政策与全球粮食安全目标的必要性。

records.title_en: Behavioural insights to reach European Union consumer food waste reduction targets
records.title_cn: 行为洞察以实现欧盟消费者食物浪费减少目标
records.abstract_en: The European Union is committed via legally binding targets to reduce per capita food waste at the retail and consumption stage. This requires realising profound behavioural change in diverse political and cultural contexts. Work of food waste experts systematically analysing implemented reduction interventions revealed important insights and gaps that need to be jointly addressed by scientists, policymakers and practitioners.
records.abstract_cn: 欧盟通过具有法律约束力的目标承诺减少零售和消费阶段的人均食物浪费。这需要在不同的政治和文化背景下实现深刻的行为改变。食物浪费专家系统分析已实施的减少干预措施的工作揭示了重要的见解和差距，这些需要科学家、政策制定者和实践者共同解决。

records.title_en: Beyond information: The power of personalized nudges in promoting vegetable purchases
records.title_cn: 超越信息：个性化助推在促进蔬菜购买中的力量
records.abstract_en: This study explores the impact of providing general health-related information and personalized nudges aimed at modifying cognitive biases on enhancing vegetable purchases and consumption. We conducted a four-month natural field experiment and analyzed daily purchase records of 942 households using receipt scanner data. While merely explaining the loss-framed health benefits of vegetables did not significantly alter the overall vegetable purchasing habits, we observed a notable decrease in meat purchases, attributing this to the indirect effects of vegetable information. Additionally, when the status of relative vegetable purchases amount was provided based on personal purchase histories, individuals who initially purchased more vegetables demonstrated an increased buying volume. This effect was more pronounced in households with children than in those without. The nudging interventions had long-term effects beyond the experiment’s duration, possibly driven by an altruistic concern for children’s health within the household. Therefore, while nudges alone are not a complete solution, their ability to effect long-term changes in household purchasing patterns suggests that they can be a valuable addition to policy tools promoting sustainable and healthy food choices, as well as traditional mass-targeted promotion strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了提供一般健康相关信息以及旨在修正认知偏差的个性化助推对增强蔬菜购买和消费的影响。我们进行了一项为期四个月的自然实地实验，并使用收据扫描仪数据分析了942户家庭的每日购买记录。虽然仅仅解释蔬菜的损失框架健康益处并未显著改变整体的蔬菜购买习惯，但我们观察到肉类购买量显著减少，这归因于蔬菜信息的间接效应。此外，当根据个人购买历史提供相对蔬菜购买量的状态时，最初购买蔬菜较多的个体表现出购买量的增加。这种效应在有孩子的家庭中比没有孩子的家庭更为明显。助推干预在实验结束后具有长期效应，这可能是由家庭中对孩子健康的利他关切所驱动的。因此，虽然助推本身并非完整的解决方案，但它们改变家庭购买模式的长期能力表明，它们可以成为促进可持续和健康食品选择以及传统大众定向推广策略的政策工具的有价值补充。

records.title_en: A comment on USDA Food Business Centers: Collaborations to nurture innovation in the food system
records.title_cn: 对美国农业部食品商业中心的评论：合作培育食品系统创新

records.title_en: An approach for assessing whether agricultural projects help smallholders transition to better livelihood strategies: A malawian case study
records.title_cn: 评估农业项目是否帮助小农户向更好的生计策略转变的方法：马拉维案例研究
records.abstract_en: Agricultural projects typically aim to promote the uptake of project components amongst targeted small farm populations to improve their farm productivity and welfare. While this approach can be an important first step towards improving smallholder livelihoods, it ignores alternative and often superior livelihood options that might arise within the rural transformation process, particularly in commercial agriculture and the rural nonfarm economy. We argue that the design of smallholder projects implemented within regions already undergoing a dynamic transformation and/or projects which have significant value chain components, should be broadened to assist smallholders in making successful transitions to their best livelihood options. For such projects, monitoring and evaluation activities should track livelihood transitions as well as the usual assessments of productivity and welfare outcomes. To help operationalize such an approach, we propose a typology of smallholder livelihood strategies that can track transitions over time and illustrate its use with data from the Sustainable Agricultural Production Program (SAPP), an agricultural value chain project in Malawi. Using available household panel data and quasi-experimental econometric approaches, we find that the project helped smallholders transition out of subsistence farming to market-oriented farming and helped already existing market-oriented farmers remain as such. Even though the project did not have any specific components designed to promote off-farm incomes, nevertheless, it facilitated many farm household transitions to off-farm diversified livelihoods, possibly due to spillover benefits generated within the local nonfarm economy. All SAPP facilitated transitions led to increases in household incomes. We conclude with some lessons for designing, monitoring, and the evaluation of future agricultural projects.
records.abstract_cn: 农业项目通常旨在促进目标小农群体采纳项目组成部分，以提高其农业生产力和福利。虽然这种方法可以是改善小农生计的重要第一步，但它忽视了在农村转型过程中可能出现的替代性且往往更优越的生计选择，特别是在商业农业和农村非农经济中。我们认为，在已经经历动态转型的地区实施的小农项目，以及/或具有显著价值链组成部分的项目，其设计应扩大范围，以帮助小农成功过渡到其最佳生计选择。对于此类项目，监测和评估活动应跟踪生计转变，以及通常的生产力和福利结果评估。为了帮助实施这种方法，我们提出了一种小农生计策略的类型学，可以随时间跟踪转变，并利用马拉维的可持续农业生产计划（SAPP）——一个农业价值链项目的数据来说明其用途。利用现有的家庭面板数据和准实验计量经济学方法，我们发现该项目帮助小农从自给农业过渡到市场导向农业，并帮助已有的市场导向农民保持这种状态。尽管该项目没有任何专门设计用于促进非农收入的组成部分，但它仍然促进了许多农户向非农多样化生计的转变，这可能是由于当地非农经济中产生的溢出效益。所有SAPP促进的转变都导致了家庭收入的增加。最后，我们总结了一些对未来农业项目的设计、监测和评估的经验教训。

records.title_en: Nudging consumers’ choices for niche milk: A real purchase experiment
records.title_cn: 助推消费者对细分牛奶的选择：一项真实购买实验
records.abstract_en: Changing behaviours causing poor health is an ongoing global health challenge that requires developing adequate food policies and strengthening their effectiveness. Policies based on nudging have become increasingly popular internationally, but the literature provides mixed evidence of their effectiveness, with an intense academic debate. This study contributes to the debate by investigating the effect of different nudging techniques (availability enhancement, visibility enhancement and healthy eating calls) via a framed field experiment involving purchases of milk types. Participants were split into different nudging treatment groups and were endowed with a cash amount to purchase any desired quantity of the different products. We modelled observed choices via the multiple discrete–continuous nested extreme value model, which has yet to receive attention for the analysis of nudging effects on food choices. Results show that only the healthy eating call nudge effectively drove participants towards healthier milk choices, while the effect of other nudges is statistically insignificant. We provide simulated demand curves conditional on nudging treatments, which measure the effect of the latter on consumers’ consumption levels of the different milk types available.
records.abstract_cn: 改变导致健康状况不佳的行为是一个持续的全球健康挑战，需要制定适当的食品政策并加强其有效性。基于助推的政策在国际上日益流行，但文献对其有效性的证据不一，引发了激烈的学术争论。本研究通过一项涉及牛奶类型购买的框架实地实验，调查了不同助推技术（可得性增强、可见性增强和健康饮食呼吁）的效果，从而为这一争论做出贡献。参与者被分为不同的助推处理组，并被赋予一定现金以购买任意数量的不同产品。我们通过多重离散-连续嵌套极值模型对观察到的选择进行建模，该模型在分析助推对食品选择的影响方面尚未受到关注。结果表明，只有健康饮食呼吁助推有效地引导参与者选择更健康的牛奶，而其他助推的效果在统计上不显著。我们提供了基于助推处理的条件需求曲线，这些曲线衡量了助推处理对消费者可获得的不同牛奶类型消费水平的影响。

records.title_en: Farm size and the quality and quantity of jobs—Insights from Nigeria
records.title_cn: 农场规模与就业的数量和质量——来自尼日利亚的见解
records.abstract_en: Debates on the role of farm size for farm productivity and economic development are longstanding in agricultural and development economics. However, the link between farm size and achieving decent work and full employment—Sustainable Development Goal 8—remains unexplored, despite many African countries facing huge unemployment challenges alongside important changes in farm sizes. This paper addresses this gap by focusing on Nigeria’s labor-intensive tomato sector and using unique primary data from a matched farm-to-worker survey. We analyze the relationship between farm size and both the quantity and quality of jobs, which has never been studied before, employing multivariate regression analysis. Additionally, we account for factors that commonly differentiate larger and smaller farms, including technology use, market arrangement, crop diversification, and the reliance on seasonal versus casual labor. Our findings reveal a trade-off: smaller farms offer more jobs per hectare, while larger farms offer better jobs (i.e., higher wages and some non-monetary benefits). We conclude that neither larger nor smaller farms fully align with all dimensions of decent work and full employment, highlighting the need for greater policy and research focus on the employment quality versus quantity dilemma.
records.abstract_cn: 关于农场规模对农业生产力和经济发展作用的争论在农业经济学和发展经济学中长期存在。然而，农场规模与实现体面工作和充分就业——可持续发展目标8——之间的联系仍未得到探索，尽管许多非洲国家面临巨大的失业挑战，同时农场规模也在发生重要变化。本文通过关注尼日利亚劳动密集型的番茄部门，并利用来自农场与工人匹配调查的独特原始数据来填补这一空白。我们使用多元回归分析，研究了农场规模与就业数量和质量之间的关系，这是此前从未被研究过的。此外，我们考虑了通常区分大型和小型农场的因素，包括技术使用、市场安排、作物多样化以及对季节性劳动力和临时劳动力的依赖。我们的研究结果揭示了一种权衡：较小的农场每公顷提供更多就业机会，而较大的农场提供更好的就业机会（即更高的工资和一些非货币福利）。我们得出结论，无论是较大的农场还是较小的农场都不能完全符合体面工作和充分就业的所有维度，这凸显了在政策制定和研究中需要更加关注就业质量与数量之间的困境。

records.title_en: Public acceptance of beef carbon tax earmarks
records.title_cn: 公众对牛肉碳税专用拨款的态度
records.abstract_en: The escalating effects of climate change make it important to find ways to offset the carbon burden. One way to do so is to reduce beef consumption, since cattle production creates large amounts of greenhouse gases, which contribute to global warming and climate change. In this study, we explore US consumers’ perceptions of alternative beef products. Specifically, we test the effects of three types of earmark information on consumers’ valuation of a beef carbon tax related to hamburger meat through two labeled discrete choice experiments. Our results show that earmark information can be effective in reducing the negative impact of an environmental tax on consumers’ willingness to pay for beef products. This study contributes to a better understanding of how consumers would bear environmental taxes for beef and alternative products.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化日益加剧的影响使得寻找抵消碳负担的方法变得重要。一种方法是减少牛肉消费，因为养牛生产产生大量温室气体，这些气体导致全球变暖和气候变化。在本研究中，我们探讨了美国消费者对替代牛肉产品的看法。具体来说，我们通过两个标记离散选择实验，测试了三种专用拨款信息对消费者对与汉堡肉相关的牛肉碳税估值的影响。我们的结果表明，专用拨款信息可以有效减少环境税对消费者购买牛肉产品意愿的负面影响。本研究有助于更好地理解消费者将如何承担牛肉及替代产品的环境税。

records.title_en: Marriage customs and nutritional status of men and women
records.title_cn: 婚姻习俗与男女营养状况
records.abstract_en: Malnutrition remains a serious problem. While various nutrition policies exist, these often fail to consider cultural factors. We contribute to the literature on culture and nutrition, focusing on gendered differences in nutritional investment. Using representative panel data from Indonesia covering a period of 21 years, we analyze how ethnicity-based marriage customs are linked to the body mass index (BMI) of men and women. Patrilocal practices are positively associated with male BMI and negatively associated with female BMI, suggesting discrimination against women. Matrilocal practices are positively associated with female BMI when comparing with women in other cultural settings, but not when comparing with men. The practice of bridewealth is positively associated with male and female BMI when comparing to individuals in settings without this cultural practice. Wherever positive associations between marriage customs and BMI are observed, these are largest for those already overweight, whereas the negative association been patrilocality and female BMI is most pronounced among women who are underweight. Our findings suggest that marriage customs may reinforce nutritional inequalities. A better understanding of such links in different cultural settings is important for effective nutritional policies, especially given that different malnutrition problems coexist in many countries.
