records.abstract_cn: 营养不良仍然是一个严重的问题。尽管存在各种营养政策，但这些政策往往未能考虑文化因素。我们为关于文化与营养的文献做出贡献，重点关注营养投资中的性别差异。使用覆盖21年期间的印度尼西亚代表性面板数据，我们分析了基于种族的婚姻习俗如何与男性和女性的身体质量指数（BMI）相关联。从夫居习俗与男性BMI正相关，与女性BMI负相关，表明存在对女性的歧视。与其他文化背景下的女性相比，从妻居习俗与女性BMI正相关，但与男性相比则不然。与没有这种文化习俗的环境中的个体相比，聘礼习俗与男性和女性的BMI正相关。在观察到婚姻习俗与BMI正相关的地方，这些关联对于已经超重的人群最为显著，而从夫居与女性BMI之间的负相关在体重不足的女性中最为明显。我们的研究结果表明，婚姻习俗可能加剧营养不平等。在不同文化背景下更好地理解这种联系对于有效的营养政策至关重要，尤其是在许多国家不同营养不良问题并存的情况下。

records.title_en: Trans-Governance and Food Systems (Tr-GaF) for food policy integration: A case study of the Australian food policy landscape
records.title_cn: 跨治理与食品系统（Tr-GaF）用于食品政策整合：澳大利亚食品政策格局的案例研究
records.abstract_en: Food policy integration is critical for sustainability as urban food policies become a new norm in the policy agenda. Yet, little research demonstrates how food policies are integrated with food systems and across governance to achieve urban sustainability.This paper presents the Trans-Governance and Food Systems (Tr-GaF) framework for food policy integration developed to evaluate the Australian food policy landscape. The analysis of 102 food-relevant policy documents sourced from multiple government institutions in Queensland, Western Australia, and Victoria identifies limited food policy integration in Australia, with little attention paid to food-related urban planning. Policy misalignments arise in the agrifood economy, health and well-being, and environment and ecology domains, with horizontal and vertical fragmentation across governance levels and sectors. Inadequate integration with food systems further jeopardises the efficiency of urban food supply chains and consumption activities. These three prominent issues collectively stifle urban sustainability by economically restraining food supply chain actors’ ability to innovate and compete. While environmental imbalance worsens, urbanites inevitably face barriers to maintaining health and social well-being. Tr-GaF provides an evidenced-based framework for policymakers to evaluate and integrate food policies anchored in food systems governed by collaborative multi-scalar government agencies, institutions, food industries, and civil society. In doing so, urban development can sustainably evolve economically, socially, and environmentally.
records.abstract_cn: 食品政策整合对于可持续性至关重要，因为城市食品政策正成为政策议程中的新常态。然而，很少有研究展示食品政策如何与食品系统及跨治理层面整合以实现城市可持续性。本文提出了用于食品政策整合的跨治理与食品系统（Tr-GaF）框架，旨在评估澳大利亚的食品政策格局。对来自昆士兰州、西澳大利亚州和维多利亚州多个政府机构的102份食品相关政策文件的分析显示，澳大利亚的食品政策整合有限，对食品相关的城市规划关注甚少。政策错位出现在农业食品经济、健康与福祉以及环境与生态领域，且在治理层级和部门之间存在横向和纵向的碎片化。与食品系统的整合不足进一步危及城市食品供应链和消费活动的效率。这三个突出问题共同抑制了城市可持续性，在经济上限制了食品供应链参与者的创新和竞争能力。而环境失衡加剧，城市居民不可避免地面临维持健康和社会福祉的障碍。Tr-GaF为政策制定者提供了一个基于证据的框架，用于评估和整合以食品系统为基础的食品政策，这些政策由协作的多层级政府机构、机构、食品行业和公民社会共同治理。通过这种方式，城市发展可以在经济、社会和环境方面可持续地演进。

records.title_en: Nutrition education effects on food and nutrition security for women living with HIV/AIDS in Uganda
records.title_cn: 营养教育对乌干达感染艾滋病毒/艾滋病妇女的粮食和营养安全的影响
records.abstract_en: Food and Nutrition Security (FNS) is one of the key global concerns yet in the face of HIV/AIDS, it is compromised. The significance of nutrition education targeted at women in promoting food and nutrition security cannot be overstated, considering their role in ensuring food and nutrition security for their household members. However, empirical evidence on the causal impact of nutrition education on food and nutrition status is limited to the individual level and very scanty for vulnerable groups such as HIV/AIDS-positive women. This study used a large dataset from a randomized control experiment with 3,200 women to investigate the effects of nutrition education on household behaviour and food nutrition outcomes. Results indicate that the intervention results in increasing the individual woman’s labour supply on-farm and diversifying crops grown by the household. Positive influences of nutrition education on dietary diversity are observed but were only significant at the household level. Individual women’s nutrition outcomes were strongly influenced by engagement in an income-generating activity or household’s market participation. As such, blending nutrition education interventions with initiatives that facilitate access to the needed nutritious foods such as on-farm diversification and activities that generate revenues from off the farm was recommended.
records.abstract_cn: 粮食和营养安全是全球关注的关键问题之一，但在艾滋病毒/艾滋病面前，它受到了损害。针对妇女的营养教育在促进粮食和营养安全方面的重要性不容低估，因为她们在确保家庭成员粮食和营养安全方面发挥着作用。然而，关于营养教育对粮食和营养状况因果影响的实证证据仅限于个体层面，对于艾滋病毒/艾滋病阳性妇女等弱势群体则非常稀少。本研究使用来自一项随机对照实验的大型数据集，涉及3,200名妇女，以调查营养教育对家庭行为和粮食营养结果的影响。结果表明，干预措施增加了个体妇女在农场上的劳动供给，并使家庭种植的作物多样化。观察到营养教育对饮食多样性的积极影响，但仅在家庭层面显著。个体妇女的营养结果受到参与创收活动或家庭市场参与的强烈影响。因此，建议将营养教育干预与促进获得所需营养食品的举措相结合，如农场多样化以及从农场外产生收入的活动。

records.title_en: Maternal employment in high-value agriculture and child nutrition: Evidence from the Ethiopian cut-flower industry
records.title_cn: 高价值农业中的女性就业与儿童营养：来自埃塞俄比亚切花产业的证据
records.abstract_en: In many low- and middle-income countries, agri-food supply chains are transforming rapidly. One important feature of this transformation is growth in certain high-value agricultural subsectors, such as horticulture and cut-flowers for export. Growth in high-value agriculture often creates new employment opportunities, especially for women. More employment can lead to higher rural incomes, but the broader implications for social welfare are not yet sufficiently understood. Here, we use survey data from Ethiopia to investigate the effects of women’s employment in floriculture on child nutrition, focusing on children aged 0–5 years. We develop and estimate endogenous switching regressions to account for possible endogeneity. Our results suggest that maternal employment in floriculture negatively affects child height-for-age and weight-for-age z-scores (HAZ and WAZ). Exploration of the underlying mechanisms reveals that floriculture employment may influence time allocation, dietary quality, income, and female financial autonomy. Maternal employment is negatively associated with time spent on childcare and consumption of animal-sourced foods.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多低收入和中等收入国家，农业食品供应链正在快速转型。这一转型的一个重要特征是某些高价值农业子部门（如园艺和出口切花）的增长。高价值农业的增长往往创造新的就业机会，尤其是对女性而言。更多就业可以带来更高的农村收入，但其对社会福利的更广泛影响尚未得到充分理解。在此，我们利用埃塞俄比亚的调查数据，研究花卉产业中女性就业对儿童营养的影响，重点关注0-5岁儿童。我们开发并估计了内生转换回归模型以处理潜在的内生性问题。我们的结果表明，花卉产业中的母亲就业对儿童年龄别身高和年龄别体重z分数（HAZ和WAZ）有负面影响。对潜在机制的探索显示，花卉产业就业可能影响时间分配、饮食质量、收入和女性财务自主权。母亲就业与用于儿童照护的时间和动物源性食品消费呈负相关。

records.title_en: Race, ethnicity, and the distribution of energy efficiency incentives
records.title_cn: 种族、民族与能源效率激励的分布
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the distribution of energy efficiency incentives by race and ethnicity among residential American households based on data from the Residential Energy Consumption Survey. Across a variety of types of incentives, non-Hispanic White households are the mostly likely to have received an incentive relative to American Indian or Alaskan Native; Asian; Black or African American; Hispanic White; Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander; or multi-racial households. I compute concentration indices to compare the degree of inequality by type of incentive. Tax credits, utility rebates, and subsidies for home energy audits have similar levels of inequality by race and ethnicity. Subsidies for efficient light bulbs have a more equal rate of uptake. The driving mechanism for these disparities appears to be that non-Hispanic White households are more likely to be homeowners, as the differences in uptake disappear in models that control for homeowner/renter status.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于住宅能源消费调查数据，考察了美国住宅家庭中能源效率激励按种族和民族的分布情况。在各类激励措施中，非西班牙裔白人家庭相对于美洲印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民、亚裔、黑人或非裔美国人、西班牙裔白人、夏威夷原住民或其他太平洋岛民以及多种族家庭，最有可能获得激励。我计算了集中指数，以比较不同激励类型下的不平等程度。税收抵免、公用事业回扣和家庭能源审计补贴在种族和民族方面的不平等程度相似。高效灯泡补贴的获取率则更为平等。这些差异的驱动机制似乎是，非西班牙裔白人家庭更有可能拥有住房，因为在控制房主/租户身份的模型中，这些差异消失了。

records.title_en: Tail risk spillovers between Shanghai oil and other markets
records.title_cn: 上海原油与其他市场之间的尾部风险溢出
records.abstract_en: This paper uses daily returns data from January 2011 to December 2022 to analyse the tail risk spillovers between Shanghai oil and a sample of stock and commodities markets. The computed CAViaR measures each market's tail risk and analyses the connectedness network using the TVP-VAR method. The tail risk spillover network estimates reveal clustering—as stocks and commodities within the same category are vigorously connected. Shanghai oil's links to the global markets remain limited, but it is a net risk receiver. As such, Shanghai oil is a lesser player in the global financial system than WTI or Brent. Nevertheless, (tail risk) connectedness between Shanghai oil and sample markets soars during crises such as the shale oil revolution, the COVID-19 pandemic, and the Russia-Ukraine war. Among the crises, COVID-19 has had the most potent effect on our markets—with connectedness indicators exceeding 70%. The spillover size and shape differ considerably by crisis events. Thus, Shanghai oil futures may be viewed as a novel financial market that permits both domestic and international investors to access the Chinese crude oil market and diversify their investment risk.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用2011年一月至2022年十二月的日收益率数据，分析上海原油与一组股票和大宗商品市场之间的尾部风险溢出。计算出的CAViaR衡量每个市场的尾部风险，并使用TVP-VAR方法分析关联网络。尾部风险溢出网络的估计结果揭示了聚类现象——同一类别内的股票和大宗商品之间存在紧密关联。上海原油与全球市场的联系仍然有限，但它是净风险接收者。因此，上海原油在全球金融体系中的重要性低于WTI或布伦特原油。然而，在页岩油革命、COVID-19大流行和俄乌战争等危机期间，上海原油与样本市场之间的（尾部风险）关联性急剧上升。在这些危机中，COVID-19对市场的影响最为显著——关联性指标超过70%。溢出的大小和形态因危机事件而异。因此，上海原油期货可被视为一个新兴金融市场，允许国内外投资者进入中国原油市场并分散投资风险。

records.title_en: Inflationary oil shocks, fiscal policy, and debt dynamics: New evidence from oil-importing OECD economies
records.title_cn: 通胀性石油冲击、财政政策与债务动态：来自石油进口型OECD经济体的新证据
records.abstract_en: Appropriate fiscal and monetary policies are essential for mitigating the surging inflation caused by post-Covid 19 commodity price shocks, whilst minimizing real output losses. Considerable attention, however, has focused on the implications for monetary policy but somewhat neglected the fiscal dimension. By estimating Proxy-VARs we study the impact of inflationary oil supply and demand shocks on the dynamics of the fiscal balance and public debt in seven oil-importing OECD economies and the Eurozone bloc. The results indicate that fiscal balances actually increase in the medium-term following an inflationary oil shock, and public debt-to-GDP ratios fall. A key implication is that policy makers have more fiscal space than typically assumed, and will run the risk of an excessively contractionary macroeconomic policy stance if they do not account for this increase in the fiscal balance following inflationary oil shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 适当的财政和货币政策对于缓解后新冠19商品价格冲击引发的通胀飙升至关重要，同时需最小化实际产出损失。然而，大量关注集中于货币政策的影响，而财政层面在一定程度上被忽视。通过估计Proxy-VAR模型，我们研究了通胀性石油供给和需求冲击对七个石油进口型OECD经济体及欧元区集团的财政平衡和公共债务动态的影响。结果表明，在通胀性石油冲击后的中期，财政平衡实际上有所增加，公共债务与GDP之比下降。一个关键含义是，政策制定者拥有比通常假设更大的财政空间，如果他们没有考虑到通胀性石油冲击后财政平衡的这一增加，将面临采取过度紧缩的宏观经济政策立场的风险。

records.title_en: A simple model of global fuel consumption
records.title_cn: 全球燃料消费的简单模型
records.abstract_en: We present an SVAR model of the global oil market that utilizes information on global oil consumption in the form of fuels. Under mild identifying assumptions, data on global fuel consumption provides comparatively sharp insights into structural parameters of the global oil market. The estimated short-run global fuel demand elasticity with respect to crude oil prices is around −2%, which is considerably more inelastic than estimates of local fuel demand elasticities based on disaggregated data. Our framework provides new evidence on the drivers of oil-market dynamics and on the effects of climate change policies that act through the price of oil.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个全球石油市场的SVAR模型，该模型利用全球石油消费信息（以燃料形式）。在温和的识别假设下，全球燃料消费数据为全球石油市场的结构参数提供了相对清晰的洞察。估计的短期全球燃料需求对原油价格的弹性约为−2%，这比基于分解数据的局部燃料需求弹性估计要缺乏弹性得多。我们的框架为石油市场动态的驱动因素以及通过石油价格起作用的气候变化政策的影响提供了新的证据。

records.title_en: Technological peer pressure and corporate sustainability
records.title_cn: 技术同行压力与企业可持续性
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the relationship between technological peer pressure (TPP) and corporate sustainability performance. Studying 1536 firms in the United States for the period 2002 to 2021, we provide strong and robust evidence that corporates’ environmental and social performance have a negative effect on technological peer pressure. Our empirical findings support the view that resource constraints and agency problems serve as channels in this relationship. Additional analyses reveal industry heterogeneity of this relation that the negative impacts are stronger in the firm with high research and development (R&D) intensity, in high-tech industries, non-customer-facing sectors and “green” industries. In summary, our results highlight the importance of technological competition in the product market in the knowledge-based economy and firms’ sustainability strategies in competitive industries.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了技术同行压力（TPP）与企业可持续性绩效之间的关系。通过研究美国1536家公司，时间跨度为2002年至2021年，我们提供了强有力的证据表明，企业的环境和社会绩效对技术同行压力有负面影响。我们的实证结果支持资源约束和代理问题作为这种关系的渠道的观点。进一步的分析揭示了这种关系的行业异质性，即在高研发（R&D）强度、高科技行业、非面向消费者部门和“绿色”行业中，负面影响更为显著。总之，我们的结果强调了知识经济中产品市场竞争的重要性以及竞争行业中企业的可持续性战略。

records.title_en: Party affiliation, economic interests and U.S. governors’ renewable energy policies
records.title_cn: 党派归属、经济利益与美国州长可再生能源政策
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the impact of U.S. state governors’ party affiliation and economic interests on renewable energy outcomes. Using data on installed renewable capacity, we find that, on average, Democratic governors had a positive impact on the state-level adoption of renewable energy. However, the effect is highly heterogeneous. There are no differences in renewable energy outcomes between Democratic and Republican governors in states where the energy-intensive manufacturing industries are economically important or in states where the natural renewable endowment is scarce. Consistent with a political economy approach, we argue that in the area of renewable and climate policy, governors’ policy preferences are overridden by holding office motivations and economic interests.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了美国各州州长的党派归属和经济利益对可再生能源成果的影响。利用已安装可再生能源容量的数据，我们发现，平均而言，民主党州长对州级可再生能源的采纳产生了积极影响。然而，这种影响具有高度异质性。在能源密集型制造业具有重要经济地位的州，或自然可再生能源禀赋稀缺的州，民主党与共和党州长在可再生能源成果上没有差异。与政治经济学方法一致，我们认为在可再生能源和气候政策领域，州长的政策偏好被任职动机和经济利益所压倒。

records.title_en: Climate policy volatility hinders renewable energy consumption: Evidence from yardstick competition theory
records.title_cn: 气候政策波动阻碍可再生能源消费：来自标杆竞争理论的证据
records.abstract_en: Researchers have a high affirmative agreement on climate change and the need for policies to stimulate renewable energy consumption. However, there is little consensus among policymakers who are supposed to implement the solutions researchers propose. This phenomenon has led to extensive research on the effects of climate policy uncertainty (CPU) on energy consumption. We develop a yardstick competition model to examine the effect of climate policy volatility (CPV) on primary energy consumption in the U.S. residential sector. Our approach employs a Dirichlet process mixture linear model (DPM-LM) to account for unobserved heterogeneity and excess kurtosis. The results revealed that all three CPV estimators (Garman-Klass, Parkinson, and Rogers-Satchell) adversely affected the demand for hydrocarbon gas liquids (HGL) and biomass energy. In contrast, they positively affected the consumption of natural gas. The control variables (price and GDP) were consistent with the a priori expectations. This paper concludes that CPV creates a disincentive to increasing renewable energy demand. It is, therefore, critical for policymakers to consider ways of stabilizing climate policy and arriving at specific, measurable, achievable, realistic and definite time-bound goals and policies. It is equally important for policymakers to use science-based ex-post measures to inform the climate policy debate.
records.abstract_cn: 研究人员对气候变化以及刺激可再生能源消费的政策需求高度一致。然而，在应当实施研究人员提出的解决方案的政策制定者中，却鲜有共识。这一现象引发了对气候政策不确定性（CPU）对能源消费影响的广泛研究。我们构建了一个标杆竞争模型，以考察气候政策波动性（CPV）对美国住宅部门一次能源消费的影响。我们的方法采用狄利克雷过程混合线性模型（DPM-LM）来解释未观测异质性和超额峰度。结果显示，所有三个CPV估计量（Garman-Klass、Parkinson和Rogers-Satchell）对液化烃气体（HGL）和生物质能源的需求产生了不利影响。相反，它们对天然气的消费产生了积极影响。控制变量（价格和GDP）与先验预期一致。本文得出结论，CPV对增加可再生能源需求产生了抑制作用。因此，政策制定者考虑稳定气候政策并制定具体、可衡量、可实现、现实且有时限的目标和政策至关重要。同样重要的是，政策制定者应使用基于科学的事后措施来为气候政策辩论提供信息。

records.title_en: A novel interval-based hybrid framework for crude oil price forecasting and trading
records.title_cn: 一种新的基于区间的原油价格预测与交易混合框架
records.abstract_en: Existing research has demonstrated the effectiveness of hybrid models in improving the accuracy of crude oil forecasting compared to single models. However, these works usually focus on point-valued crude oil closing prices which may suffer from information loss. Instead, this paper proposes a novel interval-based framework based on the principle of “divide and conquer”. After deploying variational mode decomposition (VMD) on an original training series to decompose it into low- and high-frequency components, a newly proposed autoregressive conditional interval (ACI) model is applied to predict the interval-valued low-frequency component which is treated as an inseparable random set, while the interval-valued high-frequency component is predicted by interval long short-term memory (iLSTM) networks. Combination of the two parts yields the final interval-valued prediction. A trading strategy for interval-valued data is designed and executed on a daily basis. Compared to benchmark models and competing trading strategies, the proposed framework can generate superior forecasts and deliver enhanced trading performances. The analysis within this study indicates that the framework’s outstanding performance is robust to various forecasting horizons.
records.abstract_cn: 现有研究已证明，与单一模型相比，混合模型在提高原油预测准确性方面的有效性。然而，这些工作通常关注点值的原油收盘价，这可能会遭受信息损失。相反，本文基于“分而治之”原则提出了一种新颖的基于区间的框架。在将变分模态分解（VMD）应用于原始训练序列以将其分解为低频和高频分量后，应用新提出的自回归条件区间（ACI）模型来预测被视为不可分离随机集的区间值低频分量，而区间值高频分量则由区间长短期记忆（iLSTM）网络预测。两部分的组合产生最终的区间值预测。设计并每日执行一种针对区间值数据的交易策略。与基准模型和竞争性交易策略相比，所提出的框架能够产生优越的预测并带来增强的交易表现。本研究的分析表明，该框架的出色表现对各种预测期限具有稳健性。

records.title_en: The role of green energy stock market in forecasting China's crude oil market: An application of IIS approach and sparse regression models
records.title_cn: 绿色能源股票市场在中国原油市场预测中的作用：IIS方法及稀疏回归模型的应用
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the effectiveness of sparse regression models with their diverse specifications and the impulse indicator saturation (IIS) method in forecasting crude oil prices and their returns in China. The empirical findings showed that the IIS approach and sparse regression models are more effective than the benchmark of the no-change model. The IIS approach consistently outperformed the competing models and produced reliable results in terms of both ROS2 statistics and success ratio, as it is invariant to window size and time horizon. The results suggest that sparse regression models exhibit a notable decline in accuracy compared to the IIS approach over the long horizon. However, the selection of window size in the rolling window method plays a crucial role. Meanwhile, the sparse regression models are quite sensitive to window size; with a long horizon forecast and a small window size, the accuracy of the results is far less than with a broader window size. In contrast, the IIS method provides quite accurate forecasts regardless of window size and time horizon. The elastic smoothly clipped absolute deviation (E-SCAD) and elastic minimax concave penalty (E-MCP) remained more successful across the sparse models, possibly as a result of the high correlation among the set of predictors.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了具有不同规格的稀疏回归模型以及脉冲指示器饱和（IIS）方法在预测中国原油价格及其收益率方面的有效性。实证结果表明，IIS方法和稀疏回归模型比无变化模型基准更有效。IIS方法在ROS2统计量和成功率方面均持续优于竞争模型，并产生可靠的结果，因为它对窗口大小和时间范围具有不变性。结果表明，在长期范围内，稀疏回归模型相比IIS方法表现出显著的准确性下降。然而，滚动窗口方法中窗口大小的选择起着关键作用。同时，稀疏回归模型对窗口大小相当敏感；在长期预测和小窗口大小的情况下，结果的准确性远低于使用更宽窗口大小的情况。相比之下，IIS方法无论窗口大小和时间范围如何，都能提供相当准确的预测。弹性平滑剪切绝对偏差（E-SCAD）和弹性最小最大凹惩罚（E-MCP）在稀疏模型中保持更成功，这可能是由于预测因子集之间的高度相关性。

records.title_en: Environmental regulation and firms' emission reduction – The policy of eliminating backward production capacity as a quasi-natural experiment
records.title_cn: 环境规制与企业减排——以淘汰落后产能政策为准自然实验
records.abstract_en: This study examines the effects of environmental regulations on firms' emission reductions. Using the Eliminating Backward Production Capacity policy in China as a quasi-natural experiment, our matching difference-in-differences estimation shows that the policy significantly reduces the sulfur dioxide (SO2) intensity of regulated firms by 5%. The results remain robust across different specifications and alternative outcome variables. The mechanism test results show that the reduction in SO2 intensity results from a smaller reduction in total output than in total SO2 emissions or energy consumption. This effect is particularly pronounced in regions with stronger motivation to reduce emissions, less fiscal pressure, and higher levels of air pollution, as well as in the central and western regions. Furthermore, this study finds a pollution leakage from regulated firms to other local firms. The larger the size of other local firms, the more pronounced the increase in their output. Overall, we find a 50% rebound in pollution due to leakage. However, as the policy also increases total output by 187%, our results indicate that the policy is effective in substituting backward with advanced production capacity. Our findings provide empirical evidence regarding the use of command-and-control policies to adjust the technological structure of production for technological upgrading and environmental improvement. This provides a valuable reference for developing countries to consider similar policies.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了环境规制对企业减排的影响。以中国淘汰落后产能政策为准自然实验，我们的匹配双重差分估计表明，该政策显著降低了受规制企业的二氧化硫（SO2）强度，降幅为5%。结果在不同设定和替代结果变量下保持稳健。机制检验结果表明，SO2强度的降低源于总产出下降幅度小于SO2总排放量或能源消耗的下降幅度。这一效应在减排动机更强、财政压力较小、空气污染水平较高的地区以及中西部地区尤为显著。此外，本研究还发现受规制企业向其他本地企业存在污染泄漏。其他本地企业的规模越大，其产出增加越明显。总体而言，我们发现因泄漏导致的污染反弹为50%。然而，由于该政策也使总产出增加了187%，我们的结果表明，该政策在淘汰落后产能、以先进产能替代方面是有效的。我们的研究为利用命令控制型政策调整生产技术结构以实现技术升级和环境改善提供了经验证据，为发展中国家考虑类似政策提供了有价值的参考。

records.title_en: Household willingness to pay for various attributes of residential solar panels: Evidence from a discrete choice experiment
records.title_cn: 家庭对住宅太阳能电池板各种属性的支付意愿：来自离散选择实验的证据
records.abstract_en: The predominant approach in the US environmental policy so far has been to offer financial incentives for renewable energy as a more politically palatable alternative to market based policies. The policies around residential rooftop solar have generally aligned with this approach. However, recent years have witnessed a reversal in the once favorable financial terms for residential solar energy in many states largely due to concerns regarding unfair cost shifting and efficiency. Consequently, solar vendors appear to increasingly hinge their marketing strategies on the narrative of “self-reliance”. A pertinent question is whether there is enough willingness to pay for such non-market, private benefits to sustain the growth of residential solar. To address this, we designed and implemented a discrete choice experiment within a stated preference framework. Respondents were asked to make a choice among different home energy options offering varying financial terms and other attributes such as self-reliance and home battery. Notably, a random subset of the respondents was presented with the net present value (NPV) of the dollar cost of each alternative, while this information was withheld from the rest of the sample. We estimated the utility coefficients through hierarchical Bayes (HB) mixed logit and subsequently derived the marginal willingness to pay (mWTP) for each attribute, along with their individual-level confidence intervals. Our findings indicate substantial heterogeneity in preferences among decision-makers. On average, the willingness to pay for self-reliance falls short of supporting residential solar growth without financial incentives. Furthermore, respondents exposed to NPV information exhibited significantly lower mWTP values, underscoring the potential efficacy of NPV information in improving willingness to pay estimates within investment-oriented settings.
records.abstract_cn: 迄今为止，美国环境政策的主要方法是为可再生能源提供财政激励，作为市场基础政策在政治上更易被接受的选择。住宅屋顶太阳能的政策大体上也遵循了这一方法。然而，近年来，许多州对住宅太阳能的曾经有利的财政条件出现了逆转，这主要是由于对不公平成本转移和效率的担忧。因此，太阳能供应商似乎越来越多地将其营销策略依赖于“自力更生”的叙事。一个相关的问题是，对于这种非市场的、私人利益，是否有足够的支付意愿来维持住宅太阳能的增长。为了解决这个问题，我们在陈述偏好框架内设计并实施了一个离散选择实验。受访者被要求在不同的家庭能源选项中进行选择，这些选项提供不同的财政条款和其他属性，如自力更生和家用电池。值得注意的是，随机子集的受访者被提供了每个替代方案的美元成本的净现值（NPV），而这一信息对样本中的其余部分则被隐瞒。我们通过分层贝叶斯（HB）混合logit模型估计了效用系数，并随后推导出每个属性的边际支付意愿（mWTP）及其个体水平的置信区间。我们的研究结果表明，决策者之间的偏好存在显著的异质性。平均而言，对自力更生的支付意愿不足以在没有财政激励的情况下支持住宅太阳能的增长。此外，接触NPV信息的受访者表现出显著较低的mWTP值，这强调了NPV信息在投资导向环境中改善支付意愿估计的潜在有效性。

records.title_en: Media sentiment emotions and consumer energy prices
records.title_cn: 媒体情绪与消费者能源价格
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes how sentiment from different news sources affect[s] energy prices for consumers. We assess the impact of sentiments derived from newspaper and social media on prices of gasoline, heating oil and natural gas from 2006 until 2021. Having shown that sentiments derived from social media and newspapers differ significantly in the first step, we show that newspaper sentiments have significant effects on prices in times of high news coverage while the effects of social media news are negligible. Finally, we illustrate that strong emotions in newspaper coverage have additional price effects and analyze a potential factor structure for out-of-sample forecasts.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了不同新闻来源的情绪如何影响消费者的能源价格。我们评估了从报纸和社交媒体中提取的情绪对2006年至2021年间汽油、取暖油和天然气价格的影响。在第一步中，我们证明了社交媒体和报纸提取的情绪存在显著差异，随后我们表明，在高新闻覆盖时期，报纸情绪对价格有显著影响，而社交媒体新闻的影响则可忽略不计。最后，我们说明报纸报道中的强烈情绪具有额外的价格效应，并分析了样本外预测的潜在因子结构。

records.title_en: Assessing the linkage of energy cryptocurrency with clean and dirty energy markets
records.title_cn: 评估能源加密货币与清洁和肮脏能源市场的关联性
records.abstract_en: The primary objective of this study is to explore the dynamic connectedness that exists among energy cryptocurrencies, clean energy metals, and conventional dirty energies. Moreover, we aim to investigate the time-varying effects of uncertainties on the connectedness that exists among these asset classes. We uncover heterogeneous reactions among energy cryptocurrencies and other assets. Common positive co-movement clustering is revealed mostly during the periods of the cryptocurrency crash and boom in 2018 and 2020, and the oil market crash, respectively. However, a constant weak and strong co-movement over shorter and longer horizons is observed throughout the sample period for all pairs analysed, with varying outcomes for longer horizons. Combining VIX and US EPU as measures of financial and economic uncertainty, we contend that uncertainty significantly affects energy cryptocurrencies, clean and dirty energies, and clean energy metals, with relatively weak impacts or influences observed for longer investment horizons. Our findings are highly beneficial to cryptocurrency investors, alternative asset investors, and policy makers, especially during periods of market turmoil.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究的主要目标是探索能源加密货币、清洁能源金属和传统肮脏能源之间存在的动态连通性。此外，我们旨在调查不确定性对这些资产类别之间连通性的时变影响。我们揭示了能源加密货币与其他资产之间的异质性反应。常见的正协同运动聚类主要出现在2018年和2020年的加密货币崩盘和繁荣时期，以及石油市场崩盘时期。然而，在整个样本期间，对于所有分析的对，观察到较短和较长时期内持续存在的弱和强协同运动，且较长时期的结果有所不同。结合VIX和美国EPU作为金融和经济不确定性的衡量指标，我们认为不确定性显著影响能源加密货币、清洁和肮脏能源以及清洁能源金属，而对较长投资期限的影响相对较弱。我们的发现对加密货币投资者、另类资产投资者和政策制定者非常有益，尤其是在市场动荡时期。

records.title_en: Quantifying the dynamics of relationships between eco-innovations and SDG 8
records.title_cn: 量化生态创新与可持续发展目标8之间关系的动态
records.abstract_en: Achieving the sustainable development goals is a major challenge for all the countries. The possibilities are constantly being sought to ensure environmental sustainability and economic sustainability at the same time. The optimal tool in this process is green finance, which is greatly important to achieve the sustainable development goals (SDGs) from the point of view of environmental and economic sustainability. The study's main goal was to analyze and quantify the relationships between the selected categories of eco-innovations and SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth) as one of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals established by the United Nations General Assembly in 2015. Annual data were collected from all the countries that have been European Union members since 2013. The outcomes of the regression models confirmed the assumption of a relationship between the eco-innovations and SDG 8. The closest relations were found in the field of employment, meaning that with the growth of eco-innovations, the employment rate should also increase. We also examine the countries' position in eco-innovations and SDG 8. Northern European countries received the most positive evaluations, while southern countries had negative evaluations. The study results provide valuable information to support the decision-making processes for the eco-innovation policymakers, as well as for the institutions and the regulatory authorities. Our findings clearly illustrate achieving SDG 8 through eco-innovative development and confirm the detailed insights into the explored relations between eco-innovations and human resources. This study's findings also support the creation of a national and international comparative platform and the development of benchmarking indicators in the eco-innovations and green growth field.
records.abstract_cn: 实现可持续发展目标是所有国家面临的重大挑战。人们不断寻求确保环境可持续性和经济可持续性的可能性。在这一过程中，绿色金融是最佳工具，从环境和经济可持续性的角度来看，它对实现可持续发展目标（SDGs）至关重要。本研究的主要目标是分析和量化所选生态创新类别与可持续发展目标8（体面工作和经济增长）之间的关系，该目标是联合国大会于2015年设立的17个可持续发展目标之一。年度数据收集自2013年以来一直是欧盟成员国的所有国家。回归模型的结果证实了生态创新与可持续发展目标8之间存在关系的假设。在就业领域发现了最密切的关系，这意味着随着生态创新的增长，就业率也应提高。我们还考察了各国在生态创新和可持续发展目标8方面的地位。北欧国家获得了最积极的评价，而南欧国家则获得了消极评价。研究结果为支持生态创新政策制定者以及机构和监管机构的决策过程提供了宝贵信息。我们的发现清楚地说明了通过生态创新发展实现可持续发展目标8，并证实了对生态创新与人力资源之间探索关系的详细见解。本研究的发现还支持建立国家和国际比较平台，以及制定生态创新和绿色增长领域的基准指标。

records.title_en: How to achieve both environmental protection and firm performance improvement: Based on China's carbon emissions trading (CET) policy
records.title_cn: 如何实现环境保护与企业绩效提升的双赢——基于中国碳排放权交易（CET）政策
records.abstract_en: Based on panel data drawn from the Annual Survey of Industrial Firms (ASIF) in China spanning 1998 to 2013, this study assesses the micro-level effects of China's CET policy, reexamining the classic dilemma of balancing “environmental protection and economic growth”. The findings reveal that within the pilot industries, the CET policy leads to lower output and value-added for firms in the pilot regions. This can be attributed to the fact that firms in these regions have not notably increased their independent innovation or adopted imported digital products (technology). However, firms with higher initial productivity levels will benefit, as they engage in more independent innovation, effectively triggering the “Porter Effect”. Furthermore, the discussion highlights the heterogeneous impact of CET, and resulting performance divergence within the industry. The failure of inefficient enterprises to exit promptly and the inability of potential entrants to join in a timely manner, lead to suboptimal resource allocation, which lies at the core of the challenge in balancing environmental protection and economic growth. Additionally, the study reveals that China's CET policy significantly contributes to an increase in the value-added rate, signifying a transformation in the economic growth pattern and a natural alignment between environmental protection and economic growth.
records.abstract_cn: 基于中国工业企业年度调查（ASIF）1998年至2013年的面板数据，本研究评估了中国碳排放权交易（CET）政策的微观效应，重新审视了“环境保护与经济增长”平衡的经典困境。研究发现，在试点行业内，CET政策导致试点地区企业的产出和增加值下降。这归因于这些地区的企业并未显著增加自主创新或采用进口数字产品（技术）。然而，初始生产率水平较高的企业将受益，因为它们进行更多的自主创新，有效触发“波特效应”。此外，讨论强调了CET的异质性影响，以及由此产生的行业内绩效分化。低效率企业未能及时退出，潜在进入者无法及时加入，导致资源配置次优，这是平衡环境保护与经济增长挑战的核心。此外，研究揭示，中国的CET政策显著促进了增加值率的提升，标志着经济增长方式的转变，以及环境保护与经济增长之间的自然契合。

records.title_en: Environmental performance evaluation of electric enterprises during a power crisis: Evidence from DEA methods and AI prediction algorithms
records.title_cn: 电力危机期间电力企业环境绩效评价：来自DEA方法和人工智能预测算法的证据
records.abstract_en: With the continuous occurrence of power crisis events worldwide, meeting society's demand for electricity has kept coal-fired power generation high, which leads to a large amount of carbon dioxide emissions and environmental pollution problems. Therefore, improving the environmental performance of thermal power plants under the background of a power crisis has become particularly important. This research provides a new path for production optimization and environmental performance improvement of electric power enterprises from the perspective of combining prediction algorithms and DEA methods. We apply the modified non-radial directional distance function (MNDDF) method to a set of panel data containing 16 different cogeneration units and 27 different periods in eastern China and construct the grey prediction model to predict the future environmental performance of these units. Empirical analysis shows that our model has high prediction accuracy and offers a reasonable basis for future production decision-making adjustments for electric power enterprises. Based on the results herein, we present valuable suggestions for thermal power plants to improve their environmental performance during a power market crisis, including optimizing resource utilization, improving management level and operating conditions, strengthening technological innovation, and enhancing production factor allocation.
records.abstract_cn: 随着全球电力危机事件的持续发生，满足社会电力需求使得燃煤发电量居高不下，导致大量二氧化碳排放和环境污染问题。因此，在电力危机背景下提高火电厂的环境绩效变得尤为重要。本研究从预测算法与DEA方法相结合的角度，为电力企业的生产优化和环境绩效提升提供了一条新路径。我们将修正的非径向方向性距离函数（MNDDF）方法应用于中国东部地区包含16个不同热电联产机组和27个不同时期的面板数据，并构建灰色预测模型来预测这些机组未来的环境绩效。实证分析表明，我们的模型具有较高的预测精度，为电力企业未来的生产决策调整提供了合理依据。基于本文的研究结果，我们为火电厂在电力市场危机期间提高环境绩效提出了有价值的建议，包括优化资源利用、提高管理水平和运营条件、加强技术创新以及改善生产要素配置。

records.title_en: How does the green financial system affect environmentally friendly firms' ESG? Evidence from Chinese stock markets
records.title_cn: 绿色金融体系如何影响环保企业的ESG？来自中国股票市场的证据
records.abstract_en: In 2016, the Chinese authorities publicized the Guidance on Building a Green Financial System (GBGFS), which sought to guide social investment toward green industries and advance sustainable economic development. To examine whether this policy has achieved its intended effect, our study utilizes the difference-in-differences approach to investigate the influence of the GBGFS on micro level sustainable development, i.e., firms' environmental, social, and governance (ESG), and employ panel data of A-share listed firms from 2011 to 2022 as the research sample. Benchmark regression and a series of robustness tests demonstrate that the GBGFS significantly promotes firms' ESG, although a two-year lag in the policy effect is evident. We also conduct a range of additional tests to investigate the policy effect in different circumstances, finding that a) the GBGFS has positive effects on environmental and social, while it has an insignificant effect on governance; b) quantile analysis reveals that the GBGFS generates about twice the boost for firms with high degrees of ESG than those with low levels; c) our threshold regression demonstrates that the policy's promotional effect doubles, when research and development (R&D) investment exceeds the threshold value, providing new empirical validation for the Porter hypothesis; and d) the GBGFS has a stronger effect on firms with political connections than those without such connections. Non-state-owned enterprises can establish political connections by hiring government officials to obtain more government support and improve ESG. In addition, the GBGFS has the strongest effect on firms in the western region followed by the eastern region, with an insignificant effect in the central region. The central government can appropriately adjust the GBGFS and encourage firms on R&D investments, so as to make the policy effect longer, more precise, stronger and wider, and finally achieve sustainable development goals.
records.abstract_cn: 2016年，中国当局公布了《关于构建绿色金融体系的指导意见》（GBGFS），旨在引导社会投资流向绿色产业，推动可持续经济发展。为检验该政策是否达到预期效果，本研究采用双重差分法考察GBGFS对微观层面可持续发展，即企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）的影响，并以2011年至2022年A股上市公司的面板数据作为研究样本。基准回归及一系列稳健性检验表明，GBGFS显著提升了企业的ESG，尽管政策效应存在两年的滞后。我们还进行了一系列额外测试以考察不同情境下的政策效应，发现：a) GBGFS对环境和社会维度有正向影响，但对治理维度影响不显著；b) 分位数分析显示，GBGFS对高ESG水平企业的提升作用约为低水平企业的两倍；c) 门槛回归表明，当研发（R&D）投入超过门槛值时，政策的促进效应翻倍，为波特假说提供了新的实证验证；d) GBGFS对有政治关联的企业影响强于无政治关联的企业。非国有企业可通过聘请政府官员建立政治关联，以获得更多政府支持并改善ESG。此外，GBGFS对西部地区企业的影响最强，其次是东部地区，对中部地区影响不显著。中央政府可适当调整GBGFS并鼓励企业增加研发投入，以使政策效应更持久、更精准、更强、更广泛，最终实现可持续发展目标。

records.title_en: Climate change exposure and cost of equity
records.title_cn: 气候变化暴露与股权资本成本
records.abstract_en: In this study, we investigate the association between climate change exposure and the cost of equity financing. Using a novel dataset of US firm-level exposure to climate change risks, we find that higher exposure to climate risks co-exists with higher financing costs for the period 2010 through 2021. While the effect of physical and regulatory risks is rather muted, the main mechanism shaping financing costs stems from climate transition risk driven by uncertainty about new business opportunities. Our results are not compromised by endogeneity concerns as shown by alternative methods such as entropy balancing, instrumental variable regression, dynamic panel estimation and a difference-in-differences setting. We also document that the link between climate change exposure and the cost of equity financing is more prominent for firms facing higher attention to climate topics, a stronger realization of climate change and more problematic financing constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们考察了气候变化暴露与股权融资成本之间的关联。利用一个关于美国公司层面气候变化风险暴露的新数据集，我们发现，在2010年至2021年期间，较高的气候风险暴露与较高的融资成本并存。虽然物理风险和监管风险的影响相对较弱，但塑造融资成本的主要机制源于由新商业机会不确定性驱动的气候转型风险。我们的结果并未因内生性问题而受损，这通过诸如熵平衡、工具变量回归、动态面板估计和双重差分设定等替代方法得以证明。我们还记录了气候变化暴露与股权融资成本之间的联系在面临更高气候话题关注度、对气候变化更强烈的认识以及更严重的融资约束的公司中更为显著。

records.title_en: Energy news shocks and their propagation to renewable and fossil fuels use
records.title_cn: 能源新闻冲击及其对可再生能源和化石能源使用的传导
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of anticipated (news) shocks on renewable and fossil energy use in the U.S. economy. Using structural vector autoregressions (SVARs), we identify the news shocks captured in energy stock market indexes. Our findings show that renewable and fossil energy news shocks significantly affect economic activity, revealing the tensions between the traditional fossil fuel-based industries and the emerging green technology-based ones. We further identify news shocks on Economic Policy Uncertainty (EPU) index, as policy is a key factor driving the changes in the energy mix. First, we show that the identified anticipated shocks have very different propagation mechanisms from traditional surprise shocks. Then, we find that the combination of news shocks to energy stock prices and economic policy uncertainty jointly account for about 90% of the variability of output, job openings and house prices. To interpret our findings, we use a DSGE model that incorporates fossil and renewable energy sectors, and news shocks as a driving force. We show that the propagation mechanisms of news shocks in the model are consistent with our empirical observations. Our study illustrates on the critical interaction between energy news and economic policy uncertainty in affecting the real economy in the transition from dirty to clean energy technologies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了预期（新闻）冲击对美国经济中可再生能源和化石能源使用的影响。利用结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型，我们识别了能源股票市场指数中所捕获的新闻冲击。我们的研究结果表明，可再生能源和化石能源新闻冲击显著影响经济活动，揭示了传统化石燃料行业与新兴绿色技术行业之间的紧张关系。我们进一步识别了经济政策不确定性（EPU）指数上的新闻冲击，因为政策是推动能源结构变化的关键因素。首先，我们表明所识别的预期冲击与传统意外冲击具有非常不同的传导机制。然后，我们发现，能源股票价格和经济政策不确定性的新闻冲击组合共同解释了产出、职位空缺和房价变动的约90%。为了解释我们的发现，我们使用了一个包含化石能源和可再生能源部门以及新闻冲击作为驱动力的DSGE模型。我们表明，模型中新闻冲击的传导机制与我们的实证观察一致。我们的研究阐明了在从肮脏能源技术向清洁能源技术转型过程中，能源新闻与经济政策不确定性之间的关键相互作用对实体经济的影响。

records.title_en: Modeling the behavior of renewable energy market: Understanding the moderation of climate risk factors
records.title_cn: 建模可再生能源市场行为：理解气候风险因素的调节作用
records.abstract_en: The behavior of the renewable energy market largely depends on the impact of renewable energy generation drivers. The susceptibility of these drivers to climatic adversities shapes their impact. Moreover, renewable energy generation projects are also vulnerable to climate risk factors, i.e., physical and transition risks. Existing climate resilience frameworks in the United States of America might be inconclusive to address this concern, and this inability is reflected in non-accomplishment of the Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 7 objectives. It indicates a policy void concerning the internalization of the climate risk factors for realizing the potential of renewable energy market. Therein lies the focus of the present study. The study analyzes the impacts of the returns on renewable energy drivers on the renewable energy market returns by controlling the climate risk factors from August 01, 2014, to July 06, 2023. The analysis is carried out by cross quantile correlation and multivariate quantile-on-quantile regression methods. The results show that the impact of the returns on renewable energy drivers on the renewable energy market returns reduces in presence of the climatic risk factors, i.e., natural disasters (physical risk) and climate policy uncertainty (transition risk). The climatic resilience-oriented policy framework developed in the study is aimed at internalizing the physical and transition climate risk factors, and thereby, progressing towards attaining SDG 7 objectives.
records.abstract_cn: 可再生能源市场的表现在很大程度上取决于可再生能源发电驱动因素的影响。这些驱动因素对气候不利条件的敏感性塑造了它们的影响。此外，可再生能源发电项目也容易受到气候风险因素的影响，即物理风险和转型风险。美国现有的气候韧性框架可能不足以解决这一问题，这种不足反映在可持续发展目标（SDG）7目标未能实现上。这表明在将气候风险因素内部化以实现可再生能源市场潜力方面存在政策空白。这正是本研究的重点。本研究分析了从八月 01，2014到七月 06，2023期间，在控制气候风险因素的情况下，可再生能源驱动因素收益对可再生能源市场收益的影响。分析采用交叉分位数相关和多元分位数对分位数回归方法进行。结果表明，在气候风险因素存在的情况下，即可自然灾害（物理风险）和气候政策不确定性（转型风险），可再生能源驱动因素收益对可再生能源市场收益的影响减弱。研究中开发的以气候韧性为导向的政策框架旨在将物理和转型气候风险因素内部化，从而朝着实现SDG 7目标迈进。

records.title_en: Hotter days, dirtier air: The impact of extreme heat on energy and pollution intensity in China
records.title_cn: 更热的天，更脏的空气：极端高温对中国能源和污染强度的影响
records.abstract_en: This research endeavors to investigate the causal relationship between climate change and pollution intensity, employing a county-level dataset encompassing meteorological data and air pollution measurements from 2008 to 2017 in China. We discern the immediate causal impact of “local temperature shocks” on pollution intensity, uncovering a positive association between climate change and pollution intensity. Notably, this effect manifests with greater significance in economically underdeveloped regions, the northern provinces, and cities not reliant on resource-based industries. Moreover, we disentangle the influence of extreme heat on air pollution into three distinct facets: scale, technological, and structural effects. Our findings reveal that extreme heat augments energy demand, diminishes energy efficiency, and amplifies coal consumption, consequently elevating pollution intensity. Drawing upon the SSP126 and SSP585 climate change scenarios for future Chinese cities in the short-term (2041–2060), mid-term (2061–2080), and long-term (2081–2100), our simulation outcomes demonstrate that the escalating frequency of hot days will perpetuate an adverse impact on pollution intensity across China's counties. This study presents a fresh perspective on the environmental repercussions of climate change and provides theoretical underpinning for local authorities in their endeavors to attain concurrent reductions in both pollution and carbon emissions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在探讨气候变化与污染强度之间的因果关系，采用中国2008年至2017年县级面板数据，涵盖气象数据和空气污染测量。我们识别了“局部温度冲击”对污染强度的即时因果影响，揭示了气候变化与污染强度之间的正相关关系。值得注意的是，这种效应在经济欠发达地区、北方省份以及非资源型产业城市中表现得更为显著。此外，我们将极端高温对空气污染的影响分解为三个不同方面：规模效应、技术效应和结构效应。我们的研究结果表明，极端高温增加了能源需求，降低了能源效率，并增加了煤炭消费，从而提高了污染强度。基于SSP126和SSP585气候变化情景，针对中国未来城市在短期（2041-2060年）、中期（2061-2080年）和长期（2081-2100年）的模拟结果显示，高温天数的增加将持续对中国各县的污染强度产生不利影响。本研究为气候变化的环境后果提供了新视角，并为地方政府实现污染和碳排放协同减排提供了理论支撑。

records.title_en: Carbon leakage perspective: Unveiling policy dilemmas in emission trading and carbon tariffs under insurer green finance
records.title_cn: 碳泄漏视角：保险公司绿色金融下排放交易与碳关税的政策困境揭示
records.abstract_en: This study delves into the intricacies of the policy dilemma surrounding carbon emission trading and carbon tariffs, with a specific focus on the perspective of carbon leakage. Using a capped call option model, we assess the equity of a life insurer, emphasizing the importance of carbon leakage resulting from borrowing by carbon-intensive manufacturers. The findings reveal a nuanced scenario: while an increase in green loans positively impacts the guaranteed rate of the insurer, it simultaneously poses a challenge to the equity of carbon-leakage vulnerable manufacturers. Stringent regulatory caps on emissions act as a limiting factor on guaranteed rates for carbon-intensive borrowers. Additionally, higher Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism tariff rates contribute to a decrease in the guaranteed rate, affecting both the fund-providing insurer and the borrowing manufacturer. This analysis underscores the intricate balance required in policymaking and decision-making, where an understanding of these complex relationships becomes pivotal. Striking the right balance between environmental sustainability and financial stability is essential to navigating the policy dilemma inherent in carbon emission trading and carbon tariffs.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究深入探讨了碳排放交易与碳关税政策困境的复杂性，特别关注碳泄漏的视角。通过使用上限看涨期权模型，我们评估了人寿保险公司的权益，强调了碳密集型制造商借贷导致的碳泄漏的重要性。研究结果揭示了一个微妙的场景：虽然绿色贷款的增加对保险公司的保证利率产生积极影响，但同时对碳泄漏脆弱制造商的权益构成挑战。严格的监管排放上限对碳密集型借款人的保证利率起到限制作用。此外，较高的碳边境调节机制关税税率导致保证利率下降，影响提供资金的保险公司和借款制造商。这一分析强调了政策制定和决策中所需的微妙平衡，理解这些复杂关系变得至关重要。在环境可持续性与金融稳定之间取得适当平衡，对于应对碳排放交易与碳关税固有的政策困境至关重要。

records.title_en: Willingness to pay for renewables: Insights from a meta-analysis of choice experiments
records.title_cn: 可再生能源支付意愿：基于选择实验元分析的见解
records.abstract_en: Renewable energy policies contribute to solving some of the current environmental challenges, such as climate change mitigation and decarbonization, and people around the world are usually willing to pay for a greater presence of renewable energies. That willingness to pay (WTP) can be translated into a gain in social well-being. But not all renewables are equally valued, nor do all people experience the same gain in terms of well-being. Over the last 25 years, many choice experiments have focused on analyzing social preferences for different external effects associated with renewables. This article presents a meta-analysis of choice experiments to examine the evidence on WTP for renewable energies. We examined 63 articles across 28 countries, with a total sample of 52,948 participants and 84,821 observations. We used three econometric approaches (Generalized Least Squares, Weighted Least Squares, and a Panel Data Model) to estimate the willingness to pay of households for renewables around the world. Results show that the promotion of renewable energies is socially demanded, with an average minimum WTP of between €113 and €124 per household per year. The results also show that onshore wind farms are the preferred renewable energy source for electricity generation, whereas people are more reluctant about offshore wind in comparison with other renewable technologies. Finally, some geographic patterns are found, with people from Asia and southern Europe showing, respectively, a lower and higher willingness to pay for renewable energies.
records.abstract_cn: 可再生能源政策有助于解决当前的一些环境挑战，如减缓气候变化和脱碳，世界各地的人们通常愿意为可再生能源的更广泛存在而支付。这种支付意愿（WTP）可以转化为社会福利的增益。但并非所有可再生能源都受到同等重视，也并非所有人都经历相同的福利增益。在过去25年中，许多选择实验聚焦于分析与可再生能源相关的外部效应的社会偏好。本文对选择实验进行了元分析，以检验关于可再生能源支付意愿的证据。我们考察了28个国家的63篇文章，总样本包括52,948名参与者和84,821个观测值。我们使用了三种计量经济学方法（广义最小二乘法、加权最小二乘法和面板数据模型）来估计全球家庭对可再生能源的支付意愿。结果表明，推广可再生能源是社会所需，家庭平均最低支付意愿为每年每户113至124欧元。结果还显示，陆上风电场是发电的首选可再生能源，而与其他可再生能源技术相比，人们对海上风电更为抵触。最后，发现了一些地理模式，亚洲和南欧的人们分别表现出较低和较高的可再生能源支付意愿。

records.title_en: Does institutional commitment affect ESG performance of firms? Evidence from the United Nations principles for responsible investment
records.title_cn: 机构承诺是否影响企业的ESG表现？来自联合国负责任投资原则的证据
records.abstract_en: Based on the sample of institutions in China that signed the United Nations Principles of Responsible Investment over the period from 2012 to 2021, we study whether institutional commitment improve their environmental, social, and governance performance. The results show that institutional commitment has better environmental, social, and governance performance on its investment targets. After a series of robustness tests such as instrumental variable method and propensity score matching method, the main regression results remain unchanged. In further analysis, we find that this relationship is more pronounced when institutions are controlled by the state and have more media coverage. This study provides a new dimension for the firms to enhance environmental, social, and governance performance and also provides a theoretical basis for United Nations Principles of Responsible Investment to further expand its scope of influence.
records.abstract_cn: 基于2012年至2021年期间签署联合国负责任投资原则的中国机构样本，我们研究机构承诺是否改善其环境、社会和治理表现。结果表明，机构承诺对其投资目标具有更好的环境、社会和治理表现。经过一系列稳健性检验，如工具变量法和倾向得分匹配法，主要回归结果保持不变。在进一步分析中，我们发现当机构由国家控制且媒体关注度更高时，这种关系更为显著。本研究为企业提升环境、社会和治理表现提供了新维度，也为联合国负责任投资原则进一步扩大其影响力范围提供了理论基础。

records.title_en: Can “dual credit” replace “subsidies” successfully? -based on analysis of vehicle supply chain decisions under the digital transformation of technology
records.title_cn: “双积分”能否成功替代“补贴”？——基于技术数字化转型下汽车供应链决策的分析
records.abstract_en: Transportation is the second largest source of carbon emissions today, with more than 80% of the carbon emitted from automobile operations. Hence, reducing the fuel consumption per unit mileage while vigorously developing new energy vehicles has become an inevitable choice for carbon emission reduction. So, this paper applies the differential game approach to investigate the production trade-offs of fuel and new energy vehicles, fuel consumption reduction, and digital technology investment strategies in an automotive supply chain under a dynamic framework. In addition, it further analyzes whether the dual credit policy (DCP) can promote the healthy development of China's auto market after the withdrawal of the purchase subsidy policy for new energy vehicles (PSP). The results show that the implementation of DCP will reduce the sales of fuel vehicles with fuel consumption higher than the critical value (HFCV) but will not promote the willingness of manufacturers to invest in fuel consumption reduction of HFCV; the abolition of the PSP will not reduce the demand for fuel vehicles, nor will it affect the investment in fuel consumption reduction of fuel vehicles, but it will reduce the consumer demand for new energy vehicles. However, assuming that the government appropriately adjusts the intrinsic mechanism of the DCP, such as increasing the requirement for the proportion of new energy vehicles in the sales of cars by manufacturers and the value of the points per unit of new energy vehicles, it will be possible to promote the growth of new energy vehicles while discouraging the production of fuel-intensive vehicles. In addition, If the government abolishes PSP, the maximum rate of change in the profits of the manufacturer, retailer, and the entire supply chain in the parameter change intervals analyzed in our numerical example is only 1.6%, 0.04%, and 0.13%, respectively, which can be said to have minimal impact. The findings provide a theoretical basis for the government's choice of carbon regulation policy for the automotive supply chain.
records.abstract_cn: 交通运输是当今第二大碳排放来源，超过80%的碳排放来自汽车运行。因此，降低单位里程燃油消耗，同时大力发展新能源汽车，已成为碳减排的必然选择。为此，本文运用微分博弈方法，在动态框架下研究汽车供应链中燃油车与新能源汽车的生产权衡、燃油消耗降低以及数字技术投资策略。此外，本文进一步分析了在新能源汽车购置补贴政策（PSP）退出后，双积分政策（DCP）能否促进中国汽车市场的健康发展。结果表明，DCP的实施将降低燃油消耗高于临界值（HFCV）的燃油车销量，但不会促进制造商对HFCV燃油消耗降低的投资意愿；PSP的取消不会减少燃油车的需求，也不会影响燃油车燃油消耗降低的投资，但会减少消费者对新能源汽车的需求。然而，假设政府适当调整DCP的内在机制，例如提高制造商汽车销量中新能源汽车比例的要求以及每单位新能源汽车的积分值，则有可能在抑制高油耗汽车生产的同时促进新能源汽车的增长。此外，如果政府取消PSP，在我们数值示例分析的参数变化区间内，制造商、零售商和整个供应链利润的最大变化率分别仅为1.6%、0.04%和0.13%，可以说影响极小。研究结果为政府选择汽车供应链碳监管政策提供了理论依据。

records.title_en: Impact of short-term wind forecast accuracy on the performance of decarbonising wholesale electricity markets
records.title_cn: 短期风电预测精度对脱碳电力批发市场绩效的影响
records.abstract_en: As the proportion of variable renewable generation capacity in our electricity systems rises, so too will the associated absolute forecast errors in their generation. This work quantifies the complex interactions between short-term renewable generation forecasts, short-term demand forecasts, generator unit commitment and economic dispatch in electricity systems with levels of variable renewable generation spanning 49–79% of annual electricity demand. When the short-term operational uncertainty caused by renewable generation becomes larger in absolute terms than that of demand, the accuracy of renewable generation forecasting has a critical influence on electricity market performance. That is, inaccurate short-term wind forecasts can increase hours of unserved energy and scarcity hours spent at market price cap, increase total system costs and prices, significantly increase returns to thermal generators and energy storage, reduce returns to wind generators, and increase greenhouse gas emissions slightly. For the generalised case study considered in this work, the value of improved short term wind generation forecasts looks to becomes significant once variable renewables generate more than roughly 60% of annual electricity demand. Reductions in average market prices of 5 $/MWh or more then appear plausible as acceptable levels of reliability are recovered. As such, improvements in short-term renewable generation forecasting are likely required in order to justify continued investment in variable renewables as the major means of achieving decarbonisation efficiently and reliably, and these could be achieved by any combination of improved forecasting, dispatch control or on-site firming.
records.abstract_cn: 随着电力系统中可变可再生能源发电容量的比例上升，其发电相关的绝对预测误差也将随之增加。本研究量化了短期可再生能源发电预测、短期需求预测、发电机组组合和经济调度在可变可再生能源发电量占年电力需求49-79%的电力系统中的复杂相互作用。当由可再生能源发电引起的短期运行不确定性在绝对量上大于需求引起的不确定性时，可再生能源发电预测的准确性对电力市场绩效具有关键影响。也就是说，不准确的短期风电预测会增加未供电能量小时数和在市场价格上限处的稀缺小时数，增加系统总成本和价格，显著提高热力发电机和储能设备的回报，降低风力发电机的回报，并略微增加温室气体排放。对于本研究中考虑的广义案例，当可变可再生能源发电量超过年电力需求的大约60%时，改进短期风电预测的价值似乎变得显著。随着可接受的可靠性水平恢复，平均市场价格降低5美元/兆瓦时或更多似乎是可能的。因此，为了证明继续投资于可变可再生能源作为高效可靠实现脱碳的主要手段的合理性，可能需要改进短期可再生能源发电预测，这些改进可以通过改进预测、调度控制或现场稳固的任何组合来实现。

records.title_en: Asymmetric volatility spillover between crude oil and other asset markets
records.title_cn: 原油与其他资产市场之间的非对称波动溢出效应
records.abstract_en: This study uses the Multiplicative Error Model (MEM) to explore asymmetric volatility spillovers between crude oil and other major asset markets. We have extended the MEM of Engle et al. (2012) to include asymmetric volatility spillovers and developed the spillover balance as well as asymmetric spillover indexes. We have then allowed these indexes to vary over time. Our results reveal that the stock market is the dominant contributor to volatility spillover, while the crude oil is mostly the volatility spillover recipient. The asymmetric spillover effects are predominantly negative in the stock and crude oil markets and positive in the bond market. We further show that the spillover indexes are dynamic and influenced by specific events, such as the global financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic, as well as varying economic conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究使用乘法误差模型（MEM）探讨原油与其他主要资产市场之间的非对称波动溢出效应。我们将Engle等人（2012）的MEM扩展至包含非对称波动溢出，并开发了溢出平衡以及非对称溢出指数。随后，我们允许这些指数随时间变化。我们的结果显示，股票市场是波动溢出的主要贡献者，而原油市场主要是波动溢出的接收者。非对称溢出效应在股票和原油市场中主要为负，在债券市场中为正。我们进一步表明，溢出指数是动态的，并受到特定事件（如全球金融危机和COVID-19疫情）以及不同经济状况的影响。

records.title_en: Energy price uncertainty, environmental policy, and firm investment: A dynamic modeling approach
records.title_cn: 能源价格不确定性、环境政策与企业投资：一种动态建模方法
records.abstract_en: Environmental quality is closely related to the production and investment behavior of enterprises, which depends on the discounted future cash flows that are affected by energy price uncertainty. Meanwhile, with the increasing awareness of environmental protection, environmental policies have been introduced to restrict firm investment choices. However, the role of environmental policy has received less attention in the previous research on energy prices and firm investment. Therefore, this paper develops a dynamic firm investment model that incorporates energy price uncertainty and environmental regulation and makes the following predictions. First, ceteris paribus, energy price uncertainty negatively impacts firm investment. Second, environmental regulations mitigate this negative impact of energy price uncertainty. Third, the mitigating effect of environmental policy is greater in pollution-intensive industries. This paper merges the micro-data on A-share listed firms in China between 2004 and 2018 with the macro-data on energy prices and environmental regulation. The empirical results align with the theoretical predictions. The robustness tests, including instrumental variables, alternative measurements, and estimation methods, validate the baseline findings. These theoretical and empirical findings yield important implications for policymakers.
records.abstract_cn: 环境质量与企业的生产和投资行为密切相关，而企业的投资行为取决于受能源价格不确定性影响的折现未来现金流。同时，随着环保意识的增强，环境政策被引入以限制企业的投资选择。然而，在以往关于能源价格与企业投资的研究中，环境政策的作用较少受到关注。因此，本文构建了一个纳入能源价格不确定性和环境规制的动态企业投资模型，并做出以下预测。首先，在其他条件不变的情况下，能源价格不确定性对企业投资产生负面影响。其次，环境规制缓解了能源价格不确定性的这种负面影响。第三，环境政策的缓解效应在污染密集型行业中更大。本文将2004年至2018年间中国A股上市公司的微观数据与能源价格和环境规制的宏观数据相结合。实证结果与理论预测一致。包括工具变量、替代测量和估计方法在内的稳健性检验验证了基线发现。这些理论和实证发现对政策制定者具有重要启示。

records.title_en: Influence mechanism of electricity price distortion on industrial green transformation: A spatial analysis of Chinese regions
records.title_cn: 电价扭曲对工业绿色转型的影响机制：中国区域的空间分析
records.abstract_en: Electricity price distortion (DIS) can significantly affect industrial green transformation (IGT), influencing the pace and direction of sustainable economic growth. Understanding this link is essential for crafting effective green energy policies. Initially, this study evaluates the direct and heterogeneous effects of DIS on IGT and then investigates the indirect influence channels using a sample of 30 Chinese provincial-level administrative regions from 2006 to 2019. Spatial analysis techniques (standard deviation ellipse and geographically and temporally weighted regression methods) are applied to explore the spatial and temporal dependence and non-stationary association between DIS and IGT. The outcomes suggest that DIS significantly reduces IGT in the eastern region through R&D input intensity and energy mix, while insignificant in the central and western regions. The adverse effect of DIS is more substantial at higher quantiles of IGT. The individual spatial heterogeneity characteristics reveal that the gravity centre of IGT is located in the southeast of the geometric centre of China, displays a southwest-northeast-southeast directional migration, and distributed at the junction of Henan and Hubei. Manifestly, the ellipse and azimuth of IGT vary significantly between 0.862°-32.854°. The IGT level steadily progresses from discrete to concentrated, reflected by the ellipse's long and short semi-axes. These regions are mainly concentrated in the eastern and northwestern areas, with the most significant inhibitory effects in Fujian, Anhui, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, and Yunnan. These findings offer valuable policy implications.
records.abstract_cn: 电价扭曲（DIS）能显著影响工业绿色转型（IGT），从而影响可持续经济增长的速度和方向。理解这一联系对于制定有效的绿色能源政策至关重要。本研究首先评估了DIS对IGT的直接和异质性效应，然后利用2006年至2019年中国30个省级行政区的样本，考察了间接影响渠道。应用空间分析技术（标准差椭圆和地理加权回归方法）来探索DIS与IGT之间的空间和时间依赖性及非平稳关联。结果表明，DIS通过研发投入强度和能源结构显著降低了东部地区的IGT，而在中部和西部地区则不显著。DIS的不利影响在IGT的较高分位数上更为显著。个体空间异质性特征显示，IGT的重心位于中国几何中心的东南部，呈现西南-东北-东南方向的迁移，并分布在河南和湖北的交界处。显然，IGT的椭圆和方位角在0.862°至-32.854°之间显著变化。IGT水平从离散向集中稳步发展，这反映在椭圆的长短半轴上。这些区域主要集中在东部和西北部地区，其中福建、安徽、陕西、浙江和云南的抑制效应最为显著。这些发现提供了有价值的政策启示。

records.title_en: Firm productivity in the Energy-electricity sector over the last two decades with crisis: The role of cross-listing
records.title_cn: 过去二十年危机期间能源电力行业企业生产率：交叉上市的作用
records.abstract_en: Novel to the literature, this study examines how cross-listing impacts firms’ productivity in Energy sector. Annual data of firm cross-listing over the last two decades with crisis (2002-2022) is employed for our analyses. We find evidence of significant drop in productivity after Energy firms (including electricity firms) cross-list in the US market. Meanwhile, we do not find strong evidence of significant decreases in firm productivity from other sectors in our sample. We note one possible explanation for this finding is that after cross-listing, Energy firms appear to utilize their increased capital to heavily invest in infrastructure, equipment, and plants for expansion, which might eventually damage their productivity. To seek for more thorough explanations for such decreases in Energy firms' productivity after cross-listing, we identify the determinants of firm productivity in Energy sector. Our results provide strong evidence that the increases in capital expenditures after Energy firms cross-list appear to be associated with the decreases in firm productivity. Notably, we note that negative impacts of capital expenditures (after cross-listing) and state ownership on firm productivity become much stronger and more statistically significant in developed countries than in emerging countries. Last, corporate governance and firm liquidity are found to be two determinants that help improve firm productivity in both electricity firms and other energy firms.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究在文献中具有新颖性，探讨了交叉上市如何影响能源行业企业的生产率。我们采用过去二十年（2002-2022年）包含危机期间的企业交叉上市年度数据进行分析。我们发现，能源企业（包括电力企业）在美国市场交叉上市后，生产率显著下降。同时，在我们的样本中，未发现其他行业企业生产率显著下降的有力证据。我们注意到，对此发现的一个可能解释是，交叉上市后，能源企业似乎利用增加的资金大量投资于基础设施、设备和工厂以进行扩张，这可能最终损害其生产率。为了更全面地解释能源企业交叉上市后生产率下降的原因，我们识别了能源行业企业生产率的决定因素。我们的结果提供了有力证据，表明能源企业交叉上市后资本支出的增加似乎与企业生产率的下降相关。值得注意的是，我们注意到，在发达国家，资本支出（交叉上市后）和国有股权对企业生产率的负面影响比新兴国家更强且统计上更显著。最后，公司治理和企业流动性被发现是两个有助于提高电力企业和其他能源企业生产率的决定因素。

records.title_en: Employment and wage dynamics in the electricity sector: Evidence from Portugal 2002–2020
records.title_cn: 电力行业的就业与工资动态：来自葡萄牙的证据（2002-2020年）
records.abstract_en: Exploring a rich administrative matched employer-employee longitudinal dataset over the 2002–2020 period and a task-based approach, this study investigates to what extent the recent paradigm shift in the electricity sector has affected the structure of employment and wages in the Portuguese case. Our results show that the liberalization in the sector led to the entry of new players and firms' downsizing of the workforce, most notably in occupations involving routine cognitive tasks and non-routine manual tasks. In two decades, the employment share of occupations involving non-routine cognitive tasks (abstract or interactive) doubled, from 29.7% in 2002 to 58.1% in 2020. Regarding wage premiums, the results reveal a clear positive trend in real hourly wages for all types of occupations in the sector. However, we observe a lower wage growth acceleration for workers employed in routine (cognitive or manual) occupations, when compared with similar workers employed in non-routine occupations (cognitive or manual). Our findings are partly consistent with the skill-biased and routine-biased technological change hypotheses in the sense that we observe, respectively, a skill up-grading translated into an increase in employment share in non-routine cognitive occupations and a substantial decline in employment share in routine cognitive occupations.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用2002-2020年期间丰富的行政匹配雇主-雇员纵向数据集，并采用基于任务的方法，探讨电力行业近期的范式转变在多大程度上影响了葡萄牙的就业结构和工资。我们的结果表明，该行业的自由化导致了新参与者的进入和企业劳动力的缩减，尤其是在涉及常规认知任务和非常规体力任务的职业中最为显著。在二十年间，涉及非常规认知任务（抽象或互动）的职业就业份额翻了一番，从2002年的29.7%增至2020年的58.1%。关于工资溢价，结果显示该行业所有类型职业的实际小时工资均呈现明显的正增长趋势。然而，我们观察到，与从事非常规（认知或体力）职业的类似工人相比，从事常规（认知或体力）职业的工人的工资增长加速较慢。我们的发现部分与技能偏向和常规偏向的技术变革假说一致，因为我们分别观察到技能升级转化为非常规认知职业就业份额的增加，以及常规认知职业就业份额的大幅下降。

records.title_en: National information consumption demonstration city construction and urban green development: A quasi-experiment from Chinese cities
records.title_cn: 国家信息消费示范城市建设与城市绿色发展：来自中国城市的准实验
records.abstract_en: Modern cities are the primary sources of carbon dioxide and pollutant emissions, and information technology is a crucial component of city development. To promote the dispersion of information consumption, China constructed an information consumption demonstration city (ICDC) in 2015; however, the impact of ICDC policies on green city development remains unclear. Thus, this study aimed to explore the impact of ICDC policies on city-level carbon dioxide and pollutant emissions. Based on panel data of 204 cities in China from 2010 to 2019, a quasi-experiment method was adopted to evaluate the effects of the ICDC policy on CO2 and SO2 emissions using a difference-in-differences model. The results indicated a significant effect of ICDC policies on green development, reducing urban CO2 and SO2 growth rates by 36% and 31%, respectively. This conclusion was validated using several robustness tests. The mechanism analysis revealed that ICDC policies increased government spending on science and technology, reduced passenger traffic volumes, and promoted the city's digital finance development but had a negative impact on innovative research and development. This study provides novel insights for assessing the externalities of ICDC policies and promoting a city's green and low-carbon development.
records.abstract_cn: 现代城市是二氧化碳和污染物排放的主要来源，信息技术是城市发展的重要组成部分。为促进信息消费的扩散，中国于2015年建设了信息消费示范城市（ICDC）；然而，ICDC政策对城市绿色发展的影响仍不明确。因此，本研究旨在探讨ICDC政策对城市层面二氧化碳和污染物排放的影响。基于中国204个城市2010年至2019年的面板数据，采用准实验方法，通过双重差分模型评估ICDC政策对CO2和SO2排放的影响。结果表明，ICDC政策对绿色发展具有显著影响，分别使城市CO2和SO2增长率降低了36%和31%。这一结论通过多项稳健性检验得到验证。机制分析显示，ICDC政策增加了政府在科学技术方面的支出，减少了客运量，促进了城市数字金融发展，但对创新研发产生了负面影响。本研究为评估ICDC政策的外部性以及促进城市绿色低碳发展提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Measuring world oil market integration with a Thick Pen
records.title_cn: 用粗笔测量世界石油市场一体化
records.abstract_en: This paper measures integration of the world crude oil market using two measures based on the so-called Thick Pen Transform (TPT): the Thick Pen Measure of Association (TPMA) as well as Multi-Thickness Thick Pen Measure of Association (MTTPMA). These are nonparametric measures which are visually interpretable and allow one to quantify how integrated crude oil markets are. They can capture time-varying co-movement of different regional crude prices as well as co-movement at different time scales; i.e. short-term and long-term features of the price series. A particular strength in this application is the ability to detect instabilities in oil price relationships. The results are in line with the notion of the world oil market as one great pool; however the application vividly illustrates that the relationship between prices of crude types such as WTI Midlands and West Texas Sour is stronger than that between, e.g., Bonny Light and Dubai.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用基于所谓粗笔变换（TPT）的两种度量来测量世界原油市场的一体化程度：粗笔关联度量（TPMA）以及多厚度粗笔关联度量（MTTPMA）。这些是非参数度量，具有视觉可解释性，并允许量化原油市场的一体化程度。它们能够捕捉不同区域原油价格的时变联动以及不同时间尺度上的联动，即价格序列的短期和长期特征。在此应用中的一个特别优势是能够检测石油价格关系中的不稳定性。结果与世界石油市场作为一个大池子的概念一致；然而，该应用生动地说明了诸如WTI米德兰和西得克萨斯含硫原油等原油类型之间的关系强于例如博尼轻质原油和迪拜原油之间的关系。

records.title_en: Extreme events, economic uncertainty and speculation on occurrences of price bubbles in crude oil futures
records.title_cn: 极端事件、经济不确定性与原油期货价格泡沫发生的投机行为
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impacts of extreme events, economic uncertainty and speculation on price bubbles in crude oil futures. For better forecast and estimate the positive/negative price bubbles of crude oil futures, the log-periodic power law singularity confidence multi-scale indicators application is used. The panel probit model examines impacts of extreme events, economic uncertainty and speculation on price bubbles in crude oil. The results show that the recent extreme events including Corona Virus Disease 2019 and Russia-Ukraine war significantly affect both positive/negative bubbles in crude oil futures. Measures of economic uncertainty significantly affect both positive/negative bubbles in the crude oil. However, the results find that the speculation significantly affect the positive bubbles and does not significantly affect the negative bubbles. Overall, extreme events, economic uncertainty, and speculation can all contribute to the occurrences of price bubbles in crude oil futures markets. This study provides new insights for the policy makers and market participants to monitor the occurrence of price bubbles.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了极端事件、经济不确定性和投机行为对原油期货价格泡沫的影响。为了更好地预测和估计原油期货的正/负价格泡沫，采用了对数周期幂律奇异性置信度多尺度指标应用。面板概率单位模型检验了极端事件、经济不确定性和投机行为对原油价格泡沫的影响。结果表明，近期极端事件，包括2019冠状病毒病和俄乌战争，显著影响原油期货的正/负泡沫。经济不确定性的度量显著影响原油的正/负泡沫。然而，结果发现投机行为显著影响正泡沫，而对负泡沫的影响不显著。总体而言，极端事件、经济不确定性和投机行为都可能促成原油期货市场价格泡沫的发生。本研究为政策制定者和市场参与者监测价格泡沫的发生提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Faking for fortune: Emissions trading schemes and corporate greenwashing in China
records.title_cn: 为财富而伪装：碳排放交易体系与企业漂绿行为
records.abstract_en: Market-based environmental regulations are pivotal in facilitating the reduction of emissions. This paper employs a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) strategy to investigate the impact of Emissions Trading Schemes (ETS) on corporate greenwashing behavior. The findings suggest that ETS act as a catalyst for corporate greenwashing by intensifying financial distress, as demonstrated that the effect is notably more substantial among firms with heightened financing constraints and greater performance volatility. Further analysis reveals that corporate greenwashing behavior induced by ETS is more pronounced where market competition is higher, firms are smaller, R&D investment is lower, or intensity of environmental regulation is lower. This paper provides valuable insights for understanding the comprehensive picture of ETS.
records.abstract_cn: 基于市场的环境规制在促进减排方面至关重要。本文采用交错双重差分（DID）策略，研究碳排放交易体系（ETS）对企业漂绿行为的影响。研究结果表明，ETS通过加剧财务困境成为企业漂绿的催化剂，且这一效应在融资约束更强、业绩波动性更大的企业中更为显著。进一步分析显示，ETS引发的企业漂绿行为在市场竞争力更高、企业规模更小、研发投入更低或环境规制强度更低的情况下更为突出。本文为理解ETS的全貌提供了有价值的见解。

records.title_en: Energy related public environmental concerns and intra-firm pay gap in polluting enterprises: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 能源相关公众环境关注与污染企业内部薪酬差距：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This study empirically investigates the impact of energy related public environmental concerns on the pay gap within polluting companies. It uses the extreme environmental event of the PM2.5 surge at the end of 2011, which led to an upsurge in energy related public environmental concerns in China, as a quasi-natural experiment. According to our findings, energy related public environmental concerns lead to a significant increase in the executive–employee pay gap of polluting companies compared to that of non-polluting companies, owing to a significant increase in executive compensation and no significant change in employee income. The effect of energy related public environmental concerns on increasing the pay gap within polluting companies is more significant in samples with high agency costs, poor information transparency, less analyst follow-up, and fewer institutional investors' shareholding. Furthermore, as energy related public environmental concerns exacerbate the polluting firms' internal pay gap, their total factor productivity and investment efficiency fall significantly. In summary, energy related public environmental concerns not only widen the wage gap within polluting enterprises but also worsen their operational and investment efficiency, which has important policy implications for emerging market economies seeking to balance environmental protection and economic development.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究实证考察了能源相关公众环境关注对污染企业内部薪酬差距的影响。利用2011年底PM2.5飙升这一极端环境事件作为准自然实验，该事件导致中国能源相关公众环境关注度急剧上升。研究发现，与非污染企业相比，能源相关公众环境关注显著扩大了污染企业的高管-员工薪酬差距，这主要源于高管薪酬的显著增加，而员工收入无显著变化。在高代理成本、信息透明度低、分析师关注度低及机构投资者持股较少的样本中，能源相关公众环境关注对扩大污染企业内部薪酬差距的影响更为显著。此外，随着能源相关公众环境关注加剧污染企业内部薪酬差距，其全要素生产率和投资效率显著下降。总之，能源相关公众环境关注不仅扩大了污染企业内部的工资差距，还恶化了其运营和投资效率，这对寻求平衡环境保护与经济发展的新兴市场经济体具有重要的政策启示。

records.title_en: Natural disasters and corporate tax burden: Evidence from chinese energy sector
records.title_cn: 自然灾害与企业税负：来自中国能源行业的证据
records.abstract_en: Given the importance of energy company in disaster reconstruction and economic stability, we focus on the intrinsic link between natural disasters and energy corporate tax burden. This study examines the impact of natural disasters on the energy corporate tax burden using panel data for listed energy companies in China from 2003 to 2021. We robustly find that the higher the number of natural disasters in an energy company's region, the lower the corporate tax burden. The mechanism analysis suggests that the government, motivated by concerns that energy companies are in business distress and facing financing difficulties, is the mechanism by which natural disasters lead to lower energy corporate tax burdens. In addition, the above effects are more pronounced among energy companies that are larger, have a higher market share, and are subject to stronger government intervention. We provide theoretical basis and data support for post-disaster reconstruction and economic stability.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于能源企业在灾害重建和经济稳定中的重要性，我们关注自然灾害与能源企业税负之间的内在联系。本研究利用2003年至2021年中国上市能源公司的面板数据，考察了自然灾害对能源企业税负的影响。我们稳健地发现，能源公司所在地区的自然灾害数量越多，企业税负越低。机制分析表明，政府出于对能源企业陷入经营困境和面临融资困难的担忧，是自然灾害导致能源企业税负降低的机制。此外，上述效应在规模更大、市场份额更高以及受到更强政府干预的能源公司中更为显著。我们为灾后重建和经济稳定提供了理论基础和数据支持。

records.title_en: Technology shocks and crude oil market connection: The role of climate change
records.title_cn: 技术冲击与原油市场关联：气候变化的作用
records.abstract_en: We study the connection between global technology shocks (TS) and the crude oil market from 1880 to 2018. Our study utilizes newly constructed global TS datasets that cover OECD countries and 164 countries, while also considering the role of climate change using temperature anomalies. We use the GARCH-MIDAS framework to account for mixed data frequencies and statistical properties of the variables. Our findings show that the link between TS and oil return volatility is episodic, with the relationship becoming apparent after the great depression of the 1930s. Technological innovations appear to moderate oil return volatility. We also estimate the effect of climate change-augmented TS on oil volatility and find that it reduces the potential of technology shocks to lessen oil return volatility. We also find that the out-of-sample forecast gains are realized from observing TS and climate change in the predictability of oil return volatility. Nonetheless, a more general definition of global TS (with 164 countries) offers higher forecast gains than a more restricted global TS (with OECD countries only). Finally, we document the implications of our findings for policy and practice.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了从1880年到2018年全球技术冲击（TS）与原油市场之间的关联。我们的研究利用了新构建的覆盖OECD国家和164个国家的全球TS数据集，同时通过温度异常考虑了气候变化的作用。我们使用GARCH-MIDAS框架来处理混合数据频率和变量的统计特性。我们的研究结果表明，TS与石油收益波动率之间的联系是间歇性的，这种关系在1930年大萧条之后变得明显。技术创新似乎缓和了石油收益波动率。我们还估计了气候变化增强的TS对石油波动率的影响，发现它降低了技术冲击减轻石油收益波动率的潜力。我们还发现，在石油收益波动率的可预测性方面，观察TS和气候变化可以实现样本外预测收益。尽管如此，更广泛的全球TS定义（涵盖164个国家）比更受限的全球TS定义（仅涵盖OECD国家）提供了更高的预测收益。最后，我们记录了我们的发现对政策和实践的影响。

records.title_en: Intermittently coupled electricity markets
records.title_cn: 间歇耦合电力市场
records.abstract_en: Auctions of transmission rights between neighbouring countries are becoming increasingly active. In a parallel development, the introduction of market coupling frequently leads to smaller price differences between such countries. Indeed, if two countries are completely coupled, the price of a given hour of electricity will be identical in each country, resulting in a price spread of zero. Clearly, it is important to take this market coupling into account when evaluating transmission rights, as neglecting it would lead to a significant overvaluation of these rights. In order to address this issue, we introduce a general regime-switching mechanism that can be applied to many models in the literature. In particular, we focus on extending the model proposed by Cartea and González-Pedraz (2012). We describe the model estimation procedure in detail, and compare model and market prices of European spread options. We observe a dramatic paradigm shift in our data set at the end of the summer of 2021, and show that this shift has a strong effect on the model parameters. We also see that the reliable pricing and trading of spread options becomes problematic in such a volatile and uncertain market environment.
records.abstract_cn: 邻国之间输电权的拍卖正变得越来越活跃。与此同时，市场耦合的引入常常导致这些国家之间的价格差异缩小。事实上，如果两个国家完全耦合，某一给定小时的电价在两国将是相同的，导致价差为零。显然，在评估输电权时考虑这种市场耦合非常重要，因为忽略它会导致这些权利被显著高估。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种通用的制度转换机制，该机制可应用于文献中的许多模型。特别是，我们重点扩展了Cartea和González-Pedraz（2012）提出的模型。我们详细描述了模型估计过程，并比较了欧洲价差期权的模型价格与市场价格。我们观察到，在2021年夏末，我们的数据集发生了剧烈的范式转变，并表明这种转变对模型参数有强烈影响。我们还看到，在如此波动和不确定的市场环境中，价差期权的可靠定价和交易变得困难。

records.title_en: Banding: A game changer in the Renewables Obligation scheme in the United Kingdom
records.title_cn: 分级支持：英国可再生能源义务计划中的游戏规则改变者
records.abstract_en: The Renewables Obligation scheme was implemented in the UK in April 2002 to support electricity from renewable sources and was designed as technology-neutral to encourage competition. As less developed technologies were disadvantaged, banding was introduced in April 2009 to provide differentiated support to different technologies. A similar feature was used in other countries but its positive impact has not been identified empirically. This is the first quantitative study to examine the impacts of banding based on time series data from March 2003 to December 2018 in the UK, focusing on onshore wind, offshore wind, and solar. This study considers the impacts of banding via its feed-through effect on the markups and then investors' decisions on renewable projects, instead of considering it as an independent policy intervention. The counterfactual analysis shows that, if banding was not introduced, the offshore wind would remain silent for extended periods, then the UK might have difficulty in achieving its target for renewable generation. Besides, the costs of the RO scheme would be less, but additional fuel costs would be added to cover the generation gap.
records.abstract_cn: 可再生能源义务计划于2002年四月在英国实施，旨在支持来自可再生能源的电力，并设计为技术中立以鼓励竞争。由于欠发达技术处于不利地位，2009年四月引入了分级支持，为不同技术提供差异化支持。其他国家也采用了类似特征，但其积极影响尚未得到实证确认。这是首个基于2003年三月至2018年十二月英国时间序列数据，考察分级支持对陆上风电、海上风电和太阳能影响的定量研究。本研究通过分级支持对加价的影响及其随后对投资者可再生能源项目决策的传导效应来考虑其影响，而非将其视为独立的政策干预。反事实分析表明，如果未引入分级支持，海上风电将在较长时间内保持沉默，那么英国可能难以实现其可再生能源发电目标。此外，可再生能源义务计划的成本将降低，但将增加额外燃料成本以弥补发电缺口。

records.title_en: New estimate of shadow economy based on the total energy consumption. Evidence from the European Union countries
records.title_cn: 基于总能源消费的影子经济新估算：来自欧盟国家的证据
records.abstract_en: Estimating the shadow economy has become a significant concern for politicians, economists, and social scientists in recent times. Despite various advancements in methodology and empirical shreds of evidence, some areas remain unexplored. This article provides a valuable database on the estimations of the shadow economy in 26 EU countries for the period 2001–2021.
