The results imply that the opportunity to offer virtual presentations instead of traveling to deliver in-person presentations can decrease gender-specific inequality and increase inequality in favor of the “stars” within the profession.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了COVID-19大流行引发的经济学研讨会演讲模式变化的后果。研讨会演讲者的构成发生了显著变化。女性举办的研讨会比例有所增加。多项演讲者生产力指标显示，处于分布顶端的演讲者也获得了更多份额。知识传播的地理格局发生了显著变化，主办机构与演讲机构之间的平均距离增加了32%。这些结果表明，提供虚拟演讲而非亲临现场演讲的机会，可以减少性别特定不平等，并增加有利于业内“明星”的不平等。

records.title_en: Do governments crowd out governments? Evidence from a natural experiment
records.title_cn: 政府会挤出政府吗？来自自然实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Many governments operate budgets that expire at the end of the fiscal year and rush to spend large amounts at this time. The scale and breadth of this heightened spending raises the possibility of government departments crowding out each other at the year-end while competing with one another for limited suppliers. This may exacerbate the extent of year-end spending spikes. We investigate this possibility using expenditures of all overseas embassies and offices of the UK. We leverage a unique setting where embassies share the UK fiscal year for their budgeting but operate in countries with varying fiscal years. Our results show that: (1) in every country embassies spend more at the UK fiscal year-end than in the average month; (2) the extent of this extra spending is greater in countries that have a fiscal year that overlaps with the UK; (3) embassies spend more at the end of the fiscal years of local firms.
records.abstract_cn: 许多政府的预算在财政年度结束时到期，并在此期间急于支出大量资金。这种支出规模的扩大和范围的广泛，提出了政府部门在年底相互竞争有限供应商时可能相互挤出的可能性。这可能加剧年底支出高峰的程度。我们利用英国所有海外大使馆和办事处的支出来调查这种可能性。我们利用了一个独特的设置，即大使馆在预算编制时共享英国的财政年度，但所在国家的财政年度各不相同。我们的结果表明：（1）在每个国家，大使馆在英国财政年度末的支出都高于平均月份；（2）这种额外支出的程度在与英国财政年度重叠的国家更大；（3）大使馆在当地公司财政年度末的支出更多。

records.title_en: East Prussia 2.0: Persistent regions, rising nations
records.title_cn: 东普鲁士2.0：持续存在的地区，崛起的国家
records.abstract_en: In this study, we examine the political effects of the breakup of East Prussia into what is today Poland, Russia, and Lithuania. We expect that East Prussian legacies of nationalist and conservative political preferences persist in the respective partitions of Poland, Russia, and Lithuania. We find that there is no pattern of persistence in the Polish partition of former East Prussia, whereas East Prussian persistence appears to be robust in the Lithuanian and Russian partitions. In the context of forced migration, comparative human capital between outgoing refugees (Germans) and incoming settlers (Soviets, Poles) predicts patterns of long-run political development. Hence, higher literacy rates of incoming settlers in the Russian partition (Kaliningrad) predict higher levels of support for conservative and nationalist political parties. The opposite is observed in the Polish partition. The persistence of East Prussian legacies in Eastern Europe relates to settler literacy.
records.abstract_cn: 在这项研究中，我们研究了东普鲁士分裂为今天的波兰、俄罗斯和立陶宛的政治影响。我们预计，东普鲁士民族主义和保守政治偏好的遗产将在波兰、俄罗斯和立陶宛各自的瓜分地区继续存在。我们发现，在波兰瓜分前东普鲁士的过程中，并没有存在持久的模式，而在立陶宛和俄罗斯的瓜分中，东普鲁士的持久性似乎很强劲。在强迫移民的背景下，流出的难民（德国人）和流入的定居者（苏联、波兰人）之间的人力资本比较可以预测长期政治发展的模式。因此，俄罗斯分治区（加里宁格勒）新移民的识字率较高，预示着对保守派和民族主义政党的支持程度较高。在波兰分区中观察到相反的情况。东普鲁士遗产在东欧的持续存在与定居者的识字能力有关。

records.title_en: Assignment markets: Theory and experiments
records.title_cn: 指派市场：理论与实验
records.abstract_en: We experimentally test convergence to the core in two-sided markets for heterogeneous indivisible goods under different trading institutions. We use bargaining and strategic games as predictors that naturally generalize the core, accommodating non-equilibrium behavior. The performance of the competing theories reflects the differences in trading procedures—market outcomes are close to Nash equilibrium predictions under auction-like institutions and close to bargaining for institutions that feature decentralized negotiations. This difference may be driving the documented effect of fewer no-trade outcomes at the expense of a higher chance of suboptimal match under free-form bargaining.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在实验中测试了不同交易制度下异质不可分割商品双边市场中向核心的收敛性。我们使用讨价还价和策略博弈作为自然推广核心的预测器，以适应非均衡行为。竞争理论的绩效反映了交易程序的差异——在类似拍卖的制度下，市场结果接近纳什均衡预测，而在具有分散谈判特征的制度下，市场结果接近讨价还价。这一差异可能是导致记录到的无交易结果减少但自由形式讨价还价下次优匹配机会增加这一现象的原因。

records.title_en: Decomposing China’s bilateral export growth: A firm-regional-transactions structural gravity approach
records.title_cn: 分解中国双边出口增长：一种企业-区域-交易结构引力方法
records.abstract_en: This paper undertakes a decomposition of China’s firm-transaction-level exports with an emphasis on aggregates thereof at the prefectural level. Chinese prefectures are large and, relative to some smaller countries, the larger ones are visible players in the world market. We decompose China’s prefecture-product-level bilateral exports to foreign countries into their main components. These are factor costs, market potential (including trade frictions and foreign expenditure) as well as quality and productivity. We consider the latter two as to be drawn from a bivariate Pareto distribution that is specific to prefectures, products, and countries. This strategy enables retrieving fixed market access costs and permits conducting counterfactual experiments with a focus on the distribution across Chinese prefectures.
records.abstract_cn: 本文对中国企业-交易层面的出口进行分解，重点在于地级市层面的总量。中国的地级市规模较大，相对于一些较小的国家，较大的地级市是世界市场上可见的参与者。我们将中国地级市-产品层面的对国外双边出口分解为其主要组成部分。这些包括要素成本、市场潜力（包括贸易摩擦和外国支出）以及质量和生产率。我们将后两者视为从特定于地级市、产品和国家的二元帕累托分布中抽取。这一策略使得能够获取固定市场进入成本，并允许进行以中国地级市分布为重点的反事实实验。

records.title_en: Job security, asymmetric information, and wage rigidity
records.title_cn: 工作保障、信息不对称与工资刚性
records.abstract_en: We consider a labour market with risk averse workers, directed search and asymmetric information in which firms can commit to wage contracts but not to retain workers. The model predicts that in downturns (i) there is equal treatment of incumbents and new hires, (ii) wages are insensitive to the severity of the downturn, (iii) this leads to an amplified employment effect, and (iv) wages are determined by forecasts of labour market conditions rather than actual values. By contrast in upswings, new-hire wages are more attuned to actual conditions than forecasts, whilst incumbent wages remain relatively rigid. We find that these novel predictions are well supported in German administrative data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个劳动力市场，其中包含风险厌恶的工人、定向搜索和信息不对称，企业可以承诺工资合同但不能承诺保留工人。模型预测，在经济低迷时期，(i) 现有员工和新员工受到同等对待，(ii) 工资对低迷的严重程度不敏感，(iii) 这导致就业效应放大，以及 (iv) 工资由劳动力市场状况的预测而非实际值决定。相比之下，在经济上升期，新员工的工资更适应实际状况而非预测，而现有员工的工资则保持相对刚性。我们发现这些新颖的预测在德国行政数据中得到了很好的支持。

records.title_en: Financing universal health care: Premiums or payroll taxes?
records.title_cn: 全民医保融资：保费还是工资税？
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a stochastic overlapping generations model with endogenous health investment to study the transition from the existing hybrid health insurance system in Germany towards a uniform system, financed by either funded or unfunded premiums or payroll taxes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个具有内生健康投资的随机重叠世代模型，研究德国现有混合医疗保险制度向统一制度的转型，该统一制度由基金制或现收现付制的保费或工资税融资。

records.title_en: Optimal monetary policy and rational asset bubbles
records.title_cn: 最优货币政策与理性资产泡沫
records.abstract_en: Within a tractable New Keynesian model with stochastic asset-market participation, we analyze the normative implications of bubbly fluctuations for monetary policy. For a welfare-maximizing central bank, bubbly fluctuations imply an endogenous tradeoff between stabilizing cross-sectional consumption dispersion and stabilizing inflation/output. Inflation targeting is thus a generally suboptimal monetary-policy regime, despite the “divine coincidence”. Optimal deviations from inflation targeting are larger if the economy fluctuates around a balanced-growth path with small or no equilibrium bubbles, in which case the endogenous tradeoff is more stringent. The specific optimal-policy response to bubbly fluctuations depends however on the intrinsic nature of latter, and the associated effects on consumption dispersion.
records.abstract_cn: 在一个具有随机资产市场参与的可处理新凯恩斯模型中，我们分析了泡沫性波动对货币政策的规范含义。对于追求福利最大化的中央银行而言，泡沫性波动意味着在稳定跨部门消费离散度与稳定通胀/产出之间存在内生权衡。因此，尽管存在“神圣巧合”，通胀目标制通常是一种次优的货币政策制度。如果经济围绕一个具有较小或无均衡泡沫的平衡增长路径波动，则最优偏离通胀目标制的幅度更大，此时内生权衡更为严峻。然而，对泡沫性波动的具体最优政策反应取决于后者的内在性质及其对消费离散度的相关影响。

records.title_en: Priming ideology I: Why do presidential elections affect U.S. judges
records.title_cn: 启动意识形态 I：为什么总统选举影响美国法官
records.abstract_en: Politicians’ behavioral changes as an election nears have typically been attributed to the incentive effects of an election. I document that behavioral changes can occur even for unelected judges, using data from 1925 to 2002 on U.S. appellate judges, who are appointed for life. Exploiting monthly campaign ads in judges’ states of residence, dissents increase with campaign advertisements in states where judges reside. Elections can explain 23 % of all dissents. I rule out a number of incentive-based explanations. Topic of dissents, replication in concurrences (disagreement about reasoning), and placebo checks using milestones of case development support a transient priming mechanism. If elite U.S. judges are in fact susceptible to priming via the partisan nature of electoral cycles, then highly trained individuals may be susceptible to other forms of priming regardless of their professional commitments to be unbiased.
records.abstract_cn: 政治家在选举临近时的行为变化通常被归因于选举的激励效应。我记录了即使是非选举产生的法官也可能发生行为变化，使用的是1925年至2002年间美国上诉法院法官的数据，这些法官是终身任命的。利用法官居住州的月度竞选广告，异议意见随着法官所在州的竞选广告增加而增加。选举可以解释所有异议意见的23%。我排除了若干基于激励的解释。异议意见的主题、在并存意见中的重复（关于推理的分歧）以及使用案件发展里程碑的安慰剂检验支持一种短暂的启动机制。如果美国精英法官确实容易受到选举周期党派性质的启动影响，那么受过高度训练的个人可能无论其职业承诺保持公正与否，都容易受到其他形式的启动影响。

records.title_en: Minimum wages, wage dispersion and financial constraints in firms
records.title_cn: 最低工资、工资离散度与企业融资约束
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how minimum wages affect the wage distribution if firms face financial constraints. Using German employer-employee data and firm balance sheets, we document that the within-firm wage dispersion decreases more with higher minimum wages when firms are financially constrained. We introduce financial frictions into a search and matching labor market model with stochastic job matching, imperfect information, and endogenous effort. In line with the empirical literature, the model predicts that a higher minimum wage reduces hirings and separations. Firms become more selective such that their employment and wage dispersion fall. If effort increases strongly, firms may increase employment at the expense of higher wage dispersion. Financially constrained firms are more selective and reward effort less. As a result, within-firm wage dispersion and employment in these firms fall more with the minimum wage.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当企业面临融资约束时，最低工资如何影响工资分布。利用德国雇主-雇员数据和企业资产负债表，我们记录了在企业面临融资约束时，较高的最低工资会使企业内部工资离散度下降更多。我们将金融摩擦引入一个具有随机工作匹配、不完全信息和内生努力的搜索与匹配劳动力市场模型。与实证文献一致，该模型预测较高的最低工资会减少招聘和离职。企业变得更加挑剔，从而其就业和工资离散度下降。如果努力程度大幅增加，企业可能会以更高的工资离散度为代价增加就业。面临融资约束的企业更加挑剔，并且对努力的回报更少。因此，这些企业的内部工资离散度和就业随最低工资的下降幅度更大。

records.title_en: The spread of misinformation in networks with individual and social learning
records.title_cn: 个体学习与社会学习网络中的错误信息传播
records.abstract_en: The paper studies the spread of misinformation when agents have both individual and social learning. In the presence of sources of misinformation, the most vulnerable and harmful agents are those with poor individual learning and high centrality in the network. However, if opinions are polarized, providing some agents with better private information can backfire on other agents. Moreover, the incentives to spread misinformation have an inverted U-shaped relationship with the spreader’s influence; and, under certain conditions, an unaware spreader can be more harmful than a purposeful one. Overall, this paper warns that any policy that fails to consider both the precision of agents’ private information and the network structure runs the risk of backfiring.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当个体同时具有个体学习和社会学习时错误信息的传播。在存在错误信息来源的情况下，最脆弱和受害最深的个体是那些个体学习能力差且在网络中具有高中心性的个体。然而，如果观点极化，向某些个体提供更好的私人信息可能会对其他个体产生反效果。此外，传播错误信息的激励与传播者的影响力呈倒U型关系；并且在某些条件下，不知情的传播者可能比有目的的传播者更有害。总体而言，本文警告说，任何未能同时考虑个体私人信息的精确性和网络结构的政策都有适得其反的风险。

records.title_en: The role of emission disclosure for the low-carbon transition
records.title_cn: 排放披露对低碳转型的作用
records.abstract_en: We quantify the importance of emission disclosure for climate policies in a DSGE model for the euro area. A low-carbon energy and a fossil energy sector contribute to production and are financed by balance-sheet constrained intermediaries. We show that imperfect information on emissions by households (savers) is sufficient to create a palpable role for disclosure improvements. The underestimation of emissions from fossil energy firms (imperfect disclosure) provides these firms with too much funding. While improving disclosure in isolation has limited effects, it provides clear benefits in connection with higher carbon taxes: For a carbon tax increase by 50 euro/ton CO2, improving disclosure by 20 percentage points reduces the GDP costs by up to 14%. Over six years, this implies GDP benefits of 47 bn euro.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在欧元区 DSGE 模型中量化了排放披露对于气候政策的重要性。低碳能源和化石能源部门有助于生产，并由资产负债表受限的中介机构提供资金。我们表明，有关家庭（储蓄者）排放量的不完善信息足以为改进披露创造明显的作用。低估化石能源公司的排放量（不完全披露）为这些公司提供了过多的资金。虽然单独改善信息披露效果有限，但它与提高碳税相关的明显好处：如果碳税增加 50 欧元/吨 CO2，则改善信息披露 20 个百分点可将 GDP 成本降低高达 14%。六年内，这意味着 GDP 效益将达到 47 十亿欧元。

records.title_en: Helping behavior in networked organizations
records.title_cn: 网络化组织中的帮助行为
records.abstract_en: This article studies a networked organization in which agents work to directly increase the team’s output and help neighbors to reduce the disutility of working. I build a tractable framework to analyze the complexity of mutual help that cannot be simply characterized as strategic complements or substitutes, and the relationship between the structure of social networks within an organization and its efficiency. I establish the existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium of a two-stage game in which agents first decide how much helping effort to give to each neighbor, and, then, how much effort to expend to directly benefit the team. I show that denser networks might not necessarily sustain a higher level of help, because links might be redundant. If the agents are homogeneous, the network in which they are pairwise connected reaches the highest efficiency with the fewest links.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个网络化组织，其中代理人努力工作以直接增加团队的产出，并帮助邻居以减少工作的负效用。我构建了一个易于处理的框架来分析相互帮助的复杂性，这种复杂性不能简单地被描述为战略互补或替代，以及组织内社会网络结构与其效率之间的关系。我确立了一个两阶段博弈均衡的存在性和唯一性，在该博弈中，代理人首先决定向每个邻居提供多少帮助努力，然后决定花费多少努力直接使团队受益。我表明，更密集的网络不一定能维持更高水平的帮助，因为链接可能是冗余的。如果代理人是同质的，他们两两连接的网络以最少的链接达到最高效率。

records.title_en: Competition, equity and quality in public services
records.title_cn: 公共服务中的竞争、公平与质量
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the implications of consumer heterogeneity for the choice of competition and monopoly in public services delivery. In a setting with motivated providers who favour one type of service user over another, we show that competition can raise average quality. However, this may be at the expense of the minority type of user if the providers favour the majority type. Then an inequity averse regulator may protect the minority by not introducing competition. Alternatively, if the providers favour the minority type, the regulator may introduce competition to incentivize the providers to pay attention to the less rewarding majority type.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了消费者异质性对公共服务提供中竞争与垄断选择的影响。在存在有动机的提供者偏好某一类服务用户而非另一类的环境中，我们表明竞争可以提高平均质量。然而，如果提供者偏好多数类型用户，这可能以牺牲少数类型用户为代价。那么，一个厌恶不公平的监管者可能通过不引入竞争来保护少数群体。或者，如果提供者偏好少数类型，监管者可能引入竞争以激励提供者关注回报较少的多数类型。

records.title_en: Overreaction and the value of information in a pandemic
records.title_cn: 过度反应与疫情中信息的价值
records.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal mitigation and testing during a pandemic in the presence of partial information. We develop a stylized dynamic epidemiological model where the true number of infected individuals can only be partially inferred from two noisy signals: hospitalization and positivity rate. An egalitarian planner chooses the level of mitigation and testing, which respectively affect the infection rate and signal noise, at a certain economic cost. We first show that the planner is willing to pay a significant “information premium” to eliminate the uncertainty by extensive testing. However, if testing is prohibitively costly, then a stringent mitigation becomes optimal, as it partially substitutes for testing as an information acquisition device. Such policies were often criticized as excessive at the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic. We argue that this “optimal overreaction” is a result of the extreme costs of policy mistakes – such as high future casualties – and not due to an aversion to risk.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在信息不完全的情况下，疫情期间的最优缓解与检测策略。我们构建了一个简化的动态流行病学模型，其中真实的感染人数只能通过两个噪声信号部分推断：住院率和阳性率。一个平等主义规划者选择缓解和检测的力度，这两者分别影响感染率和信号噪声，并承担一定的经济成本。我们首先表明，规划者愿意支付显著的“信息溢价”以通过广泛检测消除不确定性。然而，如果检测成本过高，那么严格的缓解措施成为最优选择，因为它部分替代了检测作为信息获取工具的功能。此类政策在COVID-19疫情初期常被批评为过度。我们认为，这种“最优过度反应”是政策错误极端成本（如高未来伤亡）的结果，而非源于风险厌恶。

records.title_en: Labor market effects of monetary policy across workers and firms
records.title_cn: 货币政策对工人和企业的劳动力市场效应
records.abstract_en: This paper uses Austrian social security records to analyze the effects of ECB monetary policy on the labor market. Our focus is on the role of worker and firm wage components, defined by an Abowd et al. (1999) wage regression. We find that monetary tightening causes the largest employment losses for low-paid workers who are employed in high-paying firms before the tightening. Monetary tightening further causes a reallocation of workers to lower-paying firms. In particular low-paid workers who were originally employed by low-paying firms are prone to falling down the firm wage ladder.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用奥地利社会保障记录分析欧洲央行货币政策对劳动力市场的影响。我们关注的重点是工人和企业工资组成部分的作用，这些组成部分由Abowd等人（1999）的工资回归定义。我们发现，货币紧缩对在紧缩前受雇于高薪企业的低薪工人造成的就业损失最大。货币紧缩还导致工人向低薪企业重新配置。特别是，最初受雇于低薪企业的低薪工人容易在企业工资阶梯上跌落。

records.title_en: Reassessing grain price variability in early modern Europe (c. 1500–1800)
records.title_cn: 重新评估近代早期欧洲的谷物价格波动（约1500-1800年）
records.abstract_en: Grain was the most important food source in Europe during the early modern period (c. 1500–1800). The price level of grain and its volatility played a pivotal role in determining food security and, ultimately, societal and human well-being. Conflicting findings have been reported as to what extent early modern grain price volatility decreased over time. We systematically reassess early modern grain price variability, using 69 annual price series of barley, oats, rye and wheat, and different statistical methods to obtain insights into spatio-temporal changes. Over the entirety of Europe, the different grain types showed a strong price correlation, implying a low level of food security, but the price inter-correlation between grain types decreased over time — indicating an improved level of food security. Grain price volatility significantly decreased over time, especially after c. 1725 and at coastal locations, lessening the risk of food stress and reflecting market improvement from the perspective of consumers. Changes in price volatility closely followed changes in price levels until the mid-seventeenth century, when both started to be increasingly independent of each other, partly owing to less abrupt volatility changes. The largest increase in both price level and volatility is observed during the ‘price revolution’ of the late sixteenth century as well as during the Thirty Years’ War (1618–1648). In general, a high-price–low volatility pattern (and vice versa) is found throughout the early modern period and especially during the seventeenth century. This relationship, however, exhibits a somewhat geographically heterogeneous pattern, although with lower prices but higher volatility predominating in inland regions. To summarise, our results support the assumption that the level of food security improved over time and especially during the eighteenth century, but at the same time reveal considerable differences between grain types, measures considered, and geographical regions. The findings of this study point towards the need for further research on the geographical patterns of grain price variability and the factors explaining them.
records.abstract_cn: 在近代早期（约1500-1800年），谷物是欧洲最重要的食物来源。谷物的价格水平及其波动性在决定粮食安全以及最终的社会和人类福祉方面发挥了关键作用。关于近代早期谷物价格波动随时间下降的程度，已有研究报道了相互矛盾的发现。我们使用69个大麦、燕麦、黑麦和小麦的年度价格序列，并采用不同的统计方法，系统性地重新评估了近代早期的谷物价格波动，以深入了解时空变化。在整个欧洲，不同谷物类型显示出强烈的价格相关性，这意味着粮食安全水平较低，但谷物类型之间的价格相互相关性随时间下降——表明粮食安全水平有所提高。谷物价格波动随时间显著下降，尤其是在约1725年之后以及沿海地区，这减轻了粮食压力的风险，并从消费者的角度反映了市场的改善。直到十七世纪中叶，价格波动的变化与价格水平的变化密切相关，此后两者开始日益相互独立，部分原因是波动变化不再那么剧烈。价格水平和波动性的最大增幅出现在十六世纪末的“价格革命”以及三十年战争（1618-1648年）期间。总体而言，在整个近代早期，尤其是十七世纪，发现了高价格-低波动（反之亦然）的模式。然而，这种关系表现出一定程度的地理异质性，尽管内陆地区以较低价格但较高波动为主。总之，我们的结果支持了粮食安全水平随时间改善的假设，尤其是在十八世纪，但同时也揭示了谷物类型、所考虑的度量指标和地理区域之间的显著差异。本研究的发现表明，需要进一步研究谷物价格波动的地理模式及其解释因素。

records.title_en: Expansions in paid parental leave and mothers’ economic progress
records.title_cn: 带薪育儿假扩展与母亲的经济进步
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of reforms extending paid parental leave on mothers’ progress to the upper echelons of their companies. Using employer–employee matched data and examining a series of reforms between 1987 and 2005 in Norway, we find that longer parental leave neither helped nor hurt mothers’ chances to be at the top of their companies’ pay ranking or in the C-suite up to 25 years after childbirth. This holds true also for highly educated women and high performers across all sectors. Key career determinants, such as hours worked and promotions, are unaffected in the short and long run. Finally, fathers’ career progression and within-household gender wage gaps have also remained unaltered.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了延长带薪育儿假的改革对母亲晋升至公司高层的影响。利用雇主-雇员匹配数据，并考察挪威在1987年至2005年间的一系列改革，我们发现，较长的育儿假既未帮助也未阻碍母亲在分娩后长达25年内进入公司薪酬排名顶端或高管层的几率。这一结论同样适用于高学历女性及所有行业中的高绩效者。关键职业决定因素，如工作时间和晋升，在短期和长期内均未受影响。最后，父亲的职业发展及家庭内部性别工资差距也保持不变。

records.title_en: Gravity, globalization and time-varying heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 引力、全球化与时变异质性
records.abstract_en: As data availability improves, the gravity model of international trade is used to study the flow of trade over increasingly long periods of time. This puts pressure on the standard assumption that constant bilateral fixed effects are sufficient to control for unobserved heterogeneity. When looking across decades rather than years, changes in the economic landscape will affect both explanatory and dependent variables, thus biasing the results. The paper begins by providing evidence of time variation in the unobserved heterogeneity using a novel econometric test. It then presents a new way of estimating the gravity model that can identify and control for unobserved heterogeneity as it varies over country pairs and time. This approach substantially enhances the precision of the estimated parameters, enabling a detailed analysis of the impact of different types of economic integration agreements on trade on an annual basis. This heightened precision also demonstrates the diminishing importance of distance and allows our model to accurately depict the evolution of trade over time. The pattern in the unobserved heterogeneity closely resembles the ascent and the deceleration of globalization. The paper closes with some preliminary analysis into the factors that underlie the unobserved heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 随着数据可得性的提高，国际贸易引力模型被用于研究越来越长时间跨度的贸易流动。这对标准假设——即恒定的双边固定效应足以控制未观测异质性——构成了压力。当观察跨度为数十年而非数年时，经济格局的变化将影响解释变量和被解释变量，从而使结果产生偏误。本文首先通过一种新颖的计量经济学检验提供了未观测异质性存在时间变化的证据。随后，它提出了一种估计引力模型的新方法，能够识别并控制随国家对和时间变化的未观测异质性。该方法显著提高了估计参数的精度，使得能够逐年详细分析不同类型经济一体化协定对贸易的影响。这种更高的精度也证明了距离重要性的递减，并使我们的模型能够准确描绘贸易随时间的演变。未观测异质性的模式与全球化的上升和减速高度相似。本文最后对未观测异质性背后的因素进行了初步分析。

records.title_en: The fiscal arithmetic of a slowdown in trend growth
records.title_cn: 趋势增长放缓的财政算术
records.abstract_en: We study the fiscal policy implications of a slowdown in trend growth using an estimated stochastic growth model. Our analysis underscores the risks associated with fiscal rules linked to growth rates, which may prove unsustainable under permanent shifts in productivity growth. For equilibria to exist, fiscal policy must respond to the slowdown ensuring that the government budget constraint holds in the low growth regime. While the slowdown imposes significant welfare costs on households, it also triggers a substantial endogenous response that boosts capital accumulation and functions as an automatic stabilizer. If fiscal policy maintains the provision of public goods per capita constant, the slowdown gives rise to a pleasant fiscal arithmetic, requiring tax cuts or a higher target debt-to-output ratio for long-term fiscal sustainability. We discuss the ramifications of various fiscal strategies, including increasing per capita public spending, altering the tax structure, and adjusting the target debt-to-output ratio.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个估计的随机增长模型研究趋势增长放缓的财政政策含义。我们的分析强调了与增长率挂钩的财政规则所伴随的风险，这些规则在生产率增长永久性转变下可能不可持续。为了均衡存在，财政政策必须对放缓做出反应，确保政府预算约束在低增长体制下成立。虽然放缓给家庭带来了显著的福利成本，但它也引发了实质性的内生反应，促进资本积累并充当自动稳定器。如果财政政策保持人均公共产品供给不变，放缓将产生令人愉快的财政算术，要求减税或提高目标债务产出比以实现长期财政可持续性。我们讨论了各种财政策略的影响，包括增加人均公共支出、改变税收结构以及调整目标债务产出比。

records.title_en: Life after (soft) default
records.title_cn: （软性）违约后的生活
records.abstract_en: Soft default, defined as a delinquency of 90 days or more, is a relatively common event in the credit market, in 2010 such episodes affected about 3 million individuals. Yet we lack a detailed understanding of what happens afterward. We use credit report data, on approximately 2 million individuals from 2004 to 2020, to shed light on individual trajectories after such event, and document enduring negative impacts. These effects persist for up to ten years post-event and manifest in lower credit scores, reduced total credit limits, lower homeownership rates, lower income, and relocation to less economically active zip codes. It appears that those who are overextended in their mortgage lines, and with larger delinquent amounts, suffer the harshest consequences.
records.abstract_cn: 软性违约，定义为逾期90天或以上，在信贷市场中是一个相对常见的事件，2010年此类事件影响了约3万人。然而，我们对事后发生的情况缺乏详细了解。我们使用2年至2004年约2020万人的信用报告数据，揭示此类事件后个人轨迹，并记录了持续的负面影响。这些影响在事件后持续长达十年，表现为信用评分降低、总信用额度减少、住房拥有率下降、收入降低，以及迁往经济活动较不活跃的邮政编码地区。那些在抵押贷款额度上过度扩张且逾期金额较大的人，似乎遭受了最严重的后果。

records.title_en: Comparing the effects of non-monetary incentives and monetary incentives on prosocial behavior
records.title_cn: 比较非货币激励与货币激励对亲社会行为的影响
records.abstract_en: The crowding-out effects predict that offering monetary incentives to complete a task might negatively affect task performance because the monetary rewards crowd out non-monetary sources of value that people derive from task completion. In this study, we revisit a well-known field experiment by Gneezy and Rustichini (2000) that provides evidence for crowding-out effects in the context of prosocial behavior. We test the robustness of these effects using a larger sample and adjust the experiment's design to better elucidate the role of non-monetary incentives in prosocial behavior. Specifically, we assigned 245 pairs of high school students to different incentives for collecting donations for charity: low monetary incentives (1 % of total donations collected), high monetary incentives (10 % of total donations collected), non-monetary incentives (enhanced task importance and public recognition), or no external incentives. We made it explicit to the students that the monetary incentives were funded by the researchers, not the charities. In line with crowding-out effects and Gneezy and Rustichini's (2000) findings, our results show that low monetary incentives elicit lower performance (collected donations) compared with the absence of external incentives. Importantly, non-monetary incentives elicit higher performance compared with either monetary incentives or the absence of external incentives.
records.abstract_cn: 挤出效应预测，为完成任务提供货币激励可能会对任务表现产生负面影响，因为货币奖励挤出了人们从任务完成中获得的非货币价值来源。在本研究中，我们重新审视了Gneezy和Rustichini（2000）的一项著名实地实验，该实验为亲社会行为背景下的挤出效应提供了证据。我们使用更大的样本检验了这些效应的稳健性，并调整了实验设计，以更好地阐明非货币激励在亲社会行为中的作用。具体而言，我们将245对高中生分配到不同的激励条件下，以收集慈善捐款：低货币激励（所收捐款总额的1%）、高货币激励（所收捐款总额的10%）、非货币激励（增强任务重要性和公开认可）或无外部激励。我们向学生明确说明，货币激励由研究人员而非慈善机构提供资金。与挤出效应及Gneezy和Rustichini（2000）的发现一致，我们的结果表明，与无外部激励相比，低货币激励导致较低的表现（所收捐款）。重要的是，与货币激励或无外部激励相比，非货币激励导致更高的表现。

records.title_en: Trade policy uncertainty & resource misallocation
records.title_cn: 贸易政策不确定性与资源错配
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of trade policy uncertainty (TPU) on resource allocation across heterogeneous Chinese producers and aggregate productivity in the Chinese manufacturing sector. Using detailed Chinese data and common cost minimization conditions we measure the difference between optimal capital and labor holdings for each firm, or the efficiency gap. We document that (i) efficiency gaps decline sharply with China’s accession to the WTO and the declines are disproportionately pronounced among industries most exposed to TPU; (ii) efficiency gap declines were larger among Chinese exporters; (iii) efficiency gap declines occur simultaneously with a rise in the variance of firm-level employment and investment in new capital. Using China’s accession to the WTO as an exogenous change in the degree of uncertainty faced by Chinese producers, we quantify the implied change in productivity due to the reduction in TPU. Our estimates imply that the reduction in TPU induced by WTO accession accounted for a 17% increase in aggregate productivity through reduced resource misallocation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）对中国异质性生产者之间的资源配置以及中国制造业部门总体生产率的作用。利用详细的中国数据和常见的成本最小化条件，我们衡量了每个企业最优资本和劳动持有量之间的差异，即效率缺口。我们记录了以下事实：（i）随着中国加入WTO，效率缺口急剧下降，且这种下降在受TPU影响最大的行业中尤为显著；（ii）效率缺口的下降在中国出口企业中更为明显；（iii）效率缺口的下降与企业层面就业和新资本投资方差的上升同时发生。利用中国加入WTO作为中国生产者面临不确定性程度的外生变化，我们量化了由于TPU减少所隐含的生产率变化。我们的估计表明，加入WTO所引发的TPU减少，通过减少资源错配，使总体生产率提高了17%。

records.title_en: Altruism, social interactions, and the course of a pandemic
records.title_cn: 利他主义、社会互动与大流行的进程
records.abstract_en: Externalities and social preferences, such as altruism, play a key role in the choice of social interactions, which in turn affect the diffusion of a pandemic. We build a dynamic epidemiological model with endogenous social interactions in a frictional environment, also in a variant with heterogeneous agents and a network structure. Taking into account agents’ endogenous behavior and altruism generates markedly different predictions relative to a naïve epidemiological model with exogenous contact rates. Congestion and commitment inefficiencies arise, even under full altruism, and call for policy intervention. We derive the efficient allocation, and show how the Ramsey planner can mitigate the respective externalities.
records.abstract_cn: 外部性和社会偏好，如利他主义，在社会互动的选择中扮演关键角色，进而影响大流行的传播。我们构建了一个动态流行病学模型，该模型在摩擦环境中具有内生社会互动，并包含异质性主体和网络结构的变体。考虑到主体的内生行为和利他主义，相对于具有外生接触率的朴素流行病学模型，产生了显著不同的预测。即使在完全利他主义下，也会出现拥堵和承诺无效率，需要政策干预。我们推导出有效配置，并展示拉姆齐规划者如何缓解相应的外部性。

records.title_en: The effects of temperature shocks on energy prices and inflation in the Euro Area
records.title_cn: 温度冲击对欧元区能源价格和通货膨胀的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper traces the existence of an energy transmission channel of temperature anomalies to Euro-Area inflation. We show that, on average, warmer temperature shocks elicit a negative energy demand shift, exerting moderate deflationary pressure. By looking into several asymmetries and macroeconomic indicators, we rationalize that evidence as signaling that the “turn-off-heating” effect in Europe outweighs the “turn-on-cooling”. This result becomes clearer when energy market responses are decomposed into gas and electricity components. Weak inflationary effects from non-energy items are at play when the shock hits during warm seasons. A persistent inflationary tendency manifests when food and energy prices rise, an outcome emerging only when negative anomalies – cold spells – hit. These findings shed new light on monitoring price stability due to global warming.
records.abstract_cn: 本文追踪了温度异常对欧元区通货膨胀的能源传导渠道的存在性。我们表明，平均而言，较暖的温度冲击引发负向能源需求变动，施加适度的通缩压力。通过考察多种不对称性和宏观经济指标，我们合理化这一证据，表明欧洲的“关闭供暖”效应超过了“开启制冷”。当能源市场反应分解为天然气和电力组成部分时，这一结果变得更加清晰。当冲击发生在温暖季节时，非能源项目的微弱通胀效应在起作用。当食品和能源价格上涨时，持续的通胀趋势显现，这一结果仅在负异常——寒潮——来袭时出现。这些发现为监测因全球变暖导致的价格稳定提供了新的视角。

records.title_en: Labour costs and the decision to hire the first employee
records.title_cn: 劳动力成本与雇佣第一名员工的决定
records.abstract_en: Firms without paid employees account for up to 80 % of all firms, but only a small minority ever hires. This paper investigates the relationship between labour costs and the decision to hire a first employee and become an employer. Leveraging a unique policy in Belgium that permanently reduced the labour cost of the first employee by 13 %, we find that the number of new, first-time employers jumped by 31 % immediately following the reform. The elasticity of the probability to hire the first employee with respect to the labour cost is −2.39 [95 % CI: −3.45, −1.25].
records.abstract_cn: 没有带薪雇员的企业占所有企业的比例高达80%，但只有少数企业最终会雇佣员工。本文研究了劳动力成本与雇佣第一名员工并成为雇主这一决定之间的关系。利用比利时一项独特的政策，该政策将第一名员工的劳动力成本永久降低了13%，我们发现改革后新雇主（首次雇佣）的数量立即增加了31%。雇佣第一名员工的概率对劳动力成本的弹性为−2.39 [95%置信区间：−3.45, −1.25]。

records.title_en: The welfare costs of business cycles unveiled: Measuring the extent of stabilization policies
records.title_cn: 经济周期波动的福利成本揭示：衡量稳定政策的程度
records.abstract_en: How can we measure the welfare benefit of ongoing stabilization policies? We develop a methodology to calculate the welfare cost of business cycles taking into account that observed consumption is partially smoothed. We propose a decomposition that disentangles consumption into a mix of laissez-faire and riskless components, decoupled by a parameter that captures the span of stabilization power. We estimate this parameter profiting from two distinct variance regimes measured in the historical consumption data and an identification strategy for the mapping between the span for each of these periods. In our preferred specification, we find that the welfare cost of total fluctuations is 11 percent of lifetime consumption, of which 82 percent is smoothed by the status quo policies, yielding a residual 1.8 percent of consumption to be tackled by policymakers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们如何衡量持续稳定政策的福利收益？我们开发了一种方法来计算经济周期波动的福利成本，考虑到观察到的消费是部分平滑的。我们提出一种分解方法，将消费分解为自由放任和无风险成分的混合，由一个捕捉稳定政策力度的参数来解耦。我们利用历史消费数据中测得的两个不同方差体制以及这些时期各自力度的映射识别策略来估计该参数。在我们的首选设定中，我们发现总波动的福利成本为终身消费的11%，其中82%被现行政策平滑，留给政策制定者解决的剩余消费为1.8%。

records.title_en: Financial markets and legal challenges to unconventional monetary policy
records.title_cn: 金融市场与非常规货币政策的法律挑战
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the empirical effects of legal challenges to monetary policy. Several policy measures of the European Central Bank have come under scrutiny before national courts and the European Court of Justice. These lawsuits have the potential to impact the scope and flexibility of central bank policies with important consequences for the economy. The number of relevant legal challenges is small and exact timestamps are often not available. Hence, we develop an econometric approach that searches for minimum variance regimes which we use to isolate and measure the effects of the rulings. Our results suggest that legal rulings addressing central bank policies have a significant effect on financial markets and can be linked to monetary policy uncertainty shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了货币政策法律挑战的实证效应。欧洲中央银行的几项政策措施已受到国家法院和欧洲法院的审查。这些诉讼有可能影响央行政策的范围和灵活性，对经济产生重要后果。相关法律挑战的数量很少，且确切的时间戳往往不可用。因此，我们开发了一种寻找最小方差区制的计量经济学方法，用于隔离和衡量裁决的影响。我们的结果表明，针对央行政策的法律裁决对金融市场有显著影响，并可归因于货币政策不确定性冲击。

records.title_en: The role of immigration in a deep recession
records.title_cn: 移民在深度衰退中的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of pre-Great Recession immigrant inflows on the labour market during a recession. It develops a random search model of the labour market featuring vacancy persistence, endogenous return migration, and wage rigidity. Consistent with the Spanish data, some immigrants in the model leave the country during the recession, freeing up jobs for natives. Yet, differences in match-quality draws between immigrants and natives also impact firms’ job creation decisions. The return-migration channel positively affects natives, while job creation effects are negative in the calibrated Spanish economy. I find that immigrants mitigate the impact of the recession and enhance natives’ welfare. During the recession, the native unemployment rate would have been 2 percentage points higher in the absence of the pre-crisis immigration boom. Return migration plays a key role, with short- and medium-run impacts on the native unemployment rate 6 times larger than all other channels combined.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了大衰退前移民流入对衰退期间劳动力市场的影响。本文构建了一个包含职位持续性、内生性回迁和工资刚性的劳动力市场随机搜索模型。与西班牙数据一致，模型中的一些移民在衰退期间离开该国，为本地人腾出工作岗位。然而，移民与本地人在匹配质量上的差异也会影响企业的职位创造决策。在 calibrated 的西班牙经济中，回迁渠道对本地人产生积极影响，而职位创造效应则为负。我发现移民减轻了衰退的影响并提高了本地人的福利。在衰退期间，如果没有危机前的移民潮，本地失业率将高出 2 个百分点。回迁移民发挥了关键作用，其对本地失业率的短期和中期影响是其他所有渠道总和 6 倍。

records.title_en: Contacts, altruism and competing externalities
records.title_cn: 接触、利他主义与竞争性外部性
records.abstract_en: This paper considers voluntary transmissive contacts between partially altruistic individuals in the presence of asymptomatic infection. Two different types of externalities from contacts are considered, infection externalities and socioeconomic externalities. When contacts are incidental, then externalities work through disease propagation. When contacts are essential, both infection and socioeconomic externalities are present. It is shown that for incidental contacts, equilibrium involves suboptimally high exposure whereas for essential contacts, equilibrium exposure is suboptimally low. An increase in altruism may thus increase or decrease disease transmission, depending on the type of contact under consideration. The analysis implies that policy to manage an epidemic should differentiate between different types of transmissive activities.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了在无症状感染存在的情况下，部分利他个体之间的自愿传播性接触。考虑了两种不同类型的接触外部性，即感染外部性和社会经济外部性。当接触是偶然的，外部性通过疾病传播起作用。当接触是必要的，感染外部性和社会经济外部性都存在。结果表明，对于偶然接触，均衡涉及次优的高暴露，而对于必要接触，均衡暴露是次优的低。因此，利他主义的增加可能增加或减少疾病传播，取决于所考虑的接触类型。分析表明，管理流行病的政策应区分不同类型的传播活动。

records.title_en: Identity, Leadership, and Cooperation: An experimental analysis
records.title_cn: 身份、领导力与合作：一项实验分析
records.abstract_en: Effective leaders promote cooperation among their followers. Although many studies have focused on approaches to effective leadership, few have studied how social identity impacts a leader’s effectiveness within the context of a controlled laboratory environment. Using a novel laboratory experiment and a guiding theoretical framework enables us to shed new light on how social identity impacts leader–follower interactions in a decontextualized environment. In our experiment, the leader, if present, may or may not share a social identity with the rest of the group. Our main finding is that ingroup leaders are more effective than outgroup leaders, and outgroup leaders are no more effective than groups without a leader. In particular, ingroup leaders are more likely to suggest greater cooperation among followers, and their suggestions are more likely to be followed. Further, we find that outgroup leaders are less credible leaders. These findings suggest that diversity alone does not drive inclusion and provide evidence of an important challenge to achieving the well-documented organizational benefits that stem from a diverse and inclusive workplace.
records.abstract_cn: 有效的领导者能促进其追随者之间的合作。尽管许多研究关注有效领导的方法，但很少有研究在受控实验室环境下探讨社会身份如何影响领导者的有效性。通过一项新颖的实验室实验和指导性理论框架，我们得以揭示在去情境化环境中社会身份如何影响领导者与追随者的互动。在我们的实验中，如果存在领导者，其可能与团队其他成员共享或不共享社会身份。我们的主要发现是，内群体领导者比外群体领导者更有效，而外群体领导者的效果并不比没有领导者的群体更好。特别是，内群体领导者更可能建议追随者进行更多合作，且其建议更可能被遵循。此外，我们发现外群体领导者可信度较低。这些发现表明，仅靠多样性并不能推动包容，并为实现多元化与包容性工作场所所带来的有据可查的组织效益提供了重要挑战的证据。

records.title_en: Intergenerational assimilation of minorities: The role of the majority group
records.title_cn: 少数族群的代际同化：多数群体的作用
records.abstract_en: We develop a dynamic model of assimilation of ethnic minorities that posits a trade-off between higher productivity and wages and greater social distance from the culture of origin. We primarily highlight the importance of the intergenerational linkage of assimilation and also incorporate the role of the majority group in the assimilation of ethnic minorities. We first show how the assimilation of the past generation is transmitted to the subsequent generation, and then characterize the intragenerational and intergenerational externalities. Moreover, we explore the interaction of the minority and majority decisions, which accompanies a hump-shaped relationship between the act to tolerate of the majority individuals and the level of assimilation in the society. Such a relationship is also transmitted via intergenerational linkage and causes additional externalities. In fact, more tolerance from the majority group generates positive externalities for the minority group, while each minority group’s assimilation effort affects the welfare of the majority individuals differently depending on the initial minority assimilation level.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个关于少数族群同化的动态模型，该模型假设在更高生产率和工资与更大文化起源社会距离之间存在权衡。我们主要强调同化的代际联系的重要性，并纳入多数群体在少数族群同化中的作用。我们首先展示过去一代的同化如何传递给下一代，然后刻画代内和代际外部性。此外，我们探讨少数群体与多数群体决策的相互作用，这伴随着多数个体容忍行为与社会同化水平之间的驼峰形关系。这种关系也通过代际联系传递，并导致额外外部性。事实上，多数群体更多的容忍对少数群体产生正外部性，而每个少数群体的同化努力对多数个体福利的影响取决于初始少数群体同化水平的不同而不同。

records.title_en: Macro welfare effects of flexible labor contracts
records.title_cn: 灵活劳动合同的宏观福利效应
records.abstract_en: We develop a Dynamic-Stochastic-General-Equilibrium model to study the macro welfare effects of flexible labor contracts. Capturing the empirical properties observed in the data, we incorporate two labor sectors in our DSGE framework: a fixed sector and a flexible sector. The fixed sector offers contracts that exhibit rigidities in working-hours and wages while the flexible sector offers flexible contracts in both dimensions. We calibrate the model utilizing Eurozone data and show that in the benchmark currency union economy, welfare would monotonically increase if fixed sector’s wage rigidity goes up, while welfare would monotonically decline in wage rigidity if the benchmark economy were to switch to inflation targeting. We also show that it is the working-hour flexibility of flexible labor contracts that reinforces the desirability of wage stickiness in the fixed sector. Finally, we obtain strikingly different optimal flexible sector sizes for economies in currency union and inflation targeting monetary policy regimes: while the optimal flexible sector size for a currency union economy turns out to be 0%, the optimal flexible sector size for an economy with inflation targeting is 100%. These important results prevail because large fluctuations in consumption associated with flexible labor arrangements are too costly for households in a currency union with limited monetary policy flexibility — outweighing the production flexibility gains from flexible labor contracts. In this respect, our paper formalizes the welfare concerns related to the growing flexible labor sector sizes in Eurozone and urge policy makers to pay special attention to regulations that induce more flexible labor arrangements in this region.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个动态随机一般均衡模型来研究灵活劳动合同的宏观福利效应。为了捕捉数据中观察到的经验特征，我们在DSGE框架中纳入了两个劳动部门：固定部门和灵活部门。固定部门提供的合同在工作时间和工资方面表现出刚性，而灵活部门在这两个维度上提供灵活合同。我们利用欧元区数据校准模型，并表明在基准货币联盟经济中，如果固定部门的工资刚性上升，福利将单调增加；而如果基准经济转向通胀目标制，福利将随工资刚性单调下降。我们还表明，正是灵活劳动合同的工作时间灵活性强化了固定部门工资粘性的可取性。最后，我们获得了货币联盟和通胀目标制货币政策制度下经济体的最优灵活部门规模的显著不同结果：货币联盟经济体的最优灵活部门规模为0%，而通胀目标制经济体的最优灵活部门规模为100%。这些重要结果之所以存在，是因为在货币政策灵活性有限的货币联盟中，与灵活劳动安排相关的大幅消费波动对家庭来说代价过高——超过了灵活劳动合同带来的生产灵活性收益。在这方面，我们的论文正式化了与欧元区不断增长的灵活劳动部门规模相关的福利担忧，并敦促政策制定者特别关注该地区诱导更多灵活劳动安排的法规。

records.title_en: The Green Revolution, grain imports, and income divergence in the developing world
records.title_cn: 绿色革命、粮食进口与发展中国家收入分化
records.abstract_en: This study finds that the Green Revolution (GR), initiated in the 1960s, substantially increased grain imports and reduced economic growth in developing countries with below-average adoption of GR technologies. Using the exogenous timing of the GR across crops cultivated in different countries, this study estimates that, for an average developing country with an adoption rate of GR crops below the developing world average, the GR that occurred in other countries more than tripled its grain imports. This, in turn, reduced the GDP per capita by approximately one-third in low-adopting countries between 1965 and 2000. The substantial damage can be mostly explained by the resulting lower agricultural outputs, higher fertility, and lower human capital investment. This study suggests that increasing agricultural productivity is the most pertinent way to accelerate the stagnant growth historically experienced by developing countries damaged by the GR.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究发现，始于1960年的绿色革命显著增加了绿色革命技术采用率低于平均水平的發展中国家的粮食进口，并降低了其经济增长。利用不同国家种植作物中绿色革命的外生时间，本研究估计，对于采用绿色革命作物比例低于发展中国家平均水平的普通发展中国家，其他国家发生的绿色革命使其粮食进口增加了两倍以上。这反过来又使低采用国家在1965年至2000年间的人均GDP减少了约三分之一。这一重大损害主要可归因于由此导致的农业产出下降、生育率上升和人力资本投资减少。本研究表明，提高农业生产力是加速历史上受绿色革命影响的发展中国家停滞增长的最相关途径。

records.title_en: Firm-level impact of public credit guarantees
records.title_cn: 公共信贷担保的企业层面影响
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the firm-level short-term impact of one of the world’s largest credit guarantee programs recently implemented in Türkiye. Using a combination of firm-level administrative databases of the tax registry, credit registry, and the credit guarantee fund (CGF) registry, we analyze the characteristics of the CGF-supported firms and the program’s impact on their employment, sales, and credit default probability. Our findings indicate that, on average, the CGF program had a positive effect on the short-term performance of the treated firms. Specifically, CGF-supported firms preserved 17 percent more employment and achieved 70 percent higher sales, while reducing their credit default probability by 0.6 percentage points compared to their matched control group. Evaluating our estimation results at variable averages shows that every 1 million TL credit generated via the CGF program preserved 2.7 extra employment and stimulated about 3 million TL in sales. However, the program did not lead to increased productivity-enhancing investments, such as R&D. Additionally, we observe an overall increase in firm indebtedness, which may adversely affect firms’ long-term financial health. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that the program’s impact varies across firm sizes and sectors, with medium-sized firms and labor-intensive sectors experiencing the most significant benefits. Using this heterogeneity, we perform counter-factual policy exercises indicating that redesigning the program with such priorities can bring substantial efficiency gains.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了土耳其近期实施的全球最大信贷担保计划之一的企业层面短期影响。结合税务登记、信贷登记和信贷担保基金（CGF）登记的企业层面行政数据库，我们分析了CGF支持企业的特征以及该计划对其就业、销售和信贷违约概率的影响。我们的研究结果表明，平均而言，CGF计划对受处理企业的短期绩效产生了积极影响。具体而言，与匹配的对照组相比，CGF支持的企业保留了17%更多的就业，实现了70%更高的销售额，同时将其信贷违约概率降低了0.6个百分点。在变量平均值处评估我们的估计结果显示，通过CGF计划产生的每1百万土耳其里拉信贷保留了2.7个额外就业岗位，并刺激了约3百万土耳其里拉的销售额。然而，该计划并未导致生产率提升型投资（如研发）的增加。此外，我们观察到企业负债率整体上升，这可能对企业长期财务健康产生不利影响。进一步地，我们的分析揭示该计划的影响因企业规模和行业而异，中型企业和劳动密集型行业受益最为显著。利用这种异质性，我们进行了反事实政策模拟，表明按此类优先事项重新设计该计划可以带来显著的效率提升。

records.title_en: Learning from Friends in a Pandemic: Social networks and the macroeconomic response of consumption
records.title_cn: 疫情期间向朋友学习：社交网络与消费的宏观经济反应
records.abstract_en: Aggregate events often start locally with households learning about the unfolding of events through social communication. Using plausibly exogenous variation in counties’ social network exposure to geographically remote regions during the COVID-19 pandemic, we quantify the propagation of idiosyncratic COVID-19 social network weighted shocks to consumption spending. We present a wide array of tests that directly control for the role of physical mobility, and physical distance, and isolate the role of geographically distant counties to show that the detected consumption responses were primarily through the channel of expectations, rather than physical infection risks or other common economic and policy shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 总体事件往往始于局部，家庭通过社会交流了解事件的进展。利用COVID-19疫情期间各县社交网络对地理偏远地区暴露的看似外生变化，我们量化了特质性COVID-19社交网络加权冲击对消费支出的传播。我们提供了一系列广泛的检验，直接控制身体流动性和物理距离的作用，并隔离地理偏远县的作用，以表明检测到的消费反应主要是通过预期渠道，而非身体感染风险或其他共同的经济和政策冲击。

records.title_en: How do low-education immigrants adjust to Chinese import shocks? Evidence using English language proficiency
records.title_cn: 低教育移民如何适应中国进口冲击？基于英语熟练度的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the link between trade-induced changes in local labor market opportunities and English language fluency rates among low-education immigrants in the United States. The production-based manufacturing jobs lost due to Chinese import competition around the turn of the century did not require strong English-speaking skills while many of the jobs in expanding industries, mostly in the service sector, did. Consistent with responses to these changing labor market opportunities, we find that a $1,000 increase in import exposure per worker in a local area led to an increase in the share of low-education immigrants speaking English very well in that area by about half a percentage point. As evidence that at least part of this is a result of actual improvements in English language speaking abilities, we show that low-education immigrants in trade-impacted areas became especially likely to be enrolled in school compared to similarly low-education natives. While we find some evidence for domestic migration in response to trade shocks, we also show that our results are not likely to be driven by language-selective internal migration or initial settlement decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了贸易引起的当地劳动力市场机会变化与美国低教育移民英语流利度之间的联系。世纪之交，因中国进口竞争而失去的生产型制造业工作岗位并不需要很强的英语口语能力，而扩张行业（主要是服务业）中的许多工作岗位则需要。与对这些变化的劳动力市场机会的反应一致，我们发现，当地人均进口暴露每增加1000美元，该地区低教育移民中英语说得非常好的比例就会增加约半个百分点。作为至少部分原因是英语口语能力实际提高的证据，我们表明，受贸易影响的地区的低教育移民与同等低教育本土居民相比，尤其可能入学就读。虽然我们发现了国内移民对贸易冲击做出反应的一些证据，但我们也表明，我们的结果不太可能由语言选择性的国内迁移或初始定居决策所驱动。

records.title_en: Expressways and policy choices of local governments
records.title_cn: 高速公路与地方政府政策选择
records.abstract_en: We examine how intercity road connection affects the policy choices of local governments, using the construction of China’s national expressway as a natural experiment. We show that peripheral counties reduced the level of spending and changed the spending composition since the expressway connection. They became less involved in spending competition, increased the effective tax rate on private firms, and slowed down the privatization of state-owned firms. These results are consistent with the view that mobile capital tends to relocate from peripheral areas to core regions with a lower trade cost. We further show that such changes in government policies contribute significantly to the output decline in these regions after the expressway connection.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国国家高速公路建设作为自然实验，考察城际公路连接如何影响地方政府的政策选择。我们表明，自高速公路连接以来，外围县降低了支出水平并改变了支出构成。它们参与支出竞争的程度降低，提高了对私营企业的有效税率，并减缓了国有企业的私有化进程。这些结果与以下观点一致：流动资本倾向于从外围地区迁移到贸易成本较低的核心区域。我们进一步表明，这些政府政策的变化对高速公路连接后这些地区的产出下降有显著贡献。

records.title_en: On natural interest rate volatility
records.title_cn: 论自然利率的波动性
records.abstract_en: Episodes of low natural interest rates, even transitory, pose a challenge to monetary policy, by possibly causing the effective lower bound (ELB) on the policy rate to bind. Those episodes are more likely to occur not only when the natural rate is low on average but also when fluctuations around its average level are large. We study the responsiveness of the natural interest rate to structural aggregate shocks affecting the aggregate supply of and demand for savings. Using a quantitative overlapping-generations model, we trace back this responsiveness to the slopes of aggregate savings supply and demand curves and argue that both curves have likely flattened over the past four decades in the US This implies a greater sensitivity of the natural interest rate to structural shocks affecting the supply of and demand for aggregate savings — making it more likely, all else equal, that it fall into negative territory.
records.abstract_cn: 低自然利率时期，即使是暂时的，也会对货币政策构成挑战，可能导致政策利率的有效下限（ELB）被触及。这些时期不仅更可能在自然利率平均水平较低时出现，而且在其平均水平周围波动较大时也更可能出现。我们研究了自然利率对影响总储蓄供给和需求的结构性总体冲击的响应性。利用一个定量重叠世代模型，我们将这种响应性追溯到总储蓄供给和需求曲线的斜率，并认为在过去四十年中，美国的这两条曲线可能都已变得更加平坦。这意味着自然利率对影响总储蓄供给和需求的结构性冲击更加敏感——在其他条件相同的情况下，使其更有可能落入负值区域。

records.title_en: Research joint ventures: The role of financial constraints
records.title_cn: 研究合资企业：财务约束的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a novel theory of research joint ventures for financially constrained firms. When firms choose R&D portfolios, an RJV can help to coordinate research efforts, reducing investments in duplicate projects. This can free up resources, increase the variety of pursued projects and thereby increase the probability of discovering the innovation. RJVs improve innovation outcomes when market competition is weak or external financing conditions are bad. An RJV may increase the innovation probability and nevertheless lower total R&D costs. RJVs that increase innovation also increase consumer surplus and tend to be profitable, but innovation-reducing RJVs also exist. Finally, we compare RJVs to innovation-enhancing mergers.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为面临财务约束的企业提供了研究合资企业的新理论。当企业选择研发组合时，RJV有助于协调研究工作，减少重复项目的投资。这可以释放资源，增加所追求项目的多样性，从而增加发现创新的概率。当市场竞争较弱或外部融资条件较差时，RJV能改善创新成果。RJV可能提高创新概率，同时降低总研发成本。增加创新的RJV也增加了消费者剩余，并且往往是有利可图的，但也存在减少创新的RJV。最后，我们将RJV与促进创新的并购进行比较。

records.title_en: Global corporate income tax competition, knowledge spillover, and growth
records.title_cn: 全球企业所得税竞争、知识溢出与增长
records.abstract_en: Using a two-country model of endogenous growth with international knowledge spillovers, this study analyzes the welfare consequences of global corporate income tax competition. Although the Nash equilibrium tax rate can be excessively high or low according to the degree of spillover, this does not lead to significant welfare losses. The key to this outcome is that corporate income tax competition for growth maximization, which we consider hypothetically, attains the maximum growth rate despite complex externalities and strategic interactions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用一个具有国际知识溢出的两国内生增长模型，分析了全球企业所得税竞争的福利后果。尽管根据溢出程度，纳什均衡税率可能过高或过低，但这并不会导致显著的福利损失。这一结果的关键在于，我们假设性地考虑的以增长最大化为目标的企业所得税竞争，尽管存在复杂的外部性和战略互动，仍能达到最大增长率。

records.title_en: How has Brexit changed EU–UK trade flows?
records.title_cn: 英国脱欧如何改变了欧盟与英国之间的贸易流动？
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates how Brexit has affected goods trade between the United Kingdom and European Union. Using product-level trade flows between the EU and all other countries in the world as a comparison group, we find a sharp decline in trade from the UK to the EU and significant but smaller reductions in trade from the EU to the UK. However, when we estimate the size of the Brexit impact on trade using UK data and UK global trade as a benchmark, we find strikingly different results. We identify two key sources of this discrepancy. First, the UK’s global exports grew relatively slowly. We argue these are not suitable as a no-Brexit counterfactual. Second, Brexit also led to breaks in the measurement of trade flows, particularly for the EU imports data. To resolve these issues, we combine UK-reported data for its trade with EU and EU data for its trade with the rest of the world to use as the appropriate benchmark for comparison. This generates an estimate that Brexit reduced trade by close to 20% in both directions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估算了英国脱欧如何影响英国与欧盟之间的商品贸易。使用欧盟与世界所有其他国家之间的产品级贸易流动作为对照组，我们发现从英国到欧盟的贸易急剧下降，而从欧盟到英国的贸易也显著但较小幅度地减少。然而，当我们使用英国数据和英国全球贸易作为基准来估算脱欧对贸易的影响规模时，我们发现结果截然不同。我们识别出这种差异的两个关键来源。首先，英国的全球出口增长相对缓慢。我们认为这些不适合作为无脱欧的反事实。其次，脱欧还导致了贸易流动测量的中断，特别是欧盟进口数据。为解决这些问题，我们将英国报告的其与欧盟的贸易数据与欧盟与世界其他地区的贸易数据结合起来，作为适当的比较基准。这产生了一个估计，即脱欧使双向贸易减少了接近20%。

records.title_en: Norm violations and behavioral spillovers—Evidence from the lab and the field
records.title_cn: 规范违反与行为溢出——来自实验室和田野的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the contagion effects of norm-violating behavior across decision situations. Through a series of laboratory and field experiments, we empirically establish the conditions under which norm-breaking behavior in one decision situation leads individuals who observe this to violate norms in other, distinct decision situations. Our laboratory findings show that these spillover effects are more pronounced when the norms underlying the decision situations are perceived to be similar. However, spillovers can also affect decision situations governed by relatively dissimilar norms if the observers of norm violations have had the opportunity to first violate the same norm as the observed violator themselves. In an accompanying field experiment, we underscore the economic importance of norm similarity for spillover effects. When workers are exposed to information about celebrities evading taxes, they exhibit significantly higher rates of workplace theft than those in the control group, yet this exposure does not negatively affect work morale.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了规范违反行为在决策情境间的传染效应。通过一系列实验室和田野实验，我们实证确定了在何种条件下，一种决策情境中的规范破坏行为会导致观察到该行为的个体在其他不同决策情境中违反规范。我们的实验室发现表明，当决策情境所依据的规范被认为相似时，这些溢出效应更为显著。然而，如果规范违反的观察者自己有机会首先违反与观察到的违规者相同的规范，溢出效应也可能影响由相对不相似规范支配的决策情境。在一项配套的田野实验中，我们强调了规范相似性对溢出效应的经济重要性。当工人接触到名人逃税的信息时，他们表现出比对照组显著更高的工作场所盗窃率，但这种接触并未对工作士气产生负面影响。

records.title_en: The inelastic demand for affirmative action
records.title_cn: 平权行动的非弹性需求
records.abstract_en: We study the role of financial incentives in driving support for affirmative action (AA) in a series of online experiments. Participants act as employers deciding whether to use AA in hiring. We implement three treatments to disentangle AA preferences stemming from perceived gender differences in productivity, perceived effects of AA on productivity, or other costs of AA for employers. Around 1/3 of employers consistently implement AA, and we do not find any significant difference across treatments, despite successfully altering beliefs about productivity differences. Our results suggest that AA choice reflects a more intrinsic and inelastic preference for advancing female candidates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一系列在线实验中研究了财务激励在推动支持平权行动（AA）中的作用。参与者扮演雇主，决定是否在招聘中使用平权行动。我们实施了三种处理方式，以区分源于感知到的性别生产力差异、感知到的平权行动对生产力的影响，或平权行动对雇主的其他成本的平权行动偏好。大约有1/3的雇主始终实施平权行动，尽管我们成功改变了关于生产力差异的信念，但在不同处理方式之间我们没有发现任何显著差异。我们的结果表明，平权行动的选择反映了推进女性候选人方面更为内在和非弹性的偏好。

records.title_en: Addressing vaccine hesitancy using local ambassadors: A randomized controlled trial in Indonesia
records.title_cn: 利用本地大使解决疫苗犹豫问题：印度尼西亚的一项随机对照试验
records.abstract_en: In settings where resistance and rampant misinformation against vaccines exist, the prospect of containing infectious diseases remains a challenge. Can delivery of information regarding the benefits of vaccination through personal home visits by local ambassadors increase vaccine uptake? We conduct a door-to-door randomized information campaign targeted towards COVID-19 unvaccinated individuals in rural Indonesia. We recruited ambassadors from local villages tasked to deliver information about COVID-19 vaccines and promote vaccination through one-on-one meetings, using an interpersonal behavioral change communication approach. To investigate which type of ambassador – health cadres, influential individuals, and laypersons – is the most effective, we randomly vary the type of ambassador that delivers the information at the village level. We find that the overall vaccination take-up is quite moderate and that there are no differences in vaccination outcomes across the treatment groups. These results highlight the challenge of boosting vaccine uptake in late stages of a pandemic.
records.abstract_cn: 在存在对疫苗的抵制和猖獗的错误信息的环境中，控制传染病的希望仍然是一个挑战。通过当地大使的个人家访传递有关疫苗接种益处的信息能否提高疫苗接种率？我们在印度尼西亚农村地区针对未接种COVID-19疫苗的个体开展了一项挨家挨户的随机信息宣传活动。我们从当地村庄招募大使，负责通过一对一会议传递有关COVID-19疫苗的信息并促进疫苗接种，采用人际行为改变沟通方法。为了调查哪种类型的大使——卫生干部、有影响力的人士和普通民众——最有效，我们在村庄层面随机改变传递信息的大使类型。我们发现总体疫苗接种接受度相当温和，且各治疗组之间的疫苗接种结果没有差异。这些结果凸显了在大流行后期提高疫苗接种率的挑战。

records.title_en: Does one (unconventional) size fit all? Effects of the ECB’s unconventional monetary policies on the euro area economies
records.title_cn: 一种（非常规）规模是否适用于所有情况？欧洲央行非常规货币政策对欧元区经济的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper assesses the macroeconomic impact of ECB’s unconventional monetary policies (UMPs) in the euro area. We show that: (i) the relevance of the transmission channels has changed over time, with portfolio re-balancing becoming more important than the signalling effect after June 2014; (ii) there exists a substantial heterogeneity in the transmission to core and peripheral economies. By leveraging on these findings, we identify UMP shocks in a time-varying SVAR with “dynamic” restrictions and we quantify the macroeconomic impact of ECB’s measures via counterfactual analyses. We find that, absent those measures between 2014 and 2018, output growth would be on average 0.27 pp lower in peripheral countries, whereas inflation would drop on average by 0.2 pp in core economies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了欧洲央行非常规货币政策（UMPs）对欧元区的宏观经济影响。我们表明：（i）传导渠道的相关性随时间发生了变化，投资组合再平衡在2014年六月后变得比信号效应更为重要；（ii）核心经济体和外围经济体的传导存在显著异质性。基于这些发现，我们在具有“动态”限制的时变SVAR中识别UMP冲击，并通过反事实分析量化欧洲央行措施的宏观经济影响。我们发现，在2014年至2018年间，若没有这些措施，外围国家的产出增长平均将低0.27个百分点，而核心经济体的通胀平均将下降0.2个百分点。

records.title_en: Fiscal policy volatility and capital misallocation: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 财政政策波动性与资本错配：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how domestic policy uncertainty stemming from discretionary fiscal policy disrupts efficient capital allocation across firms. While fiscal policy represents the government’s reaction to economic conditions, its volatility presents firms with considerable uncertainty about conditions affecting their future profitability and consequently disrupts decisions about investment in the presence of capital adjustment costs. Using firm-level data from Chinese manufacturing industries spanning from 1998 to 2007, we find that reducing fiscal policy volatility leads to a decrease in the dispersion of the marginal revenue product of capital, accounting for 8.3 percent of the observed improvement in capital allocation during the sample period. In addition to various fiscal reforms to curb fiscal policy volatility directly, policies contributing to lower capital adjustment costs and lower reliance of firms on government expenditure can alleviate the adverse effects of fiscal policy volatility.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了由自由裁量财政政策引发的国内政策不确定性如何扰乱企业间的有效资本配置。虽然财政政策代表了政府对经济状况的反应，但其波动性给企业带来了关于影响其未来盈利能力的条件的相当大的不确定性，从而在存在资本调整成本的情况下扰乱了投资决策。利用1998年至2007年中国制造业企业的数据，我们发现降低财政政策波动性会导致资本边际收益产品离散程度的下降，这占样本期间观察到的资本配置改善的8.3%。除了直接抑制财政政策波动的各种财政改革外，有助于降低资本调整成本和减少企业对政府支出依赖的政策可以减轻财政政策波动的不利影响。

records.title_en: Evaluating the yield curve effects of central bank asset purchases under a forward-looking supply factor
records.title_cn: 前瞻性供给因子下央行资产购买收益率曲线效应的评估
records.abstract_en: The theoretical literature on term structure models emphasizes the importance of the expected absorption of duration risk during the residual life of term bonds in order to understand the yield curve effect of central banks’ government bond purchases. Motivated by this, we develop a forward-looking, long-horizon measure of euro area government bond supply net of Eurosystem holdings, and use it to estimate the impact of the ECB’s asset purchase programs in the context of a no-arbitrage affine term structure model. We find that an asset purchase shock equivalent to 10% of euro area GDP lowers the 10-year average yield of the euro area big-four by 59 basis points (bp) and the associated term premium by 50 bp. Applying the model to the risk-free (OIS) yield curve, the same shock lowers the 10-year rate and term premium by 35 and 26 bp, respectively.
records.abstract_cn: 期限结构模型的理论文献强调，在理解央行政府债券购买的收益率曲线效应时，预期吸收定期债券剩余存续期内久期风险的重要性。受此启发，我们开发了一个前瞻性的、长期视野的欧元区政府债券供给（扣除欧元体系持有）指标，并将其用于在无套利仿射期限结构模型背景下估计欧洲央行资产购买计划的影响。我们发现，相当于欧元区GDP的10%的资产购买冲击会使欧元区四大经济体的10年期平均收益率下降59个基点（bp），相关期限溢价下降50个基点。将该模型应用于无风险（OIS）收益率曲线，同样的冲击会使10年期利率和期限溢价分别下降35和26个基点。

records.title_en: Inequality and the Industrial Revolution
records.title_cn: 不平等与工业革命
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a new theory for why income inequality can be conducive to early industrial development. Technological advances in agriculture and population growth increase land rents relative to wages and as the landed elites become richer, demand for manufactured goods increases, which in turn facilitates industrialization. Using data for Britain over the period 1270–1940, we show that increasing inequality was a major contributor to the expansion of the manufacturing sector. Taking into account the more well-known drivers of modern growth, we find that inequality is a major contributor to the British Industrial Revolution, alongside foreign trade, education, technological knowledge and, to some extent, institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提出了一个新的理论，解释为什么收入不平等可能有利于早期工业发展。农业技术进步和人口增长提高了相对于工资的地租，随着土地精英变得更加富有，对制成品的需求增加，这反过来促进了工业化。利用英国1270-1940年间的数据，我们表明不平等程度的加剧是制造业扩张的主要贡献因素。考虑到现代增长更为知名的驱动因素，我们发现不平等是英国工业革命的主要贡献者，与对外贸易、教育、技术知识以及在某种程度上制度因素并列。

records.title_en: Wage and employment cyclicalities at the establishment level
records.title_cn: 企业层面的工资与就业周期性
records.abstract_en: Although the quantitative relationship between employment cyclicality and wage cyclicality is central for the dynamics of macroeconomic models, there is little empirical evidence on this topic. We use the German AWFP dataset to document that wage cyclicalities are very heterogeneous across establishments. Based on this heterogeneity, we estimate the relationship between employment cyclicality and wage cyclicality at the establishment level. We use this micro-estimate as a calibration target for a macro labor market flow model with heterogeneous wage dynamics that nests the standard search and matching model. Based on this micro-macro linkage, we provide a new quantitative benchmark for the role of wage rigidity in search and matching models. Furthermore, we show that acyclical and countercyclical wage establishments are key drivers for stronger labor market reactions in recessions than in booms.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管就业周期性与工资周期性之间的数量关系对于宏观经济模型的动态至关重要，但关于这一主题的经验证据却很少。我们使用德国AWFP数据集来记录工资周期性在企业间的异质性。基于这种异质性，我们估计了企业层面就业周期性与工资周期性之间的关系。我们将这一微观估计作为具有异质性工资动态的宏观劳动力市场流动模型的校准目标，该模型嵌套了标准搜寻与匹配模型。基于这种微观-宏观联系，我们为搜寻与匹配模型中工资刚性的作用提供了新的定量基准。此外，我们表明，非周期性和逆周期性的工资企业是衰退时期劳动力市场反应强于繁荣时期的关键驱动因素。

records.title_en: Identifying the transmission channels of credit supply shocks to household debt: Price and non-price effects
records.title_cn: 识别信贷供给冲击对家庭债务的传导渠道：价格与非价格效应
records.abstract_en: Using UK matched microdata, I show that credit supply shocks affect mortgage debt via two channels: one that operates through price conditions in credit markets; and another that operates through non-price credit conditions and affects the quantity of credit supplied by lenders. I find substantial heterogeneity in the different channels by household characteristics. Lower-income households and first-time buyers are especially sensitive to changes in the supply of riskier lending. Home-owners, higher-income households and older borrowers increase debt following shocks to either type of credit conditions, with loosening in mortgage spreads, maximum LTI limits and loan approvals being strongly correlated with their borrowing levels. In aggregate, household leverage responds more strongly to supply shocks that change the quantity of credit, as they affect households across the distribution, both at the intensive and at the extensive margin. But a loosening in price and non-price credit conditions simultaneously or a contraction in multiple price indicators at a time can also fuel rapid credit growth.
records.abstract_cn: 利用英国匹配的微观数据，我表明信贷供给冲击通过两个渠道影响抵押贷款债务：一个通过信贷市场的价格条件起作用；另一个通过非价格信贷条件起作用，并影响贷款人提供的信贷数量。我发现不同渠道在家庭特征上存在显著的异质性。低收入家庭和首次购房者对风险贷款供给的变化尤为敏感。房主、高收入家庭和年长借款人在任何一种信贷条件冲击后都会增加债务，抵押贷款利差、最大贷款收入比限制和贷款审批的放松与其借款水平密切相关。总体而言，家庭杠杆对改变信贷数量的供给冲击反应更强，因为这些冲击影响分布中的各个家庭，既在集约边际也在广延边际上。但价格和非价格信贷条件同时放松，或多个价格指标同时收缩，也可能助长快速的信贷增长。

records.title_en: Lognormal (re)distribution: A macrofounded theory of inequality
records.title_cn: 对数正态（再）分配：不平等的一个宏观基础理论
records.abstract_en: We study how political competition over redistribution determines income inequality under one macrofounded premise: the income distribution is approximately log-normal before and after any policy intervention. The unique equilibrium features substantial income inequality and less than maximal redistribution, even if the voters’ median income is very low. Fitting our model to the US economy, we argue that either the efficiency cost of redistribution is higher than estimates in the literature, or else US’s redistributive policies are optimal for an agent richer than the median voter.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究在一条宏观基础前提下的政治竞争如何决定收入不平等：在任何政策干预前后，收入分配近似于对数正态分布。即使选民的中位收入非常低，唯一均衡也呈现出显著的收入不平等和低于最大化的再分配。将我们的模型拟合到美国经济，我们认为，要么再分配的效率成本高于文献中的估计，要么美国的再分配政策对于一个比中位选民更富有的主体而言是最优的。

records.title_en: Capital controls and the global financial cycle
records.title_cn: 资本管制与全球金融周期
records.abstract_en: Capital flows into emerging markets are volatile and risky, which sparked interest in active capital flow management. We first revisit the use of capital controls and discover a new stylized fact: emerging markets, which actively revaluate their capital flow restrictions, increase capital inflow controls during episodes of major international financial distress when investors are very risk averse and markets volatile. We then explore this finding theoretically. We argue that heightened international financial volatility and investor risk aversion incentivize regulators to reduce the amount of risky emerging market debt to cope with elevated risk premiums. This rationale can be decentralized via capital inflow restrictions during periods of major financial distress, consistent with the empirical findings. The paper hence provides an alternative to the familiar macroprudential motivation for capital controls.
records.abstract_cn: 流入新兴市场的资本波动大且风险高，这激发了人们对主动资本流动管理的兴趣。我们首先重新审视资本管制的使用，并发现一个新的典型事实：在重大国际金融困境时期，当投资者风险规避程度很高且市场波动剧烈时，积极重新评估其资本流动限制的新兴市场会增加资本流入管制。然后我们从理论上探讨这一发现。我们认为，国际金融波动加剧和投资者风险规避增强，会激励监管机构减少风险较高的新兴市场债务，以应对升高的风险溢价。这一理由可以通过在重大金融困境时期实施资本流入限制来实现分散化，这与实证发现一致。因此，本文为资本管制的常见宏观审慎动机提供了一种替代解释。

records.title_en: Social norms, political polarization, and vaccination attitudes: Evidence from a survey experiment in Turkey
records.title_cn: 社会规范、政治极化与疫苗接种态度：来自土耳其调查实验的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines vaccination as a descriptive social norm in the context of the Covid-19 pandemic. Using a large-scale survey experiment in Turkey, we first elicit respondents’ vaccination attitudes and show that political affiliation is a strong predictor of it. We then use economic games to measure the extent of outgroup discrimination induced by respondents’ attitudes towards vaccination. We find that while both pro- and anti-vaxxers discriminate against each other substantially, the pro-vaxxers discriminate more than the anti-vaxxers do. This polarization intensifies when pro- and anti-vaxxers perceive a political difference between them. Using randomized informational treatments, we show that a reminder or priming of external threats, appealing to a broadly shared social identity, might mitigate such outgroup discrimination.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在Covid-19大流行的背景下，将疫苗接种视为一种描述性社会规范进行研究。通过在土耳其进行的大规模调查实验，我们首先获取受访者的疫苗接种态度，并表明政治归属是其强有力的预测因素。随后，我们使用经济博弈来衡量受访者因疫苗接种态度而产生的对外群体歧视程度。我们发现，虽然支持疫苗者和反对疫苗者都相互歧视，但支持疫苗者的歧视程度高于反对疫苗者。当支持疫苗者和反对疫苗者感知到彼此存在政治差异时，这种极化会加剧。通过随机化信息干预，我们表明，提醒或启动外部威胁，并诉诸于广泛共享的社会认同，可能有助于缓解这种对外群体的歧视。

records.title_en: Macroeconomic effects of carbon transition policies: An assessment based on the ECB’s New Area-Wide Model with a disaggregated energy sector
records.title_cn: 碳转型政策的宏观经济效应：基于欧洲央行新版区域模型及能源部门细分的评估
records.abstract_en: We assess the macroeconomic effects of carbon transition policies aimed at mitigating climate change in the euro area. To this end, we augment the ECB’s New Area-Wide Model (NAWM) with a framework of disaggregated energy production and use, which distinguishes between “dirty” and “clean” energy. Our central transition policy is that of a permanent increase in carbon taxes, which are levied as a surcharge on the price of dirty energy, combined with a price-preserving fall in fossil resource supply. Our findings suggest that increasing carbon taxes to an interim target level consistent with the transition to a net-zero economy entails a transitory rise in inflation and a lasting, albeit moderate decline in GDP. We show that the short and medium-term effects depend on the monetary policy reaction, the path of the carbon tax increase and its credibility, while expanding clean energy supply is key for containing the decline in GDP. Undesirable distributional effects can be addressed by appropriately redistributing the fiscal revenues from the carbon tax increase across households.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了旨在缓解欧元区气候变化的碳转型政策的宏观经济效应。为此，我们在欧洲央行新版区域模型（NAWM）中加入了能源生产与使用的细分框架，该框架区分了“肮脏”能源和“清洁”能源。我们的核心转型政策是永久性提高碳税，即对肮脏能源价格征收附加费，同时化石资源供应以保持价格的方式下降。我们的研究结果表明，将碳税提高至与向净零经济转型相一致的临时目标水平，会导致通胀暂时上升，以及GDP持久但温和的下降。我们表明，短期和中期效应取决于货币政策反应、碳税提高的路径及其可信度，而扩大清洁能源供应是遏制GDP下降的关键。不良的分配效应可以通过适当重新分配碳税增加的财政收入给各家庭来解决。

records.title_en: Regulation and the demand for credit default swaps in experimental bond markets
records.title_cn: 监管与实验债券市场中信用违约互换的需求
records.abstract_en: Credit default swaps (CDS) played an important role in the financial crisis of 2008 leading to calls for regulation. Here, we seek to understand the impact of a CDS regulation that restricts the possibility to hold naked CDS. We use a controlled laboratory experiment analyzing CDS pricing in a bond market subject to default risk. Our results show that the regulation achieves the goal of increasing the use of CDS for hedging purposes while reducing the use of CDS for speculation. This success does not come at the expense of lower initial public offering (IPO) prices for the bonds or worse pricing of bonds or CDS in the secondary market.
records.abstract_cn: 信用违约互换（CDS）在2008年金融危机中扮演了重要角色，引发了监管呼吁。在此，我们试图理解一项限制持有裸CDS可能性的CDS监管的影响。我们使用一个受控实验室实验，分析在面临违约风险的债券市场中CDS的定价。我们的结果表明，该监管实现了增加CDS用于对冲目的的使用，同时减少CDS用于投机目的的目标。这一成功并非以降低债券的首次公开发行（IPO）价格或二级市场中债券或CDS的定价为代价。

records.title_en: How far from full employment? The European unemployment problem revisited
records.title_cn: 距离充分就业还有多远？欧洲失业问题再探讨
records.abstract_en: This paper analyses deviations from full employment in EU countries, compared with the US and the UK. We apply the Beveridge (full-employment-consistent) rate of unemployment (BECRU), derived from the unemployment-vacancies relationship. The BECRU is the unemployment rate that minimises the non-productive use of labour. Based on a novel dataset over 1970–2022, we find full employment episodes in selected EU countries (Germany, Sweden, Austria, Finland) during the 1970s. The European unemployment problem emerged in the 1980s and 1990s, as Beveridgean full employment gaps increased. In the run-up to the global financial crisis, full employment gaps declined, then increased during the Great Recession. Slack in labour markets initially increased during the pandemic. Labour markets became tighter when recovering from the COVID-19 crisis, but few countries hit full employment. We show that Beveridgean full employment gaps are informative in predicting the share of young people who are unemployed and not receiving education or vocational training.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了欧盟国家与美国和英国相比偏离充分就业的情况。我们应用了从失业-职位空缺关系中推导出的贝弗里奇（充分就业一致）失业率（BECRU）。BECRU是使劳动的非生产性使用最小化的失业率。基于1970-2022年的新数据集，我们发现选定的欧盟国家（德国、瑞典、奥地利、芬兰）在1970年代存在充分就业时期。欧洲失业问题出现在1980年代和1990年代，当时贝弗里奇充分就业缺口扩大。在全球金融危机前夕，充分就业缺口缩小，随后在大衰退期间扩大。疫情期间劳动力市场闲置最初增加。从COVID-19危机中复苏时，劳动力市场趋紧，但很少有国家达到充分就业。我们表明，贝弗里奇充分就业缺口在预测未就业且未接受教育或职业培训的年轻人比例方面具有信息价值。

records.title_en: The dynamics of importer–exporter connections
records.title_cn: 进口商-出口商联系的动态
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the dynamics of importer–exporter connections when importers source inputs from multiple exporters. I first develop a trade model in which heterogeneous importers invest in expanding the set of potential exporters they know and from which they can source. The model delivers three novel predictions. The lower the degree of substitutability among final goods and the higher the degree of substitutability among inputs of an importer: (i) the lower the growth rate in importer’s connections, (ii) the more likely are connections to be discontinued, and (iii) the lower the trade value growth per surviving connection. I then provide evidence in favor of these predictions by using customs transaction data from Colombia. Finally, I show that the mechanism unveiled in this paper matters for the heterogeneity of the trade adjustment to macroeconomic shocks across sectors.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当进口商从多个出口商处采购投入品时，进口商-出口商联系的动态。我首先构建了一个贸易模型，其中异质性进口商投资于扩大他们认识并可以从中采购的潜在出口商集合。该模型得出了三个新颖的预测。最终产品之间的替代程度越低，进口商投入品之间的替代程度越高：（i）进口商联系增长率越低，（ii）联系越可能被中断，以及（iii）每个存续联系的贸易价值增长率越低。然后，我利用哥伦比亚的海关交易数据为这些预测提供了证据。最后，我表明本文揭示的机制对于宏观经济冲击下各部门贸易调整的异质性具有重要意义。

records.title_en: Work from home and the racial gap in female wages
records.title_cn: 居家办公与女性工资的种族差距
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the racial female wage penalty to remote work in the U.S. Instrumental variable estimates yield wage penalties that reach 66.3 % for black women and 33.9 % for white women when hours worked at home increase to 5 per week. Promotion bias, task reassignment and lack of productive social interaction are the most likely mechanisms for the wage losses. The estimates provide rare evidence on the costs of physical distancing due to work from home, particularly for women of different races managing the needs of their sick children.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了美国远程工作对女性工资的种族惩罚。工具变量估计显示，当每周居家工作时间增加到5小时时，黑人女性的工资惩罚达到66.3%，白人女性为33.9%。晋升偏见、任务重新分配和缺乏富有成效的社交互动是工资损失最可能的机制。这些估计为因居家办公而造成的身体距离成本提供了罕见的证据，特别是对于管理生病孩子需求的不同种族的女性而言。

records.title_en: Trade liberalization versus protectionism: Dynamic welfare asymmetries
records.title_cn: 贸易自由化与保护主义：动态福利不对称性
records.abstract_en: We investigate whether the losses from an increase in trade costs (protectionism) are equal to the gains from a symmetric decrease in trade costs (liberalization). We incorporate dynamics through capital accumulation into a multicountry trade model and show that the welfare changes are asymmetric: Losses from protectionism are smaller than the gains from liberalization. In contrast, standard static trade models imply that the losses equal the gains. The intuition for asymmetry in our model is that, following protectionism, the economy can coast on its previously accumulated capital stock, so higher trade costs do not imply large losses immediately. We develop an accounting device to decompose the source of welfare asymmetries into three time-varying contributions: share of income allocated to consumption, measured productivity, and capital stock. Asymmetry in capital accumulation is the largest contributing factor, and measured productivity is the smallest.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了贸易成本增加（保护主义）带来的损失是否等于贸易成本对称减少（自由化）带来的收益。我们通过资本积累将动态因素纳入多国贸易模型，并表明福利变化是不对称的：保护主义带来的损失小于自由化带来的收益。相比之下，标准静态贸易模型意味着损失等于收益。我们模型中不对称性的直觉是，在保护主义之后，经济可以依靠先前积累的资本存量继续运行，因此更高的贸易成本不会立即导致巨大损失。我们开发了一种核算工具，将福利不对称性的来源分解为三个时变贡献：收入中用于消费的份额、测度生产率和资本存量。资本积累的不对称性是最大的贡献因素，而测度生产率是最小的。

records.title_en: Understanding climate damages: Consumption versus investment
records.title_cn: 理解气候损害：消费与投资
