records.abstract_en: This study explores how rising economic costs of climate mitigation policies differentially shape climate policy support among the political left and right. To this end, we randomly manipulate how much consumption costs increase as a result of four different climate mitigation policies and study how different cost scenarios influence policy support among a sample of 1,597 Swedish adults. We find that more costly climate policies induce greater climate policy polarization, since right-leaning participants display both lower baseline and more cost-sensitive climate policy support. In addition, we investigate how policy costs affect participants’ concerns about the climatic consequences of consumption. While inconclusive, the results indicate that right-leaning participants, in some instances, display less concern about the climatic consequences of consumption when policy costs rise. This pattern can be understood through the lens of motivated disbelief, which holds that people adjust their beliefs in order to support their preferred actions. The present study provides novel insights as to how and when material conditions influence climate policy preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了气候减缓政策的经济成本上升如何在不同政治立场的人群中差异化地影响气候政策支持。为此，我们随机操纵了四种不同气候减缓政策导致的消费成本增加幅度，并研究了不同成本情景如何影响一项包含1,597名瑞典成年人的样本中的政策支持。我们发现，成本更高的气候政策会加剧气候政策的两极分化，因为右倾参与者的基线支持率较低，且其支持对成本更为敏感。此外，我们调查了政策成本如何影响参与者对消费气候后果的担忧。尽管结果不确定，但表明在某些情况下，当政策成本上升时，右倾参与者对消费气候后果的担忧较少。这一模式可以通过动机性否认的视角来理解，即人们调整自己的信念以支持其偏好的行为。本研究为物质条件如何以及何时影响气候政策偏好提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Consequences of ecological aggregation in general equilibrium analysis of perturbed ecosystems
records.title_cn: 扰动生态系统一般均衡分析中生态聚合的后果
records.abstract_en: A computable general equilibrium (CGE) model is linked with a spatially explicit model of the Lake Michigan ecosystem to assess welfare impacts of the current threat of Bigheaded carp, a non-indigenous aquatic invasive species (AIS) projected to have spatially explicit and species-specific impacts on the ecosystem. Disaggregating to model spatial decisions and spatially explicit species compositions in general equilibrium frameworks comes at a cost of additional complexity and data requirements. Whether these investments are worth the effort over extant ecological aggregations is the focus of this analysis, as typical methods consider spaceless aggregations across locations and aggregate over species. Here, the implications of aggregating over space and/or species are quantified. Results signal welfare losses from the bigheaded carp invasion, and that aggregating over one/both dimensions may miss important bioeconomic tradeoffs especially with respect to species.
records.abstract_cn: 一个可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型与密歇根湖生态系统的空间显式模型相连接，以评估当前大头鲤（一种非本地水生入侵物种（AIS））威胁的福利影响，该物种预计会对生态系统产生空间显式和物种特异性的影响。在一般均衡框架中分解以模拟空间决策和空间显式物种组成，会带来额外的复杂性和数据需求的成本。这些投资相对于现有的生态聚合是否值得，是本分析的重点，因为典型方法考虑跨地点的无空间聚合和跨物种的聚合。在此，量化了跨空间和/或物种聚合的含义。结果表明，大头鲤入侵造成福利损失，并且在一个或两个维度上的聚合可能会遗漏重要的生物经济权衡，尤其是在物种方面。

records.title_en: Reviewing studies of degrowth: Are claims matched by data, methods and policy analysis?
records.title_cn: 去增长研究综述：主张是否与数据、方法和政策分析相匹配？
records.abstract_en: In the last decade many publications have appeared on degrowth as a strategy to confront environmental and social problems. We undertake a systematic review of their content, data and methods. This involves the use of computational linguistics to identify main topics investigated. Based on a sample of 561 studies we conclude that: (1) content covers 11 main topics; (2) the large majority (almost 90%) of studies are opinions rather than analysis; (3) few studies use quantitative or qualitative data, and even fewer ones use formal modelling; (4) the first and second type tend to include small samples or focus on non-representative cases; (5) most studies offer ad hoc and subjective policy advice, lacking policy evaluation and integration with insights from the literature on environmental/climate policies; (6) of the few studies on public support, a majority concludes that degrowth strategies and policies are socially-politically infeasible; (7) various studies represent a “reverse causality” confusion, i.e. use the term degrowth not for a deliberate strategy but to denote economic decline (in GDP terms) resulting from exogenous factors or public policies; (8) few studies adopt a system-wide perspective – instead most focus on small, local cases without a clear implication for the economy as a whole. We illustrate each of these findings for concrete studies.
records.abstract_cn: 在过去十年中，许多关于去增长作为应对环境和社会问题策略的出版物相继出现。我们对其内容、数据和方法进行了系统性回顾。这涉及使用计算语言学来识别研究的主要主题。基于561项研究的样本，我们得出结论：（1）内容涵盖11个主要主题；（2）绝大多数（几乎90%）研究是观点而非分析；（3）很少有研究使用定量或定性数据，使用正式建模的更是少之又少；（4）第一类和第二类研究往往包含小样本或聚焦于非代表性案例；（5）大多数研究提供临时和主观的政策建议，缺乏政策评估以及与环境和气候政策文献见解的整合；（6）在少数关于公众支持的研究中，大多数结论是去增长战略和政策在社会政治层面不可行；（7）各种研究存在“反向因果”混淆，即使用去增长一词并非指有意的战略，而是指由外生因素或公共政策导致的经济衰退（以GDP衡量）；（8）很少有研究采用系统-wide视角——相反，大多数研究聚焦于小型地方案例，对整体经济没有明确影响。我们针对具体研究逐一说明了这些发现。

records.title_en: The nonlinear dependence of income inequality and carbon emissions: Potentials for a sustainable future
records.title_cn: 收入不平等与碳排放的非线性依赖：可持续未来的潜力
records.abstract_en: Understanding the interconnected nature of rising carbon emissions and income inequality is crucial to achieve social and ecological sustainability. We contribute to the literature with a systematic analysis of the conditional interdependence by means of a distributional copula model. The model estimates the nonlinear dependence between a country’s GINI coefficient and CO2 emissions across and within country income groups. This enables us to uncover complex interdependencies that standard linear regression techniques might hide. Using an unbalanced panel data set of 109 countries from 1960 to 2019, composed of different data sets, we show that dependence is related to the prevailing consumption level, energy sources, the structure of the economy and the political system with heterogeneous effects across country income groups. To estimate the potentials for a sustainable future, we define thresholds of potential social and environmental sustainability. We find that richer countries are furthest away from this, but have the highest potential for realizing the defined sustainable space. This further highlights the importance of the service sector and combined policies targeting social and environmental sustainability.
records.abstract_cn: 理解碳排放上升与收入不平等之间的相互关联性对于实现社会与生态可持续性至关重要。我们通过分布copula模型对条件相互依赖性进行系统分析，为文献做出贡献。该模型估计了一个国家的基尼系数与二氧化碳排放之间在不同国家收入组别内及跨组别的非线性依赖关系。这使我们能够揭示标准线性回归技术可能隐藏的复杂相互依赖性。使用由不同数据集组成的1960年至2019年109个国家的非平衡面板数据集，我们表明这种依赖性与主流消费水平、能源来源、经济结构和政治制度相关，且在不同收入组别国家中具有异质性效应。为了估计可持续未来的潜力，我们定义了潜在社会与环境可持续性的阈值。我们发现较富裕国家离此阈值最远，但实现所定义可持续空间的可能性最高。这进一步凸显了服务业以及针对社会与环境可持续性的综合政策的重要性。

records.title_en: The effect of inflation on CO2 emissions: An analysis over the period 1970–2020
records.title_cn: 通货膨胀对二氧化碳排放的影响：基于1970-2020年期间的分析
records.abstract_en: Does inflation affect CO2 emissions? Surprisingly, this crucial relationship has not benefited from enough academic attention. As a result, we fill this knowledge gap and examine conceptually and empirically the effect of inflation on CO2 emissions over a large sample of countries (N = 189) and a 50-year period (1970–2020). More precisely, we run fixed effects regressions and panel cointegration tests. We find a modest, but significant negative relationship between core inflation and CO2 emissions per capita. The effect is also present for total CO2 emissions. Nevertheless, this effect is too weak to reach recommended CO2 emission reductions. Ceteris paribus, a 10-percentage points increase of core inflation over a 5-year span leads, on average, to a reduction of CO2 emissions per capita by roughly 0.36. This implies that other policies are needed.
records.abstract_cn: 通货膨胀是否影响二氧化碳排放？令人惊讶的是，这一关键关系并未得到学术界足够的关注。因此，我们填补了这一知识空白，并在一个包含189个国家的大样本和50年（1970-2020年）期间，从概念上和实证上考察了通货膨胀对二氧化碳排放的影响。更具体地说，我们进行了固定效应回归和面板协整检验。我们发现核心通货膨胀与人均二氧化碳排放之间存在适度但显著的负相关关系。这种效应也存在于二氧化碳总排放量中。然而，这种效应太弱，无法达到建议的二氧化碳减排目标。在其他条件不变的情况下，核心通货膨胀在5年内上升10个百分点，平均会导致人均二氧化碳排放量减少约0.36。这意味着需要其他政策。

records.title_en: Climate change and its impact on home insurance uptake in Australia
records.title_cn: 气候变化及其对澳大利亚家庭保险购买的影响
records.abstract_en: Climate change is impacting the frequency and severity of physical risks such as wildfire, flood, cyclone and extreme precipitation. This is changing both the costs and benefits of home insurance purchase for households—leading to uncertainty about future insurance uptake rates under climate change. We use disaggregated data for Australia on the likelihood of climate hazards, and household panel data, to model the relationship between insurance uptake and exposure to climate physical risks. This model is then used to project insurance purchase out to 2100 under three climate scenarios. We find that exposure to climate risks does influence the likelihood of purchasing insurance. While for most hazards higher risk reduces the likelihood of purchase, there are exceptions, and the relationship is often complex. Projections from our model indicate that insurance coverage is likely to decline relatively modestly, by around one percentage point across Australia from 2000 to 2100 as a result of climate change. However, we find there is significant variation across regions.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化正在影响野火、洪水、气旋和极端降水等物理风险的发生频率和严重程度。这正在改变家庭购买房屋保险的成本和收益，导致气候变化下未来保险购买率的不确定性。我们使用澳大利亚关于气候灾害可能性的分类数据和家庭面板数据，来模拟保险购买与气候物理风险暴露之间的关系。然后，该模型被用于在三种气候情景下预测到2100年的保险购买情况。我们发现，气候风险的暴露确实会影响购买保险的可能性。虽然对于大多数灾害，较高的风险会降低购买的可能性，但也有例外，且这种关系往往很复杂。我们模型的预测表明，由于气候变化，从2000年到2100年，澳大利亚的保险覆盖率可能会相对温和地下降，大约下降一个百分点。然而，我们发现各地区之间存在显著差异。

records.title_en: Assessing global agri-food system exceedance of national cropland limits for linking responsible consumption and production under SDG 12
records.title_cn: 评估全球农业食品系统对国家耕地限额的超越，以促进可持续发展目标12下的负责任消费与生产
records.abstract_en: Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 12 requires countries to achieve responsible consumption and production patterns without exceeding safe environmental limits for natural resource use. This is particularly relevant to the global agri-food system, a major contributor to the exceedance of environmental limits such as cropland (a major component of the land-system change planetary boundary). However, little is known about how virtual cropland flows embedded in agri-food commodities jointly impact national consumption- and production-based environmental limits for cropland use in the context of responsible agri-food consumption and production. Using a multi-regional input-output model and cropland limits of agri-food consumption and production, we identified specific countries and commodity supply chains that contribute to the exceedance of production-based cropland limits of producer countries (both domestic and via trade), irrespective of whether their own consumption-based cropland limits are exceeded. For example, 86% of China's consumption-based cropland footprint originated from regions that exceeded their production-based cropland limits, even though China's per capita consumption footprint is within safe fair-share limits. This occurred mainly due to the consumption of domestically produced and imported commodities such as oilseeds, cereals, and fruit and vegetables. In addition, we identified patterns in international trade relationships that could inform national-level responsible agri-food consumption/production interventions across the global supply chain, thereby contributing to SDG 12. More stringent regulations and improved policies are required to reduce the exceedance of consumption-based and production-based environmental limits and avoid exceeding the global land-system change planetary boundary.
records.abstract_cn: 可持续发展目标（SDG）12要求各国在不超过自然资源利用的安全环境极限的情况下，实现负责任的消费和生产模式。这对全球农业食品系统尤为重要，该系统是耕地（土地系统变化行星边界的主要组成部分）等环境极限被超越的主要贡献者。然而，关于农业食品商品中隐含的虚拟耕地流动如何共同影响国家基于消费和基于生产的耕地利用环境极限，在负责任农业食品消费与生产的背景下，知之甚少。利用多区域投入产出模型以及农业食品消费和生产的耕地限额，我们识别了导致生产者国家（国内及通过贸易）基于生产的耕地限额被超越的具体国家和商品供应链，无论其自身基于消费的耕地限额是否被超越。例如，中国基于消费的耕地足迹中有86%来源于已超过其基于生产的耕地限额的地区，尽管中国的人均消费足迹在安全的公平份额限额之内。这主要是由于消费了国内生产和进口的商品，如油籽、谷物以及水果和蔬菜。此外，我们识别了国际贸易关系中的模式，这些模式可为全球供应链中的国家层面负责任农业食品消费/生产干预提供信息，从而有助于实现可持续发展目标12。需要更严格的法规和改进的政策，以减少基于消费和基于生产的环境极限被超越，并避免超过全球土地系统变化的行星边界。

records.title_en: Methodological choices for reflecting strong sustainability in composite indices
records.title_cn: 在综合指数中反映强可持续性的方法论选择
records.abstract_en: Composite indicators are widely used to represent sustainability or its underlying dimensions. Nonetheless, an alignment between the multiple choices made during their construction and the underlying conceptual framework is often lacking. This reduces the relevance of the composite indicator.
records.abstract_cn: 综合指标被广泛用于代表可持续性或其潜在维度。然而，在其构建过程中所做的多种选择与潜在的概念框架之间往往缺乏一致性。这降低了综合指标的相关性。

records.title_en: Ratcheting up private standards by exploiting coopetition: The curious case of RSPO’s adoption of zero-deforestation criteria
records.title_cn: 通过利用竞合提升私人标准：RSPO采纳零毁林标准的奇特案例
records.abstract_en: At its November 2018 annual meeting, the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) approved a new version of its foundational rules that advocates argued made it a zero-deforestation standard. Using a combination of over 160 key informant interviews and archival analysis, we argue that actors in the RSPO orbit made the High Carbon Stock Approach - a new method for defining forest boundaries that features heavy use of satellite data - attractive by blending cooperative and competitive strategies in a pattern known as coopetition. Critical stakeholders pushed leading companies into a competition for legitimacy that spurred innovations outside of the Roundtable setting. In turn, however, these firms also used relationships established through the RSPO Roundtable - cooperating - to elaborate guidelines and tools for defining forest areas, pursuing supply chain traceability and engaging in supplier transformation. This cooperation helped zero-deforestation strategies to emerge outside the organization. In response, stakeholders with sunk investments in RSPO membership reincorporated those external tools into the standard by framing them as consistent with the institution's fundamental logics. This case provides a compelling example of how coopetition can lead to norm emergence in a contentious governance arena, allowing a combination of internal and external actors to steer institutional development. We argue that this strategy could be employed to stimulate increased rigor in environmental standards.
records.abstract_cn: 在2018年十一月的年度会议上，可持续棕榈油圆桌倡议（RSPO）批准了其基础规则的新版本，倡导者认为这使其成为一项零毁林标准。结合超过160次关键知情人访谈和档案分析，我们认为，RSPO圈子内的行动者通过将合作与竞争策略融合为一种称为竞合的模式，使高碳储量方法——一种大量使用卫星数据来界定森林边界的新方法——变得具有吸引力。关键利益相关者将领先企业推入一场合法性竞争，这刺激了圆桌会议之外的创新。然而，这些企业也利用通过RSPO圆桌会议建立的关系——即合作——来制定界定森林区域的指南和工具，追求供应链可追溯性并参与供应商转型。这种合作帮助零毁林战略在组织外部出现。作为回应，在RSPO成员资格中有沉没投资的利益相关者将这些外部工具重新纳入标准，将其框定为与该机构的基本逻辑一致。这个案例提供了一个令人信服的例子，说明竞合如何在有争议的治理领域中导致规范的出现，允许内部和外部行动者的结合来引导制度发展。我们认为，这种策略可以用来刺激环境标准严格性的提高。

records.title_en: The value of information in water quality monitoring and management
records.title_cn: 水质监测与管理中信息的价值
records.abstract_en: Environmental managers face substantial uncertainty when deciding on management actions. To reduce this uncertainty prior to decision-making, collecting new data may help arrive at more informed decisions. Whether any resulting improvement in the decision will outweigh the cost of collecting the data, and thus make investing in the acquisition of the information worthwhile, is an intricate question. The concept of the value of information (VoI) is a convenient tool to address this problem. We use the VoI framework to analyse a decision problem in water quality management. Based on real-world monitoring data, we calculate the VoI of monitoring nitrogen, which is used as an indicator of the ecological state of water body. We find that the VoI is significant in our case and we further investigate the dependency of the VoI in a similar setting on the management cost, the assumed value of a good state and on the level of uncertainty regarding the ecological state. In addition, we observe a negative relation between the relative management cost and the prior probability that maximises VoI. These insights may help decide on information acquisition in the presence of substantial uncertainties and sparse data.
records.abstract_cn: 环境管理者在决定管理行动时面临巨大的不确定性。为了在决策前减少这种不确定性，收集新数据可能有助于做出更明智的决策。由此产生的决策改进是否能超过数据收集的成本，从而使信息获取的投资值得进行，这是一个复杂的问题。信息价值（VoI）的概念是解决这一问题的便捷工具。我们使用VoI框架分析水质管理中的一个决策问题。基于实际监测数据，我们计算了作为水体生态状态指标的氮监测的VoI。我们发现，在我们的案例中，VoI是显著的，并进一步研究了类似情境下VoI对管理成本、良好状态假定价值以及生态状态不确定性水平的依赖性。此外，我们观察到相对管理成本与使VoI最大化的先验概率之间存在负相关关系。这些见解可能有助于在存在重大不确定性和数据稀疏的情况下决定信息获取。

records.title_en: The role of norm dynamics for climate relevant behavior: A 2019–2021 panel study of red meat consumption
records.title_cn: 规范动态对气候相关行为的作用：一项关于红肉消费的2019-2021面板研究
records.abstract_en: More sustainable consumption is urgently called for but emerging very slowly at best. This paper contributes to the empirical foundation for understanding the role of norms in shaping, reinforcing, and changing consumption patterns. Drawing on institutional and social psychological theories and research, we investigate the development in normative influences on red meat consumption – a climate relevant behavior – over time. We apply cross lagged SEM analyses utilizing survey data from a representative sample of the Norwegian population the years 2019, 2020, and 2021. Red meat consumption is strongly supported by social norms in Norway but seems to be challenged by the societal attention to its negative climate impacts. Such attention may lead people to internalize norms for a climate-friendly diet and thus reduce their red-meat consumption. We find, however, that the influence of pro-climate mitigation norms on red meat consumption is weak and was further weakened in the 2020–21 period, during the Covid19 pandemic. An important question is whether and how policy measures can nurture pro-climate mitigation norms to reach a social “tipping point” regarding meat consumption. Implications for future research on norm dynamics are discussed.
records.abstract_cn: 更可持续的消费被迫切呼吁，但充其量只是缓慢出现。本文为理解规范在塑造、强化和改变消费模式中的作用提供了实证基础。借鉴制度和社会心理学理论及研究，我们调查了规范影响红肉消费——一种气候相关行为——随时间的发展变化。我们应用交叉滞后结构方程模型分析，利用挪威人口代表性样本在2019、2020和2021年的调查数据。在挪威，红肉消费受到社会规范的强烈支持，但似乎受到社会对其负面气候影响关注的挑战。这种关注可能导致人们内化气候友好饮食的规范，从而减少红肉消费。然而，我们发现，支持气候减缓的规范对红肉消费的影响较弱，并且在2020-21期间，即Covid19大流行期间，这种影响进一步减弱。一个重要的问题是，政策措施是否以及如何能够培育支持气候减缓的规范，以达到肉类消费的社会“临界点”。讨论了对未来规范动态研究的意义。

records.title_en: Climate change education through the lens of behavioral economics: A systematic review of studies on observed behavior and social norms
records.title_cn: 行为经济学视角下的气候变化教育：关于观察行为与社会规范研究的系统综述
records.abstract_en: We conduct a systematic review (SR) of the empirical literature on Climate Change Education (CCE) through the lens of behavioral economics. We focus on the effects of educational interventions on actual behaviors or beliefs regarding the prevalence or social acceptability of these behaviors. We identify 86 studies evaluating CCE interventions. Most of them employ pre-post evaluations, which are more susceptible to demand effects and social desirability bias. Almost all report positive effects in terms of pro-environmental outcomes. Only 19 studies look at the effects of CCE on actual behavior (mainly on recycling, trashing or energy saving) or norm-related beliefs. Most interventions involve activities aimed at engaging learners. Others focus on nudges (like stickers or posters). A minority is based on lectures, deliberative discussions, or science-based interactions. The SR reveals important gaps in the literature and potential tensions that can inform future research in behavioral ecological economics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过行为经济学的视角，对气候变化教育（CCE）的实证文献进行了系统综述（SR）。我们关注教育干预对实际行为或关于这些行为的普遍性或社会可接受性的信念的影响。我们识别了86项评估CCE干预的研究。其中大多数采用前后测评估，这类评估更容易受到需求效应和社会期望偏差的影响。几乎所有研究都报告了在亲环境结果方面的积极效应。只有19项研究考察了CCE对实际行为（主要是回收、丢弃垃圾或节能）或规范相关信念的影响。大多数干预涉及旨在吸引学习者的活动。其他干预侧重于助推（如贴纸或海报）。少数基于讲座、讨论式研讨或科学互动。该SR揭示了文献中的重要空白和潜在张力，可为行为生态经济学的未来研究提供信息。

records.title_en: Inequality beyond income quantiles: Distributional effects of climate mitigation policies
records.title_cn: 超越收入分位数的不平等：气候减缓政策的分配效应
records.abstract_en: It is argued that the political feasibility of climate mitigation policies depends heavily on their distributional effects. This paper therefore studies the distributional effects of the European Commission's Fit-for-55 package at the household level in seven EU countries, analyzing a carbon tax on transport and heating fuels as well as variations of a lump-sum refund. Based on the resulting income distributions, different inequality measures are computed. The paper aims to extend previous methodological approaches by including inequality measures such as the Theil index and Atkinson index and comparing the results of carbon taxes on transport and heating fuels for seven EU countries in a consistent manner. I find that a household-size specific lump-sum refund not only mitigates the negative distributional effects of a carbon tax but also reduces overall inequality compared to the baseline scenario without a tax.
records.abstract_cn: 有人认为，气候减缓政策的政治可行性在很大程度上取决于其分配效应。因此，本文研究了欧盟委员会“Fit-for-55”一揽子计划在七个欧盟国家家庭层面的分配效应，分析了针对交通和取暖燃料的碳税以及一次性退款的不同变体。基于由此产生的收入分配，计算了不同的不平等度量指标。本文旨在通过纳入泰尔指数和阿特金森指数等不平等度量，并以一致的方式比较七个欧盟国家交通和取暖燃料碳税的结果，来扩展先前的方法论方法。我发现，按家庭规模特定的一次性退款不仅减轻了碳税的负面分配效应，而且与没有税收的基准情景相比，还降低了整体不平等。

records.title_en: The impossible love of fossil fuel companies for carbon taxes
records.title_cn: 化石燃料公司对碳税的不可能之爱
records.abstract_en: Economists agree that carbon taxes are the most effective solution for climate change mitigation. But where do fossil fuel companies stand on carbon taxes? I analyse how the 100 largest oil and gas companies communicate on carbon taxes. Surprisingly, I find that 54% of companies that have a policy on carbon taxes support them (78% for the 50 largest). This is puzzling as an effective carbon tax should reduce the revenues and reserve value of fossil fuel companies. To understand this paradox, I offer non-mutually exclusive reasons why fossil fuel companies might support carbon taxes. Oil and gas companies could use a carbon tax to get rid of the competition from coal, create a level playing field and remove regulatory uncertainty. Or they think that these taxes will not affect them because demand for oil and gas is inelastic or that international coordination will fail and lead to leakages. Finally, it could be that this is simply a communication exercise. A carbon tax helps them shift the responsibility from fossil fuel companies to customers, voters and elected officials.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家一致认为碳税是减缓气候变化最有效的解决方案。但化石燃料公司对碳税持何立场？我分析了100家最大的石油和天然气公司如何就碳税进行沟通。令人惊讶的是，我发现有碳税政策的公司中，54%支持碳税（在50家最大的公司中这一比例为78%）。这令人费解，因为有效的碳税应减少化石燃料公司的收入和储备价值。为理解这一悖论，我提出了几个非互斥的原因，解释为何化石燃料公司可能支持碳税。石油和天然气公司可能利用碳税来摆脱煤炭的竞争，创造公平的竞争环境，并消除监管不确定性。或者他们认为这些税收不会影响他们，因为石油和天然气的需求缺乏弹性，或者国际协调将失败并导致泄漏。最后，这可能仅仅是一种沟通策略。碳税帮助他们将责任从化石燃料公司转移到客户、选民和民选官员身上。

records.title_en: On the inference about a willingness-to-pay distribution using contingent valuation data
records.title_cn: 关于使用条件价值评估数据推断支付意愿分布的研究
records.abstract_en: Although contingent valuation (CV) is one of the main sources of willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates of environmental goods, little guidance exists regarding parametric approaches to modeling CV data, which could reliably estimate WTP values based on preferences stated in binary choice, payment card, and open-ended questions, among others. Studies that use parametric models of WTP often select a specification from a limited set of commonly used distributions. To improve the reliability of parametric modeling of CV-based welfare estimates, we propose adopting a more flexible approach that considers a broad range of specifications with varying parametric distributions. We demonstrate the advantages of the proposed approach using data sets from two large CV studies: the eutrophication reduction valuation study for the Baltic Sea Action Plan and the Deepwater Horizon natural resource damage assessment. We find that the best parametric specifications that fit the data differ across the two case studies. Moreover, these optimal specifications do not always align with most commonly used distributions. We further observe non-negligible differences in welfare estimates across the specifications. Our results provide tentative evidence that the variation in the estimates is lower when better-fitting specifications are considered. These findings emphasize the need for cautiously identifying the distribution best fitting to the data. Focusing on the best-fitting parametric specifications, we provide alternative WTP value estimates for the two empirical cases studied.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管条件价值评估（CV）是环境物品支付意愿（WTP）估计的主要来源之一，但关于参数化方法建模CV数据的指导很少，这些方法能够基于二元选择、支付卡和开放式问题等陈述的偏好可靠地估计WTP值。使用WTP参数模型的研究通常从一组有限的常用分布中选择一个规格。为了提高基于CV的福利估计参数化建模的可靠性，我们建议采用更灵活的方法，考虑具有不同参数分布的广泛规格。我们使用两项大型CV研究的数据集展示了所提出方法的优势：波罗的海行动计划富营养化减少价值评估研究和深水地平线自然资源损害评估。我们发现，最适合数据的参数规格在这两个案例研究中有所不同。此外，这些最优规格并不总是与最常用的分布一致。我们进一步观察到不同规格之间福利估计存在不可忽视的差异。我们的结果提供了初步证据，表明当考虑拟合更好的规格时，估计的变异性较低。这些发现强调了谨慎识别最适合数据的分布的必要性。专注于最佳拟合的参数规格，我们为所研究的两个实证案例提供了替代的WTP值估计。

records.title_en: The infrastructural conditions of (de-)growth: The case of the internet
records.title_cn: （去）增长的基础设施条件：互联网案例
records.abstract_en: Infrastructure studies represent a domain that remains significantly uncharted among degrowth scholars. This is paradoxical considering that infrastructures constitute a fundamental prerequisite for the equitable distribution of many aspects of human well-being that degrowth proponents emphasize. Nonetheless, the substantial resource and energy consumption associated with infrastructures cannot be overlooked. The internet offers an instructive case study in this sense, at its best it forges human connections and is productive of considerable societal value. The resource implications of the often-overlooked internet physical layer of data-centres and submarine cables needs to be acknowledged. Furthermore, the ways in which assumptions of perpetual growth are built into this global infrastructure via the logic layer of internet protocols and other governing mechanisms such as finance and network design need to be examined if we are to determine the extent to which such infrastructures are inherently growth dependent. In making these two arguments, we draw upon the work of both Science and Technology Studies (STS) and Large Technological System (LTS) studies on the inherent problems of large infrastructures which have thus far seen little engagement with questions of degrowth. We review the case of the internet and suggest a number of scenarios that illustrate potential roles for such infrastructures in any planned reduction of economic activity.
records.abstract_cn: 基础设施研究在去增长学者中仍是一个很大程度上未被探索的领域。考虑到基础设施构成了去增长倡导者所强调的人类福祉诸多方面公平分配的基本前提，这具有悖论性。然而，与基础设施相关的巨大资源和能源消耗不容忽视。互联网在这方面提供了一个有启发性的案例研究，在其最佳状态下，它建立了人类联系并产生了相当大的社会价值。需要承认经常被忽视的互联网物理层（数据中心和海底电缆）的资源影响。此外，如果要确定此类基础设施在多大程度上固有地依赖增长，就需要审视通过互联网协议逻辑层以及金融和网络设计等其他治理机制，将永续增长假设嵌入这一全球基础设施的方式。在提出这两个论点时，我们借鉴了科学技术研究（STS）和大型技术系统（LTS）研究关于大型基础设施固有问题的成果，这些研究迄今很少涉及去增长问题。我们回顾了互联网案例，并提出了一些情景，说明此类基础设施在任何有计划的经济活动减少中可能扮演的角色。

records.title_en: Comparative analysis of Rights of Nature (RoN) case studies worldwide: Features of emergence and design
records.title_cn: 全球自然权利（RoN）案例比较分析：出现与设计的特征
records.abstract_en: We provide a descriptive comparative analysis of features related to emergence and design among 14 Rights of Nature (RoN) case studies worldwide. For analysis, we develop a schematic roadmap in which we categorise RoN into case studies with public guardianship and ones with appointed guardians (termed Environmental Legal Personhoods (ELPs) with further sub-categories of indirect, direct and living ELPs). Our findings suggest that RoN case studies emerged under similar circumstances where existing governance structures had been unable to protect natural environments from continued economic (urban, agricultural and industrial) activity by multiple economic actors. The strong role of local community and Indigenous Peoples in advocacy for RoN point to a divide between in situ communities and external economic agents, allowing for eco-centric value systems to emerge in juxtaposition to existing governance structures. We find that the design of RoN, however, varies in geographical entity, legal framework, legal status and guardianship. Poorly defined liability of guardians and economic agents have led to the overturning of two case studies, which stands in contrast to well-defined rights and liabilities in other case studies, suggesting that attention to liability may be an important building block for the effectiveness of RoN to protect biodiversity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对全球14个自然权利（RoN）案例中与出现和设计相关的特征进行了描述性比较分析。为进行分析，我们制定了一个示意性路线图，将RoN划分为具有公共监护的案例和具有指定监护人的案例（称为环境法律人格（ELP），并进一步细分为间接、直接和生命ELP子类别）。我们的研究结果表明，RoN案例在类似情况下出现，即现有治理结构未能保护自然环境免受多个经济行为者持续的（城市、农业和工业）经济活动的影响。当地社区和原住民在倡导RoN中的强大作用表明，原地社区与外部经济行为者之间存在分歧，使得生态中心价值体系能够在与现有治理结构并列的情况下出现。然而，我们发现RoN的设计在地理实体、法律框架、法律地位和监护方面各不相同。监护人和经济行为者的责任界定不清导致两个案例被推翻，这与其他案例中明确界定的权利和责任形成对比，表明对责任的关注可能是RoN有效保护生物多样性的重要组成部分。

records.title_en: Impact of time-saving technology on household electricity consumption: An automatic vacuum cleaner distribution experiment in Japan
records.title_cn: 节省时间的技术对家庭电力消费的影响：日本自动吸尘器分发实验
records.abstract_en: Time-saving technologies can raise people's standard of living by increasing their amount of disposable time. However, this may lead t the time-use rebound effect (TRE), wherein people reallocate their regained free time into actions that could affect energy consumption and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. In this empirical study, we used a causal inference framework to test whether TRE occurs by conducting a distribution experiment of time-saving goods. We obtained data from a questionnaire about the daily time use of the households in our experiment. Our results showed that the random assignment of time-saving goods leads to a time reallocation of household behaviour. These goods increased electricity use, although their magnitude is relatively small at 1.83% of household electricity consumption.
records.abstract_cn: 节省时间的技术可以通过增加人们的可支配时间来提高生活水平。然而，这可能导致时间使用反弹效应（TRE），即人们将重新获得的空闲时间重新分配到可能影响能源消耗和温室气体（GHG）排放的活动中。在本实证研究中，我们使用因果推断框架，通过进行节省时间商品的分发实验来检验TRE是否发生。我们从实验中关于家庭日常时间使用的问卷中获取了数据。我们的结果表明，节省时间商品的随机分配导致了家庭行为的时间重新分配。这些商品增加了电力使用，尽管其幅度相对较小，占家庭电力消费的1.83%。

records.title_en: Renewing the Subterranean Energy Regime? How Petroculture Obscures the Materiality of Deep Geothermal Energy Technology in Sweden
records.title_cn: 更新地下能源体系？石油文化如何掩盖瑞典深层地热能技术的物质性
records.abstract_en: Social visions to replace fossil fuels with renewable energy sources have motivated unprecedented growth in global renewable energy manufacturing. Previous literature shows that people committed to realizing such visions have difficulties reconciling with the negative social-ecological impacts of this mass production even if it presents a formidable challenge to a socially just and ecologically sustainable energy transition. This study contributes to a better understanding of how stakeholders view the promises and perils of large-scale renewable energy development. It draws on the petroculure literature to understand how stakeholder viewpoints of deep geothermal energy technology may be a product of the historically unparalleled energy throughput since the mid-20th century. The study relies on Q-methodology for identifying viewpoints among stakeholders in deep geothermal energy in Sweden. The results demonstrate a notable influence of petrocultural assumptions, which helps to explain how stakeholders obfuscate the materiality of renewable energy technologies. This suggests that social visions to replace fossil fuels with technologically sophisticated renewable energy systems could themselves be cultural products of the fossil era inclined to reproduce it.
records.abstract_cn: 以可再生能源替代化石燃料的社会愿景推动了全球可再生能源制造业的空前增长。既有文献表明，致力于实现此类愿景的人们难以调和这种大规模生产所带来的负面社会生态影响，即使这对实现社会公正和生态可持续的能源转型构成了严峻挑战。本研究有助于更好地理解利益相关者如何看待大规模可再生能源开发的承诺与风险。它借鉴石油文化文献，以理解利益相关者对深层地热能技术的看法如何可能是自20世纪中叶以来历史上前所未有的能源吞吐量的产物。本研究采用Q方法论来识别瑞典深层地热能利益相关者的观点。结果表明，石油文化假设具有显著影响，这有助于解释利益相关者如何掩盖可再生能源技术的物质性。这表明，以技术复杂的可再生能源系统替代化石燃料的社会愿景本身可能就是化石时代的文化产物，并倾向于复制这一时代。

records.title_en: Formal designation of Brazilian indigenous lands linked to small but consistent reductions in deforestation
records.title_cn: 巴西原住民土地的正式划定与森林砍伐的小幅但持续减少相关
records.abstract_en: Indigenous territories in Brazil have existed since the pre-European discovery of the continent. Yet, many of them remain without formal recognition by the state. While numerous studies discuss the social implications of indigenous land (IL) designation, limited empirical evidence exists regarding its role in forest conservation. To address this gap, the present study employs a quasi-experimental design and causal-inference methods to estimate the effects of formal IL designation on deforestation across Brazil and its biomes, from 1986 to 2021. Estimates indicate an average impact of −0.05% on deforestation due to the formal designation of ILs nationwide, with variations ranging from −0.21% to 0.04% across different evaluation periods and biomes. Notably, designated ILs in the Cerrado biome had the highest avoided deforestation impacts (−0.12%, on average). No evidence of deforestation leakage was observed. The findings from this study suggest that while the promotion of formal IL designation can lead to consistent reductions in deforestation, the magnitude of its effect is relatively small to be promoted on the sole basis of an effective strategy to mitigate tropical deforestation and climate change. Nevertheless, the potential positive socioeconomic impacts of formal IL designation on indigenous peoples cannot be undermined.
records.abstract_cn: 巴西的原住民领地自欧洲人发现该大陆之前就已存在。然而，其中许多仍未得到国家的正式承认。尽管众多研究讨论了原住民土地（IL）划定的社会影响，但关于其在森林保护中作用的实证证据有限。为弥补这一空白，本研究采用准实验设计和因果推断方法，估计了1986年至2021年间巴西及其生物群落中正式划定IL对森林砍伐的影响。估计结果显示，全国范围内正式划定IL对森林砍伐的平均影响为−0.05%，不同评估时期和生物群落的变动范围从−0.21%到0.04%。值得注意的是，塞拉多生物群落中划定的IL具有最高的避免森林砍伐影响（平均−0.12%）。未观察到森林砍伐泄漏的证据。本研究的发现表明，虽然促进正式划定IL可以带来森林砍伐的持续减少，但其效应规模相对较小，不足以仅作为减缓热带森林砍伐和气候变化的有效策略来推广。然而，正式划定IL对原住民可能产生的积极社会经济影响不容忽视。

records.title_en: Tropical cyclones and fertility: New evidence from developing countries
records.title_cn: 热带气旋与生育率：来自发展中国家的新证据
records.abstract_en: Does exposure to tropical cyclones affect fertility? This paper addresses this question by constructing a panel dataset from geolocated micro-data about the fertility history of mothers along with their local exposure to tropical cyclones for a sample of six developing countries for the 1985–2015 period. We then estimate the causal effect of tropical cyclone shocks on women’s likelihood of giving birth. We find evidence that tropical cyclone exposure has a significantly negative effect on motherhood. A cyclonic wind exposure between 60 and 117 km/h (resp. at least of 118 km/h) decreases the probability of giving birth by 7.8 (resp. 7.0) points a year after exposure. We also observed that the magnitude of the effect varies with the degree of cyclonic exposure associated with the mothers’ living environment and the number of children ever born. In particular, the fall in the likelihood of giving birth is lower for mothers living in cyclone-prone areas and for those who already have children. Alternative specifications of our baseline model provide further insights: (i) recent past exposure to cyclones was associated with a lower decrease in fertility when exposed once again; and (ii) no evidence of non-linearities was observed in the effect.
records.abstract_cn: 热带气旋的暴露是否影响生育率？本文通过构建一个由地理定位微观数据组成的面板数据集，该数据涉及母亲的生育历史及其在当地遭受热带气旋的情况，样本涵盖1985-2015年期间的六个发展中国家，来回答这一问题。随后，我们估计了热带气旋冲击对女性生育可能性的因果效应。我们发现证据表明，热带气旋暴露对生育具有显著的负面影响。一年后，风速在60至117公里/小时（分别为至少118公里/小时）的气旋暴露使生育概率降低7.8（分别为7.0）个百分点。我们还观察到，效应的大小随母亲居住环境相关的气旋暴露程度以及已有子女数量而变化。特别是，居住在气旋易发地区的母亲以及已有子女的母亲，其生育可能性下降幅度较小。我们基线模型的替代设定提供了进一步的见解：（i）近期曾遭受气旋暴露的母亲再次暴露时，生育率下降幅度较小；（ii）在效应中未观察到非线性证据。

records.title_en: The role of physical constraints on production
records.title_cn: 生产过程中的物理约束作用
records.abstract_en: We consider the physical constraints of the production process by connecting the actual amount (volume) of physical output to its mass. To achieve this, we introduce a function that evaluates the mass of physical objects such as resources and output. Through the mass function, we demonstrate that the marginal product of resource inputs is less than the ratio of the mass density of resource inputs to that of the final products. This ratio's boundedness implies that the marginal resource product has an upper limit, meaning that the Inada condition for resources is not valid. This restriction on the marginal product of resource input has significant implications for long-term growth and environmental sustainability. It indicates that the growth of total physical output is only feasible with more resource input and a potentially higher level of pollution.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过将实际产出量（体积）与其质量联系起来，考虑生产过程中的物理约束。为此，我们引入了一个函数来评估资源与产出等物理对象的质量。通过质量函数，我们证明了资源投入的边际产出小于资源投入质量密度与最终产品质量密度之比。该比率的有限性意味着边际资源产出存在上限，即资源的Inada条件不成立。资源投入边际产出的这一限制对长期增长和环境可持续性具有重要含义。它表明，总实物产出的增长只有通过增加资源投入和可能更高的污染水平才能实现。

records.title_en: Perceptions of Ecosystem Services and Bonds with Nature: The Case of Fish-Farming Ponds in France
records.title_cn: 生态系统服务感知与自然联系：法国养鱼池塘的案例
records.abstract_en: Recent studies have shown the importance of relationships with nature, emotions felt, forms of attachment, and experience of nature on conservation motivations. They have proposed characterizing relational values based on these complex interactions with ecosystems. We analyzed these links for ecosystem services (ESs) associated with fish farming ponds. The analysis was based on an online survey conducted on mainland France. We identified the types of pro-environmental profiles and investigated the determinants of pro-environmental behaviors. We analyzed the types of services prioritized according to individual profiles and the factors determining sensitivity. We distinguish between individual ESs that are more hedonic in nature, and regulating or heritage cultural ESs that refer to collective motivations rather linked to eudaimonic well-being. The results highlight the importance of factors related to eudaimonic well-being, which help integrate the role of ethical values and commitment to conservation. The modeling shows little influence of the usual sociodemographic variables and the strong significance of variables considering the knowledge and familiarity with these ecosystems and the pro-environment commitment, which refers to eudaimonic well-being. These results allow us to discuss the specificities of awareness-raising policies, which imply a rationale for active citizenship.
records.abstract_cn: 近期研究表明，与自然的关系、情感体验、依恋形式以及自然经验对保护动机的重要性。他们提出基于这些与生态系统的复杂互动来表征关系价值。我们分析了与养鱼池塘相关的生态系统服务（ESs）的这些联系。分析基于在法国本土进行的在线调查。我们识别了亲环境档案的类型，并调查了亲环境行为的决定因素。我们根据个人档案分析了优先考虑的服务类型以及决定敏感性的因素。我们区分了更具享乐性质的个体ESs，以及指涉集体动机、更与幸福感相关的调节或遗产文化ESs。结果强调了与幸福感相关的因素的重要性，这些因素有助于整合伦理价值观和对保护的承诺。模型显示，通常的社会人口统计变量影响很小，而考虑对这些生态系统的了解和熟悉程度以及亲环境承诺（指涉幸福感）的变量具有强烈显著性。这些结果使我们能够讨论提高认识政策的特殊性，这些政策隐含了积极公民身份的理由。

records.title_en: Beyond the haze: Decomposing the effect of economic inequality on global air quality from 2000 to 2020
records.title_cn: 迷雾之外：分解2000年至2020年经济不平等对全球空气质量的影响
records.abstract_en: Extant research has analysed the macroeconomic and political drivers of worldwide air pollution. Empirically, studies have focused on either between-country (cross-national comparisons) or within-country (temporal changes) dynamics, but these related effects have not been simultaneously addressed. Employing a comprehensive dataset spanning 156 countries over two decades (2000−2020), we take a distinctive dual approach to examine the effects of economic inequality, economic development, and democratic institutions on air pollution exposure within and across countries. First, against expectations, we find that within countries over time, increases in economic inequality correlate with reduced air pollution. This relationship remains consistent irrespective of country-level economic development or democratic status. Further we find that the trajectory of economic inequality conditions this effect, suggesting that whether redistributive measures towards addressing economic inequality carry environmental co-benefits or trade-offs likely depends upon the context. Second, between countries, economic inequality has a limited association with air pollution levels. Third, the effects of economic inequality on air pollution levels within and between countries are substantively small in comparison to the impact of economic development and democracy. This study emphasises the need to reconsider conventional expectations regarding economic inequality, further accentuating the influence of economic development and democratic institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 现有研究已分析了全球空气污染的经济和政治驱动因素。实证上，研究要么聚焦于国家间（跨国比较）动态，要么聚焦于国家内（时间变化）动态，但这些相关效应尚未被同时处理。利用涵盖156个国家、跨越二十年（2000年至2020年）的全面数据集，我们采取独特的双重方法来考察经济不平等、经济发展和民主制度对国家内和国家间空气污染暴露的影响。首先，与预期相反，我们发现国家内随时间推移，经济不平等的加剧与空气污染的减少相关。无论国家层面的经济发展水平或民主状况如何，这一关系保持一致。进一步，我们发现经济不平等的轨迹调节了这一效应，表明旨在解决经济不平等的再分配措施是否带来环境协同效益或权衡，可能取决于具体情境。其次，在国家间，经济不平等与空气污染水平的关联有限。第三，与经济发展和民主的影响相比，经济不平等对国家内和国家间空气污染水平的影响在实质上较小。本研究强调需要重新考虑关于经济不平等的传统预期，进一步凸显经济发展和民主制度的影响。

records.title_en: Circular economy and macroeconomic performance: Evidence across 28 European countries
records.title_cn: 循环经济与宏观经济表现：来自28个欧洲国家的证据
records.abstract_en: The circular economy (CE) is regarded as a new concept to promote sustainable development issues by improving economic, environmental and social goals. Essentially, the key idea of the CE is to assist modern economies to shift from linear economic thinking to a circular one in order to ensure that components of products could have a second use in new products and services. The majority of the relevant literature has focused on the relationship between CE principles and firms. However, to achieve CE principles, data and information from the macro level is also required; something which is currently under examined by the literature. Consequently, a significant gap in this field is the explanation of how the CE affects the macro economy and vice versa. To fill this gap, this paper aims to examine the relationship between a macro-level Circularity Rate and various macroeconomic variables across a sample of 28 European countries employing panel data. The findings suggest a robustly positive relationship between real GDP and the circularity rate over the long-run while higher environmental taxes are associated with an increase in the Circularity Rate. Southern European countries exhibit a significantly lower level of Circularity Rates compared to their northern counterparts.
records.abstract_cn: 循环经济（CE）被视为通过改善经济、环境和社会目标来促进可持续发展问题的新概念。本质上，CE的关键理念是帮助现代经济体从线性经济思维转向循环思维，以确保产品组件能够在新产品和服务中得到二次利用。大多数相关文献关注的是CE原则与企业之间的关系。然而，为了实现CE原则，还需要宏观层面的数据和信息；这一点目前文献研究不足。因此，该领域的一个显著空白是解释CE如何影响宏观经济以及反之亦然。为填补这一空白，本文旨在利用面板数据，考察28个欧洲国家样本中宏观层面循环率与各种宏观经济变量之间的关系。研究结果表明，长期内实际GDP与循环率之间存在稳健的正相关关系，而更高的环境税与循环率的提高相关。与北欧国家相比，南欧国家的循环率水平显著较低。

records.title_en: Maintaining human wellbeing as socio-environmental systems undergo regime shifts
records.title_cn: 社会-环境系统经历状态转变时维持人类福祉
records.abstract_en: Global environmental change is pushing many socio-environmental systems towards critical thresholds, where ecological systems’ states are on the precipice of tipping points and interventions are needed to navigate or avert impending transitions. Flickering, where a system vacillates between alternative stable states, is an early warning signal of transitions to alternative ecological regimes. However, while flickering may presage an ecological tipping point, these dynamics also pose unique challenges for human adaptation. We link an ecological model that can exhibit flickering to a model of human environmental adaptation to explore the impact of flickering on the utility of adaptive agents. When adaptive capacity is low, flickering causes wellbeing to decline disproportionately. As a result, flickering dynamics move forward the optimal timing of a transformational change that can secure wellbeing despite environmental variability. The implications of flickering on communities faced with desertification, fisheries collapse, and ecosystem change are explored as possible case studies. Flickering, driven in part by climate change and extreme events, may already be impacting communities. Our results suggest that governance interventions investing in adaptive capacity or facilitating transformational change before flickering arises could blunt the negative impact of flickering as socio-environmental systems pass through tipping points.
records.abstract_cn: 全球环境变化正推动许多社会-环境系统逼近临界阈值，在这些阈值处，生态系统的状态处于临界点的边缘，需要干预来引导或避免即将发生的转变。闪烁现象，即系统在替代稳定状态之间摇摆，是向替代生态体制转变的早期预警信号。然而，虽然闪烁可能预示着生态临界点，但这些动态也给人类适应带来了独特的挑战。我们将一个可能表现出闪烁的生态模型与一个人对环境适应的模型联系起来，以探讨闪烁对适应性主体效用的影响。当适应能力较低时，闪烁会导致福祉不成比例地下降。因此，闪烁动态提前了转型变革的最佳时机，这种变革可以在环境多变的情况下保障福祉。本文探讨了闪烁对面临荒漠化、渔业崩溃和生态系统变化的社区的影响，作为可能的案例研究。闪烁，部分由气候变化和极端事件驱动，可能已经在影响社区。我们的结果表明，在闪烁出现之前，投资于适应能力或促进转型变革的治理干预措施，可以减轻闪烁在社会-环境系统通过临界点时产生的负面影响。

records.title_en: Preferences for dynamic electricity tariffs: A comparison of households in Germany and Japan
records.title_cn: 动态电价偏好：德国与日本家庭的比较
records.abstract_en: We evaluate a stated choice experiment on dynamic electricity tariffs based on two representative household surveys from Germany and Japan. Our results indicate significant differences between German and Japanese respondents’ preferences towards dynamic tariffs, with the latter generally being more open to dynamic pricing. Furthermore, our unique experimental design allows to disentangle preferences for inter- and intraday price changes, which are two essential tariff characteristics. In this respect, our results suggest that households need significant compensation in order to accept frequently changing price patterns. In contrast, they are mostly indifferent with respect to the number of price changes per day. Besides the implementation of an environmental treatment message, we additionally investigate tariff characteristics, which aim at overcoming household acceptance barriers. To this end, a restrictive use of households’ consumption data, cost caps, as well as highlighting the environmental benefits associated to dynamic tariffs present themselves as suitable tools to reduce households’ aversion to dynamic electricity tariffs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于德国和日本的两项代表性家庭调查，评估了一项关于动态电价的陈述性选择实验。我们的结果表明，德国和日本受访者对动态电价的偏好存在显著差异，后者通常对动态定价更为开放。此外，我们独特的实验设计能够区分对日内和日内价格变化的偏好，这是两个重要的电价特征。在这方面，我们的结果表明，家庭需要显著的补偿才能接受频繁变化的价格模式。相比之下，他们对每天价格变化的次数大多持无所谓态度。除了实施环境信息干预外，我们还调查了旨在克服家庭接受障碍的电价特征。为此，限制家庭消费数据的使用、设置成本上限以及强调动态电价带来的环境效益，是减少家庭对动态电价厌恶的合适工具。

records.title_en: Are there gender differences in household carbon footprints? Evidence from Spain
records.title_cn: 家庭碳足迹是否存在性别差异？来自西班牙的证据
records.abstract_en: Identifying the main drivers of the household carbon footprint (HCF) is a priority to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and move towards a more sustainable economy. Among the multiple factors that explain the HCF, some previous research has confirmed the relevance of gender. In this paper, we calculate the HCF of individual Spanish households using an environmentally extended multi-regional input-output model (EEMRIO) that quantifies the emissions embedded in the supply chain of goods and services that households consume. We assess the differences in consumption and emissions patterns, measuring the gender effect by a new variable, the female share of the household. This represents a remarkable improvement over previous literature that used simpler approaches. Moreover, we assess the partial effect of gender on HCF using multivariate regressions for total and sectoral emissions. Our results show that households with a majority of men have a higher HCF and carbon intensity. Even when controlling for economic, sociodemographic, and regional factors there are differences in the sectoral emissions according to gender. Female households spend more (and generate more emissions) on housing and food products, while male households show that pattern for restaurants and transport. These results can help orientate environmental campaigns and demand-side mitigation policies.
records.abstract_cn: 识别家庭碳足迹（HCF）的主要驱动因素是减少温室气体排放、迈向更可持续经济的优先事项。在解释HCF的众多因素中，一些先前研究已确认了性别的重要性。本文使用环境扩展的多区域投入产出模型（EEMRIO）计算西班牙个体家庭的家庭碳足迹，该模型量化了家庭消费的商品和服务供应链中嵌入的排放。我们通过一个新变量——家庭中女性占比，来评估消费和排放模式的差异，衡量性别效应。这比先前使用更简单方法的文献有了显著改进。此外，我们使用多元回归评估性别对总排放和部门排放的部分效应。结果表明，男性占多数的家庭具有更高的HCF和碳强度。即使在控制经济、社会人口和区域因素后，部门排放仍存在性别差异。女性家庭在住房和食品上的支出更多（并产生更多排放），而男性家庭则在餐馆和交通方面表现出这种模式。这些结果有助于指导环境运动和需求侧减缓政策。

records.title_en: Hard to digest investments: People oppose investment in both conventional and cultured meat producers
records.title_cn: 难以消化的投资：人们反对投资于传统肉类和培养肉生产商
records.abstract_en: The production of meat from farmed animals is problematic both on ethical and environmental grounds. However, we are on the eve of the mass production of cultured (lab) meat. This alternative to conventional meat should be both more environmentally sustainable and cause less harm to animals, making it more socially acceptable. In this paper, we investigate how people judge investing in meat producers, an issue that has become more salient with the increasing importance of socially responsible investment. We conducted two experimental studies (N = 1301) aimed at answering whether people can separate associations towards meat when judging companies that produce them, resolving whether evaluations of meat producers as investment targets have a motivational or affective component, or not. Our findings show that people exhibit an aversion towards investment in both conventional (dconventional = −0.97) and cultured meat producers (dcultured = −0.26), consistent with the former. Concern for animal welfare exacerbates (dconventional = −1.34) or attenuates (dcultured = 0.31) this aversion unless people feel disgust-towards-animal-flesh, which has a similar adverse effect regardless of meat origin. Our findings suggest that for many, cultured meat producers might remain controversial investment targets. We speculate that similar paradoxical patterns could be observed in other economic decisions, making them socially consequential.
records.abstract_cn: 从农场动物生产肉类在伦理和环境方面都存在争议。然而，我们正处于培养（实验室）肉大规模生产的前夜。这种传统肉类的替代品应该既更环境可持续，又对动物造成更少的伤害，使其更易被社会接受。在本文中，我们研究了人们如何评价对肉类生产商的投资，这一问题随着社会责任投资的日益重要而变得更加突出。我们进行了两项实验研究（N = 1301），旨在回答人们是否能在评价生产肉类的公司时分离对肉类的联想，以及确定对肉类生产商作为投资目标的评价是否具有动机性或情感性成分。我们的研究结果显示，人们对投资于传统肉类生产商（dconventional = −0.97）和培养肉生产商（dcultured = −0.26）都表现出厌恶，且前者更为一致。对动物福利的关注加剧（dconventional = −1.34）或减弱（dcultured = 0.31）这种厌恶，除非人们对动物肉感到厌恶，这种厌恶感无论肉类来源如何都会产生类似的不利影响。我们的研究结果表明，对许多人来说，培养肉生产商可能仍然是争议性的投资目标。我们推测，在其他经济决策中也可能观察到类似的悖论模式，使其具有社会影响。

records.title_en: Saving the world voluntarily: Experimental evidence of gain-loss framing on voluntary pro-environmental behavior
records.title_cn: 自愿拯救世界：得失框架对自愿亲环境行为的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Empirical research shows that loss framing appears to be a promising tool to promote pro-environmental behavior. However, only a limited amount of experimental research has examined the effect of loss framing on actual behavior. Here, we use a variation of the Work for Environmental Protection Task (Lange & Dewitte, 2022) to study voluntary pro-environmental behavior. In an online experiment (N = 897), we find a trend of higher working efforts in the LOSS frame. However, this effect is small and marginally statistically significant. Interestingly, as explorative analyses suggest, the effect of loss framing is consistent for people with low and high intrinsic values to protect the environment.
records.abstract_cn: 实证研究表明，损失框架似乎是促进亲环境行为的一种有前景的工具。然而，只有有限的实验研究检验了损失框架对实际行为的影响。在此，我们使用环境保护工作任务的变体（Lange & Dewitte, 2022）来研究自愿亲环境行为。在一项在线实验中（N = 897），我们发现损失框架下的工作努力程度有更高的趋势。然而，这种效应较小且仅边缘显著。有趣的是，正如探索性分析所表明的，损失框架的效应对于内在环境保护价值观高低不同的人群是一致的。

records.title_en: Impact of industrial intelligence on green total factor productivity: The indispensability of the environmental system
records.title_cn: 工业智能对绿色全要素生产率的影响：环境系统的不可或缺性
records.abstract_en: Existing research suggests that the application of artificial intelligence (AI) technology in industrial fields can promote the development of a green economy. However, for most developing countries, due to imperfect technological capabilities, human capital constraints and other factors, the impact of industrial intelligence on the green economy still needs to be verified. Based on city panel data from China, we find that industrial intelligence has no significant impact on green total factor productivity (GTFP). This conclusion is still valid after GMM estimation, instrumental variable (IV) estimation and a series of robustness tests. After incorporating the environmental regulation into the analysis framework, the impact of industrial intelligence on GTFP is found to be regulated by the intensity of the environmental regulation; that is, industrial intelligence can improve GTFP only in cities with strong environmental regulation. Further research shows that industrial intelligence can optimize and upgrade the industrial structure, given strict environmental regulations, thereby improving city GTFP. We confirm that the institutional premise of environmental regulation in developing countries is indispensable for industrial intelligence to promote the green economy, which has important theoretical and practical significance.
records.abstract_cn: 现有研究表明，人工智能（AI）技术在工业领域的应用可以促进绿色经济的发展。然而，对于大多数发展中国家而言，由于技术能力不完善、人力资本约束等因素，工业智能对绿色经济的影响仍需验证。基于中国城市面板数据，我们发现工业智能对绿色全要素生产率（GTFP）没有显著影响。这一结论在GMM估计、工具变量（IV）估计以及一系列稳健性检验后仍然成立。将环境规制纳入分析框架后，工业智能对GTFP的影响受到环境规制强度的调节；即只有在环境规制较强的城市，工业智能才能提高GTFP。进一步研究表明，在严格的环境规制下，工业智能可以优化和升级产业结构，从而提高城市GTFP。我们证实，发展中国家的环境规制制度前提对于工业智能促进绿色经济是不可或缺的，这具有重要的理论和实践意义。

records.title_en: Towards a systemic view on rebound effects: Modelling the feedback loops of rebound mechanisms
records.title_cn: 迈向反弹效应的系统观：对反弹机制反馈回路的建模
records.abstract_en: Rebound Effects (RE) are systemic responses that are relentlessly hindering the achievement of sustainability actions’ intended effects. Despite the wide recognition of RE, the limited understanding of the underlying causal structures sustaining their occurrence hampers the ability to anticipate, prevent, and tackle them. To explore how feedback thinking can explain the occurrence of RE, this paper describes the structure of 26 rebound mechanisms based on qualitative system dynamics (SD) modelling using causal loop diagrams (CLD). Apart from a comprehensive catalogue of mechanisms, the elicitation of two generic rebound mechanisms reveals that RE are either the result of (1) reinforcing loops acting against quick fixes to control local resource consumption or (2) balancing reactions in the opposite direction of attempts to control local resource consumption leading to escalation behaviour. Four contributions highlight how this research supports a systemic view on RE, the natural evolutionary step required to understand and manage its occurrence.
records.abstract_cn: 反弹效应（RE）是系统性反应，不断阻碍可持续行动预期效果的实现。尽管反弹效应已被广泛认识，但对其发生背后潜在因果结构的有限理解，妨碍了预测、预防和应对这些效应的能力。为探索反馈思维如何解释反弹效应的发生，本文基于定性系统动力学（SD）建模，使用因果回路图（CLD）描述了26种反弹机制的结构。除了一个全面的机制目录外，对两种通用反弹机制的引出揭示出，反弹效应要么是（1）针对控制局部资源消耗的快速修复而起作用的增强回路的产物，要么是（2）与试图控制局部资源消耗相反方向的平衡反应，导致升级行为。四项贡献凸显了这项研究如何支持对反弹效应的系统观，这是理解和管理其发生所需的自然演进步骤。

records.title_en: Sustainable practices in cocoa production. The role of certification schemes and farmer cooperatives
records.title_cn: 可可生产中的可持续实践：认证计划与农民合作社的作用
records.abstract_en: In Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana, many small-scale cocoa producers cultivate cocoa in unshaded or low-shaded plots, leading to challenges such as reduced biodiversity, soil fertility depletion, and increased soil erosion. To assess the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices in the cocoa sector, we develop a scale that incorporates dimensions of agroforestry, soil conservation, pest and disease management and farm sanitation. Using data from >1700 cocoa producers, we examine farmer participation in cooperatives and three main certification schemes (incl. Fairtrade, Rainforest Alliance and Organic) to understand their roles in promoting sustainable practices. We apply a multinomial endogenous switching regression model to control for potential selection bias and estimate the impact of participating in certification schemes, farmer cooperatives or both. In Côte d'Ivoire, econometric results show that joint participation in both a certification scheme and a farmer cooperative is associated with a significantly higher sustainability score. In Ghana, certification scheme membership shows the highest effect.
records.abstract_cn: 在科特迪瓦和加纳，许多小规模可可种植者在无遮荫或低遮荫的地块上种植可可，导致生物多样性减少、土壤肥力枯竭和土壤侵蚀加剧等挑战。为了评估可可部门可持续农业实践的采用情况，我们开发了一个包含农林业、土壤保护、病虫害管理和农场卫生等维度的量表。利用来自超过1700名可可种植者的数据，我们考察了农民参与合作社和三个主要认证计划（包括公平贸易、雨林联盟和有机认证）的情况，以了解它们在促进可持续实践中的作用。我们应用多元内生转换回归模型来控制潜在的选择偏差，并估计参与认证计划、农民合作社或两者兼有的影响。在科特迪瓦，计量经济学结果表明，同时参与认证计划和农民合作社与显著更高的可持续性得分相关。在加纳，认证计划成员资格显示出最高的效果。

records.title_en: Intergenerational altruism, pessimism bias on tenure insecurity, and sustainable land use: Evidence from household grassland management in China
records.title_cn: 代际利他主义、产权不安全感的悲观偏差与可持续土地利用：来自中国家庭草地管理的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between intergenerational altruism, pessimism bias, and grassland use among rural households in the pastoral region of northwest China. By designing a series of hypothetical questions, we develop measures of intergenerational altruism and pessimism bias, and examine their impact on actual grazing behavior. Our analysis reveals that households with weaker intergenerational altruism and stronger pessimism bias tend to increase their livestock scale without a corresponding increase in supplementary feeding, suggesting that our measures can serve as reliable predictors of grassland overuse. Furthermore, to investigate whether the grant of long-term land rights to rural households mitigates the negative impact of pessimism bias on grassland management, we employ panel data collected before and after a land reform in China. Our results demonstrate that the reform weakens the adverse effects of pessimism bias and promotes the sustainable use of grassland.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了西北牧区农村家庭代际利他主义、悲观偏差与草地利用之间的关系。通过设计一系列假设性问题，我们构建了代际利他主义和悲观偏差的度量指标，并考察了它们对实际放牧行为的影响。分析结果显示，代际利他主义较弱、悲观偏差较强的家庭倾向于增加牲畜规模而不相应增加补饲，这表明我们的度量指标可以作为草地过度利用的可靠预测因子。此外，为了考察赋予农村家庭长期土地权利是否减轻悲观偏差对草地管理的负面影响，我们采用了中国土地改革前后收集的面板数据。结果表明，改革削弱了悲观偏差的不利影响，促进了草地的可持续利用。

records.title_en: Ecological-behavioral economics: Impact of information on energy-renovation decision through third-party investing
records.title_cn: 生态行为经济学：第三方投资下信息对能源改造决策的影响
records.abstract_en: Energy renovation faces critical challenges due to upfront costs and operational complexities, impeding its widespread adoption. Some strategies have initiated a groundbreaking economic model featuring a third-party payment mechanism. Under this innovative scheme, households redirect their energy bill savings to a third-party operator to fund renovation projects. In this study, employing a controlled laboratory experiment, we examine the diversity in preferences regarding this government policy and investigate the influence of informational tools on individuals' intentions to participate in the program. Our findings reveal that households with a strong environmental orientation, a penchant for risk-taking, and more altruistic and patient are more inclined to express interest in this program. Surprisingly, information designed to activate social norms and instill confidence in government intervention does not significantly enhance adoption intentions. Our experiment offers valuable methodological insights that can inform the implementation of effective energy renovation initiatives.
records.abstract_cn: 能源改造因前期成本和运营复杂性面临严峻挑战，阻碍了其广泛采用。一些策略已启动了一种开创性的经济模式，采用第三方支付机制。在这一创新方案下，家庭将其能源账单节省的费用转给第三方运营商，以资助改造项目。在本研究中，我们通过受控实验室实验，考察了关于这一政府政策的偏好多样性，并调查了信息工具对个人参与该计划意愿的影响。我们的研究结果显示，具有强烈环保取向、偏好冒险、更利他和更有耐心的家庭更倾向于对该计划表示兴趣。令人惊讶的是，旨在激活社会规范和增强对政府干预信心的信息并未显著提高采纳意愿。我们的实验提供了有价值的方法论见解，可为实施有效的能源改造举措提供参考。

records.title_en: The impact of cereal crop diversification on farm labor productivity under changing climatic conditions
records.title_cn: 气候变化条件下谷物作物多样化对农场劳动生产率的影响
records.abstract_en: Climate change poses a serious threat to the stability of national and global food systems. Agricultural productivity growth is needed to meet increasing global food demand and land use competition. Based on a 2009–2012 panel of 133 cereal farms in Austria, we evaluate if cereal crop diversification can increase both farm labor productivity and resilience to adverse climatic conditions. To identify the productive implications of the interaction between cereal crop diversity and climatic conditions, we apply a partial correlated random effects model accounting for potential endogeneity. Our results indicate that diversified farms are more resilient to reductions in growing season rainfall, but in years with higher rainfall levels diversified farms tend to be less productive. We find that projected climate change induced temperature increases are associated with a considerable productivity decline that cannot be attenuated by cereal crop diversification.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化对国家和全球粮食系统的稳定性构成严重威胁。农业生产力增长对于满足日益增长的全球粮食需求和土地利用竞争是必要的。基于奥地利133个谷物农场的2009-2012年面板数据，我们评估谷物作物多样化是否能提高农场劳动生产率并增强对不利气候条件的抵御能力。为了识别谷物作物多样性与气候条件之间相互作用的产量影响，我们应用了部分相关随机效应模型，并考虑了潜在的内生性。我们的结果表明，多样化的农场对生长季节降雨减少的抵御能力更强，但在降雨量较高的年份，多样化的农场往往产量较低。我们发现，预计的气候变化引起的温度升高与相当大的产量下降相关，而这种下降无法通过谷物作物多样化来缓解。

records.title_en: Karl Polanyi's and K. William Kapp's arguments on social costs: is there a common “revolutionary” raison d'être?
records.title_cn: 卡尔·波兰尼与K.威廉·卡普关于社会成本的论证：是否存在共同的“革命性”存在理由？
records.abstract_en: This article examines Karl Polanyi’s and K. William Kapp’s social cost proposals to test their suitability for a “revolutionary” Social Ecological Economics that radically breaks with neoclassical and neoliberal paradigms. Whilst some coherence is revealed in their revolutionary social cost analyses and solutions, this is much messier than previously thought. This messiness is partly due to their different adoptions and reactions to neoclassical and neoliberal arguments and partly due to differences in four key dimensions of social costs: simple vs. system-wide effects, local vs. central solutions, payment vs. prevention strategies, and monetary accounting vs. physical calculation. The coherence in their raison d'être is through 1) the prevention of social costs to secure social provisioning of human needs; 2) a social valuation of lexicographically ordered physical and monetary quantification of social costs; and 3) a qualitative measure as the ultimate concern, that is “social justice” of “Dasein” as a “humanitarian ideal” (Polanyi) and human “dignity” as a qualitative “measure of all things” (Kapp). This reflects their disagreement with neoclassical and neoliberal paradigms through their rejection of monetary economizing as the exclusive definition of the “economy” and for dealing with social costs.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察卡尔·波兰尼和K.威廉·卡普的社会成本主张，以检验其是否适合作为一种“革命性”的社会生态经济学，该经济学从根本上与新古典和新自由主义范式决裂。尽管在他们的革命性社会成本分析和解决方案中显示出某种一致性，但这比先前认为的要混乱得多。这种混乱部分源于他们对新古典和新自由主义论点的不同采纳和反应，部分源于社会成本四个关键维度的差异：简单效应与系统范围效应、地方性解决方案与中央解决方案、支付策略与预防策略，以及货币核算与实物计算。他们存在理由的一致性在于：1预防社会成本以确保人类需求的社会供给；2对社会成本进行词典序排列的实物和货币量化的社会评价；以及3作为最终关注的定性衡量，即作为“人道主义理想”的“此在”的“社会正义”（波兰尼）和作为“万物尺度”的定性“人的尊严”（卡普）。这反映了他们与新古典和新自由主义范式的分歧，即拒绝将货币节约作为“经济”的唯一定义以及处理社会成本的唯一方式。

records.title_en: Is this land for sale? The effects of drought on land ownership in Uganda
records.title_cn: 这块地出售吗？干旱对乌干达土地所有权的影响
records.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of drought on the land ownership rights of smallholder farmers in Uganda. Three waves of the Uganda National Panel Survey are combined with an indicator for drought, the Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index. Using a household fixed effects approach, we exploit spatial and temporal variation in drought conditions to identify its effect on households’ self-reported willingness to acquire land ownership rights, both at the extensive and intensive margins. Results show that exposure to drought lowers households’ intentions to purchase land and substantially reduces the price households are willing to pay for land. The effects persist over time and are robust to different specifications. Our findings suggest that drought exposure limits the operating space for farmers wishing to purchase land.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了干旱对乌干达小农土地所有权的影响。将乌干达国家面板调查的三轮数据与干旱指标——标准化降水蒸散指数相结合。采用家庭固定效应方法，我们利用干旱条件的时空变化来识别其对家庭自我报告的土地所有权获取意愿的影响，包括广延边际和集约边际。结果表明，干旱暴露降低了家庭购买土地的意愿，并大幅降低了家庭愿意支付的土地价格。这些影响随时间持续存在，并且对不同规格设定均稳健。我们的研究结果表明，干旱暴露限制了希望购买土地的农民的运作空间。

records.title_en: Impartial policymakers prefer to impose carbon pricing to capping, especially when combined with offsets
records.title_cn: 公正的政策制定者更倾向于实施碳定价而非碳上限，尤其是与碳抵消相结合时
records.abstract_en: Sustainable socio-economic development requires a global reduction of greenhouse gas emissions. We utilize an incentivized experiment to map the preferences of ‘policymakers’ over climate actions of ‘decision-makers’. Our design guarantees that these preferences are unaffected by selfish motives such as a concern about being re-elected or an unwillingness to pay for the greater good. Few of our impartial policymakers choose interventions that leave the autonomy of decision-makers' completely untouched. The choice patterns of those who intervene suggest that policymakers care not only about minimizing emissions, but also about how emissions are reduced. Policymakers strongly prefer pricing policies over capping emissions, and among the pricing policies, they prefer those that include voluntary carbon offsets, even if this leaves considerable scope for decision-makers to selfishly emit CO2. The reason is that policymakers expect decision-makers to voluntarily offset some of their emissions at their own cost, and believe that this would eventually improve the outcome in terms of both emissions and the decision-makers' profit relative to a standard carbon pricing policy (without offsetting). Our decision-making data confirm this expectation.
records.abstract_cn: 可持续的社会经济发展需要全球减少温室气体排放。我们利用一项激励性实验来描绘‘政策制定者’对‘决策者’气候行动的偏好。我们的设计确保了这些偏好不受自私动机的影响，例如对连任的担忧或不愿为公共利益付费。我们的公正政策制定者中很少有人选择完全不动摇决策者自主权的干预措施。那些进行干预的人的选择模式表明，政策制定者不仅关心最小化排放，还关心排放是如何减少的。政策制定者强烈倾向于定价政策而非排放上限，并且在定价政策中，他们更倾向于包含自愿碳抵消的政策，即使这给决策者留下了相当大的自私排放二氧化碳的空间。原因是政策制定者期望决策者自愿以自身成本抵消部分排放，并相信这最终会在排放和决策者利润方面相对于标准碳定价政策（无抵消）改善结果。我们的决策数据证实了这一预期。

records.title_en: The impact of climate change mitigation policies on European labour markets
records.title_cn: 气候变化减缓政策对欧洲劳动力市场的影响
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of climate change mitigation policies intended to reach the Paris Agreement’s two-degree target on the structure of European labour markets. Employing a three-sector macro-econometric model with a rich labour market extension, we show that the measures targeted at shrinking the use of fossil fuels in electricity generation and the road transport sector – both of which have an overall modest, positive impact on GDP and total employment – could make occupational structure less unequal and polarised in 2030, the target deadline. This could occur in more than half of the European Union’s member states, particularly where the industries most affected by the transition to a low-carbon economy (i.e., mining and quarrying, utilities and manufacturing of coke and refined petroleum products) remain most important.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了旨在实现《巴黎协定》两度目标的气候变化减缓政策对欧洲劳动力市场结构的影响。通过采用一个包含丰富劳动力市场扩展的三部门宏观计量经济模型，我们表明，针对减少电力生产和道路运输部门化石燃料使用的措施——这两者总体上对GDP和总就业产生适度积极影响——可能使职业结构在2030年（目标期限）变得不那么不平等和极化。这种情况可能发生在欧盟一半以上的成员国中，特别是在受向低碳经济转型影响最大的行业（即采矿和采石、公用事业以及焦炭和精炼石油产品的制造）仍然最为重要的国家。

records.title_en: Does recalling energy efficiency measures reduce subsequent climate-friendly behavior? An experimental study of moral licensing rebound effects
records.title_cn: 回忆能效措施是否会减少后续的气候友好行为？道德许可反弹效应的实验研究
records.abstract_en: Energy efficiency measures are a key element in the fight against climate change. However, their effectiveness is threatened by so-called rebound effects—behavioral changes that lead to increased use and thus to lower-than-expected absolute savings. The moral licensing bias might cause rebound effects on the individual level: When people implement energy efficiency measures, they may feel that they have done something good for the climate and thus license themselves to less climate-friendly behavior later on. We test this prediction with three pre-registered experiments (total n = 2315). While our manipulated efficiency does increase the feeling of having done something good for the climate, no negative effects emerge on subsequent climate-friendly behavior—contrary to the predictions derived from the moral licensing literature. Climate-friendly behavior is thus not hampered by prior energy efficiency behavior; rather, demographics (women and older people act in a more climate-friendly manner) and environmental attitude determine it. Our results imply that the literature suggesting moral licensing is probably not transferable to the field of energy efficiency, and thus moral licensing may not lead to rebound effects in this context. We discuss possible explanations, implications for climate policy making, and needs for future research.
records.abstract_cn: 能效措施是应对气候变化的关键要素。然而，其有效性受到所谓的反弹效应的威胁——即行为变化导致使用增加，从而使得绝对节约量低于预期。道德许可偏差可能在个体层面引发反弹效应：当人们实施能效措施时，他们可能觉得自己为气候做了好事，从而在之后允许自己做出较少气候友好的行为。我们通过三项预注册实验（总样本量 n = 2315）检验了这一预测。虽然我们的操作化效率确实增加了人们为气候做了好事的感觉，但后续气候友好行为并未出现负面影响——这与道德许可文献得出的预测相反。因此，气候友好行为并未因先前的能效行为而受到阻碍；相反，人口统计学特征（女性和老年人表现出更气候友好的行为）和环境态度决定了它。我们的结果表明，暗示道德许可的文献可能不适用于能效领域，因此在这一背景下，道德许可可能不会导致反弹效应。我们讨论了可能的解释、对气候政策制定的启示以及未来研究的需求。

records.title_en: Ecological footprint, resource security and semi-autarky
records.title_cn: 生态足迹、资源安全与半自给自足
records.abstract_en: Can the ecological footprint framework be used for measuring resource security? Wackernagel et al. (2021) assert it can, emphasizing the role of biocapacity balance – the difference between a country's biocapacity and the ecological footprint of its consumption. This paper argues that a positive biocapacity balance is not a good indicator of resource security, as it misrepresents climate change's relevance to national resources, overlooks resource depletion, and enforces an overly restrictive notion of “semi-autarky”. The paper suggests a set of guidelines to better capture resource security.
records.abstract_cn: 生态足迹框架能否用于衡量资源安全？Wackernagel等人（2021）断言可以，并强调生物承载力平衡的作用——即一个国家的生物承载力与其消费的生态足迹之间的差异。本文认为，正的生物承载力平衡并不是资源安全的好指标，因为它歪曲了气候变化对国家资源的相关性，忽视了资源枯竭，并强制推行了一种过于严格的“半自给自足”概念。本文提出了一套指南，以更好地捕捉资源安全。

records.title_en: Does land tenure change accelerate deforestation? A matching-based four-country comparison
records.title_cn: 土地权属变更是否会加速森林砍伐？基于匹配的四国比较
records.abstract_en: The scale and pace of land tenure change for agricultural development, often known as ‘land grabbing’ or ‘global land rush,’ are historically unprecedented. Control over millions of hectares of land has shifted over the past decade for the production of food, fiber, and biofuel. However, the rapidly growing body of research on land tenure change provides few rigorous assessments of deforestation across multiple countries with distinct biophyisical and socioeconomic characteristics. In this paper, based on spatial boundaries of land transactions (LTs) in Cambodia, Ethiopia, Liberia, and Peru, we investigate their association with deforestation using a pixel-based matching approach. Our findings suggest that the context, size, and distribution of LTs and the associated deforestation patterns vary substantially across the four countries. Land tenure change significantly accelerates deforestation in Cambodia and Liberia, but such acceleration is insignificant in Ethiopia. In Peru, we observe the opposite trend, where areas adjacent to LTs experience higher deforestation than areas within. Our analysis reveals how patterns and outcomes of LTs are linked to country characteristics and contexts, and suggests that sweeping generalizations about positive or negative consequences of LTs on deforestation and possibly other socioenvironmental outcomes need to attend more closely to specific patterns and drivers of LTs.
records.abstract_cn: 为农业发展而进行的土地权属变更，通常被称为“土地掠夺”或“全球土地热潮”，其规模和速度在历史上是前所未有的。在过去十年中，对数百万公顷土地的控制权已转移，用于生产粮食、纤维和生物燃料。然而，关于土地权属变更的快速增长的研究文献，对具有不同生物物理和社会经济特征的多个国家的森林砍伐提供了很少的严格评估。本文基于柬埔寨、埃塞俄比亚、利比里亚和秘鲁的土地交易空间边界，使用基于像素的匹配方法研究其与森林砍伐的关联。我们的研究结果表明，土地交易的情境、规模和分布以及相关的森林砍伐模式在四个国家之间存在显著差异。土地权属变更显著加速了柬埔寨和利比里亚的森林砍伐，但在埃塞俄比亚这种加速不显著。在秘鲁，我们观察到相反的趋势，即土地交易邻近地区的森林砍伐高于土地交易内部地区。我们的分析揭示了土地交易的模式和结果如何与国家特征和背景相关联，并表明关于土地交易对森林砍伐以及可能其他社会环境后果的正面或负面影响的笼统概括需要更密切地关注土地交易的具体模式和驱动因素。

records.title_en: Recreation in coastal environments: Estimating the non-market value of fishing harbors
records.title_cn: 沿海环境中的休闲活动：估算渔港的非市场价值
records.abstract_en: The importance of the fishing sector goes beyond food provisioning, by generating both positive and negative externalities. The benefits on tourism and the recreational appeal of coastal areas are often invoked among the positive externalities, even if their measurement may be hampered by the lack of market information. Non-market valuation methods can thus be useful to quantify the societal importance of fisheries. Here we focus on the recreational value of harbors by applying the travel cost method and analyzing whether small-scale vessels represent an attractive amenity for individuals engaging in outdoor recreation. We use an existing dataset with wide EU coverage, and match information on individuals' number of visits to coastal environments with fishing capacity indicators at the chosen recreational destination. The results suggest that the presence of small-scale capacity (e.g. vessels) increases the attractiveness of coastal locations, as we estimate the loss in recreational value due to a reduction in only one artisanal vessel to be 0.05€ per visit. By monetizing the welfare effects of changes in fishing capacity, these findings can justify the allocation of financial support to the small-scale fishery sector.
records.abstract_cn: 渔业部门的重要性不仅限于食物供给，还通过产生正负外部性体现。旅游业带来的收益和沿海地区的休闲吸引力常被视为正外部性之一，尽管其衡量可能因缺乏市场信息而受阻。因此，非市场价值评估方法可用于量化渔业的社会重要性。本文通过应用旅行成本法，聚焦于渔港的休闲价值，并分析小型渔船是否为参与户外休闲活动的个体提供有吸引力的便利设施。我们使用一个覆盖欧盟范围的现有数据集，将个体访问沿海环境的次数信息与所选休闲目的地的捕捞能力指标进行匹配。结果表明，小型捕捞能力（如渔船）的存在增加了沿海地点的吸引力，因为我们估计仅减少一艘手工渔船导致的休闲价值损失为每次访问0.05欧元。通过将捕捞能力变化的福利效应货币化，这些发现可以为向小型渔业部门分配财政支持提供依据。

records.title_en: Carrot and stick incentive policies for climate change mitigation: A survey experiment on crowding out of public support
records.title_cn: 减缓气候变化的胡萝卜与大棒激励政策：关于公共支持挤出效应的调查实验
records.abstract_en: To motivate public participation in climate change mitigation, both “carrot” policies that create positive incentives for mitigated carbon and “stick” policies that create negative incentives for emitted carbon have been widely applied. Given the joint deployment of these measures, a key question is whether they are compatible with each other. Focusing on the Low-Carbon Reward Scheme (LCRS) and carbon taxes, two prominent proposals on China's climate policy agenda, this study evaluates how one incentive policy affects public support for the other. The results of a large survey experiment with Hangzhou residents indicate a two-way crowding-out effect, wherein introducing the LCRS diminished support for the tax, albeit primarily among LCRS proponents, and introducing the tax reduced support for the LCRS. Aligning with the proposed account, crowding out was driven by a decrease in policy effectiveness and fairness perceptions. These findings reveal a contradictory relationship between carrot and stick policies at the citizen level and illuminate the underlying mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 为激励公众参与减缓气候变化，既广泛采用了为减排碳创造积极激励的“胡萝卜”政策，也采用了为排放碳创造消极激励的“大棒”政策。鉴于这些措施的联合部署，一个关键问题是它们是否相互兼容。本研究聚焦于中国气候政策议程上的两项突出提案——低碳奖励计划（LCRS）和碳税，评估一项激励政策如何影响公众对另一项政策的支持。一项针对杭州居民的大型调查实验结果表明存在双向挤出效应，即引入LCRS降低了对碳税的支持，尽管主要是在LCRS支持者中，而引入碳税则降低了对LCRS的支持。与所提出的解释一致，挤出效应是由政策有效性和公平性感知的下降所驱动的。这些发现揭示了公民层面胡萝卜与大棒政策之间的矛盾关系，并阐明了其潜在机制。

records.title_en: What if Brazilians reduce their beef consumption?
records.title_cn: 如果巴西人减少牛肉消费怎么办？
records.abstract_en: Beef, among all foods, has the greatest environmental impact and is associated with several chronic diseases. Brazil is one of the largest consumers of meat in the world, on par with developed countries and, most of its greenhouse gas emissions stem from deforestation and agricultural activities. Therefore, this article aims to project the economic and environmental impacts of reducing beef consumption due to changes in household preferences and an increase in beef taxes, with and without a revenue neutral mechanism (subsidies applied to food, excluding meat). To analyze this, a dynamic interregional Computable General Equilibrium model was employed, incorporating a land use change module and accounting for substitution between different food items in both consumption and production structure across regions within the Brazilian Amazon, Matopiba, and the rest of Brazil. The results show that a 40% reduction in beef consumption distributed between 2022 and 2050 could prevent deforestation on an area of approximately 65,000 km2, potentially mitigating up to 2.8 GtCO₂e (a third of the world's potential mitigation from dietary changes according to the UN). In the scenario with subsidies, the reduction in deforestation is smaller due to incentives provided to certain commodities that use pasture. Preference changes could have a virtually zero impact on GDP by 2050. Conversely, increased beef taxes could result in an overall rise in costs, leading to a negative impact on exports and GDP (subsidies only attenuate). In all scenarios, regional impacts would be heterogeneous, particularly affecting regions highly dependent on the cattle and beef sector.
records.abstract_cn: 在所有食物中，牛肉对环境的影响最大，并且与多种慢性疾病有关。巴西是世界上最大的肉类消费国之一，与发达国家相当，其大部分温室气体排放来自森林砍伐和农业活动。因此，本文旨在预测在有或没有收入中性机制（对食品（不包括肉类）进行补贴）的情况下，由于家庭偏好的变化和牛肉税的增加而减少牛肉消费的经济和环境影响。为了分析这一点，采用了动态区域间可计算一般均衡模型，纳入了土地利用变化模块，并考虑了巴西亚马逊、马托皮巴和巴西其他地区各地区消费和生产结构中不同食品之间的替代。结果表明，2022 和 2050 之间牛肉消费量的 40% 减少可以防止约 65,000 km2 区域的森林砍伐，从而可能减少高达 2.8 GtCO2e（根据联合国的数据，全球饮食变化可能减少的三分之一）。在有补贴的情况下，由于对某些使用牧场的商品提供了激励，森林砍伐的减少幅度较小。到2050，偏好变化对 GDP 的影响几乎为零。相反，增加牛肉税可能会导致成本总体上升，从而对出口和 GDP 产生负面影响（补贴只会减弱）。在所有情况下，区域影响都是不同的，特别是影响高度依赖牛和牛肉行业的区域。

records.title_en: Convenient solutions, inconvenient truths – Why supermarkets will not drive food system transformation
records.title_cn: 便利的解决方案，不便的真相——为何超市不会推动食品系统转型
records.abstract_en: Supermarkets play an important role in industrialized food systems, which is why many in academia, politics, industry, and civil society view them as key players in transforming the food system toward greater sustainability. We analyse narratives and proposed solutions in this context, as well as the role of supermarkets in Germany, home to some of the largest retailers worldwide. We show that many actors in the German food system, including supermarkets themselves, perceive the structural problems of overproduction and dysfunctional markets as major obstacles to achieving food system transformation. Despite this, they tend to propose solutions focused on optimization and efficiency in supermarket logistics and retail management or greater consumer awareness. These solutions show little transformative potential. Regarding the structural problem of dysfunctional markets, supermarkets are perceived to be in a quandary due to the drive for profits, competitive markets, and consumer demand. Thus, supermarkets are not likely to drive a transformation of the food system.
