records.abstract_cn: 尽管智利最近的收入增长令人印象深刻（现已被世界银行列为“高收入国家”），并且可以使用替代供暖系统，但智利人的人均木材消耗量仍然位居世界前列，这对健康和环境产生了严重影响。在本文中，我们估计了智利家庭使用木柴作为主要住宅供暖系统的收入弹性。我们的估计考虑了该国的气候、地理和社会人口变化；控制多个水平的固定效应和协变量；并考虑选择——因为有些家庭根本不选择任何供暖系统。我们发现，收入增加 10% 会使使用木柴的可能性降低约十分之一个百分点，这是一个统计上显着但经济上微不足道的影响。这一结果与各种稳健性检查一致，为智利基于收入的能源转型极其薄弱提供了证据。这意味着，期望仅通过收入增长来减少柴火使用的被动环境政策将会失败。如果智利政府的目标是降低与木柴使用相关的有害健康和环境后果，他们将不得不采取更积极的方法。

records.title_en: The Shale Revolution and the Dynamics of the Oil Market
records.title_cn: 页岩革命与石油市场动态
records.abstract_en: We build and estimate a dynamic, structural model of the world oil market to quantify the impact of the shale revolution. We model the shale revolution as a decrease in shale production costs and find that the resultant increase in shale production lowers oil prices by 24% in the short run and 48% once the shale oil transition is complete. Current oil price volatility is lowered by 8% to 23% depending on the horizon. We also find that OPEC core acts to keep its market share constant in the face of the dramatic increase in shale production.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建并估计了一个世界石油市场的动态结构模型，以量化页岩革命的影响。我们将页岩革命建模为页岩生产成本下降，并发现由此导致的页岩产量增加在短期内使油价降低24%，而在页岩油转型完成后则降低48%。当前油价波动性根据时间跨度的不同降低了8%至23%。我们还发现，面对页岩产量的急剧增加，OPEC核心国家致力于保持其市场份额不变。

records.title_en: Special Interest Groups Versus Voters and the Political Economics of Attention
records.title_cn: 特殊利益集团与选民及注意力的政治经济学
records.abstract_en: We investigate whether US House representatives favour special interest groups over constituents in periods of low media attention to politics. Analysing 666 roll calls from 2005 to 2018, we show that representatives are more likely to vote against their constituency’s preferred position the more special interest money they receive from groups favouring the opposite position. The latter effect is significantly larger when less attention is paid to politics due to distraction by exogenous newsworthy events like natural disasters. The effect is mostly driven by short-term opportunistic behaviour than the short-term scheduling of controversial votes in periods with high news pressure.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在媒体对政治关注度较低的时期，美国众议院议员是否更倾向于偏袒特殊利益集团而非选民。通过分析2005年至2018年的666次唱名表决，我们发现，议员从支持相反立场的团体那里获得的特殊利益资金越多，他们越有可能投票反对其选区的偏好立场。当由于自然灾害等外部有新闻价值的事件分散注意力而导致对政治的关注度较低时，后一种效应显著更大。这种效应主要由短期机会主义行为驱动，而非在新闻压力大的时期安排有争议投票的短期时间安排。

records.title_en: Bundling Genetic and Financial Technologies for More Resilient and Productive Small-Scale Farmers in Africa
records.title_cn: 捆绑遗传与金融技术以提升非洲小农户的韧性与生产力
records.abstract_en: Using a multi-year, spatially diversified randomised controlled trial spanning two African countries, this paper explores whether a complementary bundle of genetic and financial technologies can boost the resilience and productivity of small-scale farmers. The analysis shows that both moderate droughts and more severe yield losses undermine the resilience of control-group households, and that these shocks have long-lasting effects as farmers invest and produce less following shocks. Severe yield shocks also increase hunger and food insecurity. The genetic technology—drought-tolerant seeds—provides economically significant protection against mid-season drought and mitigates the long-term drop in farm productivity seen in the control group. The financial technology—satellite-based index insurance—offsets the long-term consequences of severe yield losses that are not mitigated by the drought-tolerant seeds. Finally, the analysis shows that treatment-group farmers who experienced shocks and saw the technologies in action subsequently increased their agricultural investment beyond pre-shock levels, an effect we call the resilience dividend. Unfortunately, this apparent experiential learning cuts both ways. Farmers who did not experience the efficacy of the risk management technologies backed away from using them. Our findings thus showcase how genetic and financial risk-mitigating technologies can offer farmers more complete protection, as well as the challenge of inducing sustained uptake of technologies that are midway between experience and credence goods and only infrequently reveal their benefits.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用一项跨越两个非洲国家、多年期、空间多样化的随机对照试验，探讨互补的遗传与金融技术捆绑能否提升小农户的韧性和生产力。分析表明，中度干旱和更严重的产量损失均削弱了对照组家庭的韧性，且这些冲击具有长期影响，因为农户在冲击后投资和产出减少。严重的产量冲击还加剧了饥饿和粮食不安全。遗传技术——耐旱种子——对季中干旱提供了经济上显著的保护，并缓解了对照组中观察到的农场生产力长期下降。金融技术——基于卫星的指数保险——抵消了耐旱种子未能缓解的严重产量损失的长期后果。最后，分析显示，经历冲击并目睹技术发挥作用的处理组农户，随后将其农业投资增加到冲击前水平以上，我们将这一效应称为韧性红利。不幸的是，这种明显的经验学习是双向的。未经历风险管理技术效用的农户则回避使用这些技术。因此，我们的研究结果展示了遗传和金融风险缓解技术如何为农户提供更全面的保护，以及诱导持续采用介于经验品和信任品之间且仅偶尔显现其益处的技术所面临的挑战。

records.title_en: Sharing News Left and Right: Frictions and Misinformation on Twitter
records.title_cn: 左右共享新闻：Twitter上的摩擦与错误信息
records.abstract_en: On 20 October 2020, prior to the US presidential election, Twitter modified its user interface for sharing social media posts. In an effort to reduce the spread of misinformation on the platform, the new interface nudged users to be thoughtful about the content they were sharing. Using data on over 160,000 tweets by US news media outlets, we show that this policy significantly reduced news sharing, but that the reductions varied heterogeneously by political slant: sharing of content fell significantly more for left-wing outlets relative to right-wing outlets. Examining Twitter activity data for news-sharing users, we find that conservatives were less responsive to Twitter’s intervention. Lastly, using web traffic data, we document that the policy significantly reduced visits to news media outlets’ websites.
records.abstract_cn: 在2020年十月20日，美国总统大选之前，Twitter修改了其用于分享社交媒体帖子的用户界面。为了减少平台上错误信息的传播，新界面引导用户在分享内容时更加深思熟虑。利用美国新闻媒体发布的超过160,000条推文数据，我们表明这一政策显著减少了新闻分享，但减少幅度因政治倾向而异：左翼媒体的内容分享下降幅度显著大于右翼媒体。通过检查新闻分享用户的Twitter活动数据，我们发现保守派对Twitter干预的响应程度较低。最后，利用网络流量数据，我们记录了该政策显著减少了新闻媒体网站的访问量。

records.title_en: Telementoring and Homeschooling During School Closures: a Randomised Experiment in Rural Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 学校关闭期间的远程辅导与家庭教育：孟加拉国农村的一项随机实验
records.abstract_en: Using a randomised experiment in 200 Bangladeshi villages, we evaluate the impact of an over-the-phone learning support intervention (telementoring) among primary school children and their mothers during Covid-19 school closures. Post-intervention, treated children scored 35% higher on a standardised test, and the homeschooling involvement of treated mothers increased by 22 minutes per day (26%). We also found that the intervention forestalled treated children's learning losses. When we returned to the participants one year later, after schools briefly reopened, we found that the treatment effects had persisted. Academically weaker children benefited the most from the intervention that only cost USD20 per child.
records.abstract_cn: 利用在孟加拉国200个村庄进行的随机实验，我们评估了在Covid-19学校关闭期间，针对小学生及其母亲的一项电话学习支持干预（远程辅导）的影响。干预后，受治疗儿童在标准化测试中的得分高出35%，受治疗母亲的居家教育参与度每天增加22分钟（26%）。我们还发现，该干预措施阻止了受治疗儿童的学习损失。一年后，当学校短暂重新开放时，我们再次访问参与者，发现治疗效果仍然持续。学业较弱的儿童从这项仅花费每个儿童20美元的干预中受益最多。

records.title_en: Political Language in Economics
records.title_cn: 经济学中的政治语言
records.abstract_en: Does academic writing in economics reflect the political orientation of economists? We use machine learning to measure partisanship in academic economics articles. We predict the observed political behaviour of a subset of economists using phrases from their academic articles, show good out-of-sample predictive accuracy and then predict partisanship for all economists. We then use these predictions to examine patterns of political language in economics. We estimate journal-specific effects on predicted ideology, controlling for author and year fixed effects, that accord with existing survey-based measures. We show considerable sorting of economists into fields of research by predicted partisanship. We also show that partisanship is detectable even within fields, even across those estimating the same theoretical parameter. Using policy-relevant parameters collected from previous meta-analyses, we then show that imputed partisanship is correlated with estimated parameters, such that the implied policy prescription is consistent with partisan leaning. For example, we find that going from the most left-wing authored estimate of the taxable top income elasticity to the most right-wing authored estimate decreases the optimal tax rate from 77% to 60%.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学学术写作是否反映了经济学家的政治倾向？我们使用机器学习来衡量经济学学术文章中的党派性。我们利用一组经济学家的学术文章中的短语来预测他们可观察到的政治行为，显示出良好的样本外预测准确性，然后预测所有经济学家的党派性。接着，我们利用这些预测来考察经济学中的政治语言模式。我们估计了期刊特定效应对预测意识形态的影响，并控制了作者和年份固定效应，这与现有的基于调查的测量结果一致。我们展示了经济学家按预测党派性在研究领域中的显著分类。我们还表明，即使在领域内部，甚至在估计相同理论参数的研究者之间，党派性也是可检测的。利用先前元分析中收集的政策相关参数，我们进一步表明，估算的党派性与估计参数相关，使得隐含的政策建议与党派倾向一致。例如，我们发现，从最左翼作者对可征税最高收入弹性的估计到最右翼作者的估计，最优税率从77%降至60%。

records.title_en: Deceptive Features on Platforms
records.title_cn: 平台上的隐蔽特性
records.abstract_en: Many products sold on online platforms have additional features like fees for services, shipping, luggage, upgrades, and so on. We study when a two-sided platform shrouds additional features towards potentially naive buyers. We explore a novel mechanism according to which platforms shroud to manipulate network externalities between buyers and sellers. Exploring this mechanism, we argue the advent of online marketplaces led to less transparent markets. First, platforms have stronger incentives to shroud seller fees than sellers themselves. Second, platforms shroud their own fees less if they earn more revenue from sellers; so when sellers on the platform compete more fiercely, platforms—somewhat perversely—shroud more. We connect these results to many applications and the current debate on regulating online platforms.
records.abstract_cn: 在线平台上销售的许多产品具有额外特性，如服务费、运费、行李费、升级费等。我们研究双边平台何时会向可能天真的买家隐藏这些额外特性。我们探索了一种新机制，即平台通过隐藏信息来操纵买卖双方之间的网络外部性。通过探索这一机制，我们认为在线市场的出现导致了市场透明度降低。首先，平台隐藏卖家费用的激励比卖家自身更强。其次，如果平台从卖家那里获得更多收入，它们隐藏自身费用的程度会降低；因此，当平台上的卖家竞争更加激烈时，平台——有些反常地——会隐藏更多信息。我们将这些结果与许多应用以及当前关于监管在线平台的辩论联系起来。

records.title_en: Immigration and The Short- and Long-Term Impact of Improved Prenatal Conditions
records.title_cn: 移民与产前条件改善的短期和长期影响
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of immigration from a developing country to a developed country during pregnancy on offspring outcomes. We focus on intermediate- and long-term outcomes, using quasi-experimental variation created by the immigration of Ethiopian Jews to Israel in May 1991. Individuals conceived before immigration experienced dramatic changes in their environmental conditions at different stages of prenatal development depending on their gestational age at migration. We find that females whose mothers immigrated at an earlier gestational age have better educational outcomes. They also tend to work more as adults. In contrast, we do not find any effect among males.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了怀孕期间从发展中国家移民到发达国家对后代结果的影响。我们关注中期和长期结果，利用1991年五月埃塞俄比亚犹太人移民到以色列所创造的准实验变异。在移民前受孕的个体，根据其移民时的胎龄，在产前发育的不同阶段经历了环境条件的剧烈变化。我们发现，母亲在较早胎龄移民的女性有更好的教育结果。她们成年后也倾向于工作更多。相比之下，我们在男性中没有发现任何影响。

records.title_en: Accommodating the Rise in Urbanisation: Are New Towns a Good Solution?
records.title_cn: 适应城市化进程的崛起：新城是好的解决方案吗？
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the performance of New Towns, that is, planned large urban sub-centres, as a central tool to accommodate the global rise in urbanisation. A spatial quantifiable general equilibrium framework suitable to study large-scale urban master plans is presented. The framework is then used to investigate the equilibrium effects of five New Towns developed in the 1970s in Paris’s metropolitan area. By 2015, the development of New Towns appears to have increased metropolitan population ($+$18%), metropolitan gross domestic product ($+$11%) and reduced average commuting times (−6.9%). The results obtained for Paris’s metropolitan area are externally validated using a difference-in-differences approach on all 314 New Towns developed worldwide between 1992 and 2012.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了新城（即规划的大型城市副中心）作为适应全球城市化进程崛起的核心工具的表现。文中提出了一个适用于研究大规模城市总体规划的空间可量化一般均衡框架。该框架随后被用于研究巴黎大都市区在1970年开发的五个新城的均衡效应。到2015年，新城的发展似乎增加了大都市人口（$+$18%）、大都市国内生产总值（$+$11%），并减少了平均通勤时间（−6.9%）。通过使用双重差分方法对1992年至2012年间全球开发的314个新城进行外部验证，巴黎大都市区所得结果得到了验证。

records.title_en: Kinship Taxation as an Impediment to Growth: Experimental Evidence from Kenyan Microenterprises
records.title_cn: 亲属税作为增长的障碍：来自肯尼亚微型企业的实验证据
records.abstract_en: This paper documents strong pressure to share income faced by entrepreneurs in a developing country setting. This ‘kinship tax’ can distort productive decisions, including investment. A lab experiment with 361 Kenyan entrepreneurs reveals that a third of them face distortionary pressure to share income. This kinship tax is higher for men, and increasing in entrepreneurial ability. Using a pre-existing randomised cash transfer experiment, I find that only male entrepreneurs who do not face distortionary kinship taxation invest these transfers. Imposing some parametric assumptions, I estimate that kinship taxation decreases aggregate productivity among firms in this sample by one-quarter.
records.abstract_cn: 本文记录了发展中国家环境中企业家面临的分享收入的强大压力。这种“亲属税”可能扭曲生产决策，包括投资。一项针对361名肯尼亚企业家的实验室实验显示，其中三分之一面临分享收入的扭曲性压力。这种亲属税对男性更高，并随企业家能力增强而增加。利用一项预先存在的随机现金转移实验，我发现只有不面临扭曲性亲属税的男性企业家才会投资这些转移资金。在施加一些参数假设的情况下，我估计亲属税使该样本中企业的总生产率降低了四分之一。

records.title_en: Why High Incentives Cause Repugnance: a Framed Field Experiment
records.title_cn: 为什么高激励会引起反感：一个框架田野实验
records.abstract_en: Why are high monetary payments prohibited for certain goods, thereby causing shortages in their supply? I conduct (i) a framed field experiment with a general population sample and (ii) a survey experiment with this sample and with ethics committees. In the experiment, participants can prohibit others from being offered money to register as stem-cell donors. I document that, whereas the majority of participants do not respond to changes in the incentives (63%) or become more in favour of the offer with higher incentives (20%), a minority of 17% prohibit high incentives. I show that this minority wants to protect individuals who are persuaded by high incentives. I also show that a lottery scheme reduces their objections to high incentives. Finally, I document that the public is much more supportive of high incentives than are ethics committees.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么某些商品禁止高额货币支付，从而导致其供应短缺？我进行了（i）一个针对普通人群样本的框架田野实验和（ii）一个针对该样本及伦理委员会的调查实验。在实验中，参与者可以禁止他人被提供金钱以登记为干细胞捐赠者。我记录到，尽管大多数参与者对激励变化没有反应（63%）或随着激励提高而更加支持该提议（20%），但少数参与者（17%）禁止高激励。我表明，这一少数群体希望保护那些被高激励所说服的个人。我还表明，抽奖方案减少了他们对高激励的反对。最后，我记录到公众对高激励的支持程度远高于伦理委员会。

records.title_en: Borrowing Constraints and Demand for Remedial Education: Evidence from Tanzania
records.title_cn: 借贷约束与补习教育需求：来自坦桑尼亚的证据
records.abstract_en: We use a cash transfer to relax households’ borrowing constraints, then elicit their willingness to pay for a remedial education programme offering tutoring and life skills training. Lottery losers were willing to pay 3,300 Tanzanian Shillings for the programme, which is 7% of per capita monthly expenditures. For those identified at baseline as able to borrow, willingness to pay increases by 3% upon winning a lottery prize of 3,200 Tanzanian Shillings. For those unable to borrow, willingness to pay increases by 27% upon winning the lottery. We conclude that borrowing constraints limit access to educational programmes, and may increase inequality of educational attainment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用现金转移来放松家庭的借贷约束，然后引出他们对提供辅导和生活技能培训的补习教育项目的支付意愿。彩票输家愿意为该计划支付3,300坦桑尼亚先令，这相当于人均月支出的7%。对于在基线时被识别为能够借贷的人，赢得3,200坦桑尼亚先令的彩票奖金后，支付意愿增加了3%。对于无法借贷的人，赢得彩票后支付意愿增加了27%。我们得出结论，借贷约束限制了教育项目的获取，并可能加剧教育成就的不平等。

records.title_en: Spending and Pricing to Deter Arbitrage
records.title_cn: 支出与定价以阻止套利
records.abstract_en: This article presents examples of arbitrage deterrence from the pharmaceutical, chemical and auto industries. Based on these cases, it develops two models where a monopolist prices and spends to deter arbitrage. The models differ in whether the lower price is set by the firm or negotiated with a representative of consumers. In both models, imports into the high-price market are completely deterred, but the two markets are nonetheless linked by the threat of arbitrage. If this linkage is ignored and the absence of arbitrage is misattributed to exogenous factors, econometric estimates of firm bargaining power will be biased upwards.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了来自制药、化工和汽车行业的套利阻止案例。基于这些案例，本文构建了两个模型，其中垄断者通过定价和支出来阻止套利。这两个模型的区别在于较低价格是由企业设定还是与消费者代表协商确定。在两个模型中，高价市场的进口被完全阻止，但两个市场仍然通过套利的威胁而联系在一起。如果忽略这种联系，并将套利的缺失错误地归因于外生因素，那么对企业议价能力的计量经济学估计将存在向上偏误。

records.title_en: Guarantee employment or guarantee wage? Firm-level evidence from China
records.title_cn: 保就业还是保工资？来自中国的企业层面证据
records.abstract_en: This study investigates how firms respond to the economic shock and discusses policy implication that whether the government should prioritize guaranteeing employment or guaranteeing wage. Using a comprehensive dataset, our research reveals negative effects of lockdown policies on firms' performance. In response, firms opted to reduce employment rather than cut wages. This strategy remained consistent across various types of firms and different lockdown measures. However, reducing employment without cutting wage is superficial. In fact, firms internally reduced the employment of informal workers, so that to stabilize the wages of formal employees. This study sheds light on the phenomenon of increased unemployment and income inequality during the pandemic, and advocates for prioritizing vulnerable groups to ensure their employment.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了企业如何应对经济冲击，并讨论了政府应优先保障就业还是保障工资的政策含义。利用一个全面的数据集，我们的研究揭示了封锁政策对企业绩效的负面影响。作为回应，企业选择减少就业而非削减工资。这一策略在各种类型的企业和不同的封锁措施中保持一致。然而，在不削减工资的情况下减少就业是表面的。事实上，企业在内部减少了非正式工人的就业，以稳定正式员工的工资。本研究揭示了疫情期间失业率上升和收入不平等加剧的现象，并主张优先考虑弱势群体以确保其就业。

records.title_en: Uniform agricultural tax abolition and differential household labor supply: Evidence from China's urban household survey
records.title_cn: 统一农业税取消与家庭劳动供给差异：来自中国城镇住户调查的证据
records.abstract_en: Uniform government public policy has steadily shaped the labor supply from households in the past few decades in China with possible differential impact on each parent. This paper investigates how uniform tax policy change plays differential roles in household's labor supply through government public education spending. Utilizing the exogenous shock from China's agricultural tax abolition in 2005, we find that the abolition results in a reduction in female employment but an increase in male employment. Specifically, a 1% increase of agricultural tax to public revenue ratio in the reference year leads to a 0.485% labor supply reduction and 1.50 fewer hours of work per month for married women, whereas the married men's labor supply increases by 0.191% and their working hours by 1.06 h in a typical urban family with school-going children. The effects are greater on married women with primary school-age children and married men from high-asset households. Our mechanism analysis indicates that public education spending works as a substitute for private education spending and affects the household labor supply through investment in children's human capital. Our findings offer a new perspective on the decreasing female labor supply and the widening employment gap between (married) women and (married) men in the Chinese labor market. The findings suggest that public tax policy could lead to unintended consequences on household's labor supply decisions, and thus exacerbate the gender employment gap in the labor market.
records.abstract_cn: 过去几十年中，统一的政府公共政策稳步塑造了中国家庭的劳动供给，并可能对父母双方产生不同的影响。本文研究了统一的税收政策变化如何通过政府公共教育支出在家庭劳动供给中发挥差异化作用。利用2005年中国农业税取消的外生冲击，我们发现取消农业税导致女性就业减少，但男性就业增加。具体而言，参考年份农业税占公共收入比例每增加1%，会导致已婚女性劳动供给减少0.485%，每月工作时间减少1.50小时，而在有学龄儿童的典型城市家庭中，已婚男性的劳动供给增加0.191%，工作时间增加1.06小时。对于有小学学龄儿童的已婚女性和高资产家庭的已婚男性，影响更大。我们的机制分析表明，公共教育支出作为私人教育支出的替代品，通过投资于子女的人力资本影响家庭劳动供给。我们的发现为解释中国劳动力市场中女性劳动供给下降以及（已婚）女性和（已婚）男性之间就业差距扩大提供了新的视角。研究结果表明，公共税收政策可能对家庭劳动供给决策产生意想不到的后果，从而加剧劳动力市场中的性别就业差距。

records.title_en: Economic geography of talent migration and agglomeration in China: A dual-driver framework
records.title_cn: 中国人才迁移与集聚的经济地理：双驱动框架
records.abstract_en: The long-standing debate on the role of economic factors and amenities on talent migration and redistribution foreshadows the importance of spatial economic theoretical thinking in resolving the effects of duality, a point yet to be conclusively addressed in the existing literature. Situated within the framework of new economic geography (NEG), this article introduces an innovative theoretical model – the Dual-Driver (DD) framework– aiming at comprehending the nuanced dual impact of economic and amenity factors on talent movements between regions. While the DD framework retains the mechanisms of increasing returns to scale, iceberg transportation cost, and talent agglomeration presented in the NEG models, it depicts, for the first time, the self-reinforcing mechanisms between non-traded goods (i.e., amenities) and talent agglomeration. The model describes a logic of talent movements influenced by the dual drivers of regional economic factors (nominal wage, the diversity of local manufacturing products) and amenities (the diversity and quality of amenities, transfer payment for talent), among which the economic effects play a predominant role versus the amenity effects. Empirical evidence has been given by the geographical analysis of China's internal talent migration between 2000 and 2015 and the corresponding econometric analysis using the Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood (PPML) estimation. Our findings furnish a theoretical perspective for comprehending talent geography and offer policy insights into China's logic of talent migration.
records.abstract_cn: 关于经济因素和便利设施在人才迁移与再分配中作用的长期争论，预示着空间经济理论思考在解决二元性效应中的重要性，这一点在现有文献中尚未得到最终解决。本文置于新经济地理学（NEG）框架内，引入了一个创新性的理论模型——双驱动（DD）框架，旨在理解经济与便利设施因素对区域间人才流动的细微二元影响。虽然DD框架保留了NEG模型中呈现的规模报酬递增、冰山运输成本和人才集聚机制，但它首次描绘了非贸易品（即便利设施）与人才集聚之间的自我强化机制。该模型描述了一种受区域经济因素（名义工资、本地制造业产品多样性）和便利设施（便利设施的多样性与质量、人才转移支付）双驱动影响的人才流动逻辑，其中经济效应相对于便利设施效应起主导作用。通过对2000年至2015年间中国国内人才迁移的地理分析以及使用泊松伪极大似然（PPML）估计的相应计量经济学分析，提供了经验证据。我们的发现为理解人才地理提供了理论视角，并为中国人才迁移逻辑提供了政策启示。

records.title_en: Relationship between health behavior compliance and prospect theory-based risk preferences during a pandemic of COVID-19
records.title_cn: COVID-19疫情期间健康行为遵从与基于前景理论的风险偏好之间的关系
records.abstract_en: The outbreak of COVID-19 forced people to change their lifestyles. In this study, a questionnaire was administered to 1000 Chinese residents to investigate the effects of risk preferences based on prospect theory from behavioral economics, trust in a trust game, other people's expectations, and personal attributes on the adherence to quarantine measures during a pandemic.
records.abstract_cn: COVID-19的爆发迫使人们改变生活方式。本研究对1000名中国居民进行了问卷调查，以调查基于行为经济学前景理论的风险偏好、信任博弈中的信任、他人的期望以及个人属性对疫情期间隔离措施遵从度的影响。

records.title_en: Does cross-border investment improve mutual fund performance? Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 跨境投资是否提升了共同基金业绩？来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we analyze how Chinese mutual funds' performance is affected by cross-border investments, following the relaxation of investment restrictions on Hong Kong stocks. We find that mutual funds underperform when they increase their H-share holdings, suggesting that easing investment restrictions doesn't improve fund performance. Information asymmetry and the limited ability of fund managers to access H-share information are key factors behind poor performance. And fund managers employ such “bad” strategy to cater to investor preferences. Furthermore, fund managers do not recognize their limitations in investing H-share. We hope our findings give insights into the investment behavior of funds and enhance the development of the Chinese asset management industry.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们分析了中国共同基金的业绩如何受到跨境投资的影响，这是在放宽对香港股票投资限制之后。我们发现，当共同基金增加其H股持有量时，其业绩表现不佳，这表明放宽投资限制并未改善基金业绩。信息不对称和基金经理获取H股信息的能力有限是业绩不佳的关键因素。而基金经理采用这种“糟糕”的策略是为了迎合投资者的偏好。此外，基金经理并未认识到其在投资H股方面的局限性。我们希望我们的发现能为基金的投资行为提供见解，并促进中国资产管理行业的发展。

records.title_en: Pro-poor consumption effects of trade liberalization: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 贸易自由化的亲贫消费效应：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of trade liberalization on the consumption welfare of urban households in China. The results indicate that trade liberalization in consumer goods has improved the consumption welfare of Chinese urban households with a “pro-poor” distribution across regions and households in a region, suggesting that the consumption effects are more pronounced for less developed regions and low-income households in a region. Within a city, differences in the consumption effects arise from variations in household consumption structures and the tariff-price pass-through among different types of products. Across cities, differences in the consumption effects stem from the dual heterogeneity in industrial structure and consumer demand. The variety effect resulting from changes in the types of imported consumer goods also enhances the consumption effects of trade liberalization.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了贸易自由化对中国城市家庭消费福利的影响。结果表明，消费品贸易自由化提高了中国城市家庭的消费福利，且在地区和地区内家庭之间具有“亲贫”分布，表明消费效应在欠发达地区和低收入家庭中更为显著。在城市内部，消费效应的差异源于家庭消费结构和不同类型产品关税-价格传导的差异。在城市之间，消费效应的差异源于产业结构与消费需求的双重异质性。进口消费品类型变化带来的品种效应也增强了贸易自由化的消费效应。

records.title_en: Nonmonetary awards and innovation: Evidence from winning China's Top Brand Contest
records.title_cn: 非货币奖励与创新：来自赢得中国名牌评选的证据
records.abstract_en: We use the short-lived, but high-profile, China Top Brand Award to examine the causal effects of nonmonetary awards on firm innovation. To do so, we create a panel dataset by matching official China Top Brand Award recipients to the innovation outputs of listed companies. Results from difference-in-differences estimates show that firms that received the China Top Brand Award have a higher number, and better quality, of filed patents. We find that the positive effects of winning the China Top Brand Award on innovation outputs operate through higher government subsidies to winning firms. We also find that the positive effects of award-winning are stronger among state-owned enterprises, larger enterprises, and better-performing enterprises, as well as in provinces with stronger intellectual property rights protection. Our results are robust to a series of sensitivity checks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用短暂但备受瞩目的中国名牌评选来考察非货币奖励对企业创新的因果效应。为此，我们通过将官方中国名牌评选获奖者与上市公司的创新产出相匹配，构建了一个面板数据集。双重差分估计结果显示，获得中国名牌的企业其专利申请数量更多，质量也更高。我们发现，赢得中国名牌评选对创新产出的积极影响是通过提高对获奖企业的政府补贴来实现的。我们还发现，获奖的积极效应在国有企业、大型企业和绩效较好的企业中更为显著，并且在知识产权保护较强的省份中也是如此。我们的结果在一系列敏感性检验中保持稳健。

records.title_en: Life is too short to be small: An experiment on mortality salience and prosocial behavior
records.title_cn: 人生苦短，不应渺小：关于死亡显著性及亲社会行为的实验
records.abstract_en: We study how mortality salience influences people's time preference and prosocial behavior in a laboratory experiment. We made mortality salient through priming subjects in the treatment group with grid tasks, and studied its impact on altruistic giving in an Andreoni-Miller dictator game. We found that the priming made subjects think bigger, and become more concerned with the overall social welfare, though it did not necessarily make them care more about their opponents' well-being per se. Subjects in the treatment group became more altruistic only when the price of giving is low. We built a two-period model to explain the mechanism of the findings. Our model showed that the priming altered altruistic giving through changing the subjects' time preference and social preference parameters. Finally, we strengthened our findings by showing that the priming didn't change subjects' mood.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在实验室实验中研究死亡显著性如何影响人们的时间偏好和亲社会行为。我们通过让处理组受试者完成网格任务来使死亡显著性凸显，并研究其对安德烈奥尼-米勒独裁者游戏中利他性给予的影响。我们发现，这种启动效应使受试者思考更宏大，更加关注整体社会福利，尽管这并不一定意味着他们更关心对手本身的福祉。处理组受试者仅在给予代价较低时变得更加利他。我们构建了一个两期模型来解释这些发现的机制。我们的模型表明，启动效应通过改变受试者的时间偏好和社会偏好参数来改变利他性给予。最后，我们通过证明启动效应并未改变受试者的情绪来强化我们的发现。

records.title_en: Long-term care insurance coverage and labor force participation of older people: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 长期护理保险覆盖与老年人劳动参与：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Many scholars attribute the slowdown of economic growth to population aging and its negative impact on the size of the labor force. Meanwhile, government programs targeting an aging society can generate work disincentives. This paper studies the unintended labor market effects of Long-term Care Insurance (LTCI) among people of older age by exploiting the launch of the LTCI program in China. We find that policy-covered older adults decreased labor market engagement, significantly increasing the probability of exiting the labor market completely or not working full-time. We also document more substantial effects among those with low income, poor health, advanced age, and few children. The forgone wages of older adults account for >0.25% of GDP. These findings have policy implications for countries “growing old before getting rich.”
records.abstract_cn: 许多学者将经济增长放缓归因于人口老龄化及其对劳动力规模的负面影响。同时，针对老龄化社会的政府项目可能产生工作抑制效应。本文利用中国长期护理保险（LTCI）项目的启动，研究了长期护理保险对老年人非预期的劳动力市场影响。我们发现，政策覆盖的老年人减少了劳动力市场参与，显著增加了完全退出劳动力市场或非全职工作的概率。我们还记录了在低收入、健康状况差、高龄和子女少的人群中更为显著的影响。老年人放弃的工资占GDP的>0.25%。这些发现对“未富先老”的国家具有政策启示。

records.title_en: Estimation of industry-level basic digital capital services in China: A variable depreciation rate estimation method based on DSGE
records.title_cn: 中国行业层面基础数字资本服务估算：基于DSGE的可变折旧率估算方法
records.abstract_en: Accurately measuring the input of digital capital is of great significance for understanding the development pattern of China's digital economy, nurturing new quality productivity, and achieving high-quality development. However, existing representative studies often assume a constant depreciation rate for capital goods, which does not align with reality. In this paper, we address this limitation by introducing dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model that estimates the variable depreciation rate for each capital good. By setting the depreciation rate as a function of capital maintenance expenditures and utilization rates, we provide a more realistic approach. The empirical results obtained through Monte Carlo simulation demonstrate that the trend of depreciation rates for all types of capital goods aligns with China's economic development. Additionally, we find that investment-specific technology shock plays a significant role in affecting changes in the depreciation rates of capital goods. This shock leads to an increase in capital utilization rates and a decrease in capital maintenance expenditures, resulting in higher depreciation rates. Notably, the depreciation rate of basic digital capital is more sensitive to exogenous shock compared to non-digital capital. Furthermore, the paper estimates the basic digital capital service of 19 industries in China from 1981 to 2020. The results indicate a steady increase in the services provided by basic digital capital, with particularly rapid growth observed in industries such as information transmission, software and information technology services, and the financial sector. When comparing our estimation results with those of representative literature, we find that the national-level productive capital stock and the basic digital capital services estimated using our methodology closely align with existing literature. This validation confirms the effectiveness of our methodology and the reliability of the estimated industry-level basic digital capital services.
records.abstract_cn: 准确测算数字资本投入对于理解中国数字经济发展格局、培育新质生产力以及实现高质量发展具有重要意义。然而，现有代表性研究往往假设资本品折旧率恒定，这与现实不符。本文通过引入动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型来估算每种资本品的可变折旧率，从而弥补了这一局限性。通过将折旧率设定为资本维护支出和利用率的函数，我们提供了一种更贴近现实的方法。蒙特卡洛模拟得到的实证结果表明，各类资本品折旧率的变动趋势与中国经济发展相吻合。此外，我们发现投资专用技术冲击在影响资本品折旧率变化方面发挥着重要作用。这种冲击导致资本利用率上升和资本维护支出下降，从而使得折旧率提高。值得注意的是，基础数字资本的折旧率相对于非数字资本对外生冲击更为敏感。进一步地，本文估算了中国19个行业从1981年到2020年的基础数字资本服务。结果表明，基础数字资本提供的服务稳步增长，其中信息传输、软件和信息技术服务业以及金融业等行业增长尤为迅速。将我们的估算结果与代表性文献的估算结果进行比较，我们发现使用我们的方法估算的全国层面生产性资本存量和基础数字资本服务与现有文献高度吻合。这一验证证实了我们方法的有效性以及所估算的行业层面基础数字资本服务的可靠性。

records.title_en: The hidden cost of corporate tax cuts: Evidence from worker health in China
records.title_cn: 企业减税的隐性成本：来自中国工人健康的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite extensive research on the impact of corporate tax cuts on firm-level outcomes, their effects on worker health have yet to be examined. This study aims to address this research gap by utilizing individual-level panel data from the China Family Panel Studies between 2010 and 2018, and by exploiting exogenous shock in the corporate effective tax burden stemming from accelerated depreciation. Our results yield three key findings: first, that corporate tax cuts significantly reduce worker health; second, that this effect may be driven by increased working hours and poor health behaviors; third, that corporate tax cuts exacerbate health inequalities based on gender, education level, executive positions, and employed company. These findings shed light on the wider implications of tax incentives for corporate investment and contribute to stimulating interest in the welfare of workers in a global wave of tax cuts.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管关于企业减税对企业层面结果的影响已有广泛研究，但其对工人健康的影响尚未得到考察。本研究旨在通过利用中国家庭追踪调查2010年至2018年间的个体层面面板数据，并利用加速折旧带来的企业有效税负的外生冲击来填补这一研究空白。我们的结果得出三个关键发现：第一，企业减税显著降低工人健康；第二，这一效应可能由工作时间增加和不良健康行为驱动；第三，企业减税加剧了基于性别、教育水平、高管职位和受雇公司的健康不平等。这些发现揭示了税收激励对企业投资的更广泛影响，并有助于在全球减税浪潮中激发对工人福利的关注。

records.title_en: Innovation Like China: Evidence from Chinese Local Officials' Promotions
records.title_cn: 像中国一样创新：来自中国地方官员晋升的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate how cadre incentives within political organizations affect innovation activities in China. Analyzing prefecture-level data between 2006 and 2015, we find that prefecture-level mayors are more likely to be promoted in regions with a strong innovation performance, as indicated by the number of patents, especially in prefectures with strict innovation evaluations. We also identify inter-jurisdictional competition among local governments in the field of technological innovation, which is reflected in competition over the number of patents. We show that this competition effect holds after controlling for knowledge spillover effects. Our study highlights the important role of political incentives of government officials in promoting innovation in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了政治组织内的干部激励如何影响中国的创新活动。通过分析2006年至2015年间的地级市数据，我们发现，在创新表现强劲的地区，地级市市长更有可能获得晋升，这一表现以专利数量为指标，尤其是在创新评估严格的地级市。我们还识别了地方政府在技术创新领域的跨辖区竞争，这反映在专利数量的竞争上。我们表明，在控制知识溢出效应后，这种竞争效应仍然存在。我们的研究强调了政府官员的政治激励在促进发展中国家创新中的重要作用。

records.title_en: Effect of ethnic stereotype threat on academic performance: Experimental evidence from rural China
records.title_cn: 种族刻板印象威胁对学业成绩的影响：来自中国农村的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Ethnic stereotype threat is a feeling of being at risk of perceiving a negative stereotype about one's ethnicity. Conducting a lab-in-the-field experiment at 126 rural primary schools in northwest China with a sample of 10,431 students from grade 4 and grade 5, this paper examines the effects of ethnic stereotype threat on students' academic performance. We find that stereotype threat improved minority students' English test scores and had no effect on Han students. Investigations for underlying mechanisms show that stereotype threat improves the ethnic pride of minority students, further improving their English test scores. Heterogeneous analysis shows that the positive effects of stereotype threat on English performance are more evident for minority students whose English teachers are from Han, and also more evident for minority students whose best friends of different ethnicities have higher grades than them. This study provides evidence to support the benefits of inter-ethnic communication and integration among multi-ethnic settings at school.
records.abstract_cn: 种族刻板印象威胁是一种面临对自己种族持有负面刻板印象的风险的感觉。本文以4和5年级的10,431名学生为样本，在中国西北地区126农村小学进行了一项现场实验室实验，探讨了种族刻板印象威胁对学生学业成绩的影响。我们发现刻板印象威胁提高了少数民族学生的英语考试成绩，而对汉族学生没有影响。对潜在机制的调查表明，刻板印象威胁提高了少数族裔学生的民族自豪感，进一步提高了他们的英语考试成绩。异质性分析表明，刻板印象威胁对英语成绩的正向影响对于英语教师为汉族的少数民族学生更为明显，对于不同民族最好的朋友成绩比他们高的少数民族学生也更加明显。这项研究提供了证据来支持学校多种族环境中种族间交流和融合的好处。

records.title_en: The impact of capital goods trade liberalization on regional labor market in China
records.title_cn: 资本品贸易自由化对中国区域劳动力市场的影响
records.abstract_en: The impact of trade liberalization on regional employment dynamics remains a topic of ongoing debate and scrutiny. This study aims to provide a nuanced understanding by focusing specifically on the effects of imported capital goods trade. Our study analysis reveals that capital goods trade liberalization predominantly leads to a substitution effect between capital and labor, resulting in a reduction in overall regional employment levels. However, we also find complementary effects between capital and high-skilled labor, alongside substitution effects on low-skilled labor, which collectively influence the regional labor market's skill structure. Furthermore, our study identifies the heterogeneous spillover effects of capital goods trade liberalization on regional labor markets, varying across different regions and city scales. We argue that investing in region skill development resources can help align the workforce with global factors, fostering positive interaction between regions.
records.abstract_cn: 贸易自由化对区域就业动态的影响仍是一个持续争论和审视的话题。本研究旨在通过特别关注进口资本品贸易的影响，提供细致入微的理解。我们的研究分析揭示，资本品贸易自由化主要导致资本与劳动之间的替代效应，从而降低区域整体就业水平。然而，我们也发现资本与高技能劳动之间存在互补效应，同时对低技能劳动存在替代效应，这些共同影响区域劳动力市场的技能结构。此外，我们的研究识别了资本品贸易自由化对区域劳动力市场的异质性溢出效应，这些效应在不同地区和城市规模之间有所差异。我们认为，投资于区域技能发展资源有助于使劳动力与全球因素保持一致，促进区域间的积极互动。

records.title_en: College peer effects on learning behaviors in synchronous online courses
records.title_cn: 同步在线课程中大学同伴效应对学习行为的影响
records.abstract_en: This study contributes to the growing body of research on peer effects in educational contexts by examining the peer effects on learning behaviors, which are pivotal in understanding how peers impact academic achievements, especially in online education. Drawing upon an administrative dataset and a learning behavior dataset from an online education platform at a Chinese research university in 2020, we employ fixed effects and dynamic models to investigate the peer effects on undergraduates' class absence. Notably, we further consider partially overlapping networks of peers and utilize the class absence of “classmates of classmates” (who are not one's own classmates) as instrumental variables for peers' absence to address potential estimation biases. Our findings reveal significantly positive effects of classmates' class absence on individuals' both full-class and part-class absence in synchronous online courses. Additionally, heterogeneity analyses show that males, freshmen and sophomore students are more susceptible to peer influence and exhibit greater influence on their peers, and peer effects are stronger in subject required courses, courses with larger class sizes, courses with mandatory attendance policies, and among students in the same department or grade level.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究通过考察同伴效应对学习行为的影响，为教育情境中同伴效应的日益增长的研究文献做出贡献，这对于理解同伴如何影响学业成就至关重要，尤其是在在线教育中。基于一所中国研究型大学在线教育平台在2020年的行政数据集和学习行为数据集，我们采用固定效应和动态模型来研究同伴效应对本科生缺课行为的影响。值得注意的是，我们进一步考虑了部分重叠的同伴网络，并利用“同学的同学们”（即非自己同学的人）的缺课情况作为同伴缺课的工具变量，以解决潜在的估计偏差。我们的研究结果显示，在同步在线课程中，同学的缺课行为对个体全课缺课和部分缺课均有显著的正向影响。此外，异质性分析表明，男生、大一和大二学生更容易受到同伴影响，并对同伴产生更大的影响；同伴效应在专业必修课、班级规模较大的课程、有强制出勤政策的课程以及同系或同年级的学生中更为显著。

records.title_en: Tax incentives and firm social insurance contributions: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 税收激励与企业社会保险缴费：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Tax incentives are closely related to employees' income. The relationship between tax incentives and firm social insurance contributions is underexplored in existing literature. We construct a theoretical model to portray the impact of tax incentives on firm social security contributions and use China's accelerated depreciation policy for fixed assets (AD reform) to test it empirically. We find that the tax incentives effectively increase the social security contributions of firms. This effect is more pronounced in large firms, firms with high capital intensity, firms with strong bargaining power of employees, and firms with social security contributions levied by the social security department. Moreover, the AD reform promotes improvements in firm productivity and performance by increasing investment in machinery and equipment, increasing the rents shared by firms with employees, and thus indirectly boosting firms' social security contributions. Overall, Our findings contribute to a deeper understanding of rent-sharing between firms and employees, as well as enhancing our understanding of the effective incidence of taxes in less developed regions.
records.abstract_cn: 税收激励与员工收入密切相关。现有文献中关于税收激励与企业社会保险缴费之间的关系尚未得到充分探讨。我们构建了一个理论模型来描述税收激励对企业社会保障缴费的影响，并利用中国固定资产加速折旧政策（AD改革）进行实证检验。我们发现税收激励有效增加了企业的社会保障缴费。这一效应在大企业、资本密集度高、员工议价能力强以及由社会保障部门征收社会保险缴费的企业中更为显著。此外，AD改革通过增加机械设备投资、增加企业与员工共享的租金，从而间接促进企业社会保障缴费，进而推动企业生产率和绩效的提升。总体而言，我们的研究有助于更深入地理解企业与员工之间的租金共享，以及增强我们对欠发达地区税收有效归宿的理解。

records.title_en: Diet in China during substantial economic growth: Quality, inequality, trends, and determinants
records.title_cn: 中国经济快速增长时期的饮食：质量、不平等、趋势及决定因素
records.abstract_en: This study investigates inequality in diets in China during its economic growth using data from the China Health and Nutrition Survey (1997–2011). Overall, diet quality was significantly improved over the 14 years, as indicated by the increasing mean of Chinese Healthy Eating Index (CHEI) scores from 40.76 in 1997 to 54.52 in 2011. Initially, dietary improvement favored affluent populations, leading to widening inequality, but it became more equitable in later years. Socioeconomic factors are critical determinants of inequality in diets, with urban-rural disparity being a significant barrier to equalizing diet quality. The results of the Oaxaca decomposition indicate that changes in inequality in diets are primarily driven by the extent to which nutritional choices respond to income fluctuations rather than the actual change in income itself. While women exhibited lower inequality in diets quality compared to men, they were more likely to be situated at a relatively lower level of diet quality. Furthermore, differences in health insurance coverage also play a significant role in the changes observed in inequality in diets. This study highlights the importance of considering income elasticity and its influence on dietary behaviors when examining the dynamics of income-based inequality in diets. Non-dietary factors, including basic health insurance and rural development initiatives, are essential in addressing the developing challenge of inequality in diets during economic growth phases.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用中国健康与营养调查（1997-2011年）的数据，考察了中国经济增长期间饮食不平等的情况。总体而言，饮食质量在14年间显著改善，中国健康饮食指数（CHEI）的平均得分从1997年的40.76上升到2011年的54.52。最初，饮食改善有利于富裕人群，导致不平等扩大，但在后期变得更加公平。社会经济因素是饮食不平等的关键决定因素，其中城乡差距是实现饮食质量均等化的重大障碍。Oaxaca分解结果表明，饮食不平等的变化主要受营养选择对收入波动的反应程度驱动，而非收入本身的实际变化。尽管女性在饮食质量方面的不平等程度低于男性，但她们更可能处于相对较低的饮食质量水平。此外，健康保险覆盖率的差异也在观察到的饮食不平等变化中发挥着重要作用。本研究强调了在考察基于收入的饮食不平等动态时，考虑收入弹性及其对饮食行为影响的重要性。非饮食因素，包括基本健康保险和农村发展举措，对于应对经济增长阶段饮食不平等的挑战至关重要。

records.title_en: Air pollution, weather, and agricultural worker productivity
records.title_cn: 空气污染、天气与农业工人生产率
records.abstract_en: Outdoor agricultural workers often work in harsh environmental conditions, including high temperatures and poor air quality. This paper studies how these factors impact worker productivity, which can have implications for worker health, well‐being, and income as well as farm payroll, production, and profitability. Our analysis uses 6 years of payroll records of harvesters on two large farms combined with pollution and weather monitor data from multiple sources. We address simultaneity issues by exploring pollution measurements from nearby upwind and downwind monitors and incorporating an alternative PM 2.5 measure that better captures ambient or regional concentration. Across all specifications, results suggest that heightened concentrations of ground‐level ozone and PM 2.5 are associated with reduced productivity. In our main specification, we find that one standard deviation increases in ozone and PM 2.5 are associated with reductions in productivity of 2% and 1.1%, respectively.
records.abstract_cn: 户外农业工人经常在恶劣的环境条件下工作，包括高温和空气质量差。本文研究这些因素如何影响工人生产率，这可能对工人健康、福祉和收入以及农场工资、生产和盈利能力产生影响。我们的分析使用了两个大型农场收割机工人6年的工资记录，并结合了来自多个来源的污染和天气监测数据。我们通过探索附近上风和下风监测点的污染测量值，并纳入一个更好的PM 2.5替代测量值来捕捉环境或区域浓度，从而解决同时性问题。在所有规格中，结果表明地面臭氧和PM 2.5浓度升高与生产率下降相关。在我们的主要规格中，我们发现臭氧和PM 2.5每增加一个标准差，生产率分别下降2%和1.1%。

records.title_en: Spatially coordinated conservation auctions: A framed field experiment focusing on farmland wildlife conservation in China
records.title_cn: 空间协调的保护拍卖：以中国农田野生动物保护为重点的框架性现场实验
records.abstract_en: How best to incentivize land managers to achieve conservation goals in an economically and ecologically effective manner is a key policy question that has gained increased relevance from the setting of ambitious new global targets for biodiversity conservation. Conservation (reverse) auctions are a policy tool for improving the environmental performance of agriculture, which has become well‐established in the academic literature and in policy making in the US and Australia. However, little is known about the likely response of farmers to incentives within such an auction to (1) increase spatial connectivity and (2) encourage collective participation. This paper presents the first framed field experiment with farmers as participants that examines the effects of two features of conservation policy design: joint (collective) participation by farmers and the incentivization of spatial connectivity. The experiment employs farmers in China, a country making increasing use of payments for ecosystem services to achieve a range of environmental objectives. We investigate whether auction performance—both economic and ecological—can be improved by the introduction of agglomeration bonus and joint bidding bonus mechanisms. Our empirical results suggest that, compared to a baseline spatially coordinated conservation auction, the performance of an auction with an agglomeration bonus, a joint bidding bonus, or both, is inferior on two key metrics—the environmental benefits generated and cost effectiveness realized.
records.abstract_cn: 如何最好地激励土地管理者以经济和生态有效的方式实现保护目标是一个关键的政策问题，随着制定雄心勃勃的生物多样性保护新全球目标，这一问题变得越来越重要。保护（反向）拍卖是改善农业环境绩效的政策工具，在美国和澳大利亚的学术文献和政策制定中已得到广泛认可。然而，人们对农民对此类拍卖中的激励措施的可能反应知之甚少，以（1）增加空间连通性和（2）鼓励集体参与。本文提出了第一个以农民为参与者的框架性田间实验，研究了保护政策设计的两个特征的影响：农民的联合（集体）参与和空间连通性的激励。该实验雇用了中国的农民，该国越来越多地利用生态系统服务付费来实现一系列环境目标。我们研究是否可以通过引入集聚红利和联合竞价红利机制来提高拍卖绩效（经济和生态）。我们的实证结果表明，与基线空间协调保护拍卖相比，具有集聚红利、联合投标红利或两者兼有的拍卖的绩效在两个关键指标上较差——产生的环境效益和实现的成本效益。

records.title_en: Food stamps and America's poorest
records.title_cn: 食品券与美国最贫困人口
records.abstract_en: This paper assesses the extent to which Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)—one of America's largest antipoverty programs—has reached the poorest. We compute a novel measure of the floor of income, an estimated income level of the poorest individuals in society. We measure the floor with and without SNAP benefits included in family income using 29 years of Current Population Survey (CPS) data. We correct for underreporting of SNAP participation and benefits for a subset of years and examine alternative data to assess the robustness of our findings. The analysis reveals a long‐term decline in the income floor, whereas adding SNAP to income and correcting for underreporting has reversed this decline and lifted the income floor by more than 75% on average between 2011 and 2016. The declining floor and the remarkable increase in income for the poorest Americans from SNAP are not revealed by poverty headcounts, which focus on changes at the poverty threshold.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了补充营养援助计划（SNAP）——美国最大的反贫困计划之一——在多大程度上惠及了最贫困人口。我们计算了一种新颖的收入下限衡量指标，即社会中最为贫困个体的估计收入水平。我们利用29年的当前人口调查（CPS）数据，分别测算了家庭收入中包含和不包含SNAP福利时的收入下限。我们针对部分年份对SNAP参与和福利的低报进行了修正，并考察了替代数据以评估我们研究结果的稳健性。分析揭示了收入下限的长期下降趋势，而将SNAP计入收入并修正低报后，这一下降趋势得以逆转，并在2011年至2016年间平均将收入下限提高了超过75%。贫困人口数量统计（其关注贫困线附近的变化）并未揭示出收入下限的下降以及SNAP为美国最贫困人口带来的显著收入增长。

records.title_en: Cover crops, crop insurance losses, and resilience to extreme weather events
records.title_cn: 覆盖作物、作物保险损失以及对极端天气事件的韧性
records.abstract_en: This study investigates whether cover crop adoption reduces extreme‐weather‐related crop insurance losses. To achieve this objective, we utilize a county‐level panel data set with information on cover crop adoption acres, crop insurance losses (i.e., specifically due to drought, excess heat, or excess moisture), and a number of weather variables. The data cover the main row crop production region in the Midwestern United States (US) for the period 2005 to 2018. We utilize linear fixed effects econometric models and a number of robustness checks in the empirical analysis (i.e., a fractional regression approach, two “external‐instrument‐free” estimation procedures, and a variety of alternative empirical specifications). The estimation methods used take advantage of the panel nature of the data to address various specification and endogeneity issues. We find evidence that counties with higher cover crop adoption tend to have lower crop insurance losses due to drought, excess heat, or excess moisture. Our analysis also indicates that cover crops likely have stronger loss mitigation effects against excess moisture events (like floods) and somewhat weaker loss mitigation impacts against droughts and excess heat. Nonetheless, our results overall suggest that cover crops can enhance resilience to extreme weather events and have the potential to be an effective climate change adaptation strategy in US agriculture.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨覆盖作物采用是否减少与极端天气相关的作物保险损失。为实现这一目标，我们利用县级面板数据集，包含覆盖作物采用面积、作物保险损失（即特别由于干旱、极端高温或过度潮湿）以及若干天气变量的信息。数据覆盖美国中西部主要行粮作物生产区域，时间跨度为2005年至2018年。我们在实证分析中采用线性固定效应计量经济模型及多种稳健性检验（即分数回归方法、两种“无外部工具”估计程序以及多种替代实证设定）。所用估计方法利用数据的面板性质来处理各种设定和内生性问题。我们发现证据表明，覆盖作物采用率较高的县往往因干旱、极端高温或过度潮湿导致的作物保险损失较低。我们的分析还表明，覆盖作物可能对过度潮湿事件（如洪水）具有更强的损失缓解效应，而对干旱和极端高温的损失缓解影响则稍弱。尽管如此，我们的结果总体表明，覆盖作物可以增强对极端天气事件的韧性，并有可能成为美国农业中有效的气候变化适应策略。

records.title_en: Testing the effectiveness of lottery incentives in online experiments
records.title_cn: 测试在线实验中彩票激励的有效性
records.abstract_en: This article investigates the effectiveness of lottery incentive schemes for eliciting consumer valuations in large‐scale online experiments. We implement a fully incentivized condition within a geographically dispersed sample of consumers in which bids for a Criollo steak elicited by a Becker‐DeGroot‐Marschak mechanism are realized with certainty and the products are priority shipped in dry‐ice coolers. The fully incentivized condition is compared to between‐subject random incentivized schemes, in which only a fraction of subjects realize their choices. We tested two treatments with a 10% probability framed as a percentage or an absolute number of subjects, one treatment with a 1% probability, and a purely hypothetical reference condition. The results reveal that between‐subject random incentivized schemes with 10% and 1% payment probabilities are effective in eliciting valuations that are statistically indistinguishable from the fully incentivized scheme. In addition to finding insignificant statistical differences between 10% and 1% and the fully incentivized scheme, all incentivized conditions mitigate hypothetical bias, resulting in lower product valuations than the purely hypothetical condition. We contribute a novel methodological framework for conducting large‐scale experiments with geographically diverse and representative subjects, increasing the external validity and producing reliable valuations while significantly reducing financial and logistic constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在大规模在线实验中，彩票激励方案在引出消费者估值方面的有效性。我们在一个地理上分散的消费者样本中实施了一个完全激励条件，其中通过Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制对Criollo牛排的出价被确定性地实现，并且产品通过干冰冷藏箱优先发货。完全激励条件与受试者间随机激励方案进行比较，后者中只有一部分受试者实现其选择。我们测试了两个概率为10%的处理，以百分比或绝对受试者数量的形式呈现，一个概率为1%的处理，以及一个纯假设的参考条件。结果表明，支付概率为10%和1%的受试者间随机激励方案在引出与完全激励方案在统计上无法区分的估值方面是有效的。除了发现10%和1%与完全激励方案之间的统计差异不显著外，所有激励条件都减轻了假设偏差，导致产品估值低于纯假设条件。我们贡献了一个新颖的方法论框架，用于进行具有地理多样性和代表性受试者的大规模实验，提高外部有效性并产生可靠的估值，同时显著减少财务和物流限制。

records.title_en: The effects of land direct payment program on farm income and production practices
records.title_cn: 土地直接给付计划对农场收入和生产实践的影响
records.abstract_en: Many countries of the world have implemented subsidy programs to maintain a minimum amount of farm production especially for rice. Agricultural support programs usually cause significant fiscal burdens on government budgets. These programs can be generally categorized into decoupled and coupled programs, and one longstanding research interest of previous literature is whether these programs are decoupled or coupled with farm production practices. In Taiwan, a unique land direct payment (LDP) program to rice farms was implemented to ease severe financial burden of the price support program with government purchase. In contrast to production control programs imposing quantity restrictions on farm production, this program is voluntary for rice farms, and participants are paid at a fixed rate per hectare of farmland. This paper examines the impacts of this program on farm income and farm production practices in Taiwan. The causal effect of the program is identified based on the exogenous rollout of the policy across multiple times and areas. We construct a dataset linking nationally representative rice farm surveys over several years and administrative records on program recipients to estimate the local average treatment effect of the program. We find that the effect is 4% of farm income. In addition, program participants rely less on price support programs and produce less rice and use less fertilizer, pesticide, and machinery. Although the LDP reduces rice production, we find that it causes overall government spending on the price support and direct payment programs to increase by 8.7% after the LDP.
records.abstract_cn: 世界上许多国家实施了补贴计划，以维持最低限度的农业生产，特别是水稻生产。农业支持计划通常会给政府预算带来显著的财政负担。这些计划大致可分为脱钩和挂钩两类，以往文献的一个长期研究兴趣是这些计划是否与农业生产实践脱钩或挂钩。在台湾，实施了一项针对水稻农场的独特土地直接给付（LDP）计划，以缓解政府收购价格支持计划的严重财政负担。与对农业生产施加数量限制的生产控制计划不同，该计划对水稻农场是自愿的，参与者按每公顷农田的固定费率获得支付。本文考察了该计划对台湾农场收入和农业生产实践的影响。该计划的因果效应基于政策在多个时间和地区的 exogenous 推出进行识别。我们构建了一个数据集，将多年具有全国代表性的水稻农场调查与计划受助者的行政记录联系起来，以估计该计划的局部平均处理效应。我们发现该效应为农场收入的4%。此外，计划参与者较少依赖价格支持计划，生产较少的水稻，并使用较少的化肥、农药和机械。尽管LDP减少了水稻生产，但我们发现它导致政府在价格支持和直接给付计划上的总支出在LDP之后增加了8.7%。

records.title_en: Economic sanctions and agricultural trade
records.title_cn: 经济制裁与农产品贸易
records.abstract_en: Economic sanctions are more popular than ever. But do they affect agricultural trade? Combining two new datasets and capitalizing on the latest developments in the empirical structural gravity literature, we investigate the effects of sanctions on international trade of agricultural products. We find that trade sanctions impede agricultural trade, whereas other sanctions do not show any significant impact. Complete trade sanctions have led to about a 67% decrease in the agricultural trade between the sanctioned and sanctioning countries, or a corresponding tariff equivalent of 25%, and we also obtain significant estimates for partial sanctions. At the industry level, we find substantial heterogeneity depending on the sanctioning and sanctioned countries, the type of sanctions used, and the direction of trade flows. The 2014 sanctions on Russia substantially decreased Russia's agricultural trade, mainly due to reduced trade with the EU but also due to reduced trade with other countries. Although no definitive evidence exists that sanctions alter the actions of governments of receiving countries, this paper provides broad evidence that sanctions hamper agrifood trade and hurt producers, consumers, and real output.
records.abstract_cn: 经济制裁比以往任何时候都更为普遍。但它们是否影响农产品贸易？结合两个新数据集，并利用实证结构引力模型的最新发展，我们研究了制裁对国际农产品贸易的影响。我们发现，贸易制裁阻碍了农产品贸易，而其他类型的制裁则未显示出显著影响。全面贸易制裁导致制裁国与被制裁国之间的农产品贸易减少了约67%，对应的关税等值为25%，同时我们也获得了部分制裁的显著估计值。在行业层面，我们发现根据制裁国和被制裁国、所使用的制裁类型以及贸易流向的不同，存在显著的异质性。2014年对俄罗斯的制裁大幅减少了俄罗斯的农产品贸易，这主要是由于与欧盟的贸易减少，但也包括与其他国家的贸易减少。尽管没有确凿证据表明制裁会改变受制裁国政府的行为，但本文提供了广泛的证据表明制裁阻碍了农产品贸易，并损害了生产者、消费者和实际产出。

records.title_en: Farm size, spatial externalities, and wind energy development
records.title_cn: 农场规模、空间外部性与风能发展
records.abstract_en: The global push for renewable energy must overcome the local challenge of convincing neighboring landowners to lease their properties for wind power. Is this challenge more or less pronounced in rural landscapes with small landholdings? Our theoretical model combines ideas from literatures on the commons, anticommons, and spatial externalities to explain conditions when small landholdings could promote or inhibit voluntary leasing. Empirically, we estimate the effects of landholding size and landscape fragmentation on wind farm uptake across rural areas of the United States over the past 20 years. Evidence from three spatial levels of analysis (counties, square‐mile sections, and individual parcels) indicates that areas with more landowners have less installed wind capacity after controlling for windiness, access to transmission lines, and other relevant factors that vary across and within counties. The findings imply that fragmented ownership, which is an overlooked factor in studies of the feasibility of decarbonization, will pose an impediment to future wind expansion on private land as remaining areas without wind development become disproportionately fragmented.
records.abstract_cn: 全球对可再生能源的推动必须克服说服邻近土地所有者将其房产出租用于风力发电的局部挑战。在拥有小块土地所有权的农村景观中，这一挑战是更为显著还是更不显著？我们的理论模型结合了公地、反公地和空间外部性文献中的思想，以解释小块土地所有权在何种条件下可能促进或抑制自愿租赁。在实证方面，我们估计了过去20年间美国农村地区土地持有规模和景观破碎化对风电场采用的影响。来自三个空间分析层面（县、平方英里区域和单个地块）的证据表明，在控制了风力条件、输电线路接入以及其他在县内和县间变化的相关因素后，土地所有者更多的地区已安装的风电容量较少。研究结果表明，破碎化的所有权——这一在脱碳可行性研究中被忽视的因素——将阻碍未来私人土地上的风电扩张，因为剩余未开发风电的地区将变得不成比例地破碎化。

records.title_en: Identifying farmers' response to changes in marginal and average subsidies using deep learning
records.title_cn: 利用深度学习识别农民对边际和平均补贴变化的反应
records.abstract_en: Much of the developed world has adopted substantial, complex agricultural subsidy schemes in an attempt to produce desired rural livelihood and environmental outcomes. Understanding how farmers adjust their production activity in response to farm subsidies is crucial for setting optimal agricultural policy. Whereas standard economic theory suggests that farmers largely adjust production levels in response to prices and marginal subsidy rates, recent work in consumer behavior suggests that average (dis‐)incentives may play a relevant role. We use a unique panel covering all farms applying for subsidies in Norway and a flexible deep‐learning method to exploit kinks in the subsidy scheme to answer whether farmers respond more to average or marginal subsidies. In contrast to the standard economic theory of production, we find suggestive empirical evidence that farmers respond more to changes in average payments than to changes in marginal payments. We anticipate that our findings on the relevance of average payment levels for farmers' decision making may inspire further theoretical and empirical inquiries into agricultural policy effects. The study also highlights how novel deep‐learning tools can be applied for detailed policy analysis and what advantages and challenges come with it. We believe that this approach has substantial potential for analysts and policymakers to evaluate and predict the impacts of policy options.
records.abstract_cn: 许多发达国家已采用大规模、复杂的农业补贴计划，以期实现理想的农村生计和环境成果。理解农民如何根据农业补贴调整其生产活动，对于制定最优农业政策至关重要。标准经济理论认为，农民主要根据价格和边际补贴率调整生产水平，而近期关于消费者行为的研究表明，平均（负）激励可能发挥相关作用。我们利用一个覆盖挪威所有申请补贴农场的独特面板数据，以及一种灵活的深度学习方法，利用补贴计划中的拐点来回答农民对平均补贴还是边际补贴的反应更大。与标准生产经济理论相反，我们发现有启发性的经验证据表明，农民对平均支付变化的反应大于对边际支付变化的反应。我们预期，关于平均支付水平对农民决策重要性的发现，可能会激发对农业政策效应的进一步理论和实证研究。该研究还强调了新颖的深度学习工具如何应用于详细的政策分析，以及随之而来的优势和挑战。我们相信，这种方法对于分析人员和政策制定者评估和预测政策选项的影响具有巨大潜力。

records.title_en: Monotone Function Intervals: Theory and Applications
records.title_cn: 单调函数区间：理论与应用
records.abstract_en: A monotone function interval is the set of monotone functions that lie pointwise between two fixed monotone functions. We characterize the set of extreme points of monotone function intervals and apply this to a number of economic settings. First, we leverage the main result to characterize the set of distributions of posterior quantiles that can be induced by a signal, with applications to political economy, Bayesian persuasion, and the psychology of judgment. Second, we combine our characterization with properties of convex optimization problems to unify and generalize seminal results in the literature on security design under adverse selection and moral hazard.
records.abstract_cn: 单调函数区间是介于两个固定单调函数之间逐点成立的单调函数集合。我们刻画了单调函数区间极值点的集合，并将其应用于多个经济场景。首先，我们利用主要结果刻画了由信号诱导的后验分位数分布的集合，并应用于政治经济学、贝叶斯说服和判断心理学。其次，我们将我们的刻画与凸优化问题的性质相结合，统一并推广了逆向选择和道德风险下证券设计文献中的开创性结果。

records.title_en: Long-Run Trends in Long-Maturity Real Rates, 1311–2022
records.title_cn: 长期实际利率的长期趋势，1311-2022
records.abstract_en: Taking advantage of key recent advances in long-run economic and financial data, we analyze the statistical properties of global long-maturity real interest rates over the past seven centuries. In contrast to existing consensus, we find that real interest rates are in fact trend stationary and exhibit a persistent downward trend since the Renaissance. We investigate structural breaks in real interest rates over time and find that overall the Black Death and the 1557 "Trinity default" appear as consistent inflection points. We further show that demographic and productivity factors do not represent convincing drivers of real interest rates over long spans.
records.abstract_cn: 利用近期长期经济与金融数据的关键进展，我们分析了全球长期实际利率在过去七个世纪中的统计特性。与现有共识相反，我们发现实际利率实际上是趋势平稳的，并且自文艺复兴以来呈现出持续下降的趋势。我们研究了实际利率随时间变化的结构性断裂，发现总体上黑死病和1557年的“三位一体违约”表现为一致的拐点。我们进一步表明，人口统计和生产率因素并不能代表长期跨度内实际利率的令人信服的驱动因素。

records.title_en: Indirect Effects of Access to Finance
records.title_cn: 融资渠道的间接效应
records.abstract_en: We created experimental variation across markets in China in the share of firms having access to a new loan product. Access to finance had a large positive direct effect on the performance of treated firms but a similar-sized negative indirect effect on that of firms with treated competitors, leading to nondetectable gains in producer surplus. Access to finance had a positive direct effect on business quality and consumer satisfaction and a negative effect on price, which were not offset by indirect effects, implying net gains in consumer surplus. We document other indirect effects and combine effects in a welfare evaluation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在中国各市场间对获得新贷款产品的企业比例进行了实验性变异。融资渠道对受处理企业的绩效有较大的正向直接效应，但对拥有受处理竞争对手的企业产生了同等规模的负向间接效应，导致生产者剩余无显著增益。融资渠道对商业质量和消费者满意度有正向直接效应，对价格有负向效应，这些效应未被间接效应抵消，意味着消费者剩余净增益。我们记录了其他间接效应，并在福利评估中综合了各项效应。

records.title_en: Strengthening State Capacity: Civil Service Reform and Public Sector Performance during the Gilded Age
records.title_cn: 强化国家能力：镀金时代的公务员制度改革与公共部门绩效
records.abstract_en: We use newly digitized records from the post office to study the effects of strengthened state capacity between 1875 and 1901. Exploiting the implementation of the Pendleton Act—a landmark statute that shielded bureaucrats from political interference—across US cities over two waves, we find that civil service reform reduced postal delivery errors and increased productivity. These improvements were most pronounced during election years when the reform dampened bureaucratic turnover. We provide suggestive evidence that reformed cities witnessed declining local partisan newspapers. Separating politics from administration, therefore, not only improved state effectiveness but also weakened the role of local politics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用新近数字化的邮局记录，研究了1875年至1901年间强化国家能力的效果。利用《彭德尔顿法案》——一项保护官僚免受政治干预的里程碑式法规——在美国各城市分两波实施的情况，我们发现公务员制度改革减少了邮政投递错误并提高了生产率。这些改善在选举年最为显著，因为改革抑制了官僚更替。我们提供了提示性证据，表明改革后的城市地方党派报纸数量下降。因此，将政治与行政分离不仅提高了国家效能，还削弱了地方政治的作用。

records.title_en: Repeated Trading: Transparency and Market Structure
records.title_cn: 重复交易：透明度与市场结构
records.abstract_en: We analyze the effect of transparency of past trading volumes in markets where an informed long-lived seller can repeatedly trade with short-lived uninformed buyers. Transparency allows buyers to observe previously sold quantities. In markets with intraperiod monopsony (single buyer each period), transparency reduces welfare if the ex ante expected quality is low but improves welfare if the expected quality is high. The effect is reversed in markets with intraperiod competition (multiple buyers each period). This discrepancy in the efficiency implications of transparency is explained by how buyer competition affects the seller's ability to capture rents, which, in turn, influences market screening.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在知情的长寿命卖家可以重复与短寿命不知情买家交易的市场中，过去交易量的透明度的影响。透明度使买家能够观察到先前售出的数量。在期内垄断（每期单一买家）的市场中，如果事前预期质量低，透明度会降低福利，但如果预期质量高，则会提高福利。在期内竞争（每期多个买家）的市场中，这种效应则相反。透明度效率影响的这种差异可以通过买家竞争如何影响卖家获取租金的能力来解释，这反过来又影响市场筛选。

records.title_en: Learning by Necessity: Government Demand, Capacity Constraints, and Productivity Growth
records.title_cn: 必要学习：政府需求、产能约束与生产率增长
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how firms adapt to demand shocks when facing capacity constraints. I show that increases in government purchases raise total factor productivity in quantity units at the production line level. Productivity gains are concentrated in plants facing tighter capacity constraints, a phenomenon I call "learning by necessity." Evidence is based on newly digitized archival data on US World War II aircraft production. Shifts in demand across aircraft with different strategic roles provide an instrument for aircraft demand. I show that plants adapted to surging demand by improving production methods, outsourcing, and combating absenteeism, primarily when facing tighter capacity constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究企业在面临产能约束时如何适应需求冲击。我表明，政府购买的增加在生产线上以数量单位衡量的全要素生产率有所提高。生产率收益集中在面临更严格产能约束的工厂中，我将这一现象称为“必要学习”。证据基于新数字化的美国二战飞机生产的档案数据。不同战略角色的飞机需求变化为飞机需求提供了一个工具变量。我表明，工厂通过改进生产方法、外包和应对旷工来适应激增的需求，主要是在面临更严格的产能约束时。

records.title_en: Crowding in School Choice
records.title_cn: 学校选择中的拥挤效应
records.abstract_en: We consider the market design problem of matching students to schools in the presence of crowding effects. These effects are salient in parents' decision-making and the empirical literature; however, they cause difficulties in the design of satisfactory mechanisms and, as such, are not currently considered. We propose a new framework and an equilibrium notion that accommodates crowding, no-envy, and respect for priorities. The equilibrium has a student-optimal element that induces an incentive-compatible mechanism and is implementable via a novel algorithm. Moreover, analogs of fundamental structural results of the matching literature (the rural hospitals theorem, welfare lattice, etc.) survive.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了在存在拥挤效应的情境下，将学生匹配到学校的市场设计问题。这些效应在家长的决策和实证文献中十分突出；然而，它们给设计令人满意的机制带来了困难，因此目前未被考虑。我们提出了一个新的框架和一个均衡概念，该概念兼顾了拥挤、无嫉妒和对优先权的尊重。该均衡具有一个学生最优的元素，该元素引出一个激励相容的机制，并可通过一种新颖的算法实施。此外，匹配文献的基本结构结果的类比（农村医院定理、福利格等）仍然成立。

records.title_en: Data, Competition, and Digital Platforms
records.title_cn: 数据、竞争与数字平台
records.abstract_en: A monopolist platform uses data to match heterogeneous consumers with multiproduct sellers. The consumers can purchase the products on the platform or search off the platform. The platform sells targeted ads to sellers that recommend their products to consumers and reveals information to consumers about their match values. The revenue-optimal mechanism is a managed advertising campaign that matches products and preferences efficiently. In equilibrium, sellers offer higher qualities at lower unit prices on than off platform. The platform exploits its information advantage to increase its bargaining power vis-à-vis the sellers. Finally, privacy-respecting data-governance rules can lead to welfare gains for consumers.
records.abstract_cn: 一个垄断平台利用数据将异质性消费者与多产品卖家进行匹配。消费者可以在平台上购买产品，也可以在平台外进行搜索。平台向卖家出售定向广告，推荐其产品给消费者，并向消费者揭示关于其匹配价值的信息。收入最优机制是一种管理式广告活动，能高效匹配产品与偏好。在均衡状态下，卖家在平台上提供的产品质量更高，单位价格更低。平台利用其信息优势增强了对卖家的议价能力。最后，尊重隐私的数据治理规则可以为消费者带来福利收益。

records.title_en: Buying from a Group
records.title_cn: 向群体购买
records.abstract_en: A buyer procures a good owned by a group of sellers whose heterogeneous cost of trade is private information. The buyer must either buy the whole good or nothing, and sellers share the transfer in proportion to their share of the good. We characterize the optimal mechanism: trade occurs if and only if the buyer's benefit of trade exceeds a weighted average of sellers' virtual costs. These weights are endogenous, with sellers who are ex ante less inclined to trade receiving higher weight. This mechanism always outperforms posted-price mechanisms. An extension characterizes the entire Pareto frontier.
records.abstract_cn: 一个买方采购由一组卖方拥有的商品，这些卖方的异质交易成本是私人信息。买方必须要么购买整个商品，要么什么都不买，卖方按其对商品的份额比例分享转移支付。我们刻画了最优机制：当且仅当买方的交易收益超过卖方虚拟成本的加权平均时，交易发生。这些权重是内生的，事前交易倾向较低的卖方获得更高的权重。该机制总是优于标价机制。一个扩展刻画了整个帕累托前沿。

records.title_en: Labor Market Effects of Credit Constraints: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
records.title_cn: 信贷约束的劳动力市场效应：来自自然实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We exploit the 1997 and 2003 constitutional amendments in Texas—allowing home equity loans and lines of credit for nonhousing purposes—as natural experiments to estimate the effect of easier credit access on the labor market. Using state-level as well as micro data, we find that easier access to housing credit led to a notably lower labor force participation rate between 1997 and 2007. Our findings are remarkably robust to improved synthetic control methods based on insights from machine learning. Our research shows that negative labor market effects of easier credit access are important for assessing its stimulative impact on overall growth. (JEL C45, G21, G51, J16, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用得克萨斯州1997年和2003年的宪法修正案——允许房屋净值贷款和信用额度用于非住房目的——作为自然实验，来估计更容易获得信贷对劳动力市场的影响。使用州级和微观数据，我们发现更容易获得住房信贷导致1997年至2007年间劳动力参与率显著降低。我们的发现在基于机器学习见解的改进合成控制方法下非常稳健。我们的研究表明，更容易获得信贷的负面劳动力市场效应对于评估其对整体增长的刺激影响很重要。(JEL C45, G21, G51, J16, J22)

records.title_en: Learning by Offending: How Do Criminals Learn about Criminal Law?
records.title_cn: 通过犯罪学习：罪犯如何了解刑法？
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how criminals learn about criminal laws. It uses a natural experiment in which sentences were drastically increased for a specific type of recidivism in France. In the short run, advertising the reform did not trigger any change in criminal behavior. However, people who had firsthand experience of the reform learned about it and later committed significantly fewer targeted crimes, but the same number of nontargeted crimes. Learning appears to be limited to individuals with direct experience of the law. While codefendants also learned, other criminal peers and defendants attending the same trial for another case did not. (JEL D83, K14, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了罪犯如何了解刑法。本文利用了一项自然实验，在该实验中，法国对特定类型的累犯大幅提高了刑罚。在短期内，宣传改革并未引发犯罪行为的变化。然而，亲身经历过改革的人了解到了这一点，随后显著减少了目标犯罪，但非目标犯罪的数量不变。学习似乎仅限于直接接触法律的个人。虽然共同被告也学到了，但其他犯罪同伙和因另一案件参加同一审判的被告则没有。（JEL D83, K14, K42）

records.title_en: Gender Differences in Preferences for Meaning at Work
records.title_cn: 工作中意义偏好的性别差异
records.abstract_en: Scholars have examined whether preferences for job characteristics help explain why men and women sort into different occupations but have overlooked preferences for meaning at work. We first document gender differences in preferences for meaning in a large-scale survey covering individuals in 47 countries. We then conduct a choice-based conjoint analysis of a cohort of MBA students at a leading business school to study gender differences in preferences for meaning compared to other job attributes. We show that gender differences in preferences for meaning at work are widespread and partly explain gender differences in behavioral outcomes, including industry of work. (JEL D91, I23, J16, J24, J28)
records.abstract_cn: 学者们研究了工作特征偏好是否有助于解释男性和女性为何进入不同的职业，但忽视了工作中意义偏好的作用。我们首先在一项覆盖47个国家个体的大规模调查中记录了工作中意义偏好的性别差异。然后，我们对一所顶尖商学院的一批MBA学生进行了基于选择的联合分析，以研究与其他工作属性相比，意义偏好的性别差异。我们表明，工作中意义偏好的性别差异普遍存在，并部分解释了行为结果（包括工作行业）的性别差异。（JEL D91, I23, J16, J24, J28）

records.title_en: Did the Paycheck Protection Program Help Small Businesses? Evidence from Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
records.title_cn: 薪资保护计划是否帮助了小企业？来自商业抵押贷款支持证券的证据
records.abstract_en: In this study, we examine the broader economic effects of the US federal government’s Paycheck Protection Program by focusing on the performance of securitized commercial mortgages. We provide novel evidence for spillover effects of government interventions in the face of economic crises. We find that the PPP reduced mortgage delinquencies by approximately $36 billion in 2020. The strongest effects occur when PPP funds targeted businesses in areas most affected by COVID-19, where banks overperformed in providing PPP loans, and among mortgages on properties in retail and lodging. Thus, PPP relief to small businesses eased economic distress beyond the labor market. (JEL G21, G28, I12, I18, L25, R33)
records.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们通过关注证券化商业抵押贷款的表现，考察了美国联邦政府薪资保护计划的更广泛经济效应。我们为经济危机中政府干预的溢出效应提供了新的证据。我们发现，PPP在36年将抵押贷款违约率降低了约2020亿美元。当PPP资金针对受COVID-19影响最严重地区的企业时，效果最强，这些地区的银行在提供PPP贷款方面表现超常，且对零售和住宿物业的抵押贷款效果显著。因此，对小企业的PPP救助缓解了劳动力市场之外的经济困境。（JEL G21, G28, I12, I18, L25, R33）

records.title_en: Intergenerational and Sibling Spillovers in High School Majors
records.title_cn: 高中专业选择中的代际与兄弟姐妹溢出效应
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates family spillovers in high school major choice in Sweden, where admission to oversubscribed majors is determined based on GPA. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find large sibling and intergenerational spillovers that depend on the sex mix of a dyad. Same-sex siblings copy one another, while younger brothers recoil from an older sister’s choices. Fathers and mothers influence sons but not their daughters, except when a mother majors in the male-dominated program of engineering. Back-of-the-envelope calculations reveal that these within-family spillovers have sizable implications for the sex composition of majors. (JEL I21, J12, J13, J16)
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了瑞典高中专业选择中的家庭溢出效应，在瑞典，超额申请专业的录取由GPA决定。利用断点回归设计，我们发现存在显著的兄弟姐妹和代际溢出效应，且这些效应取决于二人组合的性别构成。同性别的兄弟姐妹会相互模仿，而弟弟则会回避姐姐的选择。父亲和母亲影响儿子但不影响女儿，除非母亲主修男性主导的工程专业。粗略计算表明，这些家庭内部的溢出效应对专业的性别构成具有显著影响。(JEL I21, J12, J13, J16)

records.title_en: The Impact of Legal Abortion on Maternal Mortality
records.title_cn: 合法堕胎对孕产妇死亡率的影响
records.abstract_en: Legal abortion has recently been suggested as an essential health care service. In this study, we consider whether abortion legalization over 1969–1973 improved women’s health as measured by maternal mortality. Our event study results indicate that legal abortion substantially lowered non-White maternal mortality by 30–50 percent, with 134 non-White maternal deaths averted nationally in the first year abortion became legal. We also find that early state-level legalizations were crucial and more influential than the Roe v. Wade decision itself. (JEL I12, I18, J13, J16, K10, K38)
records.abstract_cn: 合法堕胎最近被认为是必要的医疗保健服务。在本研究中，我们考虑1969-1973年间堕胎合法化是否改善了以孕产妇死亡率衡量的女性健康。我们的事件研究结果表明，合法堕胎显著降低了非白人孕产妇死亡率30-50%，在堕胎合法化的第一年，全国避免了134例非白人孕产妇死亡。我们还发现，早期的州级合法化至关重要，且比罗伊诉韦德案本身更具影响力。(JEL I12, I18, J13, J16, K10, K38)

records.title_en: Firm Donations and Political Rhetoric: Evidence from a National Ban
records.title_cn: 企业捐赠与政治修辞：来自一项全国性禁令的证据
records.abstract_en: We study France’s 1995 ban on firm donations to politicians. We use a difference-in-differences approach and a novel dataset combining the campaign manifestos issued by candidates running in French parliamentary elections with data on their campaign contributions. We show that banning firm donations discourages candidates from advertising their local presence during the campaign, as well as economic issues. The ban also leads candidates from nonmainstream parties to use more extreme language. This suggests that private donors shape politicians’ topics of interest, and that campaign finance reforms may affect the information made available to voters through their impact on candidates’ rhetoric. (JEL D22, D72, D83, K16)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了法国1995年对企业向政治家捐赠的禁令。我们采用双重差分方法，并结合一个新颖的数据集，该数据集将法国议会选举中候选人发布的竞选宣言与其竞选捐款数据相结合。我们表明，禁止企业捐赠会抑制候选人在竞选期间宣传其地方存在以及经济议题。该禁令还导致非主流政党候选人使用更极端的语言。这表明私人捐赠者塑造了政治家关注的议题，并且竞选资金改革可能通过影响候选人的修辞来影响选民可获得的信息。(JEL D22, D72, D83, K16)

records.title_en: The Effects of a Large-Scale Mental Health Reform: Evidence from Brazil
records.title_cn: 大规模心理健康改革的效果：来自巴西的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the Brazilian Psychiatric Reform, which reorganized the public mental health care provision by introducing mental health centers (CAPS) as a community-based substitute for inpatient care. Our research design exploits the rollout of CAPS in a difference-in-differences framework. We show that these centers increased outpatient mental health care production and reduced psychiatric hospitalizations. These reductions were more pronounced for long-stay admissions and among patients with schizophrenia. We find that the savings implied by fewer admissions do not offset the cost of the policy. Also, the reform did not reduce mental health mortality and it increased violent crimes. (JEL H51, I12, I18, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了巴西精神病学改革，该改革通过引入心理健康中心（CAPS）作为住院护理的社区替代方案，重组了公共心理健康护理的提供。我们的研究设计利用了CAPS在双重差分框架中的推广。我们表明，这些中心增加了门诊心理健康护理的产出，并减少了精神病住院。这些减少在长期住院和精神病患者中更为明显。我们发现，因住院减少而节省的费用并未抵消政策成本。此外，改革并未降低心理健康死亡率，反而增加了暴力犯罪。（JEL H51, I12, I18, O15）

records.title_en: Tripping through Hoops: The Effect of Violating Compulsory Government Procedures
records.title_cn: 穿越铁环：违反强制性政府程序的影响
records.abstract_en: Millions of Americans must navigate complex government procedures under the threat of punishment. Violating these requirements can lead to poverty traps or deepening legal system involvement. We use a field experiment to estimate the effect of failing to appear for court on subsequent legal contact. The treatments reduce failure to appear by 40 percent. Using treatment assignment to identify the causal impact of minor procedural violations, we find no effect on arrests. However, for lower-level cases, violations increase fines and fees paid by 59 percent or $79, equivalent to a high-interest loan, showing that minor procedural violations can be costly. (JEL C93, D73, K14, K41)
records.abstract_cn: 数百万美国人必须在惩罚威胁下应对复杂的政府程序。违反这些要求可能导致贫困陷阱或加深法律体系的介入。我们通过一项实地实验来估计未能出庭对后续法律接触的影响。处理措施将未能出庭率降低了40%。利用处理分配来识别轻微程序违规的因果影响，我们发现对逮捕没有影响。然而，对于较低级别的案件，违规行为使支付的罚款和费用增加了59%或$79，相当于一笔高息贷款，表明轻微程序违规可能代价高昂。（JEL C93, D73, K14, K41）

records.title_en: How Do Copayment Coupons Affect Branded Drug Prices and Quantities Purchased?
records.title_cn: 共付额优惠券如何影响品牌药价格和购买数量？
records.abstract_en: We estimate the causal effects of drug copayment coupons, which reduce consumer cost sharing for branded prescription drugs, on net-of-rebate price and quantities sold. We show that coupon introductions increase the quantity of drugs without generic substitutes sold by 23–25 percent for the commercial segment relative to Medicare Advantage, where coupons are banned. To quantify the resulting equilibrium price effects, we estimate a discrete choice model of demand for multiple sclerosis drugs and simulate a model of drug price negotiations. We estimate that net-of-rebate prices are 8 percent higher due to coupons being offered for most of these drugs. (JEL G22, I18, L65)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了药品共付额优惠券（即降低品牌处方药消费者自付部分的优惠券）对扣除返利后价格和销售数量的因果效应。我们发现，相对于禁止使用优惠券的Medicare Advantage计划，优惠券的引入使商业保险细分市场中无仿制药替代品的药品数量增加了23-25%。为了量化由此产生的均衡价格效应，我们估计了一个多发性硬化症药物的离散选择需求模型，并模拟了一个药品价格谈判模型。我们估计，由于这些药物中大多数都提供优惠券，扣除返利后的价格高出8%。（JEL G22, I18, L65）

records.title_en: Indirect Savings from Public Procurement Centralization
records.title_cn: 公共采购集中化的间接节约
